literature.title: Queering a community sports club in Australia: A case study of gender inclusion
literature.title_cn: 澳大利亚社区体育俱乐部的酷儿化：性别包容的案例研究
literature.title_en: Queering a community sports club in Australia: A case study of gender inclusion
literature.author: Nadia Bevan, Ruth Jeanes
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Community sporting clubs have traditionally been shaped by hegemonic masculine norms. This paper presents a case study exploration of an independent regional women and gender diverse Australian football club. Interviews, observations, policy and online analysis of the club showed how they created an equitable and inclusive community sports club underpinned by a Do-It-Yourself ethos. Club founders queered hegemonic norms and traditions associated with existing football clubs by developing inclusive structures, policies, practices and processes. The club were dedicated to centring the voices of women and gender diverse community members; and women and gender diverse community members who experience intersectional forms of discrimination. Despite developing an equitable queer subculture, the traditionally masculine governing structures and systems they exist within provided two impediments to participation: access and inclusion to local leagues and facilities. The case study will show how DIY sporting clubs can provide inclusive alternatives to sporting norms, but the gender inclusion they are able to foster remains at a micro level unable to transform the hegemonic, heterosexist sport structures and practices they exist within.
literature.abstract_cn: 社区体育俱乐部传统上一直由霸权男性气质规范塑造。本文呈现了一个独立的区域性女性及性别多元澳大利亚足球俱乐部的案例研究。对俱乐部的访谈、观察、政策和在线分析显示，他们如何通过"自己动手"（DIY）的精神创建了一个公平包容的社区体育俱乐部。俱乐部创始人通过发展包容性的结构、政策、实践和流程，扭转了与现有足球俱乐部相关的霸权规范和传统。该俱乐部致力于以女性和性别多元社区成员为中心，特别是那些经历交叉性形式歧视的成员。尽管发展了一种公平的酷儿亚文化，但……
literature.keywords: gender; inclusion; community; football; policy; interviews

literature.title: “Zheng Qinwen is the pure-blood ideal of Gu Eileen”: Exploring the sensemaking of elite female athlete identities on Chinese social media
literature.title_cn: “郑钦文是谷爱凌的纯血理想”：中国社交媒体上精英女运动员身份的意义建构
literature.title_en: “Zheng Qinwen is the pure-blood ideal of Gu Eileen”: Exploring the sensemaking of elite female athlete identities on Chinese social media
literature.author: Xiaoya Yang, Yifan Jin
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This study explores how the Chinese make sense of elite female athletes’ identities on Weibo, focusing on Zheng Qinwen and her online comparisons with Gu Eileen, against the historical, social, and cultural backdrop of neo/non-liberal China. Guided by sensemaking theory and intersectionality, we conducted a critical discourse analysis of 2467 Weibo posts, identifying four primary themes: (1) “sporting superpower” and “empowered women”: reimagining the ideal female athlete; (2) “pure blood” and ethnic authenticity: shaping national pride in global sports; (3) middle-class success and anxiety: navigating Confucian family values and talent cultivation; and (4) polarized misogyny and national idolatry: reflecting emotionalized and commercialized online discourses. Our findings illustrate how Zheng and Gu's identities are shaped by societal tensions and competing values surrounding national aspirations, capitalist values, gender roles, and social mobility, with social media acting as a platform for grassroots expression and discursive contestation. Consequently, Zheng is portrayed as an ideal balance of these influences within global sports culture. This complexity is embedded in the unique multi-channel sports system within neo/non-liberal China, where the ideal Chinese sports heroines are expected to serve as cultural and ideological symbols for the state, underscoring their role in national representation.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了中国人如何在微博上理解精英女性运动员的身份，聚焦于郑钦文及其与谷爱凌的在线比较，背景是新/非自由主义中国的历史、社会和文化语境。在意义建构理论（sensemaking theory）和交叉性（intersectionality）的指导下，我们对2,467条微博帖子进行了批判性话语分析，识别出四个主要主题：（1）"体育强国"与"赋权女性"：重新构想理想的女性运动员；（2）"纯正血统"与种族本真性：在全球体育中塑造民族自豪感；（3）中产阶级成功与焦虑：协调儒家家庭价值观与人才培养；（4）极化厌女与民族偶像崇拜：反映情绪化和商业化的在线话语。我们的研究结果展示了中国网民如何……
literature.keywords: athlete; gender; representation; grassroots; anxiety
literature.theoretical_framework: 性别理论、话语分析理论、平台理论

literature.title: Staying active in sports during the transition from school to work: The role of social support in young adulthood
literature.title_cn: 从学校到工作的转变中保持体育活跃：青年期社会支持的作用
literature.title_en: Staying active in sports during the transition from school to work: The role of social support in young adulthood
literature.author: Sara Wiertsema, Gerbert Kraaykamp, Remco Hoekman
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: The transition from school to work is typically unfavourable for the sports participation of young adults. However, receiving social support might help young adults maintain their involvement in sports during this transition. To test this proposition, we investigated whether social support from partners, family, friends and coworkers had a mitigating effect on the decline in sports frequency. Using quasi-longitudinal data on 1040 young adults from the TRansition Into Active Living survey, we find with fixed-effects panel regression models that the transition from full-time education to employment indeed negatively impacted weekly sports frequency. This decline is mitigated by frequent experiences of social support for sports. Social support from friends and coworkers seemed especially important in alleviating the drop in sports frequency. Policy implications and avenues for future research are discussed.
literature.abstract_cn: 从学校到工作的过渡通常不利于年轻成年人的体育参与。然而，获得社会支持可能有助于年轻成年人在这一过渡期间维持体育参与。为检验这一命题，我们调查了来自伴侣、家庭、朋友和同事的社会支持是否对体育参与频率的下降具有缓冲作用。使用准纵向数据……
literature.keywords: policy; survey

literature.title: Examining the socioemotional outcomes of social justice efforts on social media users: Evidence from the NFL's Inspire Change initiatives
literature.title_cn: 审视社交媒体用户对社会正义行动的社情情感结果：来自NFL“Inspire Change”倡议的证据
literature.title_en: Examining the socioemotional outcomes of social justice efforts on social media users: Evidence from the NFL's Inspire Change initiatives
literature.author: Yoseph Z Mamo, Justin Haegele, Christos Anagnostopoulos, Kwame Agyemang
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Despite the growing interest in social justice activities, there is a lack of empirical evidence regarding their impact on various stakeholders, particularly social media users. We gathered longitudinal data from the NFL's @inspirechange X (former Twitter) account, a designated social justice communication handle, between August 2019 and March 2023. During this timeframe, the account garnered 20,967 comments (including original tweets and retweets) from 11,481 distinct users, but our analysis focused on 5851 comments deemed usable from 3632 unique users. Drawing on the social exchange theory, sentiment analysis, and thematic analysis, this study examines social media users’ sentiments toward the NFL's social justice efforts and the types of social justice influence that lead to positive and negative responses. Our findings show increased positive sentiment towards equitable social justice efforts, but racial issues, law enforcement, and transparency concerns led to notable negative sentiments, sparking polarized responses. Understanding specific social justice actions that evoke positive and negative emotions helps sport organizations effectively monitor and improve their social justice programs, enabling data-driven decisions. This study employs social media to comprehend diffuse stakeholder voices and extends the application of positive and negative reciprocity to the context of social media users and their perception of social justice.
literature.abstract_cn: 尽管社会各界对社会正义活动的兴趣日益浓厚，但关于这些活动对各类利益相关者（尤其是社交媒体用户）影响的实证证据仍然缺乏。我们收集了美国国家橄榄球联盟（NFL）指定用于社会正义传播的账号@inspirechange在X（原推特）平台上2019年8月至2023年3月间的纵向数据。在此期间，该账号获得了来自11481名不同用户的20967条评论（包括原创推文和转发），但我们的分析聚焦于3632名唯一用户的5851条可用评论。本研究基于社会交换理论，结合情感分析与主题分析，考察社交媒体用户对NFL社会正义行动的情感倾向，以及哪些类型的社会正义影响力会引发正面或负面回应。研究发现，用户对公平的社会正义行动持更多正面情绪，但种族议题、执法以及透明度问题引发了显著的负面情绪，导致两极化的回应。理解哪些具体的社会正义行动会激发正面与负面情绪，有助于体育组织有效监控和改进其社会正义项目，实现数据驱动的决策。本研究利用社交媒体来理解分散的利益相关者声音，并将正负互惠原则的应用扩展到社交媒体用户及其社会正义感知的语境中。
literature.keywords: twitter; emotion
literature.theoretical_framework: 受众研究理论、使用与满足理论

literature.title: ‘Dust off the cobwebs’: Windsurfing, kiteboarding, and the politics of modernising Olympic sailing
literature.title_cn: “掸去蛛网”：风帆冲浪、风筝冲浪与奥运帆船现代化的政治
literature.title_en: ‘Dust off the cobwebs’: Windsurfing, kiteboarding, and the politics of modernising Olympic sailing
literature.author: Belinda Wheaton, Ben Oakley, Holly Thorpe
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: The International Olympic Committee's (IOC) attempts to modernise the Olympic programme thought the Agenda 2020 framework, including through the inclusion of newer youth-focused action sports, is well documented. However, research on action sport inclusion has focused on the challenges for the newly incorporated sports, and their governance. The impacts for the traditional International Federations (IFs), and their shifting power and influence in these processes has been less well evidenced. To address this gap we focus on attempts to modernise Olympic Sailing via the integration of two youth-focused action sports windsurfing and kiteboarding. Our research used a multi-method, historical (1980s–2024) and ANT-informed methodology. This directed us to identify the different organisational actors involved in the modernisation of sailing; World Sailing (WS), the IOC, and the action sports organisations, their roles and experiences. Examining significant events and policy shifts from the inclusion of windsurfing in the 1980s, to the substantial changes implemented for Paris 2024, we show the different actants/stakeholders involved in each event, their challenges, and shifting influence. Our findings show that Agenda 2020 has played a critical role in the modernisation of Olympic Sailing. However, while both new sailing sports windsurfing and kiteboarding appeared to have had the IOC's support, Olympic inclusion was a contested process, particularly amongst sailing's traditional stakeholders. Our analysis highlights the economic, cultural, political and technological forces impacting the modernisation process, and contestation within and between these stakeholders. Our research reveals key shifts in the relationship between the IOC and this IF, showing that over the past decade, the IOC had increased its influence on WS's decision-making, and has exerted its authority more evidently. As WS is one of 39 IOC-recognised IFs under pressure from the IOC to modernise, our artic
literature.abstract_cn: 国际奥委会（IOC）通过《2020议程》框架使奥林匹克项目现代化（包括纳入更多面向青年的新型动作类运动）的尝试已有充分文献记录。然而，关于动作类运动纳入的研究主要聚焦于新纳入运动及其治理所面临的挑战。对传统国际单项体育联合会（IFs）的影响，以及它们在这些过程中的权力和影响力转移，则证据较少。为弥补这一空白，我们聚焦于通过整合两项青年……的帆船奥运现代化尝试。
literature.keywords: politics; inclusion; policy; governance

literature.title: Reconsidering anthropocentrism: Local young people's perspectives on the 2018 Winter Olympics’ developmental and environmental impacts
literature.title_cn: 重思人类中心主义：当地年轻人对2018冬奥会发展与环境影响的看法
literature.title_en: Reconsidering anthropocentrism: Local young people's perspectives on the 2018 Winter Olympics’ developmental and environmental impacts
literature.author: Sihyeong Cho, Dominic Malcolm, Nikolas Dickerson, Minhyeok Tak
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Sport mega-events such as the Olympic Games can bring both socio-economic benefits and environmental risks to hosts. While literature on the environmental impacts of mega-events has focused on contemporary capitalism and its human-centred imperatives as causal sources of environmental degradation, analysis remains relatively indifferent to how people at the scene view the outcomes of these events. Drawing upon two competing environmental ethics (anthropocentrism and ecocentrism) as conceptual tools, this paper examines how young people from the hosting areas of Pyeongchang 2018 interpret the relative significance of the developmental benefits and environmental damages. Semi-structured interviews with 15 local young people reveal three dimensions of their anthropocentric views: (a) valuing nature based on human circumstances, (b) perceiving developmental benefits as tangible but environmental impacts as distant and (c) viewing the Olympics as a means to address regional inequalities in development. Given that the predominance of anthropocentric thinking among young people derives from the region's long-standing underdevelopment, this paper argues that understanding anthropocentric views provides a crucial foundation for addressing environmental challenges. As environmental problems are inherently social and require collective action, human needs and frustrations should be considered and addressed for environmentalism to achieve meaningful impact and gain momentum in contemporary society.
literature.abstract_cn: 奥运会等体育大型赛事既能为主办方带来社会经济收益，也带来环境风险。虽然关于大型赛事环境影响的文献聚焦于当代资本主义及其以人类为中心的指令作为环境退化的因果根源，但分析对现场人们如何看待这些事件的后果相对漠然。本文以两种相互竞争的环境伦理（人类中心主义和生态中心主义）为概念工具，考察2018年平昌主办地区的年轻人如何解读发展收益与环境损害的相对重要性。对15名当地年轻人的半结构化访谈揭示了他们人类中心主义观点的三个维度：（a）基于人类处境来评价自然的价值，（b）将发展收益视为切实可见而环境影响视为遥远，以及（c）将奥运会视为解决区域发展不平等的手段。鉴于年轻人中人类中心主义思维的盛行源于该地区长期的欠发达状况，本文主张理解人类中心主义观点为应对环境挑战提供了关键基础。由于环境问题本质上是社会性的，需要集体行动，人类的需求和挫折应被考虑和解决，环境主义才能在当代社会产生有意义的影响并获得势头。
literature.keywords: olympics; environmental; ethics; interviews; source

literature.title: ‘But she’s not even trans!’: A rhetorical analysis of ‘liberal feminist’ defences of Imane Khelif amid Olympic transvestigations
literature.title_cn: “但她甚至不是跨性别！”：对围绕伊曼·哈利夫奥运性别争议的“自由女性主义”辩护的修辞分析
literature.title_en: ‘But she’s not even trans!’: A rhetorical analysis of ‘liberal feminist’ defences of Imane Khelif amid Olympic transvestigations
literature.author: R Taha, Daniel Sailofsky
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: In the explosion of discourse across the political spectrum amidst Imane Khelif’s Paris Olympics performance, little academic attention has been paid to the subtle anti-trans and anti-Arab rhetoric posed by supporters of Khelif in defence of her success. In essence, this article adopts the case study of the discursive landscape surrounding Khelif’s Paris Olympics win to demonstrate the theoretical and liberatory limits of exclusionary, so-called ‘liberal’ feminism. As anti-trans sentiments, violence, and legislation are steadily rising across North America, most blatantly within the US, there is an imperative to not only address the overt right-wing transphobia responsible for these attacks, but also the normalization of anti-trans rhetoric among the left. Under the guise of a feminist orientation, these ‘liberal feminists’ defend Khelif’s eligibility to compete by touting her cisgender womanhood – silently reinforcing the notion that transgender and intersex athletes are deserving of that violence and exclusion. These arguments also suggest the impossibility of an LGBTQ + identity for Algerian-born Khelif, given her ‘homophobic’ and ‘transphobic’ society: a common Orientalist trope assigned to Arab and Muslim countries to justify Western imperialism. Finally, we analyse the failure of these arguments to address systemic forms of gender-based violence in sport, including sex testing, which disproportionately affects racialized women athletes from the Global South.
literature.abstract_cn: 在伊马内·凯利夫（Imane Khelif）巴黎奥运会表现引发的跨政治光谱话语爆发中，学术界很少关注凯利夫的支持者为捍卫其成功而提出的微妙的反跨性别和反阿拉伯修辞。本质上，本文以围绕凯利夫巴黎奥运会夺冠的话语景观为案例，来论证排他性的所谓"自由派"女权主义的理论和解放局限。随着反跨性别情绪、暴力和立法在北美（最明显的是在美国）持续上升，不仅有必要应对造成这些攻击的公开右翼跨性别恐惧症，也有必要应对左翼中反跨性别修辞的正常化。这些"自由派女权主义者"在女权主义取向的幌子下，通过宣扬凯利夫的顺性别身份来捍卫她参赛的资格，从而强化了排他性逻辑。
literature.keywords: gender; olympics; athlete

literature.title: Blind spenders? The social meaning of money in youth sport
literature.title_cn: 盲目的挥霍者？青少年体育中金钱的社会意义
literature.title_en: Blind spenders? The social meaning of money in youth sport
literature.author: Lars Erik Espedalen, Åse Strandbu
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This study explores parents’ views and practices regarding expenses in club-organized youth sport (OYS), inspired by Zelizer's theory of the social meaning of money. Our ambition is twofold: (a) to develop a typology of the meaning of money spent on teenage children's sport participation—from the parents’ point of view, and (b) to examine how the meaning of money (the typology) is anchored in social class and familiarity with sport. Our data material is qualitative interviews with 40 parents of teenagers in organized football and/or cross-country skiing. Through our analyses, we developed a three-fold typology: Blind spending encompasses not knowing the amount spent on their children's sport. The expenses are considered worthwhile irrespective of how much they are. Concerned spending encompasses spending what is considered necessary, but accompanied by some reflections and restrictions on the spending. Painful spending is far from blind and includes struggling to pay expenses. We conclude that the meaning of money in youth sport is both related to class and the available economic resources in the family, as well as the meaning families imbue sport with. Our study contributes to the understanding of social mechanisms behind class differences in sport participation.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究受泽利泽关于金钱社会意义理论的启发，探讨父母对俱乐部组织青少年体育（OYS）开支的看法和实践。我们的目标有两个：（a）从父母角度建立青少年子女体育参与开支金钱意义的类型学；（b）考察金钱意义（类型学）如何植根于社会阶层和对体育的熟悉程度。我们的数据材料是对组织化足球和/或越野滑雪中青少年父母的40次定性访谈。通过分析，我们建立了一个三部分类型学：盲目开支指不知道花在子女体育上的金额。无论花费多少，这些开支都被认为是值得的。审慎开支指花费被认为必要的金额，但对开支有一些反思和限制。痛苦开支远非盲目，包括为支付开支而挣扎。我们得出结论，青少年体育中金钱的意义既与阶层和家庭可用的经济资源相关，也与家庭赋予体育的意义相关。我们的研究有助于理解体育参与中阶层差异背后的社会机制。
literature.keywords: football; qualitative; interviews
literature.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、产业组织理论

literature.title: Conceptualising family well-being in elite swimming
literature.title_cn: 概念化精英游泳中的家庭福祉
literature.title_en: Conceptualising family well-being in elite swimming
literature.author: Anastasia Christoforou, Louise Mansfield, Richard Blair, Daniel Rhind
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This paper presents a novel theoretical framework for understanding family well-being (FWB) in elite swimming. It uses qualitative data from longitudinal interviews with families of elite swimmers in Cyprus to show the importance of understanding the impact of FWB on athlete well-being. Adopting an Interpretative Phenomenological Analysis (IPA) approach, a year-long study was conducted to understand the experiences of four Cypriot families with an adolescent swimmer who had Olympic potential. The study employed four rounds of individual interviews with each family member to explore in-depth well-being, family life and elite sporting experiences. The findings revealed that a mutual sense of FWB was characterised by health, emotions and a sense of belonging and worthwhileness. We argue for the need to move from individual accounts of athlete well-being to multidimensional models that help to understand the sociocultural contexts and complex relationships that impact how athletes feel. Our research argues that understanding athletes’ well-being cannot be separated from the environment and communities in which they live and practise their sport, and explores this issue through the family context.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个理解精英游泳中家庭福祉（FWB）的新理论框架。它使用对塞浦路斯精英游泳运动员家庭的纵向访谈定性数据，以显示理解家庭福祉对运动员福祉影响的重要性。采用解释性现象学分析（IPA）方法，进行了一项为期一年的研究，以理解四个有奥运潜力青少年游泳运动员的塞浦路斯家庭的经历。研究对每位家庭成员进行了四轮个人访谈，以深入探索福祉、家庭生活和精英运动经历。研究结果显示，家庭福祉的相互认同以健康、情感以及归属感和价值感为特征。我们主张需要从运动员福祉的个体叙述转向多维模型，以帮助理解影响运动员感受的社会文化背景和复杂关系。我们的研究认为，理解运动员的福祉不能与其生活和从事运动的环境及社区分开，并通过家庭背景来探讨这一问题。
literature.keywords: qualitative; interviews; athlete; emotion

literature.title: Equal to, different from, better than: The multiple bodies of women Olympic Weightlifters
literature.title_cn: 平等、不同、更优：女性奥运举重运动员的多重身体
literature.title_en: Equal to, different from, better than: The multiple bodies of women Olympic Weightlifters
literature.author: Monica Nelson, Holly Thorpe, Belinda Wheaton, Gloria Hinemoa Clarke, Stacy Sims
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: In this paper, we explore how women athletes’ bodies may be simultaneously shaped by multiple—and at times contradictory—understandings of sex, gender, and athletic potential. To do so, we draw from Annemarie Mol's sociology of contrasts, a theoretical framework that emphasizes that individual bodies are multiple, composed of ontologically distinct, contrasting versions that exist alongside one another. We examine this topic in the context of Olympic Weightlifting in Aotearoa New Zealand, where the historically masculine sport is increasingly dominated by talented women athletes. Analyzing data with Mol's focus on the “practicalities, materialities, events” that contribute to the physical reality of bodies, we recount the sex- and gender-based training practices, objects, and policies that shaped women weightlifters’ bodies into versions that were equal to, different from, and better than those of men Olympic Weightlifters. Critically examining the promises and challenges of these bodies, we position Mol's sociology of contrasts as a promising method to explore questions of sex, gender, and physical capacity in sociocultural research on women's sporting bodily performance and potential.
literature.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们探讨女性运动员的身体如何可能同时被关于性别（sex）、社会性别（gender）和运动潜力的多重——有时是相互矛盾的——理解所塑造。为此，我们借鉴安内玛丽·莫尔（Annemarie Mol）的"对比社会学"（sociology of contrasts），这是一个强调个体身体是多元的理论框架，由本体论上不同、相互对立且并存的版本构成。我们在新西兰奥特亚罗瓦的奥运举重背景下考察这一主题，在这个历史上以男性为主的运动中，越来越多的才华横溢的女性运动员占据主导。运用莫尔对构成身体物理现实的"实践、物质性、事件"的关注分析数据，我们叙述了塑造女性举重运动员身体的性别和社会性别化的训练实践、物品和政策，使其成为与男性奥运举重运动员同等、不同且更优的版本。通过批判性审视这些身体的承诺与挑战，我们将莫尔的对比社会学定位为一种有前景的方法，用于在女性运动身体表现与潜力的社会文化研究中探索性别、社会性别和身体能力问题。
literature.keywords: gender; athlete

literature.title: An evaluation method of the Olympic sustainability: A systematic review
literature.title_cn: 奥运可持续性的评价方法：一项系统性综述
literature.title_en: An evaluation method of the Olympic sustainability: A systematic review
literature.author: Guoyang Chen, Jaewoo Park
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This study is a systematic review of research evaluating the sustainability of the Olympic Games. In accordance with Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines, data were collected, and an analytical framework was designed to review studies on Olympic sustainability evaluation. The findings indicate that all studies used quantitative strategies, including case, comparative and survey approaches, examining sustainability across pre-Game, Game and post-Game phases from the researcher, expert and public perspectives. Evaluation frameworks were derived from official models or independently developed tools by researchers, prioritising environmental dimensions, followed by social and economic aspects. Indicators, derived from official reports, academic papers and evaluation projects, were screened for relevance and representativeness. Proxy variables such as numerical data, expert opinions or public attitudes were converted into comparable values using tools, including Likert scales and scoring cards. Appropriate descriptive or inferential statistical methods, such as weighted sums and linear regression analysis, were selected based on the research objectives for analysis. Findings revealed that the Olympic Games generally lack sustainability, particularly in delivering positive impacts. This review highlights current evaluation limitations and offers insights into improving evaluation frameworks to promote environmental, social and economic sustainability, providing a foundation for future research and policy.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究是一项系统综述，评估评估奥运会可持续性的研究。依据系统综述与元分析首选报告项目（PRISMA）指南收集数据，并设计了一个分析框架来综述关于奥运可持续性评估的研究。研究结果表明，所有研究都采用了定量策略，包括案例、比较和调查方法，从研究者、专家和公众的视角考察了赛前、赛中和赛后阶段的可持续性。评估框架来源于……
literature.keywords: sustainability; policy; quantitative; survey; environmental
literature.research_method: 系统文献综述、量化研究

literature.title: From team attachment to sport appreciation: A concentric spheres model of contemporary sports fandom
literature.title_cn: 从球队依恋到体育欣赏：当代体育粉丝文化的同心圆模型
literature.title_en: From team attachment to sport appreciation: A concentric spheres model of contemporary sports fandom
literature.author: Orr Levental
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This study investigates the evolving landscape of sports fandom by examining how digital-era engagement practices intersect with traditional fan identities. Through semi-structured interviews with 30 Israeli sports fans, stratified into three distinct participant groups based on their engagement with traditional team support and fantasy sports participation, the research explores the multidimensional nature of contemporary fan identity construction. Findings reveal three theoretically significant themes: (1) the dialectical tension between emotional team attachment and analytical sports appreciation; (2) the contrasting community formation patterns across different fan types, from collective identity-based traditional communities to knowledge-exchange networks in fantasy sports; and (3) the spectrum between partisan emotional investment and detached analytical neutrality in sports engagement. The study's theoretical contribution lies in its development of a concentric spheres model conceptualizing sports fandom as operating across three distinct yet interconnected planes of engagement: traditional team-centric fandom characterized by emotional proximity and local identification; globalized mediated fandom marked by transnational team affiliations and digital community participation; and analytical sports appreciation centered on athletic aesthetics, entertainment value, and competitive participation. This framework advances sport sociology by reconceptualizing fandom as a dynamic continuum rather than a set of discrete categories, demonstrating how contemporary fans navigate between different engagement spheres while retaining knowledge legitimacy as a transcendent element across all fandom forms.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究通过考察数字时代参与实践如何与传统粉丝身份相交汇，探讨体育粉丝身份的演变格局。通过对30名以色列体育迷进行半结构化访谈，根据其传统球队支持和幻想体育参与程度将参与者分为三个不同的组别，研究探讨了当代粉丝身份建构的多维性质。研究发现三个具有理论意义的主题：（1）情感性球队依恋与分析性体育欣赏之间的辩证张力；（2）不同粉丝类型之间对比鲜明的社区形成模式，从基于集体身份的传统社区到幻想体育中的知识交流网络；以及（3）体育参与中从党派情感投入到超然分析性中立之间的光谱。研究的理论贡献在于发展了一个同心球模型，以概念化当代体育粉丝身份的多层结构，解释数字参与如何重塑传统粉丝身份边界。
literature.keywords: fandom; interviews; community; partisan; engagement; emotion
literature.research_method: 访谈研究、社会网络分析
literature.theoretical_framework: 国际传播理论、软实力理论

literature.title: “Adults know what's best for children!”: A critical narrative analysis of children's participation rights in sports
literature.title_cn: “大人最懂孩子！”：儿童体育参与权的批判性叙事分析
literature.title_en: “Adults know what's best for children!”: A critical narrative analysis of children's participation rights in sports
literature.author: Fiona Dowling
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: According to the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child, children have the right to be heard in all matters that affect their participation in sports and due weight should be given to these views in accordance with a child's evolving capacity. Yet, to date, sports sociologists have paid little attention to participation rights, focusing instead on studying the violation of children's rights with regard to child labour, sexual harassment and abuse and measures for safeguarding young participants. Drawing upon data from a critical narrative study of sport for the very young in Norway (a country that has had children's rights in sport policy for nearly five decades), the article examines how actors (parents, children, coaches, managers) in sports clubs narrate the child's right to be heard. It explores what discourses/narratives of children in sport are constructed and in what ways children are positioned as rights bearers. The critical narrative discourse analysis reveals that children are seldom positioned as learning to be agentic beings, that technologies of dominance in sport work to discipline very young children into docile recipients of adult expertise, and children's right to be heard is peripheral to sports clubs’ agendas of professionalisation.
literature.abstract_cn: 根据联合国《儿童权利公约》，儿童有权在其参与体育的所有事务中发表意见，且这些意见应依据儿童能力的发展给予应有的重视。然而迄今为止，体育社会学家对参与权利关注甚少，而专注于研究童工、性骚扰和虐待等儿童权利侵犯问题以及保护年轻参与者的措施。本文利用挪威（一个在体育政策中包含儿童权利近五十年的国家）关于幼儿体育的一项批判性叙事研究数据，考察体育俱乐部中的行动者（父母、儿童、教练、管理者）如何叙述儿童发表意见的权利。文章探讨了体育中儿童的何种话语/叙事被建构，以及其背后的动机和制约因素。
literature.keywords: policy; coach
literature.theoretical_framework: 话语分析理论、叙事理论

literature.title: Civil repair and children's sports: The Norwegian welfare-state's reconstruction of unhealthy, undemocratic and unsafe sports
literature.title_cn: 公民修复与儿童体育：挪威福利国家重建不健康、不民主、不安全的体育
literature.title_en: Civil repair and children's sports: The Norwegian welfare-state's reconstruction of unhealthy, undemocratic and unsafe sports
literature.author: Trygve B Broch
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: How can state politics reconstruct unhealthy, undemocratic and unsound sports as a common good? This study explores the convergence of state and sport politics. Using cultural sociology, I unearth how the Nordic welfare state reconstructs children's sport and embeds it in its broader purview of civil society. Through document-ethnography of white papers from the Ministry of Health and Care Services, Ministry of Culture, and Ministry of Childhood and Families, I clarify how the Norwegian welfare state criticizes and “repairs” children's sports by classifying its good and bad practices. The paper then reveals how this meaning-making process justifies and shapes the state's use of sport as an integration arena in civil society. The result reveals that the domain-specific politics of public health, volunteerism, and childhood and family hold three empirically interrelated yet analytically distinguishable codes. These binary codes transcend their domains to instantiate a coherent sport model that shapes how democratic integration and social criticism should be carried out in sports. Consequently, state politics can, in a culturally contingent way, (re)form sport organizations that do not have health promotion, representative democracy and “the child's best interest” as their primary functional tasks. In Norway, the state endlessly works to reshape “ bad sports” to reintegrate into its horizon of civil society. The civil repair of unhealthy, undemocratic and unsafe children's sports allows the state to use sports as a formative institution. From the perspective of the state, sport actors do not always solve all social issues, but they can learn, if principally committed, how to engage with a dynamic landscape of social problems.
literature.abstract_cn: 国家政治如何将不健康、不民主、不健全的体育重构为公共善？本研究探讨国家与体育政治的融合。运用文化社会学，我揭示了北欧福利国家如何重构儿童体育并将其嵌入其更广泛的公民社会视野之中。通过对卫生与护理服务部、文化部以及儿童与家庭部的白皮书进行文件民族志研究，我阐明了挪威福利国家如何通过区分儿童体育的好坏实践来批判和"修复"儿童体育。本文进而揭示了这一意义建构过程如何证明并塑造国家将体育用作公民社会整合场域的做法。结果表明，公共卫生、志愿服务以及儿童与家庭的领域特定政治，持有三种在经验上相互关联但分析上可区分的编码。这些二元编码超越其领域，实例化了一种连贯的体育模式，该模式塑造了民主整合与社会批评应在体育中如何开展。因此，国家政治能够以文化上偶然的方式（重新）塑造那些不以健康促进、代议制民主和"儿童最大利益"为首要功能任务的体育组织。在挪威，国家不断努力重塑"坏体育"，以将其重新纳入公民社会视野。对不健康、不民主和不安全儿童体育的公民修复，使国家能够将体育用作一种塑造性制度。从国家视角看，体育行动者并不总能解决所有社会问题，但他们可以在原则上投入的情况下，学会如何应对动态的社会问题格局。
literature.keywords: politics; ethnography

literature.title: Rethinking places for sport in the Anthropocene
literature.title_cn: 重思人类世中体育的场所
literature.title_en: Rethinking places for sport in the Anthropocene
literature.author: Peter Carlman, Gabriella Torell-Palmquist
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Anthropogenic climate change has profound effects globally. If the Anthropocene signifies the decline of nature as we once knew it, how might this transformation affect sporting activities conducted in natural environments? This scenario necessitates a renegotiation not only of the future of sports but also of humanity's shared history and the individual emotions and identities associated with sports. Ultimately, changes in nature due to climate change shape sports culture and redefine the understanding of the role sports mean to us. Drawing on a sociological and cultural–geographical perspective on place and belonging, this paper explores how an approach centred on the relationship between the physical environment, symbolic representation, and human emotions can offer new insights into sports in the Anthropocene.
literature.abstract_cn: 人为气候变化对全球产生深远影响。如果人类世标志着我们所知的自然的衰落，那么这种转变将如何影响在自然环境中进行的体育活动？这一情境不仅需要对体育的未来进行重新协商，还需要对人类共同的历史以及与体育相关的个人情感和身份进行重新协商。最终，气候变化引起的自然变化塑造了体育文化，并重新定义了我们所理解的体育对我们的意义。借鉴关于场所和归属感的社会学和文化地理学视角，本文探讨了一种以物理环境、象征表征和人类情感之间关系为中心的方法，如何能够为体育研究提供新的洞见。
literature.keywords: representation; emotion

literature.title: Sport and the Anthropocene
literature.title_cn: 体育与人类世
literature.title_en: Sport and the Anthropocene
literature.author: Jim Cherrington, Jack Black
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This editorial introduction to the special issue, ‘Sport and the Anthropocene’, examines the entanglements between sport, human activity, and the planet's accelerating ecological crisis. Framing the Anthropocene as a new epoch, marked by irreversible human-induced environmental change, the article highlights the catastrophic consequences of climate disruption, resource depletion, and socio-political instability. Yet, amid collapse, the Anthropocene also offers new beginnings, which can prompt critical reflections on human exceptionalism. In light of the sociology of sport's delayed engagement with these beginnings, especially important given sport's material dependence on vulnerable ecologies, the special issue challenges the adequacy of conventional sustainability discourses, which externalise nature and uphold anthropocentric assumptions. Instead, we call for a reorientation towards our ecological entanglement and temporal complexity, examining how objects, surfaces, and environments shape movement, meaning, and our planetary future(s). In doing so, the issue foregrounds diverse theoretical and empirical contributions that position sport as both problem and possibility. Ultimately, we contend that sport must be reimagined through the lens of the Anthropocene, indeed, as a site of contested and contingent relations where ecological, ethical, and existential stakes converge.
literature.abstract_cn: 本期特刊"体育与人类世"的编辑导言考察了体育、人类活动与地球加速生态危机之间的纠葛。将人类世框架为一个新时代，其特征是不可逆的人类引发的环境变化，文章强调了气候紊乱、资源枯竭和社会政治不稳定的灾难性后果。然而，在崩溃之中，人类世也提供了新的开端，这可以引发对人类例外论的批判性反思。鉴于体育社会学对这些开端参与的延迟，尤其是考虑到体育对脆弱生态的物质依赖，本期特刊挑战了常规可持续性话语的充分性，这些话语将自然外化并维护人类中心假设。相反，我们呼吁重新面向我们的生态纠缠和时间复杂性，考察物体、表面和环境如何塑造运动、意义和我们星球的未来。在此过程中，特刊突出了将体育定位为问题和可能性的多样理论和实证贡献。最终，我们认为必须通过人类世的视角重新想象体育，确实，作为一个有争议和偶然关系的地点，生态、伦理和存在利害在此交汇。
literature.keywords: ethical; framing; engagement; environmental; sustainability
literature.theoretical_framework: 框架理论、危机传播理论

literature.title: Women, sport and social inclusion in Saudi Arabia
literature.title_cn: 沙特阿拉伯的女性、体育与社会包容
literature.title_en: Women, sport and social inclusion in Saudi Arabia
literature.author: Kyra Margarete Angerer
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Globally, women lag behind men in sports participation and physical activity, a phenomenon that is also evident in Saudi Arabia. Recently, the Saudi government has invested significantly in sports and health through its Vision 2030 strategy, which aims to strengthen the Kingdom's presence in sports, public health, entertainment and tourism. This is evident in the hosting of major sporting events and the transformation of the national physical activity infrastructure. To date, little research has explored developments in women's sport in Saudi Arabia. In response to this gap, this study investigates socio-cultural factors influencing Saudi women's participation in sport and physical activity through critical adaptation and application of the analytical concept of social inclusion. Over the span of 10 months of fieldwork, data were collected through participatory observations and 12 individual interviews with officials, managers and stakeholders in the Saudi sports sector with a particular focus on football. Data analysis revealed three key socio-cultural themes shaping women's participation in sport. First, pioneering women leaders have fostered a strong sense of ownership, organic development and community involvement. Second, the promotion of national socialisation, heritage and nationalism in Saudi women's sport is perceived as balancing traditional customs and national pride. Thirdly, the growing recognition of sport as a tool for empowerment in Saudi Arabia highlights the importance of family involvement, career development and increasing female participation in technical roles. This research seeks to contribute to the literature on women's participation in sports in Saudi Arabia, gender dynamics in the context of transformative social change and social inclusion theory.
literature.abstract_cn: 在全球范围内，女性在体育参与和身体活动方面落后于男性，这一现象在沙特阿拉伯同样明显。近年来，沙特政府通过其"2030愿景"战略在体育和健康方面进行了大量投资，该战略旨在加强该国在体育、公共卫生、娱乐和旅游领域的影响力。这在主办大型体育赛事和国家身体活动基础设施的转型中体现得很明显。迄今为止，关于沙特女性体育发展的研究很少。针对这一空白，本研究通过批判性调整和应用社会包容（social inclusion）这一分析概念，调查了影响沙特女性参与体育和身体活动的社会文化因素。在为期10个月的田野调查中，数据通过参与式观察和对沙特体育部门（尤其是足球）官员、管理者和利益相关者的12次个人访谈收集。数据分析揭示了塑造女性体育参与的三个关键社会文化主题。第一，先驱女性领导者培养了强烈的所有权意识、有机发展和社区参与。第二，在沙特女性体育中促进国家社会化、遗产和民族主义，被视为在传统习俗与民族自豪感之间取得平衡。第三，沙特日益认识到体育作为赋权工具的作用，凸显了家庭参与、职业发展以及女性在技术岗位中参与度提高的重要性。本研究旨在为关于沙特女性体育参与、转型社会变革背景下性别动态以及社会包容理论的文献作出贡献。
literature.keywords: inclusion; gender; football; nationalism; interviews; community

literature.title: Towards more accountable journalism: An examination of Spanish sports reporters’ perceptions and practices regarding racism in football
literature.title_cn: 迈向更负责任的新闻：西班牙体育记者对足球种族主义认知与实践的考察
literature.title_en: Towards more accountable journalism: An examination of Spanish sports reporters’ perceptions and practices regarding racism in football
literature.author: José Luis Rojas-Torrijos, Carmen Longas-Luque, Xavier Ramon
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This paper analyses sports journalists’ reflections about racism in Spanish professional men's football and the meaning-making practices involved in reporting about this phenomenon. To this end, we employed a qualitative research design that relied on in-depth interviews conducted with nine sports journalists working at leading media outlets in Spain. Findings reveal that interviewees consider racism a deep-rooted problem in society, which is reflected in Spanish football stadiums as in other European countries, and argue that coverage would benefit from avoiding partisanship and embracing cultural sensitivity and combativeness. Interviewees believe that media organizations should be proactive in raising public awareness and counteracting racism through different initiatives such as campaigns, guidelines, and in-depth coverage. While journalists nominally acknowledge sports newsrooms as masculine and White hegemonic spaces, their perspectives ultimately reinforce Whiteness and leave racism unaddressed. For example, they understand racism in football as accidental and perpetrated by minorities of hooligans or abusers, concealing the systemic character of racism. Bearing in mind the responses provided by the participants and the theoretical framework underpinning this study, a decalogue of recommendations is drawn up to guide sports journalists to cover stories related to racism in a more accountable way.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文分析了体育记者对西班牙职业男足中种族主义的反思，以及报道这一现象所涉及的意义建构实践。为此，我们采用了定性研究设计，对在西班牙主要媒体机构工作的九名体育记者进行了深度访谈。研究结果显示，受访者认为种族主义是社会根深蒂固的问题，反映在西班牙足球场上，如同其他欧洲国家一样，并认为报道应避免党派立场、拥抱文化敏感性以及斗争性。受访者认为，媒体机构应主动提高公众意识，并通过诸如运动等不同举措来抵制种族主义。
literature.keywords: football; reporter; qualitative; interviews; partisan; newsroom

literature.title: It's time to re-evaluate the reporting of common measures from isokinetic dynamometers: isokinetic for torque, isotonic for power
literature.title_cn: 是时候重新评估等速测力计的常规测量报告了：等速测扭矩、等张测功率
literature.title_en: It's time to re-evaluate the reporting of common measures from isokinetic dynamometers: isokinetic for torque, isotonic for power
literature.author: Brennan J. Thompson
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: Isokinetic dynamometry is commonly used to provide an objective and reliable assessment of muscle function across a variety of clinical, athletic and research settings. Important muscle function variables that are commonly assessed are torque- and power- related measures. Isokinetic mode is overwhelmingly used to provide these variables, and has been so for decades; however, this mode may not be the best suited to examine power variables. The article aims to explore this issue through conceptual evaluation and empirical results using unpublished data. The implication is that due to the almost complete lack of unique information that power provides additional to torque in isokinetic mode, the isotonic mode is better suited to assess power for functional, operational, and methodological reasons. Thus, muscle function tests on an isokinetic dynamometer provide more fitting and useful data when isokinetic mode is used to determine torque measures, and isotonic mode is used to provide power measures.
literature.keywords: muscle function; isokinetic mode; isotonic mode; common measures; isokinetic dynamometers; dynamometers isokinetic

literature.title: Investigation of validity evidence for the Coach Precompetitive Communication Questionnaire-Preference for measurement of collegiate athlete preferences of coach speech content and delivery
literature.title_cn: 教练赛前传播问卷-偏好信度检验：测量大学生运动员对教练言语内容与传达方式的偏好
literature.title_en: Investigation of validity evidence for the Coach Precompetitive Communication Questionnaire-Preference for measurement of collegiate athlete preferences of coach speech content and delivery
literature.author: Corinne T. Zimmerman, Nicholas D. Myers, Robin S. Vealey
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: IntroductionPrevious measures of athlete perception of pregame speech have centered around a two-dimensional structure of speech content (i.e., tactical and emotional), although psychometric evidence is limited. The Coach Precompetitive Communication Questionnaire – Preference (CPCQ-P) was developed to extend the two-dimensional model of pregame speech content by (a) including speech delivery and (b) allowing a general pregame speech factor. The purpose of this study was to investigate initial validity evidence for responses to the CPCQ-P under an exploratory bifactor approach at the athlete level.MethodsParticipants were athletes (N = 264) at level-1 nested within NCAA varsity level teams (G = 36) at level-2. Participant survey responses were analyzed using an exploratory bifactor analysis with a general factor (i.e., pregame speech) and three grouping factors (i.e., tactical content, emotional content, delivery).ResultsA four-factor model with three grouping factors and a general factor exhibited approximate to close fit to the data. Review of factor loadings provided initial evidence of validity for the internal structure of responses to the CPCQ-P.DiscussionThis study expands the existing psychometric understanding of pregame speech within the collegiate sport context.
literature.keywords: athlete; coach; survey; emotion
literature.theoretical_framework: 技术社会学、创新扩散理论

literature.title: A narrative analysis of learning to teamwork in youth sport: a sociocultural perspective on communication and cooperative learning
literature.title_cn: 青少年体育团队合作的叙事分析：传播与合作学习的社会文化视角
literature.title_en: A narrative analysis of learning to teamwork in youth sport: a sociocultural perspective on communication and cooperative learning
literature.author: Joan Arumí-Prat, Gil Pla-Campas
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: This study investigates from a sociocultural perspective how team members' communication within a training approach based on cooperative learning (CL) fosters the development of teamwork. Employing a narrative analytic approach, the research examines into the experiences of a coach and his players in the locker room conversations before, during and after the game, throughout the season. A total of 69 5- to 17-minute conversations were recorded and transcribed over 23 matches that took place during an entire season. Three different steps were implemented for the narrative analysis: codification of the dialogues under the CL approach, identification of stages of learning in players and creation of the autoethnographic storytelling. Findings are shown through a narrative based on five significant stories that illustrate the context, and the complex dynamics of social interaction that emerge to learn teamwork in youth sport are discussed. By examining the coach's adoption of CL principles as a coaching and communication approach between team members, this research shows how these principles frame the learning context and contribute to teamwork. This research reveals the complexities of player-coach interactions and provides valuable insights for youth team sport coaches committed to fostering teamwork.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究从社会文化视角出发，考察了基于协作学习（CL）的训练方法中团队成员之间的沟通如何促进团队协作能力的发展。研究采用叙事分析方法，深入考察了一位教练及其球员在整季赛前、赛中和赛后的更衣室对话中的经历。研究在整整一个赛季的23场比赛中录制并转写了69段5至17分钟的对话。叙事分析采用三个步骤：在CL方法下对对话进行编码、识别球员的学习阶段以及创建自传体叙事故事。研究通过五个意义深刻的故事来展示研究发现，这些故事说明了背景以及青少年体育中学习团队协作所浮现的复杂社会互动动态。通过考察教练将CL原则采纳为教练和团队沟通方式的实践，本研究展示了这些原则如何构建学习环境并促进团队协作。本研究揭示了球员与教练互动的复杂性，并为致力于培养团队协作能力的青少年团体运动教练提供了宝贵的见解。
literature.keywords: coach; youth sport; cooperative learning; team members; teamwork in youth; communication within

literature.title: Sport fans’ curiosity and impulsive buying: mediation of social media use intensity
literature.title_cn: 体育迷的好奇心与冲动购买：社交媒体使用强度的中介作用
literature.title_en: Sport fans’ curiosity and impulsive buying: mediation of social media use intensity
literature.author: Chen-Yueh Chen, Ya-Lun Chou, Yi-Hsiu Lin, Yen-Kuang Lin
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: IntroductionSports fans' curiosity and impulsive buying tendencies are important topics in sports marketing, yet the mediating role of social media use intensity in linking these variables remains underexplored. Grounded in the Stimulus-Organism-Response (S-O-R) theory, this study examines how social media use intensity mediates the relationship between sports fans' curiosity and impulsive buying behavior.MethodsThe study sampled 623 Taiwanese sports fans, including baseball and basketball enthusiasts, to investigate these relationships. Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) was employed to test the proposed hypotheses, focusing on the mediating effect of social media use intensity.ResultsThe results indicate that social media use intensity fully mediates the relationship between sports fans' curiosity and impulsive buying tendencies. This highlights the significant role of digital engagement in shaping consumer behavior among sports fans.DiscussionThese findings emphasize the importance of fostering social media engagement as a strategic tool in sports marketing. By transforming fans' curiosity into tangible purchasing behavior, this study provides valuable theoretical and practical contributions to understanding fan behavior and offers actionable recommendations for sports marketers seeking to enhance their marketing strategies in the digital era.
literature.abstract_cn: 引言：体育迷的好奇心和冲动购买倾向是体育营销中的重要话题，但社交媒体使用强度在连接这些变量中的中介作用仍未得到充分探讨。基于刺激-有机体-反应（S-O-R）理论，本研究考察了社交媒体使用强度如何中介体育迷好奇心与冲动购买行为之间的关系。方法：研究抽样了623名台湾体育迷，包括棒球和篮球爱好者，以调查这些关系。使用结构方程建模（SEM）检验所提出的假设，重点关注社交媒体使用强度的中介效应。结果：结果表明，社交媒体使用强度完全中介了体育迷好奇心与冲动购买倾向之间的关系。这凸显了数字参与在塑造体育迷消费行为中的重要作用。讨论：这些发现强调了社交媒体平台在体育营销中的重要性，并为体育品牌制定数字营销策略提供了见解。
literature.keywords: basketball; engagement; marketing
literature.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、产业组织理论

literature.title: “It should just be about sport!”: exploring Italian athletes' perspectives in paralympic media coverage
literature.title_cn: “就应该只谈体育！”：探索意大利运动员对残奥媒体报道的看法
literature.title_en: “It should just be about sport!”: exploring Italian athletes' perspectives in paralympic media coverage
literature.author: Athanasios (Sakis) Pappous, Pablo Gómez-Iniesta
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: This study explores how Italian Paralympic athletes perceive their representation in the media, shifting the analytical focus from media texts to the lived experiences of the athletes themselves across their sporting careers. Using semi-structured interviews and a hybrid inductive–deductive thematic analysis, the research identifies key themes in how athletes evaluate current media coverage. Findings reveal that while visibility has improved, narratives remain dominated by stereotypical frames—such as the “supercrip” or pity narratives—that marginalise athletic performance. Athletes advocate for more balanced, sport-centered coverage and highlight the role of self-representation through social media in challenging mainstream portrayals. Drawing on theories of framing, representation, and disability models, the study underscores the importance of incorporating athletes’ voices to advance inclusive and accurate media narratives.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了意大利残奥运动员如何看待自己在媒体中的呈现，将分析焦点从媒体文本转移到运动员自身在其运动生涯中的生活经验。研究采用半结构化访谈和混合归纳—演绎主题分析，识别出运动员评价当前媒体报道的关键主题。研究结果显示，虽然可见性有所改善，但叙事仍被刻板化框架所主导——如"超级残疾"或怜悯叙事——这些框架边缘化了运动表现。运动员倡导更平衡、以运动为中心的报道，并强调通过社交媒体进行自我呈现以挑战主流呈现的作用。借鉴框架理论、呈现理论，研究探讨了……
literature.keywords: athlete; paralympic; framing; representation; interviews

literature.title: Constructing national identity: media narratives on the naturalization of football players in Indonesia
literature.title_cn: 建构国家认同：印度尼西亚足球运动员归化的媒体叙事
literature.title_en: Constructing national identity: media narratives on the naturalization of football players in Indonesia
literature.author: Ahmad Ismail, Hardiyanti Munsi, Semiarto Aji Purwanto
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: This study explores how Indonesian media construct narratives surrounding the naturalization of foreign-born football players and their implications for national identity. Drawing on 52 media articles from major national outlets published between January 2022 and April 2025, the research employs a qualitative content analysis grounded in a multi-theoretical framework that includes imagined communities (Anderson), identity representation (Hall), and thick vs. thin citizenship (Oonk). The findings reveal three dominant media frames: (1) naturalized players as national assets who elevate performance and international competitiveness; (2) skepticism over their authenticity and emotional ties to Indonesia; and (3) contested implications for local talent development. While naturalization is often portrayed as a pragmatic strategy, the media also frame it as a site of negotiation between globalization and local values. By mediating public perception, the media significantly influence how naturalized players are integrated into the symbolic boundaries of national identity. This study contributes to scholarship on media, sports, and nationalism in the Global South by showing how national identity is constructed through media discourses in the era of sports globalization.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了印度尼西亚媒体如何围绕外籍归化足球运动员及其对国家认同的影响来建构叙事。研究基于2022年1月至2025年4月期间主要全国媒体发布的52篇媒体报道，采用扎根于多理论框架的定性内容分析，这些框架包括想象的共同体（安德森）、身份表征（霍尔）以及厚/薄公民身份（奥恩克）。研究发现三个主导媒体框架：（1）归化球员作为提升表现和国际竞争力的国家资产；（2）对其真实性及与印尼情感联系的怀疑；（3）对本土人才发展的有争议影响。虽然归化常被描绘为一种务实策略，但媒体也将其框定为全球化与地方价值之间的协商场域。通过调节公众认知，媒体显著影响归化球员如何被纳入国家认同的象征边界。本研究通过展示在体育全球化时代国家认同如何通过媒体话语建构，为全球南方关于媒体、体育和民族主义的学术作出贡献。
literature.keywords: football; representation; nationalism; qualitative; emotion

literature.title: Refusal in physical education—teachers’ strategies and utilization of digital media
literature.title_cn: 体育教育中的拒绝——教师策略与数字媒体的运用
literature.title_en: Refusal in physical education—teachers’ strategies and utilization of digital media
literature.author: Pierre Meinokat, Katja Reimers, Ingo Wagner
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: IntroductionPhysical education refusal (PER) is a subject-specific form of classroom disruption within physical education (PE). PE teachers are tasked with managing PER effectively to improve learning outcomes and protect their well-being. Teacher interventions occur across institutional, classroom, and relationship dimensions. However, existing research has not yet adequately addressed the increasing role of digitalization.MethodsTherefore, this interview study explores the potential of digital media by investigating PE teachers' strategies for dealing with PER (RQ1) and their use of digital media in this process (RQ2).ResultsFindings show, for the first time internationally, an empirical basis for connecting the dimensional framework to reported strategies, hereby confirming and enhancing existing research. Teachers tend to use strategies that are based in the classroom dimension where they seem to have the best possible influence. In terms of use of digital media, teachers prefer software solutions to deal with PER, supplemented, if possible and sensible, by hardware and methodical structuring.DiscussionCombining these findings into a preliminary model, this study lays the foundation for future research in dealing with PER in digitally based PE lessons.
literature.abstract_cn: 引言：体育课拒绝（PER）是体育课内一种特定学科的课堂干扰形式。体育教师的任务是有效管理PER，以改善学习成果并保护自身福祉。教师干预发生在制度、课堂和关系等维度。然而，现有研究尚未充分解决数字技术日益增长的作用……
literature.keywords: digital media; physical education; teachers strategies; pe teachers; dealing with per; education teachers

literature.title_en: Editorial: The role of technology and social media in sport
literature.author: Shir Levy, Christopher Barry, Jolita Vveinhardt

literature.title: Investigating the role of Chinese sports media in shaping young adults’ exercise habits through the lens of the health belief model
literature.title_cn: 基于健康信念模型考察中国体育媒体对青年运动习惯的影响
literature.title_en: Investigating the role of Chinese sports media in shaping young adults’ exercise habits through the lens of the health belief model
literature.author: Fangni Li
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: BackgroundThe rapid proliferation of Chinese sports media has significantly impacted young adults’ exercise habits, influencing their perceived susceptibility to health risks, perceived benefits of exercise, self-efficacy, and perceived barriers, according to the Health Belief Model (HBM). Hence, the research is based on the question: How are key components of the HBM (susceptibility, benefits, barriers, and self-efficacy) associated with exercise motivation among young adults exposed to Chinese sports media?MethodUtilizing a quantitative cross-sectional design and Structural Equation Modeling (SEM), this research analyzed data from 1,221 respondents to assess the psychological mechanisms underlying media-driven health behaviors.ResultsFindings indicate that perceived susceptibility to health risks, perceived benefits of exercise, and self-efficacy are positively associated with higher levels of exercise motivation, while perceived barriers show a negative association. The findings demonstrated how media directly affects fitness views through its 4.81 average rating regarding the health dangers of inactivity. The study indicated that exercise increases physical health by an average score of 4.77 and high confidence levels in executing regular physical exercise activities. In confirming the study, the SEM evaluation tests yielded CFI = 1.000, SRMR = 0.022, and RMSEA = 0.002.ConclusionFitness influencers and government-led efforts in Chinese sports media are associated with higher reported motivation to exercise despite unrealistic body standards and accessibility inequities. This study helps policymakers, media strategists, and public health experts connect media influence and behavioral health to improve digital fitness initiatives’ media-driven health promotion. Future research should explore AI-driven personalized fitness interventions leveraging Chinese sports media analytics.
literature.abstract_cn: 背景：中国体育媒体的快速扩张显著影响了年轻人的锻炼习惯，根据健康信念模型（HBM），影响了他们对健康风险易感性的感知、锻炼益处的感知、自我效能感以及感知障碍。因此，本研究基于以下问题：在中国体育媒体曝光下，HBM的关键组成部分（易感性、益处、障碍和自我效能）如何与年轻人的锻炼动机相关联？方法：采用定量横断面设计和结构方程模型（SEM），本研究分析了1,221名受访者的数据，以评估媒体驱动的健康行为背后的心理机制。结果：研究结果表明，对健康风险的感知易感性、锻炼的感知益处和自我效能感与更高的锻炼动机水平正相关，而感知障碍则呈负相关。研究结果展示了媒体如何通过其对不活动健康危害的4.81平均评分直接影响健身观念。研究表明，锻炼使身体健康平均增加4.77分，且对执行定期体育锻炼活动有很高的信心。在验证研究中，SEM评估测试得出CFI=1.000、SRMR=0.022、RMSEA=0.002。结论：中国体育媒体中的健身网红和政府主导的努力与更高的锻炼动机报告相关，尽管存在不切实际的身体标准和可及性不平等。本研究帮助政策制定者、媒体策略师和公共卫生专家将媒体影响与行为健康联系起来，以改善数字健身举措中的媒体驱动健康促进。未来研究应探索利用中国体育媒体分析数据的AI驱动个性化健身干预。
literature.keywords: policy; quantitative; access; analytics
literature.theoretical_framework: 技术社会学、创新扩散理论

literature.title: Characteristics of sports brand content on social media and their effects on consumers
literature.title_cn: 社交媒体上体育品牌内容的特征及其对消费者的影响
literature.title_en: Characteristics of sports brand content on social media and their effects on consumers
literature.author: Yue Liu
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: Introduction With the rise of short-video platforms, social media—especially TikTok—is profoundly transforming the marketing model of the sports industry. These platforms provide brands with targeted consumer engagement channels that enhance communication efficiency and drive digitalization, creating a need to understand the specific mechanisms through which content influences consumer behavior. Methods This study empirically investigated these mechanisms by surveying 1,400 adult consumers in mainland China who have purchased sports products on TikTok. Data were collected using validated scales for brand content characteristics (informativeness, entertainment, interactivity, authenticity), brand attitude, brand loyalty, and purchase intention. The proposed relationships were analyzed using structural equation modeling with SPSS 28.0 and AMOS 28.0. Results The findings reveal that all four content characteristics significantly impact purchase intention. Notably, the effects of informativeness and interactivity were found to be comparable in magnitude. Furthermore, brand attitude and brand loyalty served as significant mediators in the relationship between content characteristics and purchase intention. Crucially, the indirect effects through these psychological mediators surpassed the direct influence of the content itself. Discussion The results underscore that the primary value of TikTok content marketing lies not in direct persuasion but in building brand assets. We conclude that sports brands can optimize their digital strategy by prioritizing content that delivers valuable information and fosters active interaction, thereby directly and indirectly enhancing purchase intention through the cultivation of positive brand attitude and steadfast brand loyalty.
literature.abstract_cn: 引言：随着短视频平台的兴起，社交媒体——尤其是TikTok——正在深刻改变体育产业的营销模式。这些平台为品牌提供了针对性的消费者参与渠道，提高了沟通效率并推动了数字化进程，从而产生了理解内容影响消费者行为的具体机制的需要。方法：本研究通过对中国内地1,400名在TikTok上购买过体育产品的成年消费者进行调查，实证研究了这些机制。使用经过验证的品牌内容特征量表（信息性、娱乐性、互动性、真实性）、品牌态度、品牌忠诚度和购买意图量表收集数据。使用SPSS 28.0和AMOS 28.0进行结构方程建模分析所提出的关系。结果：研究结果表明，四种内容特征都显著影响购买意图。值得注意的是，信息性和互动性的影响在幅度上相当。此外，品牌态度和品牌忠诚度在内容特征与购买意图之间起到了显著的中介作用。关键的是，通过这些心理中介变量的间接效应超过了直接效应。
literature.keywords: brand; tiktok; survey; engagement; interactivity; marketing

literature.title: Covering the Israeli–Palestinian Conflict: A Critical Discourse Analysis of Al Jazeera English and BBC’s Online Reporting on the 2023 Gaza War
literature.title_cn: 报道巴以冲突：半岛电视台英语与BBC对2023年加沙战争在线报道的批判性话语分析
literature.title_en: Covering the Israeli–Palestinian Conflict: A Critical Discourse Analysis of Al Jazeera English and BBC’s Online Reporting on the 2023 Gaza War
literature.author: Kareem El Damanhoury, Faisal Saleh, Madeleine Lebovic
literature.abstract: The Hamas surprise attack on southern Israel on 7 October 2023, and the Israeli military response unleashed a catastrophic episode of the Israeli–Palestinian conflict and exacerbated broader tensions in the region. This study compares Al Jazeera English (AJE) and BBC’s coverage of and discourse around key events in the early stages of the 2023 Israel–Gaza War. Using critical discourse analysis as an analytical framework, this study employs mixed methods to compare transitivity, intertextuality, and lexicalization as key discursive features in the two outlets’ coverage of the war. Counter to previous qualitative works, this study quantitatively reveals no variation between AJE and BBC’s use of active voice yet points to key qualitative differences in the discursive treatment of Palestinians and the reporting on death tolls. It further demonstrates drastic differences in the quoting patterns and negative lexicalization of the early phases of the war, with AJE taking a more balanced approach and BBC refraining from emphasizing accusations against Israel of committing “genocide”, “ethnic cleansing”, “terrorism”, and “war crimes”. The study concludes with a discussion of the implications of differential discourses around the Gaza War and the Israeli–Palestinian conflict in international media.
literature.abstract_cn: 2023年10月7日哈马斯对以色列南部的突袭，以及以色列的军事回应，引发了以巴冲突中一场灾难性的事件，并加剧了该地区更广泛的紧张局势。本研究比较了半岛电视台英语频道（AJE）和BBC对2023年以色列—加沙战争早期阶段关键事件的报道和话语。研究以批判性话语分析为分析框架，采用混合方法比较两家媒体战争报道中的及物性、互文性和词汇化等关键话语特征。与以往定性研究相反，本研究定量揭示AJE和BBC在使用主动语态方面没有差异，但在对巴勒斯坦人的话语处理以及死亡人数报道方面存在关键的定性差异。研究进一步展示了战争早期阶段引用模式和负面词汇化的巨大差异，AJE采取更平衡的方法，而BBC则避免强调针对以色列犯下"种族灭绝""种族清洗""恐怖主义"和"战争罪"的指控。研究最后讨论了国际媒体中围绕加沙战争和以巴冲突的差异话语的意涵。
literature.keywords: qualitative; quantitative

literature.title: A Systematic Review of the Literature on the Mental Health of Journalists Reporting on War, Conflict and Terrorism: Gaps and Recommendations for Future Studies
literature.title_cn: 记者报道战争、冲突与恐怖主义心理健康的系统文献综述：空白与未来研究建议
literature.title_en: A Systematic Review of the Literature on the Mental Health of Journalists Reporting on War, Conflict and Terrorism: Gaps and Recommendations for Future Studies
literature.author: Idris Mohammed
literature.abstract: This literature review examines the psychological safety of journalists reporting on war, conflict, and terrorism, synthesizing contemporary research on trauma exposure, mental health outcomes, and institutional support. Using a systematic search strategy, 88 peer-reviewed studies from 2000 to 2024 were thematically analyzed. Key findings reveal elevated rates of Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), depression, and anxiety among conflict journalists, comparable to the trauma experienced by combat veterans. Recommendations for advancing theory and research to create effective interventions to safeguard journalists’ well-being worldwide are discussed.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文献综述考察了报道战争、冲突和恐怖主义的记者的心理安全，综合了关于创伤暴露、心理健康结果和制度支持的当代研究。使用系统搜索策略，对2000年至2024年的88篇同行评审研究进行了主题分析。关键发现揭示了冲突记者中创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）、抑郁和焦虑的高发率，与战斗人员经历的创伤相当。综述还考察了影响心理健康结果的因素，包括接触强度、机构支持和应对策略。虽然个人弹性机制得到探讨，但研究强调需要更多的机构支持和心理健康资源。综述为体育记者和冲突记者的心理健康支持提供了启示，指出报道创伤性体育事件（如运动员死亡或体育暴力）的记者也面临类似风险。
literature.keywords: anxiety; mental health; journalists reporting; war conflict; reporting on war; conflict and terrorism
literature.research_method: 系统文献综述、文献综述

literature.title: Examining Crisis Communication in Geopolitical Conflicts: The Micro-Influencer Impact Model
literature.title_cn: 审视地缘政治冲突中的危机传播：微观影响者影响模型
literature.title_en: Examining Crisis Communication in Geopolitical Conflicts: The Micro-Influencer Impact Model
literature.author: Ahmed Taher, Hoda El Kolaly, Nourhan Tarek
literature.abstract: In the digital communication ecosystem, micro-influencers have influenced public response during crises, especially in complex geopolitical contexts. This paper introduces the micro-influencer impact model (MIIM), a framework for analyzing the impact of micro-influencers on crisis communication. The MIIM integrates four components (micro-influencer characteristics, message framing and delivery, audience factors, and crisis context) offering a comprehensive approach to understanding micro-influencer dynamics during crises. Cross-conflict analysis spanning Ukraine–Russia, Sudan–Ethiopia, Armenia–Azerbaijan, Myanmar, Syria, and India–Pakistan tensions demonstrates the MIIM’s broad applicability across diverse geopolitical crises, showing how factors like perceived authenticity, niche expertise, narrative personalization, and audience digital literacy consistently shape public opinion and crisis response. The MIIM synthesizes crisis communication theories, social influence models, and digital media research, providing a sophisticated framework for studying the dissemination of information and public engagement during crises. The paper proposes theoretically grounded propositions on the impact of micro-influencers, encompassing perceived authenticity, narrative framing, and influence over time, thereby laying the groundwork for future empirical research. Implications for communication scholars, crisis managers, policymakers, and social media platforms are discussed, emphasizing the MIIM’s relevance to theory and practice in crisis communication.
literature.abstract_cn: 在数字传播生态系统中，微观影响者在危机期间影响了公众反应，尤其是在复杂的地缘政治背景下。本文引入了微观影响者影响模型（MIIM），这是一个用于分析微观影响者对危机传播影响的框架。MIIM整合了四个组成部分（微观影响者特征、信息框架和传递、受众因素和危机背景），提供了一种理解危机期间微观影响者动态的综合方法。跨冲突分析显示，微观影响者在危机传播中扮演着关键角色，能够动员受众、塑造舆论并影响政策讨论。该模型为危机传播研究和实践提供了新的理论工具。
literature.keywords: framing; audience; policy; engagement
literature.theoretical_framework: 框架理论、叙事理论、平台理论

literature.title: Strategic Communication: Journalists’ Role Amid the Rise in Digital Influencers
literature.title_cn: 战略传播：数字影响者崛起中记者的角色
literature.title_en: Strategic Communication: Journalists’ Role Amid the Rise in Digital Influencers
literature.author: Paula Arriscado, Rosa Maria Sobreira
literature.abstract: Journalists have a long-standing presence in strategic communication, seen as a “transitory” mediating stakeholder that can influence other key audiences within organizations. However, their role is increasingly being challenged by the rise in alternative information disseminators—mainly digital influencers (DIs) who possess considerable persuasive power and command extensive reach across diverse audiences. Using a qualitative methodology, this study aims to analyze the perceptions of brand and strategic communication professionals regarding the role of journalists in the context of the emergence of influencer marketing within the field of strategic communication. To this end, the views of 24 communication professionals were gathered, including individuals from communication agencies and communication departments in both public and private sector organizations. The findings were discussed in light of the conceptual framework of media relations and digital influence. Results indicate that, although DIs are now well-established within the field of strategic communication, their rise has not diminished the importance of journalists in communication strategies.
literature.abstract_cn: 记者在战略传播中长期存在，被视为可以影响组织内其他关键受众的"过渡性"调解利益相关者。然而，他们的角色日益受到替代性信息传播者兴起的挑战——主要是拥有相当大说服力和广泛受众覆盖面的数字影响者（DI）。本研究采用定性方法，旨在分析品牌和战略传播专业人士对在影响者营销出现的背景下记者角色的感知。为此，收集了24名传播专业人士的观点，包括来自传播机构和公共及私营部门组织传播部门的个人。研究结果在媒介关系和数字影响的概念框架下进行了讨论。结果表明，虽然DI在战略传播领域已确立地位，但他们的兴起并未削弱记者在传播策略中的重要性。
literature.keywords: audience; qualitative; marketing; brand

literature.title: Measuring Behavioral Influence on Social Media: A Social Impact Theory Approach to Identifying Influential Users
literature.title_cn: 测量社交媒体上的行为影响：识别有影响力用户的社会影响理论路径
literature.title_en: Measuring Behavioral Influence on Social Media: A Social Impact Theory Approach to Identifying Influential Users
literature.author: Tarirai Chani, Oludayo O. Olugbara
literature.abstract: The rise of social media has democratized information sharing, allowing ordinary individuals to become influential voices in public discourse. However, traditional methods for identifying influential users rely primarily on network centrality measures that fail to capture the behavioral dynamics underlying actual influence capacity in digital environments. This study introduces the Social Influence Strength Index (SISI), a metric grounded in social impact theory that assesses influence through behavioral engagement indicators rather than network structure alone. The SISI combines three key elements: the average engagement rate, follower reach score, and mention prominence score, using a geometric mean to account for the multiplicative nature of social influence. This was developed and validated using a dataset of 1.2 million tweets from South African migration discussions, a context characterized by high emotional engagement and diverse participant types. SISI’s behavioral principles make it applicable for identifying influential voices across various social media contexts where authentic engagement matters. The results demonstrate substantial divergence between SISI and traditional centrality measures (Spearman ρ = 0.34, 95% CI: 0.32–0.36 with eigenvector centrality; top-10 user overlap Jaccard index = 0.20), with the SISI consistently recognizing behaviorally influential users that network-based approaches overlook. Validation analyses confirm the SISI’s predictive validity (high-SISI users maintain 3.5× higher engagement rates in subsequent periods, p < 0.001), discriminant validity (distinguishing content creators from amplifiers, Cohen’s d = 1.32), and convergent validity with expert assessments (Spearman ρ = 0.61 vs. ρ = 0.28 for eigenvector centrality). The research reveals that digital influence stems from genuine audience engagement and community recognition rather than structural network positioning. By integrating social science theory with computational
literature.abstract_cn: 社交媒体的兴起使信息分享民主化，使普通人能够在公共话语中成为有影响力的声音。然而，识别有影响力用户的传统方法主要依赖网络中心性度量，这些方法未能捕捉数字环境中实际影响力能力背后的行为动态。本研究引入了社会影响力强度指数（SISI），这是一个基于社会影响理论的指标，通过行为参与指标而非仅凭网络结构来评估影响力。SISI结合三个关键要素：平均参与率、粉丝覆盖得分和提及突出性得分，使用几何平均来考虑社会影响力的乘数性质。研究利用120万条关于南非移民讨论的推文数据集进行开发和验证，这是一个以高情感参与和多样参与者类型为特征的语境。SISI的行为原则使其适用于识别各种社交媒体语境中真实参与重要的有影响力声音。结果显示SISI与传统中心性度量存在显著分歧（特征向量中心性的Spearman ρ=0.34，95%CI：0.32–0.36；前十用户重叠Jaccard指数=0.20），SISI始终识别出基于网络的方法所忽略的行为上有影响力的用户。验证分析确认了SISI的预测效度。

literature.abstract_cn: 马歇尔·麦克卢汉"媒介即讯息"的著名论断以及媒介的可供性为理解广播和流媒体之间的模糊关系提供了理论框架。随着流媒体服务的兴起，传统广播公司面临着前所未有的挑战和机遇。本研究探讨了媒介形式的转变如何影响体育媒体的内容生产和受众消费。在数字丰盈的时代，广播和流媒体之间的边界日益模糊，这重新定义了受众与体育内容互动的方式。研究分析了两者之间的关系如何演变，以及这一变化对体育媒体行业未来的启示。

literature.title: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Romanian Broadcasting: Opportunities and Challenges
literature.title_cn: 人工智能在罗马尼亚广播中的作用：机遇与挑战
literature.title_en: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Romanian Broadcasting: Opportunities and Challenges
literature.author: Ștefan Vlăduțescu, Georgiana Camelia Stănescu
literature.abstract: Artificial intelligence has made its mark on the media industry in Romania, and television is one of the sectors most affected by its development. This paper analyzes through a quantitative method the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on television from the perspective of media industry professionals in Romania. The research was conducted usinga quantitative method based on a structured questionnaire. The study focuses on the responses of 128 journalists working in local and national TV stations directly involved in content creation and editorial or production processes. We selected this sample because media specialists have the knowledge to express informed opinions on this subject. The survey results show that artificial intelligence is increasingly used in Romanian newsrooms. Television professionals believe that artificial intelligence tools are helpful and that they can improve the quality of content. However, at the same time, there are serious concerns about the possibility that jobs could be affected. In addition, the risk of misinformation is growing with the increasing use of artificial intelligence tools. Findings suggest that strategic, industry-wide regulations and ethical guidelines are essential to balance AI adoption while safeguarding media integrity. This research may serve media organizations, policymakers, and academia in formulating informed approaches toward AI.
literature.abstract_cn: 人工智能已在罗马尼亚媒体行业留下印记，而电视是受其发展影响最大的行业之一。本文通过定量方法，从罗马尼亚媒体行业专业人士的角度分析了人工智能（AI）对电视的影响。研究采用基于结构化问卷的定量方法进行。研究聚焦于128名在地方和国家电视台工作的记者的回应，这些记者直接参与内容创作以及编辑或制作流程。我们选择这一样本是因为媒体专家具备就这一主题发表知情意见的知识。调查结果显示，人工智能在罗马尼亚新闻编辑室中的应用日益增多。电视专业人士认为AI工具有用，且能够提高内容质量。但与此同时，人们对工作岗位可能受到影响的担忧十分严重。此外，随着AI工具使用增加，虚假信息的风险也在上升。研究结果表明，战略性的行业监管和伦理准则对于在采用AI的同时维护媒体诚信至关重要。本研究可为媒体机构、政策制定者和学术界在制定明智的AI应对方法方面提供参考。
literature.keywords: broadcasting; ethical; television; regulation; policy; quantitative
literature.theoretical_framework: 技术社会学、创新扩散理论

literature.title: The Toy Department Has Grown Up: The 2021 International Sports Press Survey (ISPS) in Comparison to the 2011 Survey
literature.title_cn: 玩具部门已成长：2021年国际体育新闻调查(ISPS)与2011年调查的比较
literature.title_en: The Toy Department Has Grown Up: The 2021 International Sports Press Survey (ISPS) in Comparison to the 2011 Survey
literature.author: Thomas Horky, Joerg-Uwe Nieland, Christof Seeger
literature.abstract: Sport and sports communication is growing. Sport is an integral part of (everyday) communication in both traditional and so-called new media. Digitalization poses major challenges for sports journalism. In connection with the changing media consumption, the crisis of the majority of print media and the increasing globalization and standardization of sports at the international level, this applies above all to daily newspapers. In addition, sports newsrooms have been described as “toy departments”. This paper discusses the findings of the 2021 International Sports Press Survey (ISPS) on the current state of the quality of sports reporting in daily newspaper and confronts these findings with the results of the 2011 study. Against the backdrop of quality journalism based on diversity, the quantitative content analysis examines 6614 articles from eight countries. The 2021 ISPS results highlighted several key findings regarding the quality and diversity of sports journalism. These included the persistent underrepresentation of women as both authors and protagonists in sports reporting, a focus on current events over in-depth research, and a limited use of sources. However, when compared to data from a decade ago, there is evidence of a slight positive trend towards increased diversity and improved quality in sports journalism.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育与体育传播正在增长。体育在传统媒体与所谓新媒体中都是(日常)传播的组成部分。数字化给体育新闻带来重大挑战。在媒介消费变化、多数纸媒危机、体育国际层面的全球化与标准化加深的背景下，这对日报的影响尤为显著。2021年国际体育新闻调查(ISPS)与2011年调查的比较显示，体育新闻部门从昔日的“玩具部门”成长为日益重要但面临严峻挑战的专业领域，揭示了数字化冲击下的体育新闻行业变迁。

literature.title: Mapping Government Use of Social Media Influencers for Policy Promotion
literature.title_cn: 政府利用社交媒体影响者推广政策的图景
literature.title_en: Mapping Government Use of Social Media Influencers for Policy Promotion
literature.author: Maud Reveilhac
literature.abstract: This study explores how national governments leverage social media through influencer partnerships and digital campaigns to promote cultural values and policy goals. Covering a broad spectrum of governmental bodies (e.g., ministries and officials), the research highlights the variety of influencer–government partnerships and collaborations. The study comes at a time when diverse regulatory frameworks are emerging globally to govern influencers’ activity, mandating transparency in sponsorships, protecting consumer interests, and setting boundaries on influencer involvement in governmental and political campaigns. The methodology combines two main steps: (a) a web search of news articles and blogs to identify relevant examples of government–influencer collaborations; (b) a manual annotation of government-led influencer strategies of the retrieved examples based on thematic areas, degree of autonomy in the partnership, and narrative strategy. The study focuses on France, the US, and Canada, chosen for their advanced digital environments and initiative-taking approaches in both social media regulation and public diplomacy. The main contribution of the study is to develop a typology of government–influencer collaborations to align public perception with (inter)national policy goals and reach their target audiences.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了国家政府如何通过网红合作和数字营销活动利用社交媒体来推广文化价值观和政策目标。研究覆盖广泛的政府机构（如部委和官员），凸显了网红—政府伙伴关系和合作的多样性。本研究正值全球各地出现多样化监管框架来管理网红活动之际，这些框架要求赞助透明度、保护消费者利益，并为网红参与政府和政治运动设定边界。方法论结合两个主要步骤：（a）网络搜索新闻文章和博客以识别政府—网红合作的相关案例；（b）手动标注以分析这些合作的特征。

literature.title: Advocacy and Activism in Sports Podcasts: Expanding Journalistic Roles
literature.title_cn: 体育播客中的倡导与行动主义：拓展新闻角色
literature.title_en: Advocacy and Activism in Sports Podcasts: Expanding Journalistic Roles
literature.author: Kim Fox, David O. Dowling, Kyle J. Miller
literature.abstract: This article examines the political turn in sports podcasting, focusing on the blurring and evolving boundaries of journalistic roles. The US-based sports podcasts Social Sport, Burn It All Down, and Edge of Sports offer three case studies of how podcasting opens space for politicizing sports coverage beyond scores and highlights. Podcast coverage of sports has adapted by enhancing a focus on the political implications of athletes’ personal stories. Analysis of episodic content and interview correspondence with podcast hosts focuses on how the podcast medium has opened new spaces advancing the cultural discourse on how issues of diversity, equity, and inclusion impact athletes’ lives. Our results indicate the affordances unique to the podcast medium, like temporality, have enabled the expansion of journalistic roles and performance to include advocacy functions and leaning toward more socially progressive content than traditional media coverage has allowed.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文考察了体育播客中的政治转向，重点关注新闻角色边界的模糊和演变。总部位于美国的体育播客Social Sport、Burn It All Down和Edge of Sports提供了三个案例研究，展示了播客如何为超越比分和集锦的体育报道政治化开辟空间。体育的播客报道通过强化对运动员个人故事政治意涵的关注而进行了调整。对节目内容及其主持人访谈通信的分析，聚焦于播客媒介如何开辟新空间，推动关于多样性、公平和包容议题如何影响运动员生活的文化话语。我们的结果表明，播客媒介独有的可供性（如时间性）使新闻角色和表现的扩展成为可能，纳入了倡导功能，并倾向于比传统媒体报道所允许的更具社会进步性的内容。
