literature.author: Tomika Ferguson, Evan Frederick, Letisha Brown, Yannick Kluch, Meg Hancock, Nina Siegfried
literature.abstract: Recent shifts in societal activism have prompted an exploration of athlete activism, particularly within higher education, where social media has become a pivotal platform for social impact. This paper investigates Division I college athletes’ engagement in athlete activism through the lens of self-authorship and self-presentation on social media for racial and social justice. Existing research underscores the significance of social media in athlete activism, focusing on access barriers, advocacy efforts, and resistance against inequalities. Through an exploratory study, we investigate how college athletes’ processes of self-authorship and selfpresentation relate to social media activism. Our findings reveal three overarching themes: social media as an activist tool, empowerment, and a starting point for advocacy. The findings suggest avenues for college sports administrators to facilitate dialogue, comprehend the strategic utilization of social media in athlete activism, and acknowledge college athletes’ aspiration for increased involvement in effecting meaningful change within their communities. These insights contribute to a deeper understanding of college athletes’ contributions to social discourse and racial and social justice initiatives.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了大学生运动员如何利用社交媒体争取种族与社会正义。通过深度访谈，分析了运动员在种族正义运动中运用社交媒体的策略、动机与影响，揭示了运动员作为社会倡导者的新兴角色。
literature.keywords: athlete; engagement; activism; advocacy; access

literature.title: Sports News in Five Arab Countries: A Comparative Study of Journalistic Role Performance Across Platforms and Sources
literature.title_cn: 五个阿拉伯国家的体育新闻：跨平台与信源的新闻角色表现比较研究
literature.title_en: Sports News in Five Arab Countries: A Comparative Study of Journalistic Role Performance Across Platforms and Sources
literature.author: Claudia Kozman, Lanfu (Randolph) Liu
literature.abstract: This study examines journalistic role performance in sports news in five Arab countries in relation to country, geographic frame, platforms, and sources. The comparative content analysis of three journalistic roles – loyal-facilitator, watchdog, and infotainment – in Egypt, Kuwait, Lebanon, Qatar, and the United Arab Emirates (UAE) relies on 874 sports news stories from 40 print, broadcast, and online outlets, sampled in 2020 through a constructed, two-week stratified-systematic approach. Results point to variations in all roles as a function of some predictors more than others. Specifically, the UAE tended to be the most loyal/cheerleader, whereas Qatar led in the infotainment role. Loyalty was also apparent across the region in domestic news that was more loyalist than foreign news. Sources mattered in that political sources tended to predict higher levels of loyalist content, while sports sources did not have any impact on any role. Sources’ viewpoint of diversity, on the other hand, revealed multiple perspectives to be associated with more infotainment and watchdog content. The results indicate the loyalist cheerleader role that sports journalists in the West have been associated with for decades also applies to the Arab region, suggesting sports journalists behave in a similar manner irrespective of their country of origin.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了五个阿拉伯国家体育新闻中记者角色表现与国别、地理框架、平台和信源的关系。对埃及、科威特、黎巴嫩、卡塔尔和阿联酋三种记者角色——忠诚协助者、看门狗和信息娱乐——的比较内容分析，依赖于2020年通过构建式两周分层系统抽样方法从40个印刷、广播和在线媒体采集的874条体育新闻报道。结果表明，各角色因某些预测因素的差异而有所不同。具体而言，阿联酋倾向于最忠诚/啦啦队角色，而卡塔尔在信息娱乐角色方面领先。忠诚度在整个地区国内新闻中也明显高于国外新闻。信源方面，政治信源倾向于预测更高的忠诚内容，而体育信源对任何角色都没有影响。相反，信源的视角多样性揭示了多重视角与更多的信息娱乐和看门狗内容相关。结果表明，西方体育记者几十年来一直与啦啦队忠诚角色相关联，这一现象在阿拉伯地区同样适用，表明无论来源国如何，体育记者的行为方式相似。
literature.keywords: source; diversity

literature.title: “Perjurers, Rapists, and Zealots are Ending Abortion”: Sports Journalists’ Symbolic Annihilation of Women Athletes on Social Media During the National Loss of Abortion Rights
literature.title_cn: “作伪证者、强奸犯与狂热者正在终结堕胎”：国家堕胎权丧失期间体育记者在社交媒体上对女运动员的符号性抹除
literature.title_en: “Perjurers, Rapists, and Zealots are Ending Abortion”: Sports Journalists’ Symbolic Annihilation of Women Athletes on Social Media During the National Loss of Abortion Rights
literature.author: Kelli S. Boling, Jessica Walsh, Brian Petrotta, Jason Stamm
literature.abstract: As athlete activism increases and social justice movements gain support and legitimacy, sports journalists have used Twitter (now the social platform X) to discuss off-field issues such as the gender pay gap, Black Lives Matter, and #MeToo. This content analysis examines 880 tweets from sports journalists who tweeted about Roe v. Wade in the summer of 2022. Findings contribute to scholarship on the prevalence of sports journalists’ opinions when posting on social media and add to the literature on the symbolic annihilation of women athletes. The analysis also found that sports journalists working for large or elite news organizations were largely absent from the Roe v. Wade conversation on X and that the relationship between the role of the media professional (editors, reporters, broadcasters, and writers) and opinion posting was moderated by their influencer score.
literature.abstract_cn: 随着运动员行动主义的增加和社会正义运动获得支持和合法性，体育记者使用推特（现为X平台）讨论场外议题，如性别薪酬差距、"黑人的命也是命"和#MeToo。本内容分析考察了2022年夏天在推特上讨论罗伊诉韦德案的体育记者的880条推文。研究结果为关于体育记者在社交媒体上发帖时意见普遍性的学术，以及对女性运动员符号性消灭的文献作出贡献。分析还发现，为大型或精英新闻组织工作的体育记者在很大程度上缺席了关于罗伊诉韦德案的X平台对话，且媒体专业角色（编辑、记者、播音员）之间的关系……
literature.keywords: athlete; gender; twitter; reporter; activism

literature.title: Social Media News as a Predictor of Sports Gambling Salience, Attitudes, and Behaviors in the United States
literature.title_cn: 社交媒体新闻作为美国体育博彩显著性、态度与行为的预测因素
literature.title_en: Social Media News as a Predictor of Sports Gambling Salience, Attitudes, and Behaviors in the United States
literature.author: R. Lance Holbert, Leland G. Holbert
literature.abstract: Gambling has become a more prominent aspect of American sports culture after the 2018 United States Supreme Court decision offered in Murphy v National Collegiate Athletic Association that rendered the Professional and Amateur Sports Protection Act (PASPA) unconstitutional. A secondary analysis of 2022 PEW American Trends Panel (ATP) data ( N = 3900) explores social media news exposure and satisfaction as predictors of the salience of, attitudes toward, and behavioral engagement with sports gambling. Social media news exposure and satisfaction do not predict individual-level salience of the expanded legalization of sports betting. However, social media news exposure and an individual’s satisfaction with news content on X, Facebook, and YouTube positively predict feelings that sports betting is good for society and sports culture. Social media news exposure positively predicts sports gambling behaviors. A broader media effects research agenda pertaining to sports gambling is outlined based on these findings.
literature.abstract_cn: 在美国最高法院2018年在Murphy v National Collegiate Athletic Association案中作出裁决，使《职业和业余体育保护法》（PASPA）违宪之后，赌博已成为美国体育文化中更突出的方面。对2022年皮尤美国趋势小组（ATP）数据（N=3900）的二次分析，探讨了社交媒体新闻曝光和满意度作为体育赌博显著性、态度和行为参与度的预测因素。社交媒体新闻曝光和满意度不能预测个体层面体育博彩扩大合法化的显著性。然而，社交媒体新闻曝光和个人对X、Facebook和YouTube新闻内容的满意度正向预测认为体育博彩对社会和体育文化有益的感受。社交媒体新闻曝光正向预测体育赌博行为。基于这些发现，概述了与体育赌博相关的更广泛的媒体效应研究议程。
literature.keywords: facebook; youtube; engagement; feeling
literature.theoretical_framework: 受众研究理论、使用与满足理论

literature.title: The Buzz of Brisbane 2032: Themes of Online and Social Media Olympic Sentiment
literature.title_cn: 布里斯班2032的喧腾：线上与社交媒体奥运情绪的议题
literature.title_en: The Buzz of Brisbane 2032: Themes of Online and Social Media Olympic Sentiment
literature.author: Peter English, David Fleischman, Rory Mulcahy, Lenny Vance, Aaron Tham, Merryn Sherwood
literature.abstract: Brisbane will stage a more regionally focused Olympics and Paralympics in 2032 when it follows in the footsteps of a series of mega-city hosts. In this new environment, in which there are challenges finding nations willing even to bid for the event, it is important to understand how sentiment is expressed towards this Games edition, which is being promoted as delivering a sustainable legacy while experiencing different demands, levels of buzz, and risks than previous hosts. This study examines audience emotions towards Brisbane 2032 across 60,929 messages and posts from Facebook, Twitter, Reddit and online media articles between 2021 and 2023. The results highlight positive sentiment overall and outline key themes that the community perceive to be important. However, the findings also indicate early concerns and levels of anxiety towards elements of the Games. The multi-layered analytical approach of this study ensures it progresses beyond general judgements on positive and negative sentiment, providing a more nuanced understanding of emotions towards Brisbane 2032.
literature.abstract_cn: 布里斯班将在2032年举办一届更具区域特色的奥运会和残奥会，这是继一系列大型城市东道主之后的又一里程碑。在这个新的环境中，由于各国有意愿申办赛事都面临挑战，理解公众对这一届奥运会（被宣传为传递可持续遗产，同时面临与往届东道主不同的需求、关注度和风险）的情感表达至关重要。本研究考察了2021年至2023年间来自脸书、推特、Reddit和在线媒体文章的60,929条消息和帖子中受众对布里斯班2032的情感。结果显示整体情绪积极，并概述了社区认为重要的关键主题。然而，研究结果也表明了对奥运会某些方面的早期担忧和焦虑程度。本研究的多层次分析方法确保其超越了正负情感的一般性判断，提供了对布里斯班2032情感的更细致理解。
literature.keywords: audience; twitter; facebook; paralympics; olympics; community

literature.title: Determinants of Online Live Esports Viewership With Advanced Data: The Case of League of Legends Champions Korea
literature.title_cn: 用高级数据确定在线电竞收视的决定因素：英雄联盟韩国冠军联赛案例
literature.title_en: Determinants of Online Live Esports Viewership With Advanced Data: The Case of League of Legends Champions Korea
literature.author: Yoonji Ryu, Jaehyun Jeong, Wonseok Jang, Gyemin Lee, Hyunwoong Pyun
literature.abstract: With the rapid advancement of technology, esports have become more accessible and widespread on online platforms. The behavior of fans watching live broadcasts online differs from that of those watching on TV or attending stadium events. To understand the online demand for esports, this study examines the determinants of live esports viewership using advanced data from online platforms. We examined game-level data from the League of Legends Champions Korea (LCK) from the summer of 2019 to the summer of 2022. We analyzed four dependent variables representing esports online demands—hours watched, peak views, concurrent average views, and view drops—based on several pre-game (outcome uncertainty and team quality), in-game (game quality and upset result), and schedule-related (evening game) variables. Using two-way least squares dummy variable regression models, we identified the key determinants. The results suggest that outcome uncertainty, team quality, game quality, and evening games significantly impact esports online viewership. In addition, in-game factors, such as the sum and difference in kills between teams, attracted more viewers. This indicates that online viewers prefer games with more kills and a closer kill difference between teams.
literature.abstract_cn: 随着技术的快速发展，电竞在在线平台上变得更容易接触和普及。在线观看直播的粉丝行为与在电视或现场观看比赛的行为有所不同。为了理解电竞的在线需求，本研究利用来自在线平台的高级数据考察了直播电竞观看量的决定因素。我们考察了2019年夏季至2022年夏季的英雄联盟韩国冠军赛（LCK）的游戏级数据。基于多个赛前（结果不确定性、球队质量）、赛中（游戏质量、爆冷结果）和赛程相关（晚间比赛）变量，分析了代表电竞在线需求的四个因变量——观看小时数、峰值观看人数、同时段平均观看人数和观看下降。使用双向最小二乘虚拟变量回归模型，我们识别了关键决定因素。结果表明，结果不确定性、球队质量、游戏质量和晚间比赛显著影响电竞在线观看量。此外，游戏内因素（如两队击杀总数和击杀差）吸引了更多观众。这表明在线观众更喜欢击杀数多、两队击杀差接近的比赛。
literature.keywords: viewers; esports; access

literature.title: Sports Issues for the Ages: Life Span and Career Span Narratives Ingrained in Sports Culture
literature.title_cn: 历久弥新的体育议题：体育文化中根深蒂固的生命周期与职业周期叙事
literature.title_en: Sports Issues for the Ages: Life Span and Career Span Narratives Ingrained in Sports Culture
literature.author: Andrew C. Billings, Marie Hardin
literature.keywords: 体育; 体育文化

literature.title: Questioning Sports Journalists: Stereotypes, Work Routines, and Color-Blind Racism in Sports Press Conferences
literature.title_cn: 质疑体育记者：体育新闻发布会中的刻板印象、工作常规与色盲种族主义
literature.title_en: Questioning Sports Journalists: Stereotypes, Work Routines, and Color-Blind Racism in Sports Press Conferences
literature.author: Vincent Peña, Mary Angela Bock
literature.abstract: Sports scholars have long studied how stereotypes pervade sports. However, little if any of this research has examined the origins of these stereotypes and how they influence journalistic practice. This study explores sports journalists’ work routines, their perception of stereotypes in sports, and whether there is a connection between the two. The authors conduct a critical discourse analysis of in-depth interviews with 13 sports journalists from across the U.S. Results show that journalists are (sometimes) aware of stereotypes, downplay their role in perpetuating them, and engage in color-blind rhetoric about the prevalence of stereotypes in sports media coverage of college sports. Additionally, the sports journalists interviewed as part of this study outlined the various constraints on their jobs that might impact their ability to establish rapport with athletes, which might result in an increased likelihood of the perpetuation of stereotypes. The findings underscore the need for more scholarly inquiry about sports press conferences and the connection between journalistic practice and ideology, particularly as it relates to race.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育学者长期以来一直研究刻板印象如何渗透到体育中。然而，这些研究几乎没有考察这些刻板印象的起源以及它们如何影响新闻实践。本研究探讨了体育记者的工作常规、他们对体育中刻板印象的感知，以及两者之间是否存在联系。作者对美国各地13名体育记者进行了深度访谈的批评性话语分析。结果显示，记者（有时）意识到刻板印象，但淡化他们在传播刻板印象中的作用，并就大学体育媒体报道中刻板印象的普遍性参与色盲修辞。此外，接受访谈的体育记者概述了他们工作中的各种制约因素，这些因素可能影响他们与运动员建立融洽关系的能力，从而导致刻板印象传播可能性的增加。研究结果强调了需要对体育新闻发布会以及新闻实践与意识形态之间联系（特别是与种族相关）进行更多学术探究。
literature.keywords: stereotype; race; interviews; athlete

literature.title: Sports Identification in Situational Problem-Solving: A Framework for Understanding Fans’ Communicative Behaviors in Sports Crises
literature.title_cn: 情境问题解决中的体育认同：理解体育危机中球迷传播行为的框架
literature.title_en: Sports Identification in Situational Problem-Solving: A Framework for Understanding Fans’ Communicative Behaviors in Sports Crises
literature.author: Mu He
literature.abstract: Sports have been enjoyed by people worldwide as an essential part of life. Inevitably, sports-related issues have also permeated into the industry. Specifically, scholars have called for more attention to fan-enacted crisis communication in sports. Based on the situational theory of problem-solving, this project incorporates sports identification, modified engagement in and disengagement from online communication, and self-mocking to examine fans’ online communicative behaviors regarding the National Football League (NFL) concussion issue and the Chinese men’s national soccer team crisis. The findings reveal that sports identification was a significant indicator that influenced fans’ perceptions of the issue. In addition, fans motivated to solve the problem were more likely to engage in online communication rather than disengage from it. Moreover, referent criterion and self-mocking were comparatively unique to the other factors in that they were sensitive to the case and the fans’ cultural background. Theoretical contributions, practical implications, and recommendations for future research are enclosed.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育作为生活中不可或缺的一部分，被世界各地的人们所享受。不可避免的是，与体育相关的问题也已渗透到该行业。具体而言，学者们呼吁更多关注球迷发起的危机传播。基于情景问题解决理论，本研究引入体育认同、在线沟通中的修正参与和脱离，以及自嘲，以考察球迷关于国家橄榄球联盟（NFL）脑震荡问题和中国男子国家足球队危机的在线沟通行为。研究发现，体育认同是影响球迷对问题感知的重要指标。此外，有动力解决问题的球迷更可能参与在线沟通而非脱离。而且，参照标准和自嘲相对其他因素较为独特，因为它们对案例和球迷的文化背景很敏感。研究提供了理论贡献、实践启示和未来研究建议。
literature.keywords: football; soccer; concussion; engagement

literature.title: Media Coverage of Sports Concussion: An Experimental Study of Framing Effects on Community Injury Perceptions
literature.title_cn: 体育脑震荡的媒体报道：框架效应对社区伤病感知的实验研究
literature.title_en: Media Coverage of Sports Concussion: An Experimental Study of Framing Effects on Community Injury Perceptions
literature.author: Karen A. Sullivan
literature.abstract: The media portrayal of sports concussion (SC) contributes to community understanding of injury. However, this could be hampered by inaccurately framed (minimising) SC coverage. 157 volunteers were randomly allocated to one of six online survey conditions. The conditions used a brief written news sports report with a non-serious (MI) or serious (MA) SC frame. Additional conditions varied the injured player’s sex (male or female) or the sport (unnamed or basketball). Standardised measures were administered, including the Illness Perceptions Questionnaire-Revised, and a custom-measure of perceptions of SC seriousness (SISI). A series of one-way ANOVA’s revealed one statistically significant framing effect for the SISI ( p < .05, large effect). Post-hoc pairwise comparisons found higher SISI scores for MA compared to MI conditions. There was no difference in the player sex or sport variants. No differences were found on other outcome measures. This study replicated a MA versus MI framing effect on the SISI, however wider effects were not seen. The framing effect on community perceptions of SC may be more circumscribed than previously suggested. While this requires further investigation, minimising frames should still be avoided as per existing recommendations.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育脑震荡（SC）的媒体呈现有助于社区对损伤的理解。然而，这可能会因不准确框定（淡化）的脑震荡报道而受阻。157名志愿者被随机分配到六个在线调查条件之一。条件使用一份简短的书面新闻体育报道，带有非严重（MI）或严重（MA）脑震荡框架。额外条件变化受伤球员的性别（男性或女性）或运动项目（未命名或篮球）。实施了标准化测量，包括修订版疾病感知问卷，以及脑震荡严重性感知的定制测量（SISI）。一系列单因素方差分析显示，SISI存在一个统计学上显著的框架效应（p<.05，大效应）。事后配对比较发现更高的SISI得分……
literature.keywords: framing; concussion; community; injury; basketball; survey

literature.title: Sports Media Research in the Slovenian Context: Mapping Trends and Suggestions for the Future
literature.title_cn: 斯洛文尼亚语境下的体育媒体研究：绘制趋势与未来建议
literature.title_en: Sports Media Research in the Slovenian Context: Mapping Trends and Suggestions for the Future
literature.author: Kaja Poteko
literature.abstract: This article provides an overview and analysis of how the study of sport at the intersection with the media has developed in the Slovenian context over the last three decades. The first part of the article briefly explains the importance and role of sport and media in the broader social context. By looking in particular at sports journalism and introducing the Slovenian context, the purpose of the study is clarified. The second part identifies and reviews all academic research contributions published on the highlighted intersection and during the selected period. Based on a quantitative and qualitative analysis of the most frequently addressed aspects of the sports media system, the main research topics identified and the media outlets studied, the main findings are summarized and highlighted. While studies addressing different aspects of nationality predominate, attention to gendered nationalism is highlighted as particularly valuable in the context of studies focusing on gender and its intersections. Event-oriented and decontextualized sports content is problematized in the context of recent studies focusing on some aspects of sports journalism. In the final section of the article, some guidelines are formulated to encourage further research in (and of) this geographical area (and beyond).
literature.abstract_cn: 本文概述并分析了体育与媒体交叉研究在过去三十年在斯洛文尼亚情境下如何发展。文章第一部分简要解释了体育和媒体在更广泛社会背景下的重要性和角色。通过特别关注体育新闻并引入斯洛文尼亚背景，阐明了研究目的。第二部分识别并回顾了在所选定时间段内于所强调交叉领域发表的所有学术研究贡献。基于对体育媒体系统最常被讨论的方面、已识别的主要研究主题和所研究的媒体机构的定量和定性分析，总结并突出了主要发现。虽然关于民族性不同方面的研究占主导地位，但在关注性别及其交叉的研究背景下，性别化民族主义受到特别强调。事件导向和非情境化的体育内容在最近一些关注体育新闻某些方面的研究背景下被问题化。文章最后一部分提出了一些指导方针，以鼓励在该地理区域（及其关于该区域）开展进一步研究。
literature.keywords: gender; nationalism; qualitative; quantitative

literature.title: Sports Done Right? Perceptions of Visually Impaired Athletes on Media Representation
literature.title_cn: 体育做得对吗？视障运动员对媒体呈现的感知
literature.title_en: Sports Done Right? Perceptions of Visually Impaired Athletes on Media Representation
literature.author: Lindsay E. Ball, Justin A. Haegele
literature.abstract: Abstract: This study examined the perspectives of visually impaired adult athletes on the way in which a blind person and athlete were depicted in the recent media article “Sports Done Right: A Shining Example for All of Us.” Seven visually impaired athletes read the article and engaged in a one-on-one Zoom interview where they discussed their thoughts regarding the representation of the athletes within the article. Interview transcripts were analyzed using a reflexive thematic analysis approach, and three themes were constructed. Based on the participants’ narratives, and on constructed themes, it remains clear that the perspectives of disabled athletes are often ignored within media, and media presentations about disabled athletes appear to be more intended to inspire nondisabled readers than represent disabled athletes.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了视障成年运动员对最近媒体文章"体育做对了：为我们所有人的光辉典范"中盲人运动员被描绘方式的观点。七名视障运动员阅读了这篇文章，并进行了面对面的Zoom访谈，讨论了他们对文章中运动员表征的看法。使用反思性主题分析方法分析访谈转写稿，构建了三个主题。基于参与者的叙述和构建的主题，很明显，残疾运动员的观点往往在媒体中被忽视，关于残疾运动员的媒体呈现似乎更旨在激励非残疾读者而非代表残疾运动员。
literature.keywords: representation; athlete; readers

literature.title: Manufacturing Concussions: Reactions in Traditional and Social Media to a Brain Injury During an NFL Game
literature.title_cn: 制造脑震荡：NFL比赛中脑损伤的传统与社交媒体反应
literature.title_en: Manufacturing Concussions: Reactions in Traditional and Social Media to a Brain Injury During an NFL Game
literature.author: Joshua Woods, Julia Galiffa
literature.abstract: Abstract: Drawing on Herman and Chomsky’s (1988) propaganda model, this study compares traditional and social media portrayals of Elijah Moore’s dramatic brain injury during a National Football League (NFL) game. Traditional media coverage minimized the severity and emotional impact of Moore’s injury, relied on NFL sources, and ignored the long-term health consequences of concussions. In contrast, social media discussions were more diverse and more likely informed by medical professionals. While traditional journalists remained mute on the need for reform, social media users often criticized the NFL and advocated for policy changes. However, many social media users also neutralized the risks posed by football and responded adversely to anyone who called for change. These findings highlight social media’s potential as a platform for concussion education and activism. Yet the adversarial qualities of the online discourse and the ephemeral nature of social media itself underscore the challenges of raising awareness about the health risks posed by repeated head blows in football.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文借鉴赫尔曼和乔姆斯基（1988）的宣传模型，比较了传统媒体和社交媒体对国家橄榄球联盟（NFL）比赛中埃利亚·摩尔严重脑损伤的呈现。传统媒体报道淡化了摩尔受伤的严重性和情感影响，依赖NFL来源，并忽视了脑震荡的长期健康后果。相比之下，社交媒体讨论更加多元化，更可能受到医学专业人士的影响。虽然传统记者对改革需求保持沉默，社交媒体用户经常批评NFL并倡导政策变革。然而，许多社交媒体用户也淡化了橄榄球带来的风险，并对任何呼吁变革的人做出负面回应。这些发现凸显了社交媒体作为脑震荡教育和行动主义平台的潜力。然而，在线话语的对抗性特征和社交媒体本身的短暂性，强调了提高对橄榄球中重复头部打击带来的健康风险意识的挑战。
literature.keywords: concussion; injury; football; policy; activism; emotion

literature.title: Defending the Indefensible? Deshaun Watson, In-House Reporting, and the Shifting Values of Sports Journalism
literature.title_cn: 为不可辩解者辩护？德肖恩·沃森、内部报道与体育新闻价值观的转变
literature.title_en: Defending the Indefensible? Deshaun Watson, In-House Reporting, and the Shifting Values of Sports Journalism
literature.author: Sean R. Sadri, Nicholas R. Buzzelli, Andrew C. Billings
literature.abstract: Abstract: In spring 2021, then–Houston Texans Quarterback Deshaun Watson was accused of sexual misconduct by 24 women he had hired to perform massages. This study focuses on the increased role of team-run in-house media to shape narratives surrounding transgression allegations levied against athletes. In an initial pilot study, news articles about Watson were textually analyzed ( N = 36) to examine in-house media coverage of the transgressions. Using qualitative interviews with 12 in-house reporters representing 12 NFL teams, the study unpacked how these individuals perceived their shifting news values as journalists and whether they saw Watson as a potential reputational challenge for larger stakeholders, such as their employer and the NFL. The team media ecosystem appeared to prioritize the protection of stakeholder interests within the organization over potential ethical quandaries of in-house journalists. For most in-house entities, a ubiquitous tactic of avoiding discussion of the allegations was employed to protect the NFL brand.
literature.abstract_cn: 2021年春季，时任休斯敦德州人队四分卫德肖恩·沃森（Deshaun Watson）被其雇用的24名为其进行按摩的女性指控性行为不当。本研究聚焦于球队运营的队内媒体（in-house media）在围绕针对运动员的越轨指控塑造叙事方面所发挥的日益增强的作用。在一项初步试点研究中，研究者对关于沃森的新闻报道进行了文本分析（N=36），以考察队内媒体对越轨行为的报道情况。通过使用对代表12支NFL球队的12名队内记者的质性访谈，研究揭示了这些记者如何看待其作为新闻从业者不断变化的新闻价值观念，以及他们是否将沃森视为对其雇主和NFL等更大利益相关者构成的潜在声誉挑战。球队媒体生态似乎优先考虑保护组织内利益相关者的利益，而非队内记者可能面临的伦理困境。对大多数队内媒体而言，采取普遍回避讨论相关指控的策略以保护NFL品牌。
literature.keywords: ethical; qualitative; interviews; reporter; brand; athlete

literature.title: It's a Problem for All of Us: Discursively Explaining the Destruction of Sports Journalism
literature.title_cn: 这是我们所有人的问题：话语性地解释体育新闻的毁灭
literature.title_en: It's a Problem for All of Us: Discursively Explaining the Destruction of Sports Journalism
literature.author: Ever Josue Figueroa, Patrick Ferrucci
literature.abstract: Abstract: In 2023 the field of sports journalism in the United States experienced two critical incidents: major, high-profile layoffs at ESPN and the closure of the New York Times sports desk. Utilizing the theory of metajournalistic discourse and the concept of journalism as an interpretative community, this study textually analyzes discourse produced in the aftermath of these two incidents. It finds that those within the field of journalism believe that the boundaries of sports journalism are collapsing, the profession is losing credibility and is the victim of corporate greed. The article ends by theorizing what this means for sports journalism practice moving forward.
literature.abstract_cn: 2023年，美国体育新闻领域经历了两次关键事件：ESPN的大规模高调裁员，以及《纽约时报》体育版的关闭。本研究运用元新闻话语（metajournalistic discourse）理论以及"新闻业作为阐释性共同体"（interpretative community）的概念，对这两次事件之后所产生的相关话语进行文本分析。研究发现，新闻业界人士认为体育新闻的边界正在崩塌，该职业正丧失公信力，并成为企业贪婪的受害者。文章最后对体育新闻实践在未来的发展方向进行了理论化思考。
literature.keywords: community; credibility
literature.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、产业组织理论

literature.title: Dear Prime Minister, Mr Musk and Mr Zuckerberg! : The challenge of social media and platformed racism in the English premier league and football league
literature.title_cn: 尊敬的首相、马斯克先生和扎克伯格先生！：英超与英格兰足球联赛中社交媒体与平台化种族主义的挑战
literature.title_en: Dear Prime Minister, Mr Musk and Mr Zuckerberg! : The challenge of social media and platformed racism in the English premier league and football league
literature.author: Kevin Hylton, Dan Kilvington, Jonathan Long, Alex Bond, Izram Chaudry
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This paper draws on original research from a larger study of racism and Islamophobia online around football, particularly a set of interviews with staff at English football clubs whose responsibility is to manage social media. We use that information alongside our reflections on “platformed racism” to appraise how expressions of racism on social media differ from those in and around the grounds, and how clubs and others in football contest them. This involves a consideration of three themes commonly identified by those speaking on behalf of the clubs: The triggers that ignite racist posts; the partnerships necessary to counter them; and their proposed solutions. Hence this is not just a cue for a collective wringing of hands, but an effort to point the way forward.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文批评英超与英格兰足球联赛中社交媒体与平台化种族主义日益严峻的挑战。研究分析了球员、俱乐部与媒体在应对网络种族主义辱骂中的责任与困境，呼吁政策制定者(包括政府与平台)采取更有效的措施打击体育中的网络种族主义。
literature.keywords: football; interviews

literature.title: Youth athletes’ framing of nutritional supplements: Performance enhancement and food
literature.title_cn: 青少年运动员对营养补剂的框架呈现：表现提升与食物
literature.title_en: Youth athletes’ framing of nutritional supplements: Performance enhancement and food
literature.author: Anette Skilbred, Åse Strandbu, Sigmund Loland
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Prior studies have revealed how some nutritional supplements used to enhance performance in sports are considered problematic because they are associated with doping. In this study, frame analysis is applied to scrutinise interviews conducted with 24 ambitious youth athletes enrolled in elite sport schools. The analysis enables exploration of the athletes’ understanding and meaning-making concerning the so-called grey zone supplements in terms of two major frames. The first performance frame is expected as the context is elite youth sport, and many aspects of the athletes’ lives revolve around athletic progress. However, the more interesting finding is that this performance frame permeates almost all aspects of the young athletes’ lives, including how food is both understood and consumed. The second frame implies the framing of nutritional supplements as food. Here, the use of supplements is rationalised by practical concerns such as hectic training and teaching schedules that leave little time for meals, with supplements becoming a quick fix to meet energy needs. Hence, meaning-making concerning the grey zone supplements gives rise to an alternative framing linked to food and eating, although an overarching logic of performance also exerts a significant impact.
literature.keywords: framing; athlete; interviews

literature.title: Are some sports riskier than others? An investigation into child athlete experiences of interpersonal violence in relation to sport type and gender
literature.title_cn: 某些运动比其它更危险吗？儿童运动员人际暴力经历与运动类型和性别关系的调查
literature.title_en: Are some sports riskier than others? An investigation into child athlete experiences of interpersonal violence in relation to sport type and gender
literature.author: Tine Vertommen, Nina Sølvberg, Melanie Lang, Jarl K Kampen
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Interpersonal violence in sport has serious consequences for athletes, sports organisations and society at large. Despite recent advances in safeguarding sport participants from interpersonal violence, empirical evidence regarding its prevalence and risk factors across different sports remains scarce. In this study, we investigated differences in the prevalence of interpersonal violence among a convenience sample of 9989 adults from six European countries who participated in organised sport before age 18. Utilising binary logistic regression analyses and CHAID regression tree analyses, we examined variations in reported experiences of neglect, psychological, physical, non-contact sexual and contact sexual forms of interpersonal violence based on gender and three sport classifications: type of sport (individual vs. team), sports attire (non-revealing vs. body-fitting/revealing) and weight-sensitivity (less weight-sensitive vs. weight-sensitive sports). Men participating in team sports reported significantly higher levels of victimisation across all types of interpersonal violence. Women in sports with non-revealing attire and men in less weight-sensitive sports also reported higher prevalence rates. The study underscores the need for a nuanced understanding of interpersonal violence characteristics and dynamics across different sports. Insights into the factors influencing victimisation enable tailored prevention and response strategies to be developed to better address the needs of athletes and sport organisations.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育中的人际暴力对运动员、体育组织和整个社会都有严重后果。尽管最近在保护体育参与者免受人际暴力方面取得了进展，但关于不同运动项目间暴力普遍性和风险因素的实证证据仍然匮乏。本研究调查了来自六个欧洲国家的9,989名18岁前参与有组织体育的成年人的方便样本中人际暴力患病率的差异。利用二元逻辑回归分析和CHAID回归树分析，我们基于性别和三种运动分类（运动类型：个人vs团队；运动着装：非暴露vs合身/暴露；体重敏感性：低体重敏感vs体重敏感运动）考察了忽视、心理、身体、非接触性性和接触性性形式人际暴力报告的差异。参加团队运动的男性在所有类型的人际暴力中报告了显著更高的受害水平。穿着非暴露服装的女性运动员和参加低体重敏感运动的男性也报告了更高的患病率。研究强调需要细致理解不同运动项目间人际暴力特征和动态的差异。
literature.keywords: gender; athlete

literature.title: Counting women: Indicator culture and gender inclusion in sports leadership
literature.title_cn: 清点女性：体育领导力中的指标文化与性别包容
literature.title_en: Counting women: Indicator culture and gender inclusion in sports leadership
literature.author: Tate Morgan, Kathryn Henne, Jude Blacklock, Kate Starre
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Despite the increasing visibility of women's sports in Australia, women continue to be underrepresented in leadership positions within sports organisations. Many sporting organisations have responded by developing strategies to improve the gender balance of their leadership, often focusing on quantifying the number of women in leadership roles. We examine this ‘counting women’ paradigm as an example of what anthropologist Sally Engle Merry has described as ‘indicator culture’, arguing that this paradigm constrains what can be known about gendered inequities and thus how they are addressed. This paradigm, with its emphasis on the number of individual women and ratios of men to women, extracts women as though they do not exist within highly gendered workplaces. Drawing on three case studies, we illustrate three thematic shortcomings that emerge from this approach, which fails to meaningfully attend to intersectionality; capture the gendered dynamics of the roles occupied by women in sports leadership; and document the experiences of women in sports organisations. We discuss how the counting women paradigm contributes to forms of ‘non-knowledge’ about women in sports organisations, flattening the ability to understand and address barriers to women's inclusion in sports leadership.
literature.abstract_cn: 尽管女性体育在澳大利亚的可见度不断提高，但女性在体育组织中的领导职位仍然代表不足。许多体育组织通过制定改善领导层性别平衡的战略来应对，通常侧重于量化领导岗位女性的人数。我们考察了这种"计数女性"范式，作为人类学家萨莉·恩格尔·梅里所描述的"指标文化"的一个例子，认为这一范式限制了我们可以了解的关于性别不平等的信息，从而也限制了如何解决这些问题。这一范式强调个体女性的数量和男女比例，将女性从高度性别化的工作场所中剥离出来，仿佛她们不存在于其中。通过三个案例研究，我们说明了这种方法产生的三个主题性缺陷：未能有意义地关注交叉性；未能捕捉体育领导岗位中女性所承担角色的性别动态；以及未能记录女性在体育组织中的经历。我们讨论了"计数女性"范式如何促成关于体育组织中女性的"非知识"形式，削弱了理解和解决女性体育领导包容障碍的能力。
literature.keywords: gender; inclusion; workplace

literature.title: The political stance of Ibero-American national teams on social media towards Qatar during the 2022 FIFA World Cup
literature.title_cn: 伊比利亚美洲国家队在社交媒体上对2022年卡塔尔世界杯的政治立场
literature.title_en: The political stance of Ibero-American national teams on social media towards Qatar during the 2022 FIFA World Cup
literature.author: Jiří Zákravský, Fernando Gutiérrez-Chico, Carlos Pulleiro Méndez
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This article investigates the role of national teams on social media and how they shape international perceptions of Qatar during the 2022 FIFA World Cup. This tournament was an essential element of Qatar's sports diplomacy that faced criticism because of corruption allegations, organisational skills, labour conditions and human rights issues, including the treatment of the LGBTQIA+ community. This study is based on a conceptual content analysis of the Twitter (now called X) and Instagram accounts of the footballers and coaches of the eight Ibero-American national teams participating in the 2022 FIFA World Cup. The aim is to identify how they communicated about the State of Qatar in their social media posts. Accordingly, this article studies the posting frequency, how they address Qatar's image, and their engagement with the aforementioned criticism of the host country. The findings show that from 2173 posts collected, a total of 275 posts mentioned Qatar. Neutral messages were dominant with 268 posts, while there were only seven positive posts. In conclusion, the Ibero-American players and coaches have contributed to the normalisation of the event through sharing content and images of Qatar in a neutral, informative tone.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文考察了国家队在社交媒体上的角色，以及它们如何在2022年FIFA世界杯期间塑造国际社会对卡塔尔的看法。这项赛事是卡塔尔体育外交的重要组成部分，但由于腐败指控、组织能力、劳工条件和人权问题（包括对LGBTQIA+社区的态度）而受到批评。本研究基于对参加2022年FIFA世界杯的八支伊比利亚美洲国家队球员和教练在推特（现为X）和Instagram账户的概念内容分析。目的是识别他们如何在社交媒体帖子中传达关于卡塔尔国的情况。据此，本文研究了发帖频率、他们如何应对卡塔尔的形象，以及他们如何参与对东道国的上述批评。研究结果显示，在收集的2,173条帖子中，共有275条帖子提及卡塔尔。中立信息占主导地位（268条帖子），而正面帖子仅有七条。总之，伊比利亚美洲球员和教练通过以中立、信息性语气分享内容和图片，为赛事的正常化做出了贡献。
literature.keywords: twitter; instagram; football; tournament; diplomacy; community
literature.theoretical_framework: 性别理论、女性主义传播理论

literature.title: Collective sports success through effective social performances: The case of Olympic wrestling in Iran
literature.title_cn: 通过有效社会表演实现集体体育成功：伊朗奥运摔跤的案例
literature.title_en: Collective sports success through effective social performances: The case of Olympic wrestling in Iran
literature.author: Saeed Shamshirian, Vidar Halldorsson
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This study argues that the athletic success of Iranian wrestlers is fused with success in social performances. Using Alexander's cultural sociology, we propose that individuals’ behavioral, emotional, and mental dispositions toward sports are shaped by tacit and invisible social forces encompassing them at a given time and place. Furthermore, we make use of Alexander's notion that the power of culture is manifested when it is actively enacted. To ground our theoretical frameworks with empirical evidence, we conducted a case study of successful Iranian male wrestlers. The study reveals that the success of Iranian wrestling is constructed upon cultural foundations, social organizations, cooperative networks, and a set of social relations that performatively contribute to producing world-class wrestlers. It is within a given social, cultural, and organizational context that culture is performed through a series of collective actions and agencies. Such successful cultural performances reinforce the meaning of certain practices by connecting the past to the present and ensuring their continuity, thereby establishing a strong tradition of collective sporting achievements.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究以伊朗奥运摔跤的案例，考察了通过有效社会表演实现集体体育成功的过程。研究分析了伊朗摔跤选手如何在奥运舞台上通过社会表演赢得认同与支持，揭示了体育成就与社会表演之间的互动机制。
literature.keywords: emotion; social performances; success of iranian; success through; through effective; effective social
literature.theoretical_framework: 新闻学理论、传播学基础理论

literature.title: Digital selves: A cross-cultural examination of athlete social media self-presentation during the 2020 Tokyo Olympics
literature.title_cn: 数字自我：2020东京奥运运动员社交媒体自我呈现的跨文化考察
literature.title_en: Digital selves: A cross-cultural examination of athlete social media self-presentation during the 2020 Tokyo Olympics
literature.author: Qingru Xu, Eunhui Kim, Sitong Guo
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This study investigates the social media self-presentation of Chinese, South Korean, and US athletes during the 2020 Tokyo Olympics, with the aim of elucidating the influence of gender and nationalism on their online portrayals across countries. A total of 1800 photographs posted by 278 Olympians were analyzed, revealing that (a) South Korean athletes, particularly males, display a higher prevalence of business-related images in their self-presentation compared to athletes from other countries; (b) Chinese athletes exhibit a greater degree of nationalism in their posted photographs than their South Korean and US counterparts; and (c) female athletes, although gaining agency over their online presence, still demonstrate behaviors reinforcing conventional gender norms. This research underscores the multifaceted interplay of gender, nationalistic, cultural, political, and ideological factors in shaping athletes’ self-representations on social media, offering valuable insights into the complex dynamics that inform their digital self-expression.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究调查了中国、韩国和美国运动员在2020年东京奥运会期间的社交媒体自我呈现，旨在阐明性别和民族主义对其跨国家在线形象的影响。共分析了278名奥运选手发布的1800张照片，结果显示：（a）韩国运动员，尤其是男性，在自我呈现中商业相关图片的出现率高于其他国家运动员；（b）中国运动员在发布的照片中表现出比韩国和美国同行更高程度的民族主义；（c）女运动员虽然对其在线形象获得了更多主动权，但仍表现出强化传统性别规范的行为。本研究强调性别、民族主义、文化、政治和意识形态因素在塑造运动员社交媒体自我呈现中的多方面相互作用，为理解其数字自我表达的复杂动态提供了有价值的见解。
literature.keywords: olympics; athlete; gender; representation; nationalism
literature.theoretical_framework: 性别理论、跨文化传播理论

literature.title: Precarity in sport coaching: Exploring the working conditions of Canadian university sports coaches
literature.title_cn: 体育执教中的不稳定性：加拿大大学体育教练工作条件探索
literature.title_en: Precarity in sport coaching: Exploring the working conditions of Canadian university sports coaches
literature.author: Alixandra Nastassia Krahn
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Although the study of sport coaching as the body of knowledge and praxis is well established, very few studies have unpacked sport coaching through a sociological work and/or labour lens. Drawing on the findings from a larger institutional ethnographic study exploring gender, work, and professionalization in sport coaching within the Canadian university sport system, this article highlights the ways in which the Canadian university sport coaching environment constructs and normalizes overwork, such that sport coaches often experience worker precarity. Given the emphasis within the university sport environment on performance, and/or the need for sport coaches to win in order to keep their jobs, this article highlights how coaches have internalized their constant work efforts as ‘just part of the job’. Key findings demonstrate the deleterious effects of nonstop work on sport coaches both within and outside of their working environments. This article concludes by emphasizing how in the contemporary political-economic context of Canadian university sport, where meritocracy is a powerful and prominent player and where winning matters most, sport coaches are often always overworked and undersupported.
literature.abstract_cn: 虽然将体育教练作为知识和实践体系的研究已相当成熟，但很少有研究从社会学的工作和/或劳动视角来解析体育教练。本文借鉴一项更大规模的制度民族志研究（该研究探索了加拿大大学体育系统中体育教练的性别、工作和专业化）的发现，着重揭示了加拿大大学体育教练在……方面的方式。
literature.keywords: precarity; coach; gender

literature.title: Cohesion to life on the land of migration: Olympic education and refugees
literature.title_cn: 迁徙之地的凝聚力：奥运教育与难民
literature.title_en: Cohesion to life on the land of migration: Olympic education and refugees
literature.author: Tuğçe Örsoğlu, İbrahim Yıldıran
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Due to global migration, addressing essential needs like nutrition, housing, and security has become a pressing concern for migrants and host communities, with social cohesion being a primary focus. To promote social cohesion, many state policies now include provisions that aim to leverage cultural and lifestyle differences as assets. This research examines the role of Olympic education programmes implemented through sports in establishing social cohesion among refugees. A qualitative single case study approach was used, collecting data through interviews and documents. Thematic analysis revealed intergroup conflict as a major obstacle to social cohesion, and the programme was seen as a potential mitigating factor. Stakeholders had diverse but similar goals and took action to achieve them. The programme's outcomes contributed to targeted development, with stakeholders recognizing the importance of a long-term social cohesion process. Short-term achievements also indicated potential medium and long-term changes.
literature.abstract_cn: 由于全球移民，解决营养、住房和安全等基本需求已成为移民和收容社区面临的紧迫关切，社会凝聚力是一个主要焦点。为促进社会凝聚力，许多国家政策现在包含旨在将文化和生活方式差异作为资产加以利用的条款。本研究考察了通过体育实施的奥林匹克教育项目在建立难民社会凝聚力方面的作用。采用定性单案例研究方法，通过访谈和文件收集数据。主题分析揭示群体间冲突是社会凝聚力的主要障碍，该项目被视为潜在的缓解因素。利益相关者有着多样但相似的目标，并采取行动以实现这些目标。项目的成果促进了定向发展，利益相关者认识到长期社会凝聚力进程的重要性。短期成就也表明了中长期变化的潜力。
literature.keywords: qualitative; interviews
literature.theoretical_framework: 国际传播理论、软实力理论

literature.title: Inclusion of Indigenous Peoples in Olympic legacy-shaping processes
literature.title_cn: 奥运会遗产塑造过程中的原住民参与
literature.title_en: Inclusion of Indigenous Peoples in Olympic legacy-shaping processes
literature.author: Dilara Valiyeva, Anna-Maria Strittmatter, Inge Hermanrud
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Scholars emphasise the need to understand how contested concepts, like social inclusion and legacy, are interpreted within specific contexts. However, there are a lack of critical studies on social legacies of sports mega-events. This study aims to analyse how social inclusion of marginalised groups is constructed in the legacy-shaping process of and bidding for the Olympic Games. Three cases were chosen in which the inclusion of Indigenous Peoples was stated as one of the goals of the bidding and organising committees: Sydney 2000, Vancouver 2010 and Tromsø 2014, 2018 bids. Translation theory and critical discourse analysis were used to understand how inclusion and legacy efforts are taken into action. The cases spread across space, time and bidding stage did not provide unique approaches to the formulations of legacies and inclusion. Despite the highlighted celebration of culture and diversity of communities in the documents, we interpret the inclusion discourse as a symbolic appreciation of Indigenous Peoples with attempts to address and solve the challenges connected to social exclusion. However, these attempts are characterised by postcolonial and assimilation thinking. A broader commitment is needed to create lasting social change through long-term initiatives created with and led by Indigenous Peoples.
literature.abstract_cn: 学者们强调需要理解诸如社会包容和遗产等有争议的概念如何在特定情境中被解释。然而，关于体育大型赛事社会遗产的批判性研究仍然缺乏。本研究旨在分析边缘化群体的社会包容如何在申奥和奥运遗产塑造过程中被建构。选择了三个案例，其中原住民的包容被声明为申奥和组织委员会的目标之一：悉尼2000、温哥华2010以及特罗姆瑟2014和2018年申奥。使用翻译理论和批判性话语分析来理解包容和遗产努力如何付诸行动。跨越空间、时间和申奥阶段的案例并没有为遗产和包容的表述提供独特的方法。尽管文化庆祝被强调，但研究揭示了对遗产和包容的表述往往表面化，未能从根本上改变权力结构。
literature.keywords: inclusion; diversity

literature.title: Rights-based policies for role-bearing people: Are geo-cultural norms a hindrance to cultivating safer sport?
literature.title_cn: 以权利为基础的关键人物政策：地缘文化规范是培育更安全体育的障碍吗？
literature.title_en: Rights-based policies for role-bearing people: Are geo-cultural norms a hindrance to cultivating safer sport?
literature.author: Minhyeok Tak, Yoon Jin Kim, Daniel JA Rhind
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Many (inter)national governments and sports organisations are implementing standardised Safe Sport policies and guidelines. However, the Western-born, rights-based norm that underlies Safe Sport can collide with pre-existing geo-sociocultural norms of local contexts. Drawing from a case study of South Korea's elite sport pathway where tightened regulations on abuse challenge the long-lasting relational hierarchy based on Confucianism, this paper examines how athletes and coaches manoeuvre within the fast-changing social order shaped by the new safeguarding policies and practices. Analysing data from semi-structured interviews with 48 participants around two Elite Sports Schools, the paper shows that the rights-based norm integral to Safe Sport is sifted through the Confucian hierarchy, generating two main shifts respectively in coaches’ roles (from caring disciplinarians to professional service providers) and senior athletes’ (from potential abusers to benevolent superiors). That is, individual actors re-script their relational template by negotiating between the familiar and new relational ethics. From this, the paper suggests that Safe Sport is not a straightforward process of modernising less advanced practices up to a certain standard; it requires understanding how individuals make sense of the process in their own socio-cultural contexts.
literature.keywords: ethics; regulation; interviews; athlete; coach

literature.title: “Now she has everything, a happy family story and an Olympic medal”: Representations of Gloria Kotnik in the Slovenian media landscape
literature.title_cn: “现在她拥有一切，幸福的家庭故事和奥运奖牌”：斯洛文尼亚媒体对格洛丽亚·科特尼克的表现
literature.title_en: “Now she has everything, a happy family story and an Olympic medal”: Representations of Gloria Kotnik in the Slovenian media landscape
literature.author: Kaja Poteko, Mojca Doupona
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Over the last four decades, feminist sports media research has developed into an established transdisciplinary branch of research that contributes to highlighting the contradictions and unevenness of social change at the level of women's sports and its positioning in society. In this context, the increasing media visibility of athlete mothers as an expression of an emerging social phenomenon provides an opportunity to examine and reflect on the patterns of media portrayal of sportswomen. This article focuses on the media representations of Gloria Kotnik, the Slovenian snowboarder and bronze medalist at the 2022 Winter Olympics. Through textual analysis, it attempts to identify how Kotnik was portrayed in selected Slovenian media and what role her motherhood, in particular, played in this. While ambivalence was identified as a predominant pattern in the media representations of Kotnik, the role of motherhood was presented both as something seemingly incompatible with the role of an elite athlete and in a way that perceived these two roles as compatible. Due to the reproduction of traditional gender ideologies and hierarchies, the article problematizes both patterns and concludes by linking the desire for social change with the need to redefine the ethics of care.
literature.abstract_cn: 在过去四十年里，女权主义体育媒体研究已发展成为一个成熟的跨学科研究分支，有助于揭示女性体育及其社会定位层面社会变革的矛盾和不均衡。在此背景下，运动员母亲日益增长的媒体可见度作为新兴社会现象的一种表达，为考察和反思女运动员的媒体呈现模式提供了机会。本文聚焦于斯洛文尼亚单板滑雪运动员、2022年冬奥会铜牌得主格洛里亚·科特尼克（Gloria Kotnik）的媒体呈现。通过文本分析，它试图识别科特尼克在斯洛文尼亚部分媒体中是如何被呈现的，以及她的母职尤其在其中扮演了什么角色。虽然矛盾性被识别为科特尼克媒体呈现的主要模式，但研究也揭示了……
literature.keywords: representation; gender; ethics; olympics; athlete

literature.title: From gamers to players: Chinese Generation Z's perspectives on minors dropping out of school to become professional esports players
literature.title_cn: 从玩家到选手：中国Z世代对未成年人辍学成为职业电竞选手的看法
literature.title_en: From gamers to players: Chinese Generation Z's perspectives on minors dropping out of school to become professional esports players
literature.author: Yuxin Luo, Lu Liu, Xianglin Luo, Shujuan Li
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: The research selected responses from Generation Z users on a Chinese question-and-answer website Zhihu, regarding the question ‘My younger brother wants to quit high school to pursue a career as an esports player, should I support him?’ as the primary research data. Utilizing the Social Cognitive Career Theory, the study delved into Generation Z's perspectives on abandoning academic pursuits to become professional esports players, from the aspects of self-efficacy, outcome expectations, and personal goals as a reflection of Generation Z's career outlook. Generation Z generally finds esports players extremely attractive, but fierce competition, uncertainty about career prospects, and pressure from societal perceptions and family expectations form a challenging career choice. Most Generation Z believe minors should remain rational, but a few Generation Z still think it's okay to give it a try. The study found that Generation Z's view of careers is a combination of romanticism and pragmatism; they cannot completely escape from considerations of career stability and social expectations, but they also value the pursuit of personal interests and the fulfilment of their passions. This duality reflects the inherent contradictions and struggles of Generation Z when confronted with traditional career concepts and modern values. This contradiction is particularly prominent in an emerging and uncertain field such as esports. This study provides profound insights into the underlying motivations of Generation Z's career choices and offers valuable implications for the evolution of societal norms and reforms in employment systems in the future.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究选取了知乎（中国问答网站）上Z世代用户对"我弟弟想退学当电竞选手，我该支持吗？"这一问题的回应作为主要研究数据。利用社会认知职业理论，研究从自我效能感、结果预期和个人目标三个方面，深入探讨了Z世代对放弃学业成为职业电竞选手的看法，反映了Z世代的职业观。Z世代普遍认为电竞选手极具吸引力，但激烈的竞争、职业前景的不确定性以及社会观念和家庭期望的压力构成了具有挑战性的职业选择。大多数Z世代认为未成年人应保持理性，但也有少数Z世代认为尝试一下也无妨。研究发现，Z世代的职业观是浪漫主义与实用主义的结合；他们无法完全脱离对职业稳定性和社会期望的考量，但也重视对个人兴趣的追求和热情的满足。这种二元性反映了Z世代在面对传统职业观念和现代价值观时的内在矛盾和挣扎。这种矛盾在电竞这样一个新兴而不确定的领域尤为突出。本研究对Z世代在电竞等新兴领域职业选择背后的深层动机提供了深刻见解。
literature.keywords: esports; career
literature.theoretical_framework: 游戏研究、媒介文化理论

literature.title: The construction of esports careers in France: Are there gender-based inequalities right from the start?
literature.title_cn: 法国电竞生涯的建构：性别不平等是否从一开始就存在？
literature.title_en: The construction of esports careers in France: Are there gender-based inequalities right from the start?
literature.author: Julien Borkowski, Nicolas Besombes, Geneviève Cabagno
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This article examines the construction of esports careers for French esports players, emphasizing gender-based socialization. We used an online questionnaire administered to both men and women recreational and amateur esports players ( n = 343) to understand and identify potential barriers or levers to participation by men and women, especially for the stage of “Commitment” which is embodied in participation in esports competitions. The theoretical approach centred around the concept of career is mobilized to sequence the careers of men and women esports players and identify the differences between men and women within the different stages of an “esports career.” Key findings reveal that male figures often introduce players to video games, with men generally experiencing more “autonomous” and diversified” initiations than women. They also lag behind men players in terms of years of experience, and they face negative criticism from their peers, impeding their “commitment.” These insights underline the barriers women face at the onset of their esports careers and call for further research into social mechanisms to enhance women's inclusion in esports.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文考察了法国电竞选手职业生涯的建构，强调基于性别的社会化过程。我们通过在线问卷对男性和女性的休闲及业余电竞选手（n=343）进行调查，以了解和识别男性和女性参与电竞的潜在障碍或推动因素，特别是体现为参加电竞比赛的"投入"阶段。围绕职业生涯概念的理论方法被用于排列男女电竞选手的职业生涯，并识别男女在"电竞生涯"不同阶段的差异。关键发现表明，通常是男性人物将玩家引入电子游戏，男性通常比女性经历更多"自主"和"多元化"的入门方式。女性在经验年限方面也落后于男性选手，并面临同伴的负面批评，阻碍了她们的"投入"。这些见解强调了女性在电竞职业生涯开始时面临的障碍，并呼吁进一步研究增强女性电竞包容性的社会机制。
literature.keywords: gender; esports; career; inclusion

literature.title: Sports following and social capital in the United States: Social networks and trust
literature.title_cn: 美国的体育追随与社会资本：社会网络与信任
literature.title_en: Sports following and social capital in the United States: Social networks and trust
literature.author: Adam Gemar
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Scholarship on sports following represents a burgeoning field of inquiry in the sociology of sport, yet sport following's connections to, or ability to facilitate, social capital remains underexplored. Drawing on a contemporary nationwide survey of the United States and employing the foundational theories of social capital by which we operationalize statistical analyses using regression modeling, this study investigates the nuanced contributions of sports following to various dimensions of social capital. Our analysis reveals complex relationships of sports following to social network size, community engagement, neighborhood trust, and social network variety, highlighting sports following as a significant predictor for all our operationalized social capital measures, although negatively so for neighborhood trust. Exploring the interplay between sports following, individual characteristics, and socio-political affiliations, results underscore the powerful predictive capacity of sports following even controlling for other characteristics, highlighting strong potentiality for building social capital, although along some dimensions more than others. These findings spotlight the domain of sports following as fertile ground for further investigation into its capacity to serve as a unique facilitator of social capital on the increasingly divided American socio-cultural landscape.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育关注学术是体育社会学中一个新兴的研究领域，然而体育关注与社会资本的联系或促进社会资本的能力仍未得到充分探索。本研究基于一项当代美国全国性调查，并运用我们通过回归建模进行统计分析的基础社会资本理论，考察了体育关注对社会资本各维度的细致贡献。我们的分析揭示了体育关注与社交网络规模、社区参与、邻里信任和社交网络多样性的复杂关系，强调体育关注是我们所有操作化的社会资本测量的显著预测因素，尽管对邻里信任是负向的。探索体育关注、个体特征和社会政治归属之间的相互作用，结果表明即使在控制其他特征后，体育关注也具有强大的预测能力，突出其建立社会资本的强大潜力，尽管在某些维度上比在其他维度上更明显。这些发现将体育关注领域定位为进一步调查其在日益分裂的美国社会文化格局中作为社会资本独特促进因素能力的肥沃土壤。
literature.keywords: trust; survey; community; engagement

literature.title: Trajectories and figurations: An analysis of sports elite in Lebanon
literature.title_cn: 轨迹与形态：黎巴嫩体育精英的分析
literature.title_en: Trajectories and figurations: An analysis of sports elite in Lebanon
literature.author: Axel Maugendre, William Gasparini
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This study investigates the trajectories of elite sports actors in Lebanon, focusing on the three most popular sports in the country: football, basketball, and volleyball. Employing a combination of Life Course Theory and Norbert Elias's figurations, the research analyzes data gathered from interviews, academic literature, and official documents. It reveals that despite the complex Lebanese context, sports actors have the capacity to navigate and select various paths within the social and sports figurations. The findings highlight significant influences of religious communities and political structures on these trajectories whilst also identifying margins for freedom and individual strategies. The post-civil war era has distinctly shaped sports actors across generations, evolving toward a diversified and stratified governance in sports. This research underscores the need for a relational approach to comprehend the intricacies of trajectories within the Lebanese sports system.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究调查了黎巴嫩精英体育行动者的轨迹，聚焦于该国最受欢迎的三项运动：足球、篮球和排球。结合生命历程理论和诺伯特·埃利亚斯的形构理论，研究分析了从访谈、学术文献和官方文件中收集的数据。研究揭示，尽管黎巴嫩背景复杂，体育行动者有能力在社会和体育形构中导航并选择各种路径。研究发现……
literature.keywords: football; basketball; governance; interviews

literature.title: A quest for legitimacy? An exploratory study of the new meanings of sports and physical activity in contemporary Saudi Arabia
literature.title_cn: 寻求合法性？当代沙特阿拉伯体育与身体活动新意义的探索研究
literature.title_en: A quest for legitimacy? An exploratory study of the new meanings of sports and physical activity in contemporary Saudi Arabia
literature.author: Arnošt Svoboda, Billy Graeff, Paul Bretherton, Simona Šafaříková, Daiana Viacelli, Abdul R Al Droushi, Jorge Knijnik
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: The Saudi Arabian Kingdom is currently undergoing significant socio-cultural changes, primarily driven by Vision 2030, a strategic document outlining the nation's future development. This initiative includes efforts to enhance sports participation and physical activity levels across various sectors of the country. This paper represents one of the first attempts to understand the effects of the Vision on domestic sports/physical activities policy through the lens of selected actors in the field. with a special interest in youth sports. Based on extensive fieldwork that took place within the country, including qualitative semi-structured interviews with stakeholders from various organisations within Saudi sports, we identify several key facets seen as crucial enablers or obstacles for the field of sports and physical activities. The individual facets form two main groups – activities of state authorities in Saudi Arabia, specifically the Ministry of Education and Ministry of Sports, and informal practices influenced by broader cultural changes oscillating between the traditional views and contemporary demands. Amongst the identified cultural facets, gender takes a crucial discursive position. As we examine these processes through the lens of concepts of soft power and rightful resistance, we identify formal and informal legitimation practices used by stakeholders to achieve and potentially surpass the goals set by Vision 2030 for the Kingdom's sporting landscape.
literature.abstract_cn: 沙特阿拉伯王国目前正在经历重大的社会文化变革，主要由"2030愿景"推动，这是一份勾勒国家未来发展的战略文件。该倡议包括努力提高该国各部门的体育参与和身体活动水平。本文是首批通过该领域选定行动者的视角来理解愿景对国内体育/身体活动政策影响的尝试之一，特别关注青少年体育。基于在该国进行的广泛田野调查，包括对沙特体育界各组织利益相关者的定性半结构化访谈，我们识别出几个被视为体育和身体活动领域关键推动因素或障碍的方面。这些个体方面形成两个主要群体——国家活动的……
literature.keywords: gender; policy; qualitative; interviews
literature.theoretical_framework: 性别理论、国际传播理论

literature.title: ‘I can’t believe I just made history’: A temporal analysis of sports media reporting
literature.title_cn: “我不敢相信我刚创造了历史”：体育媒体报道的时间性分析
literature.title_en: ‘I can’t believe I just made history’: A temporal analysis of sports media reporting
literature.author: Chloé Beaudoin, Nicolas Moreau, Mélissa Roy
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Professional sport is a central element of our daily entertainment that contributes to shaping us individually and bonding us collectively: it provides us with shared ‘historic’ moments. This article is interested in these moments, and how the field of sports generates them, by asking the following questions: (1) has the frequency of ‘historic moments’ changed over time, and (2) is the way we make sports history consistent throughout the years? We conducted a temporal analysis of newspaper and magazine articles ( n = 1062) published in France (Le Monde, l’Équipe) and in the United States (USA Today, Sports Illustrated) during three time periods in the 21st century (2003, 2010, 2019). Our results show that: (1) as time passes, ‘historic’ moments occur more frequently; (2) sporting history is increasingly linked to social dimensions; and (3) statistical performances continue to mark history above all else. Although performance-based achievements are consistently celebrated, sporting history cannot be separated from our collective social existence, and the currents therein. We show that the act of making sports history is also bound to the normative, social, and cultural history of a society.
literature.abstract_cn: 职业体育是我们日常娱乐的核心元素，有助于塑造我们个人并集体地联结我们：它为我们提供了共享的"历史性"时刻。本文关注这些时刻以及体育领域如何生成它们，提出以下问题：（1）"历史性时刻"的频率是否随时间变化，以及（2）我们创造体育历史的方式在年复一年中是否保持一致？我们对21世纪三个时间段（2003、2010、2019）在法国（《世界报》、《队报》）和美国（《今日美国》、《体育画报》）发表的报纸和杂志文章（n=1062）进行了时间分析。结果显示：（1）随着时间推移，"历史性"时刻发生得更频繁；（2）体育历史日益与社会维度相关联；（3）统计表现仍然是最重要的历史标记。虽然基于表现的成就是持续庆祝的，但体育历史不能与我们的集体社会存在及其中的潮流分开。我们表明，创造体育历史的行为也与一个社会的规范性、社会和文化历史相关联。
literature.keywords: historic moments; sporting history; i can; can t; t believe; believe i

literature.title: Observations on sport and eSport from a systems theory perspective: Theoretical reflections on differentiating sport and eSport and on the functions and consequences of an integration
literature.title_cn: 系统论视角下体育与电子竞技的观察：体育与电竞区分及整合功能与后果的理论反思
literature.title_en: Observations on sport and eSport from a systems theory perspective: Theoretical reflections on differentiating sport and eSport and on the functions and consequences of an integration
literature.author: Carmen Borggrefe, Andreas Hoffmann
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This article takes up the sport policy and sports science debate on the recognition of competitive computer and video games—so-called eSport—as sport and pursues the goal of differentiating sport and eSport on the basis of systems theory considerations and reflecting on the functions and consequences of recognizing eSport as sport. It begins by addressing the questions of how sport can be observed at all with the help of theories and which epistemological position underlies the systems theory approach. This is followed by a consideration of sport in terms of systems theory as a social functional system and by reflection on forms of structural coupling between the sport system and other social functional systems. In light of these theoretical considerations, the connectivity of eSport to the sport system as well as the functions and consequences of such an integration for structural couplings between the sport system and the systems of health, education, the economy, mass media, and politics are analyzed. The article concludes with an outline of perspectives for future scientific observation of sport and eSport.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文接续体育政策和体育科学中关于承认竞技电脑和电子游戏——即所谓电竞——为体育的辩论，旨在基于系统理论的考量来区分体育与电竞，并反思承认电竞为体育的功能和后果。文章首先探讨了借助理论如何能够观察体育，以及系统理论方法背后的认识论立场是什么。随后，从系统理论角度将体育视为一个社会功能系统进行考量，并反思体育系统与其他社会功能系统之间的结构耦合形式。鉴于这些理论考量，文章探讨了电竞与体育系统的连接性，以及承认电竞为体育的功能和后果。
literature.keywords: politics; policy
literature.theoretical_framework: 游戏研究、媒介文化理论

literature.title: Children's views on women in sport: Locating feminist narratives
literature.title_cn: 儿童对女性体育的看法：定位女性主义叙事
literature.title_en: Children's views on women in sport: Locating feminist narratives
literature.author: Niamh Kitching
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Narratives of progress have circulated around women's sport in recent times, as reflected in the growing numbers of women sports participants, increased media visibility and movements towards pay parity for professional sportswomen. As part of a wider project exploring children's sporting identities, 147 children were asked via focus groups (21) about their views on the perceived progress of women in sport, with the data analysed to see how these ideas might be underpinned by feminist perspectives. Using reflexive thematic analysis, the constructed themes comprised of (1) pay equity, (2) media visibility, (3) girl fandom and (4) a continuum of boys’ views. Overall, children are overwhelmingly positive about the progress of women in sport. Feminist frameworks presented in discussions on equity of pay and resources as linked to liberal feminism, to media visibility typically associated with popular feminism. However, while the viewpoints of the children appeared to support the progressive narrative around women in sport, many of the frameworks that underpinned children's views may not ultimately challenge gender inequality in sport. The significance of this research relates to the potential for future generations to recognise and embrace gender equity in sport.
literature.abstract_cn: 近年来，围绕女性体育的进步叙事广泛传播，体现在女性体育参与人数增长、媒体可见度提高以及职业女运动员薪酬平等方面。作为一项更广泛的儿童体育认同研究项目的一部分，通过焦点小组（21组）询问了147名儿童对女性体育所取得进步的看法，并分析数据以了解这些观点可能如何以女权主义视角为基础。使用反身性主题分析，构建的主题包括：（1）薪酬平等，（2）媒体可见度，（3）女孩粉丝文化，以及（4）男孩观点的连续谱。总体而言，儿童对女性体育的进步持压倒性的积极态度。讨论中出现的女权主义框架——与自由女权主义相关的薪酬和资源平等、通常与流行女权主义相关的媒体可见度。然而，虽然儿童的观点似乎支持关于女性体育的进步叙事，但支撑儿童观点的许多框架可能最终不会挑战体育中的性别不平等。本研究的意义在于未来几代人认识和拥抱体育性别平等的潜力。
literature.keywords: gender; fandom; equity

literature.title: Reconceptualising informality in sport participation: Towards understanding (in)formalisation of sport governance
literature.title_cn: 重新概念化体育参与中的非正式性：理解体育治理的(非)正式化
literature.title_en: Reconceptualising informality in sport participation: Towards understanding (in)formalisation of sport governance
literature.author: Satoshi Miyashita, Justen O’Connor, Ruth Jeanes
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: The ongoing change in sport participation patterns is discussed often in the context of ‘informal’ sport on the rise and ‘formal’ sport struggling to attract more participants. While studies have revealed both ‘self-organised’ and ‘regulated’ aspects of ‘informal’ sport and indicated complex power relations in its governing processes, the possibly incongruent terms of ‘informal’ and ‘formal’ as modifiers of sport participation have not been fully explored. Drawing on an approach to (in)formality developed in urban studies, we aim to develop an alternative view to (in)formality in sporting contexts with which to better understand the governing processes of sport participation. This aim is better achieved after highlighting the risk of the terms ‘informal’ and ‘formal’, and associated binaries – organised/unorganised (self-organised), regulated/unregulated, and institutionalised/non-institutionalised – that can substantialise in/formality in a particular domain of sporting activities. The alternative view repositions (in)formality as processes rather than categories of participation forms. This perspective can reveal power relations manifested in the negotiation practices that stabilise and destabilise sporting resources, institutions, and even the differentiation between ‘formal’ and ‘informal’ sport itself, which will lead to unequal opportunities for participation.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育参与模式的持续变化常在"非正式"体育兴起和"正式"体育努力吸引更多参与者的背景下讨论。虽然研究揭示了"非正式"体育的"自组织"和"受规制"两方面，并指出了其治理过程中复杂的权力关系，但"非正式"和"正式"作为体育参与修饰词的潜在不一致性尚未被充分探索。借鉴城市规划研究发展出的（非）正式性方法，我们旨在为体育情境中的（非）正式性发展一种替代性视角，以便更好地理解体育参与的治理过程。在强调"非正式"和"正式"这两个术语及相关二元对立——组织化/非组织化（自组织）、受规制/不受规制、制度化/非制度化——在特定体育活动中可能实体化（非）正式性的风险后，这一目标能更好地实现。这种替代视角将（非）正式性重新定位为过程而非参与形式的类别。这一视角可以揭示在协商实践中显现的权力关系，这些实践稳定和破坏体育资源、制度，甚至"正式"与"非正式"体育本身的区分，从而导致参与机会的不平等。
literature.keywords: governance; sport participation; informal sport; governing processes; alternative view; informal and formal
literature.theoretical_framework: 新闻学理论、传播学基础理论

literature.title: The role played by insider transfer information in esports coverage
literature.title_cn: 电竞报道中内部转会信息的作用
literature.title_en: The role played by insider transfer information in esports coverage
literature.author: Yi Rong, Jiaqi Li
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: Esports is a rapidly growing industry and related information garners the attention of audiences both inside and outside the arena. The electronic competition system has become more structured over time and there are now standard off-seasons, which coincide tightly with an intensive period of player transfers. However, at the same time, the off-season has few events to cover and transfer information is highly confidential, so any insights regarding possible transfers are of deep interest to audiences. As a result, unofficial esports insiders often leak transfer information. To explore this phenomenon in greater depth, the methodology used in this study was based on the content analysis of information relating to 10-years in the life of the esport Counter-Strike: Global Offensive (CS:GO). Data was collected from the Perfect World Esports APP and the HLTV websites to analyze the informants and the development of transfer information and its influence. It was found that, during the off-season, insider transfer revelations became the primary focus of content in the esports media sector. As the number of viewers participating in discussions about potential transfers has grown, esports tipsters have discovered a new career path within the industry. A comprehensive assessment of the audience and professional practitioners reveals the essential qualities that esports insiders should possess to excel in this field and for their careers to develop.
literature.abstract_cn: 电竞是一个快速增长的行业，相关信息吸引了赛场内外受众的关注。电子竞技系统随时间变得更加结构化，现在有标准的休赛期，这与球员转会的密集期紧密吻合。然而，与此同时，休赛期可报道的事件很少，转会信息高度保密，因此任何关于可能转会的洞察都深受受众关注。因此，非官方的电竞内部人士经常泄露转会信息。为更深入地探讨这一现象，本研究采用的方法基于对电竞反恐精英：全球攻势（CS:GO）十年生命周期相关信息的内容分析。数据收集自完美世界电竞平台及……

literature.title: Exploring print media coverage of elite athletes’ mental illness between 2010 and 2023 in Germany: a quantitative content analysis
literature.title_cn: 2010至2023年德国纸媒对精英运动员精神疾病报道的探索：量化内容分析
literature.title_en: Exploring print media coverage of elite athletes’ mental illness between 2010 and 2023 in Germany: a quantitative content analysis
literature.author: Marcia Hapig, Guido Zurstiege, Jochen Mayer, Ansgar Thiel, Jannika M. John
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: ObjectivesRecently, the stereotype of elite athletes' invulnerabilty has begun to be challenged by an increasing number of elite athletes who talk openly about struggling with mental health. Relatedly, previous research has focused primarily on specific incidents like the media's portrayal of personal disclosures. The purpose of this study was to expand this perspective and give a systematic overview of media coverage related to elite athletes' mental illness by examining more than one decade (2010–2023) of German print media reporting. Specifically, we were interested in changes over time and between broadsheet and tabloid press regarding content-related and formal aspects.MethodsBased on a systematic search and screening process in eleven German newspapers and magazines, 699 print media articles were analyzed with a codebook, forming a framework of content-related (reported mental disorder; central thematic focus; sources of comments and quotations; perspectives on the high-performance sports system) and formal categories (article genre; elements of responsible journalism). Univariate analyses and binary logistic regression models were used to examine changes over time (2010–2016 vs. 2017–2023) and differences between types of press (tabloid vs. broadsheet press) regarding content-related and formal characteristics.ResultsThe results indicate an enhanced awareness towards the topic of mental illness and those affected in recent years within German print media. This was demonstrated by the increased integration of responsible reporting elements, the inclusion of diversified perspectives and the considerate selection of content. Despite this positive trend over time, the findings also suggest that media reporting in the tabloid press bears an increased risk for inappropriate storytelling, focusing primarily on personal tragedies.ConclusionAs personal fate of prominent figures like elite athletes will always meet great interest in the public, it is of utmost importan
literature.abstract_cn: 研究目标：近年来，精英运动员"无懈可击"的刻板印象开始受到越来越多公开谈论心理健康的精英运动员的挑战。相关地，此前的研究主要聚焦于媒体如何报道个人公开披露等具体事件。本研究的目的是扩展这一视角，通过考察十多年（2010—2023年）的德国印刷媒体报道，系统梳理与精英运动员精神疾病相关的媒体报道。具体而言，我们关注内容相关和形式相关方面随时间的变化，以及大报与通俗小报之间的差异。方法：基于对德国十一种报纸和杂志的系统检索与筛选，使用编码手册分析了699篇印刷媒体文章，形成了内容相关（报道的精神障碍类型、核心主题焦点、评论与引用的来源、对高水平竞技体育系统的视角）和形式相关（文章体裁、负责任新闻要素）的分类框架。采用单变量分析和二元逻辑回归模型来考察随时间（2010—2016年与2017—2023年对比）的变化以及不同类型报纸（通俗小报与大报）在内容相关和形式特征上的差异。结果：结果表明，近年来德国印刷媒体对精神疾病话题及受影响者的认识有所提高。这体现在负责任报道要素的增多、多元视角的纳入以及对内容的审慎选择上。尽管存在这种积极的随时间趋势，研究结果也表明，通俗小报的媒体报道存在不当叙事的更高风险，主要聚焦于个人悲剧。结论：由于精英运动员等知名人物的个人命运始终会引起公众的极大兴趣，因此极为重要的是……

literature.title: Uncovering deep-rooted conflicts: the role of psychoanalytic psychotherapy in treating athletes' social media-related psychological distress
literature.title_cn: 揭示根深蒂固的冲突：精神分析心理治疗在治疗运动员社交媒体相关心理困扰中的作用
literature.title_en: Uncovering deep-rooted conflicts: the role of psychoanalytic psychotherapy in treating athletes' social media-related psychological distress
literature.author: Paweł Adam Piepiora, Ligiana Mihaela Petre, Jolita Vveinhardt
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: The use of social media by athletes can support them in difficult moments, but it can also become a source of negative emotions and psychological distress. This perspective critically examines psychoanalytic psychotherapy as a method for restoring athletes' psychological well-being after experiencing negative effects from social media use. The paper characterizes the key elements of psychoanalytic psychotherapy relevant to athletes, discusses the role of the psychoanalytic psychotherapist in working with athletes and describes the specifics of the psychoanalytic therapeutic process in this context. The potential advantages of psychoanalytic approaches over cognitive-behavioral methods are examined in treating the psychological impacts of problematic social media use among athletes. The analysis suggests that hate speech and negative online interactions can activate athletes' unprocessed life experiences rooted in early developmental stages. Psychoanalytic psychotherapy may offer a particularly effective method for restoring athletes' psychological wellbeing in such cases by addressing deep-rooted intrapsychic conflicts. However, a comprehensive approach integrating multiple therapeutic modalities is recommended to address the complex challenges athletes face in the digital age. This perspective acknowledges limitations in current research and suggest directions for future studies to develop and validate tailored interventions for athletes grappling with social media-related psychological distress.
literature.keywords: athlete; wellbeing; emotion; source
literature.theoretical_framework: 新闻学理论、传播学基础理论

literature.title: Social media behaviors and body type ideals predict weight loss and food tracking behaviors among recreational climbers
literature.title_cn: 社交媒体行为与体型理想预测休闲攀岩者的减重与食物追踪行为
literature.title_en: Social media behaviors and body type ideals predict weight loss and food tracking behaviors among recreational climbers
literature.author: Nicholas Slagel, Katie Kage, Sarah Wichern
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: IntroductionElite and recreational climbers may be at risk for disordered eating, low energy availability (LEA), and increased injury as a result. Social media use among athlete and non-athletes can lead to body image disturbances resulting in unhealthy weight loss practices exacerbating LEA and injury risk. Therefore, the objective of this study was to examine relationships between social comparative behaviors on social media, body type ideals and outcomes, and health behaviors among adult recreational climbers.MethodsParticipants (n = 324) were adult recreational climbers from the U.S. (29.30 ± 9.99 years old and 50% female). Participants answered a 66-item questionnaire comprised of demographics, climbing characteristics, social media behaviors, body type ideals, training and nutrition-seeking behaviors, and weight and food tracking behaviors.ResultsMost participants (78.7%) indicated strength-to-weight ratio was important for climbing performance. Many participants perceived they could perform better at rock climbing if their body proportions were different (59.3%). These body type ideals were found to be significant predictors of performing weight loss and food-tracking behaviors (all p < 0.001). Higher amounts of social comparative behaviors on social media and social physique anxiety independently and significantly predicted attempting weight loss to improve climbing ability (p < 0.001 and p = 0.001 respectively). Those who followed climbing influencers, used Instagram frequently for training and nutrition information, perceived they could perform better at rock climbing if their body proportions were different, or were female and college-aged had significantly higher mean social comparative behavior scores (all p < 0.01).DiscussionThis study expands on prior work with elite climbers by providing a possible explanation for how climbing-related body type ideals and certain social media behaviors can perpetuate negative body image and compensatory behaviors amo
literature.abstract_cn: 引言：精英和休闲攀岩者可能面临饮食失调、低能量可用性（LEA）和随之增加的受伤风险。运动员和非运动员中社交媒体的使用可能导致身体形象障碍，导致不健康的减重实践，加剧LEA和受伤风险。因此，本研究的目标是考察休闲攀岩成年人中社交媒体社会比较行为、身体型态理想和健康行为之间的关系。方法：参与者（n=324）是来自美国的成年休闲攀岩者（平均29.30±9.99岁，50%为女性）。参与者回答了66项问卷，包括人口统计、攀岩特征、社交媒体行为、身体型态理想、训练和营养寻求行为以及体重和食物追踪行为。结果：大多数参与者（78.7%）表示力量重量比对攀岩表现很重要。许多参与者认为如果他们的身体比例不同，他们在攀岩中能表现得更好（59.3%）。这些身体型态理想被发现是进行减重和食物追踪行为的显著预测因素（均p<0.001）。社交媒体上更高的社会比较行为和社交体质焦虑独立且显著地预测了试图通过减重来提高攀岩能力的尝试。
