literature.title: The Age of the Expert—COVID-19, Expertise, and Conflicts of Interest in Austrian Media Reporting
literature.title_cn: 专家的时代——奥地利媒体报道中的新冠疫情、专业性与利益冲突
literature.title_en: The Age of the Expert—COVID-19, Expertise, and Conflicts of Interest in Austrian Media Reporting
literature.author: Johannes Scherling, Anouschka Foltz
literature.abstract: Background: Experts are a favorite source of information in the news media as they have the ability to provide balanced and authoritative comments on important issues. However, two factors cast doubt on the extent to which such experts can actually provide balanced information: conflicts of interest and areas of expertise. In this paper, we analyze the use of expert voices during the COVID pandemic in two Austrian broadsheet papers. Methods: We examine the use of reporting verbs employed to indicate the journalists’ stance towards the expert comments as well as the relationship of those comments to the experts’ fields of expertise and to any potential conflicts of interest. Results: Our analysis shows that the media uncritically reported experts that had considerable conflicts of interest, while others were permitted to comment on topics far outside their particular fields. Conclusions: In the absence of journalistic scrutiny, distance, and context, both of these practices are likely to have led audiences to take the experts’ comments at face value and therefore to have embraced unbalanced information that amplified official narratives, to the exclusion of alternative voices.
literature.abstract_cn: 背景：专家是新闻媒体中受欢迎的资料来源，因为他们能够就重要问题提供平衡和权威的评论。然而，两个因素对专家能在多大程度上真正提供平衡信息提出了质疑：利益冲突和专业知识领域。本文分析了COVID疫情期间奥地利两家大报中专家声音的使用情况。方法：我们考察了用于表明记者对专家评论立场的报道动词的使用，以及这些评论与专家专业领域和任何潜在利益冲突的关系。结果：我们的分析表明，媒体不加批判地报道了具有相当大利益冲突的专家，而其他专家则被允许在其特定领域之外的遥远话题上发表评论。结论：这些发现凸显了在健康危机期间，新闻媒体在验证专家来源的可靠性和避免利益冲突方面面临挑战。
literature.keywords: covid; audience; pandemic; source
literature.theoretical_framework: 叙事理论、受众研究理论

literature.title: Communication in the Digital Age: The Impact of Communication Skills and Cultural Restraint on the Use of Social Media Platforms in the Case of Jordan
literature.title_cn: 数字时代的传播：传播技能与文化约束对约旦社交媒体平台使用的影响
literature.title_en: Communication in the Digital Age: The Impact of Communication Skills and Cultural Restraint on the Use of Social Media Platforms in the Case of Jordan
literature.author: Rania Abdel-Qader Abdallah, Islam Habis Mohammad Hatamleh, Yousef Sami Nemer Abu Eid, Mohammad Mahroum
literature.abstract: The rapid proliferation of social media platforms has fundamentally transformed communication dynamics globally. This study investigates the impact of communication skills on social media usage, emphasizing the moderating role of cultural restraint within the context of Jordan. Employing a quantitative research design, data were collected from 415 young adult social media users through an online survey and analyzed using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) via SmartPLS 4 software. The findings suggest that individuals with strong communication skills are more effective at using social media, supporting the ideas of Self-Efficacy Theory and Social Capital Theory, which propose that better communication abilities lead to more proficient social media usage. However, this positive relationship is moderated by cultural restraint, with higher levels of cultural restraint weakening the impact of communication skills on social media engagement. These results highlight the necessity of culturally sensitive approaches when promoting social media engagement, as cultural norms and values significantly influence digital behaviors. This study contributes to the existing literature by providing empirical evidence from a non-Western context and underscores the complex interplay between individual abilities and cultural factors in shaping social media usage. Future research should explore additional moderating variables and consider longitudinal and cross-cultural studies to further elucidate these dynamics.
literature.abstract_cn: 社交媒体平台的迅速普及从根本上改变了全球的沟通动态。本研究考察了沟通技能对社交媒体使用的影响，强调了约旦背景下文化约束的调节作用。采用定量研究设计，通过在线调查从415名年轻成年社交媒体用户收集了数据，并进行了分析……
literature.keywords: quantitative; survey; engagement
literature.theoretical_framework: 跨文化传播理论、平台理论

literature.title: Are Women Sports Journalists in Spain Truly Progressing or Facing “Pseudo-Progress”?
literature.title_cn: 西班牙女性体育记者是真正进步还是面临“伪进步”？
literature.title_en: Are Women Sports Journalists in Spain Truly Progressing or Facing “Pseudo-Progress”?
literature.author: Nahuel Ivan Faedo, Montse Corrius, Xavier Ginesta
literature.abstract: Sports journalism has become one of the news products with the most significant social reach in the press, radio, television and digital media. Despite the significant presence of women in journalism, they continue to face gender-based stereotypes. In Spain, not very many women can effectively access the labour field of sports journalism, and those who do find themselves in a space dominated by men, which results in a perpetuation of the existing imbalances in society. The main objective of this study is to analyse the evolution of the roles developed by women journalists in the article-production aspect of the Spanish sports press between 2010 and 2022. We use quantitative content analysis, studying the articles published in Marca and Mundo Deportivo during the second week of June in 2010, 2014, and 2018, and the third week of November 2022; in each of these years, the men’s FIFA World Cup was played. The results of this study show that: (a) women journalists have an almost invisible role in the production of articles, and (b) rather than progress, women are facing “pseudo-progress”, a more appropriate term for the appearance of a change that is not actually occurring.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育新闻已成为报刊、广播、电视和数字媒体中社会覆盖面最大的新闻产品之一。尽管女性在新闻业中占有重要地位，但她们仍面临基于性别的刻板印象。在西班牙，能够有效进入体育新闻劳动领域的女性不多，而那些进入的人发现自己处于男性主导的空间，这导致社会中现存不平衡的延续。本研究的主要目标是分析2010年至2022年间西班牙体育报刊中女性记者在文章生产方面的角色演变。我们采用定量内容分析，研究了《马卡报》（Marca）和《世界体育报》（Mundo Deportivo）在2010年、2014年和2018年6月第二周以及2022年11月第三周发表的文章；在这些年份中，恰逢男足世界杯等重大赛事。
literature.keywords: gender; television; stereotype; quantitative; access

literature.title: “Part of the Team”: In-House Sports Reporters Navigating the Journalistic Periphery
literature.title_cn: “团队的成员”：内部体育记者游走于新闻边缘地带
literature.title_en: “Part of the Team”: In-House Sports Reporters Navigating the Journalistic Periphery
literature.author: Gregory P. Perreault, Daniel Nölleke, Monica Crawford, Ella Hackett
literature.abstract: In recent years, the sports communication landscape has seen changes in terms of who occupies the role of sports reporter. In-house reporters, or sports communicators employed by specific clubs, teams, or leagues, now contribute content to the sports media landscape. This study explores the complicated relationship between in-house reporters’ self-perceived professional identities and in-houses reporters’ perceptions of their audiences through the lens of Bourdieusian field theory. As such, it sees in-house reporters as peripheral actors negotiating the boundaries of the sports journalism field. Through semi-structured interviews with 28 in-house sports reporters from the United States and Austria, our findings suggest that in-house reporters conceive of themselves both in relation to professional journalism and as members of the sports establishment. Furthermore, they note an ambiguous relationship to their audience, which is both reliant upon the reporters’ work, and, at times, highly critical of it.
literature.abstract_cn: 近年来，体育传播格局在谁承担体育记者角色方面发生了变化。内部记者（受雇于特定俱乐部、球队或联盟的体育传播人员）现在为体育媒体格局贡献内容。本研究通过布迪厄场域理论的视角，探讨内部记者的自我感知职业身份与内部记者对受众感知之间的复杂关系。研究将内部记者视为在体育新闻场域边界进行协商的边缘行动者。通过对来自美国和奥地利的28名内部体育记者进行半结构化访谈，我们的发现表明，内部记者既将自己与专业新闻业联系在一起，也把自己视为体育机构的成员。此外，他们指出与受众之间存在一种模糊的关系——受众既依赖记者的工作，有时又对其高度批判。
literature.keywords: reporter; audience; interviews
literature.theoretical_framework: 场域理论、受众研究理论

literature.title: Critically Contextualising a Mega-Event: Nordic Sports Commentaries During the 2022 World Cup in Football
literature.title_cn: 批判性语境化大型赛事：2022年世界杯期间北欧体育解说
literature.title_en: Critically Contextualising a Mega-Event: Nordic Sports Commentaries During the 2022 World Cup in Football
literature.author: Harald Hornmoen, Anders Graver Knudsen
literature.abstract: Prior to the FIFA 2022 World Cup, Nordic news media emphasised their ambitions of persistently covering problematic aspects of this mega-event to be hosted in Qatar, a country subjected to severe criticism of its human rights breaches in the build-up to the event. Focusing on the genre of commentary journalism—a form committed to articulating opinions on social and cultural issues—this study illuminates how key Nordic news media argued for their views on the World Cup 2022. Drawing on empirical material from Danish and Norwegian broadcasters and tabloids, the study analyses commentaries (excluding “sports only” commentaries) published during the event, highlighting the types of arguments, the discourses they articulate or imply, and their attribution of agency to organisational actors. Although a critical and contextualising argumentation runs through commentaries made during the tournament, the reasoning changes its character to such a degree that it is pertinent to categorise the commentaries as reflecting two distinct discursive phases. Argumentation in the first phase sustains a critique of FIFA and the organiser. Arguments were typically formulated as personal attacks but tended to elaborate on their premises by providing fact-based background from investigations of power abuse. The argumentation in the second phase changes its character by more clearly emphasising the action needed to transform current problematic circumstances in accordance with stated goals, not least a reformation of FIFA. The commentators now tend to be less moralising and more diverse and reflective in how they argue for changes in the governance of mega-events in football.
literature.abstract_cn: 在2022年FIFA世界杯之前，北欧新闻媒体强调其持续报道这一将在卡塔尔举办的大型赛事问题方面的雄心，卡塔尔在赛事筹备期间因其人权侵犯行为而受到严厉批评。本文聚焦评论新闻这一致力于对社会文化问题表达意见的体裁，阐明主要北欧新闻媒体如何论证他们对2022年世界杯的看法。研究利用丹麦和挪威广播公司和通俗小报的实证材料，分析了赛事期间发表的评论（不包括"纯体育"评论），突出论证类型、它们所表达或暗示的话语，以及它们对组织行动者的能动性归属。虽然批评性和情境化的论证贯穿于赛事期间发表的评论中，但论证的性质发生了变化，以至于有必要将评论归类为反映两个不同的话语阶段。第一阶段论证维持对FIFA和主办方的批评。论证通常以人身攻击的形式表达，但倾向于通过调查权力滥用的基于事实的背景来阐述其前提。
literature.keywords: football; tournament; governance

literature.title: Female Sports Journalists: The More Things Change, the More They Stay the Same
literature.title_cn: 女性体育记者：万变不离其宗
literature.title_en: Female Sports Journalists: The More Things Change, the More They Stay the Same
literature.author: Aage Radmann, Anna Sätre
literature.abstract: This article aims to explore the experiences of female sports journalists in Sweden from a gender perspective. The theoretical framework is inspired by Yvonne Hirdman’s understanding of gender in a binary system and R. W. Connell’s definition of hegemonic masculinity. Data consist of 10 semi-structured interviews with the most prominent female sports journalists in Sweden. The sports journalists in this study express that there has been a change in the media industry, resulting in a better understanding of women’s working conditions within the industry. Even so, the work is still grounded in a culture signified by hegemonic masculinity, where women need to find their own strategies to build a successful career, handle harassment, and cope with other gender-related challenges.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文旨在从性别视角探讨瑞典女性体育记者的经历。理论框架受到伊冯娜·希尔德曼（Yvonne Hirdman）对二元系统中性别理解以及R.W.康奈尔（R.W. Connell）对霸权男性气质定义的启发。数据包括对瑞典最杰出的女性体育记者的10次半结构化访谈。本研究的体育记者表示，媒体行业已发生变革，导致对该行业女性工作条件的更好理解。即便如此，工作仍植根于以霸权男性气质为特征的文化中，女性需要找到自己的策略来建立成功的职业生涯、处理骚扰并应对其他与性别相关的挑战。
literature.keywords: gender; masculinity; interviews; career

literature.title: Sports Journalists as Agents of Change in Nordic Countries
literature.title_cn: 北欧国家的体育记者作为变革推动者
literature.title_en: Sports Journalists as Agents of Change in Nordic Countries
literature.author: Anders Graver Knudsen, Harald Hornmoen, Nathalie Hyde-Clarke
literature.abstract: Sports Journalists as Agents of Change: Shifting Political Goalposts in Nordic Countries identifies and describes changes prevalent in political narratives of sports journalism. Although tensions between professional autonomy and commercial influences in sports journalism persist, shifts in public expectations and increased interest in investigative journalism present new possibilities for sports journalists to reshape this field. The research in this thematic issue examines media content and considers how sports journalists reflect on their role, how gender issues are tied to, and addressed by, that role, and how critical sports journalism develops through engagement with relevant national and international sports journalist associations.
literature.abstract_cn: 《体育记者作为变革推动者：北欧国家政治目标位的转变》识别并描述了体育新闻政治叙事中普遍存在的变化。尽管体育新闻中职业自主与商业影响之间的紧张关系持续存在，但公众期望的转变和对调查性新闻兴趣的增加，为体育记者重塑这一领域提供了新的可能性。本专题研究考察了媒体内容，并探讨体育记者如何反思自己的角色、性别议题如何与该角色关联并被解决，以及批判性体育新闻如何通过与相关的国内和国际体育记者协会的互动而发展。
literature.keywords: gender; engagement

literature.title: From Social Clubs to Champions for Sports Journalistic Identity and Integrity
literature.title_cn: 从社交俱乐部到体育新闻身份与诚信的捍卫者
literature.title_en: From Social Clubs to Champions for Sports Journalistic Identity and Integrity
literature.author: Kirsten Frandsen
literature.abstract: Taking the FIFA World Cup in Qatar as a point of departure, this article analyses the changing role of national associations of sports journalists in Denmark, Norway, and Sweden. Introducing the concept of meta-journalistic discourse and well-established media system theories, it is argued that Nordic sports journalism’s negotiations of professional practices and standards are shaped by a particular media systemic context with distinct Nordic welfare state-oriented features. One such feature is a tradition of using collective, organized social groups, like democratically based voluntary associations, as instruments for social change. The empirical study explores this through a qualitative thematic analysis of the changing structures, identities, and practices of the national associations of sports journalists across the three countries. This illustrates how the organizations in particular during the last two decades have started very similar processes of transformation away from being mainly social clubs. The associations have used their collective frameworks and bargaining power to ensure independent journalists’ access to sports organizations and athletes, and they have engaged in negotiations of what sports journalism is and what constitutes sports journalism in a sports media landscape shaped by strong combined forces of digitization and politicization.
literature.abstract_cn: 以卡塔尔FIFA世界杯为出发点，本文分析了丹麦、挪威和瑞典国家体育记者协会角色变化。通过引入元新闻话语的概念和成熟媒介系统理论，本文认为北欧体育新闻对专业实践和标准的协商受到具有独特北欧福利国家导向特征的特定媒介系统情境的塑造。其中一个特征是使用集体、有组织的社会团体（如基于民主的自愿协会）作为社会变革工具的传统。实证研究通过对三个国家体育记者国家协会不断变化的结构、认同和实践进行定性主题分析来探索这一点。这说明了这些组织特别是近二十年来如何开始了非常相似的转型过程，从主要是社交俱乐部转变而来。这些协会利用其集体框架和议价能力确保独立记者进入体育组织和接触运动员的机会，并参与协商体育新闻是什么以及体育媒介景观中什么构成体育新闻。
literature.keywords: qualitative; athlete; access

literature.title: Sports Journalists as Agents of Change: An International Academic Perspective
literature.title_cn: 体育记者作为变革推动者：一种国际学术视角
literature.title_en: Sports Journalists as Agents of Change: An International Academic Perspective
literature.author: Alina Bernstein
literature.abstract: Sports journalists can act as agents of change in society since they have a unique and powerful platform to influence public opinion, raise awareness, advocate for various issues through their reporting and commentary, and overall promote positive change in society. This is perhaps more obvious when looking at recent research from the Nordic countries. However, are sports journalists able to be, and do they even wish to be, agents of change in countries such as Iran, the United Arab Emirates, Spain, Germany, and Israel? Based on academic writing and interviews with media and sports scholars, this article examines the academic discourse that tries to assess to what extent sports journalism may be professionalized in a select number of countries in the European Union and the Middle East. Respondents were asked to speak about how they, as academics, perceived the extent to which sports journalists in each country have substantial autonomy from the economic and political systems and to what extent they are agents of change in their country.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育记者可充当社会的变革推动者，因为他们拥有独特而强大的平台来影响舆论、提高认知、通过报道与评论倡导各种议题，并总体上促进社会积极变革。这在北欧国家近期研究中尤为明显。然而，体育记者是否能够、且是否愿意在不同语境中成为变革推动者仍待探讨。本研究从国际学术视角审视了体育记者作为社会变革角色的可能性与局限性。
literature.keywords: interviews; agents of change; change in society; international academic; journalists can; journalists able

literature.title: Deconstructing or Reinforcing Binaries? How Scholars Position Non-Journalists in Global Conflict Reporting
literature.title_cn: 解构还是强化二元对立？学者如何在全球冲突报道中定位非记者
literature.title_en: Deconstructing or Reinforcing Binaries? How Scholars Position Non-Journalists in Global Conflict Reporting
literature.author: Ansgard Heinrich, David Cheruiyot
literature.abstract: Abstract This article interrogates the level of appreciation of the informational ecology that informs today’s news production. Through a scoping review of literature on media production in global conflict between 2000 and 2019, we assess how the study of non-journalistic actors evolved in scholarship across the human and social sciences. The article specifically examines if these non-journalistic actors are gauged as proximal to professional journalism and/or in their own terms as alternative content producers. The findings showed first, that there is a dearth in studies about non-traditional actors in global conflict reporting, with most publications focusing on traditional news producers as the only sources of information. Second, we identified a continuum across the sampled articles where traditional media and journalism act as the fulcrum in analysing the contributions of non-traditional actors. The logic of journalism provides the main frame of analysis to assess non-traditional actors, establishing firm binaries between journalists and non-journalists. Third, this study found only a very limited number of studies deconstructing these binaries through focusing on non-traditional actors as contributors to an ever-growing informational ecology. In light of these findings, this paper encourages research that problematises the positions between information producers in global conflict reporting.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文审视了对当今新闻生产所依赖的信息生态的重视程度。通过对2000年至2019年全球冲突媒体生产文献的范围综述，我们评估了对非记者行动者的研究在人文与社会科学领域中的演变。文章特别考察了这些非记者行动者是被视为接近专业新闻业，还是以其自身条件作为替代性内容生产者来评判。研究结果表明：首先，关于全球冲突报道中非传统行动者的研究存在匮乏，大多数出版物仅将传统新闻生产者视为唯一信息来源。其次，我们在抽样文章中发现了一个连续谱……
literature.keywords: source; global conflict; non-traditional actors; conflict reporting; informational ecology; non-journalistic actors

literature.title: Boosting or Limiting? Examining How FoMO Influences Personal News Curation Through News Fatigue in Social Media
literature.title_cn: 促进还是限制？FoMO如何通过新闻疲劳影响社交媒体中的个人新闻策展
literature.title_en: Boosting or Limiting? Examining How FoMO Influences Personal News Curation Through News Fatigue in Social Media
literature.author: Biying Wu-Ouyang
literature.abstract: Abstract While the theoretical framework of curated flows provides valuable insights into the dynamics of the social media environment, it overlooks the interactions between curators and the mechanisms pertaining to these interactions. This study argues that each curator can interact with one another, resulting in an interplay between different flows and shaping an individual’s information networks. Specifically focusing on personal news curation, this research argues that it can influence curated flows by signaling algorithms of user preferences. Furthermore, the affective mechanism of news curation has received limited attention. Drawing on the Stress-Strain-Outcome model, this study investigates how Fear of Missing Out (FoMO) manifests divergent effects on news-boosting and news-limiting curation via social media news fatigue. The findings, derived from a large-scale survey in a work-from-home context (N = 1198), reveal a noteworthy association: individuals experiencing FoMO are susceptible to news fatigue, leading them to prioritize being protected (news-limiting curation) than informed (news-boosting curation). This might contribute to a narrower news repertoire and influence the cultivation of informed citizens.
literature.abstract_cn: 虽然策展流（curated flows）的理论框架为理解社交媒体环境的动态提供了有价值的洞见，但它忽视了策展者之间的互动及与这些互动相关的机制。本研究认为，每个策展者都可以彼此互动，导致不同信息流之间的相互作用，并塑造个体的信息网络。本研究特别聚焦于个人新闻策展，认为它可以通过向算法发出用户偏好信号来影响策展流。此外，新闻策展的情感机制受到的关注有限。基于……
literature.keywords: algorithm; survey; affective

literature.title: Pandemic Podcasting: Industry Disruption, Organizational Adaptation, and Covering Sports When the World Stops
literature.title_cn: 疫情播客：行业颠覆、组织适应与世界停摆时的体育报道
literature.title_en: Pandemic Podcasting: Industry Disruption, Organizational Adaptation, and Covering Sports When the World Stops
literature.author: Ryan Broussard, Lindsey A. Sherrill, Marcus Funk
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT COVID-19 brought U.S. sports to an abrupt halt. As leagues struggled to find a path forward, so did sports podcasters, who had to find content to satisfy listeners and advertisers. Some print sports journalists covered health news or focused on the business side of sports. Sports podcasters had to similarly pivot to survive the environmental disruption to the field, but little research has been conducted on sports podcasters compared to sports journalists in other fields. Organizational ecology theory is a framework that allows researchers to examine the various avenues that organizations adapt to environmental disruptions. Using purposive sampling and inductive thematic analysis, we interviewed 14 podcasters about how they navigated this industry disruption. Key findings include how sports podcasters moved to more interview-based formats, changed their runtime, or started covering the business side of sports, while increasing their interaction with fans and fostering a community, and saying they would carry the pandemic-forced changes into the future as sporting events return.
literature.abstract_cn: 新冠让美国体育戛然而止。当联盟艰难寻找出路时，体育播客主持人也同样如此，他们必须找到内容来满足听众和广告商。一些纸媒体育记者报道健康新闻或专注于体育的商业方面。体育播客主持人不得不类似地转向以在环境的扰乱中生存，但与体育新闻的其他领域相比，对体育播客主持人的研究很少。组织生态学理论是一个框架，允许研究者考察组织适应环境扰乱的多种途径。采用目的性抽样和归纳主题分析，我们采访了14位播客主持人，了解他们如何应对这一环境挑战。
literature.keywords: podcasters, journalists, business, environmental, disruption

literature.title: Reshaping Sports Journalism Through Innovation: An Analysis of L’Équipe Explore ’s Strategies, Practices and Output
literature.title_cn: 通过创新重塑体育新闻：《队报·探索》的策略、实践与产出分析
literature.title_en: Reshaping Sports Journalism Through Innovation: An Analysis of L’Équipe Explore ’s Strategies, Practices and Output
literature.author: Xavier Ramon, José Luis Rojas-Torrijos, Christopher D. Tulloch
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT Sports journalism practice faces important challenges deriving from the multiplication of platforms, the acceleration of workflows, the emergence of new entrants and the audiences’ shifting consumption habits. In a bid to overcome those challenges and advance innovation across the board, the French newspaper L’Équipe established a specific unit for that purpose: Explore. By focusing on this case study, this research has examined the formats, output and practices deployed by Explore and evaluated its impact within L’Équipe’s offer. The study is informed by content analysis performed on the projects (N = 201) published by Explore over a 32-month timeframe (May 2021–December 2023), ethnographic work and eight semi-structured interviews with its employees. Findings reveal that Explore stands out as a leading “media lab” in sports journalism. Through a broad range of formats and a multifaceted agenda, Explore occupies a unique position in terms of delivering cultural capital. Explore embraces alternative production modes that invest in freedom and research while rejecting hyper-accelerated cycles and clickbait-oriented approaches. Such proposition has resonated with audiences and positioned Explore as a cornerstone of L’Équipe’s commercial strategy. Solutions articulated by Explore contribute to the broader discussion of how sports journalism practice can be reshaped in the digital age.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育新闻实践面临平台倍增、工作流程加速、新进入者出现和受众消费习惯转变带来的重要挑战。为克服这些挑战并全面推动创新，法国报纸《队报》为此成立了专门部门：Explore。通过聚焦这一案例研究，本研究考察了Explore部署的格式、产出和实践，并评估了其在《队报》产品中的影响。研究基于对Explore在32个月期间（2021年5月至2023年12月）发布的201个项目进行的内容分析、民族志工作以及对员工的八次半结构化访谈。研究发现，Explore作为体育新闻领域的领先"媒体实验室"脱颖而出。通过广泛的格式和多方面议程，Explore在提供文化资本方面占据独特位置。Explore拥抱替代性生产模式，投资于自由和研究，同时拒绝超加速周期和点击诱导向的方法。这一主张引起了受众的共鸣，并将Explore定位为《队报》商业战略的基石。Explore阐明的解决方案为体育新闻实践如何在数字时代被重塑的更广泛讨论做出了贡献。
literature.keywords: explore, journalism, quipe, practice, challenges

literature.title: From Glass Ceilings to Harassment: Women's Experiences in Spanish Sports Newsrooms
literature.title_cn: 从玻璃天花板到性骚扰：西班牙体育新闻编辑室女性的经历
literature.title_en: From Glass Ceilings to Harassment: Women's Experiences in Spanish Sports Newsrooms
literature.author: Raúl Martínez-Corcuera, Nahuel Ivan Faedo
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT Since its origins, women have been underrepresented in all areas of sports journalism. They are “outsiders” according to their gender, but “insiders” according to their adherence to journalistic norms and values. In Spain, sports journalism has also historically been configured as a tough environment for women to develop professionally without being belittled and/or discriminated. This research aims to identify women journalists’ perceptions about their roles in sports newsrooms. This investigation looks for meanings instead of numbers, and it is interested in how women sports journalists perceive their experiences and how they understand and interpret these experiences. The study has a qualitative approach, with semi-structured interviews conducted with ten journalists from various Spanish media. The results reveal, among other issues, that (a) women journalists suffer harassment, (b) the “glass ceiling” limits access to leadership positions, and (c) the sports journalism field continues to be conditioned by stereotypical and discriminatory views.
literature.abstract_cn: 自起源以来，女性在体育新闻的各个领域都未得到充分代表。她们根据性别是"局外人"，但根据对新闻规范和价值观的遵从又是"局内人"。在西班牙，体育新闻历来也被构建为女性在没有被轻视和/或歧视的情况下难以职业发展的艰难环境。本研究旨在识别女性记者对其在体育新闻编辑室中角色的感知。这项调查寻找的是意义而非数字，关注的是女性体育记者如何感知自己的经历以及她们如何理解和诠释这些经历。研究采用定性方法，对来自西班牙各媒体的十名记者进行了半结构化访谈。结果显示，除其他发现外……
literature.keywords: women, journalists, journalism, according, experiences

literature.title: Enacting Journalistic Authority: The Communicative Challenges and Competences of Live Two-Way Correspondents in Swedish Public Service Broadcasting
literature.title_cn: 建构新闻权威：瑞典公共服务广播直播双向记者交流的挑战与能力
literature.title_en: Enacting Journalistic Authority: The Communicative Challenges and Competences of Live Two-Way Correspondents in Swedish Public Service Broadcasting
literature.author: Mats Ekström, Åsa Kroon, Emil Östlund
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT Whenever a major event flares up in the world, we are bound to be met by correspondents reporting live on the news. The correspondents are typically promoted as authoritative voices. Their live talk is delivered in “the live two-way,” a broadcast interaction between the presenter and the correspondent on location. Focusing on live reporting during the Ukraine–Russia war (2022–), this study analyses the communicative work that goes on in the live two-way, and how correspondents handle the tasks related to the enactments of epistemic authority. A conceptual framework is applied defining the communicative and epistemic dimension of the live two-way. This study applies a discourse approach and focuses on experienced correspondents in Swedish public service. Data consists of 30 live two-ways and interviews with 5 of the journalists about planning and execution of the live reporting. Results show how practices and roles separated in other genres of news are integrated in the complex work of the correspondent who is expected to fluently report from location, convey a sense of being there, present facts, and analyse and explain. This study indicates different styles of reporting when correspondents alternate between a careful and confident stance as they balance their commitments to truth.
literature.abstract_cn: 每当世界爆发重大事件时，我们必然会在新闻中遇到现场报道的记者。这些记者通常被塑造成权威的声音。他们的现场讲述以"现场双向连接"的形式呈现，即在演播室主持人与在现场的记者之间的广播互动。本研究聚焦于乌克兰—俄罗斯战争（2022年至今）期间的现场报道，分析了现场双向连接中发生的传播工作，以及记者如何处理与权威知识宣称的实施相关的任务。研究应用了一个概念框架来界定现场双向连接的传播与认识维度。本研究采用话语分析方法，聚焦于瑞典公共服务广播中的资深记者。数据包括30个现场双向连接片段。
literature.keywords: correspondents, reporting, two-way, correspondent, location

literature.title: Does Gender Influence Media Engagement? Attitudes and Experiences of Australian Media Sources
literature.title_cn: 性别影响媒体参与吗？澳大利亚媒体信源的态度与经验
literature.title_en: Does Gender Influence Media Engagement? Attitudes and Experiences of Australian Media Sources
literature.author: Kathryn Shine, Alexandra N. Fisher, Gosia Mikołajczak, Michelle K. Ryan, Emmaline A. Monteith
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT The news media’s reliance on official sources for interviews tends to privilege male voices and perspectives. To date, most of the research in this area has focused on news content analysis which consistently finds that women voices are marginalized, comprising only around 30 per cent of people quoted, heard, and seen in the news. In this study, we extend this work to examine whether potential gender differences in sources’ attitudes toward, and experiences of, media engagement can explain the over-representation of male sources. We outline the key findings from an online survey of Australian subject experts and spokespeople (N = 220). The findings are encouraging, both for journalists and sources. Significantly, men and women perceived the interview experience as generally positive and there was no evidence that women are less willing than men to agree to interview requests. However, there were gendered factors that could deter prospective sources, including fear of being misquoted, mistrust of journalists and concerns about harassment and negative evaluations of appearance. These findings provide valuable insights for journalists and journalism educators about how to improve interviewing practices and develop strategies to increase the diversity of voices in news coverage.
literature.abstract_cn: 新闻媒体在采访中依赖官方来源往往使男性声音和观点享有特权。迄今为止，这一领域的大多数研究聚焦于新闻内容分析，一致发现女性声音被边缘化，仅占新闻中被引用、听到和看到的人的约30%。在本研究中，我们扩展这项工作，考察来源对媒体参与的态度和经历中潜在的性别差异是否可以解释男性来源的过度代表。我们概述了对澳大利亚学科专家和发言人的在线调查（N=220）的关键发现。这些发现对记者和来源都是令人鼓舞的。重要的是，男性和女性普遍认为采访经历是积极的，没有证据表明女性比男性更不愿意同意采访请求。然而，存在可能阻止潜在来源的性别因素，包括担心被错误引用、对记者的不信任以及对骚扰和外表负面评价的担忧。这些发现为记者和新闻教育工作者提供了关于如何改进采访实践和制定策略以增加新闻报道中声音多样性的宝贵见解。
literature.keywords: sources, voices, women, findings, journalists

literature.title: Online Abuse, Emotion Work and Sports Journalism
literature.title_cn: 网络辱骂、情绪劳动与体育新闻
literature.title_en: Online Abuse, Emotion Work and Sports Journalism
literature.author: G. Sinclair, C. Kearns, K. Liston, D. Kilvington, J. Black, M. Doidge, T. Fletcher, T. Lynn
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT This article generates new insights into the changing profession of journalism. Empirically, we present the findings of 21 interviews with journalists working in the Irish and UK sports beats on their experiences of online abuse. Conceptually, we address the under-theorising of emotions in journalism by extending the utility and entanglement of emotion work and emotional labour. In doing so, we posit future lines of theoretical enquiry about individual and social regulation. Several key discoveries are presented. First, sports journalism is a distinctive profession because significant authentic emotional work is undertaken. This is only accentuated when online abuse occurs. Journalists are deeply affected by this abuse, personally and professionally. Second, online abuse towards sports journalists is now so ubiquitous as to be habitually accepted, and it has obscured the distinction between public and private spaces. Third, in response, sports journalists have been compelled to develop their own emotional strategies, including self-censorship, to cope with and manage online abuse. The findings presented here also pose practical and existential questions about the sustainability of the profession, especially in the absence of formal institutional supports or even an informal code of practice about how to cope with and respond to online abuse.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文对不断变化的新闻职业产生了新的见解。在实证层面，我们呈现了对在爱尔兰和英国体育条线工作的21名记者关于其在线辱骂经历的访谈发现。在概念层面，我们通过扩展情感工作和情感劳动的有效性和纠缠性，解决了新闻业中情感理论化的不足。在此过程中，我们提出了关于个人和社会规制的未来理论探索方向。本文呈现了几个关键发现。首先，体育新闻是一个独特的职业，因为进行了大量真实的真实性情感工作。当在线辱骂发生时，这一点更为突出。记者在个人和职业层面都深受这种辱骂的影响。其次，针对体育记者的在线辱骂如今已无处不在，以至于被习惯性地接受，并且模糊了公共与私人空间之间的界限。第三，作为回应，体育记者被迫发展自己的情感策略，包括自我审查，以应对和管理在线辱骂。这里呈现的发现也对职业的可持续性提出了实践性和存在性的问题，尤其是在缺乏正式制度支持或甚至缺乏关于如何应对和回应在线辱骂的非正式实践准则的情况下。
literature.keywords: abuse, online, journalists, profession, journalism

literature.title: Sports News Media and Coming Out of Lesbian Athletes: Perspective from Non-Western News Outlets
literature.title_cn: 体育新闻媒体与女同性恋运动员出柜：非西方新闻机构的视角
literature.title_en: Sports News Media and Coming Out of Lesbian Athletes: Perspective from Non-Western News Outlets
literature.author: Muhammad Fahad Humayun
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT In May 2019, Dutee Chand became the first Indian athlete to publicly come out as a lesbian while still actively competing. This study conducts a textual analysis of the Indian news media’s coverage of Chand’s announcement, focusing on three major English-language dailies: The Hindustan Times, The Hindu, and The Times of India. As one of the first studies to explore the Indian media’s response to Chand’s coming out, it sheds light on how lesbian athletes are portrayed in non-Western sports media, this one specifically within the Indian context. Chand's public embrace of her sexuality, in a cultural environment often hostile to LGBTQIA+ identities, has broader implications for understanding the media representation of sexual minorities in sports. The findings reveal that Indian news outlets depicted Chand as a rebellious figure but balanced their coverage by supporting her stance and conforming to prevailing social and cultural norms that resist public expressions of non-heteronormative sexualities.
literature.abstract_cn: 2019年5月，杜蒂·昌德（Dutee Chand）成为第一位在积极参赛期间公开出柜的印度运动员。本研究对印度新闻媒体关于昌德出柜公告的报道进行了文本分析，聚焦于三大英文日报：《印度斯坦时报》《印度教徒报》和《印度时报》。作为最早探索印度媒体对昌德出柜回应的研究之一，它揭示了非西方体育媒体如何描绘女同性恋运动员，特别是在印度语境中。在一个经常敌视LGBTQIA+身份的文化环境中，昌德公开拥抱自己的性取向，对于理解体育中性少数群体的媒体呈现具有更广泛的意义。研究结果显示，印度新闻媒体将昌德描绘为一个反叛的人物，但也……
literature.keywords: chand, indian, media, first, lesbian

literature.title: No Longer a Sign of Weakness? Media Reporting on Mental Ill Health in Sport
literature.title_cn: 不再是软弱的标志？体育中精神疾病媒体报道
literature.title_en: No Longer a Sign of Weakness? Media Reporting on Mental Ill Health in Sport
literature.author: Keith D. Parry, Abigail G. Braim, Rebecca E. Jull, Matthew J. Smith
literature.abstract: This study analyzed media framing of athletes who have suffered mental ill health. The mass media play a crucial role in shaping public attitudes and perceptions surrounding mental health, and the present study aimed to examine the media reporting of athletes’ mental ill health and to further explore how this reporting has changed over time. We examined the reporting of elite athletes in three U.K. media outlets between January 2000 and December 2019, identifying 75 athletes from 26 different sports. From analysis, four themes were developed to consider the content of media reporting and how it has changed over three time phases. The analysis revealed that media reporting of mental ill health has increased over time, and changes were observed in terms of the specific terminology used, with greater depth in the articles, such as journalists speaking to other professionals to construct the articles. This study contributes toward our growing understanding of the reporting of mental ill health by providing empirical evidence of the increased attention to the topic and increasingly responsible reporting in the media.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了遭受心理疾病的运动员的媒体框架。大众媒体在塑造公众对心理健康的看法和态度方面发挥着关键作用，本研究旨在考察运动员心理疾病的媒体报道，并进一步探索这种报道如何随时间变化。我们考察了2000年1月至2019年12月期间三个英国媒体机构对精英运动员的报道，识别出来自26个不同运动的75名运动员。通过分析，形成了四个主题来考察媒体报道的内容以及它如何在三个时间段内变化。分析显示，心理疾病的媒体报道随时间增加，并且在所用特定术语方面观察到变化，文章深度增加，如记者与其他专业人士对话来构建文章。本研究通过提供媒体对该主题关注度增加以及报道日益负责任的实证证据，为我们对心理疾病报道的不断增长的理解做出了贡献。
literature.keywords: framing; athlete

literature.title: Exploring the Influence of Match Fixing on Consumer Motivations to Watch Esports: Perspectives From Brand Producers
literature.title_cn: 探索假球对消费者观看电竞动机的影响：品牌生产商视角
literature.title_en: Exploring the Influence of Match Fixing on Consumer Motivations to Watch Esports: Perspectives From Brand Producers
literature.author: Michael L. Williamson, Kevin Filo, Jason Doyle, Brooke Harris-Reeves
literature.abstract: Existing challenges to the esports industry, such as match fixing, potentially affect consumer motivations to watch esports. Additionally, the esports literature examining consumer motivations to watch competitions relies on data gathered from consumers. An opportunity is presented to understand industry challenges alongside additional stakeholder perspectives on consumer motivations. The purpose is to explore the perceived influence of match fixing on consumer motivations to watch esports broadcasts, from the perspective of esports brand producers. Informed by uses and gratification theory, 30 semistructured interviews were conducted with brand producers in the Australian esports industry. Four themes were generated from thematic analysis: diminished integrity, decreased engagement, limited individual impact, and reduced drama. The findings provide insight for brand producers to craft strategic communications, which mitigate negative motivational influences and encourage consumers to watch esports. The current research extends the understanding of consumer motivations to watch esports by considering the perspective of brand producers.
literature.abstract_cn: 电竞行业面临的现有挑战（如假球）可能会影响消费者观看电竞的动机。此外，考察消费者观看赛事动机的电竞文献主要依赖于从消费者那里收集的数据。本研究提供了一个机会，从品牌生产者这一额外的利益相关者视角来理解行业挑战和消费者动机。本研究的目的是从电竞品牌生产者的视角，探讨假球对消费者观看电竞转播动机的感知影响。研究以使用与满足理论（uses and gratification theory）为依据，对澳大利亚电竞行业的品牌生产者进行了30次半结构化访谈。主题分析生成了四个主题：完整性受损、参与度下降、个人影响有限以及戏剧性减弱。研究结果为品牌生产者制定战略性传播提供了洞见，以减轻消极动机影响并鼓励消费者观看电竞。当前研究通过纳入品牌生产者的视角，拓展了对消费者观看电竞动机的理解。
literature.keywords: esports; brand; interviews; engagement
literature.theoretical_framework: 游戏研究、媒介文化理论

literature.title: Passionate About Esports: Esports Players’ Motivation to Participate in and Watch Esports Events
literature.title_cn: 热爱电竞：电竞玩家参与和观看电竞赛事的内在动机
literature.title_en: Passionate About Esports: Esports Players’ Motivation to Participate in and Watch Esports Events
literature.author: Yong Chae Rhee, Kyungun Kim
literature.abstract: Alderfer’s ERG (i.e., existence, relatedness, and growth) theory of motivation (1969) was adopted in this study to analyze individuals’ motivations for engaging in esports. This study investigated the relatively new field of esports viewership and participation by concentrating on the motivating factors behind esports consumption to establish whether esports viewership and participation are distinct markets that stand alone or are comparable to or complement each other for consumption. The study was conducted using qualitative methods consisting of semistructured focus-group interviews. The transcript was coded using open, axial, and selective coding to develop themes fitting within the ERG theory. The current study found similarities and unique findings in esports participation and consumption motivation factors under the ERG groups. Practical applications are proposed for employing the results of the study to further marketing and development efforts in this field.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究采用奥尔德弗（Alderfer）的ERG动机理论（1969，即存在、关系、成长）来分析个体参与电竞的动机。研究聚焦于电竞观看与参与这一相对较新的领域，通过关注电竞消费背后的动机因素，以判断电竞观看与参与究竟是彼此独立的独立市场，还是可比较或相互补充的消费关系。研究采用定性方法，包括半结构化的焦点小组访谈。访谈文本采用开放式、轴心式和选择性编码进行编码，以发展出符合ERG理论的主题。本研究发现在ERG类别下，电竞参与和消费的动机因素既有相似之处，也有独特发现。研究为运用这些结果进一步推进该领域的营销和发展工作提出了实际应用建议。
literature.keywords: esports; viewers; qualitative; interviews; marketing; consumption

literature.title: Mediated Sports Money: An Analysis of the Relationship Between Sports Media Consumption and College Students’ Perceived Financial Understanding
literature.title_cn: 媒介化体育金钱：体育媒体消费与大学生金融认知的关系分析
literature.title_en: Mediated Sports Money: An Analysis of the Relationship Between Sports Media Consumption and College Students’ Perceived Financial Understanding
literature.author: Patrick C. Gentile, Zachary W. Arth, Emily J. Dirks, Nicholas R. Buzzelli
literature.abstract: This study investigated the correlation between sports media consumption and its influence on college students’ perception of finances. Through the lens of cultivation theory, the study sought to gauge how financial information featured in sports media may impact college students’ perceptions about money. A survey was distributed to 225 participants across four states. Results indicate that students who consume a greater amount of sports media are more likely to have a higher perceived understanding of financial concepts, higher confidence when it comes to finances, and even an elevated perception of entry-level salaries when compared with non–sports fans. Overall, sports media consumption can influence how college student sports fans perceive finances.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了体育媒介消费与大学生对财务认知之间的关联。以涵化理论（cultivation theory）为视角，研究试图衡量体育媒介中出现的财务信息如何影响大学生对金钱的认知。研究对来自四个州的225名参与者进行了问卷调查。结果表明，与不是体育迷的学生相比，消费更多体育媒介的学生更有可能对财务概念有更高的感知理解，对财务有更高的信心，甚至对入门级薪资有更高的预期。总体而言，体育媒介消费会影响大学生体育迷对财务的感知。
literature.keywords: consumption; survey

literature.title: Front Office Fantasies: The Rise of Managerial Sports Media
literature.title_cn: 管理层幻想：管理型体育媒体的兴起

literature.author: 陈凯华、曹建军、周振茂、徐晓艺
literature.abstract: 2023年,习近平文化思想在全国宣传思想文化工作会议上被正式提出,新时代体育文化也进一步明确了思想遵循。为更好地推动新时代中国体育文化传承与发展,本文从具有中国特色的体育文化主体性、现代性使命、跨时空传播三个方面,探讨了习近平文化思想引领下的体育文化理论品质与传播策略,以期为新时代体育文化建设提供理论参考。

literature.title_cn: 中国竞技体育国际话语权：基本内涵与提升策略
literature.author: 周泽天、戴永冠
literature.abstract: 竞技体育国际话语权代表主权国家或组织的参与主体在国际竞技体育事务中的权威和地位,体现了参与主体在国际竞技体育事务中话语表达权利与权力的辩证统一,与国家核心利益以及国际背景密切相关。目前,竞技体育国际话语权的西方化倾向比较明显,我国竞技体育国际话语权有待进一步提升,需要通过提升竞技体育治理能力、深化体育外交等途径增强我国竞技体育国际话语权。

literature.title: 数字化背景下中国体育文化的新媒体传播研究
literature.title_cn: 数字化背景下中国体育文化的新媒体传播研究
literature.author: 张晓琳
literature.abstract: 进入数字化时代,中国体育文化被赋予新的战略意义,新媒体传播为提升中国体育文化的解释力提供了重要载体。运用文献资料、逻辑分析等方法,分析中国体育文化数字化战略意义,进而提出新媒体传播路径。研究认为,中国体育文化数字化战略意义在于以弘扬中华体育精神繁荣社会主义文化、以提升中国体育形象构建国际文化秩序、以讲好中国体育故事维护国家文化安全。现阶段,传播主体专业能力匮乏、传播内容降低体育文化引导力、传播方式呈现碎片现象、国外受众存在认知偏差是中国体育文化新媒体传播面临的困境。

literature.title: 全运会新闻叙事的历时性特征研究
literature.title_cn: 全运会新闻叙事的历时性特征研究
literature.author: 张汝莹、刘贺娟
literature.abstract: 全运会新闻叙事的历时性特征变化主要体现为:报道立场由结果导向转向过程导向;叙事内容由叙述赛事的外部性特征转向体验性特征;叙事主体由单一叙事主体转向多元叙事主体。研究发现,全运会新闻从关注赛事的竞技属性与社会效益向人才培养、群众体育等以人物为中心的主题转变,叙事模式从事件叙事、过程叙事转向人物叙事、情感叙事。

literature.title: 北京2022年冬奥会遗产实现传承路径的多维阐释：基点·过程·趋向
literature.title_cn: 北京2022年冬奥会遗产实现传承路径的多维阐释：基点·过程·趋向
literature.author: 王海燕、王润斌
literature.abstract: 对北京2022年冬奥会遗产实现传承的起点、终点及过程的解析,有利于更好地传承北京2022年冬奥会遗产。运用文献研究法分析后认为:北京2022年冬奥会遗产实现传承路径的基点为顺应各类奥运遗产相关文件的引导、鉴纳往届奥运遗产治理经验、汇集北京办奥既有资源、采纳其他学科适宜理论方法;其传承路径的过程为静态结构(主体、客体、实现方式)与动态过程(申办阶段、筹办阶段、赛后阶段)相互嵌合;传承路径的要旨是识别遗产、评估遗产、促进遗产、传承遗产。

literature.title: 共情传播视域下中国体育故事跨文化传播的国际认同建构
literature.title_cn: 共情传播视域下中国体育故事跨文化传播的国际认同建构
literature.author: 王真真、王相飞
literature.abstract: 中国体育故事存在国际认同不足等困境,如何基于文化陌生感的语境建构中国体育故事跨文化传播的国际认同,是亟待思考的现实议题。该研究以共情传播为理论,指出了中国体育故事中的共情元素、共性历史、共同诉求和共通价值,为跨文化传播中建构国际认同提供了共情可能。并以国际认同的建构为导向,构建了中国体育故事跨文化传播中的共情传播模式。

literature.title: 体旅融合背景下乡村体育文化传播的本土实践与反思
literature.title_cn: 体旅融合背景下乡村体育文化传播的本土实践与反思
literature.author: 赵馨、张业安、于晓梅
literature.abstract: 以乡村体育文化传播的典型案例村BA和村超为例,探讨体旅融合背景下媒介传播对乡村体育文化的建构过程以及乡村体育文化传播的本土实践。研究发现,乡村体育文化具有创新乡村体育文化传承机制、增强乡村经济活力、满足乡民健康生活需求等多元价值;媒介主要通过实现空间跃升、构筑体育社群和凝聚集体情感对乡村体育文化进行建构。

literature.title: 智媒时代大型体育赛事网络舆论生态治理路径研究
literature.title_cn: 智媒时代大型体育赛事网络舆论生态治理路径研究
literature.author: 徐磊、王庆军、王锴
literature.abstract: 在智媒时代下,探寻大型体育赛事网络舆论生态治理问题,对促进体育赛事高质量发展,助力体育强国和网络强国建设具有重要意义。研究认为,智媒时代大型体育赛事网络舆论生态治理的基本逻辑在参与主体层面上,要树立体育舆论生态治理全局观,以确保治理方向;在协作机制层面上,要坚持以人民为中心的发展理念,以推进治理共享;在治理效能层面上,要不断创新舆论治理手段与方法,以提高治理效率。

literature.title: 体育传播概念的反思与本土化重构
literature.title_cn: 体育传播概念的反思与本土化重构
literature.author: 张业安、于晓梅
literature.abstract: 基于体育传播学术研究与实践发展之间的"堕距",尤其是对体育传播概念缺乏基于最新实践发展的理论跟进之现实,体育传播概念重构是当下亟待推进的议题。对国内外体育传播概念的演变进行梳理,反思其在诠释当下体育传播实践、挖掘体育传播本质特性、深化体育传播实质功能、指引本土体育传播实践方面存在的局限,并以马克思主义哲学对"人"的阐释为哲学基础,立足于本土实践、本土理论和知识生产需求对体育传播概念进行本土化重构。

literature.title: 深化“思想+艺术+技术”融合传播 打造体育报道新标杆——以中央广播电视总台巴黎奥运会转播报道为例
literature.title_cn: 深化“思想+艺术+技术”融合传播 打造体育报道新标杆——以中央广播电视总台巴黎奥运会转播报道为例
literature.author: 米笑磊

literature.abstract: 智媒时代，游戏表象广泛地出现在网络体育传播中，深刻影响着人们的认知和体育运动参与。运用文献资料法、逻辑分析法，探究游戏表象在网络体育传播中的生成条件，剖析其内在机理，进而反思其所带来的社会影响，提出应对策略。研究认为，在现阶段的网络体育传播中，大叙事被消解、娱乐化倾向突出是游戏表象生成的重要条件。

literature.title_cn: 何以“飞盘媛”：社交媒体环境下体育运动污名化影响因素研究

literature.abstract: 体育运动的污名化体现着社会认知与文化建构。以网络热词“飞盘媛”为例，通过大数据挖掘“飞盘媛”相关的社交媒体文本，采用扎根理论的方法研究社交媒体环境下体育运动污名化的影响因素。研究发现，标签化与他者化是体育运动污名化的内部驱动因素，导致体育运动参与主体被污名化。

literature.title: 全媒体时代中国武术文化传播的价值表征、现实问题与推进方略
literature.title_cn: 全媒体时代中国武术文化传播的价值表征、现实问题与推进方略

literature.abstract: 运用文献资料法和逻辑分析法，以传播学和社会学理论为基础，解析全媒体时代中国武术文化传播的价值表征、现实问题与推进方略。研究认为：全媒体时代中国武术文化传播的价值表征为全程智能再造：技术赋能中国武术文化；全员参与互动：跨界融合中国武术文化；全息内容供给：场景传播中国武术文化；全效传播反馈：价值共创中国武术文化。同时面临传播主体缺失、内容同质、渠道分散、效果评估不足等现实问题，并据此提出推进方略。

literature.title_cn: 体育赛事视听信息设权路径反思与法益体系保护——基于《体育法》第52条第2款的法教义学解读
literature.author: 罗祥
literature.abstract: 《体育法》新增第52条第2款是否有意创设权利来保护体育赛事视听信息，学界对此尚存争议。现有设权论据之所以存在缺陷，表面上是因为设权逻辑不周延，实际上是形式上的设权期待与实质上薄弱的设权基础存在差距所致。《体育法》的基本法属性以及体系构造很难为体育赛事视听信息的设权保护提供充分支撑。

literature.abstract: 文章基于个体视角，采用使用与满足理论，对2022年北京冬奥会中国受众进行问卷调查，分析了中国受众北京冬奥会媒介消费行为与动机。结果发现：审美动机是国内受众进行媒介体育消费的主要动机，新媒体技术成为了使用与满足的可供性来源；在冬奥会的媒介消费中，受众呈现出不同的消费特征。

literature.author: 陈瑾如、万晓红
literature.abstract: 研究基于福柯的身体规训理论，采用参与式观察法，对抖音平台的2个健身直播间展开观察，并结合访谈法对抖音健身直播跟练者进行半结构化访谈，尝试在权力关系的流动性与身体既缺席又在场的复杂性中，把握健身直播场域中微观权力运作的"变"与"不变"，揭示数字化健身方式的深层机制。

literature.title_cn: 体育电商直播女性观众的个人特征与居住环境对在线体育消费的综合影响
literature.author: 黄颖、孙淑慧
literature.abstract: 研究探索了体育电商直播中女性观众的个人特质与居住环境对其在线体育消费行为的综合影响。通过问卷调查与数据分析，研究发现职位职级、收入水平、婚姻状况以及居住地的空气质量对女性观众的在线消费行为产生了显著影响。

literature.title: 中国民族传统体育文化国际传播效果提升的影响因素与组态路径——基于YouTube热门视频的实证分析
literature.title_cn: 中国民族传统体育文化国际传播效果提升的影响因素与组态路径——基于YouTube热门视频的实证分析
literature.author: 李乾丙、王相飞、周榕
literature.abstract: 采用定性比较与回归分析法，对YouTube平台中与民族传统体育文化相关的热门视频传播的影响因素及组态路径进行分析。研究发现，民族传统体育文化的传播内容、信息来源特征因素与传播效果存在显著相关性，并构成三种促进民族传统体育文化国际传播的组态路径。

literature.title: 失序与共治：体育突发事件网络暴力生成路径与协同防控——基于体育突发事件网络舆情案例的实证研究
literature.title_cn: 失序与共治：体育突发事件网络暴力生成路径与协同防控——基于体育突发事件网络舆情案例的实证研究
literature.author: 卢兴、刘鹏宇
literature.abstract: 随着新媒体技术的快速发展，日渐陡增的体育网络暴力事件不断冲击体育本身所带来的社会凝聚力，阻碍了体育精神文明建设，成为危害我国体育环境健康发展的"附骨之疽"。因此，在新媒体环境下，把握体育网络暴力的显性要素与隐性路径对于营造健康积极的体育舆论环境具有重要意义。研究基于体育突发事件网络舆情案例，对体育突发事件网络暴力生成路径与协同防控展开实证研究。

literature.title: 数字化背景下中国武术国际传播研究
literature.title_cn: 数字化背景下中国武术国际传播研究
literature.author: 刘冠启、花家涛
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料、逻辑分析等方法，分析数字化背景下中国武术国际传播的价值与困境，并提出应对策略。价值：优化武术健康传播效能，拓展武术文化传播内容，提升武术的国家感召力。困境：传播主体数字技术能力不足，数字传播平台的匮乏，文化传播内容的异化。策略：强化数字资源服务，加强数字技术人才培育；实现技术资源整合，推进数字传播平台建设；创建完整的文化叙事方式，丰富武术文化传播内容。

literature.title: 基于文化洋葱模型的我国竞技体操文化解读与传播
literature.title_cn: 基于文化洋葱模型的我国竞技体操文化解读与传播
literature.author: 朱超、高希彬、秦国欣
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料、逻辑分析等方法，基于“文化洋葱模型”解读我国竞技体操项目文化，并提出传播路径。我国竞技体操文化：符号文化的民族特征与形象传播，英雄文化的民族韧性与榜样力量，仪式文化的荣光见证与精神凝聚，价值观文化的民族精神与社会传播。传播路径：展现符号文化，驱动传播创新；弘扬社会价值，铸就品牌典范；融合传承与创新，促进情感共鸣；构建系统文化体系，实现作用长效发挥。

literature.title: 新媒体时代体育明星形象塑造价值及优化策略
literature.title_cn: 新媒体时代体育明星形象塑造价值及优化策略
literature.author: 贾静敬、张佃波、单涛
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料、逻辑分析等方法，分析新媒体时代我国体育明星形象特征、塑造价值，并提出优化策略。特征：媒介形象娱乐化，个体形象立体化，角色转换多样化。价值：展现多元形象，传播体育文化；弘扬体育精神，发挥育人功效；推进体育外交，深化文化交流。优化策略：扩大体育明星榜样力量，营造良好舆论环境；搭建新媒体的宣传矩阵，加强传播体育精神；培育体育明星外交素养，加强外交人才的培养；设置育人导向网络议程，提升把关人工作能力。

literature.title_cn: 我国体育自媒体传播研究
literature.author: 王子豪、杨广辉、杨鑫
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料、逻辑分析等方法，探究我国体育自媒体传播的价值、困境，并提出纾解 方略。价值：促进全民健身参与，革新体育传播模式，激发体育消费活力，推动体育文化传播。 困境：创作者专业素养欠缺，作品创新程度不足，侵权事件层出不穷，误导性舆情频发。纾解 方略：提升专业素养，优化内容质量；开发多元题材，强化技术赋能；完善监管机制，增强版 权意识；培养意见领袖，加强舆情监管。

literature.title: 民族传统体育助力中华体育精神传播的生成机理与行动路向
literature.title_cn: 民族传统体育助力中华体育精神传播的生成机理与行动路向
literature.author: 孟国正、王启迪
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料、逻辑分析等方法，系统分析民族传统体育助力中华体育精神传播的价值、 生成机理，并提出行动路向。价值：深化思想教育，积淀精神追求；坚定文化自信，造就身心 并育；赓续华夏文脉，秉持知行合一。生成机理：筑牢共同基础，打造强劲引擎，拉紧共同纽 带，永葆高度品质。行动路向：凝聚国家认同的主体机制，弘扬核心价值；深化学生认知的客 体机制，培养受众群体；挖掘网络媒介的传播机制，搭建传播平台；构建信息反馈的保障机制， 营造传播空间。

literature.title_cn: “一带一路”倡议下中国武术转文化传播研究
literature.author: 王统领、赵翠青、姜南
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料等方法，探讨“一带一路”倡议下中国武术转文化传播愿景，并提出路径。 历程： 推向世界的国际化传播，文化走出去的跨文化传播，价值走进去的转文化传播。愿景： 人类命运共同体理念的国际传播，打造第三文化空间，达成互构共生关系，生成杂糅文化产品。 路径：立足多元时代价值，形成完整战略机制；拓宽传播实施渠道，达成多方协同推进；强化 文化产业支撑，打造特色品牌效应；注重仪式活动助力，实现传播价值共识。

literature.title_cn: 我国民族传统体育文化国际传播能力建设探赜
literature.author: 王保龙、尹树来、谭朝文，等
literature.abstract: 运用文献分析、逻辑分析等方法，厘析我国民族传统体育文化国际传播能力建设内涵， 阐释传播能力建设价值与困境，并提出建设策略。价值：讲好中国体育故事，促进文化交流互 鉴；增强中华文化自信，助力文化强国建设；推动国家形象塑造，提升国家形象亲和力。困境： 传播主体协同不足，传播内容生产不优，传播渠道建设质量不高，受众分析不足，传播影响力 不强。策略：以协同为基点构建传播共同体；以完善叙事体系为突破优化传播内容；以媒介资 源整合为动力加强传播渠道建设；以信息平台建设为抓手深化受众分析；以提升“内力”为根 本增强国际传播影响力。

literature.title: Gambling adverts in live TV coverage of the Qatar 2022 FIFA Men’s World Cup
literature.title_cn: 卡塔尔2022男足世界杯电视直播中的博彩广告
literature.title_en: Gambling adverts in live TV coverage of the Qatar 2022 FIFA Men’s World Cup
literature.author: Sharman, Piper, McGrane, Newall
literature.abstract: Abstract Background Gambling marketing is ubiquitous in UK football and, despite gambling industry self-regulation such as the whistle-to-whistle ban, remains prominent in live TV coverage. Major international tournaments do not usually feature gambling pitch-side advertising and shirt sponsorship, increasing the importance of TV adverts during these high-profile competitions. The present study examined the prevalence and features of gambling adverts shown during the commercial broadcaster ITV’s live coverage of games in the 2022 Qatar World Cup. Method Each match shown live on ITV was recorded. For each gambling advert, the timing of the advert (pre-/during-/post-match), the advert category (financial inducements/live odds/safer gambling/brand awareness) and safer gambling messaging were recorded. Results Over the 30 matches analyzed, there were 156 adverts directly for gambling brands or products (M = 5.2, range 3 – 8), featuring adverts from eight different operators. The majority of adverts were shown pre-match (80.8%). Financial inducements were most commonly advertised (42.3%), followed by brand awareness adverts (26.9%). The safer gambling message ‘take time to think’ was shown in 70.5% of adverts. Adverts for lottery products did not feature any safer gambling messages. Conclusions Multiple gambling adverts were shown during each match of the 2022 Qatar World Cup, especially so pre-match. Pre-match adverts predominantly encourage viewers to gamble promptly, through financial inducements and boosted live odds. Any potential further legislation could therefore consider either further restrictions based on the entire broadcast, or by enforcing the use of specific safer gambling messages.
literature.abstract_cn: 背景：赌博营销在英国足球中无处不在，尽管有赌博行业自我监管（如吹哨到吹哨禁令），在直播电视报道中仍然突出。大型国际锦标赛通常不设有赌博场地广告和球衣赞助，增加了这些高知名度比赛期间电视广告的重要性。本研究考察了商业广播公司ITV对2022年卡塔尔世界杯比赛直播报道中赌博广告的出现率和特征。方法：记录ITV直播的每场比赛。对于每个赌博广告，记录广告的时间（赛前/赛中/赛后）、广告类别（财务诱导/现场赔率/安全赌博/品牌知名度）和安全赌博信息。结果：在分析的30场比赛中，有156个直接针对赌博品牌或产品的广告（M=5.2，范围3-8），涉及八个不同的运营商。大多数广告在赛前显示（80.8%）。财务诱导最常被广告（42.3%），其次是品牌知名度广告（26.9%）。安全赌博信息"花时间思考"在70.5%的广告中显示。彩票产品的广告没有任何安全赌博信息。结论：2022年卡塔尔世界杯的每场比赛期间都显示了多个赌博广告，尤其是赛前。赛前广告主要通过财务诱导和提升的现场赔率鼓励观众迅速赌博。因此，任何潜在的进一步立法可以考虑基于整个转播的进一步限制，或强制使用特定的安全赌博信息。

literature.author: 吴自强
literature.abstract: 本文采用内容分析法和语料库分析法，将《人民日报》中有关卡塔尔世界杯的相关报道进行收录、降噪、赋码，并以语料库工具Antconc3.4.4为辅助，对文本进行批评话语分析，最终得到了三点结论：（1）报道主题较为片面、内容较为单薄；（2）报道手法运用较为丰富，但在部分报道中存在一定的专业性问题；（3）报道具有惯性思维，报道的价值有待提高。

literature.author: 吕雯思;王孙和颐
literature.abstract: 从“在快手看奥运会”到“在抖音看世界杯”，短视频已强势入局体育赛事。在抖音2022年卡塔尔世界杯的转播活动中，在内容、互动、流量转化等层面呈现出好看、好玩、好逛三大亮点。由于短视频体育赛事传播仍处于生态构建初期，版权投资风险、专业性欠缺以及周期性流量等问题尚待解决。

literature.title: The (De-)politicization of Black male bodies in American heavyweight boxing
literature.title_cn: 美国重量级拳击中黑人男性身体的(去)政治化
literature.title_en: The (De-)politicization of Black male bodies in American heavyweight boxing
literature.author: Wibke Schniedermann, Robert A. Winkler
literature.abstract: Abstract The bodies of African American heavyweight boxers are political objects, regardless of the individual athlete’s public persona, personal opinion, or possible activism. The cultural history of American boxing in general, and of the heavyweight championship in particular, is so infused with racial conflict and protest that no individual athlete can exist outside of its grasp. This article investigates the politicization of the Black masculine body in American heavyweight boxing. We are interested in affect-targeting strategies to either stage athletes’ bodies as political instruments or to downplay and muzzle the weaponization of their bodily presence for political ends. As the fighter’s public image—and, therefore, the image of his body—is necessarily a mediated one, the article analyses the mediation and media representations of Black heavyweight champions in the context of the historical commodification and fungibility of African American bodies.
literature.abstract_cn: 非裔美国重量级拳击手的身体是政治对象，无论个体运动员的公开形象、个人意见或可能的行动主义如何。美国拳击的一般文化史，特别是重量级冠军的文化史，充满了种族冲突和抗议，以至于没有哪个个体运动员能够存在于其掌控之外。本文调查了美国重量级拳击中黑人男性身体的政治化。我们对情感定位策略感兴趣，要么将运动员的身体作为政治工具上演，要么淡化并压制其身体存在为政治目的而武器化。由于拳手的公开形象——因此他身体的形象——必然是媒介化的，文章在非裔美国人身体的历史性商品化和可替代性的背景下，分析了黑人重量级冠军的媒介化和媒体表征。
literature.keywords: championship; representation; athlete; activism; protest

literature.title: Reconciliation within the National Rugby League: where art and sport intersect
literature.title_cn: 国家橄榄球联盟中的和解：艺术与体育的交汇
literature.title_en: Reconciliation within the National Rugby League: where art and sport intersect
literature.author: Lilianne Johanis-Bell, Audrey R. Giles, Jeremy Hapeta
literature.abstract: Abstract Annually, the National Rugby League (NRL) hosts a week of matches called the Indigenous Round that highlight Indigenous athletes’ contributions to RL and includes Indigenous ceremonies, designated speeches, merchandise, and player jerseys adorned with Indigenous art that are worn during the matches. It has been identified as part of reconciliation efforts between Indigenous and non-Indigenous peoples in Australia. In this paper, we use postcolonial theory and critical discourse analysis to closely examine six of the sixteen Indigenous Round jerseys produced by the NRL teams for the 2019 season, focusing on the use of sport merchandise as symbols of reconciliation, and assessing the practices of various NRL teams in employing (or not) Indigenous artists and utilizing Indigenous art and designs in the creation of the 2019 NRL Indigenous Round jerseys.
literature.abstract_cn: 每年，国家橄榄球联盟（NRL）都会举办一周名为"原住民回合"的比赛，突出原住民运动员对RL的贡献，包括原住民仪式、指定演讲、商品以及比赛中穿着的饰有原住民艺术的球员球衣。它已被确定为澳大利亚原住民和非原住民之间和解努力的一部分。在本文中，我们使用后殖民理论和批判性话语分析来仔细考察NRL球队为2019赛季生产的16件原住民回合球衣中的6件，聚焦于体育商品作为和解象征的使用，并评估各NRL球队在创作2019年NRL原住民回合球衣时雇用（或不雇用）原住民艺术家和利用原住民艺术与设计的实践。
literature.keywords: athlete

literature.title: Drivers of the perceived social impact of the Super Bowl: mediation and moderation analyses
literature.title_cn: 超级碗感知社会影响的驱动因素：中介与调节分析
literature.title_en: Drivers of the perceived social impact of the Super Bowl: mediation and moderation analyses
literature.author: Ji Wu, Madeleine Orr, Yuhei Inoue, Yonghwan Chang
literature.source_name: International Journal of Sports Marketing and Sponsorship
literature.abstract: Purpose Building on the social leverage model (SLM), this study aims to examine the influence of event-related attributes on residents' perceived social impact of a major sport event, as mediated by event involvement. It also investigates the moderating effect of event rights holders' credibility on the relationship between event involvement and perceived social impact. Design/methodology/approach Using a two-wave, time-lagged survey, data were collected from 220 residents of a Super Bowl host city. Hypotheses were tested using structural equation modeling (SEM). Findings High celebratory atmosphere, social camaraderie and social responsibility as perceived before the event were associated with residents' perceptions of the social impact of the Super Bowl. Moreover, the association between social camaraderie and perceived social impact was mediated by event involvement. When appraising the rights holder as credible, involved residents reported an increased level of perceived social impact. Originality/value This study contributes to research on the SLM by demonstrating its application among indirect participants of major sport events. Additionally, it suggests the imperative role of rights holders' credibility in promoting the perceived social impact among involved residents.
literature.abstract_cn: 目的：基于社会杠杆模型（SLM），本研究旨在考察赛事相关属性通过赛事参与的中介对居民对大型体育赛事感知社会影响的影响。它还调查了赛事权利持有者可信度对赛事参与和感知社会影响之间关系的调节作用。设计/方法/路径：使用两波、时间滞后的调查，从超级碗主办城市的220名居民收集了数据。使用结构方程建模（SEM）检验假设。发现：赛前感知到的高庆祝氛围、社交情谊和社会责任与居民对超级碗社会影响的感知相关。此外，社交情谊与感知社会影响之间的关联由赛事参与中介。当评价权利持有者为可信时，参与的居民报告了感知社会影响水平的提高。原创性/价值：本研究通过展示SLM在大型体育赛事间接参与者中的应用，为SLM研究做出了贡献。此外，它表明权利持有者可信度在促进参与居民感知社会影响中的关键作用。
literature.keywords: survey; credibility
literature.theoretical_framework: 新媒体传播理论、平台理论

literature.title: The Wall Street Journal ’s Agenda Setting of the LIV Golf Tour and the PGA Tour in 2022
literature.title_cn: 《华尔街日报》对2022年LIV高尔夫巡回赛与PGA巡回赛的议程设置
literature.title_en: The Wall Street Journal ’s Agenda Setting of the LIV Golf Tour and the PGA Tour in 2022
literature.author: John A. Fortunato
literature.abstract: Abstract: The core concept of agenda-setting research is the transfer of topic and topic-attribute salience from the media to the public. The theory indicates that the media perform the function of selecting topics and topic attributes for exposure to the public. Exposure characteristics of frequency and placement convey importance to the selected topics and their attributes. The launch of the LIV Golf Tour in 2022 and the response by the PGA Tour was a topic that produced 35 articles in the print edition of The Wall Street Journal . The topic appeared on the front page of the newspaper on four occasions in 2022. That the LIV Golf Tour is funded by the government of Saudi Arabia created controversy for the new golf league. Saudi Arabia is a topic attribute that is mentioned in 34 articles, including 14 article headlines or subheadlines. The Wall Street Journal ’s coverage offers an example of how a topic evolves and remains on the media agenda. Additional topic exposure and new topic attributes were introduced due to events and actions by individuals and organizations. For example, a Department of Justice investigation and an antitrust lawsuit initiated by LIV golfers against the PGA Tour generated multiple articles in The Wall Street Journal .
literature.abstract_cn: 议程设置研究的核心概念是话题和话题属性显著性从媒体向公众的转移。该理论表明，媒体发挥为公众选择话题和话题属性进行曝光的功能。频率和位置的曝光特征将重要性传达给所选话题及其属性。2022年LIV高尔夫巡回赛的推出以及美巡赛的回应，是《华尔街日报》印刷版上产生35篇文章的话题。该话题在2022年四次出现在报纸头版。LIV高尔夫巡回赛由沙特阿拉伯政府资助的事实为新高尔夫联赛制造了争议。沙特阿拉伯是一个在34篇文章中被提及的话题属性，包括14个文章标题或副标题。《华尔街日报》的报道提供了一个话题如何演变并保持在媒体议程上的例子。由于个人和组织的事件和行为，引入了额外的话题曝光和新的话题属性。例如，司法部的一项调查和LIV高尔夫球员对美巡赛提起的反垄断诉讼在《华尔街日报》上产生了多篇文章。
literature.keywords: wall street; street journal; liv golf; golf tour; pga tour; topic attributes

literature.title: Middle Aged Men in Lycra and the Performative Irony of Watching Tour de France
literature.title_cn: 穿莱卡的的中年男子与观看环法自行车赛的表演性反讽
literature.title_en: Middle Aged Men in Lycra and the Performative Irony of Watching Tour de France
literature.author: Ulrik Wagner, Stine Frydendal, Maria Hybholt
literature.abstract: Middle Aged Man in Lycra (MAMIL) is a cultural phenomenon associated with a gendered and conspicuous practice that can be inclusive by attracting individuals not previously engaged in physical activities as well as exclusive due to its gender and socio-economic conformity. Inspired by the works of Linda Hutcheon and Judith Butler, we argue that the MAMIL is an ironic figure constituting a complex and multifaceted character deeply embedded in a particular cultural context. By analyzing a TV advertising spot for Tour de France 2021 which embraces the MAMIL, the purpose of this study is to illustrate how ironic communication is productive as it leads to multiple performativities of irony. We identify four performativities in the spot which are: Irony as a way to cope with an aging male body; Irony as a way to identify with competitive elite sportsmen; (Self-) irony as enabling an exclusive male community and masculinity through humor; and Irony as legitimizing mass media consumption of cycling. We argue that the irony reaches beyond a mere humorous stance and serves a legitimizing and preservative function of road cycling as a male-dominated terrain.
literature.abstract_cn: "莱卡中年男"（MAMIL）是一种文化现象，与一种性别化和引人注目的实践相关，它可以具有包容性（吸引此前未参与体育活动的人），也可以具有排他性（由于其性别和社会经济一致性）。受琳达·哈琴和朱迪斯·巴特勒作品的启发，我们认为MAMIL是一个具有讽刺意味的形象，构成一个复杂和多方面的角色，深深嵌入一种父权制结构中。本文分析了"莱卡中年男"现象以及观看环法自行车赛的表演性反讽，探讨了这种观赛实践如何同时强化和颠覆性别、年龄和阶级规范。研究揭示了体育观看实践中的矛盾性，以及身份表演如何通过体育参与和观看得以构建。
literature.keywords: gender; masculinity; advertising; cycling; community; consumption
