literature.title: “You are the best… but can you twerk?” How twitter users challenge the messaging around female professional footballers in the 2019 UEFA women’s champions league final in a postfeminist context
literature.title_cn: “你是最棒的……但你能扭臀吗？”后女性主义语境中推特用户如何挑战2019年欧足联女足冠军联赛决赛中女职业球员的讯息
literature.title_en: “You are the best… but can you twerk?” How twitter users challenge the messaging around female professional footballers in the 2019 UEFA women’s champions league final in a postfeminist context
literature.author: Montserrat Martin, Gil Pla-Campas, Òscar Coromina, Santiago Tejedor
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT This paper analyses how fans engage on Twitter with the 22 players in the starting line up during the week of the 2019 UEFA Women’s Champions League final. It explores fans’ entangled representations of female professional footballers on Twitter from a postfeminist sensibility. Out of 200 tweets posted by the players during the day of the final and the week after, the research focuses on the 1468 fans replies to the 20 most engaged players’ tweets. To facilitate this, we developed an analysis instrument called the 3Fs Spiral, which helps to disentangle the complex meanings of the fans’ replies on Twitter. Results highlight the fans’ entangled representations and the continuous flow of disruption and reinforcement of the gender order that emerge from them in a set of tweets. The decentralised nature of Twitter has the potential to slowly promote the change of dominant gender narratives and frames in female football.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文分析了在2019年欧洲足联女足冠军联赛决赛前后一周内，球迷如何在推特上参与22名首发球员的互动。本文从后女性主义视角探讨球迷在推特上对女子职业足球运动员的纠缠性再现。在决赛当天和之后一周球员发布的200条推文中，研究聚焦于20位参与度最高的球员推文下的1468条球迷回复。为便于分析，我们开发了一种名为"3Fs螺旋"的分析工具，帮助梳理推特上球迷回复的复杂含义。结果凸显了球迷的纠缠性再现，以及从中浮现的对性别秩序的持续干扰和强化。推特的去中心化性质有可能缓慢促进女足领域主导性别叙事和框架的改变。
literature.keywords: twitter; football; gender; representation

literature.title: “The World Cup of Empowerment” and “They Really Missed the Ball”: Gender Discourses at the 2019 Women’s World Cup
literature.title_cn: “赋权世界杯”与“他们真的错过球了”：2019年世界杯的性别话语
literature.title_en: “The World Cup of Empowerment” and “They Really Missed the Ball”: Gender Discourses at the 2019 Women’s World Cup
literature.author: Rachel Allison
literature.source_name: Journal of Sport and Social Issues
literature.abstract: The FIFA Women's World Cup disseminates ideas about gender, women, and sport to a global audience. I report on a short-term ethnography involving participant observation at the 2019 Women's World Cup and in-depth interviews with fan attendees to examine the gender discourses produced through the tournament and fans’ responses to them. Integrating the concept of neoliberal postfeminism with an affective lens, I illustrate how discourses of empowerment and the progress of women's sport circulate positive affects in order to bring fans into neoliberal postfeminist ideas, ultimately presenting tournament organizers as benevolent supporters of women. While fans sometimes produced these discourses themselves, finding them emotionally resonant, they also championed a discourse of inequality that was skeptical about organizations’ true commitments and circulated an affect of frustration to call public attention to gender inequality. Fans’ simultaneous embrace and rejection of empowerment and progress discourses reveal both their reflexive agency and the powerful emotional pull that these discourses present.
literature.abstract_cn: 国际足联女足世界杯向全球受众传播关于性别、女性和体育的观念。本文报告了一项短期民族志研究，涉及在2019年女足世界杯上的参与式观察以及对球迷观众的深度访谈，考察赛事产生的性别话语以及球迷对它们的回应。将新自由主义后女性主义的概念与情感视角相结合，本文说明了赋权和女性体育进步的叙事如何传播积极情感，以将球迷带入新自由主义后女性主义观念，最终将赛事组织者呈现为女性的仁慈支持者。虽然球迷有时自己也生产这些叙事并感到情感共鸣，但他们也拥护一种不平等的叙事，对组织的真实承诺持怀疑态度，并传播挫折情感以呼吁公众关注性别不平等。球迷同时拥抱和拒绝赋权与进步叙事，既揭示了他们的反身性主体性，也揭示了这些叙事所呈现的强大情感吸引力。
literature.keywords: gender; audience; tournament; interviews; ethnography; emotion
literature.theoretical_framework: 性别理论、受众研究理论

literature.title: “In Soccer, We Have the Opportunity to Call Attention to Certain Things”: An Examination of Media Framing of Activism for Human Rights in German Sport
literature.title_cn: “在足球中，我们有机会引起人们对某些事情的关注”：德国体育中人权行动主义媒体框架的考察
literature.title_en: “In Soccer, We Have the Opportunity to Call Attention to Certain Things”: An Examination of Media Framing of Activism for Human Rights in German Sport
literature.author: Yannick Kluch, Evan L. Frederick, Nina Siegfried
literature.abstract: The goal of this study was to extend the contemporary athlete activism literature by (a) exploring athlete activism beyond a strictly North American context and (b) examining how athlete activism at an organizational/institutional level (i.e., sport organization) may be framed differently than activist efforts at an individual level (i.e., athlete). By examining two examples of activism in German soccer, we show that the framing of both athlete-enacted and organization-enacted examples of activism highlighted the importance of speaking up when human rights are violated, called for the display of solidarity, and discussed the broader political implications for such protests. Additionally, framing of both examples of activism included voices of criticism regarding the sport organizations governing global sport. As calls for accountability of sport organizations suppressing athlete expression are becoming increasingly common in global sport, this study adds to a shifting focus of activism research targeting the sport institutions that often perpetuate the various injustices individual athletes call attention to.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究的目标是通过以下方式扩展当代运动员行动主义文献：（a）探索北美严格语境之外的运动员行动主义，以及（b）考察组织/机构层面（即体育组织）的运动员行动主义如何与个体层面（即运动员）的行动主义努力被不同地框架。通过考察德国足球中行动主义的两个例子，我们表明，对运动员发起的和组织发起的行动主义例子的框架都强调了在人权受侵犯时发声的重要性，呼吁展示团结，并讨论了此类抗议的更广泛政治影响。此外，这两个行动主义例子的框架都包括了对治理全球体育的体育组织的批评声音。随着要求对压制运动员表达的体育组织问责的呼声在全球体育中日益普遍，本研究为行动主义研究的焦点转移做出了贡献，该研究针对的正是那些经常延续个体运动员所指出各种不公正的体育机构。
literature.keywords: framing; soccer; activism; athlete; protest

literature.title: ‘You can look, but don’t touch’: competitive balance and dominance in the UEFA Champions League
literature.title_cn: “你可以看，但不能碰”：欧足联冠军联赛中的竞争平衡与统治地位
literature.title_en: ‘You can look, but don’t touch’: competitive balance and dominance in the UEFA Champions League
literature.author: Girish Ramchandani, Daniel Plumley, Sarthak Mondal, Robbie Millar, Rob Wilson
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT This paper examines the competitive balance of the Champions League between 1992/93–2019/20 focusing on both the group and knockout stages. The findings show that competitive balance has declined in the Champions League over time and that the competition has begun to be dominated by a select number of clubs. This situation has also worsened in the years following the inception of UEFA Financial Fair Play regulations in 2011. From a sporting economics perspective, the received theory suggests that such a decline in competitive balance could harm the product. If competitive balance continues to decline, the Champions League may face potential future challenges from the attractiveness of the product to broadcasters and commercial partners as well as the continuing emergence of financially dominant super clubs. This could also exacerbate the threat of breakaway European super leagues that would further damage the competition through the potential loss of elite teams within it.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文考察了1992/93至2019/20赛季欧冠联赛的竞争平衡，重点关注小组赛和淘汰赛阶段。研究结果表明，欧冠的竞争平衡随时间推移而下降，该赛事开始被少数俱乐部主导。这种状况在2011年UEFA财务公平竞赛规则出台后的几年里也恶化了。从体育经济学角度来看，公认的理论表明这种竞争平衡的下降可能损害产品。如果竞争平衡继续下降，欧冠可能面临来自产品对广播商和商业伙伴吸引力的未来潜在挑战，以及财务上占主导的超级俱乐部的持续出现。这也可能加剧分裂型欧洲超级联赛的威胁，通过潜在失去其中精英球队而进一步损害该赛事。
literature.keywords: regulation; competitive balance; champions league; you can; can look; look but

literature.title: ‘Let us prepare for the Champions League!’ the symbolic Europeanization of Romania’s football bosses
literature.title_cn: “让我们为冠军联赛做准备！”罗马尼亚足球高管的象征性欧洲化
literature.title_en: ‘Let us prepare for the Champions League!’ the symbolic Europeanization of Romania’s football bosses
literature.author: Andrei Mihail
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT The post-communist privatization of Romanian football clubs saw their transfer into the hands of the nouveau riches who emerged after 1989. Gradually, the public image of the local championship rapidly worsened, because of corruption scandals or match-fixing incidents in which the new owners involved it. Thus,  the Champions League participation of Dinamo, Rapid, and Steaua Bucharest proved desirable for more than its economic benefits. The competition also offered football bosses an important symbolic capital, meant to highlight an improved image of “real” capitalist entrepreneurs. Accordingly, qualifying in the Champions League groups also meant the “Europeanization” of the club owners’ social status, through their association with a competition strongly appreciated in Romania, due to its perceived quality and correctness. The research behind this article is based on the analysis of the public discourses related to local club owners seeking participation in the Champions League groups during the past 30 years.
literature.abstract_cn: 后共产主义时期罗马尼亚足球俱乐部的私有化使它们落入1989年后出现的新贵手中。渐渐地，由于新东家卷入的腐败丑闻或假球事件，本地联赛的公众形象迅速恶化。因此，迪纳摩、快速和布加勒斯特星队参加欧冠联赛的资格被证明不仅出于其经济利益的考虑。该赛事还为足球老板提供了重要的象征资本，旨在凸显"真正的"资本主义企业家改善后的形象。相应地，进入欧冠小组赛也意味着俱乐部所有者的社会地位"欧洲化"，通过他们与一个在罗马尼亚因感知的质量和公正而备受赞赏的赛事的关联。本文背后的研究基于对过去30年间寻求进入欧冠小组赛的本地俱乐部所有者相关公共话语的分析。
literature.keywords: football; championship

literature.title: We Did It: A Content Analysis of Australian and New Zealand Online News Media Coverage of the Bid Process for the 2023 FIFA Women’s World Cup
literature.title_cn: 我们做到了：澳大利亚与新西兰在线新闻媒体对2023年女足世界杯申办过程报道的内容分析
literature.title_en: We Did It: A Content Analysis of Australian and New Zealand Online News Media Coverage of the Bid Process for the 2023 FIFA Women’s World Cup
literature.author: Eleanor Crabill, Callie Maddox, Adam Beissel
literature.abstract: The purpose of this study was to examine online news media coverage of the Australia–New Zealand joint bid to host the 2023 FIFA Women’s World Cup. Following neoliberal feminist theory and a postfeminist framework, the meanings and discourses of women’s empowerment produced in, and disseminated by, Australia and New Zealand’s popular online news media were explored. A content analysis was used to examine 77 domestic online news media articles published in response to the 2023 FIFA Women’s World Cup bid and hosting announcement. The findings revealed that the popular online news media centered on three themes: opportunities for women and girls in sport, legacy outcomes, and commercial benefits. However, there was a clear lack of critical engagement from the news media over the bid’s initiatives, claims, and promises. Only 2.5% of all online news media coverage engaged in meaningful discussion, analysis, and critique of the purported social and economic impacts of the 2023 FIFA Women’s World Cup. This study raises critical questions about the role of Australian and New Zealand (sport) media in (a) serving as a prominent forum through which the As One 2023 bid committee could circulate strategically crafted, preferred narratives regarding the event’s legacies and impacts to manufacture consent and public support for event hosting and (b) propagating a postfeminist celebration of women’s sport mega events that uncritically circulates specious claims of women’s empowerment, participation growth, and commercial benefits of the event.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究的目的是考察澳新联合申办2023年国际足联女足世界杯的在线新闻报道。遵循新自由主义女权主义理论和后女权主义框架，探讨了澳大利亚和新西兰大众在线新闻媒体生产和传播的妇女赋权意义和话语。使用内容分析检查了77篇针对2023年国际足联女足世界杯申办和主办公告发布的国内在线新闻文章。研究发现，大众在线新闻媒体围绕三个主题：体育中女性和女孩的机会、遗产成果和商业利益。然而，新闻媒体对申办的倡议、主张和承诺明显缺乏批判性参与。只有2.5%的在线新闻报道对2023年国际足联女足世界杯所谓的社会和经济影响进行了有意义的讨论、分析和批评。
literature.keywords: engagement; news media; online news; new zealand; fifa women; world cup

literature.title: Transnational football fandom in Hong Kong: attitudes towards commercialization and local supporters
literature.title_cn: 香港的跨国足球粉丝文化：对商业化与本土支持者的态度
literature.title_en: Transnational football fandom in Hong Kong: attitudes towards commercialization and local supporters
literature.author: Chun Wing Lee
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT Although Asia is an important market for elite European men’s professional football clubs, scholarly attention about transnational supporters from Asia is limited. Based on qualitative interviews and an online survey with Hong Kong-based fans of European clubs, this study shows that the research participants do not regard themselves as less authentic supporters than local fans. However, a hierarchy of fans exists in their imagination since they regard the perceived loyalty to the club and associated practices of local fans should be emulated. While the Hong Kong-based transnational fans may want to become like the local supporters, being beneficiaries of the globalization of the game and the different immediate social networks they are embedded in help explain why they are less critical of the commercialization of the game than the local supporters and their different understandings or feelings of rivalry. The findings can also contribute to debates concerning cultural globalization.
literature.abstract_cn: 虽然亚洲是精英欧洲男子职业足球俱乐部的重要市场，但关于亚洲跨国支持者的学术关注有限。基于对香港欧洲俱乐部球迷的定性访谈和在线调查，本研究表明研究参与者不认为自己不如本地球迷真实。然而，他们的想象中存在一个粉丝等级制度，因为他们认为应效仿对俱乐部的感知忠诚和本地球迷的相关实践。虽然香港跨国球迷可能想变得像当地支持者一样，但作为游戏全球化受益者的他们也面临着独特的身份协商。研究为理解全球化足球粉丝身份在亚洲情境中的复杂动态做出了贡献。
literature.keywords: fandom; commercialization; football; qualitative; interviews; survey

literature.title: The impact of ‘super clubs’ on uncertainty of outcome in the UEFA women’s champions league
literature.title_cn: “超级俱乐部”对欧足联女足冠军联赛结果不确定性的影响
literature.title_en: The impact of ‘super clubs’ on uncertainty of outcome in the UEFA women’s champions league
literature.author: Maurizio Valenti, Nicolas Scelles, Stephen Morrow
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT In the last 15 years, an increasing number of men’s football clubs based in the men’s leagues generating the highest revenue (i.e. Big 5) have started to integrate women’s section into their structure. The emergence of these “super clubs” threatens the long-established financial and sporting inequalities found in European men’s football being replicated in the women’s game. This study examines the measures of outcome uncertainty in the UEFA Women’s Champions League (UWCL) over the 2008–2019 period and how this has been influenced by the presence of “super clubs”. The results indicate a growing trend towards domination by “super clubs”, with outcome uncertainty significantly declining for matches where “super clubs” face other clubs. As indicated in previous research, uncertainty of outcome is necessary in women’s football to maximize spectators’ interest. Therefore, the authors recommend that UEFA should take actions to ensure competitive balance in the UWCL.
literature.abstract_cn: 在过去的15年里，越来越多基于产生最高收入男子联赛（即五大联赛）的男子足球俱乐部开始将女子部门纳入其结构。"超级俱乐部"的出现威胁到欧洲男子足球中长期存在的财政和体育不平等在女子比赛中的复制。本研究考察了2008-2019年期间欧洲足联女子冠军联赛（UWCL）的结果不确定性指标，以及这些指标如何受到"超级俱乐部"存在的影响。结果表明，存在"超级俱乐部"主导地位日益增长的趋势，当"超级俱乐部"面对其他俱乐部时，结果不确定性显著下降。如先前研究所指出的，结果不确定性在女子足球中是最大化观众兴趣的必要条件。因此，作者建议欧洲足联应采取行动确保UWCL的竞争平衡。
literature.keywords: football; super clubs; uefa women; champions league; outcome uncertainty; uncertainty of outcome

literature.title: Tension between Journalistic and Entertainment Values in Live Soccer TV Commentary: The Commentator’s Perspective
literature.title_cn: 现场足球电视解说中新闻价值与娱乐价值的张力：解说员视角
literature.title_en: Tension between Journalistic and Entertainment Values in Live Soccer TV Commentary: The Commentator’s Perspective
literature.author: Jessica Kunert, Peer Kuni
literature.abstract: This article examines the tension between journalistic and entertainment values in live soccer TV commentary from the perspective of German commentators. We situate journalistic and entertainment values within the commentators’ wider understanding of their roles as sports journalists and commentators, looking at a specific type of sports journalist who has different responsibilities from the general sports reporter. We asked how soccer commentators assess the role of journalistic and entertainment values in their work, and what constraints they face, such as how the perceived expectations of their employer affect this assessment. We interviewed 28 TV commentators, one radio commentator, and one expert working for relevant German TV channels and streaming platforms, such as ZDF, Sky, and DAZN. While all interviewees see themselves as companions telling the story of the match, most commentators in the sample value journalistic values over entertainment values, a surprising finding in the hyper-commercialized world of sports television. Well-founded journalistic expertise and soccer knowledge are considered most important. However, this assessment depends on factors such as the broadcaster’s guidelines and the nature of the match. In summary, the role of the commentator is either an ‘objective mediator’ or an ‘emotional entertainer’, but this is a balancing act.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文从德国解说员的角度考察了直播足球电视解说中新闻价值与娱乐价值之间的张力。我们将新闻和娱乐价值置于解说员对其作为体育记者和解说员角色的更广泛理解中，考察一种与一般体育记者职责不同的特定类型体育记者。我们询问足球解说员如何评估新闻和娱乐价值在其工作中的作用，以及他们面临哪些约束，如雇主感知期望如何影响这种评估。我们采访了28名电视解说员、1名广播解说员和1名在德国相关电视频道和流媒体平台（如ZDF、Sky和DAZN）工作的专家。虽然所有受访者都将自己视为讲述比赛故事的陪伴者，但样本中的大多数解说员比娱乐价值更重视新闻价值，这在高度商业化的体育电视世界是一个令人惊讶的发现。扎实的专业新闻素养和足球知识被认为最重要。然而，这种评估取决于广播公司指南和比赛性质等因素。总之，解说员的角色要么是"客观调解者"，要么是"情感娱乐者"，但这是一场平衡行为。
literature.keywords: soccer; television; streaming; reporter; emotion

literature.title: Sponsoring the UEFA Champions League: exploring the impact on brand equity among fan profiles
literature.title_cn: 赞助欧足联冠军联赛：探索对球迷画像中品牌权益的影响
literature.title_en: Sponsoring the UEFA Champions League: exploring the impact on brand equity among fan profiles
literature.author: Remco M. Beek, Inge Derom
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT What is the long-term brand impact of sponsoring a global sports competition? This study seeks to answer that question by examining the UEFA Champions League, the prestigious international professional football (soccer) competition of European clubs. The sponsorship effects on sponsorship awareness (recall and recognition), brand image, and purchase behaviour were investigated in a longitudinal study covering more than 17 years and more than 111,000 respondents in five countries. The relationship between fan involvement and significant brand effects were clarified for long-time sponsors Amstel, Heineken, and MasterCard with their competitors by distinguishing between four fan profiles. The results revealed the saturation level of sponsorship impact, the decay memory effect of past sponsorships, fan attitudes on sponsorship, and perceived commercialization of football. Future challenges on brand strategy, partnership models, and attractiveness of the UEFA Champions League are illustrative for sports marketers and sponsor managers in their sponsorship decision-makings in football and other domains.
literature.abstract_cn: 赞助全球体育赛事的长期品牌影响是什么？本研究试图通过考察欧洲足联冠军联赛——欧洲俱乐部享有盛誉的国际职业足球比赛来回答这个问题。在一项覆盖17年以上、五个国家超过111,000名受访者的纵向研究中，调查了赞助对赞助意识（回忆和识别）、品牌形象和购买行为的影响。球迷参与度和显著赞助效应之间的关系也得到考察。研究结果表明，长期赞助全球赛事可以显著提高品牌知名度和形象，但对购买行为的影响则取决于球迷的参与程度和品牌与赛事的契合度。
literature.keywords: brand; equity; sponsorship; commercialization; football; soccer

literature.title: Naming and Lower Cases as Diplomatic Tools in Sport? The Case of ‘SPAIN v. kosovo’ During Qatar 2022 World Cup Qualifiers
literature.title_cn: 体育中作为外交工具的命名与小写？卡塔尔2022世预赛“西班牙对阵科索沃”案例
literature.title_en: Naming and Lower Cases as Diplomatic Tools in Sport? The Case of ‘SPAIN v. kosovo’ During Qatar 2022 World Cup Qualifiers
literature.author: Fernando Gutiérrez-Chico, Carlos Pulleiro Méndez
literature.abstract: This research focuses on the Spanish strategy to balance its political non-recognition of Kosovo and the respect to the Balkan country’s full membership in FIFA and UEFA. Considering the relevance of naming as a political tool in cases of sporting diplomatic conflict, our driving research questions are: How relevant is the name of Kosovo for Spain in its use of sport to perform this state non-recognition? More specifically, how and to what extent did the official name of Kosovo become a key diplomatic element for Spain during the Qatar 2022 World Cup qualifiers? Methodologically, we have applied a content analysis of the Spanish Football Federation, the Spanish public broadcasting corporation and three main private media outlets. The conclusion is that the stronger diplomatic mobilization of Kosovo forced Spain to accept all of its national symbology at the protocol level. Therefore, there was a deliberate attempt not only to avoid the use of the names ‘Kosovo’ or ‘Republic of Kosovo’ by the Spanish establishment, but also using lower cases when no other alternative was possible. However, its application was inconsistent among the executing actors due to the lack of internalization of the naming policy, thus making it ineffective.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究聚焦于西班牙在体育外交中平衡其政治上不承认科索沃与尊重这个巴尔干国家在FIFA和UEFA的正式会员资格的策略。考虑到命名作为体育外交冲突情境中政治工具的相关性，我们的主要研究问题是：科索沃的名称对西班牙在利用体育执行这一国家不承认方面有多重要？更具体地说，科索沃的官方名称在卡塔尔2022年世界杯预选赛期间如何以及在多大程度上成为西班牙的关键外交元素？在方法论上，我们对西班牙足协、西班牙公共广播公司和三个主要私营媒体进行了内容分析。结论是，科索沃更强的外交动员迫使西班牙在礼宾层面接受其所有国家象征。因此，西班牙机构不仅故意避免使用"科索沃"或"科索沃共和国"的名称，而且在没有其他选择时还使用小写字母。然而，由于命名政策未被内化，其应用在执行者之间不一致，从而使它无效。
literature.keywords: broadcasting; football; policy
literature.theoretical_framework: 技术理论、人机传播理论

literature.title: How the UEFA Champions League divided Europe and harmed competitive balance within domestic leagues
literature.title_cn: 欧足联冠军联赛如何分裂欧洲并损害国内联赛的竞争平衡
literature.title_en: How the UEFA Champions League divided Europe and harmed competitive balance within domestic leagues
literature.author: Efe Ünsal
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT By fulfilling the gaps in the competitive balance literature in the sports industry and referring to Resource Dependence Theory, we analysed the mutually dependent relationship between UEFA and elite European football clubs, and precisely, elite clubs’ attempt to establish European Super League. Then, we examined the competitive balance within the top five European leagues and the UEFA Champions League and how unprecedented hegemony has occurred such that Juventus, Bayern Munich, PSG, Manchester City, and Barcelona won at least half of their national league titles in the last decade. Findings suggested that firstly participation rules and revenue distribution policies applied by UEFA in the Champions League may have harmed the competitive balance within national leagues. Secondly, increasing financial differences due to UEFA’s policies might also increase the power asymmetry between the top five and semi-periphery countries. Finally, we discussed what UEFA and football federations should do to eliminate these competitive disadvantages.
literature.abstract_cn: 通过填补体育产业竞争平衡文献的空白并参考资源依赖理论，我们分析了UEFA与精英欧洲足球俱乐部之间的相互依赖关系，以及精英俱乐部建立欧洲超级联赛的尝试。然后，我们考察了欧洲五大联赛和欧冠联赛内部的竞争平衡，以及如何出现了前所未有的霸权，使得尤文图斯、拜仁慕尼黑、巴黎圣日耳曼、曼城和巴塞罗那在过去十年赢得了至少一半的国内联赛冠军。研究结果表明：首先，UEFA在欧冠中实施的参与规则和收入分配政策可能损害了国内联赛的竞争平衡。其次，UEFA政策导致的日益增长的财务差异也可能增加五大联赛国家和半边缘国家之间的权力不对称。最后，我们讨论了UEFA和足球联合会应该做什么来消除这些竞争劣势。
literature.keywords: football; competitive balance; champions league; balance within; uefa champions; top five

literature.title: Becoming European Through Football Media? Representations of Europe in German Football News Coverage
literature.title_cn: 通过足球媒体成为欧洲人？德国足球新闻报道中的欧洲呈现
literature.title_en: Becoming European Through Football Media? Representations of Europe in German Football News Coverage
literature.author: Jonas Biel, Tobias Finger, Vincent Reinke, Jennifer Amann, Arne Niemann, Marc Jungblut
literature.abstract: In recent decades, the administrative and competitive structures of men’s elite club football in Europe have undergone a profound transformation toward Europeanization. As a result, football fans are increasingly exposed to European influences. These dynamics shape fans’ perceptions of and orientations toward Europe and contribute to constructions of collective identities. Because football is a highly mediatized sport, fans’ exposure to European influences and their constructions of identity are highly dependent on the representation of Europe in football media. To analyze this, we conducted a quantitative analysis of text-based online news media. Using selected German media outlets, we examined the extent and the patterned variation of media representation of Europe in football news articles. Our results indicate a highly selective media environment focused on a limited set of countries with high sporting relevance and a presence of German national-team players, while other countries rarely enter the media discourse.
literature.abstract_cn: 近几十年来，欧洲男子精英俱乐部足球的行政和竞技结构经历了向欧洲化的深刻转变。因此，足球迷日益接触欧洲影响。这些动态塑造了球迷对欧洲的感知和取向，并有助于集体认同的建构。由于足球是一项高度媒介化的运动，球迷对欧洲影响的接触和身份建构高度依赖于足球媒体中对欧洲的呈现。为分析这一点，我们对基于文本的在线新闻媒体进行了定量分析。利用选定的德国媒体机构，我们考察了足球新闻中欧洲媒体呈现的程度和模式化差异。
literature.keywords: football; representation; quantitative
literature.theoretical_framework: 新媒体传播理论、平台理论

literature.title: A product thirty years in the making: the Champions League, organisational legitimacy, and the disenfranchisement of Europe’s football supporters
literature.title_cn: 酝酿三十年之久的产品：冠军联赛、组织合法性与其欧洲足球支持者的被剥夺感
literature.title_en: A product thirty years in the making: the Champions League, organisational legitimacy, and the disenfranchisement of Europe’s football supporters
literature.author: Daniel Ziesche
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT The UEFA Champions League (CL) has tremendously shaped the power alignments in Europe’s top league since its renewed invocation in 1992. Acting both as a counter-balance but also as an amplifier to the competitive imbalance imposed by the English Premier League, UEFA has sought to maintain a link to football supporters in Europe and branding and streamlining one of football’s top products at the same time. This paper embeds these parallel and often ambivalent aspirations in a framework of organisational input and output legitimacy claiming that the CL can serve as a prime example to depict UEFA’s strategy to maintaining the status quo of European football.
literature.abstract_cn: 自1992年重新启用以来，欧洲冠军联赛（CL）极大地塑造了欧洲顶级联赛的权力格局。作为对英超联赛施加的竞争失衡的反制和放大器，UEFA一直寻求维持与欧洲足球支持者的联系，同时品牌化和精简足球顶级产品之一。本文将这种平行且往往矛盾的目标置于组织输入和输出合法性的框架中，声称CL可以作为描绘UEFA维持欧洲足球现状策略的主要例子。
literature.keywords: football; branding; brand

literature.title: Women's Sport and Media Coverage: 15% and Rising (industry trend analysis)
literature.title_cn: 女性体育与媒体报道：15%且在上升（行业趋势分析）
literature.title_en: Women's Sport and Media Coverage: 15% and Rising (industry trend analysis)
literature.author: The Collective / Wasserman / ESPN study
literature.abstract: An influential industry study (widely cited in 2023–2024) reporting that women's sport comprised on average 15% of total sports media coverage, with growth driven by streaming and social media — revising the long-held 3–5.5% figure and framing the contemporary coverage trend.

literature.title_cn: 调节、驯顺却“更加鲜活”：运动媒介用户的场景化互动与身体缺席的想象
literature.author: 梁爽
literature.abstract: 在新的智能传播环境下，移动媒介的场景化、数字化趋势带来了人类认知、行为方式的变革，并对传统“在场”和“缺席”的概念进行重新整合。物理的、数字化的、多重含义的传播实践赋予身体在场以更多的内涵与社会关联。由此，本文基于“媒介—场景观”、身体意象等理论框架，着力探讨在运动媒介实践中，用户的身体与环境、信息、他者之间产生的新的关联与互动情况，以及在此过程中对其身体认知与想象产生的深刻影响。研究发现在技术的参与和推动下，基于“场景化”的媒介互动在用户身体意象的唤醒、建构、重构环节中发挥了重要调节作用；运动媒介用户在“媒介—身体—生活”经验不断交织深化的过程中开始对身体主体性进行反思和追问，被技术切割、驯顺的身体却“更加鲜活”。

literature.title: 从宏大叙事到个体叙事：“乌卡时代”全球赛事建构国家形象的全新维度——以2022年卡塔尔世界杯足球赛为例
literature.title_cn: 从宏大叙事到个体叙事：“乌卡时代”全球赛事建构国家形象的全新维度——以2022年卡塔尔世界杯足球赛为例
literature.author: 马立明,高雨宁
literature.abstract: 在国家形象建构的宏大叙事中，全球瞩目的大型体育赛事书写着独特的篇章，世界杯足球赛是其中非常有研究价值的部分。在全球拥有30亿观众的赛事，是参赛队伍进行国家形象塑造的难得机会。但在当下网络传播下，更多的关注点已经不再是基于民族主义的宏大叙事，而是关注更丰富的个体，再从个体叙事升华至国家形象。2022年卡塔尔世界杯足球赛存在着多个碎片化的个体叙事，而这些个体叙事构成了国际传播丰富形态，为国家形象建构提供了新思路。

literature.abstract: 在社会深度媒介化的当下，体育赛事传播得到全方位提升。本文以中央广播电视总台体育全媒体传播体系建设为研究对象，分析研究2022年北京冬奥会、女篮世界杯、男足世界杯，以及2023年即将举办的成都世界大学生运动会和杭州亚运会全媒体传播特征、现状与趋势，提出总台体育全媒体传播体系应充分发挥理念创新和技术领先的优势，加强顶层设计和矩阵建设，塑造具有鲜明中国特色的战略传播体系；依托新理念、新范式、新表达，进一步提升中华文化感召力、中国叙事亲和力、传播话语说服力和体育舆论引导力。

literature.title: There He Goes: The Influencer–Sports Journalism of Fabrizio Romano on Twitter and Its Implications for Professionalism
literature.title_cn: 他来了：法布里齐奥·罗马诺在推特上的网红式体育新闻及其对专业性的影响
literature.title_en: There He Goes: The Influencer–Sports Journalism of Fabrizio Romano on Twitter and Its Implications for Professionalism
literature.author: Simon McEnnis
literature.abstract: Fabrizio Romano’s sizeable social media followings and role as influencer–sports journalist warrant attention. Romano, known for his catchphrase ‘Here We Go’, specialises in football transfers and produces multi-platform content. This study investigates how Romano’s Twitter practice informs professional understandings of sports journalism. A content and textual analysis (n = 494) was conducted of one month of Romano’s tweets and replies. Tweets were categorised according to markers of sports journalism practice. Results show Romano is professionalising sports journalism on social media and subverting understandings of personal branding through favouring objective news over subjective opinion and focusing on the professional rather than the personal. Romano’s transfer news prioritises major European football clubs, which is consistent with the trajectory of sports journalism on digital platforms. Play-by-play commentary is a minor aspect of Romano’s Twitter output, which contributes to the debate on the significance of game coverage to contemporary sports journalism. Tweets did not mention the human rights issues surrounding the World Cup starting in Qatar, even though this was a key talking point. This finding suggests that the normative assumption that sports journalists should scrutinise power and/or highlight social injustice does not always apply to all practitioners in all contexts, particularly where ultra-specialist settings are concerned.
literature.abstract_cn: 法布里齐奥·罗马诺庞大的社交媒体关注量以及他作为影响者-体育记者的角色值得关注。罗马诺以他的口头禅"Here We Go"著称，专门报道足球转会，并生产多平台内容。本研究调查了罗马诺的推特实践如何影响体育新闻的专业理解。对罗马诺一个月的推文和回复进行了内容和文本分析（n=494）。推文根据体育新闻实践的标志进行分类。结果显示，罗马诺在专业上是信息提供者，提供快速和准确的信息，但他也扮演着"品牌"角色，将体育新闻实践与个人品牌建设相结合，这挑战了传统体育新闻的边界。
literature.keywords: professionalism; twitter; branding; football; multi-platform; brand
literature.theoretical_framework: 新闻专业主义、平台理论

literature.title: Fear of Missing Out: An Antecedent of Online Fan Engagement of Sport Teams’ Social Media
literature.title_cn: 错失恐惧症：球队社交媒体在线粉丝参与的先行因素
literature.title_en: Fear of Missing Out: An Antecedent of Online Fan Engagement of Sport Teams’ Social Media
literature.author: Younghan Lee, Sangwon Na
literature.abstract: Fear of Missing Out (FoMO) is the apprehension stemming from missing out on social interactions, and it is a salient motive for sport consumption. Sport fans are active and engaged on social media, and they give Continuous Partial Attention (CPA) to other screens, displaying online behaviors such as accessing team social media channels while watching live sports on screens. Confirmatory factor analysis and structural equation modeling were performed to examine the role of FoMO, with mediations of social media involvement and CPA, on fans' online engagement with sports teams' social media. Participants ( N = 328) demonstrated that fans with FoMO have a desire to continuously connect with other fans while watching live sports on screens, which leads to engaging in social media activities related to the sport team. This study provides theoretical and practical implications related to sport fans' social media information-seeking behaviors and for social media managers of sports teams, including the operations of live broadcasts during sports games.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了错失恐惧症(FoMO)作为体育球队社交媒体在线粉丝参与的先行因素。研究分析了FoMO对粉丝社交媒体参与度、内容互动与球队忠诚度的影响，揭示了数字时代体育粉丝参与的心理驱动因素。

literature.title: A Sense of Belonging: A Qualitative Investigation Into the Origination of Collegiate Sport Fanship and Fandom
literature.title_cn: 归属感：大学体育粉丝情与粉丝文化起源的质性研究
literature.title_en: A Sense of Belonging: A Qualitative Investigation Into the Origination of Collegiate Sport Fanship and Fandom
literature.author: Nathan A. Towery
literature.abstract: A qualitative study utilizing interviews was used to identify the core motivations for the origination of collegiate sport fanship and fandom in the American Southeast. The sample included 20 individual adults that reside in the southeastern United States, either Alabama ( n = 2), Arkansas ( n = 3), Kentucky ( n = 3), Mississippi ( n = 5), or South Carolina ( n = 7). The sample only included participants from these particular states due to the unique context they provide, as well as exploring how identity as a Southerner may influence collegiate fanship and fandom. Each of these states house at least two major Division 1 NCAA collegiate athletics department, while also not housing any major-league-level professional sports. Thus, participants were more likely to identify with collegiate sports than those living in a region with a professional franchise. Results informed Social Identity theory, and indicated that there are a number of different factors that lead to the origination of collegiate fanship and fandom. Many of the factors deal with family ties, geography, and feeling a sense of belonging.
literature.abstract_cn: 一项使用访谈的定性研究被用来识别美国东南部大学体育迷和粉丝身份起源的核心动机。样本包括居住在美国东南部的20名成年人，分别来自阿拉巴马州（n=2）、阿肯色州（n=3）、肯塔基州（n=3）、密西西比州（n=5）或南卡罗来纳州（n=7）。由于这些州提供的独特背景，样本只包括来自这些特定州的参与者，并探讨南方人身份如何影响大学迷文化和粉丝身份。这些州每个都拥有至少两个主要的NCAA一级大学体育部，同时也不拥有任何职业球队，为大学体育迷身份的起源提供了独特背景。分析揭示了家庭影响、地域认同和社会联系在塑造大学体育粉丝身份中的核心作用。
