literature.title: The geopolitics of the European super league: A historiographical approach and a media analysis of the failed project in 2021
literature.title_cn: 欧洲超级联赛的地缘政治：2021年失败项目的历史学方法与媒体分析
literature.title_en: The geopolitics of the European super league: A historiographical approach and a media analysis of the failed project in 2021
literature.author: Xavier Ginesta, Carles Viñas
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: IntroductionThe main objective of this article is to analyse the reasons why the 2021 European Super League project failed. The authors ask whether, in addition to the popular clamour against a semi-closed competition, it was the combination of geopolitical interests of the different actors currently involved in European elite football that prevented the project from going ahead.MethodsThe main methodological framework is based on a case study, which follows an Stakian approach. To do so, on the one hand, a historiographical analysis of the case has been done; on the other hand, authors have complemented this case study with an analysis of 23 pieces of news published on the website of five mainstream newspapers (from April to June 2021) from those countries with the most significant European football leagues: The United Kingdom (The Guardian), Spain (El País), France (Le Monde), Italy (La Repubblica) and Germany (Der Spiegel). To supplement the analysis of this phenomenon, authors have also considered other relevant news published in other mainstream press or news agencies (such as The New York Times, Politico, The Yorkshire Post, The Times, Marca, Bloomberg and Reuters).Results and DiscussionThe authors conclude that, while financially the Super League debate has not been closed, in defending the current business and competition model of European football, UEFA has had the complicity of owners and shareholders of the founding clubs outside of their traditional historical roots, as well as governments that have made football an asset because of their geopolitical positioning, such as Qatar and the UK post-Brexit.
literature.abstract_cn: 引言：本文的主要目标是分析2021年欧洲超级联赛项目失败的原因。作者追问，除了公众对半封闭赛事的强烈反对之外，是否正是目前参与欧洲精英足球的各行动者地缘政治利益的组合，阻止了该项目的推进。方法：主要方法论框架基于案例研究，遵循Stakian方法。为此，一方面对该案例进行了历史编纂学分析；另一方面，作者以……补充了该案例。
literature.keywords: football; super league; european super; news published; european football; historiographical approach

literature.title: “Let’s Draw a Line between Dos and Don’ts”: Pakistani Journalists’ Perspectives about the Ethics of Conflict-Sensitive Reporting
literature.title_cn: “让我们划清可为与不可为的界限”：巴基斯坦记者对冲突敏感性报道伦理的看法
literature.title_en: “Let’s Draw a Line between Dos and Don’ts”: Pakistani Journalists’ Perspectives about the Ethics of Conflict-Sensitive Reporting
literature.author: Sadia Jamil, Gifty Appiah-Adjei
literature.abstract: In conflict-ridden countries, the news media has a pivotal role to perform as an active advocate of human rights and societal peace, as well as a facilitator of conflict mitigation and resolution through the gathering and dissemination of non-partisan information. While today the world witness armed conflicts in more forms than ever before, some countries are more sensitive to conflict and violence—such as Pakistan. The country is recognized as one of the riskiest places for working journalists by virtue of recurrent political, ethnic, and religious conflicts. The Pakistani journalists work in a climate of fear and risks and with opposing groups seeking to influence the news media, which creates more difficulties for them to report unbiased and accurate news to the public. The practice of ethics has become more challenging for the Pakistani journalists because the country lacks an effective and standardized code of conduct to report on conflict. Therefore, drawing on the theory of the conflict triangle by Galtung, this study seeks the Pakistani journalists’ perspectives about the ethics of conflict sensitive reporting. In doing so, this study uses the quantitative method of survey and the qualitative method of in-depth interviews. The study uses descriptive analysis to present the survey findings in the form of percentage and thematic analysis to present the findings of interview data.
literature.abstract_cn: 在冲突频发的国家，新闻媒体在作为人权和社会和平的积极倡导者，以及通过收集和传播不偏不倚的信息来促进冲突缓解与化解方面，扮演着关键角色。虽然当今世界以比以往任何时候更多的形式目睹武装冲突，但一些国家对冲突和暴力更为敏感——例如巴基斯坦。由于反复发生的政治、种族和宗教冲突，该国被公认为对从业记者而言最危险的地区之一。巴基斯坦记者在恐惧和风险的环境中工作，对立的团体试图影响新闻媒体，这使他们更难以向公众报道客观准确的新闻。冲突敏感报道的实践……
literature.keywords: ethics; qualitative; quantitative; interviews; survey; partisan

literature.title: Consumer Trust in AI–Human News Collaborative Continuum: Preferences and Influencing Factors by News Production Phases
literature.title_cn: AI与人类新闻协作连续体中的消费者信任：按新闻生产阶段的偏好与影响因素
literature.title_en: Consumer Trust in AI–Human News Collaborative Continuum: Preferences and Influencing Factors by News Production Phases
literature.author: Steffen Heim, Sylvia Chan-Olmsted
literature.abstract: AI has become increasingly relevant to the media sector, especially for news media companies considering the integration of this technology into their production processes. While the application of AI promises productivity gains, the impact on consumers’ perceptions of the resulting news and the level of AI integration accepted by the market has not been well studied. Our research focused on the analysis of news consumers’ preferred level of AI integration, AI news trust, and AI news usage intentions linked to the application of the technology in the discovery/information-gathering and writing/editing phases. By connecting a comprehensive set of factors influencing the perception of news and AI, we approached this gap through structural equation modeling, presenting an overview of consumers’ responses to AI integration into news production processes. Our research showed that while participants generally prefer lower levels of AI integration into both phases of production, news trust and usage intention can even increase as AI enters the production process—as long as humans remain in the lead. These findings provide researchers and news media managers with a first overview of consumers’ responses to news production augmentation and its implications for news perception in the market.
literature.abstract_cn: 人工智能对媒体行业越来越重要，尤其是对考虑将这项技术整合到生产流程中的新闻媒体公司而言。虽然AI的应用承诺提高生产力，但其对消费者感知所产生新闻的影响，以及市场接受的AI整合程度，尚未得到充分研究。我们的研究聚焦于分析新闻消费者偏好的AI整合水平、AI新闻信任以及与技术在发现/信息收集和写作/编辑阶段应用相关的AI新闻使用意图。通过连接影响新闻和AI感知的一整套因素，我们通过结构方程模型来填补这一空白。
literature.keywords: trust; ai integration; news production; news media; production processes; ai news
literature.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、产业组织理论

literature.title: Parenting on Celebrities’ and Influencers’ Social Media: Revamping Traditional Gender Portrayals
literature.title_cn: 名人与影响者社交媒体上的育儿：重塑传统性别呈现
literature.title_en: Parenting on Celebrities’ and Influencers’ Social Media: Revamping Traditional Gender Portrayals
literature.author: Ana Jorge, Bibiana Garcez, Bárbara Janiques de Carvalho, Ana Margarida Coelho
literature.abstract: This study consisted of a content analysis of parenting portrayals in the 40 most popular Portuguese male and female content producers on YouTube and Instagram, on a sample of content published in 2019. Female creators give disproportionately greater attention to parenting and are the ones depicting everyday labor related to it, whereas male creators show themselves as fathers in happy and fun moments. By way of their popularity and visibility on social media platforms, and as supported by the social media platforms and advertising realms, celebrities and influencers are amplifying the traditional division of parenting labor through the mechanisms of a postfeminist, hyper-individualistic discourse emphasized by female influencers and celebrities, and of humoristic content that confirms gender stereotypes without social punishment, deployed by entertainment personalities, both male and female.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究对葡萄牙最受欢迎的40位男女内容创作者在YouTube和Instagram上的育儿呈现进行了内容分析，样本为2019年发布的内容。女性创作者给予育儿不成比例的更多关注，并且是描绘与之相关的日常劳动的人，而男性创作者在快乐和有趣的时刻展示自己作为父亲的角色。凭借她们在社交媒体平台上的受欢迎程度和可见性，以及社交媒体平台和广告领域的支持，名人和网红正在通过以下机制放大传统的育儿劳动分工：女网红和名人所强调的后女权主义、超个人主义话语，以及娱乐名人（无论男女）部署的确认性别刻板印象而不受社会惩罚的幽默内容。
literature.keywords: gender; advertising; instagram; youtube; stereotype; labor

literature.title: European Public Service Media, Disability Sports and Cultural Citizenship in the Digital Age: An Analysis of Agenda Diversity in the Tokyo 2020 Paralympic Games
literature.title_cn: 欧洲公共服务媒体、残疾人体育与数字时代的文化公民身份：东京2020残奥会议程多样性分析
literature.title_en: European Public Service Media, Disability Sports and Cultural Citizenship in the Digital Age: An Analysis of Agenda Diversity in the Tokyo 2020 Paralympic Games
literature.author: Xavier Ramon, José Luis Rojas-Torrijos
literature.abstract: In the current cross-media ecosystem, which is characterized by technological disruption, the prominent relationship between public service media (PSM), sport and cultural citizenship is undergoing a profound transformation. Currently, PSM can utilize its myriad platforms, channels and services to transcend the constraints of linear broadcasting, find new ways of advancing diversity and overcome the perception of disability sport as a media ‘blind spot’. Through content analysis, the objective of this research has been to examine the agenda diversity on Twitter offered during the timeframe of the Tokyo 2020 Paralympic Games by 15 PSM corporations in Europe. This comparative analysis of 6072 tweets demonstrated the uneven attention devoted by European PSM to the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics. In the aggregate, 39.42% (n = 2398) of the messages focused on the event, although significant imbalances can be observed among the different media organizations, both in terms of the volume of coverage and the attention given to the various Paralympic disciplines and protagonists. From a theoretical perspective, the article adds to the existing literature on the nexus between media, sport and cultural citizenship, signaling the need for PSM to reimagine its social media strategies to counteract the limited visibility of different societal groups and to adequately contribute to enhancing cultural citizenship in the digital age. The results can also inform media practitioners. Despite that the conditioning factors and trade-offs linked to the commercial nature of social networking sites cannot be overlooked, PSM should take into account the importance of promoting inclusion and observe audiences’ increasing interest in disability sport.
literature.abstract_cn: 在当前以技术颠覆为特征的跨媒体生态系统中，公共服务媒体（PSM）、体育与文化公民身份之间的显著关系正在经历深刻转变。目前，PSM可以利用其众多平台、渠道和服务来超越线性广播的限制，找到推进多样性的新方法，并克服将残障体育视为媒体"盲点"的观念。通过内容分析，本研究旨在考察欧洲15家PSM公司在东京2020残奥会期间在推特上提供的议程多样性。这项对6,072条推特的比较分析显示了不同PSM对残障体育关注的差异。
literature.keywords: diversity; disability; paralympic; audience; broadcasting; twitter
literature.theoretical_framework: 平台理论、受众研究理论

literature.title: Sports Organizations and Their Defensive Mediatization Strategies: The Sports Journalist’s Perspective
literature.title_cn: 体育组织及其防御性媒介化策略：体育记者的视角
literature.title_en: Sports Organizations and Their Defensive Mediatization Strategies: The Sports Journalist’s Perspective
literature.author: Neil O’Boyle, Aaron Gallagher
literature.abstract: This article provides empirical evidence of ‘defensive mediatization strategies’ in the field of sport. These are strategies used by actors individually and collectively to control and sometimes avoid media publicity—for example, by refusing requests for media interviews, or in the case of an organization, by making media literacy training available to its staff. In this article, we use the concept of defensive mediatization strategies to identify and illuminate some of the challenges facing professional sports journalists in the postbroadcast era. The article draws on findings from an ongoing study of the relationships between professional sports organizations, athletes, and journalists, but reports only on interviews conducted with experienced sports journalists in Ireland and Britain (n = 16). Our analysis identifies a number of defensive mediatization strategies used by sports organizations, including increased levels of in-house media, differential treatment of journalists, and an increasingly competitive stance towards journalism generally. We also consider a potentially more pernicious strategy: the hiring of professional sports journalists as internal communications advisers—a switching of role positions that might be termed ‘poacher turned gamekeeper’. The article organizes findings according to the three categories of defensive mediatization strategies identified in the extant literature (persistence, shielding, and immunization) and proposes a fourth category, which we label steering.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文提供了体育领域"防御性媒介化策略"的实证证据。这些策略是行为者个人和集体用来控制和有时避免媒体曝光的策略——例如，拒绝媒体采访请求，或就组织而言，为其员工提供媒介素养培训。在本文中，我们使用防御性媒介化策略的概念来识别和阐明后广播时代职业体育记者面临的一些挑战。本文借鉴了一项关于职业体育组织、运动员和记者之间关系的持续研究结果，但只报告了对爱尔兰和英国经验丰富的体育记者（n=16）的访谈。我们的分析识别了体育组织使用的多种防御性媒介化策略，包括内部媒体水平的提升、对记者的区别对待，以及对新闻业日益竞争的立场。我们还考虑了一种可能更具危害性的策略：聘用职业体育记者担任内部传播顾问——这种角色转换可称为"猎场看守人变成了偷猎者"。本文根据现有文献中识别的三类防御性媒介化策略（坚持、屏蔽和免疫）来组织研究发现，并提出第四类，我们称之为"引导"。
literature.keywords: interviews; athlete

literature.title: Social Media Publishing Strategies of German Newspapers: Content Analysis of Sports Reporting on Social Networks by German Newspapers—Results of the 2021 Social Media International Sports Press Survey
literature.title_cn: 德国报纸的社交媒体发布策略：德国报纸社交网络体育报道的内容分析——2021年社交媒体国际体育新闻调查结果
literature.title_en: Social Media Publishing Strategies of German Newspapers: Content Analysis of Sports Reporting on Social Networks by German Newspapers—Results of the 2021 Social Media International Sports Press Survey
literature.author: Christof Seeger, Thomas Horky, Jörg-Uwe Nieland, Peter English
literature.abstract: Newspaper sports departments in Germany are reacting to changes in social media by expanding their offerings and employing a variety of publishing and engagement strategies. In this constantly evolving media environment, it is important to understand how newsrooms utilize social media to inform their audiences. This study examines the approaches German newspapers apply to publishing sports content on social media, and outlines how users interact with these posts. In analyzing these aspects, this paper applies theoretical elements of agenda setting and audience engagement, gender in media, and quality and diversity of published content. Social media posts were examined across eight German publications, totaling 3633 posts from Twitter and Facebook. Results in the study, which is part of the global 2021 Social Media International Sports Press Survey, highlighted how most of the content published by German newspapers on social media aimed to redirect users to the publications’ websites. The findings also reflect how social media is used less as an editorial space and more as part of a campaign to increase the audience. These results demonstrate challenges for the quality of sports coverage distributed via social networks in Germany.
literature.abstract_cn: 德国的报纸体育部门正在应对社交媒体的变化，通过扩展服务并采用各种发布和参与策略来应对。在这个不断演变的媒体环境中，了解新闻编辑室如何利用社交媒体向受众传递信息至关重要。本研究考察了德国报纸在社交媒体上发布体育内容的方式，并概述了用户如何与这些帖子互动。在分析中，本文运用了议程设置和受众参与、媒体中的性别，以及所发布内容的质量和多样性等理论元素。研究考察了八家德国出版机构的社交媒体帖子，总计来自推特和脸书的3633条帖子。该研究是全球"2021年社交媒体国际体育新闻调查"的一部分，结果显示德国报纸在社交媒体上发布的大部分内容旨在将用户重定向到出版机构的网站。研究还反映出社交媒体更多地被用作增加受众的宣传活动而非编辑空间。这些结果显示了德国社交网络体育报道质量面临的挑战。
literature.keywords: survey; gender; audience; twitter; facebook; diversity
literature.theoretical_framework: 议程设置理论、性别理论、受众研究理论

literature.title: Fans, Fellows or Followers: A Study on How Sport Federations Shape Social Media Affordances
literature.title_cn: 粉丝、会员还是追随者：体育联合会如何塑造社交媒体可供性
literature.title_en: Fans, Fellows or Followers: A Study on How Sport Federations Shape Social Media Affordances
literature.author: Lovisa Broms
literature.abstract: Increased in-depth knowledge on how sport federations shape their social media affordances to build relationships with their audiences will develop the understanding and ongoing discussion on the effects of social media in organized sports. The aim of this study was therefore to investigate in what way sports federations shape their social media affordances to create an increased understanding of how they interact with their audiences through social media. Three sports federations, the Swedish Basketball Federation, the Swedish Skateboard Association, and the Swedish Equestrian Federation, were investigated through semi-structured interviews as well as digital ethnography. The analytical focus lies on in what way the organizations shape social media affordances as well as in what way they imagine social media uses and users. This study shows that the federations’ imagination of who their users are, what they would like to see and how these users act and react defines their affordances. Further, the results reveal that the federations have differing approaches to in what way they imagine their users (as fans, fellows or followers) as well as what their incentives are for using social media. To learn how ongoing mediations mold long-term changes for sport federations, it is of importance to look beyond mediatization and learn more about their current structure and operations, their history, and traditions, as well as their view of their users.
literature.abstract_cn: 深入了解体育联合会如何塑造其社交媒体可供性以与受众建立关系，将促进对社交媒体在有组织体育中影响的理解和持续讨论。本研究的目的是调查体育联合会以何种方式塑造其社交媒体可供性，以更好地理解它们如何通过社交媒体与受众互动。研究调查了三个体育联合会——瑞典篮球联合会、瑞典滑板协会和瑞典马术联合会，采用半结构化访谈和数字民族志方法。分析焦点在于组织如何塑造社交媒体可供性，以及它们如何想象社交媒体的使用和用户。研究表明，联合会对用户是谁、他们想看什么以及用户如何行动和反应的想象定义了其可供性。此外，结果揭示各联合会在想象用户（作为粉丝、同伴或追随者）的方式以及使用社交媒体的动机方面存在不同方法。要了解持续的媒介化如何为体育联合会带来长期变革，重要的是超越媒介化本身，更多地了解它们当前的结构和运作、历史和传统，以及它们对用户的看法。
literature.keywords: audience; basketball; interviews; ethnography
literature.theoretical_framework: 媒介化理论、受众研究理论

literature.title: All My Friends Know The Slow Writer: Contextualization, Explanation, Fairness and Equity in Sports Illustrated’s Daily Cover
literature.title_cn: 我所有的朋友都知道这位慢笔作家：《体育画报》每日封面的情境化、阐释、公平与平等
literature.title_en: All My Friends Know The Slow Writer: Contextualization, Explanation, Fairness and Equity in Sports Illustrated’s Daily Cover
literature.author: Ryan Broussard, Marcus Funk, Prachi Vashisht
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT Sports Illustrated has a long legacy of respected longform journalism and a well-documented history of oversexualizing female athletes and underrepresenting women’s sports. In March 2020, the magazine launched the Daily Cover, a daily digital investigative or feature article emailed to subscribers and displayed prominently on SI.com. Given the magazine’s overall focus on digital journalism and breaking news, the Daily Cover provides an ideal opportunity to examine this generation of “bonus piece” journalism through the lens of slow journalism. Slow journalism emphasizes fairness, goodness and contextualization, reflecting a commitment to underserved communities and activist journalism. Quantitative and qualitative content analysis of the 244 Daily Cover stories in the first year found a qualitative commitment to slow journalism tenets - disconnecting from the hustle of breaking news; focusing on contextualization; and explaining prominent and uncommonly discussed topics for a community, not just an audience. While women’s sports were covered infrequently and less than a quarter of reporters were women and non-binary journalists—though that number is higher than the percentage of women in sports media—the overall sample reflected slow journalism principles of fairness, goodness, and balance.
literature.abstract_cn: 《体育画报》拥有悠久的受尊敬的长篇新闻传统，以及过度性化女性运动员和低代表性女性体育的有据可查的历史。2020年3月，该杂志推出了"每日封面"（Daily Cover），一个每日数字调查或专题文章，通过电子邮件发送给订阅者并在SI.com上突出显示。鉴于该杂志对数字新闻和突发新闻的整体关注，每日封面为通过慢新闻的视角审视这一代"附加作品"新闻提供了理想机会。慢新闻强调公平、善良和情境化，反映对服务不足社区和行动主义新闻的承诺。对第一年244篇每日封面故事的定量和定性内容分析发现，在质量上致力于慢新闻原则——摆脱突发新闻的匆忙；聚焦于情境化；为一个社区（不仅仅是一个受众）解释突出和不常讨论的话题。虽然女性体育被报道的频率不高，且只有不到四分之一的记者是女性和非二元性别记者——尽管这个数字高于体育媒体中女性的百分比——但整个样本反映了公平、善良和平衡的慢新闻原则。
literature.keywords: journalism, women, daily, cover, magazine

literature.title: Sports Journalists and Readers: Journalism and User Incivility
literature.title_cn: 体育记者与读者：新闻与用户失礼行为
literature.title_en: Sports Journalists and Readers: Journalism and User Incivility
literature.author: Joseba Bonaut, Mireya Vicent-Ibáñez, María Antonia Paz-Rebollo
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT This article assesses the impact of sports journalism style on uncivil conversations, by analyzing the news that has generated the most deleted comments and the published readers’ comments. The two sports newspapers with the largest number of readers in Spain (As and Marca) between 2019 and 2020 are compared. The analyzed journalistic pieces in both newspapers are proven to promote controversy and user participation, thus creating a polarized and strongly confronted community. Journalists lose their status as professionals by using a subjective, emotional and colloquial style, and they become mere commentators who can be discredited. This style is the breeding ground for uncivil conversations. Localized hate expressions are ideological: Spanish nationalism confronts Catalan independence in such a way that the world of football becomes dependent on the country's politics. There is no lack of negative gender stereotypes either in the predominantly male order of sport. Since no changes were observed during the pandemic, it can be established that these characteristics are part of the journalistic routine. Only the paywall introduced by As in the second half of 2020 change conversations: the number of messages, including deleted ones, was reduced, and positive feelings advanced in more rational conversations.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文通过分析引发最多被删除评论的新闻和已发布的读者评论，评估了体育新闻风格对不文明对话的影响。比较了2019年至2020年间西班牙读者最多的两家体育报纸（As和Marca）。分析表明，两家报纸的新闻作品都证明其旨在促进争议和用户参与，从而创造了极化且强烈对抗的社区。记者通过使用主观、情绪化和口语化的风格而失去了专业身份，变成可以被诋毁的普通评论员。这种风格是不文明对话的温床。被定位的仇恨表达是意识形态性的：西班牙民族主义与加泰罗尼亚独立主义以某种方式对抗，使足球世界变得依赖于国家政治。在以男性为主的体育秩序中也不乏负面的性别刻板印象。由于疫情期间未观察到变化，可以确定这些特征属于新闻常规的一部分。只有As在2020年下半年引入的付费墙改变了对话：消息数量（包括被删除的）减少了，积极情感在更理性的对话中得以推进。
literature.keywords: conversations, style, uncivil, deleted, comments

literature.title: Social Media and Sports Journalism in Zimbabwe
literature.title_cn: 津巴布韦的社交媒体与体育新闻
literature.title_en: Social Media and Sports Journalism in Zimbabwe
literature.author: Lyton Ncube, Admire Mare, Itai Muzondo
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT Social media has opened up alternative spaces for the production, distribution, and consumption of sports news across the world. Previously, legacy media were the main spaces through which sports news and commentaries were mediated. Despite these transformations, few empirical studies have unpacked the disruptive impacts of these digital technologies in the global South. Utilising insights from Pfaffenberger’s concept of “technological dramas”, we investigate how sports journalism has been reconfigured by social media in Zimbabwe. Further, we assess ways in which sports journalists are incorporating social media into their everyday newsmaking routines. We also examine the extent to which sports journalists have the appropriate digital skills and competencies required to operate in a multimedia environment. Importantly, we highlight the ethical challenges that Zimbabwean sports journalists are navigating in the digital age. Data was collected through in-depth semi-structured interviews with 15 purposively sampled sports journalists from across Zimbabwe’s hybrid media ecosystem. Findings show that sports journalists are increasingly depending on social media for news production, distribution, and audience engagement. Notable challenges facing multimedia sports journalists include limited access to digital devices and internet connectivity.
literature.abstract_cn: 社交媒体为世界各地体育新闻的生产、分发和消费开辟了替代空间。此前，传统媒体是体育新闻和评论得以中介的主要空间。尽管发生了这些转变，但很少有实证研究解开这些数字技术在全球南方的颠覆性影响。利用Pfaffenberger的"技术戏剧"概念的见解，我们调查了体育新闻如何被津巴布韦的社交媒体重新配置。此外，我们评估了体育记者将社交媒体纳入其日常新闻制作常规的方式。我们还考察了体育记者在多大程度上拥有在多媒体环境中运作所需的适当数字技能和能力。重要的是，我们强调了津巴布韦体育记者在数字时代正在应对的伦理挑战。数据通过对津巴布韦混合媒体生态系统中15名有目的地抽样的体育记者进行深度半结构化访谈收集。研究发现，体育记者日益依赖社交媒体进行新闻生产、分发和受众参与。多媒体体育记者面临的主要挑战包括数字设备和互联网连接的可及性有限。
literature.keywords: media, journalists, social, digital, spaces

literature.title: Supporting Activism in Latin America: The Role of Science Communication, Science Journalism, and NGOs in Socio-environmental Conflicts
literature.title_cn: 支持拉丁美洲的行动主义：科学传播、科学新闻与非政府组织在社会环境冲突中的作用
literature.title_en: Supporting Activism in Latin America: The Role of Science Communication, Science Journalism, and NGOs in Socio-environmental Conflicts
literature.author: Diogo Lopes de Oliveira, Bruce V. Lewenstein
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT This exploratory paper addresses the relationship of science journalism, science communication, environmental activism, and social movements. It draws on data from Latin America, exploring how journalists and activists use science communication as a tool for telling stories about environmental conflicts that frequently turn violent (more than 1600 land and environmental activists lost their lives between 2002 and 2020 in Latin America, more than three times that of all other regions of the world combined). The main goal of the paper is to understand how scientific storytelling by NGOs helps them present their points of view for journalists and to influence public opinion. Our data is drawn from the formal reports of four NGOs and from semi-structured interviews with representatives from each NGO’s staff about their use of science communication. Our analysis suggests that Latin American NGOs use science communication tools such as scientific storytelling and scientific explanation to support journalists and to communicate with broad publics about complex phenomena such as socio-environmental conflicts, contributing to efforts to reduce the alarming amount of violence in the region.
literature.abstract_cn: 这篇探索性论文探讨了科学新闻、科学传播、环境激进主义和社会运动之间的关系。它借鉴拉丁美洲的数据，探讨记者和活动人士如何利用科学传播作为讲述经常演变为暴力的环境冲突故事的工具（2002年至2020年间，拉丁美洲有超过1,600名土地和环境活动人士丧生，是全世界所有其他地区总和的3倍以上）。本文的主要目标是理解非政府组织的科学叙事如何帮助他们呈现……
literature.keywords: science, communication, environmental, latin, journalists

literature.title: Journalists on a Journey: Towards Responsible Media on Transgender Participation in Sport
literature.title_cn: 记者的旅程：迈向负责任的跨性别运动员参与体育报道
literature.title_en: Journalists on a Journey: Towards Responsible Media on Transgender Participation in Sport
literature.author: Holly Thorpe, Monica Nelson, Shannon Scovel, Jaimie Veale
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT This paper draws upon interviews to reveal how a small minority of journalists are working towards more ethical approaches to representing transgender participation in sport. Writing in a context of a growing transphobic discourse in both the mainstream media and public sentiment, we examine the learning journeys of six sport journalists reporting on transgender weightlifter Laurel Hubbard’s participation in the Tokyo Olympic Games. The paper reveals variable reflexive considerations; ongoing efforts to educate themselves, colleagues and readers; varying levels of care in sourcing practices (i.e., members of the transgender community; scientists and anti-trans groups); and considerations about their responsibilities amidst rising transphobic discourse and online abuse. Engaging with recent writings on journalistic ethics and reflection-in-practice, this paper offers an example of the possibilities for more reflexive and responsible reporting on issues of social and political importance.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文借鉴访谈，揭示了一小部分记者如何努力走向更伦理的跨性别者体育参与表征方法。在主流媒体和公众情绪中日益增长的恐跨性别论述的背景下，我们考察了六名报道跨性别举重运动员劳雷尔·哈伯德参加东京奥运会经历的体育记者的学习旅程。论文揭示了可变的反思性考量；教育自己、同事和读者的持续努力；信息来源实践中不同程度的关怀（即跨性别社区成员、科学家和反跨性别团体）；以及在日益增长的恐跨性别论述和在线辱骂中对其责任的各种考虑。通过参与近期关于新闻伦理和实践中反思的著作，本文提供了一个关于具有社会和政治重要性议题的更反思性和负责任报道可能性的例子。
literature.keywords: transgender, journalists, participation, sport, transphobic

literature.title: Social Media Scholarship in Sport Studies and College Athletes’ Name, Image, and Likeness Opportunities
literature.title_cn: 体育研究中的社交媒体学术与大学生运动员的姓名、形象与肖像机会
literature.title_en: Social Media Scholarship in Sport Studies and College Athletes’ Name, Image, and Likeness Opportunities
literature.author: Edward M. Kian, Matthew Zimmerman
literature.abstract: The passage of name, image, and likeness (NIL) laws in individual states within the United States has provided intercollegiate athletes opportunities to potentially profit from their personal NIL in a free marketplace. Concurrently, the NCAA (National Collegiate Athletic Association) also allowed college athletes to utilize their NIL rights. Thus far, most college athletes’ NIL deals for payments are for posts on the athletes’ own social media channels for products, including their own self-promotion in relation to brands, or promotion of brands such as fast food and auto dealerships. Notably, published scholarly work on NIL itself is sparse since it was not until 2021 that the NCAA enacted NIL rules for college athletes. Published scholarship on NIL and social media is even rarer. Therefore, this commentary provides recommendations for potential future scholarship related to NIL and social media, focusing on three potential frameworks: (a) agenda setting, (b) relationship marketing, and (c) personal branding.
literature.abstract_cn: 美国各州通过姓名、形象和肖像（NIL）法律，为大学生运动员提供了在自由市场中可能从个人NIL获利的机遇。同时，NCAA（全国大学体育协会）也允许大学生运动员利用其NIL权利。到目前为止，大多数大学生运动员的NIL支付交易是针对运动员自己社交媒体渠道上的帖子。本文综述了体育研究中关于社交媒体学术以及大学生运动员NIL的文献，考察了社交媒体如何在NIL背景下被理解和研究。研究讨论了社交媒体在运动员个人品牌建设中的重要性，NIL交易对运动员的机遇和挑战，以及体育研究如何为理解NIL和社交媒体互动提供理论框架。
literature.keywords: athlete; branding; marketing; brand

literature.title: Dynamic Social Media Content in Sport Communication Research
literature.title_cn: 体育传播研究中的动态社交媒体内容
literature.title_en: Dynamic Social Media Content in Sport Communication Research
literature.author: Galen Clavio
literature.abstract: Research focusing on social media usage in sport communication and its related media has made significant strides in the last 2 decades. Researchers have provided key insights into how social media content is created by sport entities and media members, how sport fans and consumers feel about social media content, and how aspects of social media content inform public perception of matters pertaining to race, gender, ethnicity, politics, and other key cultural areas. However, the changing natures of social media technology and user preferences for content have often moved faster than the body of research surrounding them. This commentary highlights a gap in published sport communication studies focusing on dynamic social media content and provides suggestions for addressing a key present, and future, need for scholarly inquiry in the field.
literature.abstract_cn: 关注体育传播及其相关媒体中社交媒体使用的研究在过去20年取得了显著进展。研究人员提供了关于体育实体和媒体成员如何创作社交媒体内容、体育迷和消费者对社交媒体内容的感受，以及社交媒体内容的哪些方面影响公众对种族、性别、民族、政治和其他关键文化领域问题认知的关键洞察。然而，社交媒体技术不断变化的性质以及用户对内容的偏好，往往比围绕它们的研究发展得更快。这篇评论文章强调了已发表体育传播研究中关于动态社交媒体内容的空白，并提出了满足该领域学术探究当前和未来关键需求的建议。
literature.keywords: gender; race; ethnicity; politics

literature.title: Brand Management and Social Media
literature.title_cn: 品牌管理与社交媒体
literature.title_en: Brand Management and Social Media
literature.author: Beth A. Cianfrone
literature.abstract: Social media allows sport entities (organizations, athletes, coaches, fans, and partnering companies) to reach audiences across the world and create, extend, maintain, and improve their brand equity through constant communication. Brand management and the strategies employed by entities to create effective content that reinforces brand image and brand equity are a common goal among sport marketers. Over the last 20 years, scholars have investigated a wide range of topics in sport social media and branding, yet there is a need to continue to expand the social media brand management literature to address and reflect rapidly changing industry challenges. The purpose of this commentary is to provide a reflection of past academic literature, while critically examining areas in methodology and theory to guide future research. The recommendations of more sophisticated designs, along with a call for experimental designs, qualitative approaches, and critical communication inquiry, among others, are discussed.
literature.abstract_cn: 社交媒体允许体育实体（组织、运动员、教练、球迷和合作公司）接触世界各地的受众，并通过持续沟通来创建、扩展、维持和改进其品牌资产。品牌管理和实体采用的策略——创建强化品牌形象和品牌资产的有效内容——是体育营销人员共同的目标。在过去20年里，学者们研究了体育社交媒体和品牌的大量主题，但仍有必要继续扩展这些研究领域。本文回顾了体育社交媒体和品牌管理研究的当前状态，并确定了未来研究的关键方向，包括社交媒体分析的运用、不同平台的比较研究，以及社交媒体对品牌资产的长期影响。
literature.keywords: brand; audience; branding; qualitative; athlete

literature.title: Social Media and Consumer Behavior
literature.title_cn: 社交媒体与消费者行为
literature.title_en: Social Media and Consumer Behavior
literature.author: Andrea N. Geurin
literature.abstract: The topics of social media and consumer behavior are inextricably linked. Since 2008, scholars in sport-studies fields such as sport communication and sport management have increasingly focused their research on social media use by sport entities and consumers. This commentary provides an overview of sport social media and consumer behavior scholarship to date, including prominent and growing topics such as consumers’ uses of social media, social media engagement, user segmentation, and user-generated content. A scoping review was conducted to illustrate the current state of research on social media, sport, and consumer behavior. Future research priorities to advance this area of inquiry are also discussed, including more qualitative research resulting in rich and descriptive analyses, the need to better understand Gen Z as sport social media consumers, and the need to understand the connection between social media consumption and purchasing behavior. Finally, the commentary encourages scholars to expand their research focus in geographic contexts outside of North America, on underrepresented groups, such as women’s sport and disability sport, and to adopt new theoretical frameworks for such research.
literature.abstract_cn: 社交媒体和消费行为的主题密不可分。自2008年以来，体育传播和体育管理等体育研究领域的学者越来越多地将研究重点放在体育实体和消费者的社交媒体使用上。本评论概述了迄今为止的体育社交媒体和消费行为学术研究，包括热门和不断增长的主题，如消费者对社交媒体的使用、社交媒体参与、用户细分和用户生成内容。进行了范围综述以说明当前社交媒体、体育和消费行为研究的状况。还讨论了推进这一研究领域的未来研究优先事项，包括更多产生丰富描述性分析的定性研究、更好理解Z世代作为体育社交媒体消费者的需要，以及理解社交媒体消费与购买行为之间联系的需要。最后，评论鼓励学者将研究焦点扩展到北美以外的地理背景、代表性不足的群体（如女性体育和残疾人体育），并为这类研究采用新的理论框架。
literature.keywords: qualitative; engagement; consumption; disability
literature.theoretical_framework: 性别理论、女性主义传播理论

literature.title: The Continued Olympic Agenda Shift: A Case Study of the Time on Camera for Men and Women During the 2022 Beijing Olympics on NBC
literature.title_cn: 奥运议程的持续偏移：NBC对2022北京冬奥男女出镜时长的案例研究
literature.title_en: The Continued Olympic Agenda Shift: A Case Study of the Time on Camera for Men and Women During the 2022 Beijing Olympics on NBC
literature.author: Zachary W. Arth, James R. Angelini, Patrick C. Gentile, Andrew W. Hard
literature.abstract: This case study assessed the differences in time on camera dedicated to men and women athletes at the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics. An analysis of the entirety of the programming on the the American broadcast television company NBC, including the prime-time broadcasts, the daytime programming, and the additional nightly content, yielded nearly 185 hr of coded Olympic content. When excluding mixed-sex events, in the 61.5 hr of prime-time coverage, women received 60.05% of the time on camera. During the non-prime-time coverage, which spanned 123 hr, men received the majority of clock time, accounting for 51.6% of coverage. In addition, differences by sport were uncovered, with the major differences occurring in alpine skiing, which saw more women’s coverage regardless of broadcast. In contrast, women received more coverage in freestyle skiing and snowboarding during the prime-time broadcast, but men were more emphasized in these competitions during the non-prime-time content. Utilizing agenda setting as the theoretical framework for this case study, ramifications for these broadcast trends and differences are discussed.
literature.abstract_cn: 本案例研究评估了2022年北京冬奥会上男性和女性运动员出镜时间的差异。对美国电视广播公司NBC全部节目（包括黄金时段转播、日间节目和额外的夜间内容）的分析，产生了近185小时的编码奥运内容。排除混合性别项目后，在61.5小时的黄金时段报道中，女性获得了60.05%的出镜时间。在跨越123小时的非黄金时段报道中，男性获得了大部分时间，占报道的51.6%。此外，还发现了按项目划分的差异，主要差异出现在高山滑雪项目，无论哪种转播都看到更多女性报道。相比之下……
literature.keywords: olympics; television; athlete

literature.title: Role Models and Athlete Expression at the Youth Olympic Games as Impactful Sport Communication Practices
literature.title_cn: 青奥会中的榜样力量与运动员表达：有影响力的体育传播实践
literature.title_en: Role Models and Athlete Expression at the Youth Olympic Games as Impactful Sport Communication Practices
literature.author: Jannicke Stålstrøm, Marina Iskhakova, Zack P. Pedersen
literature.abstract: This study investigated athlete expressions and the impact that Olympian (OLY) role models have on athletes participating at the Youth Olympic Games (YOG), with a focus on the YOG educational program. The YOG educational program was created in 2010 and has not yet garnered extensive scholarly examination. Therefore, the aim of the current investigation was to develop an understanding of the impact that OLY role models have on YOG athletes and the communicative practices young athletes use to express themselves. This study used a mixed methodology (i.e., survey and interviews) and drew on three theories (i.e., social learning theory, role model theory, and communicative theory of expression) to better understand the aforementioned impact of OLY role models on YOG athletes. An examination of the communicative expression practices of OLY role models, through the mixed methodological approach, produced novel findings pertaining to YOG athlete perceptions of the structure and benefit of the educational program.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究调查了运动员的表达以及奥运会榜样运动员（OLY）对参加青奥会（YOG）运动员的影响，重点关注YOG教育项目。YOG教育项目于2010年创建，尚未获得广泛的学术审视。因此，当前研究的目标是理解OLY榜样对YOG运动员的影响，以及年轻运动员用来表达自己的传播实践。本研究使用混合方法论（即调查和访谈），并借鉴三种理论（社会学习理论、榜样理论和表达传播理论），以更好地理解上述OLY榜样对YOG运动员的影响。通过混合方法论方法对OLY榜样传播表达实践的研究，产生了关于YOG运动员对教育项目结构和益处感知的新颖发现。
literature.keywords: athlete; interviews; survey

literature.title: “Time to Award Some Medals”: A Comparative Social Media Analysis of Olympic Coverage in the United States and Australia
literature.title_cn: “是时候颁奖了”：美澳奥运报道的社交媒体比较分析
literature.title_en: “Time to Award Some Medals”: A Comparative Social Media Analysis of Olympic Coverage in the United States and Australia
literature.author: Kelsey Slater, Dunja Antunovic, Meg S. Messer, Sam P. Dreher
literature.abstract: Rights-holding broadcasters of the Olympic Games play an integral role in conveying the values of the Olympic Movement, but few studies have examined these networks’ social media content. This investigation involved a comparative content analysis of rights-holding broadcasters’ official Olympic Twitter accounts in the United States (@NBCOlympics) and Australia (@7Olympics) during the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics. Results indicate significant differences between the two accounts in sport disciplines, gender representations, and national interest. Both accounts dedicated <40% of the tweets to women’s sport. Whereas the American outlet NBC promoted home athletes, Australia’s Seven Network emphasized athletes from other countries. Twitter accounts partially followed the televisual logics of representation patterns, but contextual factors specific to social media structured agenda diversity. Contextual elements (e.g., structure of sport schedules and nation-specific factors) are also relevant when interpreting representation patterns. Theoretical implications for agenda setting and methodological directions for cross-national Olympic social media research are discussed.
literature.abstract_cn: 奥运会的持权转播商在传达奥林匹克运动价值观方面发挥着不可或缺的作用，但很少有研究考察这些电视网络的社交媒体内容。本调查对2022年北京冬奥会期间美国（@NBCOlympics）和澳大利亚（@7Olympics）持权转播商官方奥运推特账户进行了比较内容分析。结果表明，两个账户在体育项目、性别呈现和国家利益方面存在显著差异。两个账户对女子体育的推文占比均不足40%。美国NBC推广本国运动员，而澳大利亚的七号网络则强调来自其他国家的运动员。推特账户部分遵循了电视表现的逻辑，但社交媒体特有的语境因素塑造了议程的多样性。语境因素（如体育赛程结构和特定国家因素）在解读表现模式时也具有相关性。文章讨论了议程设置的理论意涵以及跨国奥运社交媒体研究的方法论方向。
literature.keywords: gender; twitter; olympics; diversity; representation; athlete
literature.theoretical_framework: 议程设置理论、性别理论

literature.title: “I’m Obviously a Sucker for Punishment”: Responses to Audience Interactions Used by Women Working in Sports Media
literature.title_cn: “我显然是惩罚的受虐狂”：体育媒体女性工作者对受众互动的回应
literature.title_en: “I’m Obviously a Sucker for Punishment”: Responses to Audience Interactions Used by Women Working in Sports Media
literature.author: Niamh Kitching, Aoife Sheehan
literature.abstract: The gendered experiences of women working in sports media have been the subject of growing research, particularly in the United States, but cases are emerging in other contexts. This paper examines the strategies used by seven women working in sports media in the United Kingdom and Ireland to deal with undesirable audience interactions, both online and in person. With emotional labor as an overarching framework, semistructured interviews interviews were conducted and reflexive thematic analysis was used to construct two themes: internal and external responses. The study reveals the additional self-regulated emotional burden carried by women working in sports media and the strategies used to cope. Women in sports media publicly downplay their mistreatment and have not yet embraced the reporting of gendered practices in the workplace. The findings contribute to a growing body of literature that sheds light on the experiences of women in sports media and offer insights for women working in the industry and their employers.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育媒体中女性的性别化经历一直是日益增长的研究主题，特别是在美国，但其他情境下的案例也正在出现。本文考察了英国和爱尔兰体育媒体工作的七名女性用来应对不受欢迎的观众互动（无论是在线还是面对面）的策略。以情绪劳动为总体框架，进行了半结构化访谈，并使用反身性主题分析构建了两个主题：内部反应和外部反应。研究揭示了在体育媒体工作的女性承担的额外自我调节的情感负担以及她们使用的应对策略。体育媒体的女性公开淡化她们的受虐经历，尚未接受对工作场所性别化实践的举报。这些发现为日益增长的揭示体育媒体女性经历的研究文献做出贡献，并为该行业工作的女性和她们的雇主提供了见解。
literature.keywords: audience; gender; interviews; workplace; labor; emotion
literature.theoretical_framework: 性别理论、受众研究理论

literature.title: When Sports Fans Buy: Contextualizing Social Media Engagement Behavior to Predict Purchase Intention
literature.title_cn: 当体育迷消费时：情境化社交媒体参与行为以预测购买意愿
literature.title_en: When Sports Fans Buy: Contextualizing Social Media Engagement Behavior to Predict Purchase Intention
literature.author: Emil Steiner, Matthew Pittman, Brandon Boatwright
literature.abstract: While sports fandom and social media advertising have been widely studied, and all major, professional teams use social media campaigns for direct sales, there is surprisingly little research on the relationship between fans’ social media engagement behavior (SMEB) and their purchase intention (PI), and none that differentiates PI across different platforms and sports contexts. This study addresses those gaps by exploring (a) how different kinds of fans engage their teams’ advertising on various social media and (b) how those different behaviors predict PI in different contexts. To do so, we utilized an SMEB framework to interpret survey data (N = 452) of U.S. sports fans’ social media engagement with their favorite teams over six popular platforms for two situations—in-game and out-of-game. Regression analyses determined the extent to which those behaviors predict PI across different sports and platforms during and outside of games. Our results show that fan SMEB varies by sport, platform, and situation. Furthermore, we found that information-acquiring social media behaviors—such as checking scores—best predict PI in-game, while fan-identity cultivation social media behaviors—such as posting—best predict PI out-of-game. In addition, PI predictability varies across platform and game situation, but not across age, gender, or even level of fandom. By contextualizing the relationship between fan SMEB and PI, our study lays a foundation to address these lingering gaps in the sport communication literature while providing actionable insights for teams and brands seeking more effective sales campaigns across an array of social media.
literature.abstract_cn: 虽然体育粉丝身份和社交媒体广告已被广泛研究，所有主要职业球队都使用社交媒体活动进行直销，但令人惊讶的是，关于粉丝社交媒体参与行为（SMEB）与其购买意图（PI）之间关系的研究很少，而且没有研究区分不同平台和体育情境下的PI。本研究通过探讨以下问题来填补这些空白：（a）不同类型的粉丝如何在各种社交媒体上参与其球队的广告，以及（b）这些不同行为如何预测不同情境下的PI。为此，我们利用SMEB框架来解释美国体育迷（N=452）在六个流行平台上与心爱球队的社交媒体参与调查数据，涵盖两种情境——比赛期间和比赛之外。回归分析确定了这些行为在不同运动和平台、比赛期间和之外的PI预测程度。我们的结果显示，粉丝的SMEB因运动、平台和情境而异。此外，我们发现信息获取型社交媒体行为（如查看比分）在比赛期间最能预测PI，而粉丝身份培养型社交媒体行为（如发帖）在比赛之外最能预测PI。此外，PI可预测性因平台和比赛情境而异，但不因年龄、性别甚至粉丝程度而异。通过情境化粉丝SMEB与PI之间的关系，我们的研究为解决体育营销中这些悬而未决的空白奠定了基础。

literature.title: Cyberbullying in Sport
literature.title_cn: 体育中的网络霸凌
literature.title_en: Cyberbullying in Sport
literature.author: Ellen MacPherson, Gretchen Kerr
literature.abstract: Despite over 30 years of scholarly attention devoted to bullying and cyberbullying behaviors in school settings, research related to these experiences in the sport context remains limited. Yet, numerous anecdotal examples and preliminary evidence suggests cyberbullying exists in the sport domain and must be addressed given the potential adverse psychosocial outcomes for athletes. This commentary reviews research related to bullying and cyberbullying in the sport literature. To advance our understanding of cyberbullying in sport, recommendations are made to clarify conceptual issues around the central defining features (i.e., power, repetition, intent) commonly used to operationalize these experiences. Further, methodological issues to be addressed are discussed, including, the use of more diverse methods; adoption of an intersectional lens to all research; and the development, implementation, and evaluation of interdisciplinary evidence-based prevention and intervention strategies. Only through a research base that addresses these conceptual and methodological challenges, will empirically-informed prevention and intervention strategies be developed to advance safe, healthy, and inclusive sport environments.
literature.abstract_cn: 尽管学校情境中的欺凌和网络欺凌行为已获得三十多年的学术关注，但在体育情境中与这些经历相关的研究仍然有限。然而，大量轶事证据和初步证据表明，网络欺凌存在于体育领域，且鉴于其对运动员可能造成的负面心理社会后果，必须加以应对。本评论回顾了体育文献中与欺凌和网络欺凌相关的研究。为增进我们对体育中网络欺凌的理解，研究者就围绕常被用于操作化这些经历的核心定义特征（即权力、重复性、意图）澄清概念问题提出建议。此外，本文还讨论了需要解决的方法论问题，包括使用更多样化的方法；在所有研究中采用交叉性（intersectional）视角；以及开发、实施和评估跨学科的循证预防与干预策略。只有通过能够应对这些概念和方法论挑战的研究基础，才能制定出有实证依据的预防与干预策略，以推进安全、健康和包容的体育环境。
literature.keywords: cyberbullying; bullying; athlete

literature.title: Critiquing the Social Media Scholarship in Sport Studies: A Sport Entrepreneurship Analysis
literature.title_cn: 批评体育研究中的社交媒体学术：一项体育创业分析
literature.title_en: Critiquing the Social Media Scholarship in Sport Studies: A Sport Entrepreneurship Analysis
literature.author: Vanessa Ratten
literature.abstract: Social media is endemic to the sport industry and ensures its global competitiveness. The aim of this article is to critique social media scholarship in sport studies by taking a sport entrepreneurship perspective. This approach is useful in expanding and building on the existing social media research by focusing on the innovation apparent in the sport industry. An overview of current literature on social media and sport entrepreneurship is discussed. This article concludes with a number of different research trajectories that are needed to advance the practice and scholarship of sport social media studies and sport entrepreneurship.
literature.abstract_cn: 社交媒体已渗透于体育产业之中，并确保其全球竞争力。本文旨在从体育创业（sport entrepreneurship）的视角对体育研究中的社交媒体学术进行批判性审视。这一路径通过聚焦体育产业中显现的创新，有助于扩展和深化现有的社交媒体研究。文章概述了当前关于社交媒体与体育创业的文献，最后提出了推进体育社交媒体研究和体育创业实践与学术所需的若干不同研究路径。

literature.title: 国际政治心理学视域下我国体育对外交往的理论探索与实践应用
literature.title_cn: 国际政治心理学视域下我国体育对外交往的理论探索与实践应用
literature.author: 于思远、顾帅、刘桂海
literature.abstract: 体育对外交往作为体育强国建设的五大战略任务之一,是助力体育成为中华民族伟大复兴标志性事业的重要突破口。以国际政治心理学为方法引领,对体育对外交往促进和平的作用进行理论剖析。研究认为,体育对外交往对于化解国家间"外交信任困境"具有重要作用,能够通过塑造国家间的内部知觉实现理解与共识;体育对外交往分为官方体育对外交往与民间体育对外交往,两种形式通过不同的功效与目标对传统外交的功能进行补足。通过国际政治心理学的相关理论对我国体育对外交往实践进行剖析认为,我国民间体育对外交往囿于"定域"思维,体育国际话语权处于弱势地位。

literature.abstract: 以永春白鹤拳为媒介,探讨中华武术在马来西亚的跨文化传播议题。研究发现,永春白鹤拳在马来西亚的传播经历了在地根植、我武惟扬、薪火相传、复兴之举等组织化发展,阐释了传播个体、传播组织、传播媒介等协同作用下人与人、群体与群体之间的共情传播中的个体行动及集体行动逻辑,为中华传统体育文化海外传播提供参考。

literature.title: "一带一路"倡议10年中国体育文化传播的成就、挑战与展望
literature.title_cn: "一带一路"倡议10年中国体育文化传播的成就、挑战与展望
literature.author: 于俊利、冯鹭
literature.abstract: 共建"一带一路"倡议提出10年来,中国体育文化传播取得了突出的成就。这些成就表现在,优质国际合作平台的搭建促进了体育文化的国际传播交流,丝路沿线国家体育赛事及文化交流互动日趋频繁,体文旅融合新业态进一步带动体育文化传播,以互联网为依托的数字传媒打破了体育文化传播的时空局限。而面临的挑战主要是体育文化持续创新能力尚显不足、多元化的传播交流方式尚需完善、传播人才队伍建设能力薄弱。

literature.abstract: 于全球化与本土化之间寻找话语实践的张力空间,既是我国主流媒体国际传播的难点,也是突破点。基于球土化理论,以3家主流媒体官方推特(Twitter,现更名为X)账号有关北京冬奥会的相关报道为样本,采用定性比较分析法,对影响我国主流媒体体育国际传播话语实践的主要因素及组态路径进行考察,尝试析出体育国际传播实践层面"全球"与"中国"的接合之道。分析发现,主流媒体体育国际传播话语实践成效的取得主要依靠两组"可选择"组态路径,即"自述"中的全球话语调用与本土化转译、"他述"中的本土立场抒发与"全球中国"构建。

literature.abstract: “体育洗白”理论成为近年来西方学者污名化非西方体育势力的工具，并且有逐渐升级的趋势。“体育洗白”污名化的实质是体育西方中心主义作祟，在理论层面它涉及西方主义与东方主义、奥林匹克主义与世界主义的对峙。当下的体育西方中心主义由以“超级体育集合”为特征的美国体育集团所主导。

literature.abstract: 顺应时代发展趋势，加快新媒体建设，是新时代体育学术期刊高质量发展的重要理论与实践议题。运用文献资料、专家访谈、实地调研等方法，对数字化背景下体育学术期刊与新媒体融合发展的必要性、可行性以及现实障碍进行了调研与分析，旨在提出有针对性的融合发展策略。

literature.author: 阎晋虎、于晓梅、张业安、孙浩
literature.abstract: 体育健康传播是促进人的身心健康发展的重要方式，对全面推进健康中国建设、增进民生福祉具有深远意义。在渐入数字文明时代之际，人机交互在增进技术红利、用户赋权的同时，其融于体育健康传播实践可能带来一定受众风险：以语言模型倚重生成符号传播，弱化体育默会知识传播等。据此提出疏解路径。

literature.abstract: 提升中华体育文化感召力有利于维护中国文化安全、传播中华优秀传统文化，是增强中国体育国际传播能力和提升体育国际话语权的重要环节。在当前纷繁复杂的国际国内局势下，中华体育文化感召力的提升面临4个方面的现实困境：西方体育文化霸权不断强化，挤占中华体育文化发展空间等，并据此提出共情传播视角下的实践路径。

literature.title: 网络直播间健身群体的身份类型与建构逻辑——基于“刘畊宏女孩”的网络民族志考察
literature.title_cn: 网络直播间健身群体的身份类型与建构逻辑——基于“刘畊宏女孩”的网络民族志考察
literature.author: 王亮杰、涂传飞
literature.abstract: 基于“刘畊宏女孩”群体，运用网络民族志的方法探讨了网络直播间健身群体的身份类型及其建构逻辑。研究表明：网络直播间健身群体主要有两种身份类型，即“元粉丝”和“新粉丝”构成的粉丝群体以及“纯在线学员”和“粉丝型学员”构成的学员群体。粉丝群体遵循偶像感知的建构逻辑，学员群体遵循健身效果感知的建构逻辑。

literature.abstract: 运用内容分析和文本分析的混合方法对CGTN关于北京冬奥会的报道进行研究，考察了相关报道的新闻框架、议题主体以及不同议题的内容细节，力求展现主流媒体在体育国际传播中建构国家形象的全貌与特征。研究认为，CGTN在情景性、故事化的国际传播叙事空间中，基本形塑了负责任大国的国家形象。

literature.abstract: 5G时代的受众心理特征呈现新样态，作为客观存在的心理和行为实体，网络受众渐已成为奥运传播研究的核心议题。在此，迫切需要立足奥运传播的视角，以知觉的悬置为切入点，对奥运期间网民的媒介行为和情感状态进行分析，揭示影响新媒体奥运传播生态的受众心理因素，探讨奥运网络受众的情感生成、参与逻辑与传播机制。

literature.title: 我国国际体育赛事的西方媒介话语建构及其应对策略——以《纽约时报》北京冬奥会报道为例
literature.title_cn: 我国国际体育赛事的西方媒介话语建构及其应对策略——以《纽约时报》北京冬奥会报道为例

literature.abstract: 北京冬奥会结束后，我国仍将迎来一系列国际赛事，有必要深入了解西方媒体体育报道特点，为我国开展体育国际传播提供支持。研究以《纽约时报》北京冬奥会报道为例，依托媒介话语理论，运用批判话语分析和内容分析，探讨我国国际体育赛事的西方媒介话语建构及应对策略。

literature.abstract: 以媒介环境为分析框架，从健身媒介的自身属性特征以及所建构的媒介环境分析其所衍生的媒介偏向，以探讨数字健身媒介在人们健身文化实践中所扮演的角色。研究发现：数字健身媒介在其独特的感知、符号和社会环境下，通过感官系统的延伸、多重符号的卷入和运动社交的嵌套建构了独特的传播偏向。

literature.title_cn: 数字时代体育赛事视听盗播行为的刑法规制：必要证成、分类解析与实现路径
literature.author: 周岩峰、王桢
literature.abstract: 对体育赛事视听盗播行为的刑法规制进行研究，能够更好保护赛事组织者、授权制播单位的合法利益，维护体育传媒市场的公平竞争秩序。研究发现，虽然著作权法、反不正当竞争法、民商法等多种非刑事手段在一定程度上也能挽救受害者的合法权益，但是由于盗播行为的技术门槛低，亟需刑法规制加以保障。

literature.abstract: 体育国际话语权是强化身份认同、体现国际地位、展现国家综合实力的重要因素。本文采用文献资料法、案例分析法，运用场域理论，从场域、机制、创新3个方面对我国体育国际话语权进行研究。研究认为：场域是提升体育国际话语权的基础，机制是提升体育国际话语权的保障，创新是提升体育国际话语权的动力。

literature.abstract: 北京2022年冬奥会作为重要的国际体育赛事，在短视频平台引发广泛关注。研究引入"算法可见性"这一理解智能媒体平台的新视角，以抖音为例，探究平台如何通过算法推荐来建构北京冬奥会的可见性。研究发现：北京冬奥会内容中运动员和赛事信息可见性最高，吉祥物冰墩墩成为重要的可见性符号。

literature.abstract: 北京冬奥会胜利举办，我国运动员谷爱凌成为街谈巷议的热门话题。运用LDA主题模型，对北京冬奥会谷爱凌夺冠时刻的社交媒体评论内容进行挖掘与分析，呈现出6大聚类主题：主题1聚焦于谷爱凌优异的竞技表现和媒体表现；主题2突出了谷爱凌成长的家庭教育因素；主题3侧重于对运动员归化现象的讨论。

literature.abstract: 运用文献资料、案例分析等方法，探究智能技术赋能体育传媒产业发展。智能技术赋能 体育传媒产业发展逻辑：变革产业格局，拓展业态边界；优化盈利模式，提升行业效率；创新 内容模式，重构生产流程。困境：舆论引导与数据安全面临风险，科技发展与算法机制受到限 制，优质产品与价值取向存在失范，身体身份与消费需求可能异化。策略：政策保障与他治自 治实现风险规避，培养人才与人机协同促进科技进步，理念转变与价值倡导实现信息优化，以 人为本与权益维护满足消费需求。

literature.author: 傅新宇、于红妍、孟泽
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料、案例分析等方法，以 2022 年卡塔尔世界杯为例，分析大型体育赛事短视 频传播的现状、价值与短板，并提出传播路径。价值：吸引人群关注的主流渠道，催生商业价 值的重要途径，传播文化内涵的必备手段。短板：题材缺乏创新，传播内容雷同；视听效果欠 佳，传播热度不足；缺少专业平台，运营能力较弱；缺乏版权意识，侵权现象严重。传播路径： 开发多元题材，丰富传播内容；优化视听效果，提升传播热度；增加平台功能，强化运营能力； 完善监管体制，增强版权意识。

literature.title: 我国体育哲学社会科学国际话语权生成维度及提升策略
literature.title_cn: 我国体育哲学社会科学国际话语权生成维度及提升策略
literature.author: 张也、闫晗、邰峰
literature.abstract: 运用文献计量法等，对我国体育哲学社会科学国际话语权生成维度、现实挑战进行研究， 并提出提升策略。生成维度：体育国际学术期刊发展与建设、体育国际学术交流会议参与度、体育学术成果的国际化传播。现实挑战：国际学术期刊出版传播平台不足，国际学术会议举办质量不高，学术话语体系缺失，学术成果质与量不匹配。提升策略：整合出版资源，建设高质量出版平台；坚持国际化办刊路线，打造高水平国际学术期刊；加强国际学术会议组织管理，提升议程设置能力；立足实际，构建中国特色学术话语体系；加强话语自信，提高学术成果的国际传播力。

literature.title: 我国优秀传统体育文化对外传播能力建设研究
literature.title_cn: 我国优秀传统体育文化对外传播能力建设研究
literature.author: 王壹伦、曹庆雷
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料、专家访谈等方法，对我国优秀传统体育文化对外传播能力建设的价值、机遇与挑战进行研究，并提出建设路径。优秀传统体育文化对外传播能力建设的价值：推动国际形象塑造，彰显中国形象亲和力；推进文化强国建设，展现大国文化自信；传播好中国声音，赓续传统体育文化。面对的挑战：传播主体多元，但仍以政府主导为主；传播形式多元，但效果相对较弱；传播内容多样，但注重浅层符号；尚未充分洞悉域外受众的个性化需求。对外传播能力建设路径：凝聚传播合力，构建多元立体格局； 拓宽传播渠道，拓展国际传播平台；深化受众分析，满足多元文化需求；优化传播内容，拉近国外民众关系；检验传播效果，动态优化传播对策。

literature.title: 从 4G 到 5G：体育赛事直播的变革与进路
literature.title_cn: 从 4G 到 5G：体育赛事直播的变革与进路
literature.author: 孟祥阳、邹月辉
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料、逻辑分析等方法，研究从4G到5G时代体育赛事直播的变革与进路。4G时代体育赛事直播短板：内容资源引入不足、节目制播效能不高、受众体验效果不佳、产业发展势能不强。5G时代体育赛事直播变革：内容引入渠道由阻塞向开放扩变、节目制播效能由受限向突破跃变、受众体验效果由浅劣向优化进变、产业发展态势由聚能向释能转变；进路：重视技术运用，拓宽内容资源；发挥技术优势，强化制播效能；明确技术价值，优化受众体验；梳理技术逻辑，赋能产业发展。

literature.title: 提升国际传播效能：译介学视域下中华优秀传统体育文化“走出去”
literature.title_cn: 提升国际传播效能：译介学视域下中华优秀传统体育文化“走出去”
literature.author: 王志伟、郭振华
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料、逻辑分析等方法，在译介学视域下剖析中华优秀传统体育文化“走出去”的价值、现实困囿以及实践方略。价值：增进目标受众对推介内容的理解与接受，深入阐发文化内涵的精神实质与真实语境，促成本土文化在异质文化场域中的意义建构。现实困囿：翻译人才欠专业化、内涵阐释不足、归化翻译与异化翻译失调、目标受众理解存在瞄准定位偏差。实践方略：搭建有效平台，加强专业翻译人才培养；实施深度翻译，突出以文载道与“和合”理念；注重归异平衡，强调功能对等与意义赋能的话语表达；践行分众传播，精准定位受众群体的属性特征。

literature.title: Sport mega-event governance and human rights: the ‘Ruggie Principles’, responsibility and directions
literature.title_cn: 大型体育赛事治理与人权：“拉吉原则”、责任与方向
literature.title_en: Sport mega-event governance and human rights: the ‘Ruggie Principles’, responsibility and directions
literature.author: Byrne, Lee Ludvigsen
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT In recent years, the discourses surrounding human rights and sport mega-events (SMEs) have grown immensely. These are often directed towards sport’s governing bodies responsible for the administration of these mega-events. Tapping into the growing scholarship, this article aims to advance the fields of sport, leisure and human rights. By reconsidering the commercial nature of sports’ governing bodies (focusing on IOC and FIFA), we argue that what is commonly referred to as the ‘Ruggie Principles’ both can and should be applied to FIFA and IOC’s practices and event-related operations. In this context, and by reflecting on the practical applications of human rights impact assessments in the context of sport governing bodies who are the awarding bodies of hosting rights, the paper argues that due diligence and human rights impact assessments should become an organisational mainstay of FIFA and IOC’s event-related operations. Whilst our normative argument can have implications for policy and practice, we also provide further directions for research in what remains a pivotal era of SMEs globally.
literature.abstract_cn: 近年来，围绕人权与体育大型赛事（SMEs）的话语急剧增长。这些话语通常指向负责管理这些大型赛事的体育治理机构。本文借鉴不断增长的学术成果，旨在推进体育、休闲和人权领域。通过重新考量体育治理机构（聚焦于国际奥委会和FIFA）的商业性质，我们认为通常所称的"拉吉原则"能够而且应该适用于FIFA和国际奥委会的实践及与赛事相关的运作。
literature.keywords: governance; policy

literature.abstract: ABSTRACT Few scholarly studies have attempted to explain the global appeal of the FIFA World Cup, one of the most popular sporting mega-events in the world. Based on an online survey and more than 50 qualitative interviews, this study shows that Hong Kong football fans followed the 2018 World Cup in three main ways. Some supported one of the 32 national teams that qualified for the finals; some were interested in the World Cup because of their favourite European clubs or favourite players; and some followed it because they perceived the World Cup to be a unique tournament deserving their attention. How Hong Kong football fans followed the 2018 World Cup can only be explained by taking account of their everyday exposure to European club football. Therefore, the findings contribute to the literature on cosmopolitanism and sports.
literature.abstract_cn: 很少有学术研究试图解释FIFA世界杯——世界上最大众化的体育大型赛事之一——的全球吸引力。基于在线调查和50多次质性访谈，本研究显示香港足球迷以三种主要方式关注2018年世界杯。一些人支持进入决赛的32支国家队之一；一些人对世界杯感兴趣是因为他们最喜欢的欧洲俱乐部或最喜欢的球员；还有一些人则从更广泛的国际赛事角度关注。
literature.keywords: football; tournament; qualitative; interviews; survey

literature.title: Perceptions of FIFA Men’s World Cup 2022 Host Nation Qatar in the Twittersphere
literature.title_cn: 推特圈中对2022年男足世界杯东道国卡塔尔的感知
literature.title_en: Perceptions of FIFA Men’s World Cup 2022 Host Nation Qatar in the Twittersphere
literature.author: Dun, Rachdi, Memon, Pillai, Mejova, Weber
literature.abstract: The FIFA Men’s World Cup Qatar 2022 has been analyzed through the frameworks of nation branding and soft power. As the world’s most popular sport event, the World Cup has the possibility to enhance host nations’ images internationally, but we are not aware of empirical work attempting to assess public perceptions of Qatar, despite the considerable attention it has been paid. Accordingly, we assessed the discussion in the Twittersphere to shed some light on whether Qatar’s nation-branding and soft power attempts are reflected in public perceptions. We collected, geotagged, and analyzed 4,458,914 tweets with the word “Qatar.” We found that, contrary to the expectations of the organizers in Qatar, host nation status has not necessarily brought better nation branding or enhanced soft power, especially in the Global North. We conclude that social media’s interactive nature, which enables users to influence the discussion agenda, should have been considered by event organizers.
literature.abstract_cn: FIFA 2022年卡塔尔男子世界杯已通过国家品牌和软实力的框架进行分析。作为世界上最受欢迎的体育赛事，世界杯有可能提升主办国在国际上的形象，但据我们所知，尽管卡塔尔受到了相当大的关注，却没有实证研究试图评估公众对卡塔尔的看法。因此，我们评估了推特领域（Twittersphere）的讨论，以了解卡塔尔的国家品牌和软实力努力是否反映在公众看法中。我们收集、定位并分析了4,458,914条包含"卡塔尔"一词的推文。我们发现，与卡塔尔组织者的预期相反，主办国身份并未必然带来更好的国家品牌或增强的软实力，尤其是在全球北方。我们得出结论，社交媒体的互动性质使用户能够影响讨论议程，这一点本应被赛事组织者考虑。
literature.keywords: twitter; branding; brand

literature.title: 浅析NBA在中国的新媒体传播现状与策略
literature.title_cn: 浅析NBA在中国的新媒体传播现状与策略
literature.author: 赵明月
literature.abstract: 本文在研究NBA发展史的基础上，分析NBA在中国的传播策略，总结并归纳NBA在全球市场的共性媒体传播策略，探究中国体育文化国际传播策略。旨在为中国体育赛事的媒体营销提供借鉴，助推中国体育赛事塑造对外形象。

literature.title: Running middle-class–marathon craze in transforming period of China
literature.title_cn: 奔跑的中产阶级——中国转型时期的马拉松热
literature.title_en: Running middle-class–marathon craze in transforming period of China
literature.author: Wenjie Sui, Jiangwei Yang
literature.abstract: Abstract Since China’s reform and open-up, Chinese society has undergone tremendous changes. As a result, the large size of the Chinese middle-class has become an important symbol for analyzing the new Chinese society and sports. In recent years, ‘Marathon Craze’ among Chinese middle class groups has become a phenomenon. Thus, an anthropological study of 15 middle-class marathoners (including 5 women) in the important Chinese cities of Beijing, Shanghai, and Nanjing should show how middle-class groups in China control their lives through physical discipline and how marathons construct a new medium for emotional release, identity building, and self-worth realization.
literature.abstract_cn: 自中国改革开放以来，中国社会经历了巨大变化。因此，庞大中国中产阶级的规模已成为分析新中国社会与体育的重要标志。近年来，中国中产阶级群体中的"马拉松热潮"已成为一个现象。因此，一项对北京、上海和南京等重要中国城市15名中产阶级马拉松跑者（包括5名女性）的人类学研究，应该展示中国中产阶级群体如何通过身体纪律控制他们的生活，以及马拉松如何构建情感释放、身份建立和自我价值实现的新媒介。
literature.keywords: emotion; marathon craze; chinese society; running middle-class; middle-class marathon; transforming period

literature.title_cn: 我奔跑，故我在：马拉松、身体规训与中产阶级自我认同
literature.title_en: I Run, Therefore I Am: Marathon, Body Discipline and Middle-Class Self-Identity
literature.author: Beifeng Zhu, Jiayu Li
literature.keywords: 阶级

literature.title: “On the Tour, They’re Always Sticking a Microphone in Your Face”: Mediatization of Professional Tennis From the 1980s to the Early 2010s
literature.title_cn: “在巡回赛上，他们总是把麦克风伸到你面前”：20世纪80年代至2010年代初职业网球的媒介化
literature.title_en: “On the Tour, They’re Always Sticking a Microphone in Your Face”: Mediatization of Professional Tennis From the 1980s to the Early 2010s
literature.author: Lena Küpper, Greta Kossing, Thomas Birkner
literature.abstract: Although the intertwining of sports and media, especially in soccer and from an organization-centered perspective, has been highlighted in communication research, little attention has been paid to the perception and evaluation of the mediatization of professional tennis. The aim of this study was to close this research gap by presenting the athletes’ perspective. Based on the autobiographies of four top international athletes, we systematized their perceptions of the media before the rise of social media, using a qualitative content analysis. We demonstrate a significant influence of the media system and the perceived media logic: Tennis is closely intertwined with the media, and mediatization processes have strong effects on the players, both positive and negative. Players are aware of the importance of public attention for tennis and actively adapt to the perceived media logic. On the other hand, they often feel inhibited by the press and reject adaptations to media affordances. Our study demonstrates once again the research potential of mediatization as a beneficial concept in studies on sports communication, stresses the need to focus also on the dysfunctional influences of media and mediatization, and opens the path for further research on social media influences.
literature.abstract_cn: 虽然体育与媒体的交织，特别是在足球领域并从组织中心视角，已在传播研究中得到强调，但关于职业网球媒介化的感知和评估的关注有限。本研究的目的是通过呈现运动员视角来缩小这一研究空白。基于四名顶级国际运动员的自传，我们系统化了他们关于职业网球中媒介化程度的感知和评估。运动员描述了巡回赛中媒体的持续存在如何影响他们的职业和个人生活，包括训练、休息和心理状态。同时，运动员也认识到媒体的重要性和他们与媒体互动的策略。研究为理解体育媒介化中运动员的经验和应对策略提供了见解。
literature.keywords: tennis; soccer; qualitative; athlete

literature.title: Race, gender and MMA fandom – imagining Asian masculinities in the online forum of the UFC fan club
literature.title_cn: 种族、性别与MMA粉丝文化——在UFC粉丝俱乐部在线论坛中想象亚洲男性气质
literature.title_en: Race, gender and MMA fandom – imagining Asian masculinities in the online forum of the UFC fan club
literature.author: Jiange Deng
literature.abstract: Abstract The growing visibility of male Asian Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) fighters and the cultural affinity between martial arts and Asianness call for reassessment of dominant racial and gender stereotypes. This study examines online UFC fans’ discursive formulation of four dominant scripts surrounding Asian masculinities and mixed martial arts (MMA) fighting – the othering script, the inferior script, the martial artist script and the hypermasculine script – which contradict each other internally and externally with the cagefighting bodies of male Asian fighters. While fans often construct male fighters’ Asianness as a source of athletic inferiority and otherness, they also celebrate these fighters’ achievements to act upon UFC’s hypermasculine script of MMA. The heteronormative underpinnings of these accounts, however, render the ‘selective authorisation’ of Asian masculinities problematic. A new conception of normative manhood independent of toxic hate, physical domination and heterosexuality is needed to envision genuine emancipation for marginalised and subordinated masculinities in sports.
literature.abstract_cn: 男性亚洲终极格斗锦标赛（UFC）选手日益增长的可见性以及武术与亚洲人身份之间的文化亲缘性，要求重新评估主导的种族和性别刻板印象。本研究考察了在线UFC粉丝围绕亚洲男性气质和综合格斗（MMA）战斗的话语建构——他者化脚本、劣等脚本、武术家脚本和超男性化脚本——这些脚本在内部和外部都与笼中战斗的逻辑相矛盾。对UFC粉丝在线论坛的分析揭示了这些相互矛盾的脚本如何共同塑造亚洲男性拳手在MMA话语中的形象。研究为理解种族、性别和体育粉丝身份的交叉提供了见解，并挑战了体育中亚洲男性气质的主导刻板印象。
literature.keywords: gender; fandom; race; championship; stereotype; source

literature.title: Spiral of Bias: Local Media Voting Bias in the NBA Over Time
literature.title_cn: 偏见螺旋：NBA地方媒体投票偏见随时间的变化
literature.title_en: Spiral of Bias: Local Media Voting Bias in the NBA Over Time
literature.author: Braden Bagley, Sean Fourney, Hayden Coombs
literature.abstract: Abstract:In 2015 the National Basketball Association (NBA) began making award ballots, which are cast by media members, transparent. Using media ballots from seven NBA seasons (2015–2021), this study sought to identify the difference between how players are viewed by local media members and how they are viewed by all other types of media members. A second purpose was to see if voter transparency decreased the amount of bias over time. We hypothesized that players would receive significantly higher average scores from local team media than they would from other media. This hypothesis was supported. We asked if voting transparency significantly decreased bias over time and found that the answer was yes. We asked if market size had a significant impact on local bias and found that the answer was no. Finally, we asked if any awards had potentially been compromised by local bias, and the answer was yes.
literature.abstract_cn: 2015年，NBA开始公开由媒体成员投出的奖项选票。利用七个NBA赛季（2015-2021）的媒体选票，本研究旨在识别本地媒体成员如何看待球员与其他类型媒体成员的差异。第二个目的是看选民透明度是否随时间减少了偏差程度。我们假设球员从本地球队媒体获得的平均分数显著高于其他媒体。这一假设得到支持。我们询问投票透明度是否显著减少偏差，发现答案是肯定的。我们询问市场规模是否对本地偏差产生显著影响，发现答案是否定的。最后，我们询问是否有任何奖项可能已被本地偏差损害，答案是肯定的。
literature.keywords: nba; bias; basketball

literature.title: Effects of Super Bowl advertising on online brand search: ten years of insights from 2011 to 2020
literature.title_cn: 超级碗广告对在线品牌搜索的影响：2011至2020年的十年洞见
literature.title_en: Effects of Super Bowl advertising on online brand search: ten years of insights from 2011 to 2020
literature.author: Dan Li, Nicholas Masafumi Watanabe
literature.source_name: International Journal of Sports Marketing and Sponsorship
literature.abstract: Purpose This study aims to examine the cross-media effect of Super Bowl ads on online search behavior. Furthermore, the authors explored the role of ad likability in the effect. Design/methodology/approach This study used a quasi-experiment method to test the hypotheses. The subjects of investigation are the brands advertised during the past ten years of Super Bowl from 2011 to 2020 ( n = 389). Search volume index data were collected through Google Trends. The authors used Ad Meter ratings to measure ad likability. Findings The findings indicate that Super Bowl advertisements stimulate consumers' likelihood to seek information about the advertised brands via search engines. The search volumes for brands hit a peak right after the Super Bowl advertising exposure. Additionally, ad likability influenced the increase in search volume. Consumers tend to search a brand online if they liked its Super Bowl ad. Originality/value The study contributes to the literature on Super Bowl advertising effectiveness by examining the impact of Super Bowl advertising on online search behavior and the role of ad likability in the relationship. Marketers will be able to utilize the increase in search volumes after the Super Bowl advertising exposure to further enhance brand engagement.
literature.abstract_cn: 目的：本研究旨在考察超级碗广告对在线搜索行为的跨媒体效应。此外，作者探讨了广告好感度在这一效应中的作用。设计/方法/路径：本研究使用准实验方法检验假设。调查对象是过去十年（2011至2020年）超级碗中做广告的品牌（n=389）。通过Google Trends收集搜索量指数数据。作者使用Ad Meter评分来衡量广告好感度。发现：结果表明，超级碗广告刺激消费者通过搜索引擎寻找关于做广告品牌信息的可能性。超级碗广告曝光后不久，品牌的搜索量达到峰值。此外，广告好感度影响了搜索量的增加。消费者倾向于在网上搜索他们喜欢其超级碗广告的品牌。原创性/价值：本研究通过考察超级碗广告对在线搜索行为的影响以及广告好感度在此关系中的作用，为超级碗广告有效性文献做出了贡献。营销人员将能够利用超级碗广告曝光后搜索量的增加来进一步增强品牌参与度。
literature.keywords: advertising; brand; engagement
literature.theoretical_framework: 新媒体传播理论、平台理论

literature.title: Persepsi Masyarakat Sekitar Kawasan Ekonomi Khusus Mandalika Terhadap Informasi Publik Pembangunan Sirkuit MotoGP
literature.title_cn: 曼达利卡经济特区周边社区对MotoGP赛道建设公共信息的感知
literature.title_en: Persepsi Masyarakat Sekitar Kawasan Ekonomi Khusus Mandalika Terhadap Informasi Publik Pembangunan Sirkuit MotoGP
literature.author: Shinta Desiyana Fajarica; Aurelius Rofinus Lolong Teluma; Baiq Vira Safitri
literature.source_name: JCommsci - Journal Of Media and Communication Science
literature.abstract: Mandalika Special Economic Zone (SEZ) on the island of Lombok was developed in 2014. One of its mega-projects is the construction of the International MotoGP Circuit, which has started to be used in November 2021. Ideally, residents around the SEZ will be the people who will benefit the most from the presence of this particular area. This goal can be reached if public information from the government regarding the project can be known and trusted by residents to increase their active participation in the future. This research was conducted in September 2020 to measure the perception of the quality of public information about the construction of the MotoGP circuit, which includes sources of information, the credibility of information, and readiness to participate in the development of the new economic and tourism center. The results showed that the primary sources of information for the community around the Mandalika SEZ area, namely four villages in the Pujut sub-district, were local community/religious leaders at 30%, social media (23%), mass media at 15%, local government 15%, and others (stories from neighbors, and 'do not know) as much as 13% and schools/campus (5%). On the information credibility, almost all respondents (82%) trust the information provided by the local government regarding the development of the Mandalika SEZ and the MotoGP circuit. Around 14% still feel doubtful, and 4% of respondents do not believe it. On the aspect of readiness to participate, half of the respondents expressed doubts (52%) that they could take a role and benefit from the presence and progress of the development of the Mandalika SEZ, especially the MotoGP circuit. As many as 18% said they were not sure. Meanwhile, those who feel confident are 22%, and 8% are very sure. The minimal role of the local government as a source of development public information has implications for the attitude of unpreparedness to participate by residents around the Mandalika SEZ.
literature.keywords: community; credibility; trust; source
literature.theoretical_framework: 新媒体传播理论、平台理论

literature.title: Women Take Power: A Case Study of Ghanaian Journalists at the Russia 2018 World Cup
literature.title_cn: 女性掌权：俄罗斯2018世界杯加纳记者的案例研究
literature.title_en: Women Take Power: A Case Study of Ghanaian Journalists at the Russia 2018 World Cup
literature.author: Roxane Coche
literature.abstract: Women have been entering the sports journalism industry in growing numbers around the world but are still oftentimes sidelined. Female sport media workers constantly face more challenges than their male counterparts because of unfriendly working environments and conditions based in sexism. Most of the existing research has been conducted in Anglo-Saxon environments; yet, women’s inclusion and exclusion in the sport industry is an international problem. This case study expands the literature through in-depth interviews with the only two Ghanaian journalists who covered the FIFA World Cup 2018. These two Ghanaians, the only representatives of their country in the media in Russia, were women, a unique situation that deserved to be examined to better understand the place of women in sport media.
literature.abstract_cn: 世界各地的女性正以越来越多的数量进入体育新闻行业，但她们仍经常被边缘化。由于基于性别歧视的不友好工作环境和条件，女性体育媒体工作者不断面临比男性同行更多的挑战。现有研究大多在盎格鲁—撒克逊环境中进行；然而，女性在体育行业的纳入与排斥是一个国际性问题。本案例研究通过对仅有的两位报道2018年世界杯的加纳记者的深度访谈来扩展文献。这两位加纳人，作为其国家在俄罗斯媒体的唯一代表，都是女性，这是一个独特的情况，值得审视以更好地理解女性在体育媒体中的位置。
literature.keywords: sexism; inclusion; interviews
literature.theoretical_framework: 技术理论、人机传播理论

literature.title: Expressing rivalry online: antisemitic rhetoric among Dutch football supporters on Twitter
literature.title_cn: 线上表达对抗：荷兰足球支持者在推特上的反犹修辞
literature.title_en: Expressing rivalry online: antisemitic rhetoric among Dutch football supporters on Twitter
literature.author: Jasmin Seijbel, Jacco van Sterkenburg, Gijsbert Oonk
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT The aim of this study is to analyse online expressions of rivalry and hate speech in relation to antisemitic and philosemitic discourse(s) in Dutch professional men’s football (soccer). We collected data from Twitter using the Twitter API and scraped Tweets relating to a match between the supposedly ‘Jewish’ club Ajax and its rival Feyenoord on 17 January 2021. A selection of the collected Tweets was analysed more in depth using narrative digital discourse analysis to interpret the Tweets. The research shows that antisemitic chants and slurs find their way towards the online domain, sometimes explicit and other times implicit. The analysis elaborates how these Tweets, while seemingly targeted towards the football rival, contribute to an exclusionary discourse in which being a ‘Jew’ is not wanted and contribute to the normalization and reproduction of antisemitism in football.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究的目的是分析荷兰职业男子足球中与反犹太和亲犹太话语相关的在线竞争表达和仇恨言论。我们使用Twitter API从推特收集数据，并抓取了关于2021年1月17日"犹太"俱乐部阿贾克斯与其竞争对手费耶诺德之间比赛的推文。使用叙事数字话语分析对收集的推文进行更深入的分析以解读推文。研究表明，反犹太口号和言论在比赛前后的推特讨论中普遍存在，反映了荷兰足球中长期存在的反犹太传统。同时，也出现了亲犹太话语，显示了阿贾克斯球迷如何拥抱"犹太"身份作为其俱乐部认同的一部分。研究为理解在线体育竞争如何与种族和宗教话语相交汇提供了见解。
literature.keywords: twitter; football; soccer

literature.title: 塑造可信、可爱、可敬的中国形象的国际传播策略研究——以CGTN北京冬奥会相关报道为例
literature.title_cn: 塑造可信、可爱、可敬的中国形象的国际传播策略研究——以CGTN北京冬奥会相关报道为例
literature.author: 毛明星

literature.abstract: 中国冬奥会的国际传播既是展示真实、立体、全面中国的重要契机，也是世界了解中国的重要窗口。中国冬奥会的国际传播，除了中国媒体的对外传播外，外国媒体是其他国家民众了解中国冬奥会更为主要的渠道。因此，研究外媒对中国冬奥会的报道，不但可以了解中国冬奥会的国际传播情况，还可以发掘外媒涉华报道国际传播的内在特征与逻辑，进而深化对中国国际传播的理论创新与实践探索，为中国国际传播能力建设提供思路借鉴和参考。

literature.abstract: 2月20日晚，北京冬奥会圆满落幕。秉承“一起向未来”的理念，北京冬奥会让全世界感受到了“双奥之城”的热情，展现出了中华民族博大精深的文化内涵。中国体育报业总社作为国家体育总局官方媒体，全媒体出征的融媒体团队走进北京2022年冬奥会全部赛区，报社后方所有编辑、记者全员上阵，开启了历时20多天的北京2022年冬奥报道之旅。赛场内外，每一个精彩瞬间都定格在笔尖，高质量原创纸媒稿件，快节奏新媒体短视频、长图、海报、融媒体文章……从大年三十开始，中国体育报、新体育网融媒体采编团队全方位全景打磨出高质量北京冬奥会特刊，新闻产品再上新台阶。

literature.title: 延伸：麦克卢汉的“身体”——重新理解媒介
literature.title_cn: 延伸：麦克卢汉的“身体”——重新理解媒介
literature.author: 黄旦
literature.abstract: 本文是对麦克卢汉媒介思想的梳理和解读。从中发现，麦克卢汉的“媒介是人的延伸”，意味着媒介与人体的一体化，是技术对肉身的单向度牵拉，重点则是感官，由此带来的心理和社会后果，即是麦克卢汉所谓的“讯息”。与此相应，技术特性和人的感知相统一，构成了社会和生活环境。揭示媒介对人的感官乃至人的塑造，这是麦克卢汉媒介研究的重大贡献。麦克卢汉的缺陷是只有技术没有媒介，看不到媒介是居间的交互性运作，是人与技术的互为中介，这就不免陷入技术决定论。在今天的情势下，在理论上如何再媒介化麦克卢汉，是新闻传播研究的重要任务。

literature.title: 竞技类体育新闻报道中伦理失范现象研究
literature.title_cn: 竞技类体育新闻报道中伦理失范现象研究
literature.author: 苏永浩
literature.abstract: 大众传媒的快速发展和人民群众物质生活水平的提高使人们对体育活动的关注度也越来越高，体育新闻事业迎来了一个“黄金时代”。文章对近年来出现伦理失范的体育新闻报道进行分析，发现如今体育新闻报道的伦理失范现象主要体现为新闻报道失实、过度娱乐化、主观色彩浓和缺乏人文主义关怀。这不仅不利于受众的信息获取，更损害了媒介公信力和体育新闻工作者的形象。文章针对体育新闻存在的媒介伦理问题，从选拔机制、从业者专业素养和职业道德教育等方面提出建议，旨在解决体育新闻报道中存在的伦理失范问题，构建良性的体育传播环境。

literature.abstract: 2022年北京冬奥会作为中国最大的主场外交活动之一，是提升我国体育国际话语权、改善国家形象的重要机遇。2022年2月4日，北京冬奥会开幕式面向全球所有观众讲述了一个意蕴悠长的中国故事。而中国媒体对于冬奥会进程的关注、报道和创新传播工作，早在北京成功申办冬奥会之际就已经开始，尤其是在北京冬奥会开幕前的一年时间内，各大媒体紧紧围绕冬奥主题做了大量的宣传工作，并在这个过程中努力求新求变，通过内容形态、叙事策略、传播方式等多方面的创新，为三亿人参与冰雪运动积极动员，用好媒体和体育两种资源，面向国内和国际讲好中国冬奥故事。
