literature.title: Extractives Companies’ Social Media Portrayals of Their Funding of Sport for Development in Indigenous Communities in Canada and Australia
literature.title_cn: 采掘公司在社交媒体上对其资助加拿大与澳大利亚原住民社区体育促进发展项目的呈现
literature.title_en: Extractives Companies’ Social Media Portrayals of Their Funding of Sport for Development in Indigenous Communities in Canada and Australia
literature.author: Steven Latino, Audrey R. Giles, Steven Rynne, Lyndsay Hayhurst
literature.abstract: The extractives industry (mining, quarrying, oil, and gas) engages in corporate social responsibility (CSR) activities to reinforce its organizational legitimacy and enhance its public image. One such approach to CSR that is popular in the industry is through funding sport initiatives aimed at improving the lives of Indigenous peoples, known as sport for development (SFD). Through the adoption of a settler colonial studies lens, and using netnographic methods and discourse analysis, we examined how three extractives companies portray their funding of SFD in Indigenous communities in Canada and Australia on social media, and the ways in which it contributes to settler colonialism. We determined that there are two main discourses that extractive companies use: i) Extractives companies “help” and “partner” with Indigenous communities to enable Indigenous youth’s access to the transformative power of sport; ii) longevity is strategically associated with such “help” and “partnership.” The production of these discourses enables extractives companies to downplay their contributions to settler colonialism through land denigration and colonial authority.
literature.abstract_cn: 采掘业（采矿、采石、石油和天然气）从事企业社会责任（CSR）活动以加强其组织合法性和提升公共形象。该行业流行的一种CSR方法是通过资助旨在改善原住民生活的体育倡议，即所谓的"体育促进发展"（SFD）。通过采用定居者殖民研究视角，并利用网络民族志方法和话语分析，我们考察了三家采掘公司如何在其社交媒体上呈现对印度尼西亚SFD项目的资助。分析揭示，这些公司在呈现其SFD资助时，采用了某种叙事框架，该框架既强调了其对原住民社区的贡献，又回避了对采掘活动本身对原住民土地和环境影响的批判性讨论。这种呈现策略反映并加强了定居者殖民结构的延续。
literature.keywords: access; extractives companies; indigenous communities; social media; settler colonialism; sport for development

literature.title: “Posting More than Just a Black Square”: National Collegiate Athletic Association Student-Athletes’ Perceptions of the Athletic Department’s Role in Social Media, Racial Justice, and the Black Lives Matter Movement
literature.title_cn: “发的远不止一个黑方块”：NCAA学生运动员对体育部在社交媒体、种族正义与黑命贵运动中作用的感知
literature.title_en: “Posting More than Just a Black Square”: National Collegiate Athletic Association Student-Athletes’ Perceptions of the Athletic Department’s Role in Social Media, Racial Justice, and the Black Lives Matter Movement
literature.author: Natalie Bunch, Beth A. Cianfrone
literature.abstract: There is a rise in athletes and sports organizations utilizing social media activism to discuss social injustices. Social media staff are tasked with communicating such messages, often with little insight into how it impacts their athletes. Empirical research is necessary to understand the perspectives of athletes to inform best practices for the staff. The purpose of this study was to assess college student-athletes’ perceptions of their athletic departments’ involvement in promoting racial justice and the Black Lives Matter movement on social media. We surveyed 273 student-athletes from 40 universities for their perspectives. Quantitatively, we explored four factors: affective responses to the posts, perceived conflict, the role of the athletic department in using social media to discuss the topic, and the perceived qualifications of the athletic department to post about the topic. MANOVA revealed Black student-athletes were significantly more likely to believe that it was the athletic department’s role to address racial justice than their non-Black counterparts, with no significant differences in the other three factors. Qualitatively, student-athletes’ reactions were classified into three themes: social activism communication strategy, strategies to develop race conscious culture, and challenges to social media activism. Athletic department staff can utilize the findings to implement a strategy.
literature.abstract_cn: 运动员和体育组织利用社交媒体行动主义来讨论社会不公正现象的情况正在增加。社交媒体工作人员负责传播此类信息，往往对如何影响其运动员缺乏深入了解。需要进行实证研究来理解运动员的观点，为工作人员的最佳实践提供参考。本研究旨在评估大学生运动员对其体育部门社交媒体行动主义努力的看法。通过调查，研究考察了运动员如何感知其所在部门在社交媒体上参与社会正义议题的行为，以及这些行动如何影响运动员的认同和归属感。研究发现揭示了运动员对部门社交媒体行动主义的不同看法，以及这种行动主义如何影响运动员的大学体育体验。
literature.keywords: athlete; race; qualitative; quantitative; survey

literature.title: Informing Future Paralympic Media Approaches: The Perspective of Canadian Paralympic Athletes
literature.title_cn: 为未来残奥媒体路径提供信息：加拿大残奥运动员的视角
literature.title_en: Informing Future Paralympic Media Approaches: The Perspective of Canadian Paralympic Athletes
literature.author: Erin Pearson, Laura Misener
literature.abstract: Media coverage of the Paralympic Games can affect how athletes with impairment and disability sport are perceived by the public. Researchers investigating media representations of disability sport have focused on how Paralympic athletes and disability sport are represented by the media. Limited research, however, has examined how Paralympic athletes perceive these representations of themselves and the meanings they attribute to such representations. The purpose of this study was to examine how Paralympic athletes make meaning of discourses of disability within Paralympic coverage. This involved semi-structured photo-elicitation interviews with eight Canadian Paralympic athletes. A reflexive thematic analysis (RTA) was used to analyze the data utilizing Foucault’s notions of discourse, power, and technologies of the self. The findings demonstrate that Paralympic athletes made meaning of the discourses of disability within Paralympic media coverage by drawing on their lived and media experiences. Athletes with more media experience articulated problematizations of dominant discourses of disability in Paralympic media coverage and engagement in technologies of the self. Knowledge generated from this study offers media personnel an informed understanding of how Paralympic athletes understand representations of disability and disability sport. This knowledge may offer insight and inform future media approaches of disability sport and the Paralympic Games.
literature.abstract_cn: 残奥会的媒体报道会影响公众如何感知残障运动员和残障体育。调查残障体育媒体呈现的研究者聚焦于残奥运动员和残障体育是如何被媒体呈现的。然而，很少有研究考察残奥运动员如何看待这些关于自己的呈现以及他们赋予这些呈现的意义。本研究的目的是考察残奥运动员如何在残奥会报道中建构关于残障话语的意义。这涉及对八名加拿大残奥运动员的半结构化照片诱导访谈。采用反思性主题分析（RTA）分析数据，运用福柯关于话语、权力的概念。
literature.keywords: athlete; paralympic; representation; interviews; engagement

literature.title: Systematic Sexism: Women’s Sports News in a Circle of Gatekeepers and Users on Twitter
literature.title_cn: 系统性的性别歧视：把关者与用户循环中的女性体育新闻
literature.title_en: Systematic Sexism: Women’s Sports News in a Circle of Gatekeepers and Users on Twitter
literature.author: Bünyamin Ayhan, Yavuz Demir
literature.abstract: The main purpose of this research is to determine how conventional and digital sports content producers in Turkey present women’s sports news on Twitter, as well as “how much, where, how, why, and when” these stories are shared, as well as “who” the Twitter users are and “what” are they saying in their comments. Between June 25 and July 31, 2022, a sample of Twitter accounts and tweets were reviewed. It was found that 3.41% ( n = 612) of the 17,932 sports news items examined were reserved for women’s sports news. It was discovered that the gatekeepers in the news employed language that highlight failure, sexism, and personal life as well as instructive and successful expressions in women’s sports news. Additionally, 85.54% ( n = 888) of the comments included comments about women’s bodies, sexist stereotypes, and compared negative expressions. The majority of the comments ( n = 1038) on female sports news studied on Twitter were posted by male users ( n = 962). The language users use in their comments on sports news on Twitter, presented by traditional and digital sports content producers, support the patriarchal and dominant structure in the world of sports and sports media.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究的主要目的是确定土耳其的传统和数字体育内容生产者在推特上如何呈现女性体育新闻，以及这些故事"多少、何地、如何、为何、何时"被分享，以及推特用户"是谁"、他们在评论中"说什么"。在2022年6月25日至7月31日期间，对推特账户和推文样本进行了审查。研究发现，所审查的17,932条体育新闻中，仅有3.41%（n=612）保留给女性体育新闻。研究发现，新闻中的把关人使用的语言强调失败、性别歧视和个人生活，以及女性体育新闻中的教诲性和成功性表达。此外，85.54%（n=888）的评论包含关于女性身体的评论。
literature.keywords: sexism; twitter; stereotype
literature.theoretical_framework: 性别理论、女性主义传播理论

literature.title: Gender, Sports, and Cultural Barometers: The State of Play in the Year 2022
literature.title_cn: 性别、体育与文化晴雨表：2022年的现状
literature.title_en: Gender, Sports, and Cultural Barometers: The State of Play in the Year 2022
literature.author: Andrew C. Billings, Marie Hardin
literature.keywords: 体育; 性别

literature.title: A U.S. Medal Agenda? Clock-Time and Salience Analyses of Biological Sex Representation in the 2020 and 2022 NBC Olympic Telecasts
literature.title_cn: 美国奖牌议程？NBC 2020与2022奥运转播中生理性别呈现的时钟时间与显著性分析
literature.title_en: A U.S. Medal Agenda? Clock-Time and Salience Analyses of Biological Sex Representation in the 2020 and 2022 NBC Olympic Telecasts
literature.author: James R. Angelini, Zachary W. Arth
literature.abstract: This report examines how the National Broadcasting Company’s (NBC’s) primetime telecasts of the 2020 Tokyo Summer Olympic Games and the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympic Games presented male and female athletes. Clock-time analyses (of how much time each sporting event was featured in primetime) and salience analyses (of the most mentioned athletes by NBC employees) are reported. Results show that women received the majority of clock-time and name mentions during both Olympiads, a further continuation of NBC’s most recent Olympic broadcast practices, which appears to continue to be driven by American women winning the majority of the United States’ medals during both the Summer and Winter Games.
literature.abstract_cn: 本报告考察了国家广播公司（NBC）对2020年东京夏季奥运会和2022年北京冬季奥运会的黄金时段转播如何呈现男性和女性运动员。报告了时钟时间分析（每项体育赛事在黄金时段播出多少时间）和显著性分析（NBC员工提及最多的运动员）。结果显示，在两届奥运会上，女性都获得了大部分播报时间和姓名提及次数，这是NBC最近奥运转播实践趋势的进一步延续。研究还考察了美国奖牌议程如何影响生物性别的代表性，为理解奥运会转播中的性别呈现提供了新视角。
literature.keywords: representation; broadcasting; athlete
literature.theoretical_framework: 性别理论、女性主义传播理论

literature.title: A Public Service? Mediatization of the Olympic Games in Croatia and Slovenia
literature.title_cn: 公共服务？克罗地亚与斯洛文尼亚奥运会的媒介化
literature.title_en: A Public Service? Mediatization of the Olympic Games in Croatia and Slovenia
literature.author: Simon Ličen, Dunja Antunovic, Sunčica Bartoluci
literature.abstract: The Olympic Games are the largest mediated sporting mega-event, and broadcasters are instrumental in ensuring their exposure and financial viability. In the digital era, the Olympics navigate technological and societal changes that contest the values of sport, carry political and economic implications, and shape the relationship between the organizers and nation states. These interdependencies vary by global regions. This study examines the mediatization of sport as manifested in digital Olympic content published on Facebook during the Tokyo Olympics by public service media (PSM) in Croatia and Slovenia—two countries inconsistently assigned to either Central and Eastern Europe or Southeast Europe. These PSM face a host of challenges, including rising media rights costs, digitalization, and political interference, while continuing to broadcast the Olympics. On their Facebook pages, contest-related updates were the primary type of content, general news and especially human interest content was rare, critical posts were virtually non-existent, and “home” athletes were politicized conspicuously. Mediatization in this region seems delayed, facilitates event-focused and decontextualized sport content, and appears central in promoting patriotic narratives. On social media, broadcasters perpetuate problematic practices characteristic of sport media and only partially fulfill the roles traditionally ascribed to PSM.
literature.abstract_cn: 奥运会是最大的媒介化体育大型赛事，广播商在确保其曝光度和财务可行性方面发挥着关键作用。在数字时代，奥运会应对着技术和社会变化，这些变化挑战体育的价值，带有政治和经济影响，并塑造组织者与民族国家之间的关系。这些相互依存因全球地区而异。本研究考察了体育的媒介化，体现在克罗地亚和斯洛文尼亚的公共服务媒体（PSM）在东京奥运会期间在Facebook上发布的数字奥运内容中——这两个国家被不一致地归入中欧和东欧或东南欧。这些PSM面临一系列挑战，包括日益上涨的媒体版权成本、数字化和政治干预，同时继续转播奥运会。在他们的Facebook页面上，比赛相关的更新是主要内容类型，一般新闻尤其是人文内容是罕见的，批评性帖子几乎不存在，而"本国"运动员被显著地政治化。该地区的媒介化似乎滞后，促进了以赛事为中心和去情境化的体育内容，并在推动爱国主义叙事方面显得核心。在社交媒体上，广播商延续了体育媒体的特征性有问题的实践，并且只部分履行了传统上归于PSM的角色。
literature.keywords: facebook; olympics; athlete

literature.title: Beyond Crisis? Institutionalized Mediatization of the Refugee Olympic Team at the 2020 Olympic Games
literature.title_cn: 危机之外？2020年奥运会难民奥运代表队的制度化媒介化
literature.title_en: Beyond Crisis? Institutionalized Mediatization of the Refugee Olympic Team at the 2020 Olympic Games
literature.author: Daniel Burdsey, Enrico Michelini, Sine Agergaard
literature.abstract: Following the global “refugee crisis” of 2015, the International Olympic Committee (IOC) established the Refugee Olympic Team (ROT), providing opportunities for refugee athletes to compete at the 2016 and 2020 (2021) Summer Olympics. To examine the changing intertwinements between wider social dynamics and mediated constructions of refugees, this article considers the IOC’s representation of the ROT around the 2020 Games. With this aim, a catalogue of articles published on the IOC’s website was examined through critical discourse analysis. Four discursive themes emerged: 1. The saving, healing and transformative power of Western sporting capital and the Olympic Games; 2. The ROT as epitome of the Global North’s inclusivity and benevolence; 3. Refugee athletes as offering hope and inspiration to other refugees; and 4. The neoliberal ideal that “hard work pays off” and “you can overcome everything” in and through sport. More broadly, current changes in the societal reception of refugees were evident in the IOC’s communication, which appeared to assume that we have moved beyond the “refugee crisis”. The IOC disseminates an “official” discourse, which elides the challenging structural conditions that refugees face after their arrival in receiving contexts, and obscures current political reluctance towards finding more long-term solutions for refugees.
literature.abstract_cn: 在2015年全球"难民危机"之后，国际奥委会（IOC）成立了难民奥运队（ROT），为难民运动员参加2016年和2020（2021）年夏季奥运会提供了机会。为考察更广泛的社会动态与难民媒介建构之间不断变化的交织关系，本文考察了IOC在2020年奥运会前后对ROT的呈现。为此，通过批判性话语分析检查了IOC网站上发表的文章目录。浮现出四个话语主题：1.西方体育资本和奥运会的拯救、治愈和变革力量；2.ROT作为难民运动员赋权的典范；3.难民运动员身份的缩减和标准化；4.作为IOC人道主义形象工具的ROT。分析揭示了IOC如何通过ROT呈现来构建其人道主义形象，同时限制了难民运动员身份的复杂性和多样性。
literature.keywords: olympics; representation; athlete
literature.theoretical_framework: 媒介化理论、话语分析理论、危机传播理论

literature.title: Let’s Watch Live Streaming: How Streamer Credibility Influences Brand Attitude in Esports Streamer Marketing
literature.title_cn: 来看直播：电竞主播营销中主播可信度如何影响品牌态度
literature.title_en: Let’s Watch Live Streaming: How Streamer Credibility Influences Brand Attitude in Esports Streamer Marketing
literature.author: Qingru Xu, Hanyoung Kim, Andrew C. Billings
literature.abstract: This study explores if and how perceived Esports streamer credibility influences the audience’s attitude toward the brand endorsed by the streamer. Results from a survey conducted with US adults ( N = 277) show the significant and positive relationship between streamer credibility and brand attitude while identifying parasocial relationships and streamer loyalty as two factors mediating the impact of streamer credibility on brand attitude. Structural equation modeling analysis is used to reveal how perceived expertise and trustworthiness of an Esports streamer affect viewer attitudes toward the promoted brands, with theoretical and practical implications outlined.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了感知的电竞主播可信度是否以及如何影响受众对被主播代言的品牌的态度。对美国成年人（N=277）进行的调查结果显示，主播可信度与品牌态度之间存在显著正向关系，同时确定准社会关系和主播忠诚度是主播可信度影响品牌态度的两个中介因素。使用结构方程模型分析揭示了感知的电竞主播专业知识和可信度如何影响观众对推广品牌的态度，并概述了理论和实践意义。
literature.keywords: streaming; esports; credibility; marketing; brand; audience

literature.title: Paralympic Broadcasting in Sub-Saharan Africa: Sport, Media and Communication for Social Change
literature.title_cn: 撒哈拉以南非洲的残奥转播：为促进社会变革的体育、媒体与传播
literature.title_en: Paralympic Broadcasting in Sub-Saharan Africa: Sport, Media and Communication for Social Change
literature.author: Jessica Noske-Turner, Emma Pullen, Mufunanji Magalasi, Damian Haslett, Jo Tacchi
literature.abstract: The purpose of this commentary is to discuss how Paralympic coverage in sub-Saharan Africa can be effectively mobilised to stimulate discursive and structural change around disability. Paralympic coverage has demonstrated its pedagogical power to engage public(s) and challenge stigma toward disability. Yet, the Global picture of Paralympic broadcasting is deeply uneven, with audiences in parts of the Global South afforded limited opportunities to watch the Games. Considering this, the International Paralympic Committee has begun to broadcast Paralympic coverage across sub-Saharan Africa with an explicit aim to challenge stigma toward disability. In this article, we draw on examples from research to argue that ideas from the field of Communication for Social Change (CfSC) can add value towards this aim. We begin by providing a brief overview of CfSC before critically examining one of the field’s key concepts – Communicative (E)ecologies. Following this, we critically reflect on the potential of Paralympic broadcasting as a vehicle for social change and disability rights agendas in sub-Saharan Africa. We argue that thinking with CfSC concepts show the importance of a ‘decentred’ media approach that engages with disability community advocacy groups, localised communication activities and practices, and culturally specific disability narratives.
literature.abstract_cn: 本评论的目的是讨论如何有效动员撒哈拉以南非洲的残奥会报道，以促进围绕残疾的话语和结构性变革。残奥会报道展示了其教育力量，能够吸引公众并挑战对残疾的污名。然而，残奥会转播的全球图景极不均衡，全球南方部分地区的观众观看比赛的机会有限。考虑到这一点，国际残奥委员会已开始在部分全球南方地区转播残奥会。本文讨论了扩大残奥会转播覆盖的机遇和挑战，以及如何将体育、媒体和传播用作社会变革的工具，以改善非洲残疾人群体的生活和可见度。
literature.keywords: broadcasting; paralympic; audience; community; advocacy; disability
literature.theoretical_framework: 叙事理论、受众研究理论

literature.title: Speaking Up and Speaking Out: Collective Voice in Women’s Sports Media
literature.title_cn: 大声疾呼：女性体育媒体中的集体发声
literature.title_en: Speaking Up and Speaking Out: Collective Voice in Women’s Sports Media
literature.author: Monica Crawford
literature.abstract: This qualitative textual analysis considers “voice” in a new sports media platform Just Women’s Sports. Using communicative injustice and collective voice as its theoretical framework, this study considers whose voices are represented in women’s sports media and how those voices are represented. The unique position of Just Women’s Sports as a news outlet independent from mixed-gender sports media outlets and funded by venture capital investments makes it an interesting case study to consider new avenues in sports media production. The findings of this study indicate that Just Women’s Sports’s voice consists of diverse women who promote an inclusive and activist community. Furthermore, this study provides a theoretical intervention in the study of women’s sports media by introducing communicative injustice as an informative theoretical lens.
literature.abstract_cn: 本定性文本分析考察了新体育媒体平台"女性体育"（Just Women's Sports）中的"声音"。以传播不公正和集体声音为理论框架，本研究考察了女性体育媒体中呈现了谁的声音以及这些声音如何被呈现。"女性体育"作为独立于混合性别体育媒体、由风险投资资助的新闻机构的独特地位，使其成为考察体育媒体生产新途径的有趣案例研究。研究结果表明，"女性体育"的声音由多元女性组成，她们促进了一个包容和行动主义的社区。此外，本研究通过引入传播不公正作为富有启发性的理论视角，为女性体育媒体研究提供了理论介入。
literature.keywords: gender; qualitative; community

literature.title: A Fracturing Profession on Shifting Terrain: Challenges and Directions for Sports Journalism
literature.title_cn: 变迁地形上的分化职业：体育新闻的挑战与方向
literature.title_en: A Fracturing Profession on Shifting Terrain: Challenges and Directions for Sports Journalism
literature.author: Marie Hardin, Andrew C. Billings
literature.keywords: 体育新闻; 体育

literature.title: "It's Impossible": Local Sports Broadcasters and the Prospect of Motherhood
literature.title_cn: “那是不可能的”：地方体育转播者与母职的前景
literature.title_en: "It's Impossible": Local Sports Broadcasters and the Prospect of Motherhood
literature.author: Kevin Hull, Miles Romney, Kirstin Pellizzaro, Denetra Walker
literature.abstract: Abstract:Local sports broadcasters work long hours, make little money, and often perform a host of different tasks in the newsroom and out in the field. Adding the prospect of also being a mother, the job can seem impossible. A survey of local female sports broadcasters throughout the United States found that the majority of them have delayed starting a family due to their perceptions of work requirements and worry about their employment if they became pregnant.
literature.abstract_cn: 地方体育转播员工作时间长、收入少，且经常在新闻编辑室和外勤中承担一系列不同的任务。再加上成为母亲的可能性，这项工作似乎变得不可能。一项对美国各地地方女性体育转播员的调查发现，由于对工作要求的认知以及担心怀孕后的就业状况，大多数人都推迟了组建家庭。
literature.keywords: survey; newsroom

literature.title: “Cowing to the Unnecessary Pressures”: Examining Story Forms Sports Journalists Employ for Sports-Related Sociopolitical Issues
literature.title_cn: “屈服于不必要的压力”：体育记者报道体育相关社会政治议题时采用的故事形式
literature.title_en: “Cowing to the Unnecessary Pressures”: Examining Story Forms Sports Journalists Employ for Sports-Related Sociopolitical Issues
literature.author: Ryan Broussard
literature.abstract: Abstract:The sports pages have historically been economic drivers for newspapers, and editors have maintained cozy relationships with the entities they cover, both of which have led to a laissez-faire attitude about the journalism aspect of sports journalism. But with sports and social issues intersecting in a way unseen, with a few exceptions, since the 1960s, sports reporters can no longer ignore these stories. The questions then become, how are they covering these stories, and why do the story forms vary? This study answers those questions using a combination of interviews with 20 journalists and aspects of Bourdieu’s field theory. The results provide three main takeaways: (1) Journalists take a position in the field depending on which stories they cover and which of the four main story types they use to cover sociopolitical issues related to sports: humanity stories, investigative deep dives, off-the-field issues, and hot takes. (2) Economics play a factor in the decision whether to cover these issues. (3) Not all sports reporters have the skills to cover these issues or employ certain story types. Findings are placed in the context of field theory concepts.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育版面历来是报纸的经济驱动力，编辑与所报道对象保持着密切关系，这两者都导致了对体育新闻的新闻性方面采取放任态度。但随着体育与社会议题以自1960年代以来少有的方式交汇，体育记者再也无法忽视这些故事。接下来的问题是：他们如何报道这些故事，为什么故事形式各不相同？本研究通过结合对20名记者的访谈和布迪厄场域理论的要素来回答这些问题。结果提供了三个主要结论：（1）记者在场域中采取的立场取决于他们报道哪些故事，以及他们使用四种主要故事类型中的哪一种来报道与体育相关的社会政治议题：人性故事、深度调查、场外议题和热门观点。（2）经济因素在是否报道这些议题的决定中起作用。（3）并非所有体育记者都具备报道这些议题或使用某些故事类型的技能。研究发现被置于场域理论概念的语境中。
literature.keywords: interviews; reporter

literature.title: The Fantasy Sport Context: Altering the Uses and Gratifications of Sports Fandom
literature.title_cn: 幻想体育语境：改变体育粉丝文化的使用与满足
literature.title_en: The Fantasy Sport Context: Altering the Uses and Gratifications of Sports Fandom
literature.author: Brody James Ruihley, Nicholas Buzzelli, Andrew Billings
literature.abstract: Abstract:One might falsely classify fantasy sport as simple games played as an ancillary activity to real sporting activity; in actuality, it is much more. As an industry comprised of entrepreneurs, businesspersons, writers, developers, graphic designers, statisticians, publishers, and mass communication outlets, the fantasy sport industry boasts a U.S. participation rate of 45.9 million (Fantasy Sports and Gaming Association, 2022). Moreover, this is an ideal user base, as it is active, immersed, and consuming sports content at astonishing rates when compared to all other forms of sports fandom. With this young industry constantly in a state of flux, this research serves as an updated insight into participation rates, profiles, tendencies, and motivations.
literature.abstract_cn: 人们可能错误地将幻想体育归类为作为真实体育活动的辅助活动的简单游戏；实际上，它远不止于此。作为由企业家、商人、作家、开发者、平面设计师、统计学家、出版商和大众传播机构组成的行业，幻想体育产业声称美国参与率为4,590万（幻想体育和博彩协会，2022年）。此外，这是一个理想的用户群体，因为与所有其他形式的体育粉丝相比，他们活跃、沉浸并以惊人的速度消费体育内容。随着这个年轻行业不断变化，这项研究作为对幻想体育粉丝使用与满足模式的更新洞察。研究考察了幻想体育如何改变体育粉丝身份的使用与满足，包括知识获取、社交互动、竞争性和娱乐等方面。研究发现，幻想体育提供了独特的满足体验，但也改变了传统体育粉丝的消费模式。
literature.keywords: fandom; gaming

literature.title: NFL Player Protests, Corporate Social Responsibility, and Diversion in Sport Crisis
literature.title_cn: NFL球员抗议、企业社会责任与体育危机中的转移
literature.title_en: NFL Player Protests, Corporate Social Responsibility, and Diversion in Sport Crisis
literature.author: Virginia S. Harrison, Sara Erlichman
literature.abstract: Abstract:The 2018 Super Bowl presented an opportunity for the National Football League (NFL) to address its season-long controversy surrounding its players' demonstrations during the national anthem—yet the league did not take a specific stance, employing the communication tactic of diversion. This study seeks to understand the effects of the NFL's crisis management strategy of diversion on organizational reputation and perceptions of the need for corporate social responsibility (CSR). Fans' support for the NFL's response and CSR messaging positively impacted reputation, while fans' support for players and their cause negatively impacted reputation. Fans' current feelings about the NFL further showed frustration with past and present crises. Implications for crisis management in sport organizations and calls for inclusion in setting communication strategy are discussed.
literature.abstract_cn: 2018年超级碗为美国国家橄榄球联盟（NFL）提供了一个解决其球员在国歌期间进行示威的整个赛季争议的机会——然而联盟没有采取具体立场，而是采用了转移注意力的传播策略。本研究旨在理解NFL的转移注意力危机管理策略对组织声誉和对企业社会责任（CSR）需求认知的影响。粉丝对NFL回应和CSR信息传递的支持对声誉产生了积极影响，而粉丝对球员及其事业的支持对声誉产生了消极影响。粉丝当前对NFL的感受进一步显示了对过去和当前危机的沮丧。文章讨论了体育组织危机管理的启示，以及在制定传播策略时纳入包容性的呼吁。
literature.keywords: protest; football; inclusion; feeling

literature.title: Social Media, Crisis, and College Sport: An Analysis of Three Crises
literature.title_cn: 社交媒体、危机与大学体育：三次危机分析
literature.title_en: Social Media, Crisis, and College Sport: An Analysis of Three Crises
literature.author: Amanda Roussin, Evan Frederick, Ann Pegoraro
literature.abstract: Abstract:The purpose of this study was to analyze how three universities utilized image repair to address crises involving their athletic departments. Specifically, this study analyzed how the University of Missouri–Columbia, Baylor University, and the University of Louisville employed Facebook to engage in image repair. Additionally, this study examined users’ responses to these image-repair strategies via the theoretical framework of framing. A deductive thematic analysis was employed to examine image-repair strategies, while an inductive thematic analysis was employed to examine users’ comments. The data analysis revealed that the most frequently employed strategies across all three universities were bolstering, stonewalling, and corrective action. The employment of similar image-repair strategies by all three universities suggests that despite the varying level of institutional crisis, universities mostly rely on bolstering and diversionary techniques to disrupt the media noise surrounding the crisis faced by their athletic departments, while employing corrective action minimally in the hopes of making maximum impact. Additionally, this study highlights the ability of audiences to utilize social media to generate narratives via bottom-up framing. Findings suggest that these narratives often shift due to the timing of image-repair efforts and the severity of the institution’s crisis.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究的目的是分析三所大学如何利用形象修复来应对涉及体育部门的危机。具体而言，本研究分析了密苏里大学哥伦比亚分校、贝勒大学和路易斯维尔大学如何利用Facebook进行形象修复。此外，本研究通过框架的理论框架考察了用户对这些形象修复策略的反应。采用演绎式主题分析来考察形象修复策略，而采用归纳式主题分析来考察用户评论。数据分析显示，三所大学最常采用的策略是强化、拖延和纠正行动。三所大学采用相似的形象修复策略表明，尽管制度危机的程度不同，大学主要依赖强化和转移注意力的技术来打破围绕其体育部门所面临危机的媒体噪音，同时最小限度地采用纠正行动以期产生最大影响。此外，本研究强调了受众利用社交媒体通过自下而上的框架生成叙事的能力。研究发现，这些叙事常常因形象修复努力的时机和机构危机的严重程度而改变。
literature.keywords: framing; audience; facebook

literature.title: Sport, gender, and national interest during the Olympics: A comparative analysis of media representations in Central and Eastern Europe
literature.title_cn: 奥运期间的体育、性别与国家利益：中欧与东欧媒体呈现的比较分析
literature.title_en: Sport, gender, and national interest during the Olympics: A comparative analysis of media representations in Central and Eastern Europe
literature.author: Dunja Antunovic, Sunčica Bartoluci
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Researchers have documented patterns in sports media coverage across a variety of geographical and media contexts extensively, but relatively few studies focus on the Central and Eastern European region. This study examines the agenda diversity of European public service media in Hungary, Croatia, and Slovenia on their sport-related Facebook accounts during the 2020 Tokyo Olympic Games. A content analysis identified featured sports, gender balance, and the role of national interest in the events and athletes represented. Sports agenda diversity was driven by the hegemony of men's football and national success at the Olympics. Gender imbalance in media coverage persists in the region even on public service broadcasters’ social media accounts. Women received coverage only when representing the home nation at an Olympic event. The hegemony of men's football is a transnational phenomenon, while Olympic coverage emphasizes sports that share historical associations with national identity. Sports agenda diversity in the three countries is heterogeneous and regionally distinct. In practice, broadcasters might temporarily minimize gender imbalance in Olympic coverage, but in ways that routinizes the national focus. Theoretical developments in agenda setting in coverage of international events should account both for transnational patterns in public service media in the region and local particularities.
literature.abstract_cn: 研究者已在多种地域与媒介情境中记录了体育媒体报道的模式，但聚焦中欧与东欧地区的研究相对较少。本研究考察了匈牙利、克罗地亚与斯洛文尼亚三国欧洲公共服务媒体在2020年东京奥运会期间体育相关Facebook账号上的议程多样性。内容分析识别了报道的项目、性别平衡与议题多样性，揭示了中东欧地区体育传播中性别与国家利益交织的特征。
literature.keywords: gender; olympics; representation; facebook; football; diversity
literature.theoretical_framework: 议程设置理论、性别理论

literature.title: Female elite sports achievements in Iran. The Case of the First Olympic Medalist
literature.title_cn: 伊朗女性精英体育成就：首位奥运奖牌得主的案例
literature.title_en: Female elite sports achievements in Iran. The Case of the First Olympic Medalist
literature.author: Ali Ziaee, Jacco van Sterkenburg, Ivo van Hilvoorde
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: The present study aims to identify the societal implications of the first-ever Iranian female medalist in the Olympics to date. We explored the meanings given to Kimia Alizadeh's success within Iranian society. We collected data through an examination of online news agencies and social networking sites using Leximancer software, a computer-assisted program for qualitative content analysis. This analysis uncovered four main themes: ‘women's sports and the dynamics of local-global policy’, ‘hope and determination’, ‘pride in light of hijab’, and ‘meaningful and historic medal’. It was concluded that the societal implications of this medal-winning are more important than the quality of the medal itself within Iranian society. We also suggest assessing Iranian sportswomen within their own socio-cultural context.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在识别伊朗首位奥运会女性奖牌得主的社会影响。我们探索了伊朗社会中赋予基米亚·阿里扎德成功的意义。我们通过使用Leximancer软件（一种计算机辅助的定性内容分析程序）检查在线新闻机构和社交网站来收集数据。这一分析揭示了四个主要主题："女性体育与地方-全球政策动态"、"希望与决心"、"面纱下的自豪"和"作为国家象征的运动员"。这些主题揭示了伊朗社会中围绕女性体育成就的复杂叙事，交织着民族主义、宗教、性别和全球化的维度。
literature.keywords: olympics; policy; qualitative
literature.theoretical_framework: 性别理论、女性主义传播理论

literature.title: Muscle moves mass: Deconstructing the culture of weight loss in American Olympic Weightlifting
literature.title_cn: 肌肉推动重量：解构美国奥运举重的减重文化
literature.title_en: Muscle moves mass: Deconstructing the culture of weight loss in American Olympic Weightlifting
literature.author: Monica Nelson, Shannon Jette
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Sport scholars have argued that to protect athlete health, competitive sport cultures must begin to de-emphasize the importance of leanness for athletic performance. However, there is a notable lack of analyses of the pressures towards leanness experienced by athletes in sports that are not considered most ‘at-risk’ for the development of disordered bodily practices, such as Olympic Weightlifting. Based on interviews with sixteen competitive American Olympic Weightlifters, this study uses Foucauldian insights about the inseparability of culture, language, and the body to examine how weightlifters come to understand—and rationalize—their weight classes, body compositions, and avoidance of body fat. We find that while weightlifters characterized a wide range of body compositions as being functional for the sport, their own weight class choices were informed by a sport-specific narrative that condemned body fat. We critically interrogate this preference for leanness-focused bodily practices in a ‘non-lean’ sport, looking to the ‘Sport Ethic’ and other dominant bodily discourses as possible sources of influence.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育学者认为，为保护运动员健康，竞技体育文化必须开始降低瘦削对运动表现的重要性。然而，对于不被视为最"高风险"发展异常身体实践的体育项目（如奥运举重）中运动员所经历的瘦身压力，缺乏显著的分析。基于对16名美国竞技奥运举重运动员的访谈，本研究运用福柯关于文化与身体不可分离性的见解，解构了美国奥运举重中减重文化。研究发现，运动员面临着强大的减重压力，这些压力来自教练、同行和运动文化本身，尽管科学证据表明减重可能损害表现和健康。研究呼吁更批判性地审视举重文化中对体重和身体成分的过度关注。
literature.keywords: interviews; athlete; source

literature.title: Governing Olympic education: Technologies of policy announcements and outsourcing
literature.title_cn: 治理奥运教育：政策公告与外包的技术
literature.title_en: Governing Olympic education: Technologies of policy announcements and outsourcing
literature.author: Honglu Zhang, Darren Powell
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: The Chinese government views the Olympic Games as a critical platform to present national pride on a global scale. Olympic education also has an important role to play for China, as it is a requirement for any Olympic host country. In the context or preparations for the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics, this original ethnographic research examines the governance of Olympic education, with a focus on how relationships between China's government and a range of stakeholders (e.g. private sectors, academics, and individual teachers) ‘worked’ to shape the implementation of Olympic education in two Beijing primary schools. Utilising Foucault's notion of governmentality, we demonstrate that Olympic education was a significant tactic for Chinese government to realise their ambition of the great rejuvenation of China. Here, the state employed two technologies of government: policy announcements and outsourcing. In tension with common assumptions about China – and Chinese education – being purely authoritarian, our research illuminates how hybrid socialist-neoliberal rationalities worked to shape Olympic education in schools.
literature.abstract_cn: 中国政府将奥运会视为在全球舞台上展现民族自豪感的关键平台。奥林匹克教育对中国也发挥着重要作用，因为这是任何奥运会主办国的要求。在2022年北京冬奥会筹备背景下，这项原创的民族志研究考察了奥林匹克教育的治理，重点关注中国政府与一系列利益相关者（如私营部门、学者和个别教师）之间的关系如何"运作"以塑造两所北京小学的奥林匹克教育实施。运用福柯的治理术概念，我们表明奥林匹克教育是中国政府实现中华民族伟大复兴雄心的重要策略。在此，国家运用了两种治理技术：政策公告和外包。与关于中国及中国教育纯属威权主义的常见假设相悖，我们的研究阐明了混合的社会主义—新自由主义理性如何塑造学校的奥林匹克教育。
literature.keywords: policy; olympics; governance

literature.title: Clothes and caps: An exploration of the thing-power of objects and activism at the Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games
literature.title_cn: 服饰与帽子：东京2020奥运会物品之力与行动主义的探索
literature.title_en: Clothes and caps: An exploration of the thing-power of objects and activism at the Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games
literature.author: Julie E. Brice
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Building upon a rich body of literature around politics and the Olympics, this article explores the role of objects in political activism and protest at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics. Inspired by new materialist theory, Jane Bennett's vital materialism, and her concept of thing-power (2010) , this research thinks about the ways in which objects in the Tokyo 2020 games were lively and agentic players in developing assemblages and discussions around social inequalities at the Games. To accomplish this, the project conducted a thematic analysis of international popular press published during the Tokyo 2020 Olympics to explore the thing-power of two objects (unitards and a swimming cap). In so doing, this article explores the ways in which objects were integral actants and helped ignite conversations around gender, the sexualization of female athletes, and the racism and exclusionary practices of elite swimming. The article finishes with a discussion of the thing-power of objects and how a different ontological approach (i.e. one that values nonhuman matter) has implications for athlete protest, policy development, and addressing social inequalities and injustices within sport.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文基于关于政治与奥运会的丰富文献，探讨了东京2020奥运会中物品在政治行动主义和抗议中的作用。受新唯物主义理论、简·班尼特的活力唯物主义及其"物之力"概念（2010）的启发，本研究思考东京2020奥运会中的物品如何在围绕赛事社会不平等的组合和讨论中充当活跃和有能动性的参与者。为实现这一目标，项目对国际奥委会关于运动员在东京2020的抗议活动进行了主题分析，包括对报道、声明和运动员表达的分析。
literature.keywords: activism; gender; olympics; politics; policy; athlete

literature.title: Linking sports-related and socio-economic resources of retiring Olympic athletes to their subsequent vocational career
literature.title_cn: 将退役奥运运动员的体育相关与社会经济资源与其后续职业联系起来
literature.title_en: Linking sports-related and socio-economic resources of retiring Olympic athletes to their subsequent vocational career
literature.author: Michael J. Schmid, Merlin Örencik, Jürg Schmid, Achim Conzelmann
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: The aim of this study was to examine patterns of sports-related and socio-economic resources at the time of athletic retirement and their relation to the subsequent vocational career. We surveyed 341 former Olympic athletes representing Switzerland about their athletic, educational, and vocational careers. In order to adequately depict the heterogeneous situations of athletes during and after their athletic career, we applied a person-oriented approach. This involves adopting a holistic perspective and using nonlinear methods of analysis to allow for interactions between different aspects of an athlete’s career. Using cluster analytic techniques, we found different patterns of sports-related and socio-economic resources at the time of athletic retirement which were related with specific vocational career paths. In particular, clusters disposing of manifold resources had various opportunities in working life, whereas clusters with few resources fared less well. However, a lack of educational certificates could be compensated for by success in sports and popularity, provided that the vocational activity was pursued in sport. These findings may help career counsellors to better understand athletes’ career development options and provide services of ever-improving quality.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在考察运动员退役时体育相关和社会经济资源的模式及其与随后职业发展的关系。我们调查了代表瑞士的341名前奥运选手的运动员、教育和职业经历。为充分描绘运动员在运动生涯期间和之后的异质性情况，我们采用了以人为导向的方法。这涉及采取整体视角并使用非线性分析方法，以考虑运动员生涯不同方面之间的相互作用。运用聚类分析技术，我们发现了退役时体育相关和社会经济资源的不同模式，这些模式与特定的职业发展路径相关。特别是，拥有多种资源的群组在职场中有多种机会，而资源较少的群组则表现较差。然而，教育证书的缺乏可以通过体育成就和知名度来弥补，前提是职业活动在体育领域进行。这些发现可能有助于职业咨询师更好地理解运动员的职业发展选项，并提供不断改进质量的服务。
literature.keywords: athlete; career; survey

literature.title: Gendering strategic action fields in sports governance
literature.title_cn: 体育治理中战略行动领域的性别化
literature.title_en: Gendering strategic action fields in sports governance
literature.author: Madeleine Pape, Lucie Schoch
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: How do meso-level field relations shape the ways that sports organizations act on gender equality? In this paper, we approach international sports governance as comprised of meso-level fields of strategic action in which male dominance and relations of masculinity are centrally at stake. We focus on the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI), showing how the organization's efforts to address gender inequality are shaped by its relations with adjacent actors in the field. These actors jockey to form strategic coalitions as they struggle over the influence and resources to define the field configuration of international cycling, with challenges to the gendered status quo requiring careful management. Based on semi-structured interviews with individuals who held an elected or staff position within the UCI between 2005 and 2020, we show how field relations shaped the work of the UCI Women's Committee during this period as well as the experiences of women who succeeded in accessing decision-making roles. The UCI emerges in our analysis as a central governance unit via which the historical accumulation of advantage to men is preserved. We suggest that studying meso-level fields of strategic action can advance sociological research more broadly on how sports organizations are shaped by their contingent, dynamic, and (gender) unequal context.
literature.abstract_cn: 中观层面的场域关系如何塑造体育组织在性别平等方面行动的方式？在本文中，我们将国际体育治理视为由中观层面的战略行动场域组成，其中男性主导和男子气概关系处于核心地位。我们聚焦于国际自行车联盟（UCI），展示该组织解决性别不平等的努力如何受其与场域中相邻行动者关系的影响。这些行动者在争夺场域结构和意义时竞相形成战略联盟。分析揭示，UCI的性别平等倡议在追求改革的同时，也与既有的男性主导结构进行协商，导致性别平等的推进面临复杂挑战。
literature.keywords: gender; governance; masculinity; cycling; interviews; access

literature.title: Corruption in sports: Lessons from Montenegro
literature.title_cn: 体育中的腐败：黑山的教训
literature.title_en: Corruption in sports: Lessons from Montenegro
literature.author: Marko Begović
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This paper represents a pioneering attempt to study corruption in sports within the Western Balkans countries. Even though it is not a new phenomenon, as such, it aims to contribute to the existing literature on corruptive practices associated with the sports by exploring its nature, reach and magnitude. A mixed-method approach is employed using two levels of analysis – document analysis followed by semi-structured interviews. From 2006, Montenegro's official political orientation was towards membership within the European Union (EU). That said, for a country currently undergoing the process of EU integration, the control of corruption represents an essential element of the legitimization of both parties, Montenegro and the EU. However, as found, the form of corruption enables continuity of the dominant position of the long-standing political structure in power – the Democratic Party of Socialists (DPS). The DPS utilizes a range of undemocratic practices, combining clientelism and corruption to spread its influence outside of politics, on the broader socio-economic realms. The significance of the empirical study is in offering new perspectives and insights from a specific country within the Western Balkans, confirming the existence of a strong clientelist network established in the sports movement in Montenegro. The presence of politically exposed persons within sports governing bodies influences decisions at all levels in favor of political interest, including allocation of resources, public funds and media protection.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文是对西巴尔干国家体育腐败进行研究的开创性尝试。尽管这并非新现象，但本文旨在通过探索腐败实践的性质、范围和程度，为既有体育腐败文献做出贡献。研究采用了混合方法，包含两个分析层面——文件分析随后是半结构化访谈。自2006年起，黑山的官方政治方向是加入欧洲……
literature.keywords: politics; interviews

literature.title: How gender affects the newsworthiness of sports news on German TV: An application of the news-factors approach to understanding gender-biased sports news presentation
literature.title_cn: 性别如何影响德国电视体育新闻的新闻价值：用新闻要素方法理解性别偏向的体育新闻呈现
literature.title_en: How gender affects the newsworthiness of sports news on German TV: An application of the news-factors approach to understanding gender-biased sports news presentation
literature.author: Holger Ihle
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Gender inequalities in sports media are well-documented. This study focuses on sports news composition and how gender influences the prominence of sports news stories. The news-factors approach offers a causal explanation for the lower prominence (i.e. newsworthiness) of women's sports in TV sports reporting. Following this theory's perspective, athletes’ gender is supposed to work as a moderating variable on news values of news factors in sports reports. The content analysis of seven German sports news programs reveals whether the same news factors are treated unequally with regard to women's and men's sports in TV news coverage. The results show that women's sports are presented as less newsworthy than men's sports, although news factors do not differ significantly by gender. However, the moderation effect of gender does not cause lower newsworthiness. That means, e.g., sports women's successes are equally emphasized as the success of male athletes in sports news on TV, and gender does not lower the credits female athlete's success receive in any given news stories. Instead, the results suggest that gender works as a news factor of its own, reducing not the news value of certain news factors but the overall newsworthiness of women's sports in TV coverage. Thus, the results demonstrate that gender inequality in sports media does not necessarily come from journalists perceiving female athletes’ performance as inferior but from presenting women's sports less often and in a far less prominent way than men's sports.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育媒体中的性别不平等已有充分记录。本研究聚焦体育新闻的构成以及性别如何影响体育新闻故事的显著性。新闻要素方法为女性体育在电视体育报道中显著性(即新闻价值)较低提供了因果解释。按照该理论视角，运动员的性别被假定为体育新闻中新闻价值与新闻要素的调节变量。研究对德国电视体育新闻进行了新闻要素分析，揭示性别如何影响女性体育报道的新闻价值与呈现。
literature.keywords: gender; bias; athlete

literature.title: When sport is taken to extremes: A sociohistorical analysis of sport addiction
literature.title_cn: 当体育走向极端：运动成瘾的社会历史分析
literature.title_en: When sport is taken to extremes: A sociohistorical analysis of sport addiction
literature.author: Emmanuelle Larocque, Nicolas Moreau
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: In the 1970s, the concept of sport addiction appeared in scientific literature, warning of the addictive properties of exercise when taken to extremes. Appearing in over 6500 peer-reviewed articles in Google Scholar from 1979 to 2017, this construct is of interest to the fields of mental health and sport sociology as it provides a heuristic case to consider the conditions which allow for a category-in-the-making to gain meaning despite its absence from leading classification systems. Using Hacking's framework of ecological niches, this review of literature provides a critical examination of “sport addiction” and aims to investigate the driving forces and the means by which social actors from the scientific community negotiate the landscape and boundaries of this emerging disorder. The results highlight the prominence of psychology in the diffusion of the construct and the reticence of the medical world to legitimize it as a mental health category.
literature.abstract_cn: 在20世纪70年代，体育成瘾的概念出现在科学文献中，警告当锻炼走向极端时具有成瘾性。这一概念在1979年至2017年间出现在谷歌学术超过6,500篇同行评审文章中，对心理健康和体育社会学领域具有意义，因为它提供了一个启发式案例，用以考量在缺乏领先分类系统的情况下，一个"形成中的类别"如何获得意义的条件。运用哈金的生态学框架……
literature.keywords: community; sport addiction; mental health; addiction appeared; extremes appearing; sport sociology

literature.title: Athlete experiences of communication strategies in applied sports nutrition and future considerations for mobile app supportive solutions
literature.title_cn: 运动员在应用运动营养中传播策略的体验及移动应用辅助方案的未来考量
literature.title_en: Athlete experiences of communication strategies in applied sports nutrition and future considerations for mobile app supportive solutions
literature.author: David Mark Dunne, Carmen Lefevre-Lewis, Brian Cunniffe, Samuel George Impey, David Tod, Graeme Leonard Close, James P. Morton, Rebecca Murphy
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: AimThis study aimed to explore athletes' experiences and opinions of communication strategies in applied sports nutrition, as well as capture suggestions for future mobile app supportive solutions.MethodsA qualitative approach was used for this research. Data was generated from semi-structured focus groups (n = 9) with a purposive sample of 41 (male = 24, female = 17) full time professional athletes (mean age 24 ± 4.59) from five sports (football, rugby union, athletics, cycling, and boxing). Data was analyzed using reflexive thematic analysis.ResultsThe analysis identified four higher order themes and five sub themes. Athletes appear dissatisfied with the levels of personalization in the nutrition support they receive. Limited practitioner contact time was suggested as a contributing factor to this problem. Athletes acknowledged the usefulness of online remote nutrition support and reported a desire for more personalized technology that can tailor support to their individual needs.ConclusionAthletes experienced a hybrid human-computer approach that combines in-person and remote digital methods to communicate with and receive information from practitioners. Mobile technology may now afford sports nutritionists with new opportunities to develop scalable solutions to support practice.
literature.abstract_cn: 目的：本研究旨在探索运动员在应用体育营养中沟通策略的经验和看法，并收集未来移动应用支持解决方案的建议。方法：本研究采用定性方法。数据来自对41名（男性=24，女性=17）全职职业运动员（平均年龄24±4.59岁）的九个半结构化焦点小组，涉及五项运动（足球等）。结果：分析揭示了运动员对当前体育营养沟通策略的经验，包括对个性化营养建议的需求、与营养师沟通的障碍，以及数字工具在支持营养沟通中的潜在作用。运动员建议开发移动应用来提供个性化的营养指导、跟踪工具和易于理解的营养信息。研究为体育营养沟通策略的改进提供了见解，并为未来数字解决方案的发展提供了方向。

literature.title: Editorial: Esports: Playing Into the Future
literature.title_cn: 社论：电子竞技：走向未来
literature.title_en: Editorial: Esports: Playing Into the Future
literature.author: PI Joanne DiFrancisco-Donoghue, Gordon J. Schmidt, KIRILL Micallef Stafrace, Jerry R. Balentine
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: The topic of esports spans multiple cross-disciplinary domains such as management, physical and mental wellbeing, performance, and psychology. Despite a year of extensive solicitations to research intensive institutions, we received only 11 articles, and eight were considered for publication. This demonstrates a paucity of data being conducted and published in esports. Competitive video gaming has a global appeal of more than 450 million viewers and has grown exponentially in the past few years with a surge resulting from the pandemic lockdowns (Esports the money game, 2022). The editors of this journal have reviewed the submissions and advocate for further scientific inquiry with an emphasis on data sharing on topics related to health, training, and nutritional aspects of esport athletes. McGee and Ho, confirm the injurious nature of esports especially related to tendinopathies associated with sustained wrist bending and twisting movements. A public health approach to combat injury for those who have sedentary lifestyles and unhealthy diets has been advocated by Ketelhut et al. Our intention is to highlight the current studies involving many more aspects of esport health and to bring greater prominence to the nascent field of esport research.
literature.abstract_cn: 电竞主题跨越多个跨学科领域，如管理、身心健康、表现和心理学。尽管对研究密集型机构进行了大量征集，我们只收到了11篇文章，其中8篇被考虑发表。这表明电竞领域正在进行和发表的数据匮乏。竞技视频游戏拥有超过4.5亿全球观众，电竞产业快速增长。本编辑导言概述了特刊"电竞：面向未来"的内容，汇集了关于电竞管理、身心健康、表现和心理学的研究。导言强调电竞作为新兴研究领域的潜力，并呼吁更多的学术关注和理解电竞的独特特征和挑战。

literature.title: Both Physical and Virtual: On Immediacy in Esports
literature.title_cn: 既虚拟又实在：论电竞的即时性
literature.title_en: Both Physical and Virtual: On Immediacy in Esports
literature.author: David Ekdahl
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: This article strives to make novel headway in the debate concerning esports' relationship to sports by focusing on the relationship between esports and physicality. More precisely, the aim of this article is to critically assess the claim that esports fails to be sports because it is never properly “direct” or “immediate” compared to physical sports. To do so, I focus on the account of physicality presented by Jason Holt, who provides a theoretical framework meant to justify the claim that esports is never properly immediate and therefore never sports. I begin by motivating Holt's account of physicality by contrasting it with a more classical way of discussing physicality and sports, namely in terms of physical motor skills. Afterwards, I introduce Holt's account of physicality as immediacy and engage with its assumptions more thoroughly to problematize the claim that esports is fundamentally indirect. Lastly, I argue that the assumption that esports necessarily lacks immediacy is based on a narrow understanding of body and, consequently, of space. In response, I offer a different way of thinking about body and space, focusing on the subjective, bodily engagement of the esports practitioners with their practice, whereby physical space and virtual space can be appreciated as immediately interconnected during performance in a hybrid manner. In providing such an account, the article contributes directly to the broader, growing discussion on the relationship between physicality and virtuality in an increasingly digital world.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文旨在通过在电竞与身体性之间关系上取得新的进展，在关于电竞与体育关系的辩论中做出创新。更确切地说，本文的目的是批判性地评估电竞不是体育的说法，因为它与物理体育相比从未是适当"直接"或"即时"的。为此，我关注杰森·霍尔特提出的身体性观点，他提供了关于体育中直接性条件的理论性论证。通过对电竞即时性的分析，本文论证电竞涉及一种独特的身体性形式，这种形式既非完全虚拟，也非传统意义上的物理。电竞的即时性涉及数字操控、反应速度和竞技决策的融合，这挑战了体育中即时性的传统概念。研究为理解电竞作为体育形式的本体论地位提供了哲学视角。
literature.keywords: esports; engagement
literature.theoretical_framework: 游戏研究、媒介文化理论

literature.title_cn: 社论：精英体育与表现提升洞见：2021
literature.title_en: Editorial: Insights in Elite Sports and Performance Enhancement: 2021
literature.author: Olivier Girard, Oliver Faude
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: High performance sport is often perceived as the top end of athletic development, and typically operates in a fast paced, highly dynamic environment. In this environment, a large number of stakeholders is involved who pursue their own interests (sometimes with a commercial background) and exert influence on the athlete. This complex web of interests surrounds an individual, with his or her individual needs, requiring individual solutions to enable the athlete to achieve the small edge that is critical at the highest level. Despite its growth, the complex nature of managing high performance sport remains under-explored. The intention of this Research Topic is to shed more light on recent development in the elite sports and performance enhancement field. It is our hope that this articles collection will inspire, inform and provide direction and guidance to researchers/sport scientists in this area.
literature.keywords: athlete; performance enhancement; high performance; performance sport; editorial insights; enhancement high

literature.title: Brief Research Report: “Nothing About Us, Without Us”: A Case Study of the Outer Sanctum Podcast and Trends in Australian Independent Media to Drive Intersectional Representation
literature.title_cn: 简讯：“没有我们，就没有我们的事”：Outer Sanctum播客与澳大利亚独立媒体推动交叉代表性趋势的案例研究
literature.title_en: Brief Research Report: “Nothing About Us, Without Us”: A Case Study of the Outer Sanctum Podcast and Trends in Australian Independent Media to Drive Intersectional Representation
literature.author: Kasey Symons, Sam Duncan, Emma Sherry
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: Alternative and independent sports media platforms create custom content that reflects a diversity of voices and representation of athletes, sports and issues that are not covered in meaningful ways in traditional sports media. While these new media outlets often set out to redress the lack of diversity and intersectional approaches to traditional sports media, they are also seeking ways to drive even more change. This in an interesting and important movement to interrogate as these platforms are not only predominantly unfunded, passion projects created by those marginalized groups. This brief research report provides a case study into this emerging alternative media space and its impact in driving change in an ever-evolving sports media landscape. We also discuss the problematic nature of intersectional-redressing work falling on those who still occupy the margins. This report uses a case study of an independent Australian rules football platform, The Outer Sanctum podcast, to focus on these key areas. The case study investigates how this outlet has worked to increase the visibility and profile of marginalized and underrepresented voices discussing football in new ways. It follows their journey as they have taken steps to improve their own diversity, enacting their mantra “nothing about us, without us,” and proactively becoming more intersectional in their content producing journey. This research report will present key findings from the work of this media outlet to drive change and point to the learnings mainstream media can adopt to meaningfully embed intersectional approaches to sports media as core business.
literature.keywords: podcast; representation; football; diversity; athlete

literature.title: Media Consumption, Stress and Wellbeing of Video Game and eSports Players in Germany: The eSports Study 2020
literature.title_cn: 德国电子游戏与电竞玩家的媒体消费、压力与幸福感：2020年电竞研究
literature.title_en: Media Consumption, Stress and Wellbeing of Video Game and eSports Players in Germany: The eSports Study 2020
literature.author: Kevin Rudolf, Markus Soffner, Peter Bickmann, Ingo Froböse, Chuck Tholl, Konstantin Wechsler, Christopher Grieben
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: The popularity of video gaming and eSports is increasing rapidly. However, most research focuses on the economical features and psychological consequences of gaming and only little is known about the health behavior of the players. Therefore, this study is a follow-up of the eSports Study 2019 and further investigates the health and health behavior of video game and eSports players in Germany. This cross-sectional study, conducted between April and September 2019, includes 1038 players (91.2% male; 23.0 ± 5.4 years; body mass index: 24.8 ± 5.0 kg/m2) who provided data regarding their health status, physical activity, sleep, media consumption, stress and wellbeing via a web-based survey. Descriptive statistics were performed on all questions. Linear regressions were used to examine the relation between media consumption, wellbeing and stress. Almost all respondents classified their health status as “good” or better (92.5%). The average sedentary and physical activity time was 7.2 ± 3.5 h/day and 8.8 ± 10.7 h/week, respectively. Respondents slept for 7.5 ± 1.3 h/night on weekdays and for 8.5 ± 1.5 h/night on weekends, but many were “sometimes” or more frequently overtired (53.1%). Daily duration of playing video games (230.4 ± 159.3 min/day) and watching livestreams and videos with (102.6 ± 101.7 min/day) and without gaming content (72.9 ± 88.5 min/day) were much higher than watching regular television (18.9 ± 49.1 min/day) or reading analog media (32.1 ± 53.5 min/day). In terms of stress and wellbeing, most players reported low stress levels (13.8 ± 5.7) and reached a moderate average score of 60.1 ± 16.4 out of 100 points in the WHO-5 Well-Being Index. Linear regressions revealed no relevant significant associations. The results indicate good subjective health and health behavior of the target group. However, the high amounts of screen-based media-consumption, as well as the moderate stress and wellbeing levels show potential for improvement. In addition, the target
literature.abstract_cn: 视频游戏和电竞的受欢迎程度正在迅速增长。然而，大多数研究关注游戏的商业特征和心理后果，对玩家的健康行为知之甚少。因此，本研究是2019年电竞研究的后续研究，进一步调查了德国视频游戏和电竞玩家的健康和健康行为。这项横断面研究于2020年4月至8月进行。研究考察了德国电竞和游戏玩家的媒体消费、压力和幸福感。研究结果揭示了游戏玩家和电竞选手在媒体消费模式、压力水平和幸福感方面的差异，为理解游戏和电竞人群的健康行为提供了新的见解。研究对电竞行业健康促进和监管政策具有启示意义。
