literature.title: Nationalistic Media Obsession With Olympic Medal Counts: The Case of the 2020 Tokyo Olympic Games
literature.title_cn: 对奥运奖牌数的民族主义媒体执念：2020年东京奥运会案例
literature.title_en: Nationalistic Media Obsession With Olympic Medal Counts: The Case of the 2020 Tokyo Olympic Games
literature.author: Steve Dittmore, Kibaek Kim
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: Because Olympic medals are awarded to athletes representing an individual National Olympic Committee, it is natural for the media, and even the International Olympic Committee, to create a table indicating which nation has experienced the most athletic success. Problems, and even disagreements, arise when nations utilize different methods to count medals. The 2020 Tokyo Olympic Games, contested in 2021, provided a unique opportunity to observe how media organizations create a narrative around medal tables. American media outlets preferred to consistently show the United States at the top of the medal standings even though China had more gold medals for much of the Games' fortnight. Non-American media organizations took exception to that method of counting.
literature.abstract_cn: 由于奥运奖牌颁发给代表各国家奥委会的运动员，媒体乃至国际奥委会自然都会制作反映各国体育成就的奖牌榜。但当各国采用不同的奖牌计数方法时，就会产生问题甚至分歧。2020年东京奥运会(于2021年举办)提供了一个独特机会，得以观察不同媒体如何构建与呈现奥运奖牌榜及其背后的民族主义叙事。
literature.keywords: athlete

literature.title: New Media, Digitalization, and the Evolution of the Professional Sport Industry
literature.title_cn: 新媒体、数字化与职业体育产业的演变
literature.title_en: New Media, Digitalization, and the Evolution of the Professional Sport Industry
literature.author: Jingxuan Zheng, Daniel S. Mason
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: The professional sport industry achieved tremendous success in the traditional broadcast media age, established a multi-sided market and an effective business model for revenue growth. However, the emergence and proliferation of the new media technologies have drastically changed the media landscape, creating a much more complicated cross-media environment that unites popularity and personalization, structure and agency. Such a changing environment creates transformations within the professional sport industry, and adapting to these transformations will lead to the evolution of the professional sport industry and its success in the digital media age.
literature.abstract_cn: 职业体育产业在传统广播媒体时代取得了巨大成功，建立了多边市场和有效的收入增长商业模式。然而，新媒体技术的出现和普及极大地改变了媒体格局，创造了一个更加复杂的跨媒体环境，将人气和个性化、结构和能动性结合在一起。这种变化的环境在职业体育产业内部产生了转变，适应这些转变将导致职业体育产业的演变及其在数字媒体时代的成功。
literature.keywords: professional sport; sport industry; new media; media age; media digitalization; industry achieved

literature.title: Social Media and the Olympics: A Chance for Improving Gender Equality
literature.title_cn: 社交媒体与奥运会：改善性别平等的机会
literature.title_en: Social Media and the Olympics: A Chance for Improving Gender Equality
literature.author: Aneta Grabmüllerová
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: The purpose of this paper is to explore whether social media content by the National Olympic Committees (NOC) during the 2020 Tokyo Olympic Games strengthens or weakens the International Olympic Committee's (IOC) gender equality ambitions. As the media play an important role in creating the impressions that people cherish during and after the Olympics, the IOC has since the 1990s increased its responsibility for fair media portrayal of athletes and competitions by revising its own media production. In the past decade, this most notably concerns social media. Not only has it become an inseparable part of global sports consumption, but it is also seen as a tool for changing the biased and stereotypical portrayal of female athletes in news media, even though male and female athletes have become nearly equal in numbers of participants. Studies of media production and equality-informed decisions are, however, rare in sport. Drawing upon a quantitative analysis of social media accounts of three National Olympic Committees (NOC) (Norway, Czech Republic and Switzerland) and qualitative in-depth interviews with key informants—NOCs' and European Olympic Committee's (EOC) social media personnel—this study therefore explored the decisions and processes that influenced gender portrayal during the 2020 Tokyo Olympics. Findings of the study showed that media personnel have a significant influence on gender portrayal in their respective communication channels. In contrast to news media, they were aware of the frames they apply, and they applied them in alignment with the Olympic values. Consequently, they set a fairer agenda for both male and female athletes and strengthened the gender equality mission of the IOC.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文旨在探讨国家奥委会（NOC）在2020年东京奥运会期间的社交媒体内容，是加强还是削弱了国际奥委会（IOC）的性别平等雄心。由于媒体在塑造人们于奥运会期间和之后珍视的印象方面发挥重要作用，国际奥委会自1990年代以来通过修订自身媒体制作，增加了对运动员和比赛公平媒体呈现的责任。在过去十年中，这最显著地涉及社交媒体。它不仅已成为全球体育消费不可分割的一部分，也被视为改变新闻媒体中女性运动员有偏见和刻板呈现的工具。
literature.keywords: gender; olympics; qualitative; quantitative; interviews; bias

literature.title: Clutching on to Gendered Tropes? Framing of Gender Roles and Power Dynamics by Young Indian Writers of BTS Fanfiction
literature.title_cn: 紧抓性别化套话？BTS同人文年轻印度作者对性别角色与权力动态的框架呈现
literature.title_en: Clutching on to Gendered Tropes? Framing of Gender Roles and Power Dynamics by Young Indian Writers of BTS Fanfiction
literature.author: Jasdeep Kaur Chandi, Kulveen Trehan
literature.abstract: As more young girls write stories online thanks to the increased amount of publishing platforms, their fiction becomes a means to explore if they are offsetting prescribed practices of patriarchy in their gender constructions. Often, young women interrogate gender and recontextualize their experiences by writing fanfictions. In the age of transmedia storytelling, various online fan communities are rich data sources, as transnational female fans prolifically write fiction featuring icons from music and movies belonging to another country. We examined how young Indian girls frame gender roles and power dynamics in their fanfictions of BTS, the South Korean boyband, on Wattpad. To know if conventional gender frames are upheld or challenged in fanfiction stories revolving around non-Indian celebrities, we performed a textual analysis on forty-four BTS fanfictions. We found that in these fanfictions, existing gendered tropes used to depict masculinity and femininity are mostly normalized, with minor alterations reflecting a power imbalance typical in Indian patriarchal households. A subversion of tropes was found in framing men as emotionally expressive, arguably drawing from the soft masculinity projected in the home country of BTS–South Korea. Grounding these findings in self-categorization theory implores us to situate the construction of gendered identities within the socio-cultural conventions of fanfiction writers.
literature.abstract_cn: 随着出版平台的增加，越来越多的年轻女孩在网上写故事，她们的小说成为探索她们在性别建构中是否抵消了父权制规定实践的手段。通常，年轻女性通过写作同人小说来审视性别并重新情境化她们的体验。在跨媒介叙事的时代，各种在线粉丝社区是丰富的数据来源，因为跨国女性粉丝大量创作以来自其他国家的音乐和电影偶像为特征的小说。我们考察了年轻印度女性作家如何在她们的同人小说中框架化性别角色和权力动态，以理解跨文化粉丝创作中性别建构的复杂性。
literature.keywords: gender; framing; masculinity; emotion; source
literature.theoretical_framework: 框架理论、性别理论、叙事理论

literature.title: Twitter Engagement in Media Organizations: The Case of the Greek National Broadcasting Corporation
literature.title_cn: 媒体组织中的推特参与：希腊国家广播电视公司案例
literature.title_en: Twitter Engagement in Media Organizations: The Case of the Greek National Broadcasting Corporation
literature.author: Styliani Antonakopoulou, Andreas Veglis
literature.abstract: A key parameter in the strategy of news organizations remains the exploitation of factors (such as post time and post type) that enhance the engagement level within online communities on social media. The purpose of this paper is to examine the relationship between post time and post type in correlation with audience response in the Twitter digital platform. Specifically, the study aims to ascertain how the two specific variables affect user engagement with its Twitter posts and how they shape the effectiveness of communication on social networks. The analysis includes 7.122 tweets of the Greek National Broadcasting Corporation (ERT) over four months. Moreover, the study analyzes the tone of user comments on the Twitter posts of the specific public media organizations to understand in-depth how the users communicate their views publicly. The collection of comments lasted seven weeks and they numbered 265 in 2639 tweets. Regarding the post time variable, the study came to important findings on user behavior during the 24 h, as the number of Retweets appears to increase in the morning compared to the afternoon. It was also found that as time goes on, the user is interested in leaving his personal opinion. Regarding the correlation of post type with user engagement, it was found that the accompaniment of a tweet with audiovisual material has a tempting effect on users.
literature.abstract_cn: 新闻组织战略中的一个关键参数仍然是利用增强社交媒体在线社区参与度的因素（如发帖时间和发帖类型）。本文的目的是考察发帖时间和发帖类型与推特数字平台受众反应之间的关系。具体而言，研究旨在确定这两个特定变量如何影响用户对其推特帖子的参与度，以及它们如何塑造社交网络上的沟通有效性。分析包括希腊国家广播公司（ERT）四个月内7,122条推文。此外，研究分析了特定公共媒体组织推特帖子下用户评论的语气，以深入了解用户如何公开表达他们的观点。评论收集持续了七周，在2,639条推文中编号为265条。关于发帖时间变量，研究在24小时内发现了关于用户行为的重要发现，因为转推次数在上午比下午有所增加。还发现随着时间推移，用户更感兴趣于留下评论而非分享内容。
literature.keywords: broadcasting; twitter; engagement; audience
literature.theoretical_framework: 平台理论、受众研究理论

literature.title: China’s Media Expansion in Zambia: Influence on Government, Commercial, Community, and Religious Media
literature.title_cn: 中国在赞比亚的媒体扩张：对政府、商业、社区与宗教媒体的影响
literature.title_en: China’s Media Expansion in Zambia: Influence on Government, Commercial, Community, and Religious Media
literature.author: Gregory Gondwe
literature.abstract: This study examines how news about China is presented, spread and impacts the diversity of opinions in state-owned, commercial, community, and religious media outlets in Zambia. Drawing from the 2012–2021 data, and guided by intermedia agenda-setting theory, we provide evidence of the counter-attitudinal influence of news content on China across the four media categories. While state-owned media emphasized issues of privatization, and government and foreign policies, community and religious media focused on issues of environmental degradation, poor labor conditions, and mining. Commercial media mirrored state-owned media, a trend also reflected in community and religious media outlets across time. These findings suggest that China shapes how the media in Zambia present content about China. As observed, over the years, China is positively presented in the Zambian media.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了关于中国的新闻如何在赞比亚国有、商业、社区和宗教媒体机构中被呈现、传播并影响意见多样性。基于2012年至2021年的数据，并以媒介间议程设置理论为指导，我们提供了关于中国新闻内容在这四类媒体类别中反态度影响的证据。国有媒体强调私有化、政府和外交政策问题，而社区和宗教媒体则关注环境退化、恶劣劳动条件和采矿等问题。商业媒体与国有媒体相似，这一趋势也反映在……
literature.keywords: community; diversity; labor; environmental
literature.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、产业组织理论

literature.title: Artificial Intelligence and Journalism: Current Situation and Expectations in the Portuguese Sports Media
literature.title_cn: 人工智能与新闻业：葡萄牙体育媒体的现状与期待
literature.title_en: Artificial Intelligence and Journalism: Current Situation and Expectations in the Portuguese Sports Media
literature.author: João Canavilhas
literature.abstract: With an important presence in various sectors of activity, Artificial Intelligence has also reached journalism, mostly in the field of natural-language processing, in the detection of informational trends or in the automatic production of texts. The fact that sport is one of the first to test AI is not a coincidence: it is a subject in which there is a lot of information online and where data is essential, so it is simpler to resort to natural language processing to transform them in texts with little or no human intervention; this work sought to understand if Artificial Intelligence is already used in Portuguese sports media, but also in mainstream media sports sections, whether they are newspapers, radios, TVs or online natives. A survey was sent only to decision-makers, that is, editors and coordinators. The study seeks to understand to what extent journalists expect AI to help journalism, what are the greatest difficulties of its use and what threats it represents. We can conclude that Portuguese sports journalism is aware of the potential of AI, although for now it is not used in newsrooms due to economic and professional constraints.
literature.abstract_cn: 人工智能在各行业领域具有重要影响，也已进入新闻业，主要集中在自然语言处理、信息趋势检测或文本自动生产方面。体育是最早测试AI的领域之一并非偶然：该领域线上信息量大且数据至关重要，因此更便于借助自然语言处理技术在极少或无需人工干预的情况下将数据转化为文本。本研究旨在探究AI在葡萄牙体育媒体中的应用现状与预期，分析其实际使用程度及从业者对未来发展的期待。
literature.keywords: survey; newsroom
literature.theoretical_framework: 技术社会学、创新扩散理论

literature.title: A Proposed Model of Self-Perceived Authenticity of Social Media Influencers
literature.title_cn: 社交媒体影响者自我感知真实性的模型构建
literature.title_en: A Proposed Model of Self-Perceived Authenticity of Social Media Influencers
literature.author: Delia Cristina Balaban, Julia Szambolics
literature.abstract: It is rather contradictory that there is a high demand for authenticity in today’s virtual space, where some platforms encourage the proliferation of idealized images, the products of digital alteration. Previous studies have examined how social media users perceive the authenticity and credibility of new digital celebrities—influencers—and the impacts on advertising outcomes. Authenticity in media communication has been defined in many ways, but most definitions include factors such as sincerity, trustworthiness, accuracy, originality, and spontaneity. Prior research on authenticity in computer-mediated communication emphasized the importance of three levels of authenticity, that of the source, of the message, and of the interaction. How social media influencers (SMIs) perceive their own authenticity is an understudied topic. SMIs are simultaneously perceived by their audiences as celebrities, experts, and consumers. Expanding their audiences is one of their goals. Being authentic at the beginning of one’s SMI career as a content creator might be simple, but it becomes much more challenging after one’s audience has grown significantly. Sponsorship can pose a challenge to an SMI’s authenticity. The present study aims to explore the role that authenticity plays for SMIs and develop a theoretical framework for understanding the self-perceived authenticity of SMIs. For this purpose, in-depth interviews were conducted with SMIs that have both national and international audiences (N = 20). Sincerity, expertise, uniqueness, commitment to values, mediated realness, visibility, communication style, spontaneity, transparent and creative brand endorsement, commitment to followers, and frequency of interaction are the components of the proposed model.
literature.abstract_cn: 当今虚拟空间中对真实性的高度需求是相当矛盾的，因为一些平台鼓励理想化图像的扩散，这些图像是数字处理的产物。先前研究考察了社交媒体用户如何感知新数字名人——影响者——的真实性和可信度，以及对广告结果的影响。媒体传播中的真实性已以多种方式被定义，但大多数定义包括真诚、可信、准确、原创和自发性等因素。本文提出了一个自我感知影响者真实性的模型，整合了影响者自我呈现、受众感知和平台可供性等因素。该模型有助于理解影响者如何在数字环境中维持或构建真实性，以及真实性感知如何影响影响者营销的效果。
literature.keywords: audience; advertising; sponsorship; interviews; credibility; trust
literature.theoretical_framework: 平台理论、受众研究理论

literature.title: ProPublica’s Data Journalism: How Multidisciplinary Teams and Hybrid Profiles Create Impactful Data Stories
literature.title_cn: ProPublica的数据新闻：多学科团队与混合型人才如何创造有影响力的数据报道
literature.title_en: ProPublica’s Data Journalism: How Multidisciplinary Teams and Hybrid Profiles Create Impactful Data Stories
literature.author: Mathias-Felipe De-Lima-Santos
literature.abstract: Despite growing interest in the emergence of technologies in journalistic practices, especially from the production perspective, there is still very little research on organizational structures and professional culture in relation to the deployment of these technologies. Drawing on six interviews and observation in staff meetings, this study aims to explore the nuances behind the professional roles of data journalists and how these relate to structural aspects of news organizations. The study focuses on the case of ProPublica, a news organization internationally renowned for its global excellence in data stories. This work considers boundary-making in the context of journalism and focuses on new professional roles in the news industry to produce a hybrid ethnography study based on qualitative data collected immediately before the Covid-19 pandemic hit the United States. The findings reveal the importance of hybrid profiles at ProPublica. While some journalists have had to expand their knowledge to learn more about new areas, such as coding and design, some non-journalistic professionals have had to develop writing skills, and this blurring of traditional boundaries forms an important aspect of ProPublica’s professional culture. The structure of the organization, divided into two teams engaged in cross-sector activities, helps to promote data skills and collaboration with other journalists, which also serves to mitigate any individual lack of experience on certain topics. The article concludes by suggesting that the growing importance of these new professional roles has broader implications for the development of data skills in the newsroom, and also discusses the limitations that can arise from the increasing overlap between journalistic and non-journalistic roles.
literature.abstract_cn: 尽管对新闻实践中技术出现的研究兴趣日益增长，尤其是从生产视角出发，但关于这些技术部署相关的组织结构和职业文化的研究仍然很少。本研究基于六次访谈和员工会议观察，旨在探索数据记者职业角色背后的细微差别，以及这些角色如何与新闻组织的结构方面相关联。研究聚焦于ProPublica的案例，这是一家以数据报道全球卓越而闻名的新闻组织。本工作考察了新闻语境中的边界划定，并聚焦于新闻业中的新职业角色。
literature.keywords: qualitative; interviews; ethnography; newsroom; pandemic; covid

literature.title: Points of Contact Between Activism, Populism, and Fandom on Social Media
literature.title_cn: 社交媒体上行动主义、民粹主义与粉丝文化的接触点
literature.title_en: Points of Contact Between Activism, Populism, and Fandom on Social Media
literature.author: Sarah Riddick
literature.abstract: This article explores how music fans used social media to increase a social movement’s public support. Although initially dismissed as a conspiracy theory, the movement eventually gained widespread support and is motivating communities to engage in broader cultural conversations. The movement’s success, this article argues, is largely owed to social media’s networked communication affordances and how they facilitate fan-based citizenship and citizen journalism. Through a rhetorical analysis of social media communication related to the movement, this article examines how online fan-based citizen journalism can draw together seemingly disconnected ideologies and audiences to diversify and bolster social movements’ support.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了音乐粉丝如何利用社交媒体来增加社会运动的公众支持。尽管最初被视为阴谋论而被驳回，该运动最终获得了广泛支持，并激励社区参与更广泛的文化对话。本文认为，该运动的成功在很大程度上归功于社交媒体的网络化传播可供性以及它们如何促进基于粉丝的公民身份和公民新闻。通过对该运动相关社交媒体传播的修辞分析，本文考察了在线基于粉丝的公民新闻如何将看似不相关的意识形态和受众联系在一起，以多样化和加强社会运动的支持。
literature.keywords: fandom; activism; audience
literature.theoretical_framework: 网络社会理论、受众研究理论

literature.title: Does Third-Party Fact-Checking Increase Trust in News Stories? An Australian Case Study Using the “Sports Rorts” Affair
literature.title_cn: 第三方事实核查能提升新闻信任吗？澳大利亚“Sports Rorts”事件的案例研究
literature.title_en: Does Third-Party Fact-Checking Increase Trust in News Stories? An Australian Case Study Using the “Sports Rorts” Affair
literature.author: Andrea Carson, Andrew Gibbons, Aaron Martin, Justin B. Phillips
literature.abstract: Abstract Given the centrality of news media to democracy, it is concerning that public trust in media has declined in many countries. A potential mechanism that may reverse this trend is independent fact-checking to adjudicate competing claims in news stories. We undertake a survey experiment on a sample of 1608 Australians to test the effects of fact-checking on media trust using a real-life case study known as the “sports rorts” affair. We construct duplicate news articles from two national media outlets (i.e. ABC.net.au, news.com.au) containing a senior government minister’s real-life false claim that public funds were not used for political advantage immediately before an election. Half of the participants are exposed to a third-party fact check, which confirms the Minister’s claim is verifiably false, the other half are not. All respondents are asked to evaluate the story’s and news outlets’ trustworthiness. Contrary to our expectations we find a backfire effect whereby independent fact-checking decreases readers’ trust in the original news story and outlet. This negative relationship is not conditional on partisanship or the media source. Our study provides a cautionary tale for those expecting third-party fact-checks to increase media trust and we outline several avenues by which fact-checkers might overcome this.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究考察第三方事实核查是否能提升新闻信任。以澳大利亚“Sports Rorts”事件为案例，通过问卷调查与实验方法，分析了事实核查标签对受众新闻信任与分享意愿的影响，为事实核查在新闻信任建构中的作用提供了实证依据。
literature.keywords: trust; readers; survey; partisan; source

literature.title: Local News on Facebook: How Television Broadcasters use Facebook to Enhance Social Media News Engagement
literature.title_cn: Facebook上的地方新闻：电视广播机构如何利用Facebook提升社交媒体新闻参与
literature.title_en: Local News on Facebook: How Television Broadcasters use Facebook to Enhance Social Media News Engagement
literature.author: Miao Guo, Fu-Shing Sun
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT This study examines how local television broadcasters use Facebook to enhance social media news engagement. By scraping 1,063 news posts from nine local television stations’ Facebook pages, this investigation performs a content analysis on different features of news posts, including news topics, message vividness and interactivity, post time, and length of the post. This study further explores how news post features affect three dimensions of news engagement, indicated by reactions, comments, and shares.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了地方电视台如何利用Facebook来提升社交媒体新闻参与度。通过抓取九家地方电视台Facebook页面上的1,063条新闻帖子，本研究对不同新闻帖子特征（包括新闻主题、信息的生动性和互动性、发布时间及帖子长度）进行了内容分析。本研究进一步探讨了新闻帖子特征如何影响新闻参与的三个维度（以反应、评论和分享为指标）。
literature.keywords: local, television, facebook, engagement, posts

literature.title: “Through Our Prism”: Black Television Sports Journalists’ Work Experiences and Interactions with Black Athletes
literature.title_cn: “透过我们的棱镜”：黑人电视体育记者的工作经历及与黑人运动员的互动
literature.title_en: “Through Our Prism”: Black Television Sports Journalists’ Work Experiences and Interactions with Black Athletes
literature.author: Kevin Hull, Denetra Walker, Miles Romney, Kirstin Pellizzaro
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT Black local television sports journalists throughout the United States were surveyed to discover how they view both their perceived place in the newsroom and media treatment of, and their own interactions with, Black athletes. The majority say that Black athletes are negatively stereotyped and that, as Black journalists, they have an easier time relating to and telling the story of the Black athlete. Using a thematic analysis of the open-ended comments, the authors found perspective, realization of racism, discriminatory hiring practices, and emotional labor to be common themes. Findings from this mixed methods study point to their belief that hiring more Black television sports journalists could improve coverage of Black athletes, but there are doubts that those job opportunities exist. When discussing their own experiences, the Black television sports journalists said there is some “tokenism” within television station hiring practices that makes it difficult for many of them to be hired. Practical implications for the future of sports journalism and newsroom diversity is discussed.
literature.abstract_cn: 对美国各地黑人地方电视体育记者进行了调查，以了解他们如何看待自己在新闻编辑室中的感知地位、媒体对待黑人运动员的方式，以及他们自己与黑人运动员的互动。大多数人表示，黑人运动员被负面刻板印象化，作为黑人记者，他们更容易理解和讲述黑人运动员的故事。通过对开放式评论的主题分析，作者发现视角、对种族主义的认识、歧视性招聘实践和情感劳动是常见主题。这项混合方法研究的发现指出，他们认为招聘更多黑人电视体育记者可以改善对黑人运动员的报道，但对这些工作机会是否存在表示怀疑。
literature.keywords: black, television, journalists, athletes, hiring

literature.title: Magic 10 and NBA Bubble Sports Journalists’ Practices During NBA Season 2019–2020
literature.title_cn: 魔术10号与NBA泡泡：2019-2020赛季NBA体育记者的实践
literature.title_en: Magic 10 and NBA Bubble Sports Journalists’ Practices During NBA Season 2019–2020
literature.author: Andy Sturt, Muhammad Fahad Humayun
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT After the NBA season2019-2020 was postponed due to the spread of COVID-19 in the United States, it was resumed on July 72020, in a tightly secured environment within Walt Disney World termed as NBAbubble. Only ten sports reporters were allowed within this bubble to provide news coverage for the fans, and they were soon called the Magic 10. The purpose of this exploratory study is to understand, through textual analysis of metajournalistic discourse published about the NBA bubble, how these sports journalists adjusted their practices during an unprecedented sports event. The first theme was the disruption of the journalistic norms and practices of the in-bubble reporters. The second theme manifest in the content was related to reporting on timely social justice issues from within the bubble. The third theme emerged as an element of introspection or reflection about the peculiar experience of reporting from a “bubble.” We discuss the implications of these practices for sports journalism and suggest that the NBA bubble may catalyze the relationship between sports and journalism.
literature.abstract_cn: 在2019-2020赛季因新冠在美国蔓延而推迟后，NBA于2020年7月7日在华特迪士尼世界内一个高度安全的环境（称为"NBA泡泡"）中恢复。只允许十名体育记者进入该泡泡为球迷提供新闻报道，他们很快被称为"神奇十人"（Magic 10）。这项探索性研究的目的是通过对关于NBA泡泡发表的元新闻话语进行文本分析，理解这些体育记者如何在前所未有的体育赛事中调整他们的实践。第一个主题是泡泡内记者的新闻规范和实践的中断。第二个主题涉及从泡泡内部及时报道社会正义问题。
literature.keywords: bubble, within, practices, theme, reporters

literature.title: Loyalty in the Newsroom. Employment Relationships in Public Service Broadcasting
literature.title_cn: 新闻编辑室的忠诚：公共服务广播中的雇佣关系
literature.title_en: Loyalty in the Newsroom. Employment Relationships in Public Service Broadcasting
literature.author: Samuel Toledano, María Lamuedra Graván, José María García-de-Madariaga
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT Very little research has decried the chronic deterioration of the working conditions of journalists. Public service broadcasters, which are often seen as paradigms of stable employment relationships, have been influenced by a highly competitive industry characterised by the outsourcing of content generation and the erosion of working conditions. The Spanish Public Radio and Television Corporation (RTVE) is no exception, in a context also influenced by the political clientelism distinguishing Mediterranean media systems. Accordingly, this study resorts to the classical exit, voice, and loyalty model to stress the importance of employment relationships for journalists. From this perspective, the analysis of TVE newsroom discourses invites the exploration of the role of the supervisor in access to employment and career opportunities, as well as its possible polarising effects that make it difficult for journalists to offer their full loyalty to the citizenry.
literature.abstract_cn: 很少有研究谴责记者工作条件的持续恶化。公共服务广播机构——通常被视为稳定雇佣关系的典范——也受到了高度竞争性行业的影响，该行业的特点是内容生成外包和工作条件侵蚀。西班牙广播电视公司（RTVE）也不例外，其背景还受到地中海媒体系统中政治庇护主义的影响。据此，本研究运用经典的"退出、表达和忠诚"模型来强调雇佣关系的重要性。
literature.keywords: journalists, employment, working, conditions, public

literature.title: International Broadcasting During Times of Conflict: A Comparison of China’s and Russia's Communication Strategies
literature.title_cn: 冲突时期的国际广播：中国与俄罗斯传播策略的比较
literature.title_en: International Broadcasting During Times of Conflict: A Comparison of China’s and Russia's Communication Strategies
literature.author: Chang Zhang, Dechun Zhang, Philippe Blanchard
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT The vital role of international broadcasting during times of international conflict has gained increasing attention; however, national variations in terms of communication strategies have rarely been explored in depth. This study fills this research gap by providing a comparative analysis of the communication strategies of Chinese and Russian state-sponsored international broadcasters. By examining CGTN’s coverage of the South China Sea arbitration and RT’s coverage of the Ukraine crisis in 2014, we find that the Chinese international broadcaster preferred official Chinese sources and a peace frame during a time of conflict, whereas its Russian counterpart tended to engage with Western countercultural speakers and present conflict frames. We further interpret the two media’s different usage of sources and frames in the light of the media’s organizational culture and the sponsoring states’ national identities. The research advances the scholarship on the increasingly intensive information war between the East and the West through the way international broadcasters cover international conflicts. It enriches our understanding of the cultural and national dynamics underpinning the non-Western emerging countries’ approaches of international communication.
literature.abstract_cn: 国际广播在国际冲突时期的关键作用日益受到关注；然而，各国在传播策略上的差异很少被深入探讨。本研究通过比较分析中国和俄罗斯国家资助的国际广播机构的传播策略，填补了这一研究空白。通过考察CGTN对南海仲裁案的报道和RT对2014年乌克兰危机的报道，我们发现，中国国际广播机构在冲突时期更倾向于采用中国官方信源与和平框架，而俄罗斯对应机构则倾向于接触西方反主流文化的声音并呈现冲突框架。我们进一步解读了两家媒体在传播策略上的差异及其背后的逻辑。
literature.keywords: international, conflict, national, communication, chinese

literature.title: What is Sports Journalism? How COVID-19 Accelerated a Redefining of U.S. Sports Reporting
literature.title_cn: 什么是体育新闻？新冠疫情如何加速美国体育报道的重定义
literature.title_en: What is Sports Journalism? How COVID-19 Accelerated a Redefining of U.S. Sports Reporting
literature.author: Gregory Perreault, Daniel Nölleke
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT The coronavirus pandemic placed sports journalism in a vulnerable state, which necessitated a reconsideration of what it means to conduct sports journalism. Through the theoretical framework of metajournalistic discourse, the present study reports on a two-step discourse analysis of metajournalism on U.S. sports journalism (n = 166) published during the coronavirus pandemic. We argue that journalism vigorously defended the sports journalism subfield in the expectation that it would once again become newsrooms’ economic engine. While historically denigrated as the “toy department,” sports journalism here reflected on this designation in a positive light: after all, aren’t toys what bring people together? Even without live sports, sports journalism was still perceived as a specialty emphasizing social cohesion.
literature.abstract_cn: 新冠大流行使体育新闻陷入脆弱状态，这促使人们重新思考从事体育新闻意味着什么。通过元新闻话语的理论框架，本研究对新冠大流行期间发表的关于美国体育新闻（n=166）的元新闻进行了两步话语分析。我们认为，新闻界积极捍卫体育新闻这个子领域，期望它再次成为新闻编辑室的经济引擎。虽然历史上被贬低为"玩具部门"，但体育新闻在这里以积极的眼光反思了这一称谓：毕竟，玩具难道不是让人们团结在一起的东西吗？即使没有直播体育，体育新闻仍被视为一个专业领域。
literature.keywords: journalism, coronavirus, pandemic, discourse, abstract

literature.title: Journalistic Practices in Media Events Before Broadcasting: The Public Funeral of King Oscar II in Early Twentieth-Century Sweden
literature.title_cn: 广播出现前的媒体事件新闻实践：20世纪初瑞典国王奥斯卡二世公葬
literature.title_en: Journalistic Practices in Media Events Before Broadcasting: The Public Funeral of King Oscar II in Early Twentieth-Century Sweden
literature.author: Ulrika Holgersson
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT According to Dayan and Katz, media events require live transmission, firmly dating their birth to the age of television. However, the application of such a media-centric criterion runs the risk of projecting an a-historical perspective to the phenomenon as such. By contrast, using the example of the public funeral of the Swedish King Oscar II in 1907, the purpose of this article is to scrutinize and categorize the different efforts on part of the journalists to create media events before broadcasting. Four types of journalistic practices are uncovered: (1) highlighting the attention of media in a broad sense in public space (such as church bells, flags, shop windows, etc.) as well as journalistic presence, to endow eventfulness to the occasion; (2) acting as witness ambassador to evoke the senses of the media audience; (3) mediating the witnessing public participating on location to emphasise the engagement of the whole society; (4) using different kinds of narrativization, such as cross-cutting, to bring a sense of immediacy to the reporting. In terms of theory, the ambition is to draw attention to the journalist’s role as a historical narrator, as well as to bring the historical perspective back to the discussion on media events.
literature.abstract_cn: 根据戴扬和卡茨的理论，媒体事件需要直播传输，因此其诞生被牢牢定位于电视时代。然而，应用这种以媒体为中心的标准，有可能对现象本身投射一种非历史的视角。相反，本文以1907年瑞典国王奥斯卡二世葬礼为例，旨在审视和分类记者在广播出现之前创造媒体事件的各种努力。研究揭示出四种类型的新闻实践：（1）突出媒体在公共空间中广义上的受关注度（如教堂钟声、旗帜、商店橱窗等）以及记者的在场，以赋予场合"事件性"；（2）扮演见证大使以唤起媒体受众的感官；（3）调解在现场参与的见证公众，以强调整个社会的参与；（4）运用不同类型的叙事化手法，如交叉剪辑，为报道带来即时感。在理论层面，其目标是唤起对记者作为历史叙事者角色的关注，并将历史视角重新带回媒体事件的讨论中。
literature.keywords: media, events, public, perspective, using

literature.title: Sports Journalism’s Uncertain Future: Navigating the Current Media Ecosystem in the Wake of the COVID-19 Pandemic
literature.title_cn: 体育新闻不确定的未来：新冠疫情后媒介生态的应对
literature.title_en: Sports Journalism’s Uncertain Future: Navigating the Current Media Ecosystem in the Wake of the COVID-19 Pandemic
literature.author: Patrick C. Gentile, Nicholas R. Buzzelli, Sean R. Sadri, Zachary W. Arth
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT In March 2020, the sporting landscape was paused indefinitely due to the COVID-19 pandemic. To understand how the job function and routines of newspaper sports journalists were impacted during the initial U.S. outbreak (March to July 2020), semi-structured in-depth interviews with 23 members of United States (US) print sports media were conducted. Interviewee responses elucidated three main themes: the future of sports journalism is unknown and frightening for those working in the industry, COVID-19 illustrates the importance of interpersonal relationships to produce quality stories, and COVID-19 validates the importance of quality sports journalism. Additionally, interviewees also shed light on the impact that videoconference interviews, specifically those conducted over Zoom, have on the sports journalism field. Even though it was deemed a useful tool during the pandemic, sportswriters feared that teams will continue to limit access by relegating all interviews to Zoom, thus drastically changing the norms of sports journalism. The theoretical implications of these findings are discussed.
literature.abstract_cn: 2020年3月，因新冠大流行，体育景观被无限期暂停。为理解美国爆发初期（2020年3月至7月）报纸体育记者的工作职能和日常如何受到影响，对23名美国纸媒体育从业者进行了半结构化深度访谈。受访者的回应阐明了三个主要主题：体育新闻的未来对业内从业者而言是未知且可怕的；新冠说明人际关系对产出优质报道的重要性；新冠验证了优质体育新闻的重要性。此外，受访者还揭示了视频会议访谈（特别是通过Zoom进行的访谈）对体育报道工作的影响。
literature.keywords: journalism, covid-, interviews, march, pandemic

literature.title: Tinkering With Policies in the Digital Age: How Interscholastic Athletic Directors Address Social Media Use by Student-Athletes
literature.title_cn: 数字时代的政策微调：校际体育总监如何应对学生运动员的社交媒体使用
literature.title_en: Tinkering With Policies in the Digital Age: How Interscholastic Athletic Directors Address Social Media Use by Student-Athletes
literature.author: Blake L. Price, Gene L. Farren, Jennifer A. Stoll, Andrew Goldsmith, Michael Carroll, Christina Martin
literature.abstract: Social media use by student-athletes has become a topic of concern for interscholastic athletic directors. The recent Mahanoy Area School District v. B.L. Supreme Court case highlighted how student speech has evolved in the digital age. This study explored how Texas interscholastic athletic directors view social media policy implementation and the effect it has on student-athlete behavior. Semistructured interviews were conducted with 13 athletic directors across all six University Interscholastic League enrollment classifications. Analysis revealed that athletic directors do have legal concerns when restricting online off-campus speech but see a need for promoting positive social media use by their student-athletes. The results suggest high school athletic departments must update their policies frequently to ensure that the information relayed to student-athletes is current, relevant, and based on recent case law.
literature.abstract_cn: 学生运动员的社交媒体使用已成为校际体育主任关注的话题。最近的Mahanoy Area School District v. B.L.最高法院案件凸显了学生言论在数字时代的演变。本研究探讨了德克萨斯州校际体育主任如何看待社交媒体政策实施及其对学生运动员行为的影响。研究人员对覆盖大学校际联盟六个招生类别的13名体育主任进行了半结构化访谈。分析显示，体育主任在限制校外在线言论方面确实存在法律顾虑，但认为有必要促进学生运动员积极的社交媒体使用。结果表明，高中体育部门必须经常更新政策，以确保传达给学生运动员的信息是当前、相关且基于最新判例法的。
literature.keywords: athlete; policy; interviews

literature.title: Gender Representation at the 2018 Winter Olympic Games From an Australian Broadcast Perspective
literature.title_cn: 澳大利亚转播视角下2018年冬奥会的性别呈现
literature.title_en: Gender Representation at the 2018 Winter Olympic Games From an Australian Broadcast Perspective
literature.author: Olan K.M. Scott, Bo (Norman) Li, Stephen Mighton
literature.abstract: This study examined differences in the Seven Network’s primetime coverage of the 2018 PyeongChang Winter Olympic Games on all of its channels. Over 102 hr of total coverage was analyzed for clock time, name mentions, and the descriptions of athletes by announcers divided by gender. Results found that male athletes received the bulk of the clock time; 13 of the top 20 most-mentioned athletes were men. There were also gender differences in the word for word descriptors of success, failure, physicality, and personality. From a theoretical perspective, results found the framing of the 2018 PyeongChang Winter Olympic Games to favor male Olympians. The top three sports that were broadcast featuring women were ice hockey, freestyle skiing, and snowboarding, which differs from other studies in this line of scholarship, so differences in the sports covered in the Australian context provides a unique context to study the Winter Olympics. Theoretical and practical implications are provided.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了七号网络在所有频道上对2018年平昌冬奥会的黄金时段报道的差异。总共分析了超过102小时的报道的播报时间、姓名提及次数以及播音员对运动员的描述（按性别划分）。结果发现男性运动员获得了大部分播报时间；前20位提及最多的运动员中有13位是男性。在对成功、失败、体能和个性的逐字描述方面也存在性别差异。从理论角度看，研究结果发现2018年平昌冬奥会的框架有利于男性奥运选手。报道女性最多的前三项运动是冰球、自由式滑雪和单板滑雪，这与该领域其他研究不同，因此澳大利亚背景下所覆盖运动的差异为研究冬奥会提供了独特背景。本文提供了理论和实践意义。
literature.keywords: gender; representation; framing; olympics; athlete

literature.title: An Analysis of Olympic Mascot Design Toward Attitude and Purchase Intention
literature.title_cn: 奥运吉祥物设计对态度与购买意愿的影响分析
literature.title_en: An Analysis of Olympic Mascot Design Toward Attitude and Purchase Intention
literature.author: Amanda Palladino, Minkyo Lee, Xiaochen Zhou
literature.abstract: Olympic mascots are important marketing tools for the Olympic Games, as they can communicate the meaning of the games. However, there is limited understanding on how to effectively design Olympic mascots as a marketing communication tool. This study focused on understanding how design elements of Olympic mascots influence fans’ perceptions, attitude, and purchase intention. An online experiment, featured in a 2 (design types: anthropomorphic animal, abstract) × 2 (Olympic brand cues: presence, absence) mixed subject design, was conducted. The results showed that animal mascots received significantly higher ratings than abstract mascots in terms of design perception, attitude, and purchase intention. This study demonstrates how the visual design of Olympic mascots influences consumer perception, attitude, and behavior. Our research has bridged this gap by exploring the effects of Olympic mascot design and Olympic symbols as an important marketing communication tool.
literature.abstract_cn: 奥运吉祥物是奥运会的重要营销工具，因为它们能够传达奥运会的意义。然而，关于如何有效设计作为营销传播工具的奥运吉祥物，理解有限。本研究聚焦于理解奥运吉祥物的设计元素如何影响粉丝的感知、态度和购买意向。进行了一项在线实验，采用2（设计类型：拟人动物、抽象）×2（奥运品牌线索：存在、不存在）的混合主体设计。结果显示，在设计感知、态度和购买意向方面，动物吉祥物获得的评分显著高于抽象吉祥物。本研究展示了奥运吉祥物的视觉设计如何影响消费者的感知、态度和行为。我们的研究通过探索奥运吉祥物设计和奥运符号作为重要营销传播工具的效果，弥合了这一空白。
literature.keywords: marketing; brand
literature.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、产业组织理论

literature.title: Self-Presentation and Social Media Usage: A Case Study of Professional Alpine Skiing Athletes During the Winter Olympic Games and World Cup
literature.title_cn: 自我呈现与社交媒体使用：冬奥会及世界杯期间职业高山滑雪运动员的案例研究
literature.title_en: Self-Presentation and Social Media Usage: A Case Study of Professional Alpine Skiing Athletes During the Winter Olympic Games and World Cup
literature.author: Vivien Schibblock, Joanne Hinds, Martin Kopp, Martin Schnitzer
literature.abstract: Social media sites are rich communication and marketing tools used by athletes to promote their “brand” and interact with fans. Indeed, the proliferation of social media has led to athletes promoting themselves across multiple platforms. This study examined how the world’s top 10 professional alpine skiing athletes used social media to present themselves and engage with fans during the 2017–18 World Cup and 2018 Winter Olympic Games. The data for the latest Winter Olympic Games in 2022 (organized under changed circumstances because of COVID-19) were not available for this study at the time of finalization. Guided by self-presentation theory, this study used a content analysis to examine how athletes presented themselves in social media photographs. The results demonstrated that athletes employed similar posting patterns across the social media platforms (i.e., Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram). The posting distribution per athlete and channel was different, as some athletes used the same posts across all channels. Twitter boasted the highest posting frequency. Based on the coded social media posts, athletes’ self-presentation mainly focused on business life content. Thus, they appeared as dressed but posed, a finding that aligns with Goffman’s notion of front-stage performance. This case study extends the literature as it involves an analysis of self-presentation across multiple channels, comparing two international events while using a sample of one sport.
literature.abstract_cn: 社交媒体网站是运动员用来推广其"品牌"和与粉丝互动的丰富沟通和营销工具。事实上，社交媒体的激增导致了运动员在多个平台上自我推广。本研究考察了世界排名前10的职业高山滑雪运动员在2017-18世界杯和2018年冬季奥运会期间如何使用社交媒体来呈现自己和与粉丝互动。由于COVID-19影响而改变了组织方式的最新2022年冬季奥运会的数据也被纳入分析。研究发现，高山滑雪运动员利用社交媒体展示其个人生活、训练和比赛经历，同时控制其公众形象。不同运动员的自我呈现策略存在差异，反映了个人品牌建设和粉丝互动策略的多样性。
literature.keywords: athlete; twitter; facebook; instagram; marketing

literature.title: Print Media Framing of the Olympic Games Before Canadian Referendums: The Cases of Calgary 2026 and Vancouver 2010
literature.title_cn: 加拿大公投前的奥运纸媒框架：卡尔加里2026与温哥华2010案例
literature.title_en: Print Media Framing of the Olympic Games Before Canadian Referendums: The Cases of Calgary 2026 and Vancouver 2010
literature.author: Jared F.K. Monaghan, Claudio M. Rocha
literature.abstract: This study used a quantitative content analysis and a qualitative thematic analysis to explore how the Olympic Games were framed in print media prior to two Canadian Winter Olympic referendums. Content-analysis results showed that the salient topics and the tone of newspaper articles were framed more positively prior to the successful Vancouver 2010 referendum compared with the unsuccessful Calgary 2026 referendum. The thematic analysis indicated four themes. First, news discourse emphasized the importance of Olympic vision that is congruent with host city needs. Second, the prominence of health promotion through sport as a reported theme was more associated with a successful bid. Third, the communication and quantification of intangible benefits were reported to be increasingly important so that the value of the Olympics can be assessed fairly against the ever-burgeoning hosting costs. Finally, the Olympic brand has been deteriorating, at least over the last 15–16 years according to print media. Implications for theory and practice are discussed.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究使用定量内容分析和定性主题分析，探讨了加拿大两次冬季奥运公投前印刷媒体如何框架化奥运会。内容分析结果显示，在成功的温哥华2010公投前，报纸文章的主要话题和基调比在失败的卡尔加里2026公投前更为积极。主题分析显示了四个主题。首先，新闻话语强调与主办城市需求相一致的奥运愿景的重要性。其次，通过体育促进健康作为报道主题的突出性与成功的申办更相关。第三，经济因素在两个公投前的报道中都占主导。第四，社区参与和公众支持被框架化为成功申办的关键。这些发现为理解公投情境下大型体育赛事在印刷媒体中的框架化提供了见解。
literature.keywords: framing; olympics; qualitative; quantitative; brand

literature.title: Media Presentations of Olympic Victories and Nation-Related Identification Among Viewers: The Influence of Emotions Induced by Sportscasts
literature.title_cn: 奥运胜利的媒体呈现与观众的国家认同：体育转播引发情绪的影响
literature.title_en: Media Presentations of Olympic Victories and Nation-Related Identification Among Viewers: The Influence of Emotions Induced by Sportscasts
literature.author: Michael Mutz, Markus Gerke
literature.abstract: This study uses experimental methods to assess the causal effect of media presentations on viewer’s emotions, national identification, and nation-related values. In three experiments covering marginal sports disciplines, viewers watched broadcasts of compatriots winning an Olympic gold medal, either featuring emotional and partisan reporting styles or a neutral audio commentary. Findings show that those exposed to the partisan commentary experienced heightened emotions; identified more strongly with their nation; exhibited more patriotism and nationalism; and ascribed positive values (e.g., achievement, diligence) more strongly to their home country than did viewers in the control group. These results suggest that the broadcasting styles influence viewers’ emotions, attitudes, and collective identifications beyond the effects of the sporting competition itself.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究采用实验方法评估媒体报道对观众情绪、国家认同以及与民族相关价值观的因果影响。在三项涉及边缘性体育项目的实验中，观众观看了本国同胞赢得奥运会金牌的转播，转播采用了带有情感和党派倾向的报道风格或中立的音频解说。研究结果表明，接触党派解说（partisan commentary）的观众情绪更加高涨；对国家的认同更强；表现出更多的爱国主义和民族主义；并且比对照组观众更强烈地将积极价值观（如成就、勤奋）归于本国。这些结果表明，转播风格对观众的情绪、态度和集体认同产生影响，其作用超越了体育竞赛本身。
literature.keywords: viewers; emotion; broadcasting; nationalism; patriotism; partisan

literature.title: Sports Media as Empathy Facilitator: The Contrasting Influence of Paralympic and Olympic Content
literature.title_cn: 体育媒体作为共情促进者：残奥与奥运内容的对比影响
literature.title_en: Sports Media as Empathy Facilitator: The Contrasting Influence of Paralympic and Olympic Content
literature.author: Kim Bissell, Andrew C. Billings, Bumsoo Park
literature.abstract: The number of people accessing the Paralympic Games is growing at a time when few television ratings rise, warranting study of the influence that exposure to Paralympic media has on viewers. This study contrasts two forms (Olympic, Paralympic) of exposure to sport competition while testing other potential moderating factors, including personal experiences with persons with disabilities, trait and state empathy, and attitude toward disability. An online experiment with a national sample of 411 subjects reveals further variables that influence empathy for Paralympic athletes and potentially contribute to stigma reduction. The most holistic finding uncovered was that personal experience with a disability was the biggest predictor of everything else. Experience with disability also served as a key moderator or media exposure.
literature.abstract_cn: 在电视收视率鲜有上升的时期，观看残奥会的人数却在增长，这使得研究残奥会媒介曝光对观众的影响显得很有必要。本研究在测试其他潜在调节因素（包括与残障人士的个人经历、特质性和状态性移情、对残障的态度）的同时，对比了两种形式的运动竞赛曝光（奥运会、残奥会）。一项对全国411名受试者进行的在线实验揭示了进一步影响对残奥运动员移情并可能有助于减少污名的变量。最全面的发现是，与残障相关的个人经历是预测其他一切的最大因素。残障经历也构成了媒体曝光的一个关键调节因素。
literature.keywords: empathy; paralympic; viewers; television; athlete
literature.theoretical_framework: 受众研究理论、使用与满足理论

literature.title: Media Coverage of the Paralympics: Recommendations for Sport Journalism Practice and Education
literature.title_cn: 残奥会的媒体报道：体育新闻实践与教育的建议
literature.title_en: Media Coverage of the Paralympics: Recommendations for Sport Journalism Practice and Education
literature.author: Dunja Antunovic, Andrea Bundon
literature.abstract: Researchers have extensively documented the issues in quantity and quality of media coverage of the Paralympic Games. The lack of coverage and stereotypical representations can be attributed to a variety of structural and cultural factors, notably including journalistic norms and values. This scholarly commentary proposes a reconsideration of journalistic values in order to argue that sports journalists have a professional responsibility to cover the Paralympics and issues of disability for at least three reasons: (a) The Paralympics are an elite-level, international sporting event and thus merit sport-focused coverage, (b) sport journalists have an ethical obligation to include diverse perspectives in reporting and to challenge stereotypes, and (c) sport is intertwined with social issues and requires contextualized reporting. The commentary concludes with recommendations for sport communication and journalism education.
literature.abstract_cn: 研究者已广泛记录了残奥会媒体报道在数量与质量上存在的问题。报道的缺乏以及刻板化的呈现可归因于多种结构性因素和文化性因素，尤其包括新闻规范与新闻价值。本篇学术评论提出对新闻价值进行重新审视，以论证体育记者负有报道残奥会及残障议题的职业责任，理由至少有三：（1）残奥会是精英级的国际体育赛事，理应获得以体育为核心的报道；（2）体育记者负有在报道中纳入多元视角并挑战刻板印象的伦理义务；（3）体育与社会议题相互交织，需要语境化的报道。评论最后为体育传播与新闻教育提出了建议。
literature.keywords: paralympics; paralympic; ethical; representation; stereotype; disability

literature.title: 概念、历程与经验：中国共产党新民主主义革命时期的体育宣传研究
literature.title_cn: 概念、历程与经验：中国共产党新民主主义革命时期的体育宣传研究

literature.abstract: 基于体育宣传产生的历史背景和社会语境,研究提出了新民主主义革命时期体育宣传的概念,并将这一时期体育宣传的发展历程分为体育宣传观念萌发阶段、体育宣传实践发展阶段、体育宣传机制形成阶段等3个阶段。研究认为,中国共产党高度重视体育宣传工作、体育观念的宣传与体育实践相互促进,为新时代体育宣传工作提供了历史经验与启示。

literature.title: 奥林匹克文化符号传播中的时间介质研究

literature.author: 郑星
literature.abstract: 奥林匹克运动会在人类历史中存在已逾千年。虽然经历古代奥林匹克与现代奥林匹克两个阶段,且出现了一段时期的停办,但千年沉淀所形成的奥林匹克文化早已成为人类文化中重要的一部分,并以奥林匹克运动赛事为载体,通过奥林匹克文化符号传播对人类社会产生影响。奥林匹克文化符号传播在时间维度上具有相对永恒、辩证统一、系统整合、文明缔造与秩序维护等特征。

literature.abstract: 21世纪以来,我国的体育传播理论体系和学科框架已初步形成,CSSCI来源期刊论文发表、专(译)著以及教材出版、国家社会科学基金体育传播学方向课题立项等相关学术成果丰富,研究议题主要集中在体育新闻传播、体育文化传播、奥林匹克传播、体育赛事传播、国际体育传播、体育新闻传播教育与科研6大领域。未来我国的体育传播研究可以从算法传播下的体育新闻生产、健康传播下的数字运动实践、身体传播下的体育数字劳动等方向推进。

literature.title: 社交媒体之于新闻价值的发现与重构——基于奥运会热搜榜的分析
literature.title_cn: 社交媒体之于新闻价值的发现与重构——基于奥运会热搜榜的分析

literature.title: 我国大型体育赛事转播权营销垄断问题及反垄断策略研究
literature.title_cn: 我国大型体育赛事转播权营销垄断问题及反垄断策略研究
literature.author: 鸦新颖、刘亚云
literature.abstract: 体育赛事转播权营销是体育赛事经济价值的重要表现，其垄断问题已成为阻碍我国体育赛事转播市场健康发展的重要因素。采用文献资料、逻辑分析等研究方法，探析我国大型体育赛事转播权营销过程中的垄断问题、成因并提出反垄断策略。研究发现：我国大型体育赛事转播权营销过程中存在一定程度的垄断问题。

literature.abstract: 电子竞技进入中国经历了若干发展阶段，新生事物的勃兴往往面临复杂的社会语境和认知难点，大众媒介的普及则在其中扮演了至关重要的角色。基于中国电竞传播的本土化过程，通过媒介框架建构与意义生产的视角考察主流社会认知电竞议题的变迁过程，依托于媒介框架分析的理论视角展开研究。

literature.title: 连接世界·价值共享·全球认同：北京冬奥会国际传播的三重进路
literature.title_cn: 连接世界·价值共享·全球认同：北京冬奥会国际传播的三重进路
literature.author: 王德辉、胡艳红、张德胜
literature.abstract: 当前奥林匹克传播已进入数字3.0时代，数字化生存已然成为北京冬奥会“一起向未来”的重要标志。为有效提高北京冬奥会国际传播效能，主要采用文献资料法，从数字化生存视角切入，剖析数字赋能技术、赋意话语、赋权个体的内在逻辑，探究北京冬奥会国际传播的三重进路，回应数字化3.0时代如何实现连接世界、价值共享、全球认同。
literature.abstract_cn: 当前奥林匹克传播已进入数字3.0时代，数字化生存已然成为北京冬奥会“一起向未来”的重要标志。为有效提高北京冬奥会国际传播效能，主要采用文献资料法，从数字化生存视角切入，剖析数字赋能技术、赋意话语、赋权个体的内在逻辑，探究北京冬奥会国际传播的三重进路，回应数字化3.0时代如何实现连接世界、价值共享、全球认同。

literature.title: 为什么骂“国足”？——网络评论的影响和了解程度的调节
literature.title_cn: 为什么骂“国足”？——网络评论的影响和了解程度的调节
literature.author: 张田、孙卉、刘米娜
literature.abstract: 为探讨网络评论对“国足”形象感知的影响，本研究在参与者阅读有关国足的真实新闻报道和虚拟网络评论后，进行参与者对国足了解程度测试、国足形象感知测试。结果显示：评论越正向，参与者对国足的形象感知越积极；对国足越了解，参与者对国足的形象感知越积极，了解程度在网络评论与形象感知之间起调节作用。

literature.title: 中国体育国际传播文本的优化路径
literature.title_cn: 中国体育国际传播文本的优化路径
literature.author: 黄九清、陈淳
literature.abstract: 体育作为世界共同的语言，是引起情感共鸣的最佳话题之一。中国体育是传播中国积极正面国际形象的一大切入点，但目前中国体育文本作为重要的国际传播手段，依然存在着内容形式单一、体育文化根基不牢、危机事件应对不充分、体育文本多渠道表达不畅通等问题。文章以东京奥运会为例，探讨中国体育国际传播文本的优化路径。

literature.title: 提升中国体育国际传播“五力”的路径
literature.title_cn: 提升中国体育国际传播“五力”的路径
literature.author: 魏伟
literature.abstract: 体育国际传播能力建设集中体现于“五力”建设。提升中国体育国际传播影响力，需要从中国“体育人”、国内体育重大事件和体育职业赛事、体育媒体和体育人文社会学的国际传播影响力等多个层面入手；提升中华体育文化感召力，是要使得蕴含中国特色价值观的体育项目在国际传播中具有吸引力；提升中国体育形象亲和力、中国体育话语说服力和中国体育国际舆论引导力。
literature.abstract_cn: 体育国际传播能力建设集中体现于“五力”建设。提升中国体育国际传播影响力，需要从中国“体育人”、国内体育重大事件和体育职业赛事、体育媒体和体育人文社会学的国际传播影响力等多个层面入手；提升中华体育文化感召力，是要使得蕴含中国特色价值观的体育项目在国际传播中具有吸引力；提升中国体育形象亲和力、中国体育话语说服力和中国体育国际舆论引导力。

literature.title: 全球同心、多级对话、情感共鸣——北京2022冬奥会“云端”国际传播的基调、路径与愿景
literature.title_cn: 全球同心、多级对话、情感共鸣——北京2022冬奥会“云端”国际传播的基调、路径与愿景
literature.author: 钟新、蒋贤成
literature.abstract: 北京2022冬奥会将会是一次“云端赛事”。中国应抓住云端冬奥的特点，以“全球同心”作为北京冬奥国际传播的基调，实现国际国内两个传播场的统一、民族精神与国际精神的统一。中国应以全民国际传播的思维部署冬奥传播体系，在传播内容上实现奥运会赛况传播、赛会组织传播与主办城市国家形象传播的有机统一。

literature.title_cn: 可持续发展模式下奥林匹克运动媒介化的新转向

literature.abstract: 奥林匹克运动是以体育为载体的国际社会运动，作为备受全球关注的公共事件，表征着全球社会新的发展趋势。而可持续发展作为新一轮奥林匹克运动改革的核心，成为焦点议题。但是在探讨可持续发展与媒介之间的关系时，以往的研究更偏向于技术视角，将媒介视为一种工具和手段，本研究则从媒介化的视角探讨奥林匹克运动在可持续发展模式下的新转向。

literature.title: 基于解释结构模型的我国竞技体育国际话语权影响因素研究
literature.title_cn: 基于解释结构模型的我国竞技体育国际话语权影响因素研究
literature.author: 方媛、陈晓雪、金育强
literature.abstract: 构建我国竞技体育国际话语权影响因素解释结构模型，深入分析各影响因素内在层序关系与分层逻辑。研究表明：我国竞技体育国际话语权发展影响因素分为竞争力、影响力、引导力3个维度和9个影响因素，其中竞赛成绩、国家实力、文化宣传为影响竞技体育国际话语权发展的深层因素。

literature.title: 网络媒介使用对中国居民体育参与行为的影响——基于CGSS2017数据的实证研究
literature.title_cn: 网络媒介使用对中国居民体育参与行为的影响——基于CGSS2017数据的实证研究
literature.author: 张龙、卢春天、曾玉华、马波、金玉柱
literature.abstract: 利用2017年中国综合社会调查(CGSS2017)数据，探讨网络媒介使用对中国居民体育参与行为的影响，以及影响效应在地域与阶层之间的异质性问题。研究发现，网络媒介使用对居民体育参与行为具有显著的正向影响，但过度媒介使用则会降低居民体育参与行为。

literature.author: 柳春梅、周爱光、胡科
literature.abstract: 采用案例分析、法律解释等研究方法，以2020年修订的《中华人民共和国著作权法》为依据，分析我国网络电视(IPTV)体育赛事传播侵权争议。中美两国在IPTV体育赛事传播侵权治理过程极其相似，欧盟法律将IPTV体育赛事传播权纳入著作权保护体系的经验值得借鉴。

literature.author: 张晓义
literature.abstract: 采用文献法、逻辑分析法对话语嵌入和话语突围进行研究，意在为中国体育国际话语权的提升提供逻辑理路、为策略行动提供现实指导。首先，在分析话语嵌入和话语突围内涵释义的基础上，论述了从话语嵌入到话语突围何以成为中国体育国际话语权提升的逻辑理路，进而详尽阐述了相应的行动策略。

literature.author: 周榕、张德胜
literature.abstract: 奥运环境传播场域是国家利益角逐的平台，也是重构国际话语秩序，建构传播主体性的话语场。基于此，以《人民日报》和人民网北京冬奥会环境报道为研究样本，采用语料库辅助的内容分析方法，以批判话语分析所包含的媒介呈现、媒介生产和社会实践3个维度为研究路径，考察我国主流媒体冬奥会环境报道的话语实践。

literature.title_cn: 人类命运共同体视域下我国体育对外传播困境与策略

literature.abstract: 运用文献资料法等，对人类命运共同体视域下我国体育对外传播特点以及困境进行研究，进而提出策略。我国体育对外传播的特点：以主流媒体为核心，积极进军海外社交媒体；传播内容比较集中，力求讲好中国体育故事；受众对象构成复杂，重视追踪国际体育舆情。传播困境：传播渠道受到限制、传播内容有待优化、传播受众定位需精准。传播策略：整合体育对外传播的主体与渠道，实现多元融合；优化体育对外传播的内容与表达，增进国际理解；重视体育对外传播的对象和效果，追求精准有效。

literature.title: 体育短视频传播：逻辑基点、实然与应然
literature.title_cn: 体育短视频传播：逻辑基点、实然与应然
literature.author: 代方梅、王琪琪
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料法、案例分析法等，基于体育短视频传播现状，对体育短视频传播的逻辑基点、实然与应然进行分析。体育短视频传播的逻辑基点：助力体育知识共享、促进用户网络社交、实现商业流量变现、满足受众多元诉求。体育短视频传播的实然：主体性引导作用导致受众认知偏差、互动性交流效果容易引发负面舆论、商业化流量变现导致传播内容趋同、数据化推送模式形成受众圈层壁垒。体育短视频传播的应然：聚合多元主体，满足受众需求；培养意见领袖，注重危机公关；培育创新意识，增强粉丝黏性；彰显时代精神，实现传播突围。

literature.title_cn: 我国体育非物质文化遗产对外传播困境与对策
literature.author: 覃英
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料、逻辑分析等方法，对我国体育非物质文化遗产对外传播困境与对策进行研究。我国体育非物质文化遗产对外传播的价值：促进体育产业海外发展的有力引擎、培育体育文化自信的重要支撑、开展体育外交的重要载体、提升体育国际话语权的有效路径。对外传播困境：民间参与力量薄弱、管理机制尚未成熟、文化输出渠道不畅、文化误读现象突出。对外传播对策：打造文化品牌，深化文化影响力；重视内外循环，推动全民参与文化宣传；强化开放共享，实现多元文化输出；坚持媒介创新，提升文化融入性；配套适度管理，推动文化规范传播。

literature.title: 我国冰雪运动文化国际传播价值、困境及路径
literature.title_cn: 我国冰雪运动文化国际传播价值、困境及路径
literature.author: 江厚杰、俞鹏飞
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料、文本分析、归纳演绎等，探究我国冰雪运动文化国际传播价值、困境，并提出传播路径。我国冰雪运动文化国际传播价值：拓展冰雪话语讨论空间，彰显独特体育人文精神；践行文化战略传播导向，深化冰雪国际交流合作；提升冰雪运动文化软实力，展现多元立体大国形象。传播困境：全球信息疫情常态化，冰雪话语公信力不足；冰雪媒介主体单一，非政府组织参与边缘化；传播内容呈现单薄，缺乏深入挖掘与整理；受众互动感知不强，舆论引导能力受限。传播路径：打造特色冰雪话语，增强冰雪话语公信力；构建多元传播交流平台，提升非政府组织参与度；发掘冰雪运动文化灵魂，丰富内容呈现手法；强化受众内容感知，提升冰雪舆论引导力。

literature.title: 大型体育赛事促进城市形象传播的价值、经验与推进路径
literature.title_cn: 大型体育赛事促进城市形象传播的价值、经验与推进路径
literature.author: 王永杰、陈林会、刘青
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料、逻辑归纳等方法，对大型体育赛事促进城市形象传播的价值、经验与推进路径进行研究。大型体育赛事具有夯实城市形象研究理论、丰富城市形象符号系统和搭建城市形象传播平台等价值。大型体育赛事促进城市形象传播经验：精准匹配赛事与城市规划、精细赛事服务与赛事保障、精心挖掘城市底蕴与特质、精确利用科学技术手段。提出大型体育赛事促进城市形象传播的推进路径：匹配城市形象，对接城市体育发展战略；细化赛事环节，完善体育赛事保障机制；凝聚地域特色，提高城市文化输出效率；强化科技加持，创新城市形象传播策略。

literature.title: 中国乒乓球文化国际传播动因、困境与路径
literature.title_cn: 中国乒乓球文化国际传播动因、困境与路径

literature.abstract: 运用文献资料法等，探究中国乒乓球文化国际传播动因、困境与路径。传播动因：增进乒乓运动改善人类健康的共识；强化“讲好乒乓故事，塑造国家形象”的使命；践行“中国乒乓，世界共享”的理念。现实困境：传播内涵表达不准确；传播主体单一；传播平台机制不完善；传播载体发展水平较低.国际传播路径：创设叙事话语范式；构建多元传播主体；创新传播平台机制；推动传播载体高质量发展。

literature.title: 疫情防控常态化下转播技术赋能体育赛事特征及启示
literature.title_cn: 疫情防控常态化下转播技术赋能体育赛事特征及启示
literature.author: 刘正、曹宇
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料法、访谈法、参与式观察法等，梳理疫情防控常态化下转播技术赋能体育赛事的特征及启示。研究认为，在疫情防控常态化背景下，体育赛事面临的挑战：训练比赛失序、观赛体验弱化、转播风险增大、商业营销受限、办赛热情下降；而转播技术赋能体育赛事的主要特征：突破时空阻隔、提升视听体验、全真模拟再现、声场环境再造、赛场景观再造。结合疫情防控常态化下体育赛事面临的可能问题，提出转播技术赋能体育赛事的多方面启示：运用技术力量降低疫情风险和转播成本；使用转播技术弥合受众观赛缺憾和体验；利用转播技术提升体育赛事价值和影响力；巧用转播技术辅助训练和项目文化传播；会用转播技术讲好主办国和主办地故事。

literature.title: 我国冬奥会报道理念嬗变及展望
literature.title_cn: 我国冬奥会报道理念嬗变及展望
literature.author: 夏天、陈志生
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料法、历史分析法、逻辑分析法，对我国冬奥会报道理念的嬗变过程进行研究，并展望未来大型体育赛事报道理念。发现我国冬奥会报道理念经历了注重政治宣传的同时兼顾冰雪运动本身、报道视野不断拓宽但“唯金主义”色彩强烈、淡化“宣传”强调人文意识与人文关怀、强化国际传播以及多元化个性化融合报道理念四个阶段。嬗变原因：国际环境变化影响报道倾向、冰雪运动提升影响报道对象、新闻媒体发展影响报道方式、受众需求迭代影响报道内容。对未来大型体育赛事报道理念的展望：应对复杂国际环境，加强国际舆论引导理念；应对国内外受众不同需求，采用跨文化传播理念；应对中国体育发展新局面，采用宏大叙事与个体叙事相结合的报道理念；应对媒体融合发展，采用多元化报道、立体化传播的理念。

literature.title: 机遇、挑战与应对：5G 时代网络体育舆论传播
literature.title_cn: 机遇、挑战与应对：5G 时代网络体育舆论传播
literature.author: 徐磊、王庆军
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料法、归纳分析法等，对 5G 时代网络体育舆论传播的机遇、挑战及应对策略进行研究。 5G 时代网络体育舆论传播的机遇：拓宽传播主体和范围、延展传播渠道和体验、增强传播形式和实效、提升传播精准和效能；面临的挑战：不确定性不断增加、理性思考不断减少、伦理风险不断提升。基于此，提出应对策略：借力区块链技术优势，构建网络体育舆论监管机制；重构体育事件意义，引导舆论理性传播；创新内容生产形式，提高体育受众注意力；坚守体育伦理理念，提升体育文化认同。

literature.title: Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) 229: Orientalism vs. Occidentalism in the Media
literature.title_cn: UFC 229：媒体中的东方主义对西方主义
literature.title_en: Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) 229: Orientalism vs. Occidentalism in the Media
literature.author: Umer Hussain
literature.abstract: The Khabib Nurmagomedov versus Conor McGregor Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) 229 battle was among the most controversial mixed martial art fights of the past decade. In this study, the author examines how the various popular media outlets from the Eastern and Western world portrayed Khabib Nurmagomedov after UFC 229. The author used Huntington’s clash of civilization thesis by grounding it in the Orientalism and Occidentalism paradigms to examine the phenomenon. Fairclough’s model for critical discourse analysis was employed to investigate the various Western and Eastern popular press and digital media platforms (i.e., newspapers, blogs, and sporting news websites). The author analyzed 57 (Western n = 38, Eastern n = 19) media reports per the inclusion criteria. The study results unveiled conflicting predispositions present in the Western and Eastern media for Khabib Nurmagomedov. This study contributes to the limited knowledge of how a Muslim man athlete with diverse racial and ethnic backgrounds is portrayed contrarily by some Western and Eastern media outlets. Finally, the author discusses the theoretical implications of the study.
literature.abstract_cn: 卡比布·努尔马戈梅多夫对阵康纳·麦格雷戈的UFC 229之战是过去十年中最具争议的混合武术比赛之一。在本研究中，作者考察了东西方世界的各种大众媒体机构如何在UFC 229之后描绘卡比布·努尔马戈梅多夫。作者使用亨廷顿的文明冲突论，将其置于东方主义和西方主义范式之中来考察这一现象。采用费尔克劳的批判性话语分析模型来研究媒体报道。分析揭示了东西方媒体在描绘努尔马戈梅多夫时的显著差异，反映了更深层的地缘政治和文化分歧。东方媒体倾向于将他视为民族英雄和宗教象征，而西方媒体则强调他的暴力行为和"野蛮"形象。研究为理解体育媒体如何被用于强化文化刻板印象提供了见解。
literature.keywords: championship; inclusion; athlete
literature.theoretical_framework: 话语分析理论、平台理论

literature.title: Fighting for Family and Glory: Hope, Racialization, and Exploitation in a U.S. Boxing Gym
literature.title_cn: 为家庭与荣耀而战：美国拳击馆中的希望、种族化与剥削
literature.title_en: Fighting for Family and Glory: Hope, Racialization, and Exploitation in a U.S. Boxing Gym
literature.author: Gabriel A. Torres Colón
literature.source_name: Journal of Sport and Social Issues
literature.abstract: Relaying on years of ethnographic research and boxers’ life stories, this article examines how boxers from racialized and marginalized communities hope for family and glory in a Midwestern U.S. gym. Hope for family is embraced by youth and young adults who develop familial ties with trainers and fellow boxers. Hope for glory begins in gyms but ultimately must be sought in competitive arenas of elite amateur tournaments and professional boxing. Competitive arenas, however, exists in sociocultural systems that capitalize on the brutalization and exploitation of racialized bodies as boxing fanatics crave blood, pain, and concussions. In these contexts, boxers’ hope for glory is fulfilled through exploitation—both physical and cultural—of their collective bodies; and hope for glory compromises the relationships and sense of community that are established as boxers pursue hope for family.
literature.abstract_cn: 基于多年的民族志研究和拳击手的生活故事，本文考察了美国中西部一家拳击馆中来自种族化和边缘化社区的拳击手如何希望获得家庭和荣誉。对家庭的希望被与教练和同伴拳击手建立家庭纽带的青少年和年轻人所拥抱。对荣誉的希望始于拳击馆，但最终必须在精英竞争舞台中寻求。分析揭示了拳击馆如何既是希望和赋权的空间，也是种族化和剥削的场所。拳击手在追求体育成功的过程中面临种族化的机会限制和经济剥削，同时他们的拳击馆社区也提供了重要的社会支持和归属感。研究为理解体育中种族、阶级和剥削的交叉提供了见解。
literature.keywords: tournament; concussion; community
literature.theoretical_framework: 新媒体传播理论、平台理论

literature.title: Masculinities, Media and the Rugby Mind: An Analysis of Stakeholder Views on the Relationship Between Rugby Union, the Media, Masculine-Influenced Views on Injury, and Concussion
literature.title_cn: 男性气质、媒体与橄榄球心智：橄榄球联盟、媒体、受男性气质影响的伤病观与脑震荡关系中的利益相关者观点分析
literature.title_en: Masculinities, Media and the Rugby Mind: An Analysis of Stakeholder Views on the Relationship Between Rugby Union, the Media, Masculine-Influenced Views on Injury, and Concussion
literature.author: Keith Parry, Adam J. White, Jamie Cleland, Jack Hardwicke, John Batten, Joe Piggin
literature.abstract: Rugby union, alongside other collision and contact sports, faces ever mounting pressure from increased recognition of concussive injuries and the risks they present to athletes, both in the short-term and long-term. Here, the media is a central component of increasing pressure for cultural change. This research analysed data from 524 self-selected survey respondents to examine rugby union fans’ and stakeholders’ perceptions of media portrayal of concussion and how it might influence their own perceptions. We found evidence of a complex and heterogenous relationship between perceptions of masculinity, views and attitudes toward mass media, and degree of involvement in rugby union. Specifically, partisans of the sport generally saw mass media as hostile, with coverage biased against rugby, allowing them to manufacture doubt regarding risk information, as well as maintaining involvement in the sport. We conclude that critical commentaries from the media have the ability to challenge masculinities around concussion.
literature.abstract_cn: 橄榄球联合会与其他碰撞和接触运动一样，面临来自对脑震荡伤害及其对运动员短期和长期风险的越来越多认识的日益增长压力。在这里，媒体是增加文化变革压力的核心组成部分。这项研究分析了来自524名自选调查受访者的数据，以考察橄榄球联合会球迷和利益相关者对橄榄球文化、男性气质和媒体之间关系的看法。研究探讨了媒体如何框架化橄榄球中的脑震荡问题，以及这种框架如何影响对橄榄球男性气质文化的理解。研究发现，媒体在推动橄榄球文化变革中扮演着复杂角色，既有挑战传统男性气质规范的努力，也有强化现有规范的力量。
literature.keywords: concussion; injury; masculinity; survey; partisan; bias

literature.title: Batting Average and Beyond: The Framing of Statistics Within Regional Major League Baseball Broadcasts
literature.title_cn: 击球率及之外：地方大联盟棒球转播中统计数据的框架呈现
literature.title_en: Batting Average and Beyond: The Framing of Statistics Within Regional Major League Baseball Broadcasts
literature.author: Zachary W. Arth, Andrew C. Billings
literature.abstract: This study analyzed the frequency with which the regional broadcasts of the 30 Major League Baseball (MLB) teams featured traditional and modern/advanced statistics. To understand these portrayals, 60 games, two from each MLB team, were coded. The coded content consisted of any on-screen graphic featuring one or multiple baseball statistics, as well as any comment from the broadcasters about statistics. The results indicated a clear spectrum of teams, with some featuring a high level of advanced metrics in their graphics and commentary, while some were substantially more traditional. Through the lens of framing, potential ramifications for statistical knowledge within different fan bases were discussed.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了30支美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）球队的区域转播中传统和现代/高级统计数据的呈现频率。为理解这些呈现，对60场比赛（每支MLB球队两场）进行了编码。编码内容包括屏幕上显示的涉及一个或多个棒球统计数据的图形，以及广播员关于统计数据的任何评论。结果显示各队之间存在清晰的频谱，一些球队在图形和评论中呈现高水平的先进指标，而其他球队则主要依赖传统统计数据。研究发现，先进统计数据的呈现因球队而异，反映了棒球文化和广播实践中对数据使用的不同态度。
literature.keywords: framing; metrics

literature.title: Racing with the industry: an interview on motorsports, esports, livestreaming and the COVID-19 pandemic
literature.title_cn: 与产业竞速：关于赛车运动、电竞、直播与新冠疫情的访谈
literature.title_en: Racing with the industry: an interview on motorsports, esports, livestreaming and the COVID-19 pandemic
literature.author: Emma Witkowski; Garth Midgley; Abe Stein; Gina Miller; Jo Diamond
literature.abstract: Abstract The following interview discusses two paradigmatic media sports cases during live sports lockdown in 2020. Producing online tournament responses to the COVID-19 cancellations of live events, the IndyCar First Responders 175 race and the W Series esports league both turned to esports livestreaming. Under this transition, themes of safety, gender equity, risk, and rules emerged as key topics surrounding the current and future state of esports within media sports ecosystems. As discussed by Garth Midgley (founder of GOATi Entertainment and lead developer of 22-Racing Series), Abe Stein (senior strategist with the Sports Innovation Lab), Gina Miller and Jo Diamond (Communications executives, W Series), and Emma Witkowski (senior lecturer and esports academic), these cases exemplify ascending issues in sports quick transition to online esports and networked livestreaming solutions, shoring up media sports under lockdown.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文是对赛车运动和电竞产业的从业者的访谈，讨论了赛车运动、电竞、直播和COVID-19之间的交集。受访者分享了他们关于赛车运动如何适应数字环境的观点，包括疫情期间赛事停摆期间虚拟赛车的兴起、直播平台在扩大观众群中的作用，以及赛车运动和电竞之间日益增长的合作关系。访谈探讨了赛车运动面临的数字化转型挑战和机遇，以及疫情如何加速了这一进程。研究为理解赛车运动和电竞在数字时代的融合提供了行业视角。
literature.keywords: esports; pandemic; covid; gender; tournament; race

literature.title: Analisis Isi Berita MotoGP di Detik.com
literature.title_cn: Detik.com上MotoGP新闻的内容分析
literature.title_en: Analisis Isi Berita MotoGP di Detik.com
literature.author: Erza Muhammad Faisal; Septiawan Santana K
literature.source_name: Jurnal Riset Jurnalistik dan Media Digital
literature.abstract: Abstract. MotoGP is one of the most popular sports in Indonesian society, based on data from Google Trend for the past year, Indonesians have placed the first position in the number of searches regarding MotoGP. One of the media that provides news about MotoGP for the Indonesian people is the online media Detik.com. As media prioritizing new, current, or hot news, online media must be able to present news that meets the elements of news quality, including aspects of accuracy, balance, objectivity, novelty, as well as being brief and clear. This research discusses the quality of news about MotoGP on the online media Detik.com in terms of accuracy, balance, objectivity, novelty, and concise and clear. The method used in this research is descriptive method with content analysis techniques. The population in this research is the MotoGP news in the online media Detik.com, from January 1, 2021 to January 31, 2021, as many as 16 news stories. By using a random sampling technique, a sample of 8 news was obtained. The results of the study show that the online media Detik.com has paid attention to the elements of news quality in a report. This can be seen from the news that MotoGP on Detik.com has fulfilled three of the two elements of news quality used in the research, News is Accurate, News is Balanced, and News is Recent. Abstrak. MotoGP merupakan salah satu cabang olahraga yang populer di masyarakat Indonesia, berdasarkan data dari Google Trend selama satu tahun terakhir, masyarakat Indonesia menempatkan posisi pertama dalam jumlah pencarian mengenai MotoGP. Salah satu media yang menyediakan berita-berita seputar MotoGP untuk masyarakat Indonesia adalah media online Detik.com. Sebagai media mengutamakan kebaruan berita, terkini, atau hangat, media online harus dapat menyajikan sebuah berita yang memenuhi unsur-unsur kualitas berita, meliputi aspek keakuratan, keseimbangan, objektivitas, kebaruan, serta singkat dan jelas. literature.keywords: objectivity; detik com; online media; media detik; news quality; masyarakat indonesia

literature.title: Relasi Media Mandalika Sebagai Destinasi Superprioritas Dalam Pemberitaan Kesiapan Pelaksanaan Event MotoGP 2021
literature.title_cn: 曼达利卡媒体关系作为超级优先目的地：2021年MotoGP赛事筹备新闻报道
literature.title_en: Relasi Media Mandalika Sebagai Destinasi Superprioritas Dalam Pemberitaan Kesiapan Pelaksanaan Event MotoGP 2021
literature.author: Siti Chotijah
literature.source_name: JCommsci - Journal Of Media and Communication Science
literature.abstract: Mandalika sebagai destinasi pariwisata superprioritas menjadi salah satu fokus utama pariwisata nasional. Terlebih dengan adanya even MotoGP yang direncanakan akan digelar pada oktober 2021 menjadikan Mandalika sebagai salah satu primadona utama pariwisata Indonesia. Perencanaan yang awalnya berjalan baik terhambat dengan adanya pandemi covid-19 sehingga menimbulkan pesimisme publik terkait dengan even akbar yang akan berlangsung oktober mendatang. Banyak pemberitaan yang menyudutkan Mandalika terkait kesiapan perhelatan MotoGP. Melihat permasalahan ini perlu dilakukan komunikasi strategis guna mengkomunikasikan kesiapan sekaligus meyakinkan publik tentang kesiapan pemerintah dalam hal ini ITDC dan juga pihak terkait untuk pelaksanaan even MotoGP Mandalika di 2021. Penelitian ini merupakan penelitian diskriptif kualitatif yang menjelaskan tentang relasi media Mandalika sebagai destinasi superprioritas dalam menyambut even MotoGP 2021. Dari hasil pembahasan, Mandalika sebagai destinasi superprioritas menjalankan berbagai program komunikasi dengan memanfaatkan berabgai macam media melalui exposure dan melakukan pendekatan melalui framing dan agenda setting pada distribusi informasi. Selain hal tersebut ITDC dan juga berbagai pihak melakukan lobby sekaligus negosiasi dan terus mengkomunikasikan pesan positif kepada masyarakat secara strategis dan terencana dengan tujuan menciptakan optimisme tentang perhelatan MotoGP Mandalika. literature.title: Football and the media construction of Iranian national identity during the FIFA World Cup 2018 and AFC Asian Cup 2019
literature.title_cn: 足球与媒体对伊朗国家认同的建构：2018年世界杯与2019年亚洲杯期间
literature.title_en: Football and the media construction of Iranian national identity during the FIFA World Cup 2018 and AFC Asian Cup 2019
literature.author: Ali Ziaee, Arshin Adib-Moghaddam, Agnes Elling, Jacco van Sterkenburg, Ivo van Hilvoorde
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT Elite sport success in international tournaments is supposed to play an important role in shaping national identity. In this article, we explore if and how this applies to the Iranian context. The current study made use of a Google alert with the title of ‘Iran Men’s National Football Team’, and a general content analysis of Iranian national and sport media. The analytic focus was on media coverage of the Iranian national football team at the 2018 FIFA World Cup and the 2019 AFC Asian Cup. All relevant newspaper articles before, during, and after Iran’s matches were reviewed, coded, and analysed. We developed four main themes in the coverage expressing Iranian identity in the context of the aforesaid football events: ‘united passion’, ‘determined and conscientious’, ‘oppressed but great’, and ‘emotion-ridden’. It was concluded that political and historical references used by Iranian media contribute to the invention and reproduction of Iranian national identity through the aforementioned sporting tournaments.
literature.abstract_cn: 国际赛事中的精英体育成功被认为在塑造民族认同方面发挥重要作用。在本文中，我们探讨这是否以及如何适用于伊朗背景。当前研究使用了标题为"伊朗男子国家足球队"的谷歌提醒，并对伊朗国家和体育媒体进行了总体内容分析。分析重点是2018年FIFA世界杯和2019年亚足联亚洲杯期间伊朗国家足球队的媒体报道。对伊朗比赛之前、期间和之后的所有相关报纸文章进行了审查、编码和分析。我们在上述足球赛事的背景下表达了伊朗认同的报道中开发了四个主要主题："团结的热情"、"坚定而有良知"、"受压迫但伟大"和"情感满载"。结论是，伊朗媒体使用的政治和历史引用通过上述体育赛事对伊朗民族认同的发明和再生产做出了贡献。

literature.abstract: 大型国际体育赛事是塑造和传播国家形象的重要载体。2022年北京冬奥会的筹办与举办为我国体育国际传播提供了重要机遇。文章从传播主体、传播内容、传播渠道、传播策略等维度，探讨北京冬奥会国际传播的路径与策略创新，提出应构建多元传播主体协同、内容与形式创新并重的国际传播格局，以有效提升中国体育国际传播能力与影响力。

literature.abstract: 奥运会既是体育竞技的战场，同时也是文化传播与舆论较量的战场。在对东京奥运会的传播活动中，总台体育解说在新的传播生态语境下，成为“讲好中国故事”实践的重要组成部分。本文从符号学、叙事学视角，将体育解说看成对赛事现场的文本编码叙事传播活动，提出了解说在构建国家叙事、传播奥林匹克精神方面的框架与路径，并对解说传播效果进行了研究。

literature.title: Understanding Sporting Social Media Brand Communities, Place and Social Capital: A Netnography of Football Fans
literature.title_cn: 理解体育社交媒体品牌社群、场所与社会资本：足球迷的网络志研究
literature.title_en: Understanding Sporting Social Media Brand Communities, Place and Social Capital: A Netnography of Football Fans
literature.author: Alex Fenton, Brendan James Keegan, Keith D. Parry
literature.abstract: The emergence of social media and digital channels have expanded communication practices and also created new, virtual spaces where sports fans can interact and communicate directly with each other and with clubs. This article examines the potential for social media brand communities to develop a sense of both community and place amongst sports fans. It explores their influence in placemaking initiatives through the bonding and bridging social capital of a football club’s supporters. A netnographic study of a football club’s supporter networks (five channels) and their interactions with social media brand communities was performed. Data gathered from online sources was underpinned by interviews with 25 members of the community. Findings were analysed via NVivo using bridging and bonding social capital as a theoretical lens. The paper makes two primary contributions to knowledge. It enhances our understanding of the impact of SMBCs and their use in a sporting context—an area that has become increasingly significant during the COVID-19 pandemic enforced lockdowns that have kept fans out of venues. It also contributes to our understanding of the influence of placemaking strategies upon the social capital of supporter communities.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究运用网络志方法考察了体育社交媒体品牌社群、场所与社会资本的互动。以足球迷社群为案例，分析了社交媒体如何建构球迷身份、培育社会资本并塑造球迷与球队、社区的关系。
