literature.title: Audience Responses to Media Portrayals of Professional Athletes and Intimate Partner Violence
literature.title_cn: 受众对职业运动员与亲密伴侣暴力媒体报道的反应
literature.title_en: Audience Responses to Media Portrayals of Professional Athletes and Intimate Partner Violence
literature.author: Nicky Lewis, Jennifer A. Scarduzio, Christina S. Walker, Anthony M. Limperos
literature.abstract: This study examines audience responses to media portrayals of athlete-perpetrated intimate partner violence (IPV). Participants ( N = 569) were randomly assigned to view one of ten video news stories involving an incident of athlete-perpetrated IPV. They reported their perceptions of news story severity, perpetrator responsibility, and victim credibility post-viewing. In general, stories featuring White perpetrators were rated as more severe than stories featuring Black perpetrators. For moderately violent stories, victims of White and Latino athletes were rated as more credible than victims of Black athletes. Implications for a better understanding of athlete-perpetrated IPV and social outcomes are discussed.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了受众对运动员实施的亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）媒体呈现的反应。参与者（N=569）被随机分配观看涉及运动员实施的IPV事件的十个视频新闻故事之一。观看后，他们报告了对新闻故事严重性、施暴者责任和受害者可信度的感知。一般而言，以白人施暴者为特征的故事被评为比以黑人施暴者为特征的故事更严重。对于中度暴力故事，白人和拉丁裔运动员的受害者被评为比黑人运动员的受害者更可信。讨论了更好理解运动员实施的IPV和社会结果的启示。研究发现揭示了媒体呈现中种族如何影响受众对运动员IPV的感知和判断。
literature.keywords: audience; athlete; credibility

literature.title: Sports News, Commentary and Interviews, From the Other Side: Journalists Seen Through the Eyes of Athletes
literature.title_cn: 另一侧的体育新闻、评论与访谈：运动员眼中的记者
literature.title_en: Sports News, Commentary and Interviews, From the Other Side: Journalists Seen Through the Eyes of Athletes
literature.author: Ondřej Trunečka
literature.abstract: This study explores how professional athletes perceive sports journalists and the role of the media. They acknowledge that communication with journalists is an essential part of their profession and appreciate the verified information, knowledge, and dutiful preparation. They consider the main role of media as monitorial. In some cases, they cast doubt on journalists’ ability to evaluate athletic performance accurately, and they are also critical of errors in interviews, however they acknowledgethat there are good, and possibly excellent journalists as well.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨职业运动员如何看待体育记者和媒体的角色。他们承认与记者沟通是其职业的重要组成部分，并赞赏经过验证的信息、知识和尽职的准备。他们认为媒体的主要角色是监督性的。在某些情况下，他们对记者准确评估运动表现的能力表示怀疑，也对采访中的错误提出批评，然而他们承认也有优秀甚至可能卓越的记者存在。
literature.keywords: interviews; athlete

literature.title: Social Media Education Provided by National Governing Bodies of Sport: An Examination of Practices for Youth Olympic Games and Olympic Games Athletes
literature.title_cn: 国家体育管理机构提供的社交媒体教育：青奥会与奥运会运动员实践考察
literature.title_en: Social Media Education Provided by National Governing Bodies of Sport: An Examination of Practices for Youth Olympic Games and Olympic Games Athletes
literature.author: Andrea N. Geurin
literature.abstract: Social media provides athletes with many opportunities as well as challenges. Scholars have argued for proactive, educational social media training instead of traditional policy and punishment models, yet research on this topic is limited. Therefore, this study sought to understand the social media training/education national governing bodies (NGBs) provided to athletes ranging from Youth Olympic Games (YOG) to Olympic level, and to examine NGB communication employees’ perceptions regarding athletes’ social media use and their organization’s social media training. Utilizing uses and gratifications theory, a sequential mixed method was employed involving a survey of U.S. NGBs and in-depth interviews with NGB communication personnel. While most NGBs used proactive, educational social media training for Olympic athletes, few did the same for YOG athletes. NGB employees felt social media use posed significant benefits or gratifications to athletes, and education and training helped to enhance those benefits as well as minimize the challenges, or failed gratifications, athletes experience on social media.
literature.abstract_cn: 社交媒体为运动员提供了许多机会和挑战。学者们主张采取主动的、教育性的社交媒体培训，而非传统的政策和惩罚模式，然而关于这一主题的研究有限。因此，本研究旨在了解国家体育管理机构（NGBs）为从青奥会（YOG）到奥运水平的运动员提供的社交媒体培训/教育，并考察NGB传播员工的观念，包括对运动员社交媒体使用和其组织社交媒体培训的看法。利用使用与满足理论，采用了涉及美国NGBs调查和NGB传播人员深度访谈的序列混合方法。虽然大多数NGBs对奥运运动员使用主动的、教育性的社交媒体培训，但很少对YOG运动员这样做。NGB员工认为社交媒体使用为运动员提供了显著的益处或满足感，教育和培训有助于增强这些益处并最小化运动员在社交媒体上经历的挑战或失败的满足感。
literature.keywords: athlete; policy; interviews; survey

literature.title: One and Done: The Long Eclipse of Women’s Televised Sports, 1989–2019
literature.title_cn: 一锤定音：1989-2019年女性电视体育的长期式微
literature.title_en: One and Done: The Long Eclipse of Women’s Televised Sports, 1989–2019
literature.author: Cheryl Cooky, LaToya D. Council, Maria A. Mears, Michael A. Messner
literature.abstract: For 3 decades we have tracked and analyzed the quantity and quality of coverage of women’s and men’s sports in televised news and highlights shows. In this paper, we report on our most recent iteration of the longitudinal study, which now includes an examination of online sports newsletters and social media. The study reveals little change in the quantitative apportionment of coverage of women’s and men’s sports over the past 30 years. Men’s sports—especially the “Big Three” of basketball, football and baseball—still receive the lion’s share of the coverage, whether in-season or out of season. When a women’s sports story does appear, it is usually a case of “one and done,” a single women’s sports story obscured by a cluster of men’s stories that precede it, follow it, and are longer in length. Social media posts and online sports newsletters’ coverage, though a bit more diverse in some ways, mostly reflected these same patterned gender asymmetries. Gender-bland sexism continued as the dominant pattern in 2019 TV news and highlights’ stories on women’s sports. Three themes of this “gender-bland” coverage include: 1) nationalism, 2) asymmetrical gender marking coupled with local parochialism, and 3) community service/ charitable contributions.
literature.abstract_cn: 三十年来，我们持续跟踪和分析了电视新闻和精彩集锦节目中女性和男性体育报道的数量和质量。在本文中，我们报告了这一纵向研究的最新迭代，现在包括对在线体育通讯和社交媒体的考察。研究揭示了在过去30年中，女性体育和男性体育报道的定量分配几乎没有变化。男性体育——尤其是篮球、足球和棒球"三巨头"——仍然获得了绝大部分的报道份额。女性和男性体育报道的质量也仍然存在差异，女性体育报道通常较短且更少受到关注。研究呼吁媒体行业认真审视这种持续的性别不平等，并采取行动改善女性体育的报道。
literature.keywords: gender; sexism; football; basketball; nationalism; quantitative

literature.title: Just How They Drew It Up: How In-House Reporters Fit Themselves Into the Sports Media System
literature.title_cn: 正如他们所绘：内部记者如何在体育媒体系统中定位自己
literature.title_en: Just How They Drew It Up: How In-House Reporters Fit Themselves Into the Sports Media System
literature.author: Michael Mirer
literature.abstract: This paper explores how in-house sports reporters—those who write for team- and league-branded websites—locate themselves within the sports media production complex. It builds from perspectives on professionalism that view it as a dynamic process of defining boundaries and building relationships between systemic stakeholders. The interview data presented here find that in-house reporters accentuate professional similarities to beat reporters and use this identity to build unique roles in sports organizations’ corporate structures. This push to define themselves as a distinct job category within the constellation of sports media professions speaks to the active work occupational groups engage in, and is reshaping the media system. The paper argues for a broader reconsideration of professional definitions, actors, and relationships within the sports media system as digital technology and other changes have altered preexisting relationships.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了内部体育记者——那些为球队和联盟品牌网站撰稿的人——如何在体育媒体生产复合体中定位自己。它建立在将专业性视为定义边界和在系统性利益相关者之间建立关系的动态过程的专业主义视角之上。本文呈现的访谈数据发现，内部记者强调与随队记者的职业相似性，并利用这种身份在体育组织的企业结构中建立独特角色。这种将自己定义为体育媒体职业星座中独特职业类别的努力，说明了职业群体所从事的积极工作，并正在重塑媒体系统。本文主张对专业性进行更广泛的重新思考。
literature.keywords: reporter; professionalism; brand

literature.title: Sports Newsrooms Versus In-House Media: Cheerleading and Critical Reporting in News and Match Coverage
literature.title_cn: 体育新闻编辑室对内部媒体：新闻与赛事报道中的助威与批评报道
literature.title_en: Sports Newsrooms Versus In-House Media: Cheerleading and Critical Reporting in News and Match Coverage
literature.author: Peter English
literature.abstract: The mediatization of sport has created a rise in sports organisations expanding their media presence through digital platforms. However, the often-opposing ambitions of in-house media and sports journalism newsrooms highlight a contest over boundaries. This article examines how the mediatization of sport has impacted on content in in-house and traditional newsrooms and whether it is more aligned with journalism or public relations. The study analyses the coverage of both news and match reporting in six newspaper websites and five national sports organisation websites in Australia. The qualitative analysis is based on a sample of 466 text-based stories and focuses predominantly on elements of critical reporting and cheerleading. The findings outline how mediatization of sport through in-house publications is changing the boundaries of sports media and sports journalism. There were often strong divisions between the coverage in the sports organisations and news publications, with the in-house titles usually the more promotional, positive and less critical.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育的媒介化使体育组织通过数字平台扩展其媒体存在的现象日益增多。然而，内部媒体和体育新闻编辑室往往对立的目标凸显了一场关于边界的争夺。本文考察了体育的媒介化如何影响内部和传统编辑室的内容，以及它更符合新闻业还是公共关系的目标。研究分析了澳大利亚六家报纸网站和五家全国体育组织网站对新闻和比赛报道的覆盖。定性分析基于466篇基于文本的故事样本，主要聚焦于批判性报道和欢呼式报道的元素。研究结果概述了体育的媒介化如何通过内部媒体塑造内容。
literature.keywords: newsroom; qualitative

literature.title: The Effect of Statistics on Enjoyment and Perceived Credibility in Sports Media
literature.title_cn: 统计数据对体育媒体乐趣与可信感知的影响
literature.title_en: The Effect of Statistics on Enjoyment and Perceived Credibility in Sports Media
literature.author: Dustin Hahn
literature.abstract: Evolving media landscapes toward increasingly diverse and competitive environments in both traditional and new media requires producers regularly examine the quality of their productions. One growing line of research identifies the increasing presence and significance of statistics in sports media programming. This experiment measures the effect of statistics on enjoyment and perceived credibility by sport consumers while considering level of fanship, media source, and variations in placement within Instagram posts. Results uncover evidence that validates previous observations about statistics in media while contradicting others. Specifically, findings reveal that statistics enhance enjoyment and improve perceived credibility. Observations were consistent across fanship level. However, additional findings also suggest media source and placement of statistics influences both enjoyment and credibility as well. For both dependent variables, statistics in both the Instagram caption and image yielded significantly greater enjoyment and credibility than some other conditions including posts without statistics at all. The impact of these and other findings on sports media industry and scholarship, along with limitations and directions for future research, are discussed.
literature.abstract_cn: 传统和新媒体中媒体格局向日益多样化和竞争性环境的演变要求制作人定期检查其作品质量。一个不断增长的研究方向识别了统计在体育媒体节目中日益增长的呈现和重要性。本实验测量了统计对体育消费者享受和感知可信度的影响，同时考虑粉丝程度、媒体来源和Instagram帖子中位置的变化。结果揭示，统计数据的呈现对享受和感知可信度有显著影响，但这些影响因粉丝程度和媒体来源而异。研究发现，统计数据的呈现可以增强体育媒体的感知可信度，但可能对休闲粉丝的享受产生负面影响。
literature.keywords: credibility; instagram; source
literature.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、产业组织理论

literature.title: Recontextualizing Barstool Sports and Misogyny in Online US Sports Media
literature.title_cn: 重新语境化Barstool体育与美国在线体育媒体中的厌女
literature.title_en: Recontextualizing Barstool Sports and Misogyny in Online US Sports Media
literature.author: Christopher J. Garcia, Jennifer M. Proffitt
literature.abstract: This critical qualitative case study interrogates the roles Barstool Sports and its founder, Dave Portnoy, serve in reaffirming the narrative power of conservative cultural ideology in mainstream US sports media. Portnoy’s targeted harassment of female journalists is analyzed as examples of how the outlet alienates critics of heteronormative, hypermasculine discourse within relevant cultural arenas in digital sports media. To examine how the company deflects criticisms of misogyny, we explore Barstool Chicks—an alternative version of the company’s website targeting female audiences. Resultantly, Barstool and Portnoy undermine the potential for feminist-driven narratives in sports media and contribute to the normalization of repressive conditions within cultural industries that perpetuates the continued dominance of conservative ideology.
literature.abstract_cn: 这项批判性定性案例研究探究了Barstool Sports及其创始人戴夫·波特诺伊在美国主流体育媒体中重申保守文化意识形态叙事力量的角色。波特诺伊对女性记者的针对式骚扰被分析为该机构如何在该数字体育媒体相关的文化领域中排斥对异性恋规范性、超男性化话语的批评者。为考察该公司如何转移对厌女症的批评，我们探讨了Barstool Chicks——该公司面向女性受众的网站替代版本。结果是，Barstool和波特诺伊削弱了体育媒体中女权主义驱动叙事的潜力，并促成了文化行业中压抑条件的正常化，从而延续了保守意识形态的持续主导地位。
literature.keywords: audience; qualitative
literature.theoretical_framework: 性别理论、叙事理论、受众研究理论

literature.title: At the Buzzer: Parting Shots on Communication and Sport
literature.title_cn: 终场哨响：传播与体育的临别之言
literature.title_en: At the Buzzer: Parting Shots on Communication and Sport
literature.author: Lawrence A. Wenner
literature.abstract: In his final editorial essay, founding Editor-in-Chief Lawrence Wenner speaks to the successes of the Communication & Sport project as a disciplinary endeavor over its first 10 years. In handing over the editor’s baton to Andrew Billings and Marie Hardin, Communication & Sport is in good hands with the continued support of SAGE Publishing, the sponsorship of a set of scholarly societies, and a growing global scholarly community. Still, communication and sport, as an interdisciplinary scholarly endeavor, has been challenged by competing epistemological perspectives from pragmatic to critical. There is much evidence of implicit and explicit endorsement of a “received” view of sport in line with Coakley’s notion of the “Great Sports Myth.” Caution is advised as research from this vantage point often too eagerly receives sport as a naturalized state-of-affairs worthy of supporting and growing in an agenda focused on advancing the effectiveness and reception of sport communication in the marketplace. The essay closes with the need for a reckoning about the objectives of communication and sport as a scholarly space by reiterating reminder that today’s mediated world is ultimately “all about power.”
literature.abstract_cn: 在其最后一篇编辑文章中，创始主编劳伦斯·温纳谈到了《体育传播》项目作为一门学科事业在其头10年取得的成功。在将编辑接力棒交给安德鲁·比林斯和玛丽·哈丁时，《体育传播》在SAGE出版公司持续支持、一系列学术团体赞助和日益增长的全球学术社区的支持下掌握在良好的人手中。尽管如此，作为一门跨学科学术事业的传播与体育，一直被从实用主义到批判性的竞争性认识论视角所挑战。有大量证据表明，人们隐性和显性地认可了一种与科克利"伟大体育神话"概念一致的"既定"体育观。建议谨慎行事，因为从这个有利角度的研究往往过于急切地接受体育作为一种自然化的事态，值得在一个专注于推进体育传播在市场上有效性和接受度的议程中支持和增长。这篇文章以需要对传播与体育作为学术空间的目标进行清算作结，重申提醒：今天的媒介化世界归根结底是"一切都关于权力"。
literature.keywords: sponsorship; community
literature.theoretical_framework: 国际传播理论、软实力理论

literature.title: Sports Journalism Content When No Sports Occur: Framing Athletics Amidst the COVID-19 International Pandemic
literature.title_cn: 无体育发生时的体育新闻内容：新冠疫情国际大流行期间的体育框架呈现
literature.title_en: Sports Journalism Content When No Sports Occur: Framing Athletics Amidst the COVID-19 International Pandemic
literature.author: Sean R. Sadri, Nicholas R. Buzzelli, Patrick Gentile, Andrew C. Billings
literature.abstract: On March 11, 2020, the National Basketball Association suspended its season after a player tested positive for COVID-19. Within days, the rest of the sports world similarly suspended play in the wake of the pandemic. This study focuses on sports media storytelling when covering athletic competition was no longer an option. Utilizing four distinct time periods and framing theory as the foundation of our theoretical framework, the content analysis examined shifts from the normal reporting routine and how those shifts morphed as pandemic information dictated. As the pandemic grew more widespread, health and safety became the predominant focus of national sports media. In spring 2020, sports news experienced a significant shift in coverage as economic and fairness frames were replaced with health, safety, and quality of life as the principal frames in the coded articles. By pinpointing the major differences in coverage across time, the study revealed that sports content and frames quickly shifted to reflect the perceived severity to the global health community, while the sources used in those articles stayed largely the same. The theoretical and applied implications of the study are discussed.
literature.abstract_cn: 2020年3月11日，美国国家篮球协会在一名球员检测出COVID-19阳性后暂停了赛季。几天之内，体育界的其余部分也在疫情期间相继停赛。本研究关注当体育竞技报道不再成为选项时，体育媒体如何讲述故事。研究以四个不同时间段和框架理论为理论基础，通过内容分析考察了从正常报道常规的转变，以及这些转变如何随疫情信息的变化而演变。随着疫情蔓延，健康与安全成为国内体育媒体的主要焦点。2020年春季，体育新闻经历显著转变，经济与公平框架被健康、安全和生活质量框架所取代。通过精确识别不同时期报道的主要差异，研究揭示体育内容和框架迅速转变以反映全球卫生界所感知的严重性，而文章中使用的信源基本保持不变。研究讨论了其理论与应用意义。
literature.keywords: framing; pandemic; covid; basketball; community; source

literature.title: Shifting the Coverage: Understanding Why Reporting and Attitudes Changed About the NFL and Player Safety
literature.title_cn: 转变报道：理解NFL与球员安全报道和态度变化的原因
literature.title_en: Shifting the Coverage: Understanding Why Reporting and Attitudes Changed About the NFL and Player Safety
literature.author: David Cassilo
literature.abstract: Abstract:This research used semistructured interviews to give further context to prior research indicating that media coverage and organizational attitudes of professional football have focused more on the health and well-being of players than ever before, over the last decade. Interviews were conducted with eight current and former National Football League beat reporters who covered the sport during that time period. Through a coding process of those interview transcripts, reporters indicated that their coverage was most influenced by any personal connection to an injured player. However, it was revealed that the state of the journalism industry and barriers to information, such as access to medical professionals, sometimes limited how health, and specifically head injuries, were covered in the NFL. Consequently, such findings suggest a need to adjust reporting practices to be able to adequately cover health issues within professional football.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究使用半结构化访谈，为先前关于专业足球媒体报道和组织态度在过去十年比以往任何时候都更关注球员健康和福祉的研究提供进一步背景。研究人员对当时报道该运动的八名现任和前任NFL随队记者进行了访谈。通过对访谈转写稿的编码过程，记者们表示他们的报道最受与受伤球员的个人联系影响。然而，研究发现新闻业的状态和信息获取的障碍（如接触医疗专业人员）有时限制了NFL中健康特别是头部损伤的报道方式。因此，这些发现表明需要调整报道实践，以便充分报道职业足球中的健康问题。
literature.keywords: football; interviews; reporter; access

literature.title: The "Mighty Kacy" Effect? American Ninja Warrior and the Elevation of Women Athletes
literature.title_cn: “强大的凯西”效应？《美国忍者武士》与女运动员地位的提升
literature.title_en: The "Mighty Kacy" Effect? American Ninja Warrior and the Elevation of Women Athletes
literature.author: Kevin Hull, Andrew Billings, Lauren Schwartz
literature.abstract: Abstract:Contrary to previous sports studies demonstrating that sports within prime-time television programming minimize women athletes both in terms of exposure and the characterization of athletes when they are shown, the NBC-based athletic reality program American Ninja Warrior seemingly challenges such traditions. A study of a full season of the hit program reveals that only two significant dialogue differences emerged, disproportionately complimenting the speed of male competitors and the strength of female competitors. Otherwise, nonsignificant differences were found within the sample, perhaps revealing progress in the degree to which new renderings of sports media could be built on structures less premised in hegemonic masculinity.
literature.abstract_cn: 与先前表明黄金时段电视节目中的体育在曝光度和运动员形象塑造方面都最小化女运动员的体育研究相反，基于NBC的体育真人秀节目《美国忍者勇士》似乎挑战了这些传统。对这部热门节目一整个赛季的研究显示，只出现了两个显著的对话差异，不成比例地赞美男性选手的速度和女性选手的力量。除此之外，样本中未发现显著差异，这或许揭示了体育媒体新呈现形式可以在不那么以霸权男性气质为前提的结构上构建的进步程度。
literature.keywords: athlete; masculinity; television

literature.title: Expecting Victory Due to TV or Identity? An Examination of the Influence of Media Consumption and Social Identification on Game Expectations
literature.title_cn: 因电视还是身份而期待胜利？媒体消费与社会认同对赛事期望的影响
literature.title_en: Expecting Victory Due to TV or Identity? An Examination of the Influence of Media Consumption and Social Identification on Game Expectations
literature.author: Natalie Brown-Devlin, Michael B. Devlin
literature.abstract: Abstract:This study used a nationwide, purposive sample to examine how the concurrent effects of media consumption and social identification influence sports fans' expectations for a game outcome. This study surveyed 310 highly identified fans of two teams competing in an NCAA College Football Championship game. Participants reported their sports-related media consumption, the extent to which the media influenced their expectations, their level of team identity, and their expectations for the championship game. Path analysis demonstrated that media consumption is recognized as an influence on expectations and influences one's team identity. Furthermore, results concluded that the media is useful in shaping expectations; however, team identity may mediate some of the effect, thus offering theoretical implications concerning the influence of media consumption and subsequent development and maintenance of one's social identity.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究使用全国性、目的性样本，考察媒体消费和社会认同的并发效应如何影响体育迷对比赛结果的期望。本研究调查了参加NCAA大学橄榄球冠军赛的两支球队的310名高度认同的球迷。参与者报告了他们的体育相关媒体消费、媒体影响其期望的程度、他们的球队认同水平以及他们对冠军赛的期望。路径分析表明，媒体消费被认可为对期望的影响，并影响一个人的球队认同。此外，结果得出结论，媒体在塑造期望方面是有用的；然而，球队认同可能中介部分效应，从而对媒体消费的影响以及随后一个人的社会认同的发展和维持提供理论启示。
literature.keywords: consumption; football; championship; survey

literature.title: Multiscreen Football Enjoyment: Uses and Gratifications for Media Consumption of the National Football League
literature.title_cn: 多屏足球乐趣：国家橄榄球联盟媒体消费的使用与满足
literature.title_en: Multiscreen Football Enjoyment: Uses and Gratifications for Media Consumption of the National Football League
literature.author: Melvin Lewis, J. C. Abdallah, Kenon Brown, Andrew Billings
literature.abstract: Abstract:A uses and gratifications approach was adopted to explore the motivations of a national sample of 388 fans of the National Football League. Competition had a significant direct effect toward consumption minutes of NFL content, while relationship building had a significant inverse effect. Motives changed in regard to fantasy football media consumption, with Schwabism and habitual use significantly influencing fantasy football media consumption, while entertainment had a significant inverse effect. Eight additional motivational differences were detected when differentiating by device utilized, along with 10 motivational differences when differentiating by type of media consumption (e.g., live events or sharing user-generated content).
literature.abstract_cn: 采用使用与满足方法来探索全国388名NFL球迷样本的动机。竞争对NFL内容消费分钟数有显著的直接影响，而关系建立有显著的逆向效应。动机在幻想足球媒体消费方面发生变化，施瓦布主义和习惯性使用显著影响幻想足球媒体消费，而娱乐有显著的逆向效应。当按设备区分时检测到另外八种动机差异，当按媒体消费类型（例如，现场赛事或分享用户生成内容）区分时检测到十种动机差异。
literature.keywords: football; consumption

literature.title: Understanding How Consumers Perceive Brand Personality Through Sports Sponsorship
literature.title_cn: 理解消费者如何通过体育赞助感知品牌个性
literature.title_en: Understanding How Consumers Perceive Brand Personality Through Sports Sponsorship
literature.author: Po-Lin Pan, Joe Phua, Chang Wan Woo
literature.abstract: Abstract:Sports sponsorship has been considered a key branding strategy for various marketing objectives, but little research has investigated how consumers perceive sponsor brands through sports competitions. This study aimed to examine whether team performance and gender difference jointly impacted consumers' perceived brand personality and how team identification and self-brand connection moderated such impacts on perceived brand personality in the context of sports sponsorship. A 2 (team performance) x 2 (gender) between-subjects experiment was designed with team identification and self-brand connection as two moderators. Results indicated that team performance, team identification, and self-brand connection yielded individual and joint influences on perceived brand personality. Specifically, team performance exerted significant effects on five dimensions of brand personality, while team identification yielded significant effects on brand responsibility, aggressiveness, and simplicity. Self-brand connection moderated the effect of team performance on brand responsibility and activity. The empirical evidence further illustrated that consumer-level factors came into play to influence perceived brand personality. In support of affect-transfer hypothesis, team performance that evoked emotions greatly impacted consumers' perceived brand personality, as they rated a sponsor brand as more positive in terms of brand responsibility, activity, aggressiveness, simplicity, and emotionality.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育赞助已被视为各种营销目标的关键品牌策略，但很少有研究调查消费者如何通过体育比赛感知赞助品牌。本研究旨在考察球队表现和性别差异是否共同影响消费者感知的品牌个性，以及球队认同和自我品牌联系如何调节这些影响对体育赞助语境中感知品牌个性的作用。设计了一个2（球队表现）×2（性别）的主体间实验，以球队认同和自我品牌联系为两个调节因素。结果表明，球队表现、球队认同和自我品牌联系对感知品牌个性产生个体和联合影响。具体而言，球队表现对品牌个性的五个维度产生显著影响，而球队认同对品牌责任、攻击性和简约性产生显著影响。自我品牌联系调节了球队表现对品牌责任和活动的影响。实证证据进一步说明消费者层面的因素在影响感知品牌个性方面发挥作用。支持情感转移假设，唤起情感的球队表现极大地影响消费者感知的品牌个性，因为他们将赞助品牌在品牌责任、活动、攻击性、简约性和情感性方面评价为更积极。
literature.keywords: sponsorship; brand; gender; branding; marketing; emotion

literature.title: #JoinTheAlliance: A Network Exploration Into Hashtag Brand Building by an Emerging Sports League
literature.title_cn: #JoinTheAlliance：新兴体育联盟标签品牌建设的网络探索
literature.title_en: #JoinTheAlliance: A Network Exploration Into Hashtag Brand Building by an Emerging Sports League
literature.author: Jennifer L. Harker
literature.abstract: Abstract:This research explores the hashtag use of an emerging spring football league, the Alliance of American Football (AAF). Twitter data was collected daily via NodeXL Pro to explore the emergence and persistence of hashtag use surrounding the AAF, the social construction of secondary hashtags, and the semantic network that emerged across three time periods of interactivity. These anchoring symbols of social communication and the brand-building implications of an emerging sports league’s use of hashtags in acquiring a fan base are discussed.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了一个新兴春季橄榄球联盟——美式橄榄球联盟（AAF）的标签使用。通过NodeXL Pro每日收集推特数据，以探索围绕AAF的标签使用的出现和持续、次级标签的社会建构，以及在三个互动时间段内出现的语义网络。文章讨论了这些社会传播的锚定符号以及新兴体育联盟利用标签在获取粉丝群中的品牌建设意义。
literature.keywords: hashtag; brand; twitter; football; interactivity

literature.title: A Shaky Bet: Legalized Sports Betting in the United States
literature.title_cn: 不稳定的赌注：美国合法化体育博彩
literature.title_en: A Shaky Bet: Legalized Sports Betting in the United States
literature.author: Brian A. Petrotta, John McGuire
literature.abstract: Abstract:When the U.S. Supreme Court struck down the federal ban on sports betting in May 2018, it had the potential to dramatically change how Americans consume sporting events. Prior to the ruling, fantasy sports filled a gap for those desiring a legal alternative to illicit sports gambling. This study utilizes social cognitive theory to analyze how fantasy sports participants’ attitudes, behaviors, and environments inform their intention to adopt legal sports-betting practices. Focus group subjects suggest the conversion may not be a sure bet.
literature.abstract_cn: 当美国最高法院于2018年5月推翻联邦体育博彩禁令时，它有可能极大地改变美国人消费体育赛事的方式。在该裁决之前，幻想体育为那些想要非法体育赌博的合法替代品的填满了空白。本研究利用社会认知理论分析幻想体育参与者的态度、行为和环境影响他们采纳合法体育博彩实践的意图。焦点小组受试者表明，这种转换可能不是稳赢的赌注。
literature.keywords: shaky bet; bet legalized; united states; states abstract; legal alternative

literature.title: A Tug of War: The Israeli Sports Media During the Second Lebanon War
literature.title_cn: 拉锯战：第二次黎巴嫩战争期间的以色列体育媒体
literature.title_en: A Tug of War: The Israeli Sports Media During the Second Lebanon War
literature.author: Simon M. Pack, Yair Galily, Moran Yarchi, Ilan Tamir
literature.abstract: Abstract:In times of conflict or crisis, the media tends to “rally round the flag” and express mostly patriotic views in its news coverage. The current study aims to examine whether this phenomenon is also true for other covered topics that are not hard news related—while focusing on the coverage of the sports section. Examining the coverage of the sports sections in three leading Israeli newspapers during the Second Lebanon War (July–August 2006), the findings show that the rally effect was salient in sports coverage in the initial stages of the war. Three central themes were identified: (a) expressions of patriotism, (b) discussions about the foreign players, and (c) minimal criticism. In accordance with previous literature, the evidence suggests that the rally-round-the-flag concept has an effect on coverage of sports news not directly related to the conflict. Here, too, it is shown that sport plays a significant component in the formation and strengthening of the national spirit.
literature.abstract_cn: 在冲突或危机时期，媒体往往"聚集在旗帜周围"，在其新闻报道中表达大多是爱国主义的观点。本研究旨在考察这一现象是否也适用于其他与硬新闻无关的被报道话题——同时聚焦于体育版的报道。通过考察2006年第二次黎巴嫩战争（2006年7月至8月）期间以色列三家主要报纸体育版的报道，研究发现在战争初始阶段，集会效应在体育报道中很突出。研究识别了三个核心主题：（a）爱国主义表达，（b）关于外籍球员的讨论，以及（c）最少的批评。与先前文献一致，证据表明"聚集在旗帜周围"的概念对与冲突无直接关系的体育新闻报道产生影响。这里也表明，体育在民族精神的形成和加强中发挥着重要作用。
literature.keywords: patriotism; second lebanon; lebanon war; media during; war abstract; media tends

literature.title: An Offside Story: The Israeli Periphery in Sports Films
literature.title_cn: 越位故事：体育电影中的以色列边缘地带
literature.title_en: An Offside Story: The Israeli Periphery in Sports Films
literature.author: Orr Levental
literature.abstract: Abstract:Sports films are defined as such because they feature competitions, athletes, fans, or other aspects of amateur and professions sports. Yet most if not all these movies are also about other topics that are enhanced by the sports perspective, which is one of the most popular expressions of modern culture. Israeli sports movies often deal with politics, culture, and the periphery. The purpose of this study was to analyze the dominant representations and recurring themes in Israeli sports films that directly and indirectly touch on the social and geographical periphery. To this end, we chose 10 movies set in peripheral localities and representative of their residents. Since the study focused on symbols of the periphery as it is depicted in cinema and not necessarily as it is in everyday reality, the selected movies were set in real places as well as in places invented for the purpose of the cinematic narrative. This article is based on a study that included qualitative and visual analysis of the films. The findings of the analysis revealed three main themes: poverty as a contemporary attribute, periphery ethnicity, and sports as a symbol of hope. The findings indicate that for the most part the periphery is presented negatively, while sports, on the other hand, is portrayed as a means, whether real or virtual, for social change. Indeed, these movies usually focus on the human environment, on individuals and communities, and on their attitude toward sports as an integrative tool.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育电影之所以被定义为体育电影，是因为它们以比赛、运动员、粉丝或业余和专业体育的其他方面为特色。然而，这些电影中的大多数（如果不是全部的话）也是关于其他话题的，这些话题通过体育视角得到增强，而体育是现代文化最流行的表达之一。以色列体育电影经常涉及政治、文化和边缘地带。本研究的目的是分析以色列体育电影中直接和间接触及社会和地理边缘的主导表征和反复出现的主题。为此，我们选择了10部以边缘地区为背景并代表其居民的影片。由于研究聚焦于电影中所描绘的边缘象征，而非必然是日常现实中的边缘，所选影片既设置在真实地点，也设置在为电影叙事目的而发明的场所。本文基于一项包含对电影进行质性和视觉分析的研究。分析结果揭示了三个主要主题：贫困作为当代属性、边缘种族以及体育作为希望的象征。研究结果表明，边缘地带大多以负面方式呈现，而体育则被描绘为实现社会变革的（无论是真实的还是虚拟的）手段。事实上，这些电影通常聚焦于人文环境、个人和社区，以及他们对体育作为整合工具的态度。
literature.keywords: representation; ethnicity; politics; qualitative; athlete

literature.title: Sports Media Versus News Media: Perceptions of Media Bias in Coverage of the NFL National Anthem Protests in 2017
literature.title_cn: 体育媒体对新闻媒体：2017年NFL国歌抗议报道中的媒体偏见感知
literature.title_en: Sports Media Versus News Media: Perceptions of Media Bias in Coverage of the NFL National Anthem Protests in 2017
literature.author: Kenneth Kim, Randall Patnode
literature.abstract: Abstract:This experimental study examines how the hostile media phenomenon arises in the context of sports-specific media relative to general news media. Audience perceptions of bias can also be triggered by how particular messages are framed, so a second goal of this study is to clarify how news framing relates to the hostile media phenomenon. Participants (N = 124) read a news story, varying in news source (The Sporting News versus Fox News versus MSNBC) and news framing (outcome versus value frame), on the NFL national anthem controversy. Results revealed that partisan individuals viewed a news story from the sports-specific media vehicle as neutral or more favorable toward their own position than the general news outlets. Also, an outcome-framed news story evoked less hostile media perception than a value-framed news story.
literature.abstract_cn: 这项实验研究考察了敌对媒体现象如何在体育特定媒体相对于一般新闻媒体的语境中产生。受众对偏差的感知也可能由特定信息的框架方式触发，因此本研究的第二个目标是澄清新闻框架与敌对媒体现象的关系。参与者（N=124）阅读了一篇关于NFL国歌争议的新闻报道，该报道在新闻来源（《体育新闻》对福克斯新闻对MSNBC）和新闻框架（结果框架对价值框架）上有所不同。结果表明，党派人士认为来自体育特定媒体机构的新闻报道中立或更有利于他们自己的立场，相对于一般新闻媒体。此外，结果框架的新闻报道比价值框架的新闻报道引起的敌对媒体感知更少。
literature.keywords: bias; protest; framing; audience; partisan; source

literature.title: The Big Assist: Exploring Nonprofit Practitioner Beliefs About Sport CSR Relationships
literature.title_cn: 关键助攻：探索非营利从业者对体育CSR关系的信念
literature.title_en: The Big Assist: Exploring Nonprofit Practitioner Beliefs About Sport CSR Relationships
literature.author: Melanie Formentin, Denise S. Bortree, Nahyun Kim
literature.abstract: Abstract:Corporate social responsibility (CSR) research often emphasizes CSR practices, organizational communication, and perceptions among publics. Scholars believe sport offers unique opportunities to create social impacts (Godfrey, 2009). However, sport CSR scholarship generally fails to address the quality of relationships between partner organizations. Ethic of care provides a framework for understanding the benefits of working with professional sport organizations and the resultant quality of those CSR relationships compared to other corporate partners. To address scholarly gaps, 29 depth interviews were conducted with nonprofit practitioners whose nonprofits received support from professional sport organizations. Inductive coding revealed distinct types of benefits (audience reach and credibility) and differences compared to other corporate partners (organizational access and cause-fit) that diverge from and add to existing sport CSR literature. Findings suggest that embracing caring practices can help sport organizations leverage their positions in local communities and help differentiate them as more desirable corporate partners.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了非营利组织从业者对体育企业社会责任(CSR)关系的信念。通过质性访谈，分析了体育组织与非营利部门在CSR合作中的动机、期望与成效，为体育CSR关系的理论与实践提供了洞见。
literature.keywords: audience; interviews; credibility; access

literature.title: Malign and covert nationalism within British newspapers reporting of Eddie Jones’ appointment as head coach of the men's England national rugby union team
literature.title_cn: 英国报纸报道埃迪·琼斯出任英格兰男足橄榄球队主教练中的恶意与隐性民族主义
literature.title_en: Malign and covert nationalism within British newspapers reporting of Eddie Jones’ appointment as head coach of the men's England national rugby union team
literature.author: Alexander David Blackett
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: The appointment of Eddie Jones as the England men's rugby union head coach in 2015 was significant because he was the first foreign-born individual to occupy this role. After sourcing 136 British newspaper articles published one week either side of Jones’ official announcement for his appointment on 20th November 2015, this study identified three overarching themes for how narratives of this event were framed: (a) negativity and the loss of national identity; (b) positivity and need for cultural change underscored with conditional acceptance; and (c) declinism with the need for succession planning. Bourdieu's concepts of field, habitus, embodied cultural and symbolic capital were drawn upon to theorise how much of the media initially rejected Jones’ appointment. The results indicated an overt and xenophobic ‘Little Englander’ narrative was first presented by some journalists based on Jones’ perceived Australian habitus and capital not reflecting the cultural values attached to English rugby union. Even when reports were positive, binary ‘one of our own/us’ and ‘outsider/them’ narratives represented symbolic violence through a malign ‘Little Englander’ attitude, albeit one that is a more covert form of discrimination than has previously been reported. Recommendations for continued analyses that acknowledge temporality within this discipline are finally presented.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了英国报纸在报道埃迪·琼斯出任英格兰男足橄榄球队主教练过程中的恶意与隐性民族主义。通过对报纸报道的批判性话语分析，揭示了体育媒体中民族主义话语的隐蔽运作方式及其对体育报道客观性的影响。
literature.keywords: nationalism; coach

literature.title: Communicating consent in sport: A typological model of athletes’ consent practices within combat sports
literature.title_cn: 体育中的同意沟通：格斗运动中运动员同意实践的形态学模型
literature.title_en: Communicating consent in sport: A typological model of athletes’ consent practices within combat sports
literature.author: Alex Channon, Christopher R. Matthews
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This paper provides a systematic attempt to empirically describe the ways in which athletes’ consent to take part in sport is socially constructed, communicated and understood by others. Due to a notable lack of prior research on this topic, we draw on insights from sex research to theorise consent as a communicative social practice, specifically applying this notion to interpreting the world of competitive combat sports. To do so, we combine data from across numerous studies using the method of concatenated exploration, producing a post hoc, longitudinal, cross-contextual qualitative analysis of the ways in which consent is practiced in such settings. We then outline a four-point typology of how consent is performed, including the following categories: overt communication; subtle communication; assumed consent and deferred consent. We conclude by arguing that the apparent predominance of subtle, assumed and deferred consent presents some worrying implications for athletes’ freedom, potentially undermining the morally transformative potential of consent within these ostensibly ‘violent’, often injurious sports contexts.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文旨在系统地、经验性地描述运动员参与体育运动的同意（consent）是如何被社会建构、沟通并被他者理解的。鉴于该主题以往研究显著匮乏，我们借鉴性学研究中的洞见，将同意理论化为一种沟通性的社会实践，并特别将其应用于理解竞技对抗性搏击体育的世界。为此，我们综合了多项研究的数据，采用"串联探索"（concatenated exploration）的方法，对这类情境中同意的实践方式进行了事后、纵向、跨情境的质性分析。我们随后勾勒出一个关于同意如何被践行的四要素类型学，包括以下类别：显性沟通（overt communication）；微妙沟通（subtle communication）；被假定同意（assumed consent）和延迟同意（deferred consent）。我们最后论证，微妙、被假定和延迟同意表面上的主导地位，对运动员的自由带来了令人担忧的影响，可能在那些表面"暴力"、常有伤害性的体育情境中削弱同意所蕴含的道德变革潜力。
literature.keywords: athlete; qualitative
literature.theoretical_framework: 性别理论、女性主义传播理论

literature.title: Extreme weight control behaviors among adolescent athletes: Links with weight-related maltreatment from parents and coaches and sport ethic norms
literature.title_cn: 青少年运动员中的极端体重控制行为：与父母和教练体重相关虐待及体育伦理规范的联系
literature.title_en: Extreme weight control behaviors among adolescent athletes: Links with weight-related maltreatment from parents and coaches and sport ethic norms
literature.author: Véronique Boudreault, Marie-Pierre Gagnon-Girouard, Noémie Carbonneau, Sophie Labossière, Catherine Bégin, Sylvie Parent
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: The use of extreme weight-control behaviors is prevalent among adolescent athletes and may result from individual and sport-specific factors. Weight-related maltreatment from coaches and parents, and conformity to sport ethic norms have recently been linked to the use of extreme weight-control behaviors. This study aims to investigate the role of sport ethic norms and weight-related maltreatment from coaches and parents in the use of extreme weight-control behaviors among adolescent athletes. A sample of 999 French-Canadian athletes aged 14–17 years competing in a variety of sports completed an online survey assessing extreme weight-control behaviors, weight-related maltreatment from coaches and parents, and conformity to sport ethic norms. A total of 16.9% of the adolescent athletes reported having adopted extreme weight-control behaviors during their athletic careers. Extreme weight-control behaviors were significantly more prevalent among girls (19.75% vs 9.7% in boys) and weight-class-sport athletes (44%). In addition, 7.4% of the sample experienced at least one type of weight-related maltreatment by coaches or parents. Sex, weight-related neglect by coaches and parents, and weight-related psychological violence by coaches explained 24.4% of extreme weight-control behaviors variance. Indeed, participants who engaged in extreme weight-control behaviors experienced significantly more violence than the other participants did. In contrast, no differences were observed between people who engaged in extreme weight-control behaviors and those who did not due to conformity to sport ethic norms.
literature.abstract_cn: 极端体重控制行为在青少年运动员中普遍存在，可能源于个体和特定体育的因素。教练和父母与体重相关的虐待，以及对体育伦理规范的遵从，最近被与极端体重控制行为的使用联系起来。本研究旨在考察体育伦理规范以及来自教练和父母的体重相关虐待在青少年运动员极端体重控制行为使用中的作用。来自法国—加拿大各地参加多种体育项目的999名14至17岁运动员样本完成了……
literature.keywords: athlete; coach; survey; career
literature.theoretical_framework: 性别理论、女性主义传播理论

literature.title: Vocational careers of retired Olympic athletes from Switzerland: A person-oriented study
literature.title_cn: 瑞士退役奥运运动员的职业转轨：以人为导向的研究
literature.title_en: Vocational careers of retired Olympic athletes from Switzerland: A person-oriented study
literature.author: Michael J Schmid, Merlin Örencik, Jürg Schmid, Siegfried Nagel, Achim Conzelmann
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: For many high-performance athletes, competing in the Olympic Games is a major goal. Achieving this goal requires more than ever substantial investments of time and personal resources towards the sports career over several years. Thus, some athletes neglect other areas of life (e.g. education), which can pose a problem for the time after high-performance sport, while other athletes pursue a dual career. Previous studies have shown that former high-performance athletes achieved higher levels of education and better vocational positions than the general population. Due to the advancing professionalization and commercialization of high-performance sport, the question emerges whether these results are valid for athletes that are more recently retired. In addition, cross-cultural generalisability of these findings are of interest. For this purpose, 341 former athletes representing Switzerland at the Olympics were surveyed about their athletic, educational, and vocational careers. It turns out that these athletes obtained more degrees of higher education than the general population. Relative to their siblings, they have higher school-leaving certificates and work in more prestigious occupations. Following the holistic-interactionistic paradigm, person-oriented analyses was performed and revealed nine – mostly satisfactory – vocational career patterns. Hence, involvement in high-performance sport facilitates rather than hinders a successful vocational career.
literature.abstract_cn: 对许多高水平运动员而言，参加奥运会是一个主要目标。实现这一目标比以往任何时候都更需要在多年时间里向体育生涯投入大量时间和个人资源。因此，一些运动员忽视了生活的其他领域（如教育），这可能为高水平运动生涯结束后的时期带来问题，而其他运动员则追求双元职业。此前研究表明，前高水平运动员比普通人群获得了更高的教育水平和更好的职业地位。由于高水平体育的专业化和商业化不断推进，产生了这些结果是否对近期退役运动员仍然有效的问题。此外，这些发现的跨文化普适性也值得关注。为此，我们调查了代表瑞士参加奥运会的341名前运动员的运动员、教育和职业经历。结果表明，这些运动员比普通人群获得了更多高等教育学位。相对于其兄弟姐妹，他们拥有更高的毕业证书并在更受尊敬的职业中工作。遵循整体—互动范式，进行了以人为导向的分析，揭示了九种——大多令人满意的——职业发展模式。因此，参与高水平体育促进而非阻碍了成功的职业发展。
literature.keywords: athlete; career; commercialization; olympics; survey

literature.title: Opportunity and inequality in the emerging esports labor market
literature.title_cn: 新兴电竞劳动力市场中的机会与不平等
literature.title_en: Opportunity and inequality in the emerging esports labor market
literature.author: Christopher M. McLeod, Hanhan Xue, Joshua I. Newman
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Esports is often described as a growing industry ripe with financial opportunities for young professional, competitive gamers. However, these claims rarely consider how income is distributed amongst players. This study uses prize earnings data from 2005 to 2019 to examine labor market inequality and related social inequalities and social stratifications. Lorenz curves and Gini coefficients show that inequality has increased in the labor market overall and the labor markets for the five top games based on total prizes awarded ( Dota 2, Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, Fortnite, League of Legends, StarCraft II). Competitors can expect to earn more today than in 2005, but median incomes have shown sporadic and inconsistent growth compared with top incomes. Moreover, most competitors earn less than the US poverty threshold. Comparing the earnings of the top female players to the whole labor market shows that gender inequalities exist in median incomes and the likelihood of earning more than the poverty threshold. The esports labor market is an engine of inequality that provides opportunities for a few (primarily male) competitors while building a growing class of lowly paid players who support the interests of game designers and event organizers.
literature.abstract_cn: 电竞通常被描述为一个快速增长、充满财务机会的行业，面向年轻的职业竞技玩家。然而，这些说法很少考虑收入如何在玩家之间分配。本研究使用2005年至2019年的奖金收入数据来考察劳动市场不平等以及相关的社会不平等和社会分层。洛伦兹曲线和基尼系数显示，劳动市场整体和按总奖金排名的前五款游戏（Dota 2、Counter-Strike: Global Offensive等）的劳动市场不平等都在加剧。研究揭示电竞劳动市场的收入分配高度不平等，少数顶级玩家获得绝大部分奖金收入，而大多数玩家收入微薄。
literature.keywords: esports; labor; gender

literature.title: Female Olympians’ voices: Female sports categories and International Olympic Committee Transgender guidelines
literature.title_cn: 女性奥运选手之声：女性体育项目与国际奥委会跨性别指南
literature.title_en: Female Olympians’ voices: Female sports categories and International Olympic Committee Transgender guidelines
literature.author: Cathy Devine
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: The fair inclusion of female athletes at elite and Olympic levels is secured in most sports by way of female categories because of the extensively documented biological and performance-related differences between the sexes. International policy for transgender inclusion is framed by the definitive International Olympic Committee transgender guidelines in which the International Olympic Committee confirms the ‘overriding sporting objective is and remains the guarantee of fair competition’ and transwomen can be excluded from female categories if, in the interests of fairness, this is necessary and proportionate. Feminist theorists argue justice requires that women have equal moral standing in the sociocultural–political structures of society including sport. As such their voices should carry equal democratic weight. However, female elite and Olympic athletes are rarely heard in the sociocultural–political discourses of academic literature or policy formulation for transgender inclusion in female categories by the International Olympic Committee and governing bodies of sport. This empirical study investigated the views and presents the ‘voices’ of 19 female Olympians. The main findings include (1) these athletes thought both female and transgender athletes should be fairly included in elite sport, (2) unanimous agreement there is not enough scientific evidence to show no competitive advantage for transwomen, (3) unanimous agreement that the International Olympic Committee should revisit the rules and scientific evidence for transgender inclusion in female categories, and (4) the majority of athletes felt that they could not ask questions or discuss this issue without being accused of transphobia.
literature.abstract_cn: 在精英和奥运层面的女性运动员公平包容，在大多数体育项目中通过女性类别的形式得到保障，因为两性之间在生物学和表现相关差异方面有广泛文献记录。国际跨性别包容政策由明确的国际奥委会跨性别指南框架化，国际奥委会在其中确认"压倒性的体育目标是并且仍然是保证公平竞争"，如果跨性别女性对公平竞争构成威胁，可以被排除在女性类别之外。本研究探讨了女性奥运选手对女性运动类别和国际奥委会跨性别政策的声音和看法，分析女运动员如何理解和协商这些复杂的政策和身份问题。
literature.keywords: inclusion; policy; athlete

literature.title: Sports and boycott: Attitudes among Jewish Israelis
literature.title_cn: 体育与抵制：以色列犹太人的态度
literature.title_en: Sports and boycott: Attitudes among Jewish Israelis
literature.author: Tamir Sorek
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: The controversy about the campaign to boycott Israel in general and Israeli sports in particular suffers from the absence of empirical data about the political character of the Israeli sports sphere, as well as the way Jewish Israelis see a possible boycott. Supporters of the boycott hope, among other things, that the campaign is registered among Israelis, and maybe even contribute to political change. Liberal opposition relies on the argument that sports is a beacon of inter-ethnic tolerance that should be cherished rather than targeted. Through a survey with a representative sample of internet users among the adult Jewish citizens of Israel (N = 600), this study provides the following related observations: (1) there is no evidence that Jewish Israeli sports fans are more likely to question the regime of Jewish supremacy than non-fans. (2) Among Jewish Israelis there is a small, but non-negligible minority who justifies the boycott of Israeli sports, and this minority is even larger among people who attend the soccer stadium and/or are politically active. (3) A significant majority of Jewish Israelis (69%) are concerned about a possible boycott of Israel in general, but this majority is less clear among men who are sports fans. The findings question the liberal expectation that Israeli sports serve as a model for inclusive citizenship and at the same time they indicate the potential of sports to amplify existing political tendencies among fans. These observations should be considered in future debates about sanctions and boycotts.
literature.abstract_cn: 关于抵制以色列特别是抵制以色列体育的运动争议，缺乏关于以色列体育领域政治性质的实证数据，以及犹太以色列人如何看待可能的抵制的数据。抵制支持者希望，除其他外，该运动能引起以色列人的注意，甚至可能促进政治变革。自由派反对者则辩称，体育是应被珍视而非针对的族际宽容灯塔。通过对以色列成年犹太公民中互联网用户的代表性样本调查（N=600），本研究提供了以下相关观察：（1）没有证据表明犹太以色列体育迷比非迷更可能质疑犹太至上的制度。（2）在犹太以色列人中，有一小部分但不可忽视的少数群体为抵制以色列体育辩护，这一少数群体在前往足球场和/或在政治上活跃的人群中甚至更大。（3）绝大多数犹太以色列人（69%）担心以色列总体上可能被抵制，但这一多数在作为体育迷的男性中不那么明显。这些发现质疑了自由派对以色列体育作为包容性公民模式的作用的期望，同时表明体育有可能放大粉丝中现有的政治倾向。这些观察应在未来关于制裁和抵制的辩论中加以考虑。
literature.keywords: soccer; minority; survey
literature.theoretical_framework: 受众研究理论、使用与满足理论

literature.title: Book review: NOlympians: Inside the Fight Against Capitalist Mega-Sports in Los Angeles, Tokyo & Beyond BoykoffJules, NOlympians: Inside the Fight Against Capitalist Mega-Sports in Los Angeles, Tokyo & Beyond, Fernwood Publishing, Novia Scotia, Manitoba, 2020; 198 pp., ISBN 9781773632766 (pbk), $24.00.
literature.title_cn: 书评：NOlympians：洛杉矶、东京及更远处反资本主义大型体育抗争内幕
literature.title_en: Book review: NOlympians: Inside the Fight Against Capitalist Mega-Sports in Los Angeles, Tokyo & Beyond BoykoffJules, NOlympians: Inside the Fight Against Capitalist Mega-Sports in Los Angeles, Tokyo & Beyond, Fernwood Publishing, Novia Scotia, Manitoba, 2020; 198 pp., ISBN 9781773632766 (pbk), $24.00.
literature.author: Jan Andre Lee Ludvigsen
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: In contemporary societies, sport mega-events such as the Olympics are both celebrated and heavily criticized. The latter may be the reason why, over the past decades, global cities have become increasingly reluctant towards bidding for sport mega-events’ hosting rights and the related costs, demands and risks that arrive with any successful Olympic hosting rights bid. The existing social scientific literature on sport mega-events has not uncommonly revolved around “legacies” that occasionally fail to materialize after the relevant event’s lifecycle, or which translate into so-called “white elephants” (Horne, 2007; Preuss, 2007). Indeed, this relates to what Müller (2015) dubs the “mega-event syndrome”, as an idea which explains why mega-events tend to involve, inter alia, the overpromising of benefits (or “legacies”), the underestimation of event costs and public debt. The increased reluctance toward mega-event hosting rights, together with the rise of anti-Olympic activism, as a civic collective response to the massive spending and other social issues associated with sport mega-events (see Boykoff, 2016; Talbot, 2021), provide the main backdrops for Boykoff’s 2020 book, NOlympians: Inside the Fight Against Capitalist Mega-Sports in Los Angeles, Tokyo & Beyond. From this, the book advances new insights from largely unexplored sport mega-event cases. In his book, Boykoff, who himself was part of the United States Olympic soccer team in the 1990s (which he reflects upon in Chapter 4), critically examines local and transnational modes of anti-Olympic activism. He does so primarily in the context of the upcoming 2028 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles, whereas the 2020 Summer Olympics in Tokyo (now the be staged in 2021 because of the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic) remain a central theme throughout the book. Based on more than 100 interviews with antiOlympic activists, personal experiences and observations, existing research, Olympic archives, and media coverage, Boykoff critically engages with the key question of “why the Olympics are increasingly a flashpoint for social justice coalitions in the twenty-first century and how that’s the case in Los Angeles as the city readies for the 2028 Games” (p. 7). Placed firmly within the context of the wider reenergized socialist activism in the United States, the campaign which Boykoff follows – NOlympics LA – seeks to stop the Olympic Games. And, for the NOlympics LA activists, Boykoff notes, “‘NOOlympics Book review
literature.abstract_cn: 在当代社会，奥运会等体育大型赛事既受到庆祝也受到严厉批评。后者可能是过去几十年全球城市对申办体育大型赛事主办权及其相关成本、要求和风险日益谨慎的原因，任何成功的奥运会主办权申办都伴随着这些代价。关于体育大型赛事的社会科学文献常常围绕"遗产"展开，这些遗产在赛事生命周期结束后有时未能实现，或转化为所谓的"白象"（Horne, 2007; Preuss, 2007）。这确实与Müller（2015）所称的"大型赛事综合症"相关，这一概念解释了为何大型赛事往往涉及对收益（或"遗产"）的过度承诺、对赛事成本和公共债务的低估等。对大型赛事主办权日益增长的不情愿，加上反奥运激进主义的兴起，作为公民对体育大型赛事相关巨额支出和其他社会问题的集体回应（参见Boykoff, 2016; Talbot, 2021），构成了Boykoff 2020年著作《NOlympians：洛杉矶、东京及更远处的资本主义大型体育内部之战》的主要背景。该书从很大程度上尚未被探索的体育大型赛事案例中提出了新洞见。在书中，Boykoff（他本人曾是20世纪90年代美国奥运足球队成员，在第4章中对此进行了反思）批判性地审视了地方和跨国层面的反奥运激进主义模式。他主要在即将举行的2028年洛杉矶夏季奥运会的背景下进行，而2020年东京夏季奥运会（因新冠疫情现推迟至2021年举行）则始终是全书的核心主题。基于对反奥运活动人士的100多次访谈、个人经历和观察、现有研究、奥运档案和媒体报道，Boykoff批判性地探讨了关键问题："为何奥运会日益成为二十一世纪社会正义联盟的引爆点，以及洛杉矶在准备2028年奥运会之际情况如何"（第7页）。该书置于美国重新焕发活力的社会主义激进主义的更广泛背景下，Boykoff所跟踪的"NOlympics LA"运动旨在阻止奥运会举行。Boykoff指出，对于NOlympics LA的活动人士而言，……
