literature.title: Women's consumption of men's professional sport in Canada: Evidence of the ‘feminization’ of sports fandom and women as omnivorous sports consumers?
literature.title_cn: 加拿大女性对男子职业体育的消费：体育粉丝文化“女性化”与女性作为杂食性体育消费者的证据？
literature.title_en: Women's consumption of men's professional sport in Canada: Evidence of the ‘feminization’ of sports fandom and women as omnivorous sports consumers?
literature.author: Adam Gemar, Stacey Pope
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Women sports fans have been substantially understudied compared to their male counterparts. While a growing number of studies seek to redress this, there remains a stark absence of quantitative approaches that would allow investigations regarding patterns of women’s sporting consumption and historical trends in the potential growth of this fandom. Using large-scale survey data from Canada from 1990 through to 2015, and employing quantitative methods of latent class and regression analysis, this study seeks to redress these issues by testing the ‘feminization’ thesis of increased women’s sporting fandom over the past three decades. In addition, we consider whether women’s fandom has become increasingly ‘omnivorous’ over this time period and the nature of this consumption today. Results show support for the feminization thesis. These findings are significant as through the use of quantitative methodologies we evidence the narrowing gender gaps in professional sports following between men and women, and women’s increasingly omnivorous consumption of sports. However, we find substantial gender gaps and inequalities in omnivorism by which the evidence suggests increased socio-economic and cultural barriers to omnivorous consumption of sport for women. We suggest that these women omnivores may be able to utilize their sporting knowledge in an instrumental way for benefits in various social settings, especially workplaces. It is hoped that this article will pave the way for further quantitative studies on women sports fans across different contexts.
literature.abstract_cn: 与男性相比，女性体育迷的研究严重不足。虽然越来越多的研究试图纠正这一点，但仍然缺乏允许调查女性体育消费模式和这一粉丝群体潜在增长历史趋势的定量方法。利用1990年至2015年加拿大的大规模调查数据，并采用潜在类别和回归分析的定量方法，本研究试图通过检验女性对男子职业体育消费的模式和时间趋势来纠正这些问题。研究发现揭示了女性体育消费的"女性化"趋势，即女性越来越多地参与传统上被视为男性主导的体育消费领域。
literature.keywords: fandom; consumption; gender; quantitative; survey; workplace

literature.title: Patriotism, competition, nationalism, and respect for the military in US sports: Public recognition of American institutionalized sports nationalism
literature.title_cn: 美国体育中的爱国主义、竞争、民族主义与对军队的尊重：公众对美国制度化体育民族主义的认可
literature.title_en: Patriotism, competition, nationalism, and respect for the military in US sports: Public recognition of American institutionalized sports nationalism
literature.author: Chris Knoester, Evan A Davis
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Using new data from the National Sports and Society Survey ( N = 3993), this study first examines the extent to which US adults recognize that sports teach love of country, competition as a way of life, respect for the military, and how to be American. We characterize this sport and society process as American Institutionalized Sports Nationalism. Then, multiple regression analyses are used to assess the extent to which dominant statuses, indicators of traditionalism, and sports fandom are associated with beliefs about American Institutionalized Sports Nationalism and its component values. Results suggest that US adults commonly agree that sports teach love of country, competition as a way of life, respect for the military, and how to be American; they are especially likely to agree that sports teach competition as a way of life and love of country. Many US adults also recognize sports as teaching respect for the military and how to be American, but most do not. In addition, as expected, identifying as male, heterosexual, Christian, Republican, and as more of a sports fan is consistently and positively associated with agreeing that sports teach patriotic, capitalistic, militaristic, and nationalistic values. In contrast to expectations, we find evidence that White adults are less likely than Black and Latinx adults to recognize American Institutionalized Sports Nationalism and its component values; college educated adults are also less likely than those with a high school education or less to agree that sports teach patriotism, capitalism, militarism, and nationalism. This may be because sports have traditionally been perceived to offer rather inclusive and fair social and economic opportunities for non-Whites and the less educated. Regardless, it is important to continue to research which cultural messages are promoted through sports, why, and to what effect. The present study advances this research initiative.
literature.abstract_cn: 使用国家体育和社会调查（N=3993）的新数据，本研究首先考察了美国成年人认可体育教会爱国家、竞争作为一种生活方式、尊重军队以及如何成为美国人的程度。我们将这一体育与社会过程描述为美国制度化体育民族主义。然后，使用多元回归分析评估主导地位、传统主义指标和体育粉丝身份与美国制度化体育民族主义信念之间的关联程度。研究发现，美国成年人普遍认可体育在培养爱国情感和军队尊重方面的作用，但不同人口统计学群体之间存在差异。年龄较大、传统主义倾向较强和体育粉丝身份更强的个体更可能认同制度化体育民族主义信念。
literature.keywords: nationalism; patriotism; fandom; survey
literature.theoretical_framework: 性别理论、女性主义传播理论

literature.title: “I can’t just post anything I want”: Self-management of South Korean sports stars on social media
literature.title_cn: “我不能随便发任何东西”：韩国体育明星在社交媒体的自我管理
literature.title_en: “I can’t just post anything I want”: Self-management of South Korean sports stars on social media
literature.author: Eunhye Yoo
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This study explores the influence and sociocultural meaning of self-management of South Korean sports stars in the context of their social media activity. The study utilizes netnography to analyze social media posts to determine the meaning of sports stars’ self-management. Data were collected through in-depth interviews with study participants. Ten South Korean sports stars, who are active users of Instagram, were selected as the study participants. Photographs, videos, and stories from their accounts—around 1800 posts in total—were analyzed. The results indicated that the sports stars attempted to share their daily lives on social media to build a close relationship with the public. Moreover, they used their accounts to publicize their commercialized selves and to promote their sponsors. They uploaded only strictly composed and curated posts on their accounts as a form of self-censorship. Finally, it was determined that digital labor was used for self-management on social media, where there is no distinction between public and private territory. A sports star has become a self-living commercial today, and self-management is now a prerequisite for survival. Thus, self-management on social media has become a requirement for sports stars.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了韩国体育明星在其社交媒体活动背景下自我管理的影响和社会文化意义。研究利用网络民族志分析社交媒体帖子，以确定体育明星自我管理的意义。通过深度访谈收集数据。选择了十位Instagram活跃用户的韩国体育明星作为研究对象。分析了他们账户中的照片、视频和故事——总共约1,800条帖子。分析揭示，韩国体育明星在社交媒体上进行严格的自我管理，谨慎控制其公众形象，平衡专业运动员身份和个人生活呈现。这种自我管理反映了韩国社会中名人文化和公众期待的影响，同时也展示了运动员如何在数字空间中协商其公共身份。
literature.keywords: instagram; interviews; labor
literature.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、产业组织理论

literature.title: Public service media, sports and cultural citizenship in the age of social media: An analysis of BBC Sport agenda diversity on Twitter
literature.title_cn: 社交媒体时代的公共服务媒体、体育与文化公民身份：BBC体育推特议程多样性分析
literature.title_en: Public service media, sports and cultural citizenship in the age of social media: An analysis of BBC Sport agenda diversity on Twitter
literature.author: Xavier Ramon, José Luis Rojas-Torrijos
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: As a crucial part of their mandate, public service media have historically used sports to construct and nurture cultural citizenship. In a landscape characterised by dwindling resources and growing competition from pay-TV channels and on-demand streaming services, concerns about how public service media will enhance cultural citizenship through new platforms, including social media, are all the greater. In the digital age, delivering diverse content should remain a foundation of public service media in their countless platforms: public media should not only concentrate on major sports but also provide exposure to traditionally underrepresented disciplines and individuals, including sportswomen and athletes with disabilities. Through content analysis, this research examines the agenda diversity offered by the British Broadcasting Corporation through its sports-centred Twitter account ( @BBCSport ). The analysis of 10,821 tweets indicates how the British Broadcasting Corporation's content reinforces, rather than counteracts, the long-standing diversity imbalances in the analogue age. This case study facilitates an understanding of the nuanced relationship among public service media, social media and sports, demonstrating that more content does not necessarily ensure diversity. The football-driven, male-centred and able-bodied agenda displayed by @BBCSport signals that public service media should reframe their social media strategies to adequately contribute to fostering cultural citizenship.
literature.abstract_cn: 作为其使命的重要组成部分，公共服务媒体历来利用体育来建构与培育文化公民身份。在资源萎缩、付费电视与点播流媒体竞争加剧的格局下，公共服务媒体如何通过包括社交媒体在内的新平台增强文化公民身份令人更加担忧。数字时代中，提供多元内容的公共服务媒体在体育议程多样性、包容性呈现与文化公民身份建设中的作用亟待审视。本研究对BBC体育推特议程多样性进行了分析。
literature.keywords: twitter; diversity; broadcasting; streaming; football; athlete

literature.title: Sport for Indigenous resurgence: Toward a critical settler-colonial reflection
literature.title_cn: 原住民复兴的体育：迈向批判性定居者-殖民地反思
literature.title_en: Sport for Indigenous resurgence: Toward a critical settler-colonial reflection
literature.author: Mariana Essa, Alexandra Arellano, Stephen Stuart, Stephen Sheps
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This article examines the field of sport for development (SFD) while considering Indigenous resurgence amidst Canada’s neoliberal settler-colonial landscape. While sharing challenges encountered within their practice, program staff from the Promoting Life-skills in Aboriginal Youth program revealed high levels of constructive self-criticism and reflexivity. There are three emergent themes, the adoption of which appeared essential for transforming the sector in recognition of Indigenous resurgence: growth and pace; Indigenous agency and knowledge; and political engagement. Grounded in settler colonialism and resurgence, this paper also reflects on the field of SFD and what it would mean to decolonize the practice. The article concludes by asking if non-Indigenous scholars can study SFD by subverting the colonial status quo that is also reproduced in this research field.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文考察了加拿大新自由主义定居者殖民格局中的体育促发展（SFD）领域与原住民复兴。在分享其实践中遇到的挑战的同时，"原住民青年生活技能促进计划"的项目工作人员表现出高度的建设性自我批评和反思性。出现了三个主题，采纳这些主题对于在承认原住民复兴的背景下转变该领域似乎至关重要：增长与步伐；原住民能动性与知识；以及政治参与。扎根于定居者批判……
literature.keywords: engagement; indigenous resurgence; resurgence toward; critical settler-colonial; settler-colonial reflection; resurgence amidst
literature.theoretical_framework: 受众研究理论、使用与满足理论

literature.title: Social integration of people with a migration background in Swiss sport clubs: A cross-level analysis
literature.title_cn: 瑞士体育俱乐部中移民背景人群的社会融入：跨层级分析
literature.title_en: Social integration of people with a migration background in Swiss sport clubs: A cross-level analysis
literature.author: Matthias Buser, Jenny A Zwahlen, Torsten Schlesinger, Siegfried Nagel
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Sport clubs are considered an ideal setting for the social integration of people with a migration background. However, they can also be a place of social closure practices, where assimilative ideas and ethnic boundaries are present. Besides the individual characteristics of the members, adequate club organizational structures are relevant for preventing social closure and facilitating social integration. Thus, the role of organizational structures for social integration might differ between natives and people with a migration background. Based on data from 42 Swiss sport clubs and 780 sport club members, with and without a migration background, we analyzed individual (migration background and membership biography) and structural factors (situational, club goals, and club culture) using multilevel models and tested cross-level interactions between structural variables and migration background. The results reveal that membership biography (e.g. membership duration and volunteering) and migration background are relevant for social integration. The estimated cross-level effects reveal that, unlike for natives and second-generation people with a migration background, structural conditions are especially relevant for first-generation people with a migration background. For example, social integration increases with a higher proportion of people with a migration background in the club or a less assimilative club culture.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育俱乐部被认为是具有移民背景者社会融合的理想场所。然而，它们也可能成为社会封闭实践的场所，同化观念和种族边界在此存在。除了成员的个体特征外，适当的俱乐部组织结构对于防止社会封闭和促进社会融合也很重要。因此，组织结构对社会融合的作用可能在本地人和具有移民背景者之间有所不同。基于42个瑞士体育俱乐部和780名俱乐部成员（有和没有移民背景）的数据，我们使用多层次模型分析了个体因素（移民背景和会员经历）和结构因素（情境因素、俱乐部目标和俱乐部文化），并检验了结构变量与移民背景之间的跨层次交互作用。结果显示，会员经历（如会员时长和志愿服务）和移民背景与社会融合相关。估算的跨层次效应显示，与本地人和第二代移民背景者不同，结构条件对第一代移民背景者尤其相关。例如，俱乐部中移民背景者比例越高或俱乐部文化越不具同化性，社会融合程度越高。
literature.keywords: migration background; social integration; sport clubs; swiss sport; social closure; organizational structures
literature.theoretical_framework: 新闻学理论、传播学基础理论

literature.title: Bahraini uprising of 2011: The (No More) hidden political role of sports journalism
literature.title_cn: 2011年巴林起义：体育新闻(不再)隐藏的政治角色
literature.title_en: Bahraini uprising of 2011: The (No More) hidden political role of sports journalism
literature.author: Ali Rabea
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Two events have brought the social movement in Bahrain to light yet again: the temporary detention of the football player Hakeem Al-Araibi in Thailand for alleged ‘terrorist’ acts and the imprisonment of the activist Najah Yusuf because of her criticism of the hosting of a Formula One Grand Prix. This paper sheds light on the nexus between sports journalism and politics in Bahrain. It highlights the weaponizing of sports journalism during the first few weeks of the 2011 uprising to protect the regime. The coverage of the demonstrations is analysed to inspect how the 2011 uprising was reported on by the pro-regime sports newspapers. This paper argues that sports journalism played an unprecedented political role during the uprising when it was used by the regime as a weapon to confront the protests and in the process reinforce the regime's control over the country.
literature.abstract_cn: 两个事件使巴林的社会运动再次被关注：足球运动员哈基姆·阿拉比在泰国因被指控"恐怖主义"行为而被临时拘留，以及活动家纳贾赫·优素福因批评F1大奖赛的举办而入狱。本文揭示了巴林体育新闻与政治之间的联系。它强调了在2011年起义的头几周体育新闻被武器化以保护执政政权的现象。
literature.keywords: football; politics; protest

literature.title: Concussion Reporting and Safeguarding Policy Development in British American Football: An Essential Agenda
literature.title_cn: 英国美式足球的脑震荡报告与安全政策制定：一项必要议程
literature.title_en: Concussion Reporting and Safeguarding Policy Development in British American Football: An Essential Agenda
literature.author: Eleanor Travis, Claire Thornton, Andrea Scott-Bell
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: The objective of this study was to examine concussion reporting and safeguarding policy in British American Football (BAF). Data were collected via an online survey tool. The data presented are part of a broader study that examined injury profiles, concussion reporting behaviors, and medical provision in BAF. Concussion-like symptoms were found in over half (58.8%) of the participants. Of those, 36.4% reported they had previously been formally diagnosed with a concussion while playing BAF. Just under half of the participants (44.7%) had suspected they had had a concussion, although it was not formally diagnosed, and 23.5% of the participants had previously hidden concussion symptoms. Fifty-eight percent of the teams reported they did not have a regular game-day medic, with a range of hired medical personnel who attended the games. Prominent barriers to hiring a medic included budget, institutional support shortfall, and lack of medic reliability and game knowledge. BAF is a developing sport with a clear vision for growth of participation. Yet, the current concussion and medical provision policies do not address the sport's welfare needs. Through discussion of these policies in the context of this study's findings, we highlight vital areas of concern in policy and practice that the British American Football Association needs to address in their medical and concussion policies.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在考察英国美式橄榄球（BAF）中的脑震荡报告与保护政策。数据通过在线调查工具收集。所呈现的数据是一项更广泛研究的一部分，该研究考察了BAF中的伤病概况、脑震荡报告行为和医疗供给。超过一半（58.8%）的参与者存在脑震荡样症状。其中36.4%的人报告曾在参与BAF时被正式诊断为脑震荡。略低于一半的参与者（44.7%）曾怀疑自己患过脑震荡（但未正式诊断），23.5%的参与者曾隐瞒脑震荡症状。58%的球队报告称他们没有常规的比赛日队医，只有各种聘请的医疗人员参加比赛。聘请队医的主要障碍包括预算、机构支持不足以及缺乏队医可靠性和比赛知识。BAF是一项发展中的运动，对参与增长有明确愿景。然而，当前的脑震荡和医疗供给政策并未解决这项运动的福利需求。通过在本研究发现背景下讨论这些政策，我们强调了英国美式橄榄球协会需要在其医疗和脑震荡政策中解决的至关重要的政策与实践问题。
literature.keywords: football; policy; concussion; survey; injury

literature.title: Education, Political Party, and Football Viewership Predict Americans' Attention to News About Concussions in Sports
literature.title_cn: 教育、政党与足球观看预测美国人对体育脑震荡新闻的关注
literature.title_en: Education, Political Party, and Football Viewership Predict Americans' Attention to News About Concussions in Sports
literature.author: Andrew M. Lindner, Daniel N. Hawkins
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: News outlets, sports coverage, and even Hollywood movies have highlighted the growing body of research documenting the long-term negative consequences of traumatic injury in athletics, particularly, (sports-related) concussions. Despite so much media coverage, little is known about how much attention members of the American public pay to sports concussion news. Disparities in attention to concussion news among sociodemographic groups may contribute to further inequalities in rates of concussions that stem from participation in collision sports. In this study, using a 2017 nationally representative survey of US residents (n = 964), we examine the social, political, and demographic correlates of individuals' attention to news about concussions in sports. Regression results indicate that older, more educated, Democratic-leaning respondents reported that they pay more attention to news about concussions. Additionally, respondents with a greater past competitive athletic participation and those who regularly watch baseball and football reported higher levels of attention to concussion news. These findings are consistent with previous research showing higher levels of news consumption and trust in science among the highly educated and Democrats. The increased levels among football viewers may be in response to the inclusion of concussion news in game coverage.
literature.abstract_cn: 新闻媒体、体育报道甚至好莱坞电影都突出了越来越多的研究，这些研究记录了体育运动中创伤性损伤（尤其是运动相关脑震荡）的长期负面后果。尽管有如此多的媒体报道，但人们对美国公众在多大程度上关注体育脑震荡新闻知之甚少。不同社会人口群体对脑震荡新闻关注度的差异，可能导致因参与碰撞性体育运动而产生的脑震荡发生率进一步不平等。在本研究中，使用2017年具有全国代表性的美国调查数据……
literature.keywords: viewers; football; concussion; inclusion; survey; trust
literature.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、产业组织理论

literature.title: “Claim vs. Reality”—A German Case Study on Modes and Functions of Sports-Pedagogical Communication
literature.title_cn: “宣称与现实”——德国体育教学传播模式与功能的案例研究
literature.title_en: “Claim vs. Reality”—A German Case Study on Modes and Functions of Sports-Pedagogical Communication
literature.author: David Jaitner, Swen Koerner, Esther Serwe-Pandrick
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: Academic sports pedagogy continuously assures itself of its disciplinary foundations and determines its position in the structure of modern sciences. While communication is based on differences, the distinction between claim and reality plays a crucial role in sports pedagogy. However, the forms and functions in which the distinction appears have not been more closely investigated in sports pedagogic. This article starts with this in mind, exemplarily focusing on academic sports pedagogy in Germany. While analyzing 212 scientific texts of sports-pedagogical provenance, three central variations of the distinction could be identified, which persist until today and are present in the discipline's central discussion lines: (1) hierarchical demarcation, (2) unsystematic approach, (3) direct synthesis. From a functional point of view, the distinction between claim and reality continuously (re)organizes the relationship of sports pedagogy to other scientific disciplines, educational policy guidelines, and school practice expectations, thus proving to be a supporting pillar of disciplinary identity work.
literature.abstract_cn: 学术体育教育学持续确认其学科基础，并确定其在现代科学结构中的地位。虽然传播基于差异，但主张与现实之间的区分在体育教育学中起着关键作用。然而，这一区分以何种形式和功能出现，尚未在体育教育学中得到更深入的研究。本文以此为出发点，聚焦于德国的学术体育教育学。在分析212篇体育教育学来源的科学文本后，可以识别出这一区分的三种核心变体……
literature.keywords: policy; claim and reality; claim vs; vs reality; german case; communication academic

literature.title: Editorial: Youth and Winter Sports
literature.title_cn: 社论：青年与冬季运动
literature.title_en: Editorial: Youth and Winter Sports
literature.author: Grégoire P. Millet, Fabien Ohl
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: Just before the beginning of the COVID-19 pandemic, Lausanne—known as the “Olympic capital” since it is the home of the International Olympic Committee—had the privilege and opportunity to organise the last international sporting event not affected by the virus. The 2020 Winter Youth Olympic Games was the third edition of the Winter Youth Olympic Games (YOG) and was held in Lausanne between January 9 and 22, 2020. The event featured 8 sports and 16 disciplines, including ski mountaineering and women’s Nordic combined for the first time at the Olympics. A total of 1,788 athletes from 79 nations participated. Among several novelties was the location of the “Olympic village” on the campus of the University of Lausanne. The YOG was an opportunity to bring the academic and sports worlds closer together. The University of Lausanne collaborated with the IOC on various educational and scientific programmes for athletes and the public. Thus, in collaboration with IOC’s Olympic Studies Centre and several academic institutions, the Institute of Sport Sciences (ISSUL) organised the congress “Youth and winter sports” https://wp.unil.ch/ cyws20/program/ on January 7 and 8. It aimed to bring together sports scientists, coaches, and medics with an interest in winter sports, and around 200 people attended the congress. Several points (not only the pre-COVID date!) made this congress very special:
literature.keywords: olympics; pandemic; covid; athlete; coach

literature.title: Social Media Influencers in Equestrian Sport
literature.title_cn: 马术运动中的社交媒体影响者
literature.title_en: Social Media Influencers in Equestrian Sport
literature.author: Aage Radmann, Susanna Hedenborg, Lovisa Broms
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: The study analyzes and explains the impact of social media influencers on stable cultures in Sweden and Norway, contributing to the understanding of the complex relationship between equestrian sports and social media—a relationship that is important for the welfare of horses. Since equestrianism is one of the most popular sports in Sweden and Norway, influencers' social media communication greatly impacts followers' perception of the human-animal relationship. Despite the popularity of equestrian sports, studies thereof are rare, and research combining equestrian sports and social media is almost non-existent, making this study important and relevant. The analysis focuses on the six biggest equestrian influencers in Sweden and Norway and their social media accounts. Goffman's (1967) micro-sociological perspectives, alongside previous research on social media, are used to discuss knowledge exchange, co-creation of authenticity and intimacy and sponsorship and advertisement. The influencers mainly focus their communication on horse-related issues, and their (and their followers) love of horses create the intimacy needed as a base for other messages (perceived knowledge and advertisement). The intimacy and authenticity are strengthened in the interaction between followers and influencers, and the latter receive positive feedback for their way of handling their horses' lives. The expressive order of stable culture(s) is seldom questioned and the acceptance of this order is likely to make the commercial endorsements less visible and more convincing.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究分析和解释了社交媒体影响者对瑞典和挪威稳定马厩文化的影响，有助于理解马术运动与社交媒体之间的复杂关系——这种关系对马的福利很重要。由于马术是瑞典和挪威最受欢迎的运动之一，影响者的社交媒体传播极大地影响追随者对人与动物关系的感知。尽管马术运动很受欢迎，但相关研究很少，结合马术运动和社交媒体的研究几乎不存在，这使得本研究重要且相关。分析聚焦于瑞典和挪威六大马术影响者及其社交媒体账户。研究使用Goffman（1967）的微观社会学视角以及先前关于社交媒体的研究，讨论知识交流、真实性和亲密的共同创造以及赞助和广告。影响者主要将其传播聚焦于与马相关的问题，他们（及其追随者）对马的爱创造了作为其他信息（感知知识和广告）基础的亲密感。亲密和真实性在追随者与影响者的互动中得到加强，后者因处理马的日常生活方式而获得积极反馈。马厩文化的表达秩序很少受到质疑，对这种秩序的接受可能使商业代言不那么显眼且更有说服力。
literature.keywords: sponsorship; social media; sweden and norway; media influencers; equestrian sport; influencers social

literature.title: An Analysis of Broadcasting Media Using Social Media Engagement in the WNBA
literature.title_cn: WNBA中利用社交媒体参与的分析
literature.title_en: An Analysis of Broadcasting Media Using Social Media Engagement in the WNBA
literature.author: Ann Pegoraro, Heather Kennedy, Nola Agha, Nicholas Brown, David Berri
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: While there has been research into what teams, leagues, and athletes post on social media and the impact of post content on social media engagement, there is limited understanding and empirical research on the impact of broadcasting media on social sport consumption. There are an increasing number of new media through which sport leagues can distribute their content to fans. This research examines the impact of different broadcast platforms on game day engagement with WNBA team Twitter accounts. Using data for the 2016–2018 seasons, results indicate athlete/team quality and performance were positively associated with post engagement, underscoring the importance of the core sport product and potentially indicating that the WNBA is developing a star-driven culture similar to the NBA. In addition, broadcasting on League Pass or local TV (for home teams) and Twitter were associated with lower post engagement suggesting we have more to learn about maximizing online engagement.
literature.abstract_cn: 虽然已有关于球队、联盟和运动员在社交媒体上发布什么内容以及帖子内容对社媒互动影响的研究，但对广播媒体对体育社交消费影响的实证研究和理解仍然有限。体育联盟向粉丝分发内容的新的媒体形式越来越多。本研究考察了不同广播平台对WNBA球队推特账户比赛日互动的影响。使用2016-2018赛季的数据，结果显示了不同广播平台对比赛日互动的影响差异。研究发现，某些广播平台比其他平台更能提高比赛日的粉丝互动。研究为体育联盟如何利用广播平台提高粉丝参与提供了见解。
literature.keywords: broadcasting; engagement; twitter; nba; athlete

literature.title_cn: 社论：女性职业体育：理解独特性
literature.title_en: Editorial: Women's Professional Sport: Understanding Distinctiveness
literature.author: Ann Pegoraro, Tracy Taylor

literature.title: Bridging the Gap: How Gender Influences Spanish Politicians’ Activity on Twitter
literature.title_cn: 弥合鸿沟：性别如何影响西班牙政客的推特活动
literature.title_en: Bridging the Gap: How Gender Influences Spanish Politicians’ Activity on Twitter
literature.author: Frederic Guerrero-Solé, Cristina Perales-García
literature.abstract: Women have historically been underrepresented in politics. However, in the last few decades, more and more women have been elected to both upper and lower houses, particularly in Spain. Social media has become one >of the main channels for women to gain visibility, but the issue of unequal distribution of power and influence between men and women remains. This paper sheds light on gender differences among politicians on Twitter by analyzing the social media activity and influence of 277 of the 350 Members of the Spanish Congress of Deputies from March to June 2020. Our research shows there are still major gender differences regarding audience figures and amplification and that both male and female politicians still largely retweet more men than women. In addition, we found significant differences between parties and across the political spectrum, although these are less prominent (albeit not neutralized) in parties with a female leader. This is in keeping with studies that have found broad similarities between male and female politicians’ communicative practices, but a persistently large gap to be bridged in terms of their online influence. Female leaders are proposed as a means to bridge this gap.
literature.abstract_cn: 女性在政治中历来代表不足。然而，在最近几十年里，越来越多的女性当选进入上下议院，特别是在西班牙。社交媒体已成为女性获得可见度的主要渠道之一，但男女之间权力和影响力分配不均的问题仍然存在。本文通过分析西班牙众议院350名议员中277人的社交媒体活动和影响力，揭示了推特上政治家的性别差异。研究发现，女性政治家在推特上更活跃于某些话题，但总体影响力和曝光度仍与男性存在差异。
literature.keywords: gender; twitter; audience; politics
literature.theoretical_framework: 性别理论、受众研究理论

literature.title: Football Misinformation Matrix: A Comparative Study of 2020 Winter Transfer News in Four European Sports Media Outlets
literature.title_cn: 足球信息矩阵：四家欧洲体育媒体2020年冬窗转会新闻的比较研究
literature.title_en: Football Misinformation Matrix: A Comparative Study of 2020 Winter Transfer News in Four European Sports Media Outlets
literature.author: José Luis Rojas Torrijos, Matheus Simoes Mello
literature.abstract: Mainstream sports media generate a football information overload that sometimes makes it difficult to separate rumours from real news. Accordingly, this paper analyses the level of misinformation in the coverage of the 2020 winter football transfer window in four leading European digital sports media outlets: Marca (Spain), A Bola (Portugal), La Gazzetta (Italy) and The Guardian Sport (Britain). The methodology used was based on the content analysis of hundreds of news pieces and tweets posted on these outlets’ football homepages and Twitter handles over a month. To examine to what extent this coverage may have been speculative, misleading or false, the misinformation matrix developed by the fact-checking organisation First Draft News was employed to classify five different types of inaccuracies in sports reporting. A system was also created to determine how many reported rumours finally turned out to be true, which sources were more reliable and what outlets resulted more accurate. The findings reveal that the four digital media published a larger amount of non-factual content about likely football deals rather than sealed transfers. Speculative reporting prevailed in the coverage of the top teams in each league, on which the media outlets placed the accent, whereas reporting about minor clubs was based more on factual news.
literature.abstract_cn: 主流体育媒体产生足球信息过载，有时使区分谣言和真实新闻变得困难。因此，本文分析了四个领先欧洲数字体育媒体对2020年冬季足球转会窗口报道中的错误信息水平：Marca（西班牙）、A Bola（葡萄牙）、La Gazzetta（意大利）和The Guardian Sport（英国）。方法论基于对这些媒体足球主页和推特账号发布的数百条新闻和推文的内容分析。结果显示，各媒体之间的错误信息水平存在显著差异，有些媒体更依赖于未经证实的谣言，而其他媒体则更严格地验证信息。研究揭示体育媒体在平衡速度与准确性方面面临的挑战，以及错误信息对体育新闻公信力的影响。
literature.keywords: football; misinformation; twitter; source

literature.title: Disability Narratives in Sports Communication: Tokyo 2020 Paralympic Games’ Best Practices and Implications
literature.title_cn: 体育传播中的残障叙事：东京2020残奥会最佳实践及其启示
literature.title_en: Disability Narratives in Sports Communication: Tokyo 2020 Paralympic Games’ Best Practices and Implications
literature.author: Olga Kolotouchkina, Carmen Llorente-Barroso, María Luisa García-Guardia, Juan Pavón
literature.abstract: The Paralympic Games have become a relevant social and communication tool for the enhancement of global awareness and understanding of disability. The increasing visibility of this kind of global sports event, as well as the efforts of public authorities to make their host cities more accessible, evidence a relevant shift to new urban barrier-free experiences and discourses concerning disability. This research is guided by an exploratory case study approach to assess the disability representation and narratives within the context of the 2020 Tokyo Paralympic Games. The examination of some innovative communication strategies fostering the visibility of disability reveals a series of effective practices implemented in Japan. The focus on the personification of para-athletes, the celebration of public events to experience first-hand para-sports disciplines, as well as the engagement of school-children and young people in para-sports initiatives are predominant in the communication efforts of Tokyo 2020 in the pre-games period.
literature.abstract_cn: 残奥会已成为提高全球对残障认识和理解的相关社会和传播工具。这种全球体育赛事可见度的提高，以及公共当局努力使主办城市更加无障碍，证明了向新的城市无障碍体验和关于残障话语的相关转变。本研究以探索性案例研究方法为指导，评估2020年东京残奥会背景下的残障代表和叙事。研究考察了残奥会传播中的最佳实践，包括运动员叙事、媒体覆盖和公众参与。分析揭示了残奥会如何通过体育传播挑战残障刻板印象，以及残奥会如何作为促进包容和理解残障的工具。研究为体育传播中残障叙事的发展提供了见解。
literature.keywords: disability; paralympic; representation; engagement; athlete

literature.title: The Winner Doesn’t Take It All: Analyzing Audience Responses to an Inspirational Sports Narrative
literature.title_cn: 胜者并非通吃：分析受众对励志体育叙事的反应
literature.title_en: The Winner Doesn’t Take It All: Analyzing Audience Responses to an Inspirational Sports Narrative
literature.author: Joshua Baldwin, Gary Bente
literature.abstract: Applying a dual-process rationale, this study explored the cognitive and affective mechanisms involved in the processing of hedonic versus eudaimonic film clips and their putatively distinct inspirational effects. The two types of narratives were operationalized in terms of complete and incomplete goal satisfaction in the film endings. Participants either watched the final boxing match from Rocky, where the protagonist loses the fight, but achieves self-mastery and finds love (eudaimonic narrative) or from Rocky II, where he wins against his opponent (hedonic narrative). A combination of continuous measures of how pleasant participants felt (slider ratings) and psychophysiological measures (heart rate, galvanic skin response [GSR], pulse volume amplitude [PVA]) indicating cognitive load and arousal was used to track the audience responses while watching a compilation of the same intro and the different fight versions. Results revealed that arousal was more strongly associated with participants’ affective scores during the hedonic (winning) version than during the eudaimonic (losing) one. Furthermore, participants experience more positive affect and arousal after watching the protagonist win the match compared to those that watched him lose. Lastly, participants in the eudaimonic condition were more likely to be inspired to exercise afterward. Implications of our results are discussed.
literature.abstract_cn: 运用双过程推理，本研究探索了享乐型与幸福型（eudaimonic）电影片段处理的认知和情感机制及其看似不同的励志效果。两种叙事类型通过电影结局中目标满足的完整和不完整来操作化。参与者要么观看《洛奇》中的最后一场拳击比赛，主角输掉比赛但实现了自我掌控并找到爱情（幸福型叙事），要么观看《洛奇2》中他击败对手（享乐型叙事）。结合连续测量参与者感受的愉快程度（滑块评分）和心理生理测量（心率、皮肤电反应[GSR]、脉幅[PVA]，指示认知负荷和唤醒度）来跟踪观众观看同一引言和不同比赛版本的汇编时的反应。结果显示，在享乐型（获胜）版本中，唤醒度与参与者的情感得分关联更强。此外，参与者观看主角实现目标（获胜）的版本后，经历了更积极的情感和唤醒度。研究为理解体育励志叙事的心理影响提供了见解。
literature.keywords: audience; affective
literature.theoretical_framework: 叙事理论、受众研究理论

literature.title: The Development of Data Journalism in China: Influences, Motivations and Practice
literature.title_cn: 中国数据新闻的发展：影响、动机与实践
literature.title_en: The Development of Data Journalism in China: Influences, Motivations and Practice
literature.author: Scott Wright, David Nolan
literature.abstract: Abstract Using semi-structured interviews with Chinese data journalists across party and commercial media, this article assesses the structure and practice of data journalism in China. In doing this, it responds to calls for further studies of data journalism in non-western contexts. It finds that Chinese data journalists face some of the same pressures and challenges that have been documented in other countries, including limited access to data and the constraints imposed by the screen-size of smartphones. However, these were often exacerbated through a combination of social and systemic factors - to the point that their impact is qualitatively and quantitatively different. Simultaneously, however, we find that in some cases Chinese data journalists, at least amongst party media, were protected from pressures such as audience demand, and encouraged to focus on state-of-the-art work. We conclude that what has emerged is a form of ‘data journalism with Chinese characteristics’, and that these characteristics emerge from the interactions between systemic, newsroom and social factors.
literature.abstract_cn: 利用对中国党和商业媒体数据记者的半结构化访谈，本文评估了中国数据新闻的结构和实践。在此过程中，回应了对非西方情境下数据新闻进一步研究的呼吁。研究发现，中国数据记者面临着在其他国家已记录的一些相同压力和挑战，包括数据获取途径有限、编辑支持不足以及数据技能的持续需求。然而，中国数据新闻的实践也受到独特的制度和文化因素的影响，包括政府的数据开放政策、新闻实践中的意识形态约束，以及数据可视化和互动叙述在吸引受众方面的重要性。研究为理解中国数据新闻的独特性和发展轨迹提供了见解，并为全球数据新闻研究做出贡献。
literature.keywords: audience; qualitative; quantitative; interviews; smartphone; newsroom

literature.title: We Now Go Live: Digital Live-News Technologies and the “Reinvention of Live” in Professional TV News Broadcasting
literature.title_cn: 我们现在直播：数字直播技术与职业电视新闻广播中“直播”的再发明
literature.title_en: We Now Go Live: Digital Live-News Technologies and the “Reinvention of Live” in Professional TV News Broadcasting
literature.author: Jonathan Ilan
literature.abstract: Abstract This article sets out to provide fresh insight into the case of liveness in news media by exploring a particular live-news technology—LiveU’s digital, cellular-based, live broadcast technology, and its implementation in professional TV news broadcasting. Based on a thematic analysis of in-depth interviews with nine TV news and LiveU’s professionals, the findings point to various interconnections between LiveU’s technology and certain professional actors through a variety of editorial, business and technological decision-making processes and activities that constitute live-news broadcasting. Essentially, the case of LiveU and its implementation in professional TV live-news broadcasting illustrate the intersection of news mobility and the production of news from a socio-technical standpoint.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文旨在通过探索一种特定的直播新闻技术——LiveU的数字、基于蜂窝的直播广播技术及其在专业电视新闻广播中的实施——为新闻媒体中的现场性案例提供新的见解。基于对九名电视新闻和LiveU专业人员的深度访谈的主题分析，发现通过构成直播新闻广播的各种编辑、商业和技术决策过程和活动，指出了LiveU技术与某些专业行为者之间的各种相互联系。本质上，LiveU的案例及其在专业电视直播新闻广播中的实施，从社会技术的角度说明了新闻流动性和新闻生产的交汇。
literature.keywords: liveu, live-news, technology, professional, broadcasting

literature.title: Reporting Conflict from Afar: Journalists, Social Media, Communication Technologies, and War
literature.title_cn: 远程报道冲突：记者、社交媒体、传播技术与战争
literature.title_en: Reporting Conflict from Afar: Journalists, Social Media, Communication Technologies, and War
literature.author: Britt Christensen, Ali Khalil
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT We conducted interviews with conflict journalists who covered the conflicts in Syria, Yemen, Libya, and Iraq and who work for the major international news agencies and media companies. These journalists did most of their reporting from remote locations as the conflict zones were too dangerous to be physically present. We investigated how the journalist did their jobs with the communicative affordances of digital tools and how digital trust-building occurred. The trust-building process between journalists and sources shifted across platforms and according to the technologies’ communicative affordances. We established that reporters had embraced the flow of news material on social media platforms as a valuable source of information, but after exercising extreme caution. Journalists upheld the boundaries that separated them from amateurs by emphasizing their role in making sense of events. They also fortified their gatekeeping role through verifying and vetting information – a task needed to maintain credibility and protect readers and viewers from misinformation and propaganda. Encrypted messaging applications such as WhatsApp played a major role in speeding up communication with and protecting potential sources and verification.
literature.abstract_cn: 我们采访了报道叙利亚、也门、利比亚和伊拉克冲突、并为主要国际新闻机构和媒体公司工作的冲突记者。由于冲突区过于危险无法亲临，这些记者大多在偏远地点进行报道。我们调查了记者如何利用数字工具的传播可供性开展工作，以及数字信任如何建立。记者与信源之间的信任建立过程随平台和技术的传播可供性而转移。我们确认，记者已将社交媒体平台上的新闻信息流视为宝贵的信息来源，但在采取极度谨慎之后。记者们……
literature.keywords: journalists, conflict, major, media, communicative

literature.title: Joining the Team: Metajournalistic Discourse, Paradigm Repair, the Athletic and Sports Journalism Practice
literature.title_cn: 加入团队：元新闻话语、范式修复、The Athletic与体育新闻实践
literature.title_en: Joining the Team: Metajournalistic Discourse, Paradigm Repair, the Athletic and Sports Journalism Practice
literature.author: Patrick Ferrucci
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT Utilizing textual analysis, this article examines the metajournalistic discourse inherent in The Athletic’s “why I enlisted” columns. Through this type of study, it is possible to begin to understand how actors within the field of sports journalism delineate and navigate the boundaries of the profession. This study found that providing time for stories, valuing experience and conducting focused audience engagement are inside the boundaries, while rushed stories, a subpar user experience and overall market-driven practices should sit outside—though they do not at most organization. These findings are then discussed with an eye toward understanding the future of normative journalism, and acknowledging how new media sites can actually strengthen and not weaken boundaries.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文利用文本分析，考察了《The Athletic》"我为何应征"专栏中固有的元新闻话语。通过这类研究，可以开始理解体育新闻领域的行动者如何划定和驾驭职业的边界。本研究发现，为故事提供时间、重视经验和进行专注的受众参与属于边界之内，而仓促的故事、欠佳的用户体验和整体的市场驱动实践应置于边界之外——尽管在大多数组织中并非如此。这些发现随后被讨论，着眼于理解规范性新闻的未来，并承认新媒体网站实际上可以加强而非削弱边界。
literature.keywords: boundaries, journalism, stories, experience, abstract

literature.title: Public Broadcasting Is Not Much Different: Public and Commercial Broadcasters’ Coverage of Minimum Wage in South Korea
literature.title_cn: 公共广播并无太大不同：韩国公营与商业广播对最低工资的报道
literature.title_en: Public Broadcasting Is Not Much Different: Public and Commercial Broadcasters’ Coverage of Minimum Wage in South Korea
literature.author: Chang Sup Park, Barbara K. Kaye
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT This article provides a framing analysis of media coverage of minimum wage between public and commercial broadcasters in South Korea. To do this, the current study content analyzed 1505 news reports about “minimum wage” aired by two public television broadcasters and two commercial television broadcasters in 2018. The analysis finds that both public and commercial broadcasters directed citizens’ attention to the new policy’s collective harms framed as “increasing unemployment” and “harms to the economy,” while deemphasizing the particularistic benefits of the minimum wage increase and the resulting reduction of inequality gap between the rich and the poor. Further, all the broadcasters have not provided citizens with enough information necessary for a balanced assessment of the pros and cons of the minimum wage increase.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究比较了韩国公营与商业广播机构对最低工资议题的报道，挑战了公共广播在公共事务报道上明显优于商业广播的普遍假设。研究结果显示，公共广播与商业广播在最低工资报道上并无显著差异，为理解公营与商业媒体新闻表现提供了新证据。
literature.keywords: broadcasters, minimum, public, commercial, analysis

literature.title: “How Can They Like Doing That?” The Ambivalent Definition of Legitimate Work in Sports Journalism
literature.title_cn: “他们怎么会喜欢做那个？”体育新闻中正当工作的模糊定义
literature.title_en: “How Can They Like Doing That?” The Ambivalent Definition of Legitimate Work in Sports Journalism
literature.author: Schoch Lucie, Ohl Fabien
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT This paper investigates the opposing definitions of legitimate journalism between female and male sports reporters in the Swiss daily press, observable through the tensions in the division of work, task hierarchies, and contradictory definitions of what is perceived as distasteful or undesirable. It aims to adopt an inclusive approach that avoids being judgemental towards male perspectives or adopting a cynical view of female journalists, to better understand both male and female journalists’ experiences of interaction of work and professional recognition, and identify obstacles to greater gender equality in sports journalism. The analysis relies on the notion of “dirty work” developed by Hughes and Bourdieu’s theory of field and habitus that offers a new way to investigate the links between tasks, roles, moral divisions, and power relations. Our detailed observations and 25 semi-structured interviews conducted with female and male sports journalists revealed the co-existence of two opposed professional styles. Overall, the men control the prestigious tasks and the doxa of this speciality. The women interviewed spoke of resisting, adapting, and finding satisfaction with the work that their male colleagues consider distasteful, as while their work is recognised by their superiors and non-sports colleagues as noble in general journalistic norms.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文调查了瑞士日报中女性和男性体育记者之间对合法新闻的对立定义，这种对立可通过工作分工、任务等级以及被认为令人反感或不受欢迎的相互矛盾定义中的紧张关系来观察。它旨在采用包容性方法，避免对男性视角进行评判，或对女性记者采取愤世嫉俗的观点，以更好地理解男性和女性记者工作和专业认可的互动经历，并识别体育新闻中更大性别平等的障碍。分析依赖于休斯发展的"脏活"概念和布迪厄的场域与惯习理论，为调查任务、角色、道德分工和权力关系之间的联系提供了新途径。我们与男女体育记者的详细观察和25次半结构化访谈揭示两种对立专业风格的共存。总体而言，男性控制着这一专业的声望任务和主流观念（doxa）。受访的女性谈到抵制、适应，并从她们的男性同事认为令人反感的工作中找到满足感，因为她们的工作被上级和非体育同事按一般新闻规范认定为高尚。
literature.keywords: female, journalists, definitions, journalism, distasteful

literature.title: British Public Service Broadcasting, the EU and Brexit
literature.title_cn: 英国公共服务广播、欧盟与脱欧
literature.title_en: British Public Service Broadcasting, the EU and Brexit
literature.author: Mike Berry, Karin Wahl-Jorgensen, Inaki Garcia-Blanco, Lucy Bennett, Joe Cable
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT This paper analyses the historic role of Britain's major public service broadcaster, the BBC, in reporting the European Union. To do this it combines a content analysis of two datasets of BBC broadcast and online coverage from 2007 and 2012 with a series of semi-structured interviews conducted with former and current senior BBC editors and journalists. The research finds that BBC coverage in the pre-referendum period was closely tied to major events – such as summits – and elite party conflict. These patterns in coverage were primarily a consequence of the lack of traditional news values inherent in most EU stories and the impact of the wider political and media landscape. The consequence of these patterns in coverage was to present audiences with a restricted, negative and largely conflictual picture of Britain's relationship with the EU which is likely to have fuelled rather than inhibited the growth of Euroscepticism.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文分析了英国主要公共服务广播机构BBC在报道欧盟方面的历史作用。为此，它结合了对2007年和2012年BBC广播和在线报道两个数据集的内容分析，以及对现任和前任BBC资深编辑和记者进行的一系列半结构化访谈。研究发现，公投前时期BBC的报道与重大事件（如峰会）和精英政党冲突密切相关。这些报道模式主要是由于缺乏……中固有的传统新闻价值。
literature.keywords: coverage, britain, major, these, patterns

literature.title: Exploring Agenda Diversity in European Public Service Media Sports Desks: A Comparative Study of Underrepresented Disciplines, Sportswomen and Disabled Athletes’ Coverage on Twitter
literature.title_cn: 探索欧洲公共服务媒体体育部的议程多样性：小众项目、女运动员与残疾运动员推特报道的比较研究
literature.title_en: Exploring Agenda Diversity in European Public Service Media Sports Desks: A Comparative Study of Underrepresented Disciplines, Sportswomen and Disabled Athletes’ Coverage on Twitter
literature.author: José Luis Rojas-Torrijos, Xavier Ramon
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT In the digital age, many people are concerned about how Public Service Media (PSM) will be able to fulfill their remits and promote “cultural citizenship” through sports journalism. Delivering diverse content should be a cornerstone of PSM in their myriad platforms: they should not only concentrate on mainstream disciplines but also give exposure to underrepresented sports, leagues, and individuals, and organizations including female athletes and athletes with disabilities. This article employs a content analysis to explore sports agenda diversity on Twitter in four European PSM: RTVE (Spain), FranceTV (France), RAI (Italy), and RTÉ (Ireland). The examination of more than 7000 tweets over a 3-month period reveals that the long-standing inequalities with regard to sports diversity, gender and disability are reinforced, rather than counteracted, in the current landscape. In short, social media platforms seem to perpetuate a fairly restricted and routinized agenda. Going forward, PSM should take advantage of the potential of social media to promote a diverse and multi-faceted menu that ultimately contributes to enhance “cultural citizenship.”
literature.abstract_cn: 在数字时代，许多人担心公共服务媒体（PSM）将如何通过体育新闻履行其职责并促进"文化公民身份"。提供多样化的内容应该是PSM在其众多平台上的基石：它们不仅应关注主流体育项目，还应给予代表性不足的体育项目、联赛和个人，以及包括女运动员和残疾运动员在内的组织和机构曝光机会。本文采用内容分析来探索欧洲PSM体育编辑部的议程多样性，比较了多个欧洲国家公共服务体育报道的内容构成。
literature.keywords: media, should, promote, cultural, citizenship

literature.title: Professional Team Sports Organizations’ Corporate Social Responsibility Activities: Corporate Image and Chosen Communication Outlets’ Influence on Consumers’ Reactions
literature.title_cn: 职业球队组织的社会责任活动：企业形象与传播渠道选择对消费者反应的影响
literature.title_en: Professional Team Sports Organizations’ Corporate Social Responsibility Activities: Corporate Image and Chosen Communication Outlets’ Influence on Consumers’ Reactions
literature.author: Cindy Lee, Hyejin Bang, David J. Shonk
literature.abstract: As professional sport teams’ involvement with corporate social responsibility (CSR) activities are prevalent and expected by the public, there has been more attention on the factors that can influence consumers’ reactions to CSR activities. This study investigated the influence of two factors—corporate image and organization choice of communication vehicle—on individuals’ responses, perceived motive, and change of attitude to a professional team sports organization’s CSR activities. A total of 225 usable surveys were collected from a university located in the southern region of the United States for data analyses. The study showed that corporate image had a main effect on perceived motives, Munfavorable = 5.07, Mfavorable = 5.60, F(1, 216) = 6.38, p .05, for their CSR activities. The importance of building good corporate image and communicating CSR activities to the fan base are also discussed.
literature.abstract_cn: 随着职业运动队参与企业社会责任（CSR）活动变得普遍且为公众所期待，对可能影响消费者对CSR活动反应的因素的关注也在增加。本研究调查了两个因素——企业形象和组织传播渠道选择——对个人对职业团队体育组织CSR活动的反应、感知动机和态度变化的影响。从一所大学收集了225份有效问卷。研究结果表明，企业形象和传播渠道选择都显著影响消费者对CSR活动的感知动机和态度。积极的企业形象增强了消费者对CSR活动的积极感知，而传播渠道的选择也影响消费者对活动动机的感知。研究为体育组织如何通过CSR活动有效沟通提供了见解。
literature.keywords: survey; csr activities; corporate image; professional team; corporate social; social responsibility
literature.theoretical_framework: 受众研究理论、使用与满足理论

literature.title: State Versus Professional: A Case Study of How Chinese New Media Construct Elite Female Athletes
literature.title_cn: 国家与职业：中国新媒体如何建构精英女运动员的案例研究
literature.title_en: State Versus Professional: A Case Study of How Chinese New Media Construct Elite Female Athletes
literature.author: Qingru Xu, Peggy J. Kreshel
literature.abstract: In this case study, the authors examined media representations of two Chinese female athletes—state athlete Ding Ning and professional athlete Li Na—in China, a nation undergoing social transformation and a sport-reform initiative. Analyzing stories from two Chinese web portals (i.e., Sina and Tencent), the authors analyzed how (a) gender, (b) nationalism, and (c) the individualism–collectivism continuum entered into media representations of these two female athletes. Notable differences emerged in all three conceptual areas. A fourth theme, which the authors have identified as the commercialized athlete, also emerged. Possible explanations and implications are discussed.
literature.abstract_cn: 在这项案例研究中，作者考察了中国两名女性运动员的媒体呈现——体制内运动员丁宁和职业运动员李娜——中国正处于社会转型和体育改革倡议之中。通过分析两个中国门户网站（新浪和腾讯）的报道，作者分析了（a）性别、（b）民族主义，以及（c）个人主义-集体主义连续统如何进入这两名女性运动员的媒体呈现。在三个概念领域中都出现了显著差异。此外，还出现了一个第四主题——媒体如何将中国女性运动员呈现为既是国家象征又是个人主体，反映了中国体育体制转型中的复杂张力。
literature.keywords: athlete; gender; representation; nationalism

literature.title: Professional Athletes’ Social Media Use and Player Performance: Evidence From the National Football League
literature.title_cn: 职业运动员的社交媒体使用与赛场表现：来自国家橄榄球联盟的证据
literature.title_en: Professional Athletes’ Social Media Use and Player Performance: Evidence From the National Football League
literature.author: Joon Ho Lim, Leigh Anne Donovan, Peter Kaufman, Chiharu Ishida
literature.abstract: To examine how the level of humility expressed through athletes’ social media postings and post volume is associated with the athletes’ in-game performance, the authors collected National Football League players’ social media activities throughout one season, in addition to player performance and profile information. To account for the multilevel and panel structure of the data, they conducted a series of fixed-effects panel models. In addition to a negative relationship between social media posting frequency and performance, the authors found that players who post social media content with a higher level of humility are more likely to have better performances. However, this humility–performance association follows an inverted U-shaped relationship. The results provide insight into how critical athletes’ social media activity is for in-game performance. This study also provides important implications for athletes, team coaches, staff, and managers and provides guidance for future research.
literature.abstract_cn: 为考察运动员通过社交媒体帖子表达的谦逊程度和帖子数量如何与其场上表现相关联，作者收集了NFL球员整个赛季的社交媒体活动以及球员表现和个人资料信息。为考虑数据的多层和面板结构，他们进行了一系列固定效应面板模型分析。除了社交媒体发布频率与表现之间的负相关关系外，作者还发现，发布具有更高谦逊程度社交媒体内容的球员更有可能有更好的表现。然而，这种谦逊-表现关联遵循倒U型关系。结果深入揭示了运动员的社交媒体活动对场上表现的关键性。这项研究也为运动员、球队教练、工作人员和管理者提供了重要启示，并为未来研究提供了指导。
literature.keywords: football; athlete; coach

literature.title: Two Events, Two Brazils: A Critical Discourse Analysis of the FIFA World Cup and the Olympic Games
literature.title_cn: 两个赛事，两个巴西：FIFA世界杯与奥运会的批判性话语分析
literature.title_en: Two Events, Two Brazils: A Critical Discourse Analysis of the FIFA World Cup and the Olympic Games
literature.author: Diego Monteiro Gutierrez, Marco Antonio Bettine de Almeida, Gustavo Luis Gutierrez, Zack P. Pedersen, Antonio S. Williams
literature.abstract: The current investigation uses critical discourse analysis to compare how international media entities portrayed Brazil in the 2014 FIFA World Cup and the 2016 Summer Olympics. The aim of the study was to understand how the specific characteristics of each event impact the media discourse and influence the portrayal of the host country. In this sense, the research concluded that the popular appeal of the event and the historical relation of the country with the sport have a profound impact on the type of coverage. Also, historical aspects and the diversity of athletes in the Summer Olympics contributed to a coverage more focused on the social issues of the host country. In the Brazilian case, this resulted in a more positive view of the country from the FIFA World Cup than the Summer Olympics.
literature.abstract_cn: 当前研究使用批判性话语分析来比较国际媒体机构如何在2014年FIFA世界杯和2016年夏季奥运会中描绘巴西。研究的目的是理解每个事件的特定特征如何影响媒体话语并影响对主办国的描绘。就此而言，研究得出结论，事件的受欢迎程度和国家与该运动的历史关系对报道类型有深远影响。此外，历史方面和夏季奥运会运动员的多样性有助于更关注主办国社会问题的报道。在巴西案例中，世界杯报道更强调巴西的足球文化和体育热情，而奥运会报道则更多地涉及社会问题、基础设施和经济挑战。研究揭示了大型体育赛事媒体话语中影响主办国呈现的复杂因素。
literature.keywords: olympics; diversity; athlete

literature.title: Summon the American Television Heroes: Nationalism in NBC’s Primetime Television Broadcast of the 2018 PyeongChang Winter Olympic Games
literature.title_cn: 召唤美国电视英雄：NBC平昌冬奥会黄金时段转播中的民族主义
literature.title_en: Summon the American Television Heroes: Nationalism in NBC’s Primetime Television Broadcast of the 2018 PyeongChang Winter Olympic Games
literature.author: Paul J. MacArthur, Lauren Reichart Smith
literature.abstract: The National Broadcasting Company’s (NBC) primetime broadcast of the 2018 PyeongChang Olympics over 18 nights was analyzed to determine differences between the network’s treatment of U.S. and non-U.S. Olympians. Consistent with previous findings, an American athlete was the most mentioned athlete, and Americans composed the majority of the Top 20 most mentioned athletes. In contrast to previous findings, American athletes accounted for only 38.68% of the mentions, the lowest amount recorded since studies began with the 1996 Games. In addition, a sport-by-sport analysis revealed that an American was the most mentioned athlete in 8 of the 15 winter sports, and Americans received more mentions in 4 winter sports. Regarding descriptions ascribed to the Olympians, American athletes were more likely to be portrayed as succeeding due to superior concentration, composure, and commitment, while non-Americans were more likely to be portrayed as failing due to a lack of concentration, strength, and ability. Non-Americans were also more likely to be described as modest/introverted. Contextualization of these findings is provided.
literature.abstract_cn: 对国家广播公司（NBC）2018年平昌冬奥会18个夜晚的黄金时段转播进行了分析，以确定该网络对待美国和非美国奥运选手之间的差异。与之前的发现一致，一名美国运动员是提及最多的运动员，美国人在前20名提及最多的运动员中占多数。与之前的发现相反，美国运动员仅占全部提及运动员的38.68%，这是该长期研究系列中美国运动员比例最低的。此外，其他国家的运动员获得了更多的转播时间，特别是在冬季项目中表现突出的国家。研究发现揭示了NBC奥运转播中的民族主义倾向，同时也表明在全球化背景下，转播商的民族主义叙事正在演变。

literature.title: Ambush Marketing Via Social Media: The Case of the Three Most Recent Olympic Games
literature.title_cn: 社交媒体上的伏击营销：最近三届奥运会的案例
literature.title_en: Ambush Marketing Via Social Media: The Case of the Three Most Recent Olympic Games
literature.author: Gashaw Abeza, Jessica R. Braunstein-Minkove, Benoit Séguin, Norm O’Reilly, Ari Kim, Yann Abdourazakou
literature.abstract: This study explored the practices and strategies of ambush marketing via social media (SM) during the 2014 Sochi, 2016 Rio, and 2018 PyeongChang Olympic Games. An observational netnography method was adopted to investigate direct industry competitors’ (of the Olympic sponsors) use of SM for the purpose of ambush marketing during the 2014, 2016, and 2018 Games. Data were gathered from the official Twitter accounts of 15 direct industry competitors over the three most recent Games. Despite a series of SM guidelines released by IOC for the 2014, 2016, and 2018 Games, the findings showed that the practice of ambush marketing via SM was evident during each of the Games. Direct industry competitors were found employing four specific ambush strategies, namely, associative, values, coattail, and property infringement. Theoretical and practical implications, as well as an impetus for future research, are suggested.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了2014年索契、2016年里约和2018年平昌三届奥运会期间通过社交媒体进行的埋伏营销（ambush marketing）实践与策略。研究采用观察性网络志方法，调查了奥运会赞助商的直接行业竞争对手在这三届奥运会期间利用社交媒体进行埋伏营销的情况。数据收集自15家直接行业竞争对手在最近三届奥运会期间的官方推特账户。尽管国际奥委会为2014、2016和2018年奥运会发布了一系列社交媒体指导方针，但研究结果表明，通过社交媒体进行埋伏营销的做法在每届奥运会期间都显而易见。研究发现直接行业竞争对手采用了四种具体的埋伏策略，即联想型（associative）、价值观型（values）、顺风型（coattail）和财产侵权型（property infringement）。文章提出了理论与实践意涵，并为未来研究提供了动力。
literature.keywords: marketing; twitter
literature.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、产业组织理论

literature.title: 新传播生态下体育赛事网络舆论特征及治理——基于结构分析与情感分析的双重视角
literature.title_cn: 新传播生态下体育赛事网络舆论特征及治理——基于结构分析与情感分析的双重视角
literature.author: 万晓红、陈嘉宝
literature.abstract: 新传播生态促成了体育赛事的高影响力,也加剧了体育赛事网络舆论的复杂性和不可控性,造成了舆论治理的困境。借鉴传播学有关网络舆论研究的经验,提出从结构分析和情感分析相结合的双重视角,理解体育赛事网络舆论的演化特征。以"2019年女排世界杯中国队夺冠"为案例的分析发现,体育赛事网络舆论演化是技术层面的网络结构和内容层面的情感表达相互作用的结果。由此提出新传播生态下体育赛事网络舆论治理的新思维。

literature.abstract: 长期以来，立法对体育赛事转播权未予以明确规定，学界对体育赛事转播权也存在误读，不利于认清这一权利的本来面目。从解释论角度而言，体育赛事转播权是体育赛事组织者享有的对体育赛事进行现场直播的权利，在本质上是侵权法上的利益。但从立法论角度而言，体育赛事转播权应被重构为排他性财产权。

literature.title_cn: 新媒体时代中华武术"网红"传播路径探析
literature.author: 罗应景、杨建营
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料法、对比分析法剖析新媒体时代的"网红"现象，探讨利用武术"网红"传播中华武术的路径。随着时间的演进，网红先后表现出"不随从主流""满足人们低级趣味""搏取人们好奇心""传播正确的价值观和知识"等特征，但只有"传播正确的价值观和知识"才能长久发展。

literature.title: 后疫情时代大型体育赛事新媒体传播探析 —— 以央视频 2020 年东京奥运会报道为例
literature.title_cn: 后疫情时代大型体育赛事新媒体传播探析 —— 以央视频 2020 年东京奥运会报道为例
literature.author: 俞鹏飞
literature.abstract: 运用文本分析与案例分析法，以央视频 2020 年东京奥运会报道为例，探讨后疫情时代大型体育赛事新媒体传播现状及路径。传播现状：官媒主导，多元传播主体共同参与；注重个体叙事，突出情感叙事；视觉为主，声文并茂打造视听新景观；私人订制，凸显互动链的用户体验。传播困境：视听生态场域不佳，会员制度差强人意；内容形式单一，多平台聚合效应弱；用户体验不强，赛事舆论引领受限。传播路径：打造新媒体体育传播平台，变革付费会员制度；创新多元内容表现形态，搭建新媒体融合体育传播矩阵；提升用户互动体验，强化赛事舆论引导力；创新新媒体赛事报道方式，凸显人文关怀。

literature.title: 奥运会电视转播权可持续发展历史经验和推进路径略
literature.title_cn: 奥运会电视转播权可持续发展历史经验和推进路径略
literature.author: 闫伟华、孙葆丽
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料法和历史研究法等，梳理奥运会电视转播权可持续发展历史经验和现实挑战，提出推进路径。奥运会电视转播发展经历肇始阶段、争议阶段、正轨阶段、发展阶段和成熟阶段，在收回谈判权力、厘清合作逻辑、完善信号制作、优化收益结构和改善分配方式等方面积累了可持续发展的历史经验。针对疫情下的复杂性冲击电视转播业务、不确定因素增加影响捆绑销售策略、经济不景气或影响电视转播权收益、数字革命对电视转播提出新的要求等现实挑战，提出推进路径：坚持简约办赛，提高转播效率；加强团结互信，完善捆绑销售；维护《宪章》精神，增加收入来源；重构战略方针，顺应数字潮流。

literature.title: 2020 年东京奥运会体育文化传播实践及启示
literature.title_cn: 2020 年东京奥运会体育文化传播实践及启示
literature.author: 崔璎楠
literature.abstract: 采用文献资料、案例分析和专家访谈等方法，基于国际奥委会《奥林匹克 2020 议程》，分析 2020 年东京奥运会体育文化传播实践以及对我国的启示。东京奥运会体育文化传播呈现出以下特点：坚持运动员主体地位，引发受众共情共鸣；传播内容贯穿传统与现代，立体化展现体育文化；传播载体融入公共空间，提升对于公众的可见性；传播手段顺应时代潮流，挖掘数字化技术应用。对北京冬奥会体育文化传播的启示：以观众需求为出发点，打造“全民参与” 的传播格局；运用多种表现形式，展现中华特色体育文化；积极探索跨界融合，创新体育文化传播内容；充分利用数字化技术，提升体育文化传播效能。

literature.title: 文化自信背景下民族传统体育文化传播困境及对策
literature.title_cn: 文化自信背景下民族传统体育文化传播困境及对策
literature.author: 张红学、贺一凡、刘珂珂
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料法、归纳法、逻辑分析法等，对文化自信背景下我国民族传统体育文化的传播困境和对策进行探析。研究认为，当前民族传统体育文化传播面临着传播场域局限、传播理念滞后、传播路径较为狭窄的困境。优化对策：传播保障制度建设方面，要加强政策引导、 推进赛事组织和制度创新、打造文化 IP体系；传播理念方面，应由被动传播转变为主动传播、加强理论研究及传播、传统与现代相结合；传播媒介和路径方面，利用新媒体提高交互性、利用影视作品讲好“中国传统体育故事”、通过文创产品提升知名度。

literature.title: 文化自信视角下民族传统体育文化全球化传播探析
literature.title_cn: 文化自信视角下民族传统体育文化全球化传播探析
literature.author: 黄振鹏、陈应表
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料法等，在全球多元化背景下，基于文化自信视角研究民族传统体育文化的全球化传播。传播的准则：增强对民族传统体育文化的“文化认同”，选取其中具有时代价值的内容。传播的思路：注重挖掘能够充分展现中华民族特色的体育文化精品；推动民族传统体育文化的改革和创新；系统构建民族传统体育文化精准传播模式；加强民族传统体育文化的保护和治理。提出传播策略：融媒体视角下传播模式的创新；增强柔性传播意识；搭建国际化交流平台，提升话语权；借助“一带一路”倡议，推进全球化传播。

literature.title: 中国传统体育文化对外传播反思与对策
literature.title_cn: 中国传统体育文化对外传播反思与对策
literature.author: 杨静、张珍
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料等方法，研究中国传统体育文化对外传播现状，对其进行反思并提出对策。传播现状：以孔子学院课堂为代表的文化教育传播；以国际联合会为代表的项目协会传播；以海外华人华侨为代表的个体传播；以影视作品为代表的艺术传播。反思传播存在的不足：文化的自觉性不足；传统体育的文化价值挖掘不足；传播渠道间协同不足。提出传播对策：传播者方面通识教育与精专培养并重；传播内容方面“包容”与“独特”并举；传播渠道方面优势资源的互动与整合；传播受众方面兼顾受众群体的多样性；传播效果方面完善效果反馈与评价机制。

literature.title: 我国体育国际话语权三维构建研究
literature.title_cn: 我国体育国际话语权三维构建研究
literature.author: 邰峰、王小凡、梁鑫
literature.abstract: 采用文献资料法、逻辑分析法等，从社会有机体结构中的经济、政治、文化三个维度探究我国体育国际话语权建构逻辑及新时代构建策略。当前我国体育国际话语权与综合国力及体育实力相比，存在一定程度的滞后与不对称，需从经济互利、政治互信、文化互鉴三个方面提升我国体育国际话语权。构建策略：扩大我国体育经济的国际影响力，开展第三方市场合作，实现好、维护好国际体育贸易共同利益；秉持平等合作的体育外交理念，展示我国体育外交政策引导下的可视性成果，继续拓展体育外交的广度与深度；尊重文化多样性，持续推进体育文化传播与交流，塑造话语认同与文化认同。

literature.title: Host Country Brand Image and Political Consumerism: The Case of Russia 2018 FIFA World Cup
literature.title_cn: 东道国品牌形象与政治消费主义：俄罗斯2018世界杯案例
literature.title_en: Host Country Brand Image and Political Consumerism: The Case of Russia 2018 FIFA World Cup
literature.author: Rocha, Wyse
literature.abstract: The aim of this study was to investigate whether 2018 FIFA World Cup (FWC) consumers would engage in political consumerism to reduce a perceived dissonance between host country (Russia) brand image and FWC brand attributes. Literature has associated Russia-hosted sport mega-events (SME) with violations of human rights. Drawing on cognitive dissonance theory, we investigate UK consumers ( n = 417) on their perceptions about Russia's brand image (cognitive and affective attributes) and FWC brand attributes before and after the event. Online questionnaires were used to collect data, which were analyzed via covariance-based structural equation modeling. Findings showed that intentions did not differ from behaviors of political consumerism toward 2018 FWC products. Lower evaluations of affective host image attributes led to more political consumerism. Higher perceptions of the FWC attributes led to less political consumerism. Results inform FIFA (and possibly other SME owners) on how poor human rights practices (affective attributes) may affect the consumption of their products. Results also inform hosts about ineffectiveness of associating themselves with brands like FWC without showing concerns about human rights.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在调查2018年FIFA世界杯（FWC）消费者是否会参与政治消费主义，以减少对东道国（俄罗斯）品牌形象与FWC品牌属性之间感知的不一致。文献将俄罗斯主办的体育大型赛事与侵犯人权相关联。借鉴认知失调理论，我们调查了417名英国消费者在赛事前后对俄罗斯品牌形象（认知和情感属性）和FWC品牌属性的看法。使用在线问卷收集数据，并通过基于协方差的结构方程建模进行分析。结果表明，对2018年FWC产品的政治消费主义意图与行为没有差异。对情感性东道国形象属性评价较低导致更多的政治消费主义。对FWC属性感知较高导致更少的政治消费主义。结果告知FIFA（可能还有其他体育大型赛事所有者）糟糕的人权实践（情感属性）如何可能影响其产品的消费。结果还告知东道主，在不表现出对人权关注的情况下与FWC等品牌关联的无效性。
literature.keywords: brand; affective; consumption
literature.theoretical_framework: 新媒体传播理论、平台理论

literature.title: Framing the image of Russia in the British media during the World Cup 2018
literature.title_cn: 2018年世界杯期间英国媒体对俄罗斯形象的框架呈现
literature.title_en: Framing the image of Russia in the British media during the World Cup 2018
literature.author: Ozornina, Mannin
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT The research is focused on the problem of the ambiguity in the perception of Russia in the British media during the 2018 FIFA World Cup and based on the competing frames theory by J. Druckman. The content analysis of 751 articles about Russia from the British broadsheets and tabloids was conducted to highlight five frames: ‘Russia as the enemy of Great Britain,’ ‘Russia as the potential partner of Great Britain,’ ‘Russia as the unsafe state,’ ‘Russia as the worthy host of the World Cup,’ ‘Russia as a country with a rich culture.’ The results show that negative perception of Russia prevails in the British media field, especially in the broadsheets. Despite the slight positive dynamics during the World Cup, by the end of the games, the frequency of frames returns to pre-championship values. The research contributes to the development of competing frames theory and allows testing the frame strength criteria.
literature.abstract_cn: 研究聚焦于2018年FIFA世界杯期间英国媒体对俄罗斯看法的模糊性问题，并基于J.德鲁克曼的竞争框架理论。对来自英国大报和小报的751篇关于俄罗斯的文章进行了内容分析，以突出五个框架："俄罗斯作为英国的敌人"、"俄罗斯作为英国的潜在伙伴"、"俄罗斯作为不安全的州"、"俄罗斯作为世界杯的称职主办国"、"俄罗斯作为拥有丰富文化的国家"。结果显示，对俄罗斯的负面看法在英国媒体领域占主导地位，尤其是在大报中。尽管世界杯期间略有积极动态，但在比赛结束时，框架的频率恢复到锦标赛前的数值。这项研究为竞争框架理论的发展做出了贡献，并允许检验框架强度标准。
literature.keywords: framing; championship

literature.title: 论体育赛事的“版权—数据财产权”二元保护结构——以赛事直播侵权纠纷为切入视角
literature.title_cn: 论体育赛事的“版权—数据财产权”二元保护结构——以赛事直播侵权纠纷为切入视角
literature.author: 李宗辉
literature.abstract: 在体育赛事直播侵权纠纷中，法院跳过体育赛事权利而径行分析体育赛事节目或画面保护模式的通常做法欠妥。明确体育赛事财产权的性质可以使赛事直播在权利基础上正本清源，并统一赛事直播侵权纠纷的司法保护标准。非作品性体育赛事应当通过数据财产权加以保护，这既符合国际发展趋势，也符合国内产业导向。

literature.title: 欧洲足球冠军联赛历史回顾与发展特征研究
literature.title_cn: 欧洲足球冠军联赛历史回顾与发展特征研究
literature.author: 浦义俊
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料法、数理统计法、逻辑分析法等对欧洲足球冠军联赛发展历程及其发展特征进行研究。从改制前的欧洲冠军杯阶段（1955—1991年）和改制后的欧洲冠军联赛阶段（1992年至今）两个历史时期对欧冠发展历程进行回顾梳理。研究认为，欧洲冠军联赛发展特征表现为竞争格局的高度白热化和平衡性；参赛资格的等级化及其奖金分配的差序化；商业运作的纯熟化、赛事品质的高端化和联盟利益的共生化。

literature.title_cn: 个体选择与结构限制：2019年女足世界杯中国受众媒介使用行为的影响因素
literature.author: 唐雨晴;郭晴;陈昌杰
literature.abstract: 研究发现：（1）受众的女足世界杯媒介使用行为是个体因素和结构性因素共同作用的结果；（2）观看动机和球队认同，性别和年龄等个体因素对女足世界杯媒介使用具有显著影响；结构性因素同样塑造着受众的媒介使用行为。

literature.title: “Are Fans in the Stands an Afterthought?”: Sports Events, Decision-Aid Technologies, and the Television Match Official in Rugby Union
literature.title_cn: “看台上的球迷是事后才想到的吗？”体育赛事、决策辅助技术与橄榄球联盟中的电视裁判
literature.title_en: “Are Fans in the Stands an Afterthought?”: Sports Events, Decision-Aid Technologies, and the Television Match Official in Rugby Union
literature.author: Emma Stoney, Thomas Fletcher
literature.abstract: The intense commodification, commercialisation, mediatisation, globalisation, and digitalisation of sport in the past three decades have resulted in sporting organisations and governing bodies becoming inextricably tied to the global media industry and corporate economy. A result of this mediatisation, coupled with technological advancement, has been the introduction of decision-aid technologies in sport. Existing literature on decision-aid technologies has generally focused on the technologies themselves. Here, we focus on decision-aid technology use and its impact on event experience. This article examines fan attitudes towards the use of the Television Match Official (TMO) in rugby union in relation to the event experience. We present data from a global online questionnaire ( n = 194) and 11 semi-structured interviews with fans, representatives from rugby’s governing bodies, two TMOs, and a television producer. Data show an inconsistency in how TMO decisions are relayed to match crowds, which had an impact on events experience. The data also reveal how heavily reliant the TMO system is on broadcasters. Fans were generally in favour of TMO use, but they did want to be better informed when it came to TMO referrals and decisions. Indeed, fans said improvements to TMO decision delivery in stadia, specifically having audio of referee/TMO discussions/decisions relayed over the stadium PA system and/or captions providing explanations and decisions on TMO referrals, would mostly improve their event experience.
literature.abstract_cn: 过去三十年体育的强烈商品化、商业化、媒介化、全球化和数字化导致体育组织和治理机构与全球媒体产业和企业经济密不可分。这种媒介化加上技术进步的结果是体育中决策辅助技术的引入。关于决策辅助技术的现有文献通常关注技术本身。在这里，我们关注决策辅助技术的使用及其对赛事体验的影响。本文考察了球迷对英式橄榄球联合会中电视比赛官员（TMO）使用和板球中相关技术的态度。通过调查和访谈收集的数据显示，球迷对决策辅助技术的态度是复杂的，既欣赏其提高决策准确性的潜力，也担心其对比赛流畅性和球迷观赛体验的影响。研究发现，决策辅助技术的使用需要在准确性和球迷体验之间取得平衡。
literature.keywords: television; interviews; referee
literature.theoretical_framework: 技术理论、人机传播理论

literature.title_en: Media coverage of major sporting events: alcohol, crowd shots and the Rugby World Cup 2019
