literature.title: Stabbed, shot, left to die: Christy Martin and gender-based violence in boxing
literature.title_cn: 被刺、被枪击、被遗弃至死：克里斯蒂·马丁与拳击中的性别暴力
literature.title_en: Stabbed, shot, left to die: Christy Martin and gender-based violence in boxing
literature.author: Cathy van Ingen
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This article presents a biographical narrative of Christy Martin, a former world champion boxer who survived being stabbed and shot by her trainer/husband. Rooted in a sociological imagination, this biographic research chronicles Martin’s boxing career and its entanglements with gender-based violence. The boxing industry has a widely acknowledged, yet under-reported, problem with men’s violence against women. This article aims to illustrate that women’s boxing should be critically examined for the ways in which it functions both as a site of and a sanctuary from gender-based violence. Within this paper, I draw from media coverage of Christy Martin’s boxing career, over 700 pages of transcripts from the subsequent criminal trial, an interview with Martin, as well as my own research in women’s boxing, including work with survivors of domestic violence.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文呈现了克里斯蒂·马丁的传记叙事，她是一位前世界冠军拳击手，在被其教练/丈夫刺伤和枪击后幸存。植根于社会学想象力，这项传记研究记录了马丁的拳击生涯及其与基于性别的暴力的纠葛。拳击行业有一个被广泛承认但报告不足的问题，即男性对女性的暴力。本文旨在说明女子拳击应被批判性地审视，考察它如何同时作为暴力的场所和对暴力的抵抗。马丁的故事揭示了体育行业中性别暴力如何在运动员职业和个人生活中交织，以及体育文化如何忽视或掩盖这种暴力。研究呼吁体育组织和行业采取更积极的方式处理运动员中的性别暴力。
literature.keywords: gender; career
literature.theoretical_framework: 新闻社会学、性别理论、叙事理论

literature.title: A Good Fight: How Indigenous Women Approach Boxing as a Mechanism for Social Change
literature.title_cn: 一场好斗：原住民女性如何将拳击作为社会变革的机制
literature.title_en: A Good Fight: How Indigenous Women Approach Boxing as a Mechanism for Social Change
literature.author: MacIntosh Ross, Janice Forsyth
literature.source_name: Journal of Sport and Social Issues
literature.abstract: This article examines the experiences of select Indigenous female boxers from Canada and the United States to explore and appreciate the diverse meanings they attach to amateur and professional boxing and to write these athletes into history by constructing short case studies of fighters active from the 1970s through the 2010s. We augment each fighter’s story with context from scholarly and secondary source materials, such as newspapers, to round out each woman’s story and to illustrate the multiple overlapping conditions that shaped their boxing experiences. We embrace the work of van Ingen on the importance of understanding female boxers at the intersection of race and gender. In doing so, our work emphasizes the ideological foundations embedded in narratives, so that each narrative presents a certain point of view that results in real practical effects, whether it be supporting White liberal feminism or Indigenous self-determination. Following van Ingen, this article views all writing, whether by journalists or professional historians, as ideological acts, capable of exalting select athletes while marginalizing others.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文考察了加拿大和美国特定原住民女性拳击手的经历，以探索和欣赏她们赋予业余和专业拳击的多样意义，并通过构建1970年代至2010年代活跃拳击手的简短视频案例研究，将这些运动员写入历史。我们用学术和二手来源材料（如报纸）补充每位拳击手的故事，以充实每位女性的故事，并说明塑造她们拳击经历的多重重叠条件。分析揭示了原住民女性如何利用拳击作为社会变革的机制，在性别和种族歧视中寻求力量和自主权。研究为理解体育如何成为边缘化群体赋权工具提供了见解。
literature.keywords: gender; race; athlete; source

literature.title: Cricket has no boundaries with NatWest? The hyperreality of inclusion and diversity in English cricket
literature.title_cn: 板球与NatWest无边界吗？英格兰板球中包容与多元的超现实
literature.title_en: Cricket has no boundaries with NatWest? The hyperreality of inclusion and diversity in English cricket
literature.author: Ben Powis, Philippa Velija
literature.abstract: Abstract In this article, we examine England and Wales Cricket Board’s relationship with NatWest Bank and analyse its award-winning sponsorship campaign Cricket Has No Boundaries (CHNB). Drawing upon Jean Baudrillard’s concepts of the hyperreal and the non-event, we explore how CHNB presents an idealised image of English cricket. At the heart of this campaign is NatWest’s desire to demonstrate their commitment to inclusion and diversity through the lens of modern cricket, but what does this tell us about the ‘value’ of cricket in our neoliberal age? Using critical discourse analysis and semiotic analysis, we critique the campaign’s mediated content—advertisements, newspaper articles and short documentaries—and examine the role of commodities, signs and media messages in shaping CHNB’s hyperreal version of cricket. We also reflect upon the growth of corporate social responsibility in sport and discuss how brands exploit athletes’ lived experiences for financial gain.
literature.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们考察了英格兰和威尔士板球委员会与NatWest银行的关系，并分析了其获奖赞助活动"板球无边界"（CHNB）。借鉴让·鲍德里亚的超现实和非事件概念，我们探讨CHNB如何呈现英格兰板球的理想化形象。这一活动的核心是NatWest希望通过现代板球的视角展示其对包容和多样性的承诺，但这告诉我们在新自由主义时代板球的"价值"是什么？使用批判性话语分析和符号学分析，我们批判了该活动的媒介化内容——广告、报纸文章和短片纪录片——并考察了商品、符号和媒体信息在塑造CHNB超现实板球版本中的作用。我们还反思了体育中企业社会责任的增长，并讨论了品牌如何利用运动员的生活经历谋取经济利益。
literature.keywords: inclusion; diversity; sponsorship; brand; athlete

literature.title: The Face of Mental Health: Kevin Love and Hegemonic Masculinity in the NBA
literature.title_cn: 心理健康的代言人：凯文·乐福与NBA中的霸权男性气质
literature.title_en: The Face of Mental Health: Kevin Love and Hegemonic Masculinity in the NBA
literature.author: Katherine L. Lavelle
literature.abstract: While public discussion about mental illness has become increasingly common in the United States, previous research has found that having a mental illness diagnosis is assumed to be incompatible with elite athletic success. As explored in hegemonic masculinity scholarship, to be successful, professional male athletes attempt to physically dominate opponents. In 2018, National Basketball Association (NBA) star Kevin Love disclosed having a panic attack during a game as well as living with depression and anxiety. While Love was not the only NBA player to publicly come forward to discuss their mental health experiences, Love is a successful White player in a league where 73.9% of players self-identify as Black or African American. His social location connects his public health discussion to existing scholarship on whiteness, hegemonic masculinity, and mental illness. Love was praised for his willingness to speak about his personal experiences and provide support for others. However, through a critical discourse analysis of sports media coverage of Love’s disclosure and subsequent mental health advocacy, this study reveals that his public discussion was constructed in terms of his identity as a White athlete and constrained by expectations of hegemonic masculinity.
literature.abstract_cn: 虽然美国公众关于精神疾病的讨论日益普遍，但先前研究发现，患有精神疾病诊断被假定与精英运动成功不兼容。正如霸权男性气质学术研究所探讨的，要成功，职业男运动员试图在身体上支配对手。2018年，NBA球星凯文·乐福公开披露了比赛中的恐慌发作以及患有抑郁和焦虑。虽然乐福不是唯一公开讨论其心理健康经历的NBA球员，但乐福是一名在73.9%的球员自我认同为非白人的联盟中取得成功的白人球员。本文考察了体育媒体如何框架化乐福的心理健康披露，以及这种框架如何与NBA中的霸权男性气质相交汇。分析揭示了乐福的心理健康叙事如何挑战和强化运动中的男性气质规范，以及体育文化中精神疾病去污名化的进程。
literature.keywords: masculinity; nba; basketball; anxiety; athlete
literature.theoretical_framework: 性别理论、话语分析理论

literature.title: Royce White, DeMar DeRozan and Media Framing of Mental Health in the NBA
literature.title_cn: 罗伊斯·怀特、德玛尔·德罗赞与NBA中心理健康的媒体框架
literature.title_en: Royce White, DeMar DeRozan and Media Framing of Mental Health in the NBA
literature.author: David Cassilo
literature.abstract: This study analyzed media framing of two players from the National Basketball Association (NBA), Royce White and DeMar DeRozan, who both publicly addressed their mental health concerns within the last decade. Due to societal stigmas, such a public conversation was once a rarity in the NBA, making their discussion of mental health a worthy area of examination. A media framing analysis of 58 press articles for White and 42 articles for DeRozan revealed six frames for each athlete used to discuss their situation. Despite both being African American athletes playing the same sport, they were covered differently. Analysis discovered that frames for White, a first-year player who wanted changes in the system of how the NBA handled mental health, most commonly focused on him and his specific situation, while frames for DeRozan, an NBA All-Star who positioned himself solely as an advocate, most frequently discussed shedding the stigma of mental health and the increased awareness surrounding the topic. Additionally, while there were frames critical of White, there were no such frames for DeRozan. Still, for both players, this type of coverage humanizes the experience of mental health and leads to important insights about changes in masculinity among athletes.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了NBA两名球员罗伊斯·怀特和德玛尔·德罗赞的媒体框架，他们都在过去十年中公开谈及心理健康问题。由于社会污名，这种公开对话在NBA曾经是罕见的，使他们对心理健康的讨论成为值得研究的领域。对怀特的58篇新闻文章和德罗赞的42篇文章进行了媒体框架分析。分析揭示了媒体如何框架化这些运动员的心理健康披露，包括英雄化、正常化或质疑运动员经历的方式。研究发现，媒体框架既有助于减少心理健康污名，也可能通过将运动员的心理健康问题个人化而忽视系统性问题。研究为理解体育文化中心理健康话语的媒体建构提供了见解。
literature.keywords: framing; nba; masculinity; basketball; athlete

literature.title: Talking Baseball When There Is No Baseball: Reporters and Fans During the COVID-19 Pandemic
literature.title_cn: 在没有棒球时谈论棒球：新冠疫情期间的记者与球迷
literature.title_en: Talking Baseball When There Is No Baseball: Reporters and Fans During the COVID-19 Pandemic
literature.author: Alexander L. Curry, Tiara Good
literature.abstract: The 2020 coronavirus outbreak led Major League Baseball to cancel spring training and postpone the start of the regular season. Although baseball stopped, reporters continued to write about baseball, and fans continued to talk about baseball. But with no games being played, what were they writing and talking about? More than a simple examination of what these two groups are saying, the authors also examined why their focus has turned to particular topics and themes. Through a textual analysis of Entertainment and Sports Programming Network (ESPN) baseball headlines and Reddit posts, the authors found writers jolted out of their routines, yet still framing many of their 2020 stories to focus on the actions of players. For fans, they uncovered conversations that, in many ways, read like friends mourning the loss of a loved one.
literature.abstract_cn: 2020年冠状病毒爆发导致美国职业棒球大联盟取消春训并推迟常规赛季的开始。虽然棒球停止了，但记者继续撰写关于棒球的内容，球迷继续谈论棒球。但在没有比赛的情况下，他们在写什么和谈论什么？除了简单考察这两个群体在说什么之外，作者还考察了为什么他们的焦点转向特定的话题和主题。通过娱乐与体育节目网（ESPN）棒球标题和Reddit帖子的文本分析，作者发现撰稿人被打乱了常规，但仍将2020年的许多故事框架聚焦于球员的行动。对于球迷，他们发现了在许多方面读起来像朋友哀悼失去亲人的对话。
literature.keywords: reporter; pandemic; covid; framing

literature.title: The Show Must Go On: The Strategy and Spectacle of Dana White’s Efforts to Promote UFC 249 During the Coronavirus Pandemic
literature.title_cn: 演出必须继续：新冠疫情期间达纳·怀特推动UFC 249的策略与奇观
literature.title_en: The Show Must Go On: The Strategy and Spectacle of Dana White’s Efforts to Promote UFC 249 During the Coronavirus Pandemic
literature.author: Ted M. Butryn, Matthew A. Masucci, jay a. johnson
literature.abstract: While most professional sports quickly postponed their seasons due to COVID-19, the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) took a decidedly contrarian approach as president Dana White continued to promote UFC 249 until pressure forced its cancelation on April 9, 2020. Drawing from work on sport and spectacle and the media as well as sport management scholarship on crisis management, the authors provide a commentary on the mediated spectacle of White’s (eventually successful) efforts to promote UFC 249 during the pandemic. Drawing from numerous media sources, they discuss how White sought to control the public narrative in several key ways. The authors further explore how White decried the seriousness of the pandemic while centralizing the UFC’s place in the U.S. sporting landscape. Finally, the authors discuss how White’s efforts might both help and hinder the UFC as a mainstream sports promotion.
literature.abstract_cn: 虽然大多数职业体育因COVID-19迅速推迟了赛季，但终极格斗冠军赛（UFC）采取了截然相反的立场，总裁达纳·怀特继续推广UFC 249，直到压力迫使其于2020年4月9日取消。借鉴体育和奇观以及媒体、体育管理危机管理学术的成果，作者对怀特在疫情期间推广UFC 249（最终成功）努力的媒介化奇观提供了评论。借鉴众多媒体来源，他们讨论了怀特如何以几种关键方式寻求控制公共叙事。作者进一步探讨了怀特如何贬低疫情的严重性，同时将UFC置于美国体育格局的中心。最后，作者讨论了怀特的努力如何既可能帮助又可能阻碍UFC作为主流体育推广。
literature.keywords: pandemic; championship; covid; source
literature.theoretical_framework: 叙事理论、危机传播理论

literature.title: The 2018 World Cup in Russia and Its Regimes of Visibility: The Cases of Nizhny Novgorod and Kazan
literature.title_cn: 2018年俄罗斯世界杯及其可见性体制：下诺夫哥罗德与喀山案例
literature.title_en: The 2018 World Cup in Russia and Its Regimes of Visibility: The Cases of Nizhny Novgorod and Kazan
literature.author: Andrey Makarychev, Alexandra Yatsyk
literature.source_name: Journal of Sport and Social Issues
literature.abstract: The article addresses visualizations of the 2018 FIFA World Cup in Russian and international digital media. Drawing on the scholarship on discoursive hegemony, the authors intoduce a concept of hegemonic regime of visibility as a general frame for understanding the dominant ways of visualizing mega-events which comprise elements of attractiveness and enjoyment, on one hand, and surveillance, control, and security, on the other. Based on the cases of Nizhny Novgorod and Kazan, the authors argue, first, that the 2018 World Cup’s hegemonic regime of visibility, co-administered by FIFA and Russian government, implied a hierarchy of performative roles prescribed to the host cities as major promoters of the event. Second, local authorities in Russia used this regime for self-(re)branding to advertise the cities/regions as parts of the global world and authentically specific spaces with unique folkloric and ethnic traditions. Third, the FIFA hegemonic regime of visibility was challenged by alternative incursions that destabilized and infused new meanings in the dominant visual order.
literature.abstract_cn: 文章探讨了2018年FIFA世界杯在俄罗斯和国际数字媒体中的可视化。借鉴话语霸权学术研究，作者引入了霸权可见性体制的概念，作为理解大型赛事主导可视化方式的总体框架，该框架一方面包含吸引力和愉悦元素，另一方面包含监视、控制和安保。基于下诺夫哥罗德和喀山的案例，作者认为：第一，2018年世界杯的霸权可见性体制由FIFA和俄罗斯政府共同管理，意味着为作为赛事主要推动者的主办城市规定了表演角色的等级制度。第二，俄罗斯地方政府利用这一体制进行自我（重新）品牌化，将城市/地区宣传为全球世界的一部分和具有独特民俗和民族传统的真实特定空间。第三，FIFA的霸权可见性体制受到替代性闯入的挑战，这些闯入使主导视觉秩序不稳定并注入了新意义。
literature.keywords: visualization; branding; brand
literature.theoretical_framework: 新媒体传播理论、平台理论

literature.title: Football Without Football: Creativity in German Football Coverage by TV Broadcasters and Clubs During the Coronavirus Crisis
literature.title_cn: 无足球的足球：新冠危机期间电视转播机构与俱乐部德国足球报道中的创意
literature.title_en: Football Without Football: Creativity in German Football Coverage by TV Broadcasters and Clubs During the Coronavirus Crisis
literature.author: Christiana Schallhorn, Jessica Kunert
literature.abstract: During the COVID-19 pandemic, TV broadcasters and clubs were challenged to provide alternative formats and content for fans of Germany’s favorite sport, football [soccer]. Thus, they emulated matchdays and created a Bundesliga feeling in new ways. The authors focus on this alternative creative sports coverage during the Coronavirus crisis and consider the effect on the audience. TV broadcasters, for instance, recreated Bundesliga matchdays through broadcasting historical matches, sticking with the original fixtures from before the crisis, while offering renewed commentary. Clubs conducted the Bundesliga Home Challenge, that is, FIFA20 videogame matches with their professional and eSport players, covering these matches on Twitter and their website. The authors argue that these efforts of keeping up the beloved structure of daily sports events satisfy social and entertaining belongings that are normally continually recreated through watching and talking about live sports events. Moreover, they discuss the possible sustainability of these innovative ways of sport communication.
literature.abstract_cn: 在COVID-19疫情期间，电视广播商和俱乐部面临为德国最受欢迎的运动——足球迷提供替代格式和内容的挑战。因此，他们模拟比赛日并以新的方式创造了德甲氛围。作者关注了新冠危机期间这种替代性创意体育报道，并考虑了其对受众的影响。例如，电视广播商通过转播历史比赛重现德甲比赛日，坚持赛前原始赛程，同时提供更新的解说。俱乐部开展了德甲主场挑战赛，即他们的职业和电竞选手进行FIFA20视频游戏比赛，在推特和网站上报道这些比赛。作者认为，这些保持日常体育赛事喜爱结构的努力满足了通常通过观看和谈论直播体育赛事持续创造的社会和娱乐归属感。此外，他们讨论了这些创新体育传播方式可能的可持续性。
literature.keywords: football; audience; broadcasting; twitter; soccer; pandemic
literature.theoretical_framework: 受众研究理论、危机传播理论

literature.title: 体育新闻在今日头条各类产品中的传播特点初探
literature.title_cn: 体育新闻在今日头条各类产品中的传播特点初探
literature.author: 杜锐
literature.abstract: 本文旨在通过研究体育新闻在今日头条各款媒体产品中的传播特点，找到未来传统媒体工作者以及体育记者应对新型媒体平台，特别是针对“算法推荐”这一新兴媒体传播技术手段的方法，以及其自身所应该做出的应对和对未来趋势的把控。
literature.abstract_cn: 本文旨在通过研究体育新闻在今日头条各款媒体产品中的传播特点，找到未来传统媒体工作者以及体育记者应对新型媒体平台，特别是针对“算法推荐”这一新兴媒体传播技术手段的方法，以及其自身所应该做出的应对和对未来趋势的把控。
literature.keywords: 体育新闻,今日头条,传播特点
literature.keywords_cn: 体育新闻,今日头条,传播特点
literature.theoretical_framework: 新媒体传播理论、平台理论

literature.title: Towards a “Digital” Sports Journalism: Field Theory, Changing Boundaries and Evolving Technologies
literature.title_cn: 迈向“数字”体育新闻：场域理论、边界的变迁与技术的演进
literature.title_en: Towards a “Digital” Sports Journalism: Field Theory, Changing Boundaries and Evolving Technologies
literature.author: Gregory Perreault, Travis R. Bell
literature.abstract: Long trivialized as the “toy department,” sports journalism nevertheless represents an enduring, and vital subfield within journalism. As with many niches of journalism, sports journalism has needed to adjust to changes resulting from the technology of the field. In particular, digital sports journalism faces pressure from adjacent fields, represented in team and player media, which perform many of the same tasks historically attributed to sports journalism. Through the lens of field theory, the present study reports on long-form interviews with 47 sports journalists who self-defined their work as digital journalism. This study argues that the perception of insurgents—team media that prior research demonstrated is often seen as a part of the field—has caused digital sports journalists to view their work as economically vital to the individual newsroom, but not topically essential to the journalistic field at large.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育新闻长期被贬称为"玩具部门"，但它仍然是新闻业中持久且至关重要的小领域。与新闻业的许多细分领域一样，体育新闻需要适应该领域技术带来的变化。特别是，数字体育新闻面临来自相邻领域的压力，这些压力体现在球队和球员媒体上，它们承担了许多历史上属于体育新闻的任务。通过场域理论的视角，本研究报告了对47名自我定义为数字新闻工作者的体育记者的长篇访谈。研究认为，对"叛乱者"（即先前研究表明常被视为该领域一部分的球队媒体）的感知，使数字体育记者将其工作视为对个体编辑部经济上至关重要，但对整个新闻场域而言并非主题上必不可少。
literature.keywords: interviews; newsroom

literature.title: Media Representations as a Form of Stacking: Male and Female Athletes Featured on Men’s Magazine Covers, 1980–2019
literature.title_cn: 作为位置化形式的媒体呈现：1980-2019年男性杂志封面上的男女运动员
literature.title_en: Media Representations as a Form of Stacking: Male and Female Athletes Featured on Men’s Magazine Covers, 1980–2019
literature.author: Bryan E. Denham
literature.abstract: This study analyzed 264 athlete images featured on the covers of nine men’s magazines across a 40-year period, 1980–2019. Among males, who accounted for 227 (81%) of the 264 athletes, African Americans and Latinos each represented 6 sports, most of which involved team competition, while White males represented 21 sports, many of which were individual. Analyses of position stacking in football showed White players in positions considered “central” to contest outcomes and Black athletes assigned to more “peripheral” roles. Among females, nearly all of whom were White, more than one in three participated in professional wrestling or sports entertainment. Other female athletes represented individual sports such as tennis and swimming. Overall, the study concludes that men’s magazines reproduced stacking patterns observed in earlier research.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了1980年至2019年40年间九本男性杂志封面上264名运动员的形象。在男性中（占264名运动员中的227名，即81%），非裔美国人和拉丁裔各代表6项运动，其中大部分涉及团队竞争，而白人男性代表21项运动，其中许多是个人项目。对足球中位置堆叠的分析显示，白人球员占据被认为对比赛结果"核心"的位置，而黑人运动员被分配到更"边缘"的角色。在女性中，几乎所有的运动员都是白人，并且在杂志封面上的代表性有限。研究发现揭示了男性杂志封面中运动员呈现的种族和性别堆叠模式，反映了体育媒体中持续的种族和性别不平等。
literature.keywords: representation; athlete; football; tennis
literature.theoretical_framework: 性别理论、女性主义传播理论

literature.title: News Routines in the TV Sports Department: Shifting Expectations and Technology in an Increasingly Digital Landscape
literature.title_cn: 电视体育部的新闻常规：日益数字化环境中期望与技术的变迁
literature.title_en: News Routines in the TV Sports Department: Shifting Expectations and Technology in an Increasingly Digital Landscape
literature.author: Timothy Mirabito, John Collett, Danielle Pluchinsky
literature.abstract: The sports departments in local television news stations across the United States are transforming with the shifting contemporary trends implemented industry wide. Some departments are contracting, others are moving their content to web-only, while others are simply trying to sustain themselves in modern ways. The purpose of this study was to examine how current local sports television journalists addressed the changing marketplace and what impact the procedural and technological changes had on the stories they delivered. Researchers conducted 30 semistructured interviews with current sports media practitioners who worked in newsrooms throughout the United States. The findings of this study rendered four themes, which cumulatively suggest local sports media practitioners are facing varied engagements with job satisfaction and productivity based on their adaptability with shifting expectations. The themes were underscored by the influence of a move to digital first as an industry standard, while specifically examining how social media influences behavior and engagement. The study concludes that, while there are pervasive traditional constraints on journalists, there are also more recent challenges that created complexities in the exchange of information.
literature.abstract_cn: 美国各地地方电视新闻台的体育部门正随着全行业实施的当代趋势转型。一些部门在收缩，另一些将内容转移到纯网络，还有一些正试图以现代方式维持自身。本研究的目的是考察当前地方体育电视记者如何应对变化的市场，以及流程和技术变革对其报道的故事产生的影响。研究人员对美国各地新闻编辑室的30名现任体育媒体从业者进行了半结构化访谈。研究结果得出四个主题，累计表明地方体育媒体从业者正因对变化期望的适应能力而面临不同的工作满意度和生产力水平。这些主题以"数字优先"成为行业标准的影响为基础，同时具体考察社交媒体如何影响行为和参与度。研究结论认为，尽管记者面临普遍的传统约束，但也存在更新的挑战，这些挑战使信息交换变得更加复杂。
literature.keywords: television; interviews; engagement; newsroom
literature.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、产业组织理论

literature.title: The Gender of Sports News: Horizontal Segregation and Marginalization of Female Journalists in the Swiss Press
literature.title_cn: 体育新闻的性别：瑞士报刊中女记者的水平隔离与边缘化
literature.title_en: The Gender of Sports News: Horizontal Segregation and Marginalization of Female Journalists in the Swiss Press
literature.author: Lucie Schoch
literature.abstract: This study analyzes the allocation of sport news among female and male journalists in the francophone Swiss daily press. Relying on both quantitative content analysis and qualitative data collected through interviews with female and male sports journalists, it identifies a horizontal segregation within sports newsrooms. An overwhelmingly greater number of male journalists cover the most prestigious subjects and produce greater numbers of technical match reports, taking on what are considered to be the “hardest” news stories. Women are restricted to covering less prestigious sports, women’s sports, and tend to be allocated “soft” stories to report. This article undertakes an in-depth discussion of the gendered nature of this task allocation, exploring the way it affects female and male journalists’ careers.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了法语瑞士日报中男女记者之间的体育新闻分配。依靠定量内容分析和通过男女体育记者访谈收集的定性数据，研究识别了体育新闻编辑室内存在横向隔离。绝大多数男记者报道最受尊敬的主题，并产出更多的技术性比赛报告，承担被认为是"最硬"的新闻报道。女性则被限制在较轻松或辅助性的体育报道角色中。这种横向隔离反映了体育新闻编辑室中持续的性别不平等，并可能影响体育新闻内容的质量和多样性。研究为理解体育新闻中性别不平等提供了一种欧洲视角。
literature.keywords: gender; qualitative; quantitative; interviews; newsroom; career

literature.title: A Summer Country’s Coverage of a Winter Event: Australian Nationalistic Broadcast Focus of the 2018 Winter Olympic Games
literature.title_cn: 夏季国家报道冬季赛事：澳大利亚对2018冬奥会的民族主义转播重点
literature.title_en: A Summer Country’s Coverage of a Winter Event: Australian Nationalistic Broadcast Focus of the 2018 Winter Olympic Games
literature.author: Olan Scott, Bo (Norman) Li, Stephen Mighton
literature.abstract: Broadcast commentary of sport programs often is seen as biased for the “home team.” This study sought to determine differences between how the media framed narratives of Australian and non-Australian Olympians by analyzing prime-time coverage of the 2018 PyeongChang Winter Olympic Games across all of Australia’s Seven Network channels. Because Australia is not a traditional powerhouse at the Winter Games, how the media portrays home team and foreign athletes is of interest in this summer sport country. Results revealed that overall, non-Australian athletes were covered and mentioned more frequently than Australian athletes. However, results found taxonomical differences in Seven Network’s depiction of Australian and non-Australian athletes’ successes—Australian success was attributed to athletic ability and courage, whereas non-Australians’ success was more frequently linked to intelligence, experience, and consonance. Differences in the attribution of failure by nationality were also found, with Australian’s failures more likely to be characterized by a lack of commitment and luck compared to their non-Australian counterparts. Athletes’ personalities also were described differently, with Australians receiving comments regarding their emotions, while non-Australians received either more neutral comments or had their appearance and body parts described more often. Theoretical and practical implications of this study are provided.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育节目的广播解说常被视为偏向"主队"。本研究旨在通过分析澳大利亚七号网络所有频道对2018年平昌冬奥会的黄金时段报道，确定媒体如何框架澳大利亚和非澳大利亚奥运选手的叙事差异。由于澳大利亚不是冬奥会的传统强国，这个夏季运动国家如何描绘主队和外国运动员值得关注。结果表明，总体上非澳大利亚运动员被报道和提及的频率高于澳大利亚运动员。然而，研究发现在七号网络对澳大利亚和非澳大利亚运动员成功的描绘上存在分类学差异——澳大利亚的成功被归因于运动能力和勇气，而非澳大利亚人的成功更常与智慧、经验和一致性相关联。在失败归因方面也发现了国籍差异，与外国选手相比，澳大利亚人的失败更可能被描述为缺乏承诺和运气。运动员的个性也被不同地描述，澳大利亚人收到关于他们情感的评论，而非澳大利亚人则收到更中性的评论，或者他们的外表和身体部位被更频繁地描述。研究提供了理论与实践的启示。
literature.keywords: bias; athlete; emotion

literature.title: Shared Space: How North American Olympic Broadcasters Framed Gender on Instagram
literature.title_cn: 共享空间：北美奥运转播机构如何在Instagram上框架呈现性别
literature.title_en: Shared Space: How North American Olympic Broadcasters Framed Gender on Instagram
literature.author: Rich G. Johnson, Miles Romney, Kevin Hull, Ann Pegoraro
literature.abstract: The Olympic Games offer scholars the opportunity to better understand how broadcasters visually frame male and female athletes to their large audiences. Traditionally, scholars have focused their efforts on the televised Olympic broadcasts and photojournalism coverage in newspaper and magazines. Scholarship has historically found that female athletes were underrepresented in event coverage and framed along gender stereotypes; however, in more recent Olympic Games, research has shown the news media has provided more equitable coverage between the genders. Yet digital and social media platforms (SMPs) play a significantly larger role in how Olympic broadcasters share content and engage with audiences. Utilizing media framing theory, this study examines how gender is framed on the Olympic Instagram accounts of the two official North American rights holders: the National Broadcasting Corporation (NBC) and the Canadian Broadcasting Corporation (CBC). Researchers collected a cross-sectional sample from the 2016 Summer Games in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, and the 2018 Winter Games in Pyeongchang, South Korea. Results indicate that NBC and CBC were generally equitable in SMP coverage of men’s and women’s athletic achievements.
literature.abstract_cn: 奥运会为学者提供了更好的理解机会，了解广播商如何向其庞大受众视觉框架化男性和女性运动员。传统上，学者们专注于电视奥运转播以及报纸和杂志中的新闻摄影报道。学术研究历来发现女运动员在赛事报道中代表不足，并被沿性别刻板印象框架化；然而在最近的奥运会中，研究表明新闻媒体在性别之间提供了更公平的报道。然而，数字和社交媒体平台（SMPs）在奥运广播商分享内容和与受众互动方面发挥着越来越重要的作用。本研究运用媒体框架理论，考察了两个北美官方持权转播商的奥运Instagram账户——国家广播公司（NBC）和加拿大广播公司（CBC）——如何框架化性别。研究人员收集了2016年巴西里约夏季奥运会和2018年韩国平昌冬季奥运会的横断面样本。结果表明，NBC和CBC在男女运动员运动成就的SMP报道中总体上是公平的。
literature.keywords: gender; instagram; framing; audience; broadcasting; stereotype
literature.theoretical_framework: 框架理论、性别理论、平台理论

literature.title: Five Rings, Five Screens? A Global Examination of Social TV Influence on Social Presence and Social Identification During the 2018 Winter Olympic Games
literature.title_cn: 五环五屏？2018冬奥会期间社交电视对社会临场感与社会认同影响的全球考察
literature.title_en: Five Rings, Five Screens? A Global Examination of Social TV Influence on Social Presence and Social Identification During the 2018 Winter Olympic Games
literature.author: Natalie Brown-Devlin, Michael B. Devlin, Andrew C. Billings, Kenon A. Brown
literature.abstract: This study uses social presence theory and social identity theory as theoretical frameworks to examine global social TV usage during a mega-sporting event. A total of 2,296 people from six different nations (Canada, China, Germany, Japan, Sweden, and the United States) were surveyed about their social TV usage, degree of social presence, and team identification in the week following the 2018 Winter Olympics in PyeongChang, South Korea. Primary findings illustrate that increased social TV use predicts increased measures of social presence, social capital, and perceived sociability, which then influences one’s identification with their national team and Winter Olympics fandom. Additional insights are found regarding global social TV engagement and ancillary device usage habits.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究以社会临场感理论和社会认同理论为理论框架，考察大型体育赛事期间全球社交电视的使用情况。在2018年韩国平昌冬奥会后的那一周，调查了来自六个不同国家（加拿大、中国、德国、日本、瑞典和美国）的2,296人关于他们的社交电视使用、社会临场感程度和团队认同。主要发现表明，社交电视使用的增加预测了社会临场感、社会资本和感知社交性的增加，进而影响个人对其国家队和冬奥粉丝身份的认同。研究发现揭示了社交电视如何在大型体育赛事期间促进社会连接和粉丝参与，以及这些效果如何因国家和文化而异。
literature.keywords: fandom; olympics; survey; engagement
literature.theoretical_framework: 国际传播理论、软实力理论

literature.title: Taegeuk Warriors with Blue Eyes: A Media Discourse Analysis of the South Korean Men’s Olympic Ice Hockey Team and Its Naturalized Athletes
literature.title_cn: 蓝眼睛的太极勇士：韩国男子奥运冰球队及其归化运动员的媒体话语分析
literature.title_en: Taegeuk Warriors with Blue Eyes: A Media Discourse Analysis of the South Korean Men’s Olympic Ice Hockey Team and Its Naturalized Athletes
literature.author: NaRi Shin, DooJae Park, Jon Welty Peachey
literature.abstract: This study examines media discourses of the naturalized athletes of the South Korean men’s national ice hockey team. Building on the conceptual frameworks of imagined community, ethnic nationalism, and previous studies on athlete migration and naturalization, we further an understanding of the process of deconstruction and reconstruction of South Korean ethnic and national identity. We use Fairclough’s critical discourse analysis to explore how South Korean media legitimized the naturalization of foreign athletes without Korean ancestry and suggest three themes found from the discourses. First, the discourses highlighted the significance of the South Korean team’s Olympic success, which provided a legitimate reason for the recruitment of foreign athletes. Second, the naturalized athletes were described as “saviors” who possessed superior careers, physicality, and playing skills. Lastly, the media complimented the naturalized athletes’ acculturation to Korean culture by emphasizing their commitment to the nation. We argue that by forming and distributing discourses that favored the naturalization of athletes, Koreans have expanded the boundary of Koreanness. We discuss, then, the expansion of Koreanness in relation to the notion of flexible citizenship in the era of neoliberal globalization.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了韩国男子国家冰球队归化运动员的媒体话语。在想象社区、族群民族主义和运动员迁移与归化研究的概念框架基础上，我们进一步理解了韩国族群和民族认同的解构和重构过程。我们使用费尔克劳的批判性话语分析来探索韩国媒体如何使没有韩国血统的外国运动员的归化合法化，并提出了从话语中发现的三个主题。首先，话语强调韩国队奥运成功的重要性，这为归化提供了理由。其次，话语将归化运动员构建为"蓝眼睛的太极勇士"，将外国运动员融入韩国民族叙事。第三，话语在接纳归化运动员的同时，也反映了对韩国民族认同纯粹性的焦虑和协商。
literature.keywords: athlete; nationalism; community; career

literature.title: Media Framing of the Unified Korean Olympic Women’s Ice Hockey Team
literature.title_cn: 媒体对朝韩统一女子冰球队的框架呈现
literature.title_en: Media Framing of the Unified Korean Olympic Women’s Ice Hockey Team
literature.author: Taeyeon Oh, Seungmo Kim, Adam Love, Won Jae Seo
literature.abstract: North and South Korea competed with a unified women’s ice hockey team at the 2018 Winter Olympic Games in PyeongChang, South Korea. Although the two nations had fielded unified teams at previous international sporting events, the decision to form a unified women’s ice hockey team in 2018 became a contentious political issue. To investigate the relationship between traditional media and social media when covering a controversial political issue in sport, the researchers in the current study examined newspaper coverage and Twitter commentary focused on the unified Korean women’s ice hockey team. Results indicated that newspapers played an important agenda-setting role; progressive newspapers were active in framing the team positively throughout the Olympic Games period, whereas conservative papers covered the team less frequently and framed it negatively. Discussion about the unified team on Twitter was initially positive but turned primarily negative when controversial statements from politicians and issues of unfairness in team selection arose. Ultimately, the results highlight elements of the symbiotic relationship between traditional media and social media.
literature.abstract_cn: 朝鲜和韩国在2018年平昌冬奥会上组队参加统一的女子冰球比赛。尽管两国此前曾在国际体育赛事中组建过联合队伍，但2018年组建统一女子冰球队的决定成为一个有争议的政治问题。为考察传统媒体和社交媒体在报道体育中有争议的政治问题时的关系，本研究的作者考察了围绕统一韩国女子冰球队的报纸报道和推特评论。结果表明，报纸发挥了重要的议程设置作用；进步派报纸在整个奥运会期间积极将球队框定为正面形象，而保守派报纸报道较少且将其框定为负面。推特上关于统一球队的讨论最初是积极的，但在政治家的争议性言论和球队选拔不公问题出现后转为负面。最终，结果凸显了传统媒体与社交媒体之间的共生关系。
literature.keywords: framing; twitter

literature.title: Fulfilling the Basic Psychological Needs of Esports Fans: A Self-Determination Theory Approach
literature.title_cn: 满足电竞迷的基本心理需求：自我决定理论路径
literature.title_en: Fulfilling the Basic Psychological Needs of Esports Fans: A Self-Determination Theory Approach
literature.author: Tyreal Yizhou Qian, Jerred Junqi Wang, James Jianhui Zhang, John Hulland
literature.abstract: This study examines esports fans’ psychological processes and pertinent behaviors through the lens of the self-determination theory (SDT). The extent to which the esports fans’ basic psychological needs—that is, competence, autonomy, and relatedness—are satisfied were assessed by using a composite latent variable model. Findings derived from the data analyses confirmed the relevance of the SDT in explaining pertinent information on need satisfaction, motivation, and related consumption behaviors. In particular, relatedness was identified as the most salient basic psychological need dimension, suggesting that satisfying this need is critically important for esports consumption. Both the inquiry protocol and the findings of this investigation contribute to the existing literature on motivation by developing an SDT model in esports media studies. Further discussions were made on deciphering the opportunities and challenges associated with the burgeoning esports industry.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究通过自我决定理论（SDT）的视角考察电竞粉丝的心理过程和相关的行为。使用复合潜在变量模型评估电竞粉丝基本心理需求——能力、自主性和关联性——被满足的程度。数据分析结果确认了SDT在解释电竞粉丝需求满足相关信息方面的相关性。研究考察了需求满足如何影响电竞粉丝的行为结果，包括参与度、忠诚度和持续观看意愿。研究发现，当电竞粉丝的能力、自主性和关联性需求得到满足时，他们的参与度和忠诚度显著提高。研究为电竞组织和平台提供了如何更好地满足粉丝需求以增强粉丝体验的见解。
literature.keywords: esports; consumption
literature.theoretical_framework: 游戏研究、媒介文化理论

literature.title: Gaming Gone Viral: An Analysis of the Emerging Esports Narrative Economy
literature.title_cn: 病毒式传播的游戏：新兴电竞叙事经济分析
literature.title_en: Gaming Gone Viral: An Analysis of the Emerging Esports Narrative Economy
literature.author: Joshua I. Newman, Hanhan Xue, Nicholas M. Watanabe, Grace Yan, Christopher M. McLeod
literature.abstract: In this article, we use narrative economics to analyze the social conditions promoting the growth in private investment in esports—specifically in North American esports teams and franchises. Investment in the esport industry has outpaced revenue growth and esport teams do not have a proven cash flow model. To understand this disjuncture, we draw upon the narrative economic approaches developed by Robert Shiller and colleagues who have demonstrated how the public narrative holds the potential to influence economic behavior—and whereby following a popular story might lead to irrational investment, labor, or consumption practices. We provide a quantitative analysis of published stories that shows the virality of esport narratives is consistent with epidemic models and that business investment narratives are spreading faster than general esport narratives. We then provide a mixed method analysis that demonstrates the central narrative of esport stories is one of growth, opportunity, and sport-esport synergies. We conclude with a discussion about the industrial and theoretical implications of studying viral stories as they relate to preconditioning economic behavior in the sports industry.
literature.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们使用叙事经济学来分析促进电竞私人投资增长的社会条件——特别是北美电竞战队和联盟。电竞产业的投资已超过收入增长，电竞战队没有经过验证的现金流模型。为理解这种脱节，我们借鉴罗伯特·希勒等人开发的叙事经济学方法，他们证明了社会叙事如何影响经济行为和市场结果。分析考察了围绕电竞的叙事如何推动投资决策，即使基本面（如收入和盈利能力）尚未证实这种投资合理性。研究为理解新兴产业中叙事、投资和市场动态之间的相互作用提供了见解。
literature.keywords: esports; gaming; quantitative; labor; consumption

literature.title: Motivational Differences Among Viewers of Traditional Sports, Esports, and NBA 2K League
literature.title_cn: 传统体育、电子竞技与NBA 2K联赛观众间的动机差异
literature.title_en: Motivational Differences Among Viewers of Traditional Sports, Esports, and NBA 2K League
literature.author: Ryan Rogers, Lee Farquhar, Jacob Mummert
literature.abstract: Although there have been significant strides in terms of understanding motivations for esports participation and consumption, there has been limited research done with regard to the consumption of specific games and titles within esports. Previous work has focused primarily on esports in general. This study extends the body of esports motivations research by examining motivations for consuming NBA 2K content. Based on the use of a quasi-experiment, results indicate that people consume a specific esport ( NBA 2K) for different motivations than esports generally. This suggests that esports should not be considered a monolithic concept.
literature.abstract_cn: 虽然在理解电竞参与和消费动机方面已取得显著进展，但关于电竞内特定游戏和项目的消费研究仍然有限。以往工作主要集中在一般电竞。本研究通过考察消费NBA 2K内容的动机扩展了电竞动机研究体系。基于准实验设计，研究比较了传统体育观众、一般电竞观众和NBA 2K联赛观众的动机差异。研究结果揭示了不同观众群体之间在消费动机方面的差异，包括替代性体验、技能掌握、社交互动和娱乐等维度。研究为理解电竞特定游戏项目的观众动机提供了见解。
literature.keywords: viewers; nba; esports; consumption
literature.theoretical_framework: 游戏研究、媒介文化理论

literature.title: Active Within Structures: Predictors of Esports Gameplay and Spectatorship
literature.title_cn: 在结构中积极：电竞游戏与观赛的预测因素
literature.title_en: Active Within Structures: Predictors of Esports Gameplay and Spectatorship
literature.author: Tang Tang, Jake Kucek, Steven Toepfer
literature.abstract: This study puts both esports gameplay and spectatorship into consideration and pinpoints how individual and structural factors explain why people play and watch esports to better understand the complexities and intricacies of esports consumption. Results indicate that both measures commonly associated with active audience, and structural theories played a significant role in explaining esports consumption. Specifically, esports gameplay was explained relatively more by structural factors than by individual factors. Different from esports gameplay, esports spectatorship was driven significantly more by individual factors. Preferences, motivations, availability, and access significantly predicted both esports gameplay and spectatorship. Sports fandom and use of interactive features, on the other hand, only predicted esports spectatorship but did not influence gameplay. By employing an integrative approach, this study aids in the development of conceptual framework that will serve to predict esports consumer behavior.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究同时考虑电竞游戏和观赛，并指出个人和结构因素如何解释人们为何玩和观看电竞，以更好地理解电竞消费的复杂性和细微差别。结果表明，与活跃受众相关的指标和结构理论在解释电竞消费中发挥了重要作用。具体而言，电竞游戏比个人因素更受结构因素解释。与电竞游戏不同，电竞观赛显著更多由个人因素驱动。偏好、动机、可用性和获取显著预测了电竞游戏和观赛。另一方面，体育粉丝身份和互动功能的使用只预测了电竞观赛，但不影响游戏行为。通过采用综合方法，本研究有助于发展预测电竞消费者行为的概念框架。
literature.keywords: esports; fandom; audience; access; consumption

literature.title: How Do You Categorize Yourself as a Sports Fan?: A New Scale of Sports Fan Social–Personal Identity Salience (FSPIS) and Its Consequences
literature.title_cn: 你如何给自己归类为体育迷？体育迷社会-个人身份显著性的新量表及其后果
literature.title_en: How Do You Categorize Yourself as a Sports Fan?: A New Scale of Sports Fan Social–Personal Identity Salience (FSPIS) and Its Consequences
literature.author: Avichai Shuv-Ami, Anat Toder Alon
literature.abstract: Based on social identity, self-categorization, and optimal distinctiveness theories, this article argues that fans of team sports clubs (TSCs) may position themselves as members of their TSCs or as unique, individual sports fans. To date, no published, validated instrument has been designed to measure differences in sports fans’ personal and social identity orientation. We conducted three studies to test the validity and reliability of the Fan Social–Personal Identity Salience (FSPIS) scale. In the first two, exploratory factor analysis and confirmatory factor analysis were performed. The third study used a structural equation model to test the consequences of the new scale in an extension of the test of its nomological network validity. The data for the current research was collected using three distinct and separate empirical surveys of professional basketball fans in Israel. Our findings show that there is a moderate correlation between social and personal identities, indicating that a low level of social identity is not the same as personal identity. The FSPIS scale predicted fan optimism and satisfaction, which, in turn, partially mediated the effect on involvement. The uniqueness of the proposed scale is that it is a continuous scale that is able to capture mixed identity salience and variations in its magnitude.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究提出了体育迷社会-个人身份显著性(FSPIS)的新量表，用于测量体育迷如何自我分类其粉丝身份。通过量表开发与验证，分析了体育迷身份显著性的维度结构及其对体育消费行为的影响。
literature.keywords: basketball; survey
literature.theoretical_framework: 受众研究理论、使用与满足理论

literature.title: Consuming for the Greater Good: “Woke” Commercials in Sports Media
literature.title_cn: 为更大善消费：体育媒体中的“觉醒”广告
literature.title_en: Consuming for the Greater Good: “Woke” Commercials in Sports Media
literature.author: Jeffrey Montez de Oca, Sherry Mason, Sung Ahn
literature.abstract: Amidst a crisis in the US racial state over the summer of 2020, typically “politically” averse professional sports leagues proliferated anti-racist statements. We see the sudden advertising of corporate values and politics by sports leagues as stemming from the development of socially conscious marketing (SCM) in recent years. Marketers celebrate commercials such as Nike’s Dream Crazy (2019) since they amplify the political speech of activists, such as Colin Kaepernick, and advertise ways for consumers to engage in ethical consumption. Using discourse analysis of marketing literature on SCM and textual analysis of SCM commercials shown during sporting events, we show that SCM appropriates dissent against neoliberal capitalism in order to legitimate capitalism and resist systemic change during a moment of crisis. We conclude that while we can continue to expect professional sports leagues and other brands to appear “woke,” we should not expect to see change in the exploitative conditions that make them profitable.
literature.abstract_cn: 在2020年夏季美国种族国家危机中，通常"政治"回避的职业体育联盟大量发布了反种族主义声明。我们认为体育联盟对企业和价值观和政策的突然广告源于近年来社会意识营销（SCM）的发展。营销人员赞扬耐克的"梦想疯狂"（2019）等广告，因为它们放大了科林·卡佩尼克等活动家的政治言论，并广告了消费者参与社会政治事业的方式。本文分析了体育媒体中"觉醒"广告的现象，探讨了社会意识营销如何在体育产业中发展，以及这种营销策略对体育消费者和更广泛社会的影响。研究讨论了体育品牌参与社会政治议题的机遇和风险。
literature.keywords: ethical; advertising; politics; marketing; brand; consumption
literature.theoretical_framework: 话语分析理论、危机传播理论

literature.title: “Cutting Editors Faster Than We’re Cutting Reporters”: Influences of The Athletic on Sports Journalism Quality and Standards
literature.title_cn: “裁撤编辑比裁撤记者更快”：The Athletic对体育新闻质量与标准的影响
literature.title_en: “Cutting Editors Faster Than We’re Cutting Reporters”: Influences of The Athletic on Sports Journalism Quality and Standards
literature.author: Nicholas R. Buzzelli, Patrick Gentile, Sean R. Sadri, Andrew C. Billings
literature.abstract: Since its 2016 launch, negative attitudes toward The Athletic, a network of hyperlocal subscription sports news sites, have resonated throughout the journalism community because of the new media startup’s nontraditional approach, one centered on hiring established journalists from the hometown newspaper. Therefore, to accurately paint a picture of The Athletic’s perceived impact on print journalism, 22 in-depth interviews were conducted with newspaper sports editors. This analysis reveals that most sports editors were generally accepting of The Athletic and viewed its presence as reinforcement that newspapers need to stick to daily coverage to stand out in the crowded sports media marketplace.
literature.abstract_cn: 自2016年上线以来，The Athletic（一个由超本地订阅制体育新闻网站组成的网络）因其非传统的做法——核心是从家乡报纸挖角资深记者——在整个新闻界引发了负面态度。因此，为了准确描绘The Athletic对纸质新闻的感知影响，研究人员对报纸体育编辑进行了22次深度访谈。这一分析揭示，大多数体育编辑普遍接受The Athletic，并认为它的存在印证了报纸需要坚持日常报道才能在拥挤的体育媒体市场中脱颖而出。
literature.keywords: reporter; interviews; community; hyperlocal
literature.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、产业组织理论

literature.title: Adoption of Innovations in Digital Sports Journalism: The Use of Twitter by German Sports Journalists
literature.title_cn: 数字体育新闻中的创新采纳：德国体育记者对推特的使用
literature.title_en: Adoption of Innovations in Digital Sports Journalism: The Use of Twitter by German Sports Journalists
literature.author: Inga Oelrichs
literature.abstract: Based on the fact that Twitter penetration in Germany is comparatively low this study analyzes the adoption of Twitter by German sports journalists. It questions how far influences on adoption that were proven to be important in the well-established diffusion of innovation theory can help to explain the Twitter usage among sports journalists. As influences for circumstances of adoption, the type of innovation decision and communication channels are identified. In addition, perceived attributes of Twitter concerning relative advantages, compatibility with norms and values and complexity are specified. A representative online survey with members of the German Association for Sports Journalists reveals that many sports journalists are reluctant concerning Twitter usage. Three Twitter user types were identified: Non-users, Occasional Information Seekers, and Regular Active Users. These user types differed clearly in terms of the circumstances of adoption: management decisions and the adoption by near peers favor the usage of Twitter. Further, compatibility and complexity are influential. For relative advantages, surprisingly, results are less distinct. Overall, this study shows that the diffusion of innovation theory is a helpful approach to explain Twitter usage in German sports journalism and advocates its application for the adoption of other digital innovations in sports journalism.
literature.abstract_cn: 鉴于德国推特渗透率相对较低，本研究分析了德国体育记者对推特的采纳。它质疑在成熟的创新扩散理论中被证明重要的采纳影响能在多大程度上帮助解释体育记者之间的推特使用情况。作为采纳情境的影响，识别了创新决策类型和沟通渠道。此外，对创新的感知属性也被考察。研究发现，德国体育记者对推特的采纳受到多种因素影响，包括专业社区中的同行使用、创新属性感知以及组织支持。研究结果揭示了体育记者在数字新闻环境中采纳新技术的复杂动态。
literature.keywords: twitter; survey

literature.title: “I Got Beat, and He Deserves to Win”: Image Repair Strategies Used by Athletes Who Lost Big Games
literature.title_cn: “我输了，他应得这场胜利”：大比分落败运动员使用的形象修复策略
literature.title_en: “I Got Beat, and He Deserves to Win”: Image Repair Strategies Used by Athletes Who Lost Big Games
literature.author: Michael Ostrowsky, Kevin Stein
literature.abstract: Abstract:A number of researchers have analyzed the image repair strategies used by athletes who have committed deviant behavior. In stark contrast, little research has examined the image repair strategies used by athletes who have lost big games. Using Benoit’s (2015) theory of image repair, this exploratory study analyzes the image repair strategies used by 44 athletes who lost. The findings reveal that this group of athletes use an extensive amount of bolstering, defeasibility, and corrective action. The results also go beyond Benoit’s typology in a few noteworthy ways. In particular, these athletes showed deference toward their opponents and identified lessons learned. The paper concludes with suggestions for future research.
literature.abstract_cn: 许多研究人员分析了犯有越轨行为的运动员使用的形象修复策略。与此形成鲜明对比的是，很少有研究考察输掉重大比赛的运动员使用的形象修复策略。利用贝诺瓦（2015）的形象修复理论，这项探索性研究分析了44名失利运动员使用的形象修复策略。研究发现，这群运动员大量使用强化、可辩护性和纠正行动。结果还在几个值得注意的方面超越了贝诺瓦的类型学。特别是，这些运动员表现出对对手的尊重，并确定了学到的教训。论文以对未来研究的建议结束。
literature.keywords: athlete

literature.title: Digital First: The Push to Move Traditional Content Online
literature.title_cn: 数字优先：推动传统内容上网
literature.title_en: Digital First: The Push to Move Traditional Content Online
literature.author: Timothy Mirabito
literature.abstract: Abstract:The push to digital-first has changed the well-established practices of journalists in all media and genres. Local sports-broadcast journalists are no exception. The purpose of this study was to examine how local sports-broadcast journalists were navigating routines that impacted not only their methods of content distribution but also the nature of the content itself. Thirty local sports journalists engaged in semistructured interviews to provide this unique perspective, which rendered three themes: digital-and social-first as the new norm, a love-hate relationship with social media, and an uneven playing field. These findings highlighted the importance of adaptability to new age journalistic demands.
literature.abstract_cn: 数字优先的推动改变了所有媒体和类型记者早已确立的实践。地方体育广播记者也不例外。本研究的目的是考察地方体育广播记者如何应对影响他们内容分发方法和内容本身的常规。30名地方体育记者参与了半结构化访谈以提供这一独特视角，这得出了三个主题：数字和社交媒体优先成为新常态、与社交媒体的爱恨关系，以及不平衡的竞争环境。这些发现突出了适应新时代新闻要求的重要性。
literature.keywords: interviews; local sports-broadcast; sports-broadcast journalists; digital first; move traditional; traditional content

literature.title: How Newspapers Can Get Inspired by The Athletic
literature.title_cn: 报纸如何从The Athletic获得启发
literature.title_en: How Newspapers Can Get Inspired by The Athletic
literature.author: Benoit Delhauteur
literature.keywords: 报纸

literature.title: “The Man South Africa Forgot”: Media Construction and Redemption of Postapartheid Hero Josia Thugwane
literature.title_cn: “南非遗忘之人”：后种族隔离英雄约西亚·图格瓦内的媒介建构与救赎
literature.title_en: “The Man South Africa Forgot”: Media Construction and Redemption of Postapartheid Hero Josia Thugwane
literature.author: Travis R. Bell, Roxane Coche
literature.abstract: Abstract:On August 4, 1996, at the Atlanta Olympics, Josia Thugwane won the marathon and became the first black South African to earn a gold medal. Just 2 years after Nelson Mandela’s historic presidential election in a nation torn by more than 40 years of apartheid, Thugwane offered a story the media craved for his symbolic rise from uneducated coal miner to globally marketed icon. Then the South African basically vanished following the 2000 Sydney Games, as another forgotten Olympic hero, because of the limited 4-year media cycle. The identity markers of a hero include athletic excellence, elicitation of emotion, conveying symbolic meaning, and overcoming elements beyond the individual’s control to become iconic. Guided by framing theory, this mixed-methods content analysis examined 179 news stories across five countries and 2 decades, to identify how the South African marathoner’s identity was constructed and shaped from heralded to abandoned hero and why he resurfaced. This approach offered a socially derived view of Thugwane produced through the ideological process of journalism that shaped ideas and views while excluding or marginalizing others. Over time, media appreciated his athletic success for what it was against the backdrop of apartheid, which is why Thugwane is still discussed in heroic terms for overcoming odds to reach his sport’s pinnacle.
literature.abstract_cn: 1996年8月4日，在亚特兰大奥运会上，乔西亚·图格瓦内赢得了马拉松冠军，成为第一位获得金牌的南非黑人。在纳尔逊·曼德拉在一个被超过40年种族隔离撕裂的国家历史性当选总统仅两年后，图格瓦内为媒体提供了一个渴望的故事，讲述他从未受教育的煤矿工人象征性地崛起为全球营销的偶像。随后，这位南非人在2000年悉尼奥运会后基本消失，成为又一个被遗忘的奥运英雄，因为有限的4年媒体周期。英雄的身份标记包括卓越的运动表现、激发情感、传达象征意义以及克服个人无法控制的因素而成为偶像。以框架理论为指导，这项混合方法内容分析考察了五个国家和20年间179篇新闻报道，以识别这位南非马拉松运动员的身份如何从受赞誉的英雄被建构和塑造为被遗弃的英雄，以及他为何重新浮现。这种方法提供了通过新闻的意识形态过程产生的图格瓦内的社会视角，该过程塑造了观念和看法，同时排除或边缘化了他者。随着时间的推移，媒体欣赏他的运动成就是什么，尽管有种族隔离的背景，这就是为什么图格瓦内至今仍被以英雄主义的方式讨论，因为他克服重重困难达到了他运动的巅峰。
literature.keywords: framing; olympics; emotion

literature.title: Do Women Get Wings? Representation of Female Action-Sports Athletes in Red Bull Media House Coverage
literature.title_cn: 女性获得翅膀吗？红牛媒体屋报道中女性极限运动运动员的呈现
literature.title_en: Do Women Get Wings? Representation of Female Action-Sports Athletes in Red Bull Media House Coverage
literature.author: Charli C. Kerns, Erin Whiteside
literature.abstract: Abstract:This study examines the gender representation of action-sports athletes in Red Bull Media House’s YouTube videos. A longitudinal analysis of videos from 2008 to 2018 (N = 108) revealed that female athletes in Red Bull Media House receive more representation than what is often documented in the mainstream sports-broadcasting coverage. However, their representation was primarily limited to feature stories and only specific action sports, such as surfing and skiing. The results from this study showed that Red Bull does represent a potential fissure in hegemonic ideology by which male athletes are normalized as authentic athletes through the process of inclusion. However, that visibility was tightly constrained within a normative matrix for imagining the female athletic subject, a process that limits Red Bull Media’s counterhegemonic potential.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了红牛媒体之家的YouTube视频中极限运动运动员的性别呈现。对2008年至2018年视频（N=108）的纵向分析显示，红牛媒体之家中女运动员获得的呈现往往比主流体育广播报道中记录的多。然而，她们的呈现主要局限于专题报道和某些特定极限运动，如冲浪和滑雪。研究结果表明，红牛确实代表了霸权意识形态的一个潜在裂隙，男性运动员通过纳入过程被规范化为真正的运动员。然而，这种可见性被严格限制在想象女性运动员主体的规范性矩阵内，这一过程限制了红牛媒体反霸权潜力。
literature.keywords: representation; athlete; gender; broadcasting; youtube

literature.title: Alternative Telecasts and the Ongoing Fracturing of Sports Television
literature.title_cn: 替代性转播与体育电视的持续碎裂
literature.title_en: Alternative Telecasts and the Ongoing Fracturing of Sports Television
literature.author: Branden Buehler
literature.abstract: Abstract:Several media companies have recently experimented with expanding their television coverage of major sporting events across multiple outlets, offering traditional telecasts on their flagship channels while adding alternative telecasts on secondary outlets. Significantly, unlike most second-screen experiences, the alternative telecasts offered on secondary outlets have largely been meant not to complement the traditional telecasts but rather to substitute for them. In order to better understand what this new model of sports telecasting means for the present and future of sports television, this article is split into two parts. First, the article traces the rise of alternative telecasts, in the process distinguishing them from second-screen experiences and explaining their industrial origins. Second, the article examines how alternative telecasts contribute to the ongoing fracturing of sports television and, in the process, both continue to erode the communal engagement of sports television and reshape the genre’s relationship to its audiences.
literature.abstract_cn: 几家媒体公司最近尝试在多个渠道扩展其对重大体育赛事的电视报道，在旗舰频道提供传统转播的同时，在次要渠道增加替代转播。值得注意的是，与大多数第二屏体验不同，次要渠道提供的替代转播在很大程度上不是为了补充传统转播，而是为了取代它们。为了更好地理解这种体育转播新模式对体育电视现在和未来的意义，本文分为两部分。首先，文章追溯了替代转播的兴起，在此过程中将其与第二屏体验区分开来，并解释了其产业起源。其次，文章考察了替代转播如何促成体育电视的持续分裂，在此过程中既继续削弱体育电视的公共参与，又重塑了这一类型与其受众的关系。
literature.keywords: television; audience; engagement

literature.title: New Media, Old Ways: An Analysis of Sports Media’s Depiction of Female Athletes on Instagram and Snapchat
literature.title_cn: 新媒体、旧方式：Instagram与Snapchat上体育媒体对女运动员描绘的分析
literature.title_en: New Media, Old Ways: An Analysis of Sports Media’s Depiction of Female Athletes on Instagram and Snapchat
literature.author: Mary Lou Sheffer
literature.abstract: Abstract:Previous research has shown a discrepancy between the coverage of men’s and women’s sports (Cooky, Messner, & Hextrum, 2013; Duncan & Messner, 1994; Huffman, Tuggle, & Rosengard, 2004; Kian, Vincent, & Mondello, 2008). With the growth of social media, sports networks have new platforms to display content. Hopefully, with the rise of social media, women’s sports would receive more coverage (Street, Chen, Duncan, & Hesterburg, 2016). Past research has also shown that sports media frame female athletes as less combatant and less athletic than male athletes (Hardin, Chance, Dodd, & Hardin, 2002). The purpose of this study is to investigate the depiction of female athletes on the Instagram accounts of the four leading U.S. sports-media outlets (ESPN, CBS Sports, Fox Sports, and NBC Sports), along with ESPN’s SportsCenter and Snapchat’s Discover channel. Based on framing theory (Goffman, 1974) and social role theory (Eagly, 1987), this study analyzed 1,239 images and found that a large, significant discrepancy still exists between the coverage of male and female athletes. However, among the images of female athletes, the majority of images depicted them as competing. Furthermore, female athletes were not treated as sexual objects.
literature.abstract_cn: 以往研究表明，男性和女性体育的报道存在差异（Cooky, Messner, & Hextrum, 2013; Duncan & Messner, 1994; Huffman, Tuggle, & Rosengard, 2004; Kian, Vincent, & Mondello, 2008）。随着社交媒体的发展，体育网络有了展示内容的新平台。人们希望随着社交媒体的兴起，女性体育能够获得更多报道（Street, Chen, Duncan, & Hesterburg, 2016）。过去的研究还表明，体育媒体将女运动员框定为不如男运动员具有对抗性和运动能力（Hardin, Chance, Dodd, & Hardin, 2002）。本研究旨在调查美国四大体育媒体机构（ESPN、CBS Sports、Fox Sports和NBC Sports）以及ESPN的SportsCenter和Snapchat的Discover频道Instagram账户上对女运动员的描绘。基于框架理论（Goffman, 1974）和社会角色理论（Eagly, 1987），本研究分析了1,239张图片，发现男性和女性运动员报道之间仍然存在巨大而显著的差异。然而，在女运动员的图片中，大多数图片将她们描绘为正在比赛。此外，女运动员未被当作性对象对待。
literature.keywords: instagram; athlete; framing

literature.title: Special Issue Introduction: The Future of Sports Media in the Digital Age
literature.title_cn: 特刊导言：数字时代体育媒体的未来
literature.title_en: Special Issue Introduction: The Future of Sports Media in the Digital Age
literature.author: Jennifer L. Harker, Michael L. Mirer
literature.keywords: 体育媒体; 媒体; 体育; 导言

literature.title: Conceptual Framework for Sports Media in the 21st Century: Content, Platform, Media System, and Political System
literature.title_cn: 21世纪体育媒体的概念框架：内容、平台、媒介体制与政治体制
literature.title_en: Conceptual Framework for Sports Media in the 21st Century: Content, Platform, Media System, and Political System
literature.author: Sarah Wolter
literature.abstract: Abstract:Research on digital sports media requires analysis of multiple rhetorical, economic, regulatory, and cultural systems. The purpose of this paper is to present a conceptual media-analysis framework that illustrates how power operates in sports media in the digital age. The framework is a network of interdependent elements in four areas: content, platform, media system, and political system. Content includes the interaction between symbols, meaning, and context to reveal the power in producing meaning. The second part of the framework is how platforms promote engagement, which includes access as well as algorithms supporting advertising-driven business models. The third is media system, the relationship between the economic systems, media regulations, and how both affect sports media specifically. Political system encompasses the relationship between citizens, government, and information. All four parts of the framework are necessary for a thorough sports-media analysis in a changing media environment.
literature.abstract_cn: 对数字体育媒体的研究需要分析多重修辞、经济、规制和文化系统。本文的目的是提出一个概念性媒体分析框架，说明权力在数字时代的体育媒体中如何运作。该框架是四个领域相互依存要素的网络：内容、平台、媒体系统和政治系统。内容包括符号、意义和语境之间的互动，以揭示生产意义中的权力。框架的第二部分是平台如何促进参与，这包括可及性以及支持广告驱动商业模式的算法。第三是媒体系统，即经济体系与媒体规制之间的关系，以及两者如何具体影响体育媒体。政治系统包含公民、政府和信息之间的关系。框架的所有四个部分对于在不断变化的媒体环境中进行彻底的体育媒体分析都是必要的。
literature.keywords: algorithm; advertising; regulation; engagement; access

literature.title: Journalism or Public Relations? Coverage of Sports Teams in High School Journalism Programs
literature.title_cn: 新闻还是公关？高中新闻项目中的球队报道
literature.title_en: Journalism or Public Relations? Coverage of Sports Teams in High School Journalism Programs
literature.author: Kevin Hull, Bradley Wilson
literature.abstract: Abstract:Just as professional sports reporters are often embedded with teams, high school sports journalists have to go to class with the athletes they cover. However, high school reporters lack the expertise of professionals, leading to an examination about whether high school media coverage of sports is more like public relations or objective journalism. In a survey of high school media advisers, the scholastic sports coverage was found to be a trade-off between objective journalism and positive public relations produced by students— who, either way, gain valuable skills— for students.
literature.abstract_cn: 正如职业体育记者经常与球队"嵌入"在一起，高中体育记者也不得不去与他们所报道的运动员一起上课。然而，高中记者缺乏职业记者的专业知识，这就引出了一个问题：高中体育媒体报道更像公关还是客观新闻？在一项对高中媒体顾问的调查中，发现学校体育报道是客观新闻与由学生（无论如何，他们都能获得宝贵的技能）制作的积极公关之间的权衡。
literature.keywords: survey; reporter; athlete

literature.title: Challenges to the role of media in reporting sport corruption: Insights from reporters in Balkan countries
literature.title_cn: 媒体在报道体育腐败中角色的挑战：巴尔干国家记者的洞见
literature.title_en: Challenges to the role of media in reporting sport corruption: Insights from reporters in Balkan countries
literature.author: Argyro Elisavet Manoli, David Janečić
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Despite the influence and power that the media hold and the importance placed on the role that they can assume regarding corruption, little is known about the part the media can play in corruption in sport and any challenges they might face in reporting on it. This study aims to shed light on this unexplored area, by using insights from members of the media based in three Balkan countries, to help uncover the challenges and obstacles faced by sport media. The findings of this study allow for the multifold role of the media in sport corruption to be examined, while uncovering the internally and externally driven obstacles they face, ranging from personal greed to market-based pressures and media’s ostracism by the wider anti-corruption system.
literature.abstract_cn: 尽管媒体具有影响力与权力，且人们强调媒体在腐败问题中可能发挥的作用，但关于媒体在体育腐败中可能扮演的角色以及它们在报道中所面临的挑战，人们知之甚少。本研究旨在通过吸纳三个巴尔干国家媒体从业者的洞见，揭示体育媒体所面临的挑战与障碍，以照亮这一未开发的领域。本研究发现能够考察媒体在体育腐败中的多重角色，同时揭示其面临的内外部驱动障碍，从个人贪婪到基于市场的压力，再到媒体被更广泛的反腐体系所排斥。
literature.keywords: reporter; sport corruption; balkan countries; reporting sport; corruption insights; countries despite
literature.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、产业组织理论

literature.title: ‘These are “our” sports’: Kabaddi and Kho-Kho women athletes from the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
literature.title_cn: “这些是”我们的“运动”：巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国的卡巴迪与科科女运动员
literature.title_en: ‘These are “our” sports’: Kabaddi and Kho-Kho women athletes from the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
literature.author: Umer Hussain, George B Cunningham
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Women’s participation in sports and physical activities lags behind that of men, particularly among members of underrepresented or marginalized groups. Pakistani women from the rural areas of southern Punjab represent one such group. The aim of this study was to examine how traditional sports that are less well-known outside the Indian subcontinent offer opportunities for marginalized Pakistani women from Southern Punjab to participate in physical activities. Following a phenomenological approach, we conducted 16 semi-structured interviews with Kho-Kho and Kabaddi women athletes from underrepresented groups in Pakistan. Elo and Kyngäs’ three-phase content analysis process (preparation, organization and reporting) was used to examine interviews. The results of the study revealed that participants feel constrained by the systematic masculine hegemonic culture institutionalized by Pakistani society and the western sporting paradigm. However, the participants reported a sense of liberation and security via traditional sports. Our study contributes to the limited knowledge about women’s participation in traditional sports beyond the western world.
literature.abstract_cn: 女性在体育和身体活动中的参与度落后于男性，在代表性不足或被边缘化的群体中尤其如此。巴基斯坦南旁遮普农村地区的女性正是这样一个群体。本研究旨在考察那些在印度次大陆以外鲜为人知的传统体育，如何为巴基斯坦南旁遮普的被边缘化女性提供参与身体活动的机会。遵循现象学方法，我们对巴基斯坦来自弱势群体的16名Kho-Kho和卡巴迪（Kabaddi）女运动员进行了半结构化访谈。研究采用Elo与Kyngäs的三阶段内容分析法（准备、组织与报告）对访谈进行分析。研究结果显示，参与者感到受到巴基斯坦社会制度化的系统性男性霸权文化以及西方体育范式的束缚。然而，参与者报告称，通过传统体育获得了解放感和安全感。本研究为超越西方世界之外关于女性参与传统体育的有限知识作出了贡献。
literature.keywords: athlete; interviews
literature.theoretical_framework: 性别理论、女性主义传播理论

literature.title: Gay male athletes’ coming-out stories on Outsports.com
literature.title_cn: Outsports.com上男同性恋运动员的出柜故事
literature.title_en: Gay male athletes’ coming-out stories on Outsports.com
literature.author: Adam J White, Rory Magrath, Luis Emilio Morales
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: For two decades, Outsports.com – the world’s first website dedicated to the LGBT+ community’s experiences in sport – has provided sexual minority athletes with the opportunity to share their stories. In this research, we examine the published coming-out narratives of 60 out gay male athletes across a variety of different sports. Our analysis indicates that, prior to coming-out, many of these athletes felt the need to adopt an identity predicated on masculine stereotypes, thus distancing themselves from homosexuality. Upon coming-out to teammates, however, most of these athletes experienced acceptance and inclusivity which, in turn, led to improved health and wellbeing. Additionally, we document the changing nature of homosexually themed language on these men’s sports teams. Finally, we recognize the importance of mediums such as Outsports in providing athletes across the world the opportunity to share their coming-out stories. Accordingly, this research advances a body of evidence documenting sport’s growing inclusivity for the LGBT+ community.
literature.abstract_cn: 二十年来，Outsports.com——全球首个致力于LGBT+群体体育经历的网站——为性少数运动员提供了分享自身故事的机会。在本研究中，我们考察了来自不同体育项目的60名已出柜男同性恋运动员公开发布的出柜叙事。我们的分析表明，在出柜之前，许多运动员感到需要采取一种以男性刻板印象为基础的身份认同，从而与同性恋身份保持距离。然而，在向队友出柜之后，大多数运动员经历了接纳与包容，这进而改善了他们的健康与幸福感。此外，我们还记录了这些男性运动队中与同性恋相关语言不断变化的性质。最后，我们认识到Outsports等媒介在为世界各地运动员提供分享出柜故事机会方面的重要意义。据此，本研究推进了一系列证明体育对LGBT+群体日益包容的证据。
literature.keywords: athlete; stereotype; minority; community; wellbeing

literature.title: Gender-collaborative training in elite university sport: Challenging gender essentialism through integrated training in gender-segregated sports
literature.title_cn: 精英大学体育中的性别协作训练：通过性别隔离项目的整合训练挑战性别本质主义
literature.title_en: Gender-collaborative training in elite university sport: Challenging gender essentialism through integrated training in gender-segregated sports
literature.author: MF Ogilvie, Mark McCormack
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Competitive teamsport at university level is predominantly segregated by gender in many western countries, despite concerns that gender segregation in sport can perpetuate sexism and gender inequality. While policies and activities seek to challenge sexism and gender inequality, the use of gender collaboration within a gender-segregated system as a method to achieve this has received little attention. In this article, we draw on a year-long ethnography of elite sport and 48 in-depth interviews with elite male and female athletes at a British university to explore the impact of various forms of gender mixing during training, which we call ‘gender-collaborative training’. While men’s and women’s teams competing against each other in practice matches resulted in gender-essentialist narratives attributing difference to biology, gender-integrated practices and workouts provided opportunities for men and women to train together without the gendered sport-specific associations that can reproduce sexism. We call for gender-collaborative training to be adopted by gender-segregated teams, and suggest that where there is resistance to any integration, teams start with mixed physical workouts and progress to mixed sport-specific training and then mixed competitive training.
literature.abstract_cn: 在许多西方国家，大学水平的竞争性团队运动主要通过性别隔离进行，尽管有人担心体育中的性别隔离可能延续性别歧视和性别不平等。虽然政策和活动试图挑战性别歧视和性别不平等，但在性别隔离体系中使用性别协作作为实现这一目标的方法受到的关注有限。在本文中，我们利用对英国一所大学精英体育的一年级民族志研究和48次深入访谈（与精英男性和女性运动员进行），探讨了性别协作训练作为挑战性别本质主义的机制。研究发现，性别协作训练可以提供挑战性别刻板印象和促进性别平等的机会，但也面临结构性障碍和参与者抵制。研究为如何在精英体育中实施有效的性别协作培训提供了见解。
literature.keywords: gender; sexism; interviews; ethnography; athlete

literature.title: Sport omnivorism: Social stratification of sports practice in Chile
literature.title_cn: 体育杂食性：智利体育实践的社会分层
literature.title_en: Sport omnivorism: Social stratification of sports practice in Chile
literature.author: Javier Reyes
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Using Chan and Goldthorpe’s theoretical framework of cultural consumption, this study analyses the patterns of social stratification in sports practice in Chile. Based on the data of the National Survey of Physical Activity and Sports Habits in the Population Aged 18 and Over 2015 in Chile ( n = 5511), a latent class analysis was used to identify and characterize types of sports practice in this country. After this, logistic and multinomial regressions were performed to relate the types of sports practice found and its social determinants. The results support current literature in sports participation, finding evidence in favour of both the homology hypothesis and omnivorous–univorous hypothesis. However, in the same way as previous studies, it is shown that these arguments are reconfigured in the field of sport.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究运用陈和戈德索普的文化消费理论框架，分析了智利体育实践中的社会分层模式。基于智利2015年18岁及以上人口身体活动与运动习惯全国调查数据（n=5,511），使用潜在类别分析来识别和刻画该国体育实践的类型。此后，……
