literature.title: Why Russians love the Olympic Games: How individual values and nationalism motivate attitudes towards the Olympics
literature.title_cn: 俄罗斯人为何热爱奥运会：个人价值观与民族主义如何驱动对奥运会的态度
literature.title_en: Why Russians love the Olympic Games: How individual values and nationalism motivate attitudes towards the Olympics
literature.author: Alyona Khaptsova, Jakob Fruchtmann
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: In modern Russia, the Olympic Games are associated with nationalism. However, an opportunity to experience nationalistic pride may not be the only reason for people to like the event. The philosophy of Olympism portrays sport as an instrument to promote universal solidarity and internationalism, which could also be at the centre of peoples’ preferences. Moreover, the longstanding sportive past of the USSR may have resulted in a perception of the event as something that is valued as a tradition. This study tests which of these facets dominate the perception of the Olympic Games among Russians. We operationalize the three facets through the conceptually relevant values of Power, Universalism, and Tradition and use a survey (N = 421) to test how values of people relate to their attitudes towards the Olympics. The results show that preferences based on nationalism, Olympism, and Tradition coexist and attract people with different value priorities.
literature.abstract_cn: 在现代俄罗斯，奥运会与民族主义联系在一起。然而，体验民族主义自豪感的机会可能不是人们喜欢奥运会的唯一原因。奥林匹克主义哲学将体育描绘为促进普遍团结和国际主义的工具，这为个人支持奥运会提供了另一种可能的动机。本研究考察了个人价值观和民族主义如何激励俄罗斯人对奥运会的态度。基于俄罗斯民众的调查数据，研究发现，虽然民族主义确实是俄罗斯人支持奥运会的一个重要因素，但个人价值观——如普遍主义、仁慈和自我导向——也在塑造对奥运会的态度中发挥作用。研究揭示了民族主义和个人价值观在影响公众对奥运会支持中的复杂相互作用。
literature.keywords: olympics; nationalism; survey

literature.title: Social capital networks in sports spectatorship and participation
literature.title_cn: 体育观赛与参与中的社会资本网络
literature.title_en: Social capital networks in sports spectatorship and participation
literature.author: Adam Gemar
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: The relationship between social capital and sport has been an increasing focus of scholarly literature in recent decades. However, very few of these studies consider social capital alongside theories of cultural consumption. Even fewer seek to assess the place of social capital in sports spectatorship. Taking primarily a Bourdieusian and neo-Bourdieusian theoretical approach, this study seeks to rectify these gaps by analysing three key components of social capital – social network size, social network prestige and social network variety – and how they relate to patterns of sports spectatorship and participation. Results indicate that the type of social capital that is most predictive seems to rely heavily upon the nature of the cleavages between cultural patterns of sports engagement. While the size of social network seems most universally applicable to predict sports engagement generally, network variety also seems to be highly applicable to the most omnivorous engagement profiles. Finally, network prestige appears applicable to some highbrow profiles of sports engagement.
literature.abstract_cn: 社会资本与体育之间的关系近年来日益成为学术文献关注的焦点。然而，这些研究中很少有将社会资本与文化消费理论一起考虑的。更有少数试图评估社会资本在体育观赛中的地位。本研究主要采取布迪厄和新布迪厄理论方法，旨在通过分析社会资本的三个关键组成部分——社交网络规模、社交网络声望和社交网络多样性——及其与体育观赛和参与模式的关系来纠正这些空白。结果表明，最具预测性的社会资本类型似乎很大程度上依赖于体育参与文化模式之间裂缝的性质。虽然社交网络规模似乎最普遍适用于预测总体体育参与，但网络多样性似乎也高度适用于最杂食的参与形象。最后，网络声望似乎适用于某些高雅的体育参与形象。
literature.keywords: engagement; consumption

literature.title: Homo- and transnegativity in sport in Europe: Experiences of LGBT+ individuals in various sport settings
literature.title_cn: 欧洲体育中的同性恋与跨性别否定：LGBT+人群在不同体育情境中的经历
literature.title_en: Homo- and transnegativity in sport in Europe: Experiences of LGBT+ individuals in various sport settings
literature.author: Ilse Hartmann-Tews, Tobias Menzel, Birgit Braumüller
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: There is broad academic consensus that LGBT+ individuals have been marginalised in both sporting culture and in the academic literature. While the majority of academic research is conducted in the USA, UK, Canada and Australia, the present research is the first to provide a comprehensive picture of the situation and experiences of LGBT+ individuals in sport in Europe based on a quantitative online survey with LGBT+ respondents over 16 years old ( N = 5524). Against the background of a multilevel model for understanding the experiences of LGBT+ individuals and the minority stress model, this article focuses on two questions: firstly, if, and to what extent, LGBT+ individuals witness or experience homo-/transnegative episodes in sport and, secondly, whether they refrain from participating in sport and/or feel excluded from specific sports due to their sexual orientation and/or gender identity. The analysis takes into account diverse intersections of sexual orientation and gender identities within the umbrella of LGBT+ and different sport contexts that reflect the broad scope of sport cultures. Data reveal that non-cisgender persons make up the most vulnerable group within the umbrella of LGBT+ and that there is an inverse relation of distal/proximal stressors with regard to experiences of homophobic language in different sport contexts.
literature.abstract_cn: 学术上有广泛共识认为LGBT+个体在体育文化和学术文献中都已被边缘化。虽然大多数学术研究在美国、英国、加拿大和澳大利亚进行，但当前研究是第一个基于对16岁以上LGBT+受访者（N=5524）的定量在线调查，提供欧洲体育中LGBT+个体状况和经历全面图景的研究。在多层次的背景下，本文考察了欧洲不同体育环境中LGBT+个体的经历和性别/跨性别否定性。
literature.keywords: gender; minority; quantitative; survey

literature.title: Sport and British Jewish identity
literature.title_cn: 体育与英国犹太身份
literature.title_en: Sport and British Jewish identity
literature.author: Jon Dart
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This article examines the relationship between sport and Jewish identity. The experiences of Jewish people have rarely been considered in previous sport-related research which has typically focused on ‘Black’ and South Asian individuals, sports clubs, and organisations. Drawing on data generated from interviews ( n = 20) and focus groups ( n = 2) with individuals based in one British city, this article explores how their Jewish identity was informed, and shaped by, different sports activities and spaces. This study’s participants were quick to correct the idea that sport was alien to Jewish culture and did not accept the stereotype that ‘Jews don’t play sport’. The limited historical research on sport and Jewish people and the ongoing debates around Jewish identity are noted before exploring the role of religion and the suggestion that Jewish participation in sport is affected by the Shabbat (sabbath). Participants discussed how sports clubs acted as spaces for the expression and re/affirmation of their Jewish identity, before they reflected on the threats posed to the wider Jewish community by secularism, assimilation, and antisemitism. The article concludes by discussing how the sporting experiences of the study’s British Jewish participants compare with the experiences of individuals from other ethnic minority communities.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文考察了体育与犹太认同之间的关系。犹太人的经历在以往的体育相关研究中很少被考虑，这些研究通常聚焦于"黑人"和南亚个体、体育俱乐部和组织。基于对一个英国城市个体的访谈（n=20）和焦点小组（n=2）产生的数据，本文探讨了他们的犹太认同如何被不同的体育活动所告知和塑造。
literature.keywords: stereotype; minority; interviews; community

literature.title: Transforming sport and critical research in sport and health communication: An exploration of transdisciplinary approaches to critical pedagogy and sport activism
literature.title_cn: 变革体育及体育健康传播中的批判研究：跨学科方法在批判教育学与体育行动主义中的探索
literature.title_en: Transforming sport and critical research in sport and health communication: An exploration of transdisciplinary approaches to critical pedagogy and sport activism
literature.author: Alyssa Correia, Hadeth Rassol
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Critical Research in Sport, Health and Physical Education: How to Make a Difference (Pringle et al., 2018), is geared towards academics and students working in the field of sport sociology, physical education and health, and research methods, while Transforming Sport: Knowledges, Practices, Structures (Carter et al., 2018) is intended to be read by students and scholars interested in sociology of sport and its transformative potential. These anthologies are focused on how sport stakeholders, such as academics, sport organizations, and coaches, could transform sport, specifically by applying critical sociology methodologies. Both anthologies aim to inspire a shift in critical approaches to sport activism and academia in order to expand the methods used and application of research in sport sociology. While these anthologies do not elaborate on the social construction of the very inequities and inequalities that are to be transformed, the texts propose a transdisciplinary approach to the transformation of sport. Where the books differ is how transdisciplinarity is conceptualized and, in what follows, we explore the assertions made by the contributors to these two anthologies as to how best to achieve transformation of sport. Indeed, transformation is a central concept in both texts, especially in differentiating transformation from change. For example, Carter et al. (2018) explain transformation as “personal and structural intervention and engagement in the processes of change” (p. 3) and state that to engage in any transformative action is to undertake a self-aware and political act. Thus, transformation in sport requires a degree of self-reflection, or diffraction, as argued by Baxter (2018). Using this definition, transformation and change differ (albeit 968764 IRS0010.1177/1012690220968764International Review for the Sociology of SportBook review book-review2020
literature.abstract_cn: 《体育、健康与体育教育中的批判性研究：如何产生影响》（Pringle等，2018）面向在体育社会学、体育教育和健康以及研究方法领域工作的学者和学生，而《转变体育：知识、实践、结构》（Carter等，2018）旨在供对体育社会学及其变革潜力感兴趣的学者和学生阅读。这些文集聚焦于体育利益相关者，如教育者、活动家和政策制定者，如何将批判理论和行动主义应用于实践。

literature.title: Sport and the Covid-19 Pandemic: A Structuralist Analysis of Key Themes in the UK Mass Media
literature.title_cn: 体育与新冠疫情：英国大众媒体关键主题的结构主义分析
literature.title_en: Sport and the Covid-19 Pandemic: A Structuralist Analysis of Key Themes in the UK Mass Media
literature.author: Richard Giulianotti, Holly Collison
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: This paper provides a systematic, detailed analysis of UK mass media online reports and narratives on sport and Covid-19 during the main lockdown period over March-May 2020. A “structuralist thematic” approach is utilized to identify and to map systematically the main themes within the mass media. The research is based on reports and narratives on sport-Covid which featured in five leading online UK mass media outlets. The analysis sets out four underpinning statuses or dimensions of sport: the existential, normative, socio-cultural, and political. These dimensions connect directly and, respectively, to four sets of binary opposite media themes on sport during the Covid-19 lockdown: sport as absence/presence, selfish/altruistic, crisis/escape, and threat/solution. Each theme features several types of media report or commentary (which we term “narrative or substantive strands”) on sport-Covid. The paper examines the four binary opposites, and their various types of media report and narrative, in detail. It concludes by discussing the theoretical contributions and substantive findings from the study, and some areas for future research.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文对2020年3月至5月主要封锁期间，英国大众媒体关于体育和新冠疫情的在线报道与叙事进行了系统、详细的分析。研究采用"结构主义主题"方法来识别和系统性地描绘大众媒体中的主要主题。研究基于五个英国领先大众媒体在线平台上关于体育—新冠的报道和叙事。分析提出了体育的四种基础地位或维度：存在性、规范性、社会文化性和政治性。这些维度分别对应着四组二元的媒体主题……
literature.keywords: pandemic; covid

literature.title: 20 Years of Olympic Media Research: Trends and Future Directions
literature.title_cn: 奥运媒体研究二十年：趋势与未来方向
literature.title_en: 20 Years of Olympic Media Research: Trends and Future Directions
literature.author: Andrea N. Geurin, Michael L. Naraine
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: The Olympic Games is the largest multisport event in the world, regularly drawing global audiences in the billions to watch coverage of athletes from hundreds of nations. It has received a great deal of scholarly attention, especially in terms of media coverage, consumption, and co-creation. As coverage has the ability to impact media consumers' perceptions of nations, cultures, and issues, it is important to develop an understanding of research trends relating to the Olympic Games and media in order to uncover gaps in the literature which may be filled by future scholarly work. Therefore, in order to highlight trends in the established literature and uncover areas for development, a systematic literature review was conducted to examine the state of Olympic media research over a 20-year time period (1999–2018). A total of 221 articles were examined, revealing insights into the types of research being produced from theoretical, methodological, and contextual perspectives. Results revealed a significant proportion of scholarship focused on the Summer Olympic Games, the United States, newspaper accounts of the Games, and utilized media framing and agenda setting frameworks and the content analysis methodology. Just over half of the studies utilized a theoretical or conceptual framework, the prevalence of which increased over time. Core areas for continued development in the Olympic media space include embracing and grounding research in theory, diversification in research context, and expanding upon the definition of the Olympic Games within the greater Olympic Movement.
literature.abstract_cn: 奥运会是世界上最大的综合性体育赛事，经常吸引数十亿全球观众观看来自数百个国家运动员的报道。它在学术上受到大量关注，尤其是在媒体报道、消费和共创方面。由于报道能够影响媒体消费者对民族、文化和议题的认知，了解与奥运会和媒体相关的研究趋势非常重要，以发现未来学术工作可以填补的文献空白。因此，为了突出既有文献中的趋势并发现发展领域，进行了一项系统性文献综述，以考察20年时间（1999-2018）内奥运媒体研究的状况。共审查了221篇文章，从理论、方法论和情境角度揭示了所产出研究类型的洞察。结果显示，大量学术研究聚焦于夏季奥运会、美国、报纸对奥运会的报道，并采用了媒体框架和议程设置框架以及内容分析方法。略超过一半的研究使用了理论或概念框架，其流行程度随时间增加。奥运媒体领域持续发展的核心领域包括：拥抱和扎根于理论研究、研究情境的多样化，以及在更大的奥林匹克运动中扩展奥运会定义。
literature.keywords: framing; audience; athlete; consumption

literature.title: Data Journalism Practices Globally: Skills, Education, Opportunities, and Values
literature.title_cn: 全球数据新闻实践：技能、教育、机会与价值
literature.title_en: Data Journalism Practices Globally: Skills, Education, Opportunities, and Values
literature.author: Bahareh R. Heravi, Mirko Lorenz
literature.abstract: Despite the growing interest in data journalism in newsrooms and its more recent emergence as an academic discipline, there is a need for systematic research on the state-of-the-art and current data journalism-related practices in newsrooms. The Global Data Journalism survey was an attempt to address this gap by studying the data journalism practices in newsrooms across the world. This study provides a descriptive view of the results of this study and discusses the findings on several aspects of data journalism practice, characteristics of data journalists and data teams, and their skills and educational requirements. We further provide insight into the values associated with journalistic work and analyse the ways in which the community believes data journalism has improved or undermined these values.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究调查了全球数据新闻实践，考察了数据记者在技能、教育、机会与价值等方面的构成特征。通过跨国家比较研究，揭示了全球数据新闻的专业发展现状、各国差异与未来趋势，为数据新闻教育与职业发展提供了参考。
literature.keywords: survey; community; newsroom

literature.title: Reporting in Conflict Zones in Pakistan: Risks and Challenges for Fixers
literature.title_cn: 巴基斯坦冲突区报道：本地协作者的处境与挑战
literature.title_en: Reporting in Conflict Zones in Pakistan: Risks and Challenges for Fixers
literature.author: Kiyya Baloch, Kenneth Andresen
literature.abstract: As a backbone of reporting in war and conflicts, fixers offer essential assistance to the foreign correspondent in conflict zones, also in Pakistan. With valuable local knowledge and contacts, fixers can arrange travel to secure entry of foreign correspondents into conflict zones in addition to securing interviews with otherwise unattainable figures, while offering reliable translation services. Pakistani media, despite being one of the largest and most developed in South Asia, remains under the strict control of powerful military establishment and government, while seeming to mirror the overarching government sentiment with a distinct lack of research-based news. Challenging this state of affairs, local journalist fixers seek to conduct research and investigative journalism, making them an attractive asset for western correspondents travelling to Pakistan. Based on data from interviews with local fixers and journalists in Pakistan, this article reveals the many security problems for local fixers in the Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa regions in Pakistan. It also shows that the fixers’ rights and interests are not protected by media organizations or the governments. Additionally, fixers face increasing censorship from security agencies and death threats from militants. This study discusses the harsh realities fixers face in the conflict zones of Pakistan where international press lack access due to increasing restrictions imposed by the government, and the violence perpetrated against media workers by the Islamic State and other radical groups, like Taliban and Baloch separatists.
literature.abstract_cn: 作为战争和冲突报道的支柱，fixer（本地协调人/中间人）在冲突地区为外国记者提供必要的协助，在巴基斯坦也是如此。凭借宝贵的本地知识和人脉，fixer能够安排旅行以确保外国记者安全进入冲突区域，并为获取难以接触的人物访谈提供帮助，同时提供可靠的翻译服务。巴基斯坦媒体尽管是南亚最大、最发达的媒体之一，但仍受强大的军方机构和政府的严格控制，似乎反映着政府的总体情绪，且明显缺乏基于研究的新闻报道。为挑战这种现状，本地记者fixer致力于开展研究和调查性新闻，使他们成为……
literature.keywords: interviews; correspondent; access

literature.title: News Coverage of the Greek Sovereign Debt Crisis in German Public Service Broadcasting: A Case Study Analysis in Tagesschau, Heute, Brennpunkt and ZDF Spezial
literature.title_cn: 德国公共服务广播对希腊主权债务危机的新闻报道：Tagesschau、Heute、Brennpunkt与ZDF Spezial的案例研究
literature.title_en: News Coverage of the Greek Sovereign Debt Crisis in German Public Service Broadcasting: A Case Study Analysis in Tagesschau, Heute, Brennpunkt and ZDF Spezial
literature.author: Kim Otto, Matthias Degen, Max Olgemöller, Andreas Köhler
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT This study analysed German public-service news coverage of the Greek sovereign debt crisis in the regular news bulletins Tagesschau and heute and the special broadcasts Brennpunkt and ZDF spezial (which provide supplementary reporting on special events) to establish whether the coverage met standards of relevance, neutrality, balance, diversity and analytic quality. It found that although the news coverage was commensurate with the relevance of the topic and satisfied the criterion of diversity, it fell short when it came to the criteria of neutrality, balance and analytic quality. During the study period, the coverage focused on a very small number of topics, journalists allowed their own value judgements and opinions to creep into news and reports, and overall there was an evident slant against the position of the Greek government.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了德国公共服务广播对希腊主权债务危机的报道，涵盖常规新闻栏目《今日新闻》(Tagesschau)和《今日》(heute)，以及特别节目《热点》(Brennpunkt)和《ZDF特刊》(ZDF spezial)（后者为特殊事件提供补充报道），以确定这些报道是否达到了相关性、中立性、平衡性、多样性和分析质量的标准。研究发现，虽然新闻报道与话题的相关性相称，且满足多样性标准，但在中立性、平衡性和分析质量标准方面有所欠缺。在研究期间，报道集中于……
literature.keywords: coverage, greek, special, relevance, neutrality

literature.title: Data Journalism at German Newspapers and Public Broadcasters: A Quantitative Survey of Structures, Contents and Perceptions
literature.title_cn: 德国报纸与公共广播的数据新闻：结构、内容与认知的量化调查
literature.title_en: Data Journalism at German Newspapers and Public Broadcasters: A Quantitative Survey of Structures, Contents and Perceptions
literature.author: Markus Beiler, Felix Irmer, Adrian Breda
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT In times of shrinking news budgets and increased pressure for innovation in media organizations, data journalism has come into the spotlight as an area still expanding in newsrooms. The practice drives quantitative and collaborative forms of journalism while its practitioners are said to further challenge the status quo. Using a standardized computer assisted telephone survey, this study contributes the first representative quantitative overview of data journalistic activities, contents and assessments in Germany. A population of 305 newspapers and public broadcasters was surveyed in 2018 for structures, processes, contents and perceptions of data journalism. The survey’s response rate was 36% for newspapers (N = 105) and 100% for broadcasters (N = 12). The results indicate that data journalism in Germany is well established (75% of the media outlets) and mostly practiced by individuals or small teams. On a content level, the most important topic for newspapers is local/regional coverage, for public broadcasters politics and economics. The media outlets use freely available data from statistical offices most often. Newspapers do not seem to fully leverage the potential of sophisticated forms of presentations of their data projects. The interviewees themselves demonstrate a strong believe in data journalism’s ability to transform journalism towards more transparency.
literature.abstract_cn: 在新闻预算缩减和媒体组织创新压力增加的时期，数据新闻作为新闻编辑室中仍在扩展的领域受到关注。该实践推动了量化和协作形式的新闻，而其从业者被认为进一步挑战现状。使用标准化的计算机辅助电话调查，本研究贡献了第一个关于德国数据新闻结构和实践的代表性定量调查。调查考察了德国报纸和公共广播商中数据记者的分布、数据新闻团队的构成、工作流程和所面临的挑战。研究结果显示，数据新闻在德国新闻编辑室中已建立一定基础，但数据记者仍面临资源有限、数据获取困难以及将数据新闻整合到常规新闻流程中的挑战。
literature.keywords: journalism, newspapers, media, broadcasters, quantitative

literature.title: Poaching the News Producers: The Athletic's Effect on Sports in Hometown Newspapers
literature.title_cn: 挖角新闻生产者：The Athletic对本地球队报纸体育报道的影响
literature.title_en: Poaching the News Producers: The Athletic's Effect on Sports in Hometown Newspapers
literature.author: Nicholas R. Buzzelli, Patrick Gentile, Andrew C. Billings, Sean R. Sadri
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT When The Athletic, a conglomerate of subscription-based sports sites, launched in 2016, both its business model and editorial stance were viewed as a seismic shift in the journalism industry. Built on the notion that readers would eagerly pay a monthly fee to have access to the type of in-depth, customized coverage that print outlets often failed to deliver, The Athletic garnered a reputation for poaching newspapers’ top sports talent with perceived job security and greater flexibility in terms of writing style. This zero-sum game approach has caused a disruption to the traditional rendering of culture and localized societal community within sports media. Therefore, to determine the type of impact that The Athletic's presence in hometown media markets has on local newspapers, 22 semi-structured in-depth interviews were conducted with sports editors and producers. The results illustrate that The Athletic presents competition on three fronts: one for top writing talent, one for content differentiation, and yet another for share of a market space flooded with other outlets. However, most interviewees agreed that the strongest form of direct competition is not for engaged readers, but rather for the most recognizable reporters in a given market.
literature.abstract_cn: 当订阅制体育网站联合体The Athletic于2016年推出时，其商业模式和编辑立场都被视为新闻业的地震式转变。建立在读者会乐于每月付费获得印刷媒体往往无法提供的深度定制报道的设想之上，The Athletic以挖走报纸顶级体育人才而闻名，提供感知的工作安全感和写作风格方面更大的灵活性。这种零和游戏的方法对体育媒体中文化和本地化社会社区的传统呈现造成了破坏。因此，为了确定The Athletic在本地媒体市场的存在对地方报纸的影响类型，研究人员对体育编辑和制作人进行了22次半结构化深度访谈。结果表明，The Athletic在三个方面构成竞争：一是争夺顶级写作人才，二是内容差异化，三是在充斥其他媒体的市场空间中争夺市场份额。然而，大多数受访者认为，最强大的直接竞争形式不是争夺参与度高的读者，而是争夺特定市场中最知名的记者。
literature.keywords: athletic, readers, in-depth, outlets, newspapers

literature.title: Diversifying Voice, Democratizing the News? A Content Analysis of Citizen News Sources in Spanish-language International Broadcasting
literature.title_cn: 多元化声音，民主化新闻？西语国际广播中公民新闻信源的内容分析
literature.title_en: Diversifying Voice, Democratizing the News? A Content Analysis of Citizen News Sources in Spanish-language International Broadcasting
literature.author: Miriam Hernández, Dani Madrid-Morales
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT This paper explores sourcing practices in three international broadcasters in Spanish: China’s CGTN Español, Iran’s HispanTV and Russia’s RT. Often described as counter-hegemonic, in that the worldview they present is not in alignment with dominant Anglo-American media, these three State-sponsored TV channels have grown their presence globally in recent years, but remain largely understudied. Drawing on literature about non-elite sourcing, source functions and public diplomacy, we examine the degree to which citizen sources are featured in these three channels, and, when that happens, how these sources are used to advance the foreign policy objectives that inform the broadcasters’ raison d’être (i.e., promoting the interest of their home country while challenging the international status quo). To do so, we conducted a quantitative content analysis of news stories broadcast in 2014 and 2017 (N = 1,265). Our results show the use of non-elite sources is not ubiquitous but strategic, and is often linked to critical reporting of countries that are not political allies. We also present evidence that the practice is not equally common across broadcasters.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了三个西班牙语国际广播机构的信源使用实践：中国的CGTN Español、伊朗的HispanTV和俄罗斯的RT。这三个国家资助的电视频道通常被描述为反霸权的，因为它们呈现的世界观与主流的英美媒体不一致，近年来其全球影响力不断增长，但仍很大程度上缺乏研究。本研究借鉴关于非精英信源、信源功能和公共外交的文献，考察了这三个频道对公民信源的运用程度，以及在被运用时这些信源如何被用来推进构成广播机构存在理由的外交政策目标（即促进母国利益同时挑战国际现状）。为此，我们对2014年和2017年播出的新闻进行了定量内容分析（N=1,265）。结果表明，非精英信源的使用并非无处不在而是策略性的，且往往与对非政治盟友国家的批判性报道相关联。我们还提供证据表明，这种做法在各广播机构之间的普遍程度并不相同。
literature.keywords: three, broadcasters, these, sources, sourcing

literature.title: “Stick to Sports” is Gone: A Field Theory Analysis of Sports Journalists’ Coverage of Socio-political Issues
literature.title_cn: “坚守体育”已成过去：体育记者社会政治议题报道的场域理论分析
literature.title_en: “Stick to Sports” is Gone: A Field Theory Analysis of Sports Journalists’ Coverage of Socio-political Issues
literature.author: Ryan Broussard
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT Sports journalists in the ‘60s and ‘70s had a seat to sports icons who changed the social status quo and some reporters wrote freely about those issues. But as top athletes took a nearly 40-year hiatus from standing for socio-political causes, sports journalism, too, became apolitical. Now with the re-introduction of activist-athletes, how sports journalists cover these issues can affect how society views these social and political causes. Using Bourdieu’s field theory, this study examined why sports journalists cover these social and political topics, and the contexts and conditions that make this reporting more or less likely to happen. Responses show they want to be seen as more than a sports reporter, cover these topics when they occur on the beat, cultural capital is a predictor in how much they cover the topic, and sports reporters appear to be moving towards an issue-based approach to coverage. A lack of resources may hinder their efforts to cover these topics.
literature.abstract_cn: 六七十年代的体育记者有机会接触改变社会现状的体育偶像，一些记者自由地报道了这些问题。但随着顶尖运动员对社会政治事业保持了近40年的沉默，体育新闻也变成了非政治的。现在随着行动主义运动员的重新出现，体育记者如何报道这些问题可以影响社会如何看待这些社会和政治事业。本研究运用布迪厄的场域理论，考察了体育记者为何报道这些社会和政治话题，以及使这种报道更可能或更不可能发生的语境和条件。受访者的回应显示，他们希望被看作不仅仅是体育记者，在他们负责的领域内报道这些话题，文化资本是一个预测因素。
literature.keywords: cover, these, journalists, social, topics

literature.title: A Social Media Analysis of the Gendered Representations of Female and Male Athletes During the 2018 Commonwealth Games
literature.title_cn: 2018年英联邦运动会男女运动员性别化呈现的社交媒体分析
literature.title_en: A Social Media Analysis of the Gendered Representations of Female and Male Athletes During the 2018 Commonwealth Games
literature.author: Elaine Chiao Ling Yang, Michelle Hayes, Jinyan Chen, Caroline Riot, Catheryn Khoo-Lattimore
literature.abstract: Contemporary sport culture is characterized as highly masculinized, where female athletes are continually marginalized in traditional media. Despite evidence suggesting that media representation of athletes has a meaningful impact on social outcomes and participation rates of women and girls, little is known about gendered representations of athletes on social media and in the context of mega-sporting events. This paper examines the gendered representations of athletes on Twitter during the 2018 Commonwealth Games using framing theory. A total of 133,338 tweets were analyzed using sentiment and word-frequency analyses. Results indicate gender differences concerning athlete representation on Twitter, albeit marginal. In particular, the findings reveal that seemingly neutral words (e.g., “dedicated,” “talented,” and “hard working”) could carry gendered connotations. Recommendations are provided to guide stakeholders to advance a more inclusive sport culture through the strategic use of social media during mega-sporting events.
literature.abstract_cn: 当代体育文化被描述为高度男性化的，女性运动员在传统媒体中持续被边缘化。尽管有证据表明运动员的媒体呈现对社会结果以及女性和女孩的参与率有重要影响，但对社交媒体上以及大型体育赛事背景下运动员性别化呈现的了解甚少。本文运用框架理论，考察了2018年英联邦运动会期间推特上运动员的性别化呈现。使用情感和词频分析对总共133,338条推文进行了分析。结果表明，尽管差异微小，推特上运动员的呈现确实存在性别差异。特别是，研究揭示表面上中性的词汇（如"专注"、"有天赋"和"勤奋"）可能带有性别内涵。研究提出建议，指导利益相关者通过在大规模体育赛事期间战略性使用社交媒体来推进更具包容性的体育文化。
literature.keywords: gender; representation; athlete; framing; twitter

literature.title: The Social Media Response From Athletes and Sport Organizations to COVID-19: An Altruistic Tone
literature.title_cn: 运动员与体育组织对新冠疫情的社交媒体回应：利他基调
literature.title_en: The Social Media Response From Athletes and Sport Organizations to COVID-19: An Altruistic Tone
literature.author: Stirling Sharpe, Charles Mountifield, Kevin Filo
literature.abstract: The global coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic has resulted in restrictions on gatherings of large crowds, the suspension of live sport events across the globe, and the relegation of topical televised sport to broadcasts of past events and competitions. Consequently, there has been a shift in focus from the entertainment aspect of sport to the health and well-being aspects of sport. As athletes, teams, and sport organizations have become subject to government legislation concerning physical distancing, self-isolation, and lockdowns, the resultant spare time has presented the opportunity for individual athletes and sport organizations to pursue an approach to social media that includes viral challenges, fundraising, and socializing online. This paper provides a commentary on select high-profile athletes’ and sport organizations’ social media behavior during the COVID-19 pandemic, which has adopted an altruistic tone.
literature.abstract_cn: 全球新冠病毒（COVID-19）大流行导致了对大型人群聚集的限制、全球现场体育赛事的暂停，以及时效性电视体育节目被降级为过去赛事和比赛的转播。因此，焦点从体育的娱乐方面转向了体育的健康和福祉方面。随着运动员、球队和体育组织受到关于物理距离、自我隔离和封锁的政府立法的约束，由此产生的空闲时间为个体运动员和体育组织追求一种包括病毒挑战、筹款和在线社交在内的社交媒体方法提供了机会。本文对疫情期间精选的高知名度运动员和体育组织所采取的具有利他主义基调的社交媒体行为进行了评论。
literature.keywords: covid; athlete; pandemic
literature.theoretical_framework: 国际传播理论、软实力理论

literature.title: The Impact of Legalization of Sports Gambling: How Motivation, Fandom, and Gender Influence Sport-Related Consumption
literature.title_cn: 体育博彩合法化的影响：动机、球迷热情与性别如何影响体育相关消费
literature.title_en: The Impact of Legalization of Sports Gambling: How Motivation, Fandom, and Gender Influence Sport-Related Consumption
literature.author: Dan Cason, Minkyo Lee, Jaedeock Lee, In-Sung Yeo, Edward J. Arner
literature.abstract: This study examined how the legalization of sports wagering, in association with several factors (i.e., gender, motivations, and fandom), has impacted gambling behavior, interests in sport, and sport-related consumption (e.g., media, ticket sales) using a sample of active gamblers above the age of 21 (N = 58). The findings showed that economic motivation significantly predicted gambling behavior, interests in sports, and sport-related consumption, while fandom did not. People who are motivated by money are more likely to wager on sport and consume sport. However, being a sport fan or not does not impact those variables. Based on the results of the current study, it could be suggested that, since sports wagering was recently legalized, sport organizations should move quickly to attract new and potential market segments (e.g., gamblers).
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了体育博彩合法化，结合几个因素（即性别、动机和粉丝身份），如何影响博彩行为、对体育的兴趣以及体育相关消费（如媒体、门票销售），使用21岁以上活跃博彩者的样本（N=58）。研究结果显示，经济动机显著预测了博彩行为、对体育的兴趣和体育相关消费，而粉丝身份则不然。被金钱驱动的人更可能参与体育博彩和消费体育。然而，是否是体育迷不影响这些变量。基于当前研究结果，可以建议体育组织应考虑博彩者的独特动机和消费模式，而非仅关注传统体育迷。
literature.keywords: gender; fandom; consumption

literature.title: Social Media Usage During Live Sport Consumption: Generation Gap and Gender Differences Among Season Ticket Holders
literature.title_cn: 现场体育消费中的社交媒体使用：季票持有者的代际与性别差异
literature.title_en: Social Media Usage During Live Sport Consumption: Generation Gap and Gender Differences Among Season Ticket Holders
literature.author: Yann Abdourazakou, Xuefei (Nancy) Deng, Gashaw Abeza
literature.abstract: This study sought to examine season ticket holders’ usage of social networking sites during live sport consumption. Informed by uses and gratifications theory, the study examined three types of social media use by fans—Twitter/Facebook posting, Instagram/Snapchat posting, and mobile app use—during a live game. Survey data of 400 season ticket holders of a professional National Basketball Association team were analyzed. Regression results showed that age was a significant predictor of the fans’ in-game social media use in terms of Instagram/Snapchat posting and mobile app use, whereas gender was a significant predictor of their Twitter/Facebook posting behavior. Moreover, the study showed a mixed result for the predicted moderating effect of the season ticket holders’ tenure on the predicted relationships between the two personal characteristics (age and gender) and the three types of social media use. Theoretical and practical implications of the study for sports marketing management are discussed.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在考察季票持有者在现场体育消费期间对社交网站的使用。在使用与满足理论的指导下，研究考察了球迷在直播比赛期间三种类型的社交媒体使用——推特/脸书发帖、Instagram/Snapchat发帖和移动应用使用。分析了一支职业NBA球队400名季票持有者的调查数据。回归结果显示，年龄是球迷社交媒体使用模式的显著预测因素，年轻球迷在直播比赛期间更频繁地使用社交媒体。性别也在社交媒体使用中发挥作用，男女在使用不同类型社交平台方面存在差异。研究发现揭示了现场体育消费中社交媒体使用的代际和性别差异，以及这些差异对体育营销和粉丝参与的启示。
literature.keywords: gender; consumption; twitter; facebook; instagram; basketball
literature.theoretical_framework: 使用与满足理论、性别理论

literature.title: Interview With Xu Jicheng, Director General of the Media Operation Department, Beijing 2022 Olympic and Paralympic Winter Games
literature.title_cn: 徐济成访谈：北京2022冬奥会及残奥会媒体运营部主任
literature.title_en: Interview With Xu Jicheng, Director General of the Media Operation Department, Beijing 2022 Olympic and Paralympic Winter Games
literature.author: Ximeng Shang, Wei Wei
literature.keywords: 媒体

literature.title: Changing the Game: My Career in Collegiate Sports Marketing
literature.title_cn: 改变游戏：我在大学体育营销的职业生涯
literature.title_en: Changing the Game: My Career in Collegiate Sports Marketing
literature.author: Zack P. Pedersen
literature.keywords: 体育; 体育营销; 游戏

literature.title: Sports Television and the Continuing Search for Alternative Programming
literature.title_cn: 体育电视与对替代性节目的持续探索
literature.title_en: Sports Television and the Continuing Search for Alternative Programming
literature.author: Branden Buehler
literature.abstract: The American sports television industry has scrambled to adjust to the loss of live sporting events in the wake of the coronavirus pandemic—a scramble clearly evidenced in programming schedules suddenly filled with replays of older event telecasts. However, rather than focusing on the apparent novelty of this type of substitute coronavirus programming, this article, instead, argues that the loss of live sporting events represents the amplification of a problem that television networks have already been grappling with for years: how to fill an ever greater number of outlets with sufficient year-round programming given a finite number of live events. With that in mind, this article proposes that many of the programming strategies that networks have turned to in the midst of the pandemic, including the expanded coverage of transactions (e.g., coverage of National Football League free agency) and the increased scheduling of documentaries (e.g., The Last Dance ), have been familiar extensions of previously established alternative programming solutions.
literature.abstract_cn: 美国体育电视产业在新冠疫情来袭后竞相调整以应对现场体育赛事缺失——这一慌乱在突然被旧赛事转播重播填满的节目表中清晰可见。然而，本文并非关注这类替代性疫情节目的表面新颖性，而是认为现场体育赛事的缺失代表了电视台多年来一直在努力应对的某一问题的放大：如何用有限的现场赛事数量填充日益增多的频道的全年节目。考虑到这一点，本文提出，电视网在疫情期间采用的许多节目策略——包括扩大交易报道（如NFL自由球员市场报道）和增加纪录片排播（如《最后之舞》）——都是先前已确立的替代节目方案的熟悉延伸。
literature.keywords: television; football; pandemic
literature.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、产业组织理论

literature.title: Personnel Economics in Sports
literature.title_cn: 体育中的人事经济学
literature.title_en: Personnel Economics in Sports
literature.author: Mark L. Howard
literature.keywords: 体育; 经济

literature.title: Rebooting Content: Broadcasting Sport and Esports to Homes During COVID-19
literature.title_cn: 重新开机：新冠疫情期间向家庭转播体育与电竞
literature.title_en: Rebooting Content: Broadcasting Sport and Esports to Homes During COVID-19
literature.author: Michael M. Goldman, David P. Hedlund
literature.abstract: Beginning in early March 2020, sport in the United States entered an unprecedented period of hiatus due to the COVID-19 pandemic. The postponement, suspension, and cancellation of live sporting events impacted every professional and amateur sport organization, from the National Basketball Association to the National Association for Stock Car Auto Racing, high school sports to college football, and even esports leagues. Although the abrupt cancellation of live sporting events was disruptive, it did create opportunities for the production of new media and consumption opportunities for sport leagues, teams, and their fans through different types of sport media broadcasts. This commentary examines how the U.S. sport industry developed media content strategies using new, mixed, and rebroadcasted content, across multiple broadcast and streaming platforms, to provide sport consumption opportunities to fans who were largely quarantined at home. This research contributes to the existing scholarship on live and rebroadcasted mediated content, while providing guidance to content owners and rights holders facing uncertainty in the marketplace.
literature.abstract_cn: 自2020年3月初起，美国体育因COVID-19疫情进入了一个前所未有的停摆时期。直播体育赛事的推迟、暂停和取消影响了每一个职业和业余体育组织，从NBA到全国赛车联合会、高中体育到大学橄榄球，甚至包括电竞联赛。尽管直播体育赛事的突然取消具有破坏性，但它确实为体育联盟、球队及其球迷通过不同类型的体育媒体转播创造了新的媒体制作和消费机会。本评论考察了美国体育产业如何利用新的、混合的和重新播出的内容，在多个转播和流媒体平台上制定媒体内容策略，为大量居家隔离的球迷提供体育消费机会。本研究为关于直播和重播媒介内容的现有学术文献作出贡献，同时为在市场中面对不确定性的内容所有者和权利持有者提供指导。
literature.keywords: broadcasting; esports; covid; streaming; football; basketball

literature.title: Aggregation as the Remedy for the Decline of Niche Sports Broadcasting: A Case Study of the European Championships
literature.title_cn: 聚合作为小众体育转播衰退的解方：欧洲锦标赛的案例研究
literature.title_en: Aggregation as the Remedy for the Decline of Niche Sports Broadcasting: A Case Study of the European Championships
literature.author: Henk Erik Meier, Jörg Hagenah, Malte Jetzke
literature.abstract: As Hutchins and Rowe have emphasized, digital plenitude will fundamentally affect sports broadcasting. In particular, niche sports will be confronted with a more difficult media environment in which the chances of being telecast may increase, while the chances of finding an audience are likely to decrease. Therefore, niche sports face the need to further submit to a media logic. The current research is a case study involving an analysis of the 2018 European Championships from a mediatization perspective. While the findings show how aggregation helped to revitalize audience interest, the case study reveals that the future of niche-sport broadcasting is uncertain, because the audience habits that the European Championships exploited are fading.
literature.abstract_cn: 正如哈钦斯和罗伊所强调的，数字丰盈将从根本上影响体育广播。特别是，利基体育将面临更困难的媒体环境，被电视转播的机会可能增加，而找到受众的机会却可能减少。因此，利基体育面临进一步服从媒体逻辑的需要。本研究是一项案例研究，从媒介化视角分析2018年欧洲锦标赛。虽然研究结果表明聚合帮助重振了受众兴趣，但案例研究揭示利基体育广播的未来是不确定的，因为欧洲锦标赛所利用的受众习惯正在消退。
literature.keywords: broadcasting; championship; audience
literature.theoretical_framework: 媒介化理论、受众研究理论

literature.title: Managing Social Media Content During a Global Crisis: Interview With Ben Read, Social Media Manager at World in Motion
literature.title_cn: 全球危机中的社交媒体内容管理：World in Motion社交媒体经理本·里德访谈
literature.title_en: Managing Social Media Content During a Global Crisis: Interview With Ben Read, Social Media Manager at World in Motion
literature.author: Charles Mountifield, Stirling Sharpe
literature.abstract: aaa In 2020, nations around the world quickly became engulfed in a crisis with the announcement that the COVID-19 virus had mushroomed to the point that it had become a pandemic. Subsequent to national government attempts to curtail the spread of the virus, there was an immediate impact on the sport industry. For sporting organizations, there was a cessation of competition and a lockdown for all those in the industry. In the absence of live sport, social media producers have been required to think outside of their normal content avenues to create posts that will engage their followers. Sport agency World in Motion—active in soccer, rugby, golf, boxing, and cricket—is an avid user of social media by way of engaging with clients and sports fans alike. As a result of the COVID-19 crisis, there have been significant changes to the focus of the company’s social media output. Ben Read, the organization’s social media manager, is responsible for the design and dissemination of information through various platforms, notably, Twitter (8,715 followers) and Instagram (2,251 followers). Read has been employed at World in Motion since May 2019. Prior to this, Read was an account manager at Rockford Components and completed a psychology degree in 2017. From 2014 to 2017, while at university, Ben was also an event manager for the university student union, where he honed his social media skills. This interview provides background to the customary aspects of Read’s role, including content creation and connecting with clients and sports fans. The interview then focuses on how Read’s approach to social media has changed in light of the global crisis, based principally around the cessation of live sport and the company’s wish to provide relevant and useful social media content.
literature.abstract_cn: 2020年，随着宣布COVID-19病毒已迅速蔓延到成为大流行病的程度，世界各国迅速陷入危机。继各国政府试图遏制病毒传播之后，体育产业立即受到冲击。对于体育组织来说，比赛停止，所有业内人士都被封锁。在缺乏现场体育的情况下，社交媒体制作人必须跳出他们正常的内容渠道思考，以创建能够吸引追随者的帖子。体育经纪公司World in Motion——活跃于足球、橄榄球、高尔夫、拳击和板球领域——是通过社交媒体与客户和体育迷互动的热心用户。由于新冠疫情危机，该公司社交媒体产出的重点发生了重大变化。该组织的社交媒体经理本·里德负责通过多个平台设计和传播信息，尤其是推特（8,715名关注者）和Instagram（2,251名关注者）。里德自2019年5月起在World in Motion工作。此前，里德是Rockford Components的客户经理，并于2017年完成了心理学学位。2014至2017年大学期间，本还担任大学学生会活动经理，在那里磨练了他的社交媒体技能。这次采访提供了里德角色惯常方面的背景，包括内容创作以及与客户和体育迷的联系。采访随后聚焦于在全球危机的背景下，里德的社交媒体方法如何变化，主要基于现场体育的停止以及公司希望提供相关有用的社交媒体内容。
literature.keywords: social, media, sport, world, crisis

literature.title: “It Has Changed Completely”: How Local Sports Broadcasters Adapted to No Sports
literature.title_cn: “一切都变了”：地方体育转播者如何适应无体育时期
literature.title_en: “It Has Changed Completely”: How Local Sports Broadcasters Adapted to No Sports
literature.author: Kevin Hull, Miles Romney
literature.abstract: When COVID-19 shut down the sports world, local sports broadcasters were without the games and events that traditionally fill the content of their shows. While national media outlets could dive deep into the archives to play old games and classic content, local sports broadcasters traditionally do not have that option. Therefore, the purpose of this study was to examine how the jobs and daily routines of local sports broadcasters changed in the immediate aftermath of the COVID-19 outbreak. A cross-section of local sports broadcasters from a variety of markets was surveyed, and, based on the responses, several themes emerged: (a) an emphasis on creativity, (b) a shift in daily responsibility, (c) and an uncertain future.
literature.abstract_cn: 当COVID-19让体育世界停摆时，地方体育转播员失去了通常填充其节目内容的比赛和赛事。尽管全国性媒体机构可以深入档案回放旧比赛和经典内容，地方体育转播员传统上却没有这种选择。因此，本研究的目的是考察COVID-19疫情爆发后立即出现的地方体育转播员的工作和日常安排发生了怎样的变化。研究者对来自不同市场的地方体育转播员进行了抽样调查，并根据受访结果归纳出几个主题：（1）强调创造力，（2）日常职责的转变，（3）不确定的未来。
literature.keywords: survey; covid

literature.title: Sports Ethics for Sports Management Professionals (2nd Edition)
literature.title_cn: 体育管理专业人士的体育伦理（第二版）
literature.title_en: Sports Ethics for Sports Management Professionals (2nd Edition)
literature.author: Andy Gillentine
literature.abstract: Walter T. Champion, Jr., Richard T. Karcher, and Lawrence S. Ruddell, the authors of Sports Ethics for Sports Management Professionals, should be commended for challenging readers of this text to consider the ethical considerations in multiple sport-based scenarios. They identify an “ethical malaise” that currently seems to be prominent in the sport industry. In the preface of the book, the authors identify multiple topics—race and discrimination, gender equity, gambling, violence, and drug use/abuse (among others)—that are prominent concerns not only in the sport context but also in society in general. As such, a sport management professional (SMP) must not only be well versed in each of these issues but also be aware of the impact of occurrences outside of the sports setting and vice versa. The stated goal for the book is admirable: “to assist the SMP in making the right decision when the situation arises” (p. vii). To facilitate this goal, the authors have structured the book into 12 chapters, each containing multiple case studies (both historic and current) to help readers practice their decision-making skills. The case studies also serve as a prompt for the careful consideration of all components of a given situation and encourage readers to examine the viewpoint of others to better understand the depth of the issue and/ or problem. Each case study also contains specific questions developed by the authors for the reader to consider. In addition, each chapter ends with a brief summary of important points from the chapter. Also included in each chapter is a well-constructed research list of materials used in the chapter. This also serves as a treasure trove for additional examination into each topic covered in the book. In Chapter 1, “Ethical Concepts in Sports,” the authors address the question “Why study sports ethics?” They clearly describe the perceived roles of sport in society (specifically in the United States) and identify the complex relationship these roles have with ethical decision making. They further state the importance of SMPs’ making ethical decisions in order to “perform their duties honestly, professionally and ethically” (p. 2). To help facilitate this obligation, the chapter introduces ethical reasoning and ethical models for the SMPs. Chapter 1 offers the reader a brief snapshot of basic ethical theories to provide a base for considering ethical implications of situations. This brief overview is well developed and does not “overwhelm” readers who may not be versed in ethics theory. The chapter concludes by introducing the concept of ethical decision making for SMPs and addresses major considerations for this process that they may encounter.
literature.abstract_cn: 《体育管理专业人士的体育伦理》的作者沃尔特·T·冠军、理查德·T·卡彻和劳伦斯·S·拉德尔应因挑战本书读者考虑多个体育场景中的伦理考量而受到赞扬。他们识别了当前似乎突出的体育产业中的"伦理弊病"。在书的序言中，作者识别了多个主题——种族和歧视、性别平等、赌博、暴力和药物使用/滥用（以及其他）——这些不仅在与体育相关的情境中是突出的关注点，在一般社会中也是如此。因此，体育管理专业人士（SMP）不仅必须精通这些问题中的每一个，还必须意识到体育环境之外事件的影响，反之亦然。本书声明的目标值得钦佩："在情况出现时协助SMP做出正确的决定"（第vii页）。为促进这一目标，作者将本书结构化为12章，每章包含多个案例研究（既有历史的也有当前的），以帮助读者练习决策技能。案例研究也作为对给定情况所有组成部分仔细考虑的提示，并鼓励读者考察他人的观点以更好地理解问题/或问题的深度。每个案例研究还包含作者为读者开发的具体问题供其考虑。此外，每章以本章要点的简短总结结束。每章还包含一章中所用材料的精心构建的研究清单。这也作为对本书涵盖的每个主题进行额外考察的宝库。在第1章"体育中的伦理概念"中，作者回答了"为什么研究体育伦理？"的问题。他们清楚地描述了体育在社会（特别是美国）中感知的作用，并识别了这些作用与伦理决策之间的复杂关系。他们进一步陈述了SMP做出伦理决定的重要性，以便"诚实、专业和合乎伦理地履行职责"（第2页）。为帮助履行这一义务，该章为SMP介绍了伦理推理和伦理模型。第1章为读者提供基本伦理理论的简要概述，为考虑情境的伦理影响提供基础。这一简要概述发展良好，不会"淹没"可能不精通伦理理论的读者。该章以介绍SMP的伦理决策概念作结，并讨论了他们在这一过程中可能遇到的主要考虑因素。
literature.keywords: ethical, chapter, authors, readers, sport

literature.title: How About Playing Games as a Career? The Evolution of E-Sports in the Eyes of Mainstream Media and Public Relations
literature.title_cn: 把玩游戏当职业如何？主流媒体与公关视角下电子竞技的演变
literature.title_en: How About Playing Games as a Career? The Evolution of E-Sports in the Eyes of Mainstream Media and Public Relations
literature.author: Jue Hou, Xiaoxu Yang, Elliot Panek
literature.abstract: This paper examined the media and public relations coverage of e-sport in China over a 17-yr period, focusing on how the representations of e-sport as a fast-growing industry have changed in China during that time. With the theoretical underpinning of media framing, the study used content analysis and examined 400 e-sport-related reports. Specifically, it investigated the tone of coverage, the topic emphasis of e-sport-related stories, and the use of jargon and statistics in the reports. In general, findings indicated that both mainstream media and public relations gradually covered e-sport issues in a more positive way as time went by. Similar to reporting on traditional sports, the topic emphasis changed from nongame issues to player and team performance in the contemporary climate. The findings highlight the importance of live-streaming platforms in e-sport development and suggest that more traditional-sport-styled media coverage of e-sport might benefit the industry. Finally, the study calls for an evaluation of media e-sport coverage in different cultural contexts and comparisons between e-sport’s and traditional sports’ representation in the contemporary media climate.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文考察了17年间中国电竞的媒体与公关报道，重点关注这一时期电竞作为快速成长行业的呈现方式发生了怎样的变化。以媒体框架理论为理论基础，研究采用内容分析法，考察了400篇与电竞相关的报道。具体而言，研究考察了报道的语气、电竞相关故事的议题侧重点，以及报道中对行话和统计数字的使用。总体而言，研究发现主流媒体和公关逐渐以更加积极的方式报道电竞议题。与传统体育报道相似，议题侧重从非比赛议题转向当代背景下对运动员和队伍表现的关注。研究结果凸显了直播平台在电竞发展中的重要性，并表明更多采用传统体育风格的媒体对电竞的报道可能有利于该产业。最后，研究呼吁在不同文化背景下评估媒体的电竞报道，并在当代媒体环境中比较电竞与传统体育的呈现方式。

literature.title: When Sport Event Work Stopped: Exposure of Sport Event Labor Precarity by the COVID-19 Pandemic
literature.title_cn: 当体育赛事工作停止：新冠疫情暴露的体育赛事劳动不稳定性
literature.title_en: When Sport Event Work Stopped: Exposure of Sport Event Labor Precarity by the COVID-19 Pandemic
literature.author: R. Dale Sheptak, Brian E. Menaker
literature.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic of 2020 has exposed major weaknesses in economic, governmental, and social structures that many have taken for granted in everyday life. The sport industry, which has gained unprecedented popularity in recent decades, is no exception. Decisions, driven in response to the COVID-19 outbreak, to suspend play in major sports leagues across the globe have exposed the precarious nature of the work situation that hourly event workers find themselves in. As the games stopped, so did the earnings of workers who impact essential aspects of the sport spectators’ experience. These workers include the part-time front of house staff for public assembly facilities, including ushers, concessions workers, ticket takers, and security personnel. This essay, drawing on ideas from C.W. Mills, Arne Kalleberg, and Guy Standing, will examine the impact of the pandemic on the employment of these workers by looking at the state of labor associated with sport and sports events. Furthermore, the essay will explore the challenges facing a class of workers who depend on numerous part-time or seasonal sports event jobs to scrape together an existence when sport suddenly stops. Finally, the essay will address the potential aftereffects of the COVID-19 pandemic on sport labor and consider how sport work could change as a result. This scholarly commentary lays the groundwork for further study and analysis of an important, yet rarely remarked on, aspect of employment morality and sport labor studies.
literature.abstract_cn: 2020年的新冠疫情暴露了日常经济、政府和社会结构中许多人认为理所当然的重大弱点。近几十年来获得空前流行的体育产业也不例外。为应对疫情而做出的暂停全球各大体育联盟比赛的决定，暴露了按小时计酬的赛事工人们所面临的工作状况的不稳定性。随着比赛停止，那些影响体育观众体验关键方面的工人们的收入也停止了。这些工人包括公共集会设施的兼职前台人员，如引座员、餐饮工作人员、售票员和安保人员。本文借鉴C.W.米尔斯、阿恩·卡勒贝格和盖伊·斯坦丁的思想，通过考察与体育和体育赛事相关的劳动力状况，审视疫情对这些工人就业的影响。此外，文章探讨了一个依赖众多兼职或季节性的体育赛事工作来勉强维持生计的工人类别在体育突然停止时所面临的挑战。最后，文章将讨论新冠疫情对体育劳动的可能后续影响，并考虑体育工作可能因此如何改变。这篇学术评论为进一步研究分析就业道德和体育劳动研究中一个重要但很少被提及的方面奠定了基础。
literature.keywords: labor; precarity; pandemic; covid
literature.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、产业组织理论

literature.title: Relationship Marketing: Revisiting the Scholarship in Sport Management and Sport Communication
literature.title_cn: 关系营销：重访体育管理与体育传播中的学术
literature.title_en: Relationship Marketing: Revisiting the Scholarship in Sport Management and Sport Communication
literature.author: Gashaw Abeza, Norm O’Reilly, Jessica R. Braunstein-Minkove
literature.abstract: Relational perspectives have influenced marketing theory and practice over the past 40 years, with a volume of relationship marketing (RM) research accumulating over this time. In sport management specifically, a number of RM research articles have been published since the late 1990s. Although an influx has been seen, a review of said literature informs us that RM is a diverse field with no single best explanation, no clear domain and scope, and no universally accepted definition and that, most particularly, the literature is a melting pot of various concepts. This circumstance creates frustration and confusion among new researchers. Additionally, as strategic communication strategies rely on clear and consistent messaging, it is pivotal to holistically address the issue. Therefore, adopting an integrative literature review approach, this commentary revisits the RM scholarship to present, brings attention to the complex nature of the RM literature, and identifies a point of departure for researchers attempting to find a fitting “home” for their research.
literature.abstract_cn: 过去40年来，关系视角一直影响着营销理论与实务，期间积累了大量的关系营销（RM）研究。具体到体育管理领域，自20世纪90年代末以来已发表了相当数量的关系营销研究论文。尽管数量激增，但对相关文献的回顾表明，关系营销是一个多元化的领域：没有单一的最佳解释，没有明确的领域与范围界定，也没有被普遍接受的定义，更重要的是，文献是各种概念的熔炉。这一状况令新研究者感到挫败与困惑。此外，由于战略传播策略依赖于清晰一致的讯息，全面解决这一问题至关重要。因此，本文采用整合性文献回顾法，重新审视关系营销文献，提请注意关系营销文献的复杂性质，并为试图为其研究寻找合适"归属地"的研究者指出了出发点。
literature.keywords: marketing
literature.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、产业组织理论

literature.title: Just a Fantasy? Examining Fantasy Sport in a Time Without Sport
literature.title_cn: 只是个幻想？审视没有体育之时的幻想体育
literature.title_en: Just a Fantasy? Examining Fantasy Sport in a Time Without Sport
literature.author: Brody J. Ruihley, Jacob Chamberlin
literature.abstract: The fantasy sport industry has seen tremendous growth over the past three decades. Estimated at 500,000 participants in 1988, the industry has had positive growth every step of the way to a current estimate of 59.3 million North American participants. Touting this incredible rise in participation, nothing has obstructed the growth of this sport media and communication phenomenon until now. The sport landscape and fantasy sport industry find themselves in a situation with complete absence of live sport. The Coronavirus crisis has impacted the fantasy sport community and thousands of professionals in many ways. This research commentary, supplemented with primary interview data, questions the stoppage of fantasy sport and explores conversations, planning, and reaction from the fantasy sport community.
literature.abstract_cn: 幻想体育产业在过去三十年经历了巨大增长。1988年估计有50万参与者，该产业每一步都在积极增长，目前估计北美有5930万参与者。尽管这一惊人的参与增长被广泛宣传，但此前没有任何因素阻碍这一体育媒体和传播现象的增长。如今，体育格局和幻想体育产业发现自己处于完全没有现场体育的情境中。新冠疫情危机以多种方式影响了幻想体育社区和数千名专业人士。这篇研究评论辅以一手访谈数据，质疑幻想体育的停摆，并探索了幻想体育社区的对话、规划和反应。
literature.keywords: community; fantasy sport; sport industry; sport community

literature.title_cn: 场域理论视域下的体育题材网络剧

literature.abstract: "互联网+"时代,体育题材电影相对缺失,电视剧相较以往数量减少,唯有网络剧在持续发展:播出数量年年递增;涉及体育项目越来越广,越来越新;内容热度逐渐上升。立足布尔迪厄的场域理论观察这一现象的本质,发现该场域内的行动者、惯习、资本已然发生变化,由此探讨体育题材网络剧作为体育媒体内容的生产与传播逻辑。

literature.title: 5G时代体育短视频生产传播的媒介趋向与引导机制研究
literature.title_cn: 5G时代体育短视频生产传播的媒介趋向与引导机制研究
literature.author: 王福秋
literature.abstract: 5G时代的到来将会带来新的媒介传播趋向,5G技术的媒介应用也将促进体育文化在万物互连新时代的传播与发展。文章基于5G时代背景对体育短视频生产传播的媒介趋向及引导机制进行研究,认为:5G时代人们将以"受众"与"授众"并存的角色促进体育短视频传播,用户思维及社会交往多元诉求将成为体育短视频的价值引导;体育短视频在5G时代传播的过程中,既有可能面对资本主导下的多元体育文化发展失衡,也要面对技术繁华下的内容创新匮乏、传统体育边缘化危机。为促进体育短视频在5G时代媒介融合中发展,建立适配的IP规则、鼓励多元协同创新、提升文化自觉观念和主体意识,共同构成了5G时代体育短视频生产与传播的媒介引导机制。

literature.title_cn: 传统武术国际传播的"非遗化编码"
literature.author: 侯小琴、张德胜
literature.abstract: 运用口述史方法,考察传统武术国际传播的编码规律,将研究聚焦于十多年来传统武术民间传人的国际传播活动,发现"非遗化"编码是传统武术国际传播的新理念,契合了新时代我国全方位、多层次、立体化的外交布局,使中国传统文化的国际感召力得到提高。将传统武术国际传播"非遗化编码"定位于"传统武术作为非物质文化遗产在国际社会的离散地衍化传承与跨文化调适",探寻新时代中国传统武术国际传播的新路径。

literature.title: 连接"体育与人":"互联网+"时代体育传媒的转型——基于颠覆性创新理论的考察
literature.title_cn: 连接"体育与人":"互联网+"时代体育传媒的转型——基于颠覆性创新理论的考察
literature.author: 付晓静、付志华
literature.abstract: 体育传媒转型是体育传播学研究的焦点议题之一。以往体育传媒作为"内容服务商"角色主要报道赛事、传递信息,随着互联网的深入发展,体育传媒的底层技术逻辑被颠覆,作为信息传播渠道的独占性与稀缺性已经被打破。在颠覆性创新理论的指导下,体育传媒要从持续性创新走向颠覆性创新,连接"体育与人",主导"互联网+体育"生态圈的流转,连接内容、情感、身体,推动体育产业生态体系创新。

literature.title: 新媒体时代中国冰雪运动文化传播的机遇、困境及路径
literature.title_cn: 新媒体时代中国冰雪运动文化传播的机遇、困境及路径
literature.author: 俞鹏飞、王庆军
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料、文本分析、归纳和演绎法探究新媒体时代冰雪运动文化的传播机遇、现实困境以及发展路径。研究发现，新媒体在拓宽冰雪运动文化传播的主体和用户面，延展传播渠道和形式，增强传播话语方面提供重要机遇。同时，新媒体时代本身的碎片传播、恶搞叙事以及内容泛娱乐化等问题也构成现实困境。

literature.title: 《申报》冰雪运动报道历史考察
literature.title_cn: 《申报》冰雪运动报道历史考察
literature.author: 谢振华、薛文婷
literature.abstract: 运用文献资料法等，从历史的维度考察中国近代重要媒体《申报》有关冰雪运动的报道，分析其时代价值。研究发现，《申报》冰雪运动报道呈现出三个特点：注重西方冰雪运动介绍及多议题的讨论；冰雪赛事报道与市民冰雪活动报道并重；关注女性对冰雪运动的参与。

literature.abstract: 2018年7月15日，万众瞩目的俄罗斯世界杯落下了帷幕。在莫斯科的卢日尼基体育场，法国队以4:2的比分战胜了克罗地亚，成功获得了该球队历史上第2次的世界杯冠军。在这一届万众瞩目的比赛当中，跨屏幕的各个平台都吸引了相当的流量。本文及时对2018年俄罗斯世界杯期间媒介接触行为和媒介受众行为的媒体报道进行分析综述。
