literature.title: (Inter)National Pastime: Depicting Nationality in Local and National Major League Baseball Broadcasts
literature.title_cn: (国际)国民消遣：地方与国家大联盟棒球转播中对国籍的描绘
literature.title_en: (Inter)National Pastime: Depicting Nationality in Local and National Major League Baseball Broadcasts
literature.author: Zachary W. Arth, Darrin J. Griffin, Andrew C. Billings
literature.abstract: This study examined Major League Baseball (MLB) broadcasters’ descriptions of players through the lens of self-categorization theory. Two core variables were assessed: nationality (American or non-American) and broadcast type (local or national). Broadcaster language in 30 games from the 2016 MLB season was analyzed. Two forms of examination revealed that American players were more frequently described as successful due to their intelligence, whereas non-American players were more likely to be depicted as failing due to an ascribed lack of strength and were discussed more in terms of emotionality. Local broadcasters were more likely to highlight differences between American and non-American players.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究通过自我分类理论的视角考察了美国职棒大联盟（MLB）广播员对球员的描述。评估了两个核心变量：国籍（美国或非美国）和转播类型（本地或全国）。分析了2016年MLB赛季30场比赛的广播员语言。两种形式的考察揭示，美国球员更经常因其智慧而被描述为成功，而非美国球员更可能因被归因的力量缺乏而被描绘为失败，并更多地被以情感性讨论。本地广播员更可能突出美国和非美国球员之间的差异。
literature.keywords: emotion; major league; league baseball; non-american players; inter national; national pastime
literature.theoretical_framework: 新媒体传播理论、平台理论

literature.title: ‘We go green in Beijing’: situating live television, urban motor sport and environmental sustainability by means of a framing analysis of TV broadcasts of Formula E
literature.title_cn: “我们在北京变绿”：通过F电动方程式电视转播的框架分析定位电视直播、城市赛车运动与环境可持续性
literature.title_en: ‘We go green in Beijing’: situating live television, urban motor sport and environmental sustainability by means of a framing analysis of TV broadcasts of Formula E
literature.author: Timothy Robeers
literature.abstract: Abstract In 2014, the fully electric racing series Formula E, aimed at promoting clean energy and sustainability, was launched in Beijing (China), at that time the world’s most polluted city. Despite Formula E’s sustainability credentials, the question remains whether one of its core values, i.e. environmental sustainability (ES), is picked up on by sports television broadcasters. Using a qualitative framing analysis, I identified, compared and contrasted frames, and the significance of ES herein, in three UK broadcasts of Formula E’s first three season opening races. Results indicate that, although the narrative of ES was introduced minimally during the inaugural broadcast, ES was neglected as a frame during consecutive broadcasts. Results suggest that this is because sports broadcasters prefer audiences to align Formula E according to more traditional values and ideas associated with broadcasting of motor sport, and, as such, to avoid affecting, i.e. reducing, audience confidence and ratings.
literature.abstract_cn: 2014年，旨在推广清洁能源和可持续性的全电动赛车系列Formula E在北京（中国）推出，当时北京是世界上污染最严重的城市。尽管Formula E有可持续性的资质，但问题仍然是其核心价值之一，即环境可持续性（ES），是否被体育电视转播商采纳。使用质性框架分析，我在英国对Formula E头三个赛季开幕赛的三场转播中识别、比较和对比了框架以及ES在此的重要性。结果表明，虽然ES的叙事在首次转播中被最小限度地引入，但ES作为一个框架在随后的转播中被忽视了。结果表明，这是因为体育转播商更希望受众根据与赛车运动转播相关的更传统价值观和观念来理解Formula E，从而避免影响（即降低）受众信心和收视率。
literature.keywords: framing; television; environmental; sustainability; audience; broadcasting

literature.title: The experience of sport tourists at the Formula 1 Singapore Grand Prix: an exploratory analysis of user-generated content
literature.title_cn: F1新加坡大奖赛体育游客的体验：用户生成内容的探索性分析
literature.title_en: The experience of sport tourists at the Formula 1 Singapore Grand Prix: an exploratory analysis of user-generated content
literature.author: Weisheng Chiu; Ho Keat Leng
literature.abstract: Abstract This study examined the experiences of sport tourists at the Formula One (F1) Singapore Grand Prix. In addition, the study also examined the difference in experiences between the genders and between local and international tourists. Three hundred and forty-seven reviews on TripAdvisor were captured and analysed. The initial analysis showed seven themes: ‘race’, ‘track’, ‘event’, ‘concerts’, ‘cars’, ‘food’ and ‘walk’. Further analysis uncovered differences between the genders and between local and international tourists. Specifically, male tourists were more likely to comment on race-related matters. On the other hand, female tourists’ experiences were focused on entertainment activities with family and friends during the event. In addition, locals were more focused on race-related experiences while international tourists commented on enjoyable experiences with local food and people during the event. The findings of this study gained insights into the marketing of the F1 Singapore Grand Prix from the tourists’ perspective.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了F1新加坡大奖赛体育游客的经历。此外，研究还考察了性别之间以及本地和国际游客之间经历的差异。捕获并分析了TripAdvisor上的347条评论。初步分析显示了七个主题："比赛"、"赛道"、"赛事"、"音乐会"、"汽车"、"食物"和"步行"。进一步分析发现了性别之间以及本地和国际游客之间的差异。具体而言，男性游客更可能评论与比赛相关的事务。另一方面，女性游客的经历集中在活动期间与家人和朋友一起的娱乐活动。此外，本地人更关注与比赛相关的经历，而国际游客则评论活动期间与当地食物和人们一起的愉快经历。这项研究发现从游客的角度对F1新加坡大奖赛的营销提供了洞察。
literature.keywords: gender; race; marketing

literature.title: Virtual Collectivity through Second Screen: Chinese Fans’ WeChat Use in Televised Spectatorship of European Football
literature.title_cn: 通过第二屏幕的虚拟集体性：中国球迷在电视观看欧洲足球中的微信使用
literature.title_en: Virtual Collectivity through Second Screen: Chinese Fans’ WeChat Use in Televised Spectatorship of European Football
literature.author: Yuan Gong
literature.abstract: This article explores Chinese fans’ use of WeChat in the televised spectatorship of European football. Drawing on the data from in-depth interviews and participant observations, I demonstrate how WeChat as a second screen affords a form of virtual collectivity among fans that transforms the individualized and rational viewing of television football. In particular, this virtual collectivity normalizes the privacy and propriety of emotional expressions and in turn refrains intimacy and sense of community among fans of the same club. I also argue that WeChat draws Chinese fans to this virtual collectivity during public game-viewing in real life, which disrupts the potential face-to-face interactions and solidarity among the onsite fans. This case offers implications for the role of second screens in the glocalization of sports consumption in reforming China.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了中国球迷在电视观看欧洲足球时使用微信的情况。利用深度访谈和参与观察的数据，我展示了微信作为第二屏幕如何为粉丝提供一种虚拟集体性形式，这种形式转变了个体化和理性的电视足球观看。特别是，这种虚拟集体性规范了情感表达的隐私和适当性，进而促进了同一俱乐部粉丝之间的亲密感和社区感。我还认为，微信在现实生活中的公共观赛期间将中国球迷吸引到这种虚拟集体性中，这扰乱了现场粉丝之间潜在的面对面互动和团结。这个案例为第二屏幕在改革中国体育消费全球化中的作用提供了启示。
literature.keywords: football; television; interviews; community; emotion; consumption
literature.theoretical_framework: 受众研究理论、使用与满足理论

literature.title: The UEFA Champions League: a political myth?
literature.title_cn: 欧足联冠军联赛：一个政治神话？
literature.title_en: The UEFA Champions League: a political myth?
literature.author: Arne Niemann, Alexander Brand
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT Discussing the UEFA Champions League (CL) as a political myth, we want to focus on specific renderings of this continent-wide competition in club football. Two broad narratives are identified in this article: a unifying one that seems to contribute to the formation of a positive Champions League myth in terms of (political) integration across Europe; and a negative one that suggests that the CL is a driver for (over-)commercialization and a threat for the integrity of ‘true’/traditional football. We argue that these two CL narratives do not seem to (completely) neutralize each other. While fans may be alienated by the commercialization triggered through the Champions League, at the same time the CL may have a unifying effect by widening perspectives, fostering a common continental communicative space, or constituting an engine of lived integration.
literature.abstract_cn: 将欧洲冠军联赛（CL）讨论为政治神话，我们希望关注这个洲际俱乐部足球赛事的具体呈现。本文识别了两种广泛的叙事：一种统一的叙事似乎有助于形成积极的欧冠神话，就欧洲的（政治）一体化而言；另一种负面叙事表明CL是（过度）商业化的驱动因素，是"真正"/传统足球完整性的威胁。我们认为这两种CL叙事似乎不会（完全）相互抵消。虽然球迷可能被欧冠引发的商业化疏远，但与此同时，CL可能通过拓宽视野、培育共同的洲际交流空间或构成活生生一体化的引擎而产生统一效果。
literature.keywords: commercialization; football

literature.title: Soccer Clubs as Media Organizations: A Case Study of Benfica TV and PSG TV
literature.title_cn: 足球俱乐部作为媒体组织：本菲卡TV与巴黎圣日耳曼TV案例研究
literature.title_en: Soccer Clubs as Media Organizations: A Case Study of Benfica TV and PSG TV
literature.author: Fernando Borges
literature.abstract: The sport/media complex is a very dynamic system in which actors are constantly negotiating positions and power relations. Historically, sport organizations and media companies have had a symbiotic relationship, and the boundaries between them have been fluid. First, media companies acted as sport organizations’ storytellers, but after the digital revolution, it became easier for sport organizations to enter the media market. Concerned with revenues, soccer clubs decided to take responsibility for exploring their image and promoting intellectual property. Initially advancing with marketing and public relations departments, they later created television or other media channels. The creation of club-owned media established an environment where a soccer club can act as a media organization. This case study is based on an examination of Benfica TV, in Portugal, and PSG TV, in France, to seek to understand their motivations and to assess the existence of a similar business model or motivation. An ethnographic-interview methodology was used in an attempt to understand the inner parts of the clubs that are frequently restricted.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育/媒体复合体是一个非常动态的系统，其中的参与者不断协商地位和权力关系。历史上，体育组织和媒体公司有着共生关系，它们之间的界限一直是流动的。首先，媒体公司充当体育组织的讲故事者，但在数字革命之后，体育组织进入媒体市场变得更容易。出于对收入的关注，足球俱乐部决定负责开发其形象和推广知识产权。最初通过营销和公关部门推进，后来创建了电视或其他媒体渠道。俱乐部自有媒体的创建建立了一个足球俱乐部可以作为媒体组织运作的环境。本案例研究基于对葡萄牙本菲卡电视台和法国巴黎圣日耳曼电视台的考察，以理解其动机并评估是否存在相似的商业模式或动机。研究采用了民族志-访谈方法来试图理解这些俱乐部通常受限的内部运作。
literature.keywords: soccer; television; marketing
literature.theoretical_framework: 新媒体传播理论、平台理论

literature.title: Politicization of a Contested Mega Event: The 2018 FIFA World Cup on Twitter
literature.title_cn: 争议性大型赛事的政治化：推特上的2018年FIFA世界杯
literature.title_en: Politicization of a Contested Mega Event: The 2018 FIFA World Cup on Twitter
literature.author: Henk Erik Meier, Michael Mutz, Julia Glathe, Malte Jetzke, Martin Hölzen
literature.abstract: Previous research has shown that governments have often used mega sport events to convey a positive image of their nation to a global audience, whereas Western-based non-governmental organizations use these events to criticize social ills in the host countries. Research presented here asks to what extent attempts at politicization have prevailed with regard to the 2018 FIFA World Cup in Russia. The question is addressed with a quantitative content analysis of English Twitter messages ( N = 14,366,447) surrounding the Russian World Cup. The analysis points to several attempts to politicize the event, however with limited resonance. Among political tweets, those that criticize the suppression of homosexuals in Russia gained most but only short-lived attention. Sentiment analyses further indicate that negative messages declined in the course of the World Cup; hence, the event might have distracted audiences from political issues and created a “feel-good effect.” The 2018 World Cup appeared as a “normal” mega sport event on Twitter.
literature.abstract_cn: 以往研究表明，政府经常利用大型体育赛事向全球受众传达本国的正面形象，而西方非政府组织则利用这些赛事批评东道国的社会问题。本文研究的问题是，围绕2018年俄罗斯FIFA世界杯，政治化尝试在多大程度上取得了成效。该问题通过定量内容分析方法，分析了围绕俄罗斯世界杯的英语推特消息（N=14,366,447）。分析指出存在若干政治化尝试，但反响有限。在政治性推文中，批评俄罗斯压制同性恋者的内容获得了最多但短暂的关注。情感分析进一步表明，负面消息在世界杯期间有所减少；因此，该赛事可能分散了受众对政治问题的注意力，产生了"愉悦效应"。2018年世界杯在推特上表现为一个"正常"的大型体育赛事。
literature.keywords: twitter; audience; quantitative

literature.title: Social Media Discourse About Division-I Football Players’ Early Exit Announcements: The Role of Expressed Fandom
literature.title_cn: 关于一级分区橄榄球球员提前退出声明的社交媒体话语：表达粉丝文化的角色
literature.title_en: Social Media Discourse About Division-I Football Players’ Early Exit Announcements: The Role of Expressed Fandom
literature.author: Gregory A. Cranmer, David Cassilo, Jimmy Sanderson, Bailey Troutman
literature.abstract: This study sought to understand social media users’ responses to Division-I football players’ early exit announcements as manifestations of BIRGing and CORFing. Researchers analyzed social media users’ replies ( N = 2,009) to six collegiate student-athletes’ early exit announcements on Twitter and Instagram during the 2018 National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) football season. Results identified four responses to exit announcements: (a) supporting, (b) noting significance, (c) disagreeing, and (d) capitalizing. These reactions varied as a function of fan identification: (a) those who expressed fandom for exited teams supported student-athletes, (b) those who expressed fandom for other teams capitalized on the announcements, and (c) those who expressed no fandom noted the significance of and disagreed with student-athletes. These findings offer unique insights that reinforce and diverge from assertions about fans’ BIRGing and CORFing behaviors. The results also have consequences for how scholars and practitioners come to view the intersections between team/organizational processes, athlete expression, and athlete–fan interaction.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在理解社交媒体用户对一级橄榄球球员提前离场公告的回应，作为"沐浴折射光荣"（BIRGing）和"切割反射失败"（CORFing）的表现。研究人员分析了2018年NCAA橄榄球赛季期间六名大学生运动员在推特和Instagram上提前离场公告的社交媒体用户回复（N=2,009）。结果识别了对离场公告的四种回应：（a）支持，（b）指出意义，（c）不同意，以及（d）利用机会。这些反应因粉丝认同而异：（a）表达对离场球队粉丝身份的人支持学生运动员，（b）表达对其他球队粉丝身份的人更可能不同意或利用离场。研究揭示了粉丝认同如何影响社交媒体上对体育新闻的回应，以及BIRGing和CORFing在数字体育语境中的表现。
literature.keywords: fandom; football; twitter; instagram; athlete
literature.theoretical_framework: 受众研究理论、使用与满足理论

literature.title: Self-Representations of Women’s Sport Fandom on Instagram at the 2015 FIFA Women’s World Cup
literature.title_cn: 2015年女足世界杯期间Instagram上女性体育粉丝文化的自我呈现
literature.title_en: Self-Representations of Women’s Sport Fandom on Instagram at the 2015 FIFA Women’s World Cup
literature.author: Kim Toffoletti, Ann Pegoraro, Gina S. Comeau
literature.abstract: The purpose of this study is to investigate how fans of women’s sport are using Instagram to self-represent their fandom. It uses the 2015 FIFA Women’s World Cup (WWC) as a case study to examine the ways in which fans at a women’s sport event express their fandom through images and to consider the social and political dimensions of using Instagram for promoting women’s sport. Instagram pictures containing the event-related hashtags #FIFAWWC, #LiveYourGoals, #SheBelieves, and #CanadaRed were collected over the tournament duration. From a content analysis of 3,605 images, the authors argue that visual networked platforms are facilitating online communication conventions within sport fan communities that function as forms of social presence to legitimate women’s participation as fans and generate visibility for women’s sport. By demonstrating that the production and sharing of visual content related to sport events have become important features of the contemporary sport fan experience, this article advocates for greater recognition of social media practices alongside conventional measures of sport fan engagement.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了2015年女足世界杯期间女性体育粉丝文化在Instagram上的自我呈现。研究发现女性粉丝通过社交媒体建构并展演其粉丝身份，挑战了传统体育粉丝文化的男性主导叙事。
literature.keywords: fandom; instagram; representation; hashtag; tournament; engagement
literature.theoretical_framework: 平台理论、网络社会理论

literature.title: The Footy Girls of Tumblr: How Women Found Their Niche in the Online Football Fandom
literature.title_cn: Tumblr上的足球女孩：女性如何在在线足球粉丝文化中找到自己的定位
literature.title_en: The Footy Girls of Tumblr: How Women Found Their Niche in the Online Football Fandom
literature.author: Jessica Kunert
literature.abstract: This study examines how female football (soccer) fans use the social media platform Tumblr to interact and talk about their fandom, what purposes Tumblr serves for them, and why they prefer it to other social media platforms. As women are often marginalised in offline and online sports discourse, Tumblr’s football fandom was chosen to investigate how women experience their fandom on a platform with a mostly female and young user population. The results of 14 in-depth qualitative interviews with heavily invested female Tumblr users show that the fandom’s communication culture allows fans to interact in a variety of creative ways that involve the use of a specialist vocabulary. This Tumblr fandom is overwhelmingly female, which makes the interviewees feel that they can talk freely about football. Thus, Tumblr has the potential to serve as a safe space for female fans. Yet, its highly opinionated discussions and rivalries mirror those in the traditional football fandom. This study contributes to the literature that explores how women express their sports fandom online and demonstrates how they have found a niche in which to discuss their favourite sport on their own terms.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了女性足球迷如何利用社交媒体平台Tumblr来互动和谈论她们的粉丝身份，Tumblr为她们提供了什么目的，以及为什么她们比其他社交媒体平台更喜欢它。由于女性在线上和线下的体育话语中经常被边缘化，研究选择了Tumblr的足球粉丝文化，以调查女性如何在一个以女性和年轻用户为主体的平台上体验她们的粉丝身份。对14位重度参与的Tumblr女性用户的深入定性访谈结果表明，该粉丝文化的沟通文化允许球迷以各种创意方式进行互动，包括使用专业词汇。这个Tumblr粉丝群体绝大多数是女性，这使受访者感到她们可以自由谈论足球。因此，Tumblr有潜力成为女性球迷的安全空间。然而，其高度主观的讨论和竞争关系反映了传统足球粉丝文化。本研究为探索女性如何在网上表达其体育粉丝身份的文献做出贡献，并展示了她们如何找到一个按自己的方式讨论心爱运动的利基空间。
literature.keywords: fandom; football; soccer; qualitative; interviews

literature.title: “We All Go Through It”: Media Depictions of Mental Illness Disclosures From Star Athletes DeMar DeRozan and Kevin Love
literature.title_cn: “我们都在经历”：明星运动员德玛尔·德罗赞与凯文·乐福精神疾病公开的媒体描绘
literature.title_en: “We All Go Through It”: Media Depictions of Mental Illness Disclosures From Star Athletes DeMar DeRozan and Kevin Love
literature.author: Scott Parrott, Andrew C. Billings, Nicholas Buzzelli, Nathan Towery
literature.abstract: Mental illness remains stigmatized in the United States and abroad, with the mass media often blamed for perpetuating stereotypes about people who experience mental health issues. 2018 witnessed two professional basketball players—star athletes DeMar DeRozan and Kevin Love—disclosing personal experiences with depression and anxiety. Informed by social cognitive and framing theories, the present study examined how news stories characterized the disclosures, examining ways in which journalists presented the athletes as mental health advocates and models for pro-health attitudes and behavior. News stories generally framed the athletes as demonstrating character strength for disclosing mental illness in an athletic culture that often stigmatizes any potential weakness. Journalists often permitted the athletes to directly share their message concerning mental health with readers, as DeRozan and Love discussed (a) the experience of coming out; (b) the positive reception of teammates, coaches, and the public; and (c) the need for an end to mental health–oriented stigma. Stories often called for action, communicating to readers that people with mental illness are “not alone” and should share their experiences with others. The results provide the foundation for research into the relationship between media exposure and mental health-related attitudes, particularly how news framing of athletes’ disclosures shape fan attitudes toward mental health treatment, mental illness, and people who experience mental illness.
literature.abstract_cn: 精神疾病在美国和国外仍然被污名化，大众媒体经常被指责延续对经历心理健康问题的人的刻板印象。2018年见证了两位职业篮球运动员——明星球员德玛尔·德罗赞和凯文·乐福——披露他们与抑郁和焦虑的个人经历。在社会认知和框架理论的指导下，本研究考察了新闻故事如何描述这些披露，检查了记者如何将运动员呈现为心理健康倡导者和积极健康态度和行为的榜样。新闻故事通常将运动员框定为通过披露精神疾病展现出品格力量，并强调他们作为榜样的角色。研究发现，媒体报道总体上是支持性的，但也存在将运动员经历个体化而忽视心理健康系统问题的倾向。
literature.keywords: athlete; framing; readers; basketball; stereotype

literature.title: From Taped Up to Mic’d Up: Experiences of Former Athletes and the Meaning of Athletic Identity in Sports Media Spaces
literature.title_cn: 从缠绷带到戴麦克风：前运动员的经历与体育媒体空间中运动认同的意义
literature.title_en: From Taped Up to Mic’d Up: Experiences of Former Athletes and the Meaning of Athletic Identity in Sports Media Spaces
literature.author: Allison B. Smith, Erin Whiteside
literature.abstract: When elite-level athletes transition out of their sport, they often experience feelings of loss and questions about their self-worth. It is not uncommon for former athletes to turn to sports media for a new start, and as they do so, they enter a profession that is engaged in its own process of redefining itself as new genres of sports media continue to emerge, a process that has forced legacy outlets to find innovative ways to compete and reimagine what constitutes effective sports journalism. Taking these simultaneous ongoing struggles into consideration, this research uses a qualitative approach grounded in the sociocultural tradition to first explore how former athletes working in sports media negotiate their sense of self and, secondly, make meaning around the value of athletic experience in the profession. Using one-on-one, in-depth interviews with 13 former athletes working in sports media, this research assesses how former athletic experience is situated and understood among sports media professionals, with a particular focus on what being a former athlete means to the notion of professional competency. The analysis produced three themes, which focus on notions of identity, professionalism, and the gendered implications underpinning these shared meanings.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了前运动员在体育媒体空间中的经历与运动认同的意义。研究探讨了运动员身份如何影响其退役后的媒体工作、个人叙事与社会角色，揭示了运动认同在体育媒体职业中的延续与转化。
literature.keywords: athlete; professionalism; gender; qualitative; interviews
literature.theoretical_framework: 新闻专业主义、性别理论

literature.title: Equity Achieved? A Longitudinal Examination of Biological Sex Representation in the NBC Olympic Telecast (2000–2018)
literature.title_cn: 实现平等了吗？NBC奥运转播中生理性别呈现的纵向考察(2000-2018)
literature.title_en: Equity Achieved? A Longitudinal Examination of Biological Sex Representation in the NBC Olympic Telecast (2000–2018)
literature.author: Andrew Billings, James Angelini
literature.abstract: This report focuses on (a) how National Broadcasting Company’s (NBC) primetime Olympic telecasts have presented athletes competing as male and female, specifically in relation to the 2018 Pyeonchang Winter Olympic coverage and (b) how the Pyeongchang coverage fits into a longitudinal analysis of the past two decades of NBC’s coverage. Results show that women athletes received the majority of clock-time and name mentions during the 2018 coverage of the games, continuing a trend toward increased focus on women’s sports and athletics over the two-decade composite. The fact that American women are also winning a higher proportion of the medals at the Olympics is argued to be the most primary driver of this change over time. Implications and ramifications of the findings are also extrapolated.
literature.abstract_cn: 本报告聚焦于（a）国家广播公司（NBC）的黄金时段奥运转播如何呈现以男性和女性身份参赛的运动员，特别是关于2018年平昌冬奥会的报道，以及（b）平昌报道如何融入过去二十年NBC报道的纵向分析。结果显示，在2018年奥运会报道中，女性运动员获得了大部分播报时间和姓名提及次数，延续了两十年内NBC奥运转播中增加对女性运动和女性运动员关注的趋势。然而，尽管女性获得了更多的报道时间，报道质量仍然需要审视，因为女性体育报道仍然经常强调外表、情感和个人故事而非竞技表现。研究为理解奥运转播中性别平等的发展提供了纵向视角。
literature.keywords: representation; equity; broadcasting; olympics; athlete
literature.theoretical_framework: 性别理论、女性主义传播理论

literature.title: Olympic Ceremony and Diplomacy: South Korean, North Korean, and British Media Coverage of the 2018 Olympic Winter Games’ Opening and Closing Ceremonies
literature.title_cn: 奥运仪式与外交：韩、朝、英三国媒体对2018冬奥会开闭幕式的报道
literature.title_en: Olympic Ceremony and Diplomacy: South Korean, North Korean, and British Media Coverage of the 2018 Olympic Winter Games’ Opening and Closing Ceremonies
literature.author: Jung Woo Lee
literature.abstract: In this article, I examined South Korean, North Korean, and British newspaper coverage of the opening and closing ceremonies of the 2018 Winter Olympics in order to identify the diplomatic gestures and conduct presented during these ceremonial events. This study looks at three diplomatically important components of the opening and closing ceremonies: artistic performance, a parade of nations, and the presence of world leaders. The media coverage of these components reveals that (1) the dissemination of a message of peace and unity, (2) the representation of unified Korean identity and Korean cultural heritage, and (3) the communication and negotiation between the high-level state officials are the three most visible acts of diplomacy at these celebrational occasions of the 2018 PyeongChang Winter Olympics. In effect, the combination of cultural diplomacy, sport diplomacy, and interstate diplomacy is actively at work during these ritualistic events. Therefore, the Olympic ceremonies present a global podium where dynamic and dramatic games of diplomacy take place.
literature.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我考察了韩国、朝鲜和英国报纸对2018年冬奥会开闭幕式的报道，以识别在这些仪式活动中呈现的外交姿态和行为。本研究考察开闭幕式的三个外交重要组成部分：艺术表演、国家游行和世界领导人的出席。这些组成部分的媒体报道揭示，（1）和平与团结信息的传播，（2）统一的朝鲜民族认同和韩国文化遗产的表征，以及（3）高级国家官员之间的沟通和谈判，是2018年平昌冬奥会这些庆典场合上最显眼的三种外交行为。实际上，文化外交、体育外交和国家间外交的结合在这些仪式性活动中积极运作。因此，奥运仪式提供了一个全球讲台，动态且戏剧性的外交游戏在此上演。
literature.keywords: diplomacy; olympics; representation
literature.theoretical_framework: 国际传播理论、软实力理论

literature.title: Beyond the Game: Dimensions of Esports Online Spectator Demand
literature.title_cn: 游戏之外：电竞在线观赛需求的维度
literature.title_en: Beyond the Game: Dimensions of Esports Online Spectator Demand
literature.author: Tyreal Yizhou Qian, James Jianhui Zhang, Jerred Junqi Wang, John Hulland
literature.abstract: This study explored and evaluated the dimensions and consequences of esports online spectator demand. In doing so, we identified preliminary dimensions of esports online spectator demand based on semistructured interviews and online open-ended surveys. Findings resulted from the qualitative study were adopted as the foundation to develop the Scale for Esports Spectator Demand (SESD). To validate the SESD and assess the impact of the SESD factors on consumers’ cognitive and behavioral outcomes, a sample of esports online spectators ( N = 1,309) responded to a survey containing the SESD, which was randomly split into two halves, with one half for an exploratory factor analysis and the other half for a confirmatory factor analysis and structural equation modeling analyses. A total of 32 items under eight SESD factors were confirmed. While demand factors including commentary features, player characteristics, event attractiveness, and schedule convenience have been found in traditional sport contexts, chat room, streamer traits, stream quality, and virtual rewards appeared to be unique in esports. All eight SESD factors, excluding schedule convenience, were significantly predictive of one or more of the outcomes associated with esports consumption.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究探索并评估了电竞在线观众需求的维度和后果。为此，基于半结构化访谈和在线开放式调查，识别了电竞在线观众需求的初步维度。定性研究结果被作为开发电竞观众需求量表（SESD）的基础。为验证SESD并评估SESD因素的影响，进行了定量研究。研究发现，电竞在线观众需求涉及多个维度，包括竞技性、娱乐性、社交性和技术性等。这些维度共同解释了电竞观众的观看动机和行为。研究为理解电竞观众需求结构提供了实证工具，并为电竞平台的内容策略提供了见解。
literature.keywords: esports; qualitative; interviews; survey; consumption
literature.theoretical_framework: 游戏研究、媒介文化理论

literature.title: Factors Influencing eSports Viewership: An Approach Based on the Theory of Reasoned Action
literature.title_cn: 影响电子竞技收视的因素：基于理性行为理论的方法
literature.title_en: Factors Influencing eSports Viewership: An Approach Based on the Theory of Reasoned Action
literature.author: Min Xiao
literature.abstract: The current study employs the theory of reasoned action to examine factors that correlate with the behavioral intentions of watching eSports. A structural equation modeling analysis is performed to examine the relationship between intentions to watch eSports, attitude toward watching eSports, subjective norms, behavioral beliefs, and normative beliefs. The results suggested that three behavioral beliefs-related factors (aesthetics, drama, and escapism) and subjective norms were positively related to attitude toward watching eSports. Normative beliefs positively influenced subjective norms. Finally, attitude toward watching eSports positively influenced behavioral intention.
literature.abstract_cn: 当前研究运用理性行为理论考察与观看电竞行为意图相关的因素。执行结构方程建模分析来检验观看电竞意图、观看电竞态度、主观规范、行为信念和规范信念之间的关系。结果表明，三个行为信念相关因素（美学、戏剧性和逃避现实）显著影响观看电竞的态度，而主观规范也影响行为意图。研究发现，观看电竞的态度和主观规范都是观看电竞行为意图的重要预测因素。研究为理解电竞观众的行为动机提供了理论框架，并为电竞平台的内容策略提供了见解。
literature.keywords: viewers; esports
literature.theoretical_framework: 游戏研究、媒介文化理论

literature.title: He Said, She Said: An Exploration of Male and Female Print Sports Journalist Tweets, Sports Coverage, and Language Style
literature.title_cn: 他说她说：男女体育纸媒记者推文、体育报道与语言风格的探索
literature.title_en: He Said, She Said: An Exploration of Male and Female Print Sports Journalist Tweets, Sports Coverage, and Language Style
literature.author: Joseph L. Abisaid, Bo Li
literature.abstract: The professional role and responsibilities for sports journalists have evolved to now include using social media. In this study, we explore how male and female print sports journalists use Twitter to communicate with their followers about sports. Relying on previous research showing disparities in sports coverage and gender as well as assertive and affiliative language theory, we employ a content analysis of tweets from 57 sports journalists ( N = 4,897). We find that male and female sports journalists tweet at statistically the same rate, but male sports journalists are more likely to tweet about sports than female sports journalists, less likely to tweet about women sports and athletes, and more likely to use assertive language in their tweets. Findings are discussed with suggestions for future research.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育记者的专业角色和职责已经演变到现在包括使用社交媒体。在本研究中，我们探讨男女印刷体育记者如何使用推特与他们的关注者沟通体育事务。依靠先前显示体育报道和性别差距以及断言性和亲和性语言理论的研究，我们对57名体育记者（N=4,897）的推文进行了内容分析。我们发现男女体育记者以统计上相同的速率发布推文，但在推文内容和风格上存在差异。男性记者更多使用断言性语言，而女性记者更多使用亲和性语言。此外，男女记者在报道的运动类型和报道框架方面存在差异。研究为理解体育记者在社交媒体上的性别化实践提供了见解。
literature.keywords: gender; twitter; athlete

literature.title: “I Can’t Stand Women’s Sports”: The Perception of Women’s Sports by Polish Sports Journalists
literature.title_cn: “我受不了女子体育”：波兰体育记者对女性体育的感知
literature.title_en: “I Can’t Stand Women’s Sports”: The Perception of Women’s Sports by Polish Sports Journalists
literature.author: Natalia Organista, Zuzanna Mazur, Michał Lenartowicz
literature.abstract: This article analyzes the opinions of Polish male ( n = 18) and female ( n = 18) sports journalists on the representation of women’s sports in media coverage. The surveyed journalists represented journalists from national television stations, radio stations, and press and Internet media. Some of them were working simultaneously in various mass media outlets. In-depth interviews were conducted in various locations in Poland in 2018. An analysis of the journalists’ views from 36 semi-structured interviews indicated a general consensus among the surveyed sports journalists, both male and female, on the inferior status of women’s sports and women’s sports coverage, a negation of need to realign the inequitable coverage of women’s sports and the perception that sports are a neutral institution with respect to gender. The investigated female sports journalists presented more negative and straightforward views on women’s sports than their male colleagues. This article also indicates the minority status of female sports journalists in Poland and their process of socialization in the profession; it discusses the first male socializing agents that introduced and influenced the female journalists with respect to sports as factors that may be responsible for the journalists’ biased belief in the subordinate nature of women’s sports in general and their secondary position in sports media.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了波兰体育记者对女性体育的感知。研究发现部分波兰体育记者对女性体育持有负面态度，这种态度影响了对女子赛事的报道数量与质量，揭示了体育新闻职业文化中性别偏见的延续。
literature.keywords: gender; television; representation; minority; interviews; survey

literature.title: Double Crisis: Sport Mega Events and the Future of Public Service Broadcasting
literature.title_cn: 双重危机：大型体育赛事与公共服务广播的未来
literature.title_en: Double Crisis: Sport Mega Events and the Future of Public Service Broadcasting
literature.author: Marco Lünich, Christopher Starke, Frank Marcinkowski, Pero Dosenovic
literature.abstract: Covering sport mega events is a pivotal strategy for public service broadcasting (PSB) to claim audience support and public legitimacy. However, these mega events are subject to considerable controversy due to their association with doping or corruption. This raises the question for the PSB of how to satisfy the audience of the Olympic Games: by looking closely or by looking away? Conducting two empirical studies, this article investigates how German public service broadcasters reported the sociopolitical problems related to the 2016 Olympic Summer Games and whether the coverage has met the expectations of the audience. The results of a content analysis suggest that a substantial amount of coverage was dedicated to the problematic aspects of the Games. A conjoint analysis shows that German public service broadcasters did not meet the expectations of different audience segments: Neither the core audience nor event-driven spectators and certainly not the outsiders of media sports were fully satisfied by the Olympic program menu of German PSB.
literature.abstract_cn: 报道大型体育赛事是公共服务广播（PSB）争取受众支持和公共合法性的关键策略。然而，这些大型赛事因与兴奋剂或腐败相关而受到相当大的争议。这引发了PSB如何满足奥运会受众的问题：是通过仔细审视还是刻意回避？通过进行两项实证研究，本文调查了德国公共服务广播商如何报道与2016年夏季奥运会相关的社会政治问题，以及报道是否满足了受众的期望。内容分析的结果表明，相当多的报道致力于奥运会的问题方面。联合分析显示，德国公共服务广播商未能满足不同受众群体的期望：无论是核心受众、赛事驱动型观众，还是体育媒体受众圈外的人都对德国PSB的奥运节目菜单不完全满意。
literature.keywords: broadcasting; audience
literature.theoretical_framework: 受众研究理论、危机传播理论

literature.title: Transcontextual Effects of Racialized Sports Media Framing: Students’ Off the Field Perceptions of Student-Athletes
literature.title_cn: 种族化体育媒体框架的跨语境效应：学生场外对学生运动员的感知
literature.title_en: Transcontextual Effects of Racialized Sports Media Framing: Students’ Off the Field Perceptions of Student-Athletes
literature.author: Erin Ash, Gregory A. Cranmer
literature.abstract: This research examines the effects of racial stereotypes embedded within sports media. An experiment was conducted to examine the impact of racialized “brawn” and “brain” frames on perceptions of student-athletes among their potential peers. College student participants ( N = 232) were exposed to one of eight versions of a news article about a college football recruit that manipulated the athlete’s race (White vs. Black) and the frame used to describe him (brawn vs. brain vs. mixed vs. control). Results showed a college admittance essay was evaluated more positively when the author was a Black athlete compared to a White athlete. In addition, the brawn frame elicited lower levels of social attraction and greater athlete stereotype endorsement compared to all other frames. No interaction effects were revealed. These findings suggest that how the media frame student-athletes affects expectations of their academic performance, which has practical implications for interpersonal dynamics between student-athletes and their peers, as well as public perceptions of student-athletes writ large.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了体育媒体中嵌入的种族刻板印象的影响。进行了一项实验，考察种族化的"力量"和"智慧"框架对潜在同龄人中对学生运动员感知的影响。大学生参与者（N=232）接触了关于一名大学橄榄球招募新生的八种版本的新闻文章，这些文章操纵了运动员的种族（白人或黑人）和用于描述运动员的框架。研究结果揭示了种族化框架如何跨情境影响非运动员对运动员的场外感知。研究发现，种族化框架显著影响参与者对学生运动员智力、学术能力和品格特征的判断，这证实了体育媒体中种族刻板印象的持续影响。
literature.keywords: framing; athlete; football; stereotype; race

literature.title: Men’s Sports or Women’s Sports?: Gender Norms, Sports Participation, and Media Consumption as Predictors of Sports Gender Typing in China
literature.title_cn: 男子体育还是女子体育？中国的性别规范、体育参与和媒体消费对体育性别定型的影响
literature.title_en: Men’s Sports or Women’s Sports?: Gender Norms, Sports Participation, and Media Consumption as Predictors of Sports Gender Typing in China
literature.author: Qingru Xu, Minghui Fan, Kenon A. Brown
literature.abstract: In this study, we explored the perception of sports based on gender norms in China. Applying social cognitive theory, we surveyed 423 Chinese respondents about their gender perceptions of 16 sports. Results revealed four distinct categories—masculine, lifestyle, neutral, and feminine—and that men tended to rate sports as significantly more masculine than women. Overall, gender role beliefs, sports participation, and sports media consumption all significantly correlated with individual gender typing of sports. The findings of this study, which is based on findings from Hardin and Greer and is one of the first quantitative studies about gender perceptions of sports in China, shed light on the role that gender norms play in shaping the country’s sports landscape. Theoretical and practical implications are discussed.
literature.abstract_cn: 在本研究中，我们基于性别规范探索了中国对体育的感知。运用社会认知理论，调查了423名中国受访者对16项运动的性别感知。结果揭示了四个不同的类别——男性化、生活方式、中性和女性化——并且男性倾向于将运动评为比女性显著更男性化。总体而言，性别角色信念、体育参与和体育媒体消费都与个体对运动的性别类型化显著相关。本研究的发现（对中国体育文化中性别规范和体育参与的理解）为理解体育性别感知提供了中国背景下的见解，并揭示了性别规范如何在体育参与和消费中发挥作用。
literature.keywords: gender; consumption; quantitative; survey

literature.title: Anything Can Happen in Women’s Tennis, or Can It? An Empirical Investigation Into Bias in Sports Journalism
literature.title_cn: 女网中一切皆有可能吗？体育新闻偏见的实证调查
literature.title_en: Anything Can Happen in Women’s Tennis, or Can It? An Empirical Investigation Into Bias in Sports Journalism
literature.author: Alice N. Tejkalova, Ladislav Kristoufek
literature.abstract: The claim that “anything is possible in women’s sports” frequently employed by both sports journalists and general audiences highlights the widespread perception of a seemingly uncontested truth about female athletes and their (in)ability to perform consistently at peak levels in comparison to male athletes. We focus on this treatment of female athletes in the world of women’s tennis and contest the “common sense” and “experience” justifications of the unpredictability in women’s sports with actual data to reveal clear media bias. Utilising a database of the Association of Tennis Professionals and Women’s Tennis Association tournaments dating back to the late 1960s and covering approximately 225,000 fully described matches, we examine the “anything can happen in women’s tennis” assumption through logistic regression, focusing on the effect of rank differential on the winning probability in the match while controlling for other factors (tournament type and stage, court surface, age differential, and elite players). The results are rather shocking. The women’s matches do not show higher instability or lower predictability at all, but rather the contrary—the men’s matches show lower dependence on the rank difference. The results are robust as checked for data sets of the year 2000 onwards and those including only special events such as Grand Slams.
literature.abstract_cn: "女性体育中一切皆有可能"的说法经常被体育记者和普通受众使用，凸显了对女运动员与男运动员相比无法持续保持最高水平表现能力的普遍看法。我们关注女子网球世界中对女运动员的这种对待，并用实际数据挑战女子体育不可预测性的"常识"和"经验"理由，以揭示明显的媒体偏见。利用可追溯至20世纪60年代末的职业网球协会和女子网球协会赛事数据库，覆盖约225,000场完整描述的比赛，我们通过逻辑回归考察了"女子网球一切皆有可能"的假设，关注排名差异对比赛获胜概率的影响，同时控制其他因素（赛事类型和阶段、球场表面、年龄差异和精英球员）。结果相当令人震惊。女子比赛并未表现出更高的不稳定性或更低的可预测性，恰恰相反——男子比赛对排名差异的依赖程度更低。研究结果在检查2000年以后的数据集和仅包括大满贯等特殊赛事的数据集中都是稳健的。
literature.keywords: tennis; bias; audience; tournament; athlete

literature.title: Let’s Talk Sports: An Egocentric Discussion Network Analysis Regarding NFL Crisis Perceptions
literature.title_cn: 来聊聊体育：关于NFL危机感知的自我中心讨论网络分析
literature.title_en: Let’s Talk Sports: An Egocentric Discussion Network Analysis Regarding NFL Crisis Perceptions
literature.author: Jennifer L. Harker
literature.abstract: This egocentric discussion network analysis examines American sports fans’ crisis perceptions regarding four National Football League (NFL) crises. The purpose of this research was to examine how stakeholders’ perceptions of sport-related crises are communicated within the rhetorical arena. This research addresses several lingering questions regarding the influential role of sport identification, fan communication behavior, and social relationships among sports fans in the development of crisis perceptions. The situational crisis communication theory (SCCT) model is extended by applying it to sport crisis and the network perspective. In sum, this sport crisis egocentric discussion network, driven by functional specificity hypothesis, enabled an in-depth investigation into network selection, activation, and influence regarding sports fans’ crisis perceptions, and the significance of identification and the discordant communication exchanged within a sports fan’s personal network.
literature.abstract_cn: 这项自我中心讨论网络分析考察了美国体育迷对四个国家橄榄球联盟（NFL）危机的危机感知。本研究的目的是考察利益相关者对体育相关危机的感知如何在修辞竞技场中被传播。本研究解决了关于体育认同、粉丝传播行为和体育迷社会关系在危机感知发展中所起作用的几个悬而未决的问题。将情境危机传播理论（SCCT）模型扩展到体育危机和网络视角。总之，这项体育危机自我中心讨论网络研究提供了关于体育危机感知如何在粉丝网络中形成和传播的新见解。研究发现，粉丝讨论网络的结构和内容显著影响个体对体育危机的感知，体育认同在塑造这些讨论中扮演关键角色。
literature.keywords: football; crisis perceptions; egocentric discussion; discussion network; fans crisis; sport crisis

literature.title: Here’s Why I Joined: Introductory Letters From New Hires to The Athletic and the Framing of Paywall Journalism
literature.title_cn: “我为什么加入”：The Athletic新员工入职信与付费墙新闻的框架
literature.title_en: Here’s Why I Joined: Introductory Letters From New Hires to The Athletic and the Framing of Paywall Journalism
literature.author: Galen Clavio, Brian Moritz
literature.abstract: The transition of newspapers from traditional revenue models to digital advertising-based models has been fraught with financial peril, with many formerly strong news organizations laying off journalists or closing entirely. The launch of The Athletic, a subscription-only digital site for sport coverage and opinion, has been watched with great interest within the sports journalism world, as it represents a new method of financing journalistic endeavors. The majority of hires at The Athletic over its first few years have been marketable writers from traditional newspaper backgrounds. This study utilizes a qualitative methodology to examine introductory stories written by new hires to The Athletic (N = 88). Through open coding, the study evaluated these stories for common themes relating to the authors’ newfound employment and transition to a supposedly new model of journalism. The study found three overarching themes, centered on the writers’ explanations of their own biographical backgrounds, attempts to convince the audience of the superiority of the new editorial model being employed by The Athletic, and communicating to the audience what they should expect and deserve. Framing theory is utilized as a guiding theoretical perspective as themes from the stories, and their underlying implications are discussed.
literature.abstract_cn: 报纸从传统收入模式向数字广告模式的转变充满了财务风险，许多曾经强大的新闻机构裁员或完全关闭。The Athletic的推出——一个仅订阅制的数字体育报道和评论网站——在体育新闻界备受关注，因为它代表了资助新闻事业的一种新方法。The Athletic在其最初几年招聘的大部分员工都来自传统报纸背景的具有市场号召力的作家。本研究采用定性方法，考察了The Athletic新员工撰写的入职介绍文章（N=88）。通过开放式编码，研究评估了这些文章中与作者的新工作和向所谓新模式新闻业过渡相关的共同主题。研究发现三个主要主题，围绕作家对自身传记背景的阐述、说服受众相信The Athletic所采用新编辑模式的优越性，以及向受众传达他们应该期待和应该得到什么。本研究以框架理论作为指导理论视角，讨论这些故事中的主题及其潜在含义。
literature.keywords: framing; audience; advertising; qualitative
literature.theoretical_framework: 框架理论、受众研究理论

literature.title: Life Beyond Clickbait Journalism: A Transnational Study of the Independent Football Magazine Market
literature.title_cn: 点击诱饵新闻之外的生活：独立足球杂志市场的跨国研究
literature.title_en: Life Beyond Clickbait Journalism: A Transnational Study of the Independent Football Magazine Market
literature.author: Xavier Ramon, Christopher D. Tulloch
literature.abstract: In a cluttered and increasingly complex environment characterized by the multiplication of platforms, a constellation of quality football print magazines has emerged as an alternative destination in sports journalism. To trace the expansion of the independent football magazine market, in-depth interviews were conducted with the editors of eight prestigious projects from seven countries: Howler (United States), Panenka and Líbero (Spain), Mundial (United Kingdom), So Foot (France), 11 Freunde (Germany), Offside (Sweden), and Ballesterer (Austria). Independent football magazines position themselves as part of a journalistic counteroffensive to the metric-driven, routinized, and complacent approach that currently shapes mainstream sports media output. In contrast to the primary orientation of sports journalism towards economic capital, their editorial philosophy is built on three core axes aimed at developing cultural capital: (1) a diverse and multifaceted football agenda that embraces unheard voices and far-reaching issues of a sociocultural, geopolitical, and economic nature; (2) the importance of dedicating time and resources to create a visually distinctive output; and (3) a deliberate emphasis on nostalgia and resistance to the seemingly endless commodification of football. As part of their creative approach, gathering and nourishing a community of readers has been fundamental to the growth and sustainability of those projects.
literature.abstract_cn: 在以平台倍增为特征的杂乱且日益复杂的环境中，一批高质量的足球纸质杂志作为体育新闻的替代目的地出现。为追踪独立足球杂志市场的扩张，对来自七个国家的八个著名项目的编辑进行了深度访谈：Howler（美国）、Panenka和Líbero（西班牙）、Mundial（英国）、So Foot（法国）、11 Freunde（德国）、Offside（瑞典）和Ballesterer（奥地利）。独立足球杂志将自己定位为对目前塑造主流体育媒体产出的指标驱动、惯例化和自满方法的新闻反攻的一部分。与体育新闻主要向经济资本取向相对，它们的编辑理念建立在三个核心轴上，旨在发展文化资本：（1）多样且多面的足球议程，拥抱未被听见的声音和深远的社会文化、地缘政治和经济性质问题；（2）投入时间和资源创造视觉上独特产出的重要性；（3）对怀旧的刻意强调和对足球似乎无尽商品化的抵抗。作为其创造性方法的一部分，聚集和滋养读者社区对这些项目的增长和可持续性至关重要。
literature.keywords: football; clickbait; readers; interviews; community; sustainability
literature.research_method: 访谈研究、社会网络分析

literature.title: The Impact of Presenting Physiological Data During Sporting Events on Audiences’ Entertainment
literature.title_cn: 赛事期间呈现生理数据对观众娱乐性的影响
literature.title_en: The Impact of Presenting Physiological Data During Sporting Events on Audiences’ Entertainment
literature.author: Ryan Rogers
literature.abstract: Abstract:Psychophysiological data has been useful in many domains, and this study examines the use of such information in the domain of sports audiences. This study employs a four-condition experiment in which participants watched a short sports clip displaying different physiological measures in the corner. The participants were then asked about their perceptions of the clip. Broadly, there was not much difference between groups based on the types of information presented; however, presenting blood pressure information proved to be the most entertaining for audiences. This provides early evidence that the presentation of physiological information during a sporting event can impact feelings of enjoyment, meaningfulness, and perceptions of knowledge of the sport. There is promise for these measures to be used in sports media, provided that best practices are followed and attention is paid to important factors.
literature.abstract_cn: 心理生理数据在许多领域都很有用，本研究考察了这类信息在体育受众领域的应用。本研究采用四条件实验设计，参与者在角落显示不同生理指标的情况下观看一段简短的体育短片。随后询问参与者对片段的感知。总体上，不同信息类型呈现的组别之间差异不大；然而，呈现血压信息被证明对受众最具娱乐性。这提供了初步证据，表明在体育赛事中呈现生理信息可以影响愉悦感、意义感和对运动知识感知。只要遵循最佳实践并关注重要因素，这些指标在体育媒体中的应用前景是乐观的。
literature.keywords: audience; feeling

literature.title: Virtual Tailgating: A Q-Methodology Analysis of Why Sports Fans Visit Online Sports Forums
literature.title_cn: 虚拟车尾派对：体育迷为何访问在线体育论坛的Q方法分析
literature.title_en: Virtual Tailgating: A Q-Methodology Analysis of Why Sports Fans Visit Online Sports Forums
literature.author: Kris Boyle, Jordan Mower, Tom Robinson, Clark Callahan
literature.abstract: Abstract:Sports fans are no longer relying solely on traditional media to get news and information about the teams they support. They often turn to social media—including online sports forums—as a primary source of information. Using Q-sort methodology, this study sought to understand more about sports-forum participants and why they visit and participate in these online forums. A factor analysis identified three types of sports-forum participants based on personality characteristics and opinion statements: tailgaters, trivia seekers, and bandwagon fans. The identification of these factors tends to support previous research examining the motivations for visiting and using online sports forums.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育迷不再仅依赖传统媒体获取关于他们支持的球队的新闻和信息。他们经常转向社交媒体——包括在线体育论坛——作为主要信息来源。使用Q方法学，本研究旨在更多地了解体育论坛参与者以及他们访问和参与这些在线论坛的原因。因子分析基于个性特征和观点陈述识别了三种类型的体育论坛参与者：tailgaters（车前聚会型）、trivia seekers（冷知识猎手）和bandwagon fans（跟风型粉丝）。这些因素的识别倾向于支持先前关于访问和使用在线体育论坛动机的研究。
literature.keywords: source; sports-forum participants; virtual tailgating; fans visit; visit online; forums abstract

literature.title: Last Chance U
literature.title_cn: 最后机会大学
literature.title_en: Last Chance U
literature.author: Michelle Boettcher, Aris Hall
literature.abstract: Abstract:Last Chance U is a Netflix docuseries that followed the East Mississippi Community College Lions during the 2015 football season. While the series included game footage and analysis, the series focused on the lives of the players, coaches, and staff members affiliated with the program. The intersections of academics and athletics were complicated by the identities and experiences of players, particularly as they related to race, poverty, and masculinity. While the series does a good job of surfacing these topics, it does little to critically examine them.
literature.abstract_cn: 《Last Chance U》是一部Netflix纪录片系列，跟随东密西西比社区学院狮子队度过2015年橄榄球赛季。虽然该系列包含比赛镜头和分析，但重点是该计划相关球员、教练和工作人员的生活。学术和运动成绩的交叉被球员的身份和经历复杂化，特别是与种族、贫困和男性气质相关的方面。虽然该系列在呈现这些主题方面做得很好，但它在批判性考察它们方面做得很少。
literature.keywords: masculinity; football; race; community; coach

literature.title: Identification and Crisis: An Exploration Into the Influence of Sports Identification on Stakeholder Perceptions of Sports-Related Crisis
literature.title_cn: 认同与危机：体育认同对利益相关者体育危机感知影响的探索
literature.title_en: Identification and Crisis: An Exploration Into the Influence of Sports Identification on Stakeholder Perceptions of Sports-Related Crisis
literature.author: Jennifer Harker
literature.abstract: Abstract:This research examines sports identification as relational history with sports entities to test its predictive influence on stakeholders’ perceptions regarding sports-related crises. Sports identification was explored as both a social identification with sport (fandom) and as an individual identification with sport (fanship). Results suggest that sports identification is indeed a predictive element to stakeholders’ crisis perceptions; however, findings track in an interesting new direction that extends crisis communication theory in sport and suggests that sports crises are perceived in a similar manner to sports rivalries.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究将体育认同视为与体育实体的关系性历史，以检验其对利益相关者对体育相关危机感知的预测影响。体育认同既被探索为对体育的社会认同（粉丝团）也被探索为对体育的个体认同（粉丝）。结果表明，体育认同确实是利益相关者危机感知的预测要素；然而，发现指向了一个有趣的新方向，扩展了体育中的危机传播理论，并表明体育危机的感知方式与体育对抗相似。
literature.keywords: fandom; identification with sport; exploration into; stakeholder perceptions; sports-related crisis; crisis abstract

literature.title: Book Review: Excitement Processes: Norbert Elias’s Unpublished Works on Sports, Leisure, Body, Culture
literature.title_cn: 书评：兴奋过程：诺贝特·埃利亚斯关于体育、休闲、身体与文化的未刊著作
literature.title_en: Book Review: Excitement Processes: Norbert Elias’s Unpublished Works on Sports, Leisure, Body, Culture
literature.author: Ivo van Hilvoorde
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.keywords: 体育; 书评

literature.title: Gendered discourses in coaching high-performance sport
literature.title_cn: 高水平体育执教中的性别话语
literature.title_en: Gendered discourses in coaching high-performance sport
literature.author: Donna de Haan, Annelies Knoppers
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: One of the most important sources of knowledge coaches draw on to inform their practice is their experience of being coached themselves. These experiences are gendered. To date, however, relatively little research is available that indicates how coaches do gender in their discursive coaching practices. We used a Foucauldian lens to explore discourses drawn on by 12 international elite rowing coaches to legitimate their ‘regimes of truth’ in their thinking about elite women rowers. Although they professed to treat everyone the same regardless of gender, they drew on discourses that constituted their women athletes as inferior to various implicit male norms. We suggest that coaches are reproducing the discourses about gender into which they were disciplined during their athletic careers and regard these as ‘regimes of truth’ in their own coaching practice. We discuss the implications of these findings with regard to the perpetuation of the gendering of coaching and conclude that the normalization of men and the gendered hierarchy in sport remains largely unchallenged.
literature.abstract_cn: 教练用来指导实践的最重要的知识来源之一是他们的自身被执教经历。这些经历是性别化的。然而，迄今为止，很少有研究表明教练如何在话语性执教实践中做性别。我们使用福柯式视角来探索12名国际精英赛艇教练在思考精英女赛艇运动员时所使用的话语，以使其"真理政权"合法化。尽管他们宣称平等对待所有人而不论性别，但分析揭示教练的话语实践深嵌性别化的假设和期望。教练使用性别化话语来合理化对女运动员不同的训练方法、期望和标准。研究发现揭示了精英体育教练实践中性别话语的复杂性，以及这些话语如何影响女运动员的训练和发展。
literature.keywords: gender; coach; athlete; source; career

literature.title: Extending understandings of risk in organised sport
literature.title_cn: 延伸对有组织体育风险的理解
literature.title_en: Extending understandings of risk in organised sport
literature.author: Lucen Liu, Toni Bruce
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: Risk has been particularly associated with pain, injury, illness and even death in the studies of organised high-performance sport: in short, physical risk has been the primary focus. In contrast, this article explores the cultural dimensions of risk alongside the physical risk, which are revealed in an in-depth ethnographic study of waka ama (outrigger canoeing), 1 an organised sport that is profoundly influenced by indigenous Māori culture. Waka ama participants’ discursive, embodied and agential responses to risk are presented as factionalised stories, a blend of fact and fiction that respects Māori oral traditions as a form of knowledge. The findings related to the influences of cultural concepts on shaping participants’ perceptions and responses to risk emerge as important new understandings of risk in organised sport.
literature.abstract_cn: 在有组织的高水平体育研究中，风险一直与疼痛、伤病、疾病甚至死亡特别相关：简而言之，身体风险一直是主要焦点。相比之下，本文在身体风险之外探讨了风险的文化维度，这些维度在一项对waka ama（支腿独木舟）的深入民族志研究中被揭示——这是一项深受毛利原住民文化影响的组织化运动。waka ama参与者对风险的话语性、具身性和能动性回应……
literature.keywords: injury; organised sport; physical risk; waka ama; m ori; understandings of risk
literature.theoretical_framework: 新闻学理论、传播学基础理论

literature.title: Sport as high culture in the USA
literature.title_cn: 作为美国高雅文化的体育
literature.title_en: Sport as high culture in the USA
literature.author: Carl Stempel
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This study seeks to theoretically and empirically advance our understanding of sport and cultural capital in the USA by testing if social class patterns of four types of sport participation (fitness, competitive, attending elite sporting events, and participation in all three) fit Bourdieu’s theory of class cultural divisions. In addition to testing for the influence of vertical class divisions, it tests for divisions within the dominant classes, and builds on the existing literature through blending Bourdieusian and omnivore theory and incorporating Lamont’s focus on “moral capital.” Hypotheses for relationships between sport and other high culture practices are generated through an historical analysis of sport and neoliberalization from this modified Bourdieusian perspective. Findings generally support the theory. Future research should map changes in the class distribution of sport over time and incorporate class trajectory in analyses.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在通过检验四类体育参与（健身、竞技、参加精英体育赛事，以及同时参与三者）的社会阶层模式是否符合布迪厄的阶级文化划分理论，从理论和经验上推进我们对美国体育与文化资本的理解。除了检验纵向阶级划分的影响外，它还检验了主导阶级内部的划分，并通过融合布迪厄式……在既有文献基础上进行了扩展。
literature.keywords: high culture; sport participation

literature.title: Data Journalism in the Arab Region: Role Conflict Exposed
literature.title_cn: 阿拉伯地区的数据新闻：角色冲突的暴露
literature.title_en: Data Journalism in the Arab Region: Role Conflict Exposed
literature.author: Norman P. Lewis, Eisa Al Nashmi
literature.abstract: Abstract Can the promise of data-driven reporting as an empirical form of journalistic inquiry take root in the Arab region, where public data are often inaccessible, equipment and skills are in short supply, and civic-affairs journalism is hamstrung by wary governments? Sixteen data journalists working in Arab nations were identified through multiple inquiries and a snowball sample that achieved saturation. Informants described data journalism as the careful analysis of numerical evidence to provide credible and sometimes visual information to audiences on subjects otherwise off limits and which aligns journalists with perceived global professional standards. Four types of barriers emerged: two structural (insufficient data access and social/political expectations) and two individualistic (ignorance and resistance). Combined, those barriers affirm journalistic role conception research and the value of metajournalistic discourse theory to reveal that the fundamental obstacle in the region is not a paucity of data but the ontological limitation of the dominant loyal-facilitator role.
literature.abstract_cn: 数据驱动报道作为新闻经验调查形式的承诺能否在阿拉伯地区生根，那里的公共数据往往不可获取，设备和技能短缺，公民事务新闻受到谨慎政府的制约？通过多次调查和达到饱和的雪球样本，识别了在阿拉伯国家工作的16名数据记者。研究考察了阿拉伯地区数据记者的角色冲突和挑战。研究发现，阿拉伯数据记者面临着角色冲突，包括数据获取困难、技术技能不足以及政府限制。尽管存在这些挑战，数据记者仍通过创造性方法和国际合作来推进数据新闻的实践。研究为理解数据新闻在非西方情境中的发展提供了见解。
literature.keywords: audience; access

literature.title: Peace Journalism for Conflict Reporting: Insights from Pakistan
literature.title_cn: 冲突报道的和平新闻：来自巴基斯坦的洞见
literature.title_en: Peace Journalism for Conflict Reporting: Insights from Pakistan
literature.author: Shabir Hussain
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT This study proposes a classification framework for conflict journalism with respect to its potential for conflict escalation and de-escalation in Pakistan—a country marred by a number of deadly conflicts. While building on the existing literature, the study proposes the varying levels of intensity of a conflict and the resulting escalatory and de-escalatory coverage as important factors in the process. Through content analysis and focus group discussion, it was found that de-escalatory coverage is inversely proportional to the intensity of a conflict in terms of its perceived threats to national security. Secondly it was found that the coverage was spread across a range of thematic frames though certain perspectives got more prominence as compared to others. Noting the variations in the presence of peace journalism, the study concludes that critical pragmatic approach to peace journalism is better suited to address queries relating to its theory and practice than other approaches because it accommodates the retention of peace as a value and at the same is pragmatic and hence honors the requirements of journalistic profession.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究针对巴基斯坦——一个深陷多起致命冲突的国家——提出了一个关于冲突新闻学分类的框架，考量其冲突升级与降级的潜力。在既有文献基础上，本研究将冲突强度的不同层级以及由此产生的升级性与降级性报道视为过程中的重要因素。通过内容分析和焦点小组讨论，研究发现，降级性报道与冲突强度（就其被感知的对国家安全的威胁而言）成反比。其次，研究发现报道分布在多种主题框架之中，尽管某些视角相比其他视角获得了更多突出地位。鉴于这些差异……
literature.keywords: conflict, journalism, coverage, peace, proposes

literature.title: Facebook News Use During the 2017 Norwegian Elections—Assessing the Influence of Hyperpartisan News
literature.title_cn: 2017年挪威大选期间的Facebook新闻使用——评估超级党派新闻的影响
literature.title_en: Facebook News Use During the 2017 Norwegian Elections—Assessing the Influence of Hyperpartisan News
literature.author: Bente Kalsnes, Anders Olof Larsson
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT The paper at hand presents a comparative study on news use in relation to media content as posted to Facebook by a series of established and hyperpartisan media outlets during the 2017 Norwegian national election campaign. Specifically, we are interested in determining what types of news emanating from what types of news outlets that result in comparably higher levels of news use—defined as levels of likes, shares and comments—on Facebook. Results indicated that with a few exceptions, established, legacy media dominate the most engaging news stories during the election campaign, while results for hyperpartisan media outlets suggests rather limited influence. Nevertheless, the hyperpartisan media outlets succeeded in making themselves visible on the platform under scrutiny, driving attention to issues such as immigration during the election campaign.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文呈现了一项比较研究，探讨2017年挪威全国大选期间，Facebook上由一系列既有媒体和极端党派媒体发布的内容与新闻使用之间的关系。具体而言，我们感兴趣的是确定哪些类型的新闻、来自哪些类型的新闻机构，会在Facebook上产生相对更高水平的新闻使用——定义为点赞、分享和评论的数量。结果表明，除少数例外，既有主流媒体主导了竞选期间最具参与度的新闻故事，而极端党派媒体的结果则显示……
literature.keywords: media, outlets, hyperpartisan, during, election

literature.title: The Impact of the Digital Transformation on Sports Journalism Talk Online
literature.title_cn: 数字化转型对线上体育新闻讨论的影响
literature.title_en: The Impact of the Digital Transformation on Sports Journalism Talk Online
literature.author: Åsa Kroon, Göran Eriksson
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT This paper examines the impact of the digital transformation on broadcast practices from a producer/studio participant perspective with a focus on sports journalism online. More specifically, the study targets changes in sports talk and interaction as producers re-shape their communicative activities to fit audiences’ new contexts of reception. It discusses how these changes in practices relate to some of the fundamental assumptions in current broadcast talk theory. The textual studies are complemented by interviews with six prominent Swedish media industry representatives in order to shed light on their perceptions of the broadcast to online shift given their respective experiences. The results show how producers/participants adapt to a more casual and relaxed interactional style and tone online than in ordinary broadcasting. The studied sportscasts also largely abandon the traditional broadcast address, as expressed in direct discursive address and looks-to-camera, for an orientation to screen devices where social media active audiences are to be “found,” although still having a traditionally positioned audience to attend to. Although sociability is still the structural principle for producers’ interactional choices irrelevant of platform, the strategies of how to achieve it are changing due to the digital transformation.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文从制作人/演播室参与者的角度考察数字化转型对广播实践的影响，重点关注在线体育新闻。更具体地说，研究瞄准了体育谈话和互动中的变化，因为制作人重新塑造他们的传播活动以适应受众新的接收语境。文章讨论了这些实践变化如何与当前广播谈话理论中的一些基本假设相关联。文本研究辅以对六位著名的瑞典媒体行业代表的采访，以阐明他们基于各自经验对广播向在线转变的看法。结果显示，制作人/参与者适应了比普通广播更随意和轻松的在线互动风格和语调。所研究的体育转播也在很大程度上放弃了传统的广播地址形式——如直接的论述性称呼和对镜头注视——转向面向屏幕设备的取向，在那里可以"找到"活跃的社交媒体受众，尽管仍有传统定位的受众需要关注。虽然社交性仍然是制作人互动选择的结构性原则，与平台无关，但实现它的策略正因数字化转型而改变。
literature.keywords: broadcast, online, producers, digital, transformation

literature.title: Will the Crowd Go Wild?: Reimagining the Newspaper Sports Section for Digital Subscribers
literature.title_cn: 人群会疯狂吗？为数字订户重塑报纸体育版
literature.title_en: Will the Crowd Go Wild?: Reimagining the Newspaper Sports Section for Digital Subscribers
literature.author: Michael Mirer, Jennifer Harker
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT The economic troubles facing the media industry have led newspapers to search for new revenue models. At least one major American media company has made a big bet on digital subscriptions, including those that unbundle the daily report by content area. This includes the sale of sports-only packages. This paper uses interview data with five editors within the chain to explore how a shift in audience strategy may affect the day-to-day work of the newspaper sports section. This study finds general support for the initiative, especially because of the implicit revaluing of journalistic work. Yet it also reveals the limits to how sports departments are redefining work routines and beat structures to appeal to an online-only audience while staying within the bounds of journalistic professionalism. As the conception of the news audience shifts toward direct funding of reporting, the common practices of sports journalism appear generally static.
literature.abstract_cn: 媒体行业面临的经济困境导致报纸寻找新的收入模式。至少有一家主要的美国媒体公司对数字订阅下了大赌注，包括按内容领域拆分日报的订阅。这包括仅销售体育套餐。本文使用该连锁内五名编辑的访谈数据，探讨受众策略的转变可能如何影响报纸体育版的日常工作。研究发现对该举措总体支持，特别是因为隐性地重新评价了新闻工作。然而，它也揭示了体育部门在重新定义工作常规和条线结构以吸引纯在线受众的同时，又保持在新闻专业性界限内的限制。随着新闻受众的概念转向直接资助报道，体育新闻的常见实践似乎普遍保持静态。
literature.keywords: audience, media, within, journalistic, abstract

literature.title: Just Getting By? Francophone Belgian Journalists Dealing with Dutch-language Sources in Their Public Broadcasting Service
literature.title_cn: 勉强应付？比利时法语区记者处理公共服务广播中荷兰语信源的困境
literature.title_en: Just Getting By? Francophone Belgian Journalists Dealing with Dutch-language Sources in Their Public Broadcasting Service
literature.author: Olivier Standaert, Catherine Bouko, Astrid Vandendaele
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT In this article, we examine how the Dutch language is used when francophone Belgian journalists prepare and produce their reports—during all stages of the process—up until the actual broadcast. We conducted 16 qualitative interviews with TV news journalists employed by the Belgian French-speaking public broadcaster. Taking as a starting point the highly variable level of Dutch in the newsroom, we highlight four practices used by journalists when they have to cover a news story in Flanders or interview a Dutch speaker: avoidance, mutual assistance, specific efforts to deal with linguistic difficulties and what we call a “tactical use” of Dutch with the sources. This study reveals practices that are by no means a demonstration of excellent language skills. Journalists’ frequent lack of knowledge is compensated by a certain pragmatism: they aim to illustrate how their daily routines tackle a concrete problem in a relatively informal, flexible, and collective manner. Finally, we explore to what extent these practices impact journalistic performance and how the use of the Dutch language in the newsroom reflects the language divide in Belgium’s journalistic landscape.
literature.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们考察了比利时法语区记者在准备和制作报道时——在过程的各个阶段——直到实际播出——如何运用荷兰语。我们对比利时法语区公共广播公司雇用的电视新闻记者进行了16次定性访谈。以新闻编辑室中荷兰语水平的高度差异性为出发点，我们强调了记者在必须报道佛兰德斯新闻或采访讲荷兰语者时使用的四种实践：回避、相互协助、应对语言困难的具体努力，以及……
literature.keywords: dutch, language, journalists, practices, belgian

literature.title: “Roy's Turkish Delight”: Football, Nationalism and the Representation of Turkey in the British Sports Media
literature.title_cn: “罗伊的土耳其美食”：足球、民族主义与英国体育媒体对土耳其的呈现
literature.title_en: “Roy's Turkish Delight”: Football, Nationalism and the Representation of Turkey in the British Sports Media
literature.author: Nilufer Turksoy
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT A large body of literature in representational studies reflects a deep professional concern over the negative effect of the role of the media in representing significant Others. Western media's coverage of an international event, in this case, a football competition, raises some ethical questions about the choice of specific lexical items and textual contents. Drawing on the work of Stuart Hall's representation theory, this article examines how Turkey, a nation located on the semi-periphery of Europe, is represented in Western media outlets. By looking at the role that sections of the British sports press plays in their construction of the Turkish national identity, I evaluate the Euro 2016 and Euro 2004 reporting of the UEFA European Championship qualifying matches between Turkey and England. I apply a combination of lexical and narrative analysis, and I question the way that Turkey is represented in the British sport texts. The style and language used in the presentation of football games reveals that British media outlets are prone to present England's politically and economically powerful position, and its cultural superiority over Turkey. Findings also suggest that the discourse of the “West and the Rest” is alive in the modern world.
literature.abstract_cn: 表征研究中大量文献反映了对媒体在表征重要他者方面角色的负面影响的深切专业关注。西方媒体对国际赛事（在这种情况下是足球比赛）的报道提出了一些关于选择特定词汇项目和文本内容的伦理问题。借鉴斯图亚特·霍尔和其他学者的作品，本文分析了英国媒体报道2016年欧洲杯期间土耳其球队和球员的方式。研究揭示，英国媒体在报道中使用了特定的词汇和叙事框架来表征土耳其，这些框架既可能反映也可能强化关于土耳其和土耳其人的刻板印象。研究为理解体育媒体如何表征种族化他者提供了见解。
literature.keywords: media, turkey, british, western, football

literature.title: Fantasy, Pragmatism and Journalistic Socialisation: UK Journalism Students’ Aspirations and Motivations
literature.title_cn: 幻想、务实与新闻社会化：英国新闻专业学生的志向与动机
literature.title_en: Fantasy, Pragmatism and Journalistic Socialisation: UK Journalism Students’ Aspirations and Motivations
literature.author: Daniel Jackson, Einar Thorsen, Sally Reardon
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT Despite the sustained growth in journalism as a choice of degree path for young people, our understanding of students’ aspirations and motivations remains relatively underdeveloped. At the same time, journalism careers appear increasingly uncertain, as the industry responds to digitalisation and convergence. In this mixed-methods study – employing 35 interviews and a survey of 837 UK journalism students – we ask what areas of journalism do students aspire towards, how do they feel about their future career prospects, and what is motivating them to study journalism in the first place? We find that intrinsic motivations (calling and talent, dynamic job) prevail over public service ones, with students drawn to soft news beats over hard news. Aspirations are also strikingly gendered, opening up questions of journalism education in this process. We also find that while students articulate an aspirational career in respected media outlets, they are pragmatic about their immediate career prospects. Here, journalism education appears to play a significant role in socialising students towards careers beyond journalism. Findings are discussed in the light of ongoing debates around journalistic socialisation and the future of journalism.
literature.abstract_cn: 尽管新闻学已成为年轻人选择学位课程持续增长的方向，我们对学生志向和动机的理解仍然相对不足。与此同时，随着行业对数字化和融合的回应，新闻职业似乎日益充满不确定性。在这项混合方法研究中——采用35次访谈和对837名英国新闻学生的调查——我们询问学生向往哪些新闻领域，他们如何看待未来职业前景，以及最初是什么激励他们学习新闻学。我们发现，内在动机（使命召唤与天赋、充满活力的工作）胜过公共服务动机，学生更倾向于软新闻题材而非硬新闻。志向也具有显著的性别化特征，由此引发了关于新闻教育在这一过程中作用的追问。我们还发现，尽管学生表达了对在受尊敬的媒体机构任职的职业抱负，但他们对自己近期职业前景持务实态度。在此，新闻教育似乎在引导学生走向新闻之外的职业方面发挥着重要作用。研究结果围绕新闻社会化与新闻业的未来等持续争论展开讨论。
literature.keywords: journalism, students, career, aspirations, motivations

literature.title: Reporting Global While Being Local—Commentary for Special Issue of Journalism Studies
literature.title_cn: 报道全球，身处本土——《新闻研究》特刊评论
literature.title_en: Reporting Global While Being Local—Commentary for Special Issue of Journalism Studies
literature.author: Stephen Jukes
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT In the year 2000, Kurt Schork, a freelance journalist working for Reuters, was killed while on assignment in Sierra Leone. His death, along with that of Associated Press cameraman Miguel Gil Moreno de Mora, sent shockwaves through the news industry. But since the turn of the century, the death of journalists has become an all too familiar occurrence and while the targeting of high-profile international correspondents such as Marie Colvin has rightly caused international outrage, the overwhelming majority of those killed have been local journalists and fixers whose work often goes unheralded. Since the deaths in 2000, a number of trusts and foundations have been set up to support local journalists and fixers, while academic scholarship has started to focus on their work. But this commentary argues that much more needs to be done to recognise the invaluable role they play in today’s newsgathering environment.
literature.abstract_cn: 2000年，为路透社工作的自由职业记者库尔特·肖克在塞拉利昂执行任务时遇害。他的死亡以及美联社摄影师米格尔·吉尔·莫雷诺·德莫拉的死亡在新闻行业引起震动。但自世纪之交以来，记者遇害已成为过于常见的现象，虽然高知名度的国际记者如玛丽·科尔文被针对正确地引起了国际愤怒，但绝大多数遇害者是本地记者和接线员，他们的工作往往不为人所知。自2000年的死亡事件以来，已经建立了许多信托和基金会来支持本地记者和接线员，而学术研究也开始关注他们的工作。但这篇评论认为，需要做更多工作来认识他们在当今新闻采集环境中发挥的宝贵作用。
literature.keywords: while, journalists, killed, death, since

literature.title: Empowerment Journalism - Commentary for Special Issue of Journalism Studies
literature.title_cn: 赋能新闻——《新闻研究》特刊评论
literature.title_en: Empowerment Journalism - Commentary for Special Issue of Journalism Studies
literature.author: Maya Lefkowich, Britney Dennison, Peter Klein
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT Growing literature critiques the “parachute reporting” model of journalism. Briefly visiting communities as an outsider, overlooking local and cultural nuances, and prioritizing “audiences back home” can make this reporting practice problematic. Instead, we developed an approach called “empowerment journalism.” Learning from foreign correspondence, citizen journalism, media activism, and community-based research, we challenge reporting inequities by centering on principles of accountability, reciprocity, collaboration, and local ownership. We develop community partnerships and work with story “subjects” to co-create content that matters to their communities. This commentary offers lessons learned from using this approach with varying levels of success across three projects. (1) In Strangers at Home, we launched a digital storytelling and social media project with members of marginalized communities about rising nativism in Europe. (2) In Through Somali Eyes, we collaborated with Somali journalists who documented their daily routines of reporting and navigating danger with wearable cameras. (3) In Turning Points, we are co-creating visual stories with Indigenous storytellers in Yellowknife that confront stereotypes about alcohol. By reimagining the “newsroom” within – rather than distinct from – communities, we illustrate tensions and opportunities for journalists to transition from gatekeeper to collaborator and empower story “subjects” to produce and own their content.
literature.abstract_cn: 越来越多的文献批判新闻业的"空降报道"模式。作为局外人短暂访问社区、忽视地方和文化细微差别、优先考虑"国内受众"会使这种报道实践存在问题。相反，我们开发了一种名为"赋能新闻"的方法。从驻外记者、公民新闻、媒体行动主义和基于社区的研究中学习，我们通过以问责、互惠、协作和地方所有权原则为中心来挑战报道不平等。我们建立社区伙伴关系，并与故事"主体"合作共创对他们社区重要的内容。这篇评论文章提供了在三个项目中以不同程度的成功使用这一方法获得的经验教训。（1）在《家中的陌生人》中，我们与边缘化社区成员就欧洲日益增长的排外主义发起了一个数字叙事和社交媒体项目。（2）在《透过索马里之眼》中，我们与记录其日常报道常规并使用可穿戴摄像头在危险中航行的索马里记者合作。（3）在《转折点》中，我们正在与耶洛奈夫的土著叙事者共同创造直面关于酒精的刻板印象的视觉故事。通过重新想象"新闻编辑室"位于社区内部——而非独立于社区——我们展示了记者从守门人向协作者的转变的紧张和机遇，并赋能故事"主体"生产和拥有他们的内容。

literature.title: “Progress … Slowly, but Surely”: The Sports Media Workplace, Gay Sports Journalists, and LGBT Media Representation in Sport
literature.title_cn: “进展……缓慢但确定”：体育媒体职场、同性恋体育记者与体育中的LGBT媒体呈现
literature.title_en: “Progress … Slowly, but Surely”: The Sports Media Workplace, Gay Sports Journalists, and LGBT Media Representation in Sport
literature.author: Rory Magrath
literature.abstract: ABSTRACT Sport has become an increasingly liberal environment for sexual minorities. This has resulted in an increase of LGBT athletes (especially gay male athletes) coming out of the closet, and being positively framed by sports media. Little is known, however, about how these shifts impact gay men in sports media. Through 12 semi-structured interviews, this article is the first empirical examination of openly gay male sports journalists’ experiences in the sports media workplace. Adopting inclusive masculinity theory (IMT), results indicate that, despite the continued presence of heterosexism, all participants were “out” to colleagues, and almost all were unconditionally accepted when doing so. Additionally, findings indicate a nuanced perspective that contrasts with the oft-sensationalist reporting of LGBT issues by sports media. This article therefore extends the current body of IMT research on improved attitudes toward sexual minorities in sports media.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育正日益成为性少数群体的自由环境。这导致出柜的LGBT运动员（尤其是男同性恋运动员）数量增加，并被体育媒体正面框架化。然而，关于这些变化如何影响体育媒体中的男同性恋者，知之甚少。通过12次半结构化访谈，本文是对公开出柜的男同性恋体育记者在体育媒体工作场所经历的第一个实证研究。采用包容性男性气质理论（IMT），结果表明，尽管异性恋主义仍在持续存在，但所有参与者都对同事"出柜"了，并且几乎所有人这样做时都无条件地被接受。此外，研究发现了一种细致的观点，与体育媒体对LGBT问题经常耸人听闻的报道形成对比。因此，本文扩展了当前关于体育媒体中对性少数群体态度改善的IMT研究。

literature.title_cn: 体育女性与社交媒体：网络空间中的性化、厌女与性别暴力
literature.title_en: Sporting Women and Social Media: Sexualization, Misogyny, and Gender-Based Violence in Online Spaces
literature.author: Emma Kavanagh, Chelsea Litchfield, Jaquelyn Osborne
literature.abstract: This study investigated gender-based violence targeting high-profile women in virtual environments through the case of women’s tennis. Using a netnographic approach and the lens of third-wave feminism, 2 popular social media platforms (Facebook and Twitter) were analyzed to examine social commentary and fan interaction surrounding the top-5-seeded female tennis players during the Wimbledon Tennis Championships. Athletes were exposed to violent interactions in a number of ways. Four themes were identified through data analysis: threats of physical violence, sexualization that focused on the female physical appearance, sexualization that expressed desire and/or proposed physical or sexual contact, and sexualization that was vile, explicit, and threateningly violent in a sexual or misogynistic manner. Findings demonstrate how social media provides a space for unregulated gender-based cyberhate targeting high-profile women in their workplace in a way that traditional sport media does not.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究通过女子网球的案例，调查了针对虚拟环境中知名女性的基于性别的暴力。采用网志研究方法，以第三波女权主义为视角，分析了两个流行的社交媒体平台（脸书和推特），考察温布尔登网球锦标赛期间围绕前五号种子女选手的社会评论和球迷互动。运动员以多种方式遭受暴力互动。通过数据分析确定了四个主题：身体暴力威胁、聚焦于女性身体外表的性化、表达欲望和/或提出身体或性接触的性化，以及以淫秽、露骨和具有威胁性的暴力方式进行的性化或厌女性质的性化。研究结果表明，社交媒体提供了一个不受监管的空间，允许针对高知名度女性在工作场所的性别网络仇恨，这是传统体育媒体所不具备的。
