literature.title: Fandom face to face
literature.title_cn: 面对面粉丝文化
literature.title_en: Fandom face to face
literature.author: Matthew Guschwan
literature.abstract: This essay focuses on the contexts away from the stadium where fans congregate, organise, develop and learn to perform their fandom. I define the concept of performance and show how it applies to fandom. I describe how, in small to medium scale, face-to-face settings, fans are able to form bonds and validate each others’ fandom. For some, fandom is an extension of playing the game as in Holland, where one might play in the amateur ranks of one of the famous professional teams. In Italy, organised fandom follows from a history of neighbourhood social clubs. I describe the Roma Club Testaccio as the epicentre of Roma fandom, and how it serves to educate fans in Roman-ness. Hardcore fan clubs support the team home and away, and I describe one of my own intense experiences travelling on the bus with some of the most notorious hardcore fans in Italy. Italians can also visit the grounds at which their beloved team practices and where they can catch a glimpse of the players up close, and connect with other devotees. As these snapshots demonstrate, the social gatherings of fans away from the football stadium are where fandom takes shape.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文关注远离体育场的语境，粉丝在此聚集、组织、发展和学习表演他们的粉丝身份。我定义表演的概念并展示它如何应用于粉丝身份。我描述了在小到中等规模的面对面环境中，粉丝如何能够建立联系并验证彼此的粉丝身份。对某些人来说，粉丝身份是游戏的延伸，如在荷兰，粉丝参与业余足球以保持与运动联系。对其他人来说，粉丝身份主要涉及观看和谈论体育。研究探讨了面对面粉丝互动如何塑造和强化粉丝身份，以及这些互动如何与更大规模的媒体化粉丝文化相关联。
literature.keywords: fandom; football

literature.title: Battle for control? Copyright, football and European media rights
literature.title_cn: 控制权之争？版权、足球与欧洲媒体权利
literature.title_en: Battle for control? Copyright, football and European media rights
literature.author: Raymond Boyle
literature.abstract: The position of copyright in the arena of sports content rights and property rights of sporting organizations is a highly contested area of legal and commercial interest in the digital age. At its core is the issue of whether copyright can be incorporated into sports rights contracts as it has been for many years. This article identifies the ramifications of this debate for the existing business models for both rights holders (Football Association (FA) Premier League, Union of European Football Associations (UEFA)) and broadcasters. Drawing on interviews with key stakeholders, this research analyses the strategic responses of pan-European broadcasters in the field, and key football content rights holders at both the national and European level. How will these developments affect both the pan-European and national markets for football rights? How does copyright law affect live and recorded games and what are the implications for the wider European audio-visual sector of changes in the rights regime for European cultural content?
literature.abstract_cn: 在数字时代，体育内容权利和体育组织产权领域的版权地位是一个高度争议的法律和商业利益领域。其核心问题是版权能否像多年来的做法那样被纳入体育权利合同。本文确定了这一争论对权利持有者（英超联盟、欧足联）和广播商现有商业模式的影响。借鉴对关键利益相关者的访谈，本研究分析了该领域泛欧广播商的战略应对，以及国家和欧洲层面的关键足球内容权利持有者。这些发展将如何影响泛欧和国家的足球权利市场？版权法如何影响直播和录制比赛，以及欧洲文化内容权利体制的变化对更广泛的欧洲视听部门有什么影响？

literature.title: 体育微博在体育赛事传播中的应用
literature.title_cn: 体育微博在体育赛事传播中的应用
literature.author: 尤洪林
literature.abstract: 随着社交媒体的兴起，体育微博成为体育赛事传播的重要平台，以其即时性、互动性强的特点在体育信息传播中发挥日益重要的作用。本文分析体育微博在体育赛事传播中的应用现状与特点，探讨其传播优势与存在的问题，为利用体育微博更好地进行体育赛事传播提供参考。

literature.title: 现代体育传媒化发展的现状、症候与反思
literature.title_cn: 现代体育传媒化发展的现状、症候与反思
literature.author: 李宇、钟小燕、郑亮
literature.abstract: 采用文献资料法,探讨现代体育传媒化发展的现状、症候表征以及价值反思。研究发现:体育传媒化是一个技术化的转换过程、市场化的调整过程以及体育娱乐化的演变过程;然而,体育传媒化发展过程中出现了过度商业化、消费化的倾向,大众体育和传统体育公益功能丧失;因此对体育传媒化发展而言,切不可因为商业逻辑和市场驱动,而漠视体育的价值理性与公共属性。

literature.title: 大数据背景下大型体育赛事新媒体的传播研究
literature.title_cn: 大数据背景下大型体育赛事新媒体的传播研究
literature.author: 王相飞、张巧玲
literature.abstract: 大数据时代的体育传播发生了根本性变革，新媒体的应用推动了大数据的资源获取和信息挖掘。阐述了大数据背景下大型体育赛事新媒体传播的主要特征，大数据在大型体育赛事新媒体传播中的应用及存在的问题，并对大数据背景下体育赛事新媒体的传播进行了展望：体育赛事的数据总量不断增加，来源与种类更加复杂；体育赛事大数据的处理与挖掘将会变得更为复杂；大数据的解读必须服从于体育传闻传播的本质需求；体育赛事受众参与大数据新闻的创作成为可能，大型体育赛事的新媒体传播不能过于迷信大数据。

literature.title: 大型国际体育赛事与跨文化传播
literature.title_cn: 大型国际体育赛事与跨文化传播

literature.abstract: 采用文献资料法、逻辑思维法、专家访谈法研究国际体育赛事中的跨文化传播。结论：大型国际体育赛事中的跨文化传播是多维度和多层面的，它是以个人传播、组织传播、大众传播为主要支撑点的多个传播系统的交织、多种传播渠道的汇集以及多种传播模式的整合。

literature.title: Broadcast Inequality in Australian Football
literature.title_cn: 澳大利亚足球的转播不平等
literature.title_en: Broadcast Inequality in Australian Football
literature.author: Fujak, Frawley
literature.abstract: The Australian sporting landscape is characterised by centralised broadcasting agreements that leave individual clubs at the mercy of league and broadcaster objectives in determining the nature and degree of their broadcast exposure. As a by-product, the potential exists for variances in television coverage between clubs that may result in significant economic disparity. This article endeavours to quantify this variance and discuss the related management implications of findings by analysing television ratings for a sample of 2,297 Australian Football League and National Rugby League fixtures played between 2007 and 2011. The article concludes that there is significant variance in the coverage provided and corresponding cumulative audience exposure of clubs within both leagues that was likely to impact sponsorship desirability and ability to engage fans. Notably, there was distinct favouritism shown towards those traditionally perceived as “powerhouse” clubs. The degree to which free-to-air broadcasts and finals matches deliver superior audience outcomes to subscription-only telecasts and regular season matches was also quantified.
literature.abstract_cn: 澳大利亚的体育格局以集中的转播协议为特征，这使个别俱乐部在确定其转播曝光的性质和程度时受联盟和转播商目标的摆布。作为副产品，俱乐部之间的电视报道可能存在差异，这可能导致显著的经济差距。本文通过分析2007至2011年间举行的2,297场澳式橄榄球联盟（AFL）和国家橄榄球联盟（NRL）赛事的电视收视率样本，努力量化这种差异并讨论相关发现的管理启示。文章得出结论，两个联盟内俱乐部的报道和相应的累积受众曝光存在显著差异，这可能影响赞助吸引力和与球迷互动的能力。值得注意的是，对传统上被视为"强队"的俱乐部存在明显的偏爱。研究还量化了免费转播和决赛相比仅订阅转播和常规赛季比赛提供优越受众结果的程度。
literature.keywords: football; audience; television; broadcasting; sponsorship

literature.title_en: “The Nail Polish underneath the Hockey Gloves”: nbc’s Framing of Women Hockey Players in the 2010 Winter Olympics
literature.author: Kelly Poniatowski
literature.abstract: This study used textual analysis to explore how North American women hockey players were framed via nbc’s commentary in the 2010 Olympics. Findings suggest the women’s game was portrayed as being inferior to the men’s game, with nationality and marital status playing a role in framing, and that women were framed as legitimate athletes for having previously participated in more masculine sports. While not all of the findings are positive, some give hope that the image of women athletes is changing in the media.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究运用文本分析法，考察了北美女子冰球运动员如何在2010年冬奥会NBC的解说中被框架呈现。研究结果表明，女子冰球赛事被描绘为不如男子冰球赛事，国籍和婚姻状况在框架构建中发挥作用，而女性由于先前参与过更具男性化的运动而被框架为合法的运动员。虽然并非所有发现都是积极的，但有些发现为女性运动员在媒体中的形象正在改变带来了希望。

literature.title_cn: 环球、巴西军事独裁与1970年FIFA足球世界杯
literature.title_en: Globo, the Brazilian Military Dictatorship and the 1970 FIFA Football World Cup
literature.author: Victor Andrade de Melo, Mauricio Drumond
literature.abstract: TV Globo is the leading television channel in Brazil and is among the biggest television networks in the world. Globo is internationally renowned for its soap operas, but football has also been an important part of its popularity. Domestically, Globo is also known for its ambiguous relationships with the military dictatorships of the 1960s and 1970s, a context highlighted by the controversial telecast of the 1970 FIFA World Cup in Brazil. More than four decades later, Brazilians have not forgotten this context, or the controversies raised by the relationship between Globo and the government. This article aims to discuss this subject, trying to better understand the relations between football, television, and political systems.
literature.abstract_cn: 环球电视台（TV Globo）是巴西领先的电视渠道，也是世界上最大的电视网络之一。Globo以其肥皂剧闻名国际，但足球也是其受欢迎程度的重要组成部分。在国内，Globo也以其与1960和1970年代军事独裁的暧昧关系而闻名，这一背景因备受争议的1970年巴西世界杯转播而凸显。四十多年后，巴西人没有忘记这一背景，或Globo与政府关系引发的争议。本文旨在讨论这一主题，试图更好地理解足球、电视和政治制度之间的关系。

literature.title: Soccer, Broadcasting, and Narrative
literature.title_cn: 足球、转播与叙事
literature.title_en: Soccer, Broadcasting, and Narrative
literature.author: Andrew Barnfield
literature.abstract: Soccer broadcasts have been explored in a number of interesting ways, uncovering racial difference, gendered stereotypes, domestic viewing experiences, nationalistic discourse, and national styles of production. What is lacking, however, is how the viewer comprehends space and time in the live broadcast. Such literatures neglect the hybrid nature of televised soccer as a combination of visual and verbal communication. Understanding and experiencing a televised soccer match is a formulation of visual principles and verbal understanding of temporality within the narrative of a live broadcast. These principles are materialized through the screen and develop an unconscious understanding of movement, spatiality, and temporality differing from a cinematic unconscious through the cutting and sequencing of footage and border moments—screen wipe, frames, cuts—which work in combination with commentary to establish a microgeography of the screen. Viewers of televised soccer, therefore, establish a comprehension of time and space which is distinctive and differs from reportage.
literature.abstract_cn: 足球转播已通过多种有趣的方式被探讨，揭示了种族差异、性别刻板印象、家庭观看体验、民族主义话语和国家制作风格。然而，缺乏的是观众如何在直播中理解时间和空间。这些文献忽视了电视足球作为视觉和语言传播相结合的混合性质。理解和体验一场电视转播的足球比赛，是对直播叙事中时间性的视觉原则和语言理解的综合建构。这些原则通过屏幕得以物质化，并发展出与电影无意识不同的对运动、空间性和时间性的无意识理解——通过镜头剪辑和边框时刻（屏幕擦除、画面框、剪切），这些与解说相结合，建立了屏幕的微观地理。因此，电视足球的观众建立起一种与新闻报道不同且独特的对时间和空间的理解。

Twitter has become a vital tool in sports journalists' repertoire and cannot be ignored.

literature.title: What League? The Representation of Female Athletes in Australian Television Sports Coverage
literature.title_cn: 什么联赛？澳大利亚电视体育报道中女运动员的呈现
literature.title_en: What League? The Representation of Female Athletes in Australian Television Sports Coverage
literature.author: Helen Caple, Kate Greenwood, Catharine Lumby
literature.abstract: This article explores why women's sport in Australia still struggles to attract sponsorship and mainstream media coverage despite evidence of high levels of participation and on-field successes. Data are drawn from the largest study of Australian print and television coverage of female athletes undertaken to date in Australia, as well as from a case study examining television coverage of the success of the Matildas, the Australian women's national football team, in winning the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) Women's Asian Cup in 2010. This win was not only the highest ever accolade for any Australian national football team (male or female), but also guaranteed the Matildas a place in the 2011 FIFA Women's World Cup in Germany [where they reached the quarter-finals]. Given the close association between success on the field, sponsorship and television exposure, this article focuses specifically on television reporting. We present evidence of the starkly disproportionate amounts of coverage across this section of the news media, and explore the circular link between media coverage, sponsorship and the profile of women's sport.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了为什么在澳大利亚，尽管有高水平的参与度和赛场成绩的证据，女子体育仍然难以吸引赞助和主流媒体关注。数据来自迄今澳大利亚进行的最大规模的女性运动员印刷和电视报道研究，以及一个考察澳大利亚女子国家足球队玛蒂尔达斯赢得2010年亚足联女足亚洲杯这一成功的电视报道案例研究。这次胜利不仅是澳大利亚任何国家足球队（男女）获得的最高荣誉，还保证了玛蒂尔达斯获得2011年在德国举办的FIFA女足世界杯参赛资格（她们在那里晋级四分之一决赛）。鉴于赛场成功、赞助和电视曝光之间的密切关联，本文特别关注电视报道。我们呈现了这一新闻媒体板块中报道量极不均衡的证据，并探讨了媒体报道、赞助与女子体育知名度之间的循环关联。

literature.title: The 2010 FIFA World Cup and women's experiences In Fan Parks
literature.title_cn: 2010年FIFA世界杯与女性在球迷公园的经历
literature.title_en: The 2010 FIFA World Cup and women's experiences In Fan Parks
literature.author: Bob, Swart
literature.abstract: abstract The existing body of research on mega-events has so far focused on wider economic impacts, with little attention being given to the social impacts of large sporting events on visitors and local residents. Specifically gender issues are neglected in relation to the FIFA World Cups since it is often assumed that these events are male dominant, both in terms of participants and spectators. However, Manzenreiter and Home (2002) indicate the growing interest among women in soccer as both participants and attendees. In South Africa a significant proportion of attendees at both stadiums and Fan Parks were women. Fan Parks in particular were introduced in the 2006 German World Cup and have emerged as key spaces for residents and tourists to experience the event outside the stadiums. During the World Cup, visitors to the host cities (non-locals! were interviewed at Fan Parks and Stadium Precincts in Durban, Cape Town and Port Elizabeth. A purposive, systematic sampling approach was adopted and interviews were conducted on all match days. Eight hundred and thirty three (833) women were interviewed at the Fan Parks in these cities. The analysis also draws on observations made by the authors at the Fan Parks. This Article presents the experiences, perceptions and concerns of these female respondents in relation to the World Cup and Fan Parks.
literature.abstract_cn: 现有关于大型赛事的研究迄今侧重于更广泛的经济影响，很少关注大型体育赛事对游客和当地居民的社会影响。具体而言，在FIFA世界杯中性别问题被忽视，因为人们通常假设这些赛事以男性为主，无论是参与者还是观众。然而，Manzenreiter和Home（2002）指出女性作为参与者和观众对足球日益增长的兴趣。在南非，体育场和球迷公园的大量参加者是女性。球迷公园特别在2006年德国世界杯引入，并已成为居民和游客在体育场外体验赛事的关键空间。世界杯期间，在德班、开普敦和伊丽莎白港的球迷公园和体育场区域采访了到访主办城市的游客（非本地人！）。采用了目的性、系统抽样方法，并在所有比赛日进行了采访。在这些城市的球迷公园采访了833名女性。分析还借鉴了作者在球迷公园的观察。本文呈现了这些女性受访者与世界杯和球迷公园相关的经历、感知和担忧。

literature.title: The crucial 'where' of motorsport marketing: is motorsport now "a race out of place"?
literature.title_cn: 赛车运动营销的关键“地点”：赛车运动如今是否“错位”？
literature.title_en: The crucial 'where' of motorsport marketing: is motorsport now "a race out of place"?
literature.author: Paul J. Tranter
literature.source_name: International Journal of Sports Marketing and Sponsorship
literature.abstract: This paper explains how the location of motorsports events is an integral part of the marketing of the sport of motor racing and of all its attendant commercial interests. Case studies of the major motorsports events staged in public street circuits in Australia are used to illustrate how the locations have particular symbolic significance that adds legitimacy to the sport of motor racing, and the messages and impacts associated with these events. The paper examines the wider significance of allowing special public spaces in cities to be used for motorsports events, and contends that the marketing of sporting events should not be considered independently of the major challenges facing the world.
literature.abstract_cn: 本文解释了赛车运动赛事的地点如何成为赛车运动及其所有相关商业利益营销的一个组成部分。对澳大利亚公共街道赛道举办的主要赛车赛事进行的案例研究，说明这些地点如何具有特定的象征意义，为赛车运动、以及与这些事件相关的信息和影响增加了合法性。本文考察了所有地点的更广泛意义。
literature.keywords: race; marketing

literature.title: Checkered Flags and Mediated Friendships: Parasocial Interaction among NASCAR Fans
literature.title_cn: 格子旗与中介化友谊：NASCAR车迷中的准社会互动
literature.title_en: Checkered Flags and Mediated Friendships: Parasocial Interaction among NASCAR Fans
literature.author: John S. W. Spinda; Adam C. Earnheardt; Lawrence W. Hugenberg
literature.abstract: Parasocial interaction (PSI) involves attraction to and subsequent relationship development with mediated characters. This study examined the nature of PSI in NASCAR fans, the fastest growing sport in the United States. Our findings indicated that PSI among NASCAR fans is a multi-dimensional concept consisting of parasocial enjoyment and parasocial attachment. Furthermore, PSI was linked to increased audience activity (involvement, intentionality and affinity), higher levels of NASCAR fandom, positive perceptions of a favorite driver’s corporate sponsors, sex, NASCAR fandom within ones family, and NASCAR viewing motives. The results of this study examine the strong parasocial bond between fan and driver and may have direct implications for marketers of NASCAR.
literature.abstract_cn: 准社会互动（PSI）涉及对媒介化人物的吸引以及随后与之建立的关系发展。本研究考察了美国增长最快的运动——NASCAR粉丝中PSI的性质。研究结果表明，NASCAR粉丝中的PSI是一个多维概念，由准社会愉悦和准社会依恋组成。此外，PSI与受众活动的增加（参与度、意向性和亲和力）、更高水平的NASCAR粉丝认同、对最喜爱车手的企业赞助商的积极看法、性别、家庭内的NASCAR粉丝认同以及NASCAR观看动机相关联。本研究的结果考察了粉丝与车手之间的强烈准社会纽带，可能对NASCAR的营销者产生直接影响。
literature.keywords: fandom; audience

literature.title: Enthusiasts, Invaders, and Custodians: Media Characterizations of Foreign Owners in Barclays Premier League
literature.title_cn: 热衷者、入侵者与守护者：媒体对巴克莱英超外国老板的描绘
literature.title_en: Enthusiasts, Invaders, and Custodians: Media Characterizations of Foreign Owners in Barclays Premier League
literature.author: Anne C. Osborne, Danielle Sarver Coombs
literature.abstract: By the end of the 2007–8 season, non-Britons owned 9 of the 20 teams competing in England’s Barclays Premier League. Of these, 3—Manchester United, Aston Villa, and Liverpool—were purchased by Americans. This article examines how the British press covered foreign takeovers between the July 2003 purchase of Chelsea and the January 2008 sale of Derby County. The thematic analysis of articles written around the times of each takeover identified 3 dominant media characterizations of incoming foreign owners: the rich enthusiast, the foreign invader, and the savvy custodian. Each characterization is explored in terms of four key dimensions: commitment, authenticity, finances, and character myths. The study suggests that in addition to media making globalization possible insofar as they actually carry sports across the globe, media, particularly sports journalism, might facilitate globalization simply by not questioning it.
literature.abstract_cn: 到2007-8赛季结束时，英格兰英超联赛的20支参赛球队中有9支为非英国人所拥有。其中，3支——曼联、阿斯顿维拉和利物浦——由美国人购买。本文考察了从2003年7月购买切尔西到2008年1月出售德比郡之间，英国新闻界如何报道外国收购。对每次收购时撰写的文章进行的主题分析，识别了对外国新东家的三种主导媒体表征：富有的爱好者、外国入侵者和精明的看护者。每种表征都从四个关键维度探讨：承诺、真实性、财务和角色神话。研究表明，除了媒体通过实际将体育传播到全球各地而使全球化成为可能之外，媒体，特别是体育新闻，可能仅仅通过不质疑全球化而促进全球化。
literature.keywords: media characterizations; foreign owners; barclays premier; premier league; enthusiasts invaders; custodians media

literature.title: NASCAR fans' responses to current and former NASCAR sponsors: the effect of perceived group norms and fan identification
literature.title_cn: NASCAR车迷对现任与前任赞助商的回应：感知群体规范与车迷认同的效应
literature.title_en: NASCAR fans' responses to current and former NASCAR sponsors: the effect of perceived group norms and fan identification
literature.author: Aron M. Levin; Fred Beasley; Richard L. Gilson
literature.source_name: International Journal of Sports Marketing and Sponsorship
literature.abstract: This research examined fans' purchase intentions towards the sponsor of a NASCAR (National Association for Stock Car Auto Racing) event and towards the previous sponsor. The study shows that fans are more likely to purchase from the current sponsor and less likely to purchase from the previous sponsor. Fan identification and perceived group norms were significant predictors of purchase intentions towards the current sponsor, but only perceived group norms predicted purchase intentions towards the ex-sponsor. Additionally, perceived group norms partially mediated the relationship between fan identification and purchase intention.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了粉丝对NASCAR（全国运动汽车竞赛协会）赛事当前赞助商和前任赞助商的购买意向。研究表明，粉丝更有可能从当前赞助商处购买，而不太可能从前任赞助商处购买。粉丝认同和感知群体规范是对当前赞助商购买意向的显著预测因素，但只有感知群体规范能预测对前任赞助商的购买意向。此外，感知群体规范部分中介了粉丝认同与购买意向之间的关系。

literature.title_en: A Detour Through `Nascar Nation'
literature.author: Joshua I. Newman
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This study offers an ethnographically informed critical interrogation of the spaces and spectacles of `NASCAR Nation'. Informed by a series of open-ended interviews with fans and administrators at NASCAR races, hundreds of hours of participant observation and spatial analysis at these events, and examination of various mediations of NASCAR driver-celebrity, spectacle, and fandom, this project illuminates the processes by which citizenship and entitlement in `NASCAR Nation' are both constructed and contested. The article also investigates the ways in which NASCAR — often referred to as America's `fastest growing sport' — has played a significant role in articulating the hegemonic structures of consumer capitalist neoliberalism and the current regime's brand of faith-based, militarized neoconservativism to the identity politics of stock car racing fandom.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究提供了对'NASCAR Nation'的空间和景观的民族志式批判性考察。基于对NASCAR赛事中粉丝和管理人员的开放式访谈、在这些赛事中数百小时的参与观察和空间分析，以及NASCAR车手-名人、景观和粉丝文化的各种媒介化的考察，本项目阐明了'NASCAR Nation'中公民身份和资格既被建构又被争夺的过程。文章还考察了NASCAR——常被称为美国'增长最快的运动'——在将消费资本主义新自由主义的霸权结构以及当前政权基于信仰的军事化新保守主义与赛车粉丝认同政治相关联方面所发挥的重要作用。

literature.title: Brand loyalty of NASCAR fans towards sponsors: the impact of fan identification
literature.title_cn: NASCAR车迷对赞助商的品牌忠诚：车迷认同的影响
literature.title_en: Brand loyalty of NASCAR fans towards sponsors: the impact of fan identification
literature.author: Aron M. Levin; Fred Beasley; Tom Gamble
literature.source_name: International Journal of Sports Marketing and Sponsorship
literature.abstract: Although brand loyalty has been cited by practitioners as one of the most important sponsorship objectives, there is little empirical research on the effect that sponsorship has on sports fans' loyalty towards sponsoring brands. Comparing a sample of NASCAR fans to a sample of non-NASCAR fans, brand loyalty towards NASCAR sponsors was measured using a scale that includes both attitudinal and behavioural components. It was found that NASCAR fans exhibited stronger brand loyalty than non-NASCAR fans to NASCAR sponsoring brands of beer, particularly on the attitudinal component of brand loyalty. Furthermore, it was found that NASCAR fans' loyalty to NASCAR sponsoring brands is significantly higher for those fans who scored high on a scale that measures fan identification. Again, this effect was significant on the attitudinal factor of brand loyalty, but not the behavioural factor.
literature.abstract_cn: 尽管品牌忠诚度被从业者引用为最重要的赞助目标之一，但关于赞助对体育粉丝忠诚于赞助品牌的影响的实证研究却很少。通过将NASCAR粉丝样本与非NASCAR粉丝样本进行比较，使用包含态度和行为成分的量表测量了NASCAR粉丝对赞助商的品牌忠诚度。研究发现，NASCAR粉丝比非NASCAR粉丝对NASCAR啤酒赞助品牌表现出更强的品牌忠诚度，尤其是在品牌忠诚度的态度成分上。此外，研究发现，在衡量粉丝认同的量表上得分高的粉丝，其NASCAR粉丝对赞助品牌的忠诚度显著更高。同样，这一效应在品牌忠诚度的态度因素上显著，但在行为因素上不显著。
literature.keywords: brand; sponsorship

literature.abstract: British television coverage of the 1990 soccer World Cup provides a context in which to explore some of the ways in which television seeks to construct coherent narratives about ongoing events. In telling such stories television draws upon distinctive narrative strategies and on extensive reservoirs of stereotypes. This is seen in elementary form in the techniques by which television commentary defines and develops particular `characters', and more elaborately in the construction of extended narrative accounts of the activities of national teams — notably, in this paper, Cameroon and England. These accounts are seen to be rooted in discourses that formulate key distinctions in terms of race and national identity, and, by circulating applications of such systems of stereotypes, television contributes to the production and reproduction of our everyday knowledge of `Them' and `Us'.
literature.abstract_cn: 英国对1990年足球世界杯的电视报道提供了一个背景，用于探索电视试图围绕进行中的事件构建连贯叙事的某些方式。在讲述这些故事时，电视利用了独特的叙事策略和大量的刻板印象储备。这在电视解说定义和发展特定"角色"的技术中以基本形式体现，并在构建关于国家队活动的扩展叙事中更详尽地体现——特别是在本文中关于喀麦隆和英格兰。这些叙述被认为植根于以种族和民族认同制定关键区分的论述，通过传播这种刻板印象系统的应用，电视为我们的日常知识中"他们"和"我们"的生产和再生产做出了贡献。
literature.keywords: stereotype; television; soccer; race

literature.title: Super Bowl: Mythic Spectacle
literature.title_cn: 超级碗：神话般的盛典
literature.title_en: Super Bowl: Mythic Spectacle
literature.author: Michael R. Real
literature.abstract: A foundational cultural/media study treating the Super Bowl as a 'mythic spectacle' — a mass-mediated ritual in which American ideology, militarism and corporate capitalism are dramatized and celebrated. Widely regarded as one of the earliest landmark analyses of sport as a media event.
literature.abstract_cn: 一项基础性的文化/媒体研究，将超级碗视为一种"神话奇观"——一种大规模媒介化的仪式，在其中美国意识形态、军国主义和企业资本主义被戏剧化和庆祝。被广泛认为是对体育作为媒体事件的最早里程碑式分析之一。
